Are you looking to further develop your profession into a career? Are you driven by opportunity?

Nextran Truck Centers is hiring!

Job Duties

The Diesel Technician is a skilled position that is responsible for repairing and maintaining our customers Medium & Heavy-Duty Trucks. This includes diagnosing issues, preventative maintenance, repairs, disassembly and re-assembly, and writing detailed work notes.

  • Diagnoses cause of malfunctions and performs repairs.
  • Performs work outlined on repair order efficiently and accurately.
  • Communicates with parts department to obtain needed parts.
  • Communicates with Service Advisor on repair updates and/or delays.
  • Documents all work performed and recommended on the repair order.
  • Understands, keeps abreast and complies with federal, state and local regulations, such as hazardous waste disposal, OSHA, etc.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Heavy-duty truck repair experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Personal tools. Basic Hand Tools
  • ASE Certification a plus
  • Experience with Mack, Volvo, Isuzu, Cummins heavy-duty trucks and engines.
  • Basic computer skills
  • Valid CDL a plus

Physical Demands

  • Regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.
  • Use of torque wrenches, air powered tools and hand tools.
  • Use of arms in a raised position above shoulder level for prolonged periods of time.
  • Frequently required to walk, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, talk and hear.
  • Entry and exit safely in and out of truck cab.
  • Regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds, and occasionally life and/or move more than 100 pounds.

Compensation: $22.00 - $30.00/hour + incentive

Summary

As a Mobile Diesel Technician, you will serve as a concierge-style field technician supporting customer fleets on-site. You become an extension of both our dealership and our customers’ operation. Every day brings new challenges and opportunities as you work closely with fleet managers, drivers, and maintenance personnel to keep equipment operating safely and efficiently.

This is not a traditional roadside emergency repair position. Instead, you will serve as a trusted technical resource for our fleet customers, delivering planned maintenance, inspections, upgrades, and repair solutions directly at their locations.

We believe our technicians are among our most valuable assets. In this role, you will not simply repair equipment, you will build lasting relationships with customers and help develop solutions that support their business. You will work directly on customer property, in their maintenance facilities, and in the field, serving as a trusted advisor and representative of our organization.

Essential Duties:

  • Scheduled preventive maintenance services
  • Factory warranty campaigns and recalls
  • Fleet-wide upgrades and retrofits
  • DOT inspections and certifications
  • Windshield replacements
  • Valve adjustments and engine services
  • Diagnostic troubleshooting and repairs
  • Customer consultations and maintenance planning
  • Coordinating transportation of equipment to our dealership service center when major repairs are required.

What We’re Looking For

  • Heavy-duty diesel repair experience
  • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent communication and customer service abilities
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • Professional appearance and positive attitude
  • Commitment to safety and quality workmanship
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and customer needs

Schedule & Pay

This position offers a dynamic work environment with variety and flexibility. Schedules may vary based on customer needs and business demands. We are committed to supporting our team members by providing flexibility whenever possible while ensuring exceptional service for our customers.

  • Performance-based wage growth opportunities
  • Additional compensation opportunities tied to industry certifications
  • Company-provided service truck stocked with tools and inventory
  • Potential authorization to take company vehicle home based on performance and business needs
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Supportive team environment
  • Opportunity to build meaningful customer relationships and make a direct impact

If you’re looking for a career where your skills, work ethic, professionalism, and positive attitude are genuinely appreciated, you’ve come to the right place. Join a team that values expertise, invests in its people, and empowers technicians to make a difference every day.

The Delivery Driver is responsible for the safe, timely, and accurate delivery and pickup of heavy-duty truck parts and accessories to customers, vendors, and internal departments. This position serves as a key representative of the dealership, providing excellent customer service while maintaining a professional appearance and attitude.

Essential Duties

  • Pull parts orders in warehouse for deliver
  • Deliver parts to customer and ensure accuracy by matching parts to invoice
  • Complete documentation necessary for the delivery and payment of goods
  • Stock items in warehouse, as needed
  • Assist in other warehouse duties, as assigned.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Valid driver’s license
  • DOT physical and resulting Medical Examiner’s Certificate required
  • Must pass a driving test
  • Effective communication skills for relationship building with customers
  • Basic math, reading, and ability to follow directions
  • High School Education or GED preferred

Notice Regarding Job Posting Scams

We are aware that fraudulent job postings and recruitment scams are becoming more common. Please be advised that legitimate communications from our company will only come from official company email addresses and through our verified hiring platforms.

We will never ask candidates to provide payment, purchase equipment, or share sensitive personal or financial information (such as bank account details or Social Security numbers) during the initial application or interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent our company, please do not respond or provide any information. Instead, report the communication to us through our official website or apply directly through our verified job postings.

Your safety and privacy are important to us, and we encourage all applicants to remain vigilant when searching for employment opportunities.

We are a network of commercial truck dealerships committed to providing the best products and services through highly skilled associates who are focused on delivering the lowest life-cycle cost to our customers. Spanning the Southeast and Midwest United States, we provide sales, parts, and service for several leading brands, including Mack, Volvo, Isuzu, GMC, Ford, Hino, and Kalmar Ottawa. EEO Employer

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Accounts Payable / Receivable, Accounting / Finance / Banking
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: 5401 Energy Air Court, Orlando, FL
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Workplace: Drug-free workplace

About this job

Process vendor invoices and subcontractor pay applications for an energy company in Orlando. Track purchase orders, maintain subcontractor insurance certificates, and ensure accurate accounting records and timely document processing.

Good fit if you have two to five years of accounts payable experience, know lien law, and understand AIA Schedule of Values.

Full job description

Job Title: Accounts Payable Specialist

Classification: Hourly/Non-Exempt

Reports to: Controller

Department: Accounting

Introduction:

  • The role of the Accounts Payable Specialist is to collect, report, and process all Vendor invoices and pay applications from subcontractors. He/she is to assure accountability, accuracy, and confidentiality of any and all payables related information and to track pay applications, invoices, purchase order receivers and unvouchered liabilities.

Functional Role:

  • The basic function of this position is to manage the smooth flow of Accounts Payable information of the company. To track all invoices and pay applications received and match all purchase order receivers to the appropriate invoices. They are also responsible for coordinating the approval of all subcontractors pay applications with the appropriate Project Manager and to ensure pay applications are posted to accounts payable in the accounting period that they apply to.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for maintaining Insurance certificates for subcontractors ensuring all insurance requirements are at the minimum amounts required by the subcontract and are current with respect to policy expiration dates.
  • Responsible for accurate accounting records of the Company’s Accounts Payable and Vendor records.
  • Maintain the close security of company Accounts Payable and Vendor records.
  • Maintain the confidentiality of company Accounts Payable and Vendor records.
  • Keep management apprised of the collection status of past due accounts and lien position within the time requirements that protect all lien rights.
  • Ensure the Accounts Payable documents are processed in a timely and error-free manner.

Requirements:

  • Education: High School diploma with courses in accounting.
  • Experience: Two to five year’s experience in Accounts Payable and AIA Schedule of Values.
  • MUST have lien law knowledge and experience.
  • Skills, knowledge, and abilities - Ability to work independently and to work well with others in a multi-functional fast paced environment. Good comprehension of Accounts Payables, Subcontractor and spreadsheet software, excellent reading, writing and verbal skills. Must understand AIA Schedule Of Values.
  • Reasoning Ability – Ability to apply principles of logical thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems, ability to deal with a variety of abstract and concrete variables, ability to manage a variety of activities simultaneously.
  • Language Skills – Ability to communicate and give answers in a clear and precise style, ability to compose standard letters with proper format, grammar, punctuation, and spelling, using all parts of speech, ability to speak with poise, voice control, and confidence, using correct English with a well modulated voice.
  • Physical – While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to talk on the phone and use a computer.
  • Work Environment - The work is normally performed in a standard office environment with usually quiet to moderate noise levels.

DFWP/EOE

About this job

Full-time administrative assistant position with the City of Leesburg Fire Department. Responsibilities include payroll processing, accounts payable, billing, public contact, and emergency operations support.

Good fit if you have public or business administration experience, strong typing skills, proficiency with Microsoft Office, and can obtain required NIMS certifications.

Full job description

Nature of Work

This position is a full-time, non-exempt, non-supervisory position reporting to, and at the direction of, Administrative Staff. The individual in this position will act as a professional assistant to the Administrative Staff. Individual(s) assigned to this position are expected to show professional conduct, be attentive to detail, demonstrate a high degree of accuracy, handle work flow consistently and efficiently, meet deadlines, follow through, keep work organized and easily accessible, think independently and problem solve, work with fire department personnel at all levels of the organization in dealing with payroll (7K) issues, and health and safety issues. Work involves responsibility for performing difficult and varied office and secretarial services, important public contact work, and administrative details for the Department Director and Senior Staff. Employee works with considerable independence in the performance of general office services and administrative routines. This position is unique in that it performs complex and paraprofessional-level duties in addition to assisting the Senior Staff and other Divisions within the organization, must be an independent thinker with the ability to make decision affecting individuals, coworkers, subordinates, and others that depend on the service.

Essential Job Functions

  • Assist in entering and processing the full payroll, including:
  • Knowledge dealing with 7K FLSA for Public Safety Personnel.
  • Receiving, organizing, and preparing all payroll information and enters data into a computerized payroll system, preparing and transmitting payroll data, receiving and reviewing payroll reports.
  • Performs accounts payable functions for payment processed through payroll including calculating and preparing remittance for employee PTO and Comp-time buy-back program.
  • Responsible for accurate computation, recordkeeping, administration and reporting, and tracking.
  • Maintain knowledge and understanding of electronic payroll processing system and assign pay codes as needed for a variety of positions and “Add Pay”.
  • Maintain accurate time off records for all personnel including PTO, sick leave (LTB), compensatory time, special leave, disability leave, and other types of time off. Complete monthly reconciliation of all time off.
  • Maintain knowledge and understanding of shift assignment, shift schedules, work back day schedules, and electronic roster system.
  • Assist with Public Safety Presentations.
  • Process fire department purchases orders
  • Prepare invoices
  • Audit and Monitor billing accounts and process fire department purchases
  • Resolve billing issues with external and internal customers
  • Monthly/Annually, collect, compile and prepare the department reports
  • Maintain office and station supplies within cost-saving budgetary guidelines
  • Responsible for receiving all incoming calls from the main Fire Department line. Gather pertinent information for the callers and provide an accurate response and/or directions to the appropriate entity or party.
  • First point of contact for greeting the visiting public/citizens and provide assistance accordingly.
  • Requires knowledge of Fire Collective Bargaining Agreement
  • Assist in Emergency Operation Center during “Declared Emergencies”
  • Monthly/Annually, collect, compile and prepare the department reports
  • Assist in various other office duties.
  • Assist with Public Safety Education and Presentation

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires a high school diploma or GED.

  • Two (2) years’ experience in public or business administration or related subject and two (2) years local government administrative experience, or an equivalent combination of training and experience which provides the required knowledge skills, and abilities. Requires four years or more of experience in performing secretarial and office work of a progressively responsible nature. Must be able to type 35cwpm. Typing test will be administered.

  • Demonstrated experience with word-processing applications (i.e.: Microsoft Word®™©), spreadsheets (i.e. Microsoft Excel®™©). Experience with HTE NaviLine and/or a multi-departmental finance and accounting system are preferred. May require occasionally working outside regular business hours. 

  • Must possess, or obtain within the first six (6) months of employment, knowledge of Fire Department payroll procedures and the ability to effectively assist personnel at all levels with payroll-related (7K) matters.

  • Notary Public (preferred)

  • Must possess a valid Florida driver’s license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment.

  • Must obtain NIMS 100, 200, 700, 800 Certifications within 90 days of employment. Must obtain NIMS 300 and 400 within 6 months of employment.

  • Monitors operation of equipment, provides minor maintenance or service and reports conditions in the field to the supervisor in a timely manner and request repairs or abatement of problems or issues in the field; 
  • Performs inspections of vehicles; performs basic maintenance activities, and keeps the interior and exterior of assigned equipment clean.  
  • Report unsafe working conditions, accidents and injuries to supervisor.
  • Inform supervisor of problems, emergency situations, unsafe or broken sanitation containers and unsafe, difficult, or poorly maintained collection sites.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with co-workers and the general public, using good judgment to resolve customer complaints in a positive and timely manner, using tact and courtesy.
  • Complete paperwork, forms, and reports related to collection services.
  • Attends meetings to exchange information; attends in-service training to gain or improve skills. 
  • Provide support as needed during special events and activities involving the delivery, setup, and removal of sanitation containers from field locations; assist in maintaining refuse containers in clean, working condition; perform other special event/activity tasks as needed;
  • Perform related duties as assigned and follows applicable standards and department-specific safety policies and practices.

Minimum Requirements

Requires a High school diploma or general equivalency diploma (GED).

Requires one year of experience in the operation of medium-sized trucks or equipment such as garbage trucks required; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience, which provides the necessary knowledge, skills and abilities for this job.

Requires knowledge of traffic laws, ordinances, and rules for operating a class B commercial vehicle; including experience reading and understanding route maps and street signs.

Requires an orientation of up to three weeks. Duties are performed under training and close supervision until proficiency is demonstrated.

Weekend, holiday and afterhours work may be required, as well as after-hours response and emergencies.

Requires the ability to work under a minimum degree of stress related to duties that require constant attention to detail and tight deadlines. 

Requires the ability to follow specific oral and written instructions

Requires a valid State of Florida Class B Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) with airbrake endorsement and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment.

Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

Quick facts

  • Pay: $23.56 to $34.82 an hour

About this job

Provides accounting functions for the City of Leesburg including reconciliation, payroll tracking, fixed asset management, and financial reporting. Works with accounts under general supervision and prepares audit documents.

Good fit if you have an associate degree in accounting or related field, one year of accounting experience, and a valid Florida driver's license.

Full job description

Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to provide accounting functions in conformance with generally accepted accounting principles. The class is responsible for accounting, disbursement, maintenance, review, interpretation, analysis and reconciliation of accounts within assigned area of responsibility. The class works within a general outline of work to be performed, and develops work methods and sequences under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Performs accounting functions in accordance with Federal, State, and local laws, rules, and requirements for assigned accounts.
  • Reconciles all funds and accounts for assigned areas of responsibility; researches discrepancies, collects information, and reports findings.
  • Tracks payroll activity for all departments and related funds.
  • Tracks fixed assets for General and Capital funds; inventories fixed assets.
  • Posts payments, journal and general ledger entries as assigned.
  • Prepares required financial reports such as worker’s compensation, pension, 941, element object reconciliation etc.
  • Prepares audit documents, assists with or performs audits.
  • Performs data entry of all financial activities for assigned accounts and funds; verifies and reconciles accuracy of data entered.
  • Attends staff or project meetings to exchange information; attends in-service training and technical or professional classes, seminars, or conferences to improve technical or professional skills.
  • Performs routine office tasks, such as typing, filing, faxing, phoning, and copying.

Minimum Requirements

Requires an Associate of Science Degree (A.S.), Vocational Technical Degree, specialized training, or self-education equivalent to satisfactory completion of two years of college education with emphasis in accounting or a closely related field.

Requires one year of work experience in accounting.

Must possess a valid Florida driver’s license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment.

Nature of Work

Wastewater Collections Tech Apprentice - $18.62

The purpose of the class is to perform routine manual work in the Wastewater Collections division. This class is responsible for service work such as digging trenches, cleaning ditches; assists with installation of fixtures such as pipes, valves, fittings, and manholes; landscape, road, sidewalk, driveway restoration and other outdoor work. Completes logs or routine records. The class works according to set procedures under direct supervision. Weekend, holiday and after-hours work may be required, as well as after-hours response and emergencies.

Tech “C” - $21.78

This class is responsible for service work such as digging trenches, cleaning ditches; assists with installation of fixtures such as pipes, valves, fittings, and manholes; landscape, road, sidewalk, driveway restoration and other outdoor work, completing logs or routine records, operating light to medium mobile equipment, minor equipment maintenance, assisting and supporting City facility and area maintenance, and minor administrative tasks. Tech “B” - $23.56

The class works according to written and verbal procedures, but decides how and when to do things with minor supervision. Weekend, holiday and after-hours work may be required, as well as after-hours response and emergencies.

Nature of Work

Buyer - $24.50 - $36.21 per hour

The purpose of this position is to perform responsible specialized work in procurement of assigned types of commodities at competitive prices in connection with the Central Procurement Operation of the City. Employees in this classification do detailed work involved in purchasing assigned commodity groups, including review of requisitions. Work involves the ability to communicate with vendors and City personnel in order to discern needs and ability to furnish needed materials. The employee exercises considerable judgment and initiative in the performance of work tasks. Work is performed under the general supervision of the Procurement Manager and Senior Buyer in accordance with established policies and is reviewed through observation and analysis of reports. Works with supervisor to prepare specifications for bidding and quoting purposes. Prepares bid packets, and quote packets, and public advertisement of tabulations.

Senior Buyer – $26.50 - $39.17 per hour 

The purpose of this position is to perform highly specialized work in the purchase of a variety of complex commodities for the City.  Employees in this classification function at senior professional level to perform detailed work in the preparation, research, writing, evaluating and administration of solicitations and contracts. The position consists of technical and professional work in the procurement of goods and services in compliance with federal, state and local policies and procedures. The Senior Buyer may act on behalf of the Procurement Manager in their absence. This position ensures proper administration of the solicitations, specifications, scopes of work and resulting agreements or contracts, purchase orders issued by the City in support of departmental activity.  Leads and participates in work of other staff within the division.

Essential Job Functions

Buyer 

  • Purchases assigned commodities, supplies, services and equipment.
  • Evaluates requisitions and confers with department representatives on specifications, quantity, quality and delivery requirements of merchandise.
  • Solicits and analyzes written and verbal quotations for materials, supplies, services and equipment.
  • Performs expediting and follow-up activities to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Interviews vendors and their representatives and maintains close contact by telephone and correspondence.
  • Contacts suppliers and vendors regarding condition of goods and errors in shipment, prices and extensions.
  • Assists in establishing schedules for purchases and term contracts for annual requirements.
  • Assists in preparation of manuals and procedures.
  • Assists with the administration of the procurement card program.
  • Remains familiar with the State of Florida Contracts system.
  • Exercises responsibility to assist Procurement Manager in administration of purchasing procedures for all City acquisitions.
  • Performs some general clerical functions, filing, answering telephone, taking messages, inventory functions and other support activities, as required.
  • Performs special assignments.
  • Works with supervisor to prepare specifications for bidding and quoting purposes.        Prepares bid packets, and quote packets, and public advertisement of tabulations.
  • Creates, monitors and recommends award of formal bids as directed by the Procurement Manager.
  • Creates, monitors and facilitates the evaluation of formal RFP’s as directed by the Procurement Manager. 
  • Maintains awareness of the material requirements of all City departments.
  • Candidate must be highly proficient in the use of a personal computer and associated general software such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.  Procurement staff are responsible for completing their own correspondence and all computer related data entry.
  • Reads technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports, forms, and business letters; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form.  
  • Performs specialized technical and professional work requiring general understanding of operating policies and procedures and their application to problems not previously encountered; applies specialized technical or professional principles and practices in the solution of problems; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results and occasional exposure to unusual pressure.
  • Directs actions of others, making decisions almost constantly, affecting coworkers and City staff.
  • Performs related functions as required.

Senior Buyer 

  • Performs complex and specialized purchasing work according to generally accepted public procurement principles. Provides initial and ongoing support to the department staff assigned to all types of complex and simple procurement functions for all City Departments.
  • Serves as the liaison between City departments and the procurement division for all department needs related to procurement.
  • Prepares and reviews justifications, specifications, and scopes of work for high dollar and complex procurement; performs complex purchasing work according to, regulatory requirements applicable to the work, City Procurement Policy/Code, established policies and procedures, and departmental guidelines.
  • Monitors, reviews and processes departmental requisitions, specifications and procurement related to City Agreements and City Commission agenda items for accuracy and conformance with established policies and procedures; communicates with various department users to determine needs for contractual and consultant services, commodities, materials, supplies and equipment. 
  • Prepares specifications, legal advertisements, invitations and addendums to bid, Requests for Proposals, solicitation schedules, contracts, contract amendments and options of renewals; advertises formal bids and solicits quotations; assists with facilitating bid openings and tabulations; conducts pre-solicitation conferences; conducts solicitation evaluation process and price analysis; reviews post-award documents.
  • Prepares formal solicitations and works with departments to develop scope of services and/or specifications, conditions and requirements; works with department users to evaluate complex bids to ensure compliance and consistency with purchasing policies and regulations while fulfilling department needs; prepares and issues purchase orders; assists departments with vendor disputes.
  • Tracks purchase requisitions and purchase orders on computer; investigates any outstanding purchase orders, invoices or inquiries; works closely with requesting divisions/offices and the supplier to reconcile problems pertaining to delivery of goods, procurement process and/or receiving for the payment of goods.
  • Conducts meetings, interviews vendors, evaluates new products, and solicits user feedback for needed goods and services; coordinates and conducts meetings and training sessions with City staff.
  • Communicates with vendors on product pricing, specifications and availability; participates in solicitation reviews and debriefings with vendors; discusses results with department users.
  • Assists in the development, drafting, and review of new/revised procedures, and programs related to purchasing and contract administration.
  • Reads technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports, forms, and business letters; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form.  
  • Performs supervisory work involving policy and guidelines, solving both people and work-related issues.
  • Performs addition and subtraction, multiplication and division and/or calculates ratios, rates and percentages.
  • Performs specialized technical and professional work requiring general understanding of operating policies and procedures and their application to problems not previously encountered; applies specialized technical or professional principles and practices in the solution of problems; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results and occasional exposure to unusual pressure.
  • Directs actions of others, making decisions almost constantly, affecting coworkers and City staff.
  • Performs related functions as required.

Minimum Requirements

Buyer 

  • Requires a high school diploma or GED.  Associates degree with major or minor course work in business administration, public administration, or related field or an equivalent combination of experience and education.  Work experience will be considered in lieu of college degree or credits.
  • A minimum of three (3) years’ experience in the following: procurement, supply activity, assisting with contract negotiations or contract management.  Experience in government or municipal procurement is highly desirable.   
  • Must be able to communicate clearly orally and in writing.
  • Must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.  These programs are used on a daily basis in performing the duties of this position. Must be capable of using or learning to use on-line web hosted software applications for bid management, vendor notifications and contract administration/management. Must be capable of using or learning to use virtual meeting software applications to host online meetings related to Solicitations, presentations and City department training and collaboration.
  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 
  • Public procurement certification (such as CPPB, NIGP-CPP or CPP) is preferred, but not required.

 Senior Buyer 

  • Graduation from a four (4) year accredited college with major or minor course work in business administration or related field or an equivalent combination of experience and education.  A college degree is desirable but not required. Work experience will be considered in lieu of college degree or credits.
  • Four (4) or more years’ experience in one or more of the following: procurement, buying, supply activity, contract negotiation or contract management.  Experience in the government or municipal sector is highly desirable.
  • Must be able to communicate clearly orally and in writing. 
  • Must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft Word and Microsoft Excel software programs. These programs are used on a daily basis in performing the duties of this position. Must be capable of using or learning to use on-line web hosted software applications for bid management, vendor notifications and contract administration/management. Must be capable of using or learning to use virtual meeting software applications to host online meetings related to Solicitations, presentations and City department training and collaboration.
  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 
  • Public procurement certification (such as CPPB, NIGP-CPP or CPP) is preferred, but not required.

About this job

Workers typically perform a variety of tasks, which may, include any combination of the following: light carpentry, digging, raking, sprinkler installation and repair, painting and power washing and completing logs or routine records. The class works according to set procedures under direct supervision.

  • Follows instructions and orders of supervisor.

  • Must possess a valid State of Florida driver license and a satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment at time of hire.

About this job

Maintain City of Leesburg buildings, facilities, grounds, and irrigation systems. Handle installation, repair, and modification of electrical, plumbing, HVAC, carpentry, and mechanical systems, plus park maintenance and required documentation.

Good fit if you have four years of trades experience and working knowledge of plumbing, HVAC, and electrical work.

Full job description

Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to maintain City buildings, facilities, grounds, and irrigation systems. The class is responsible for installation, modification, maintenance, and repair of facilities including electrical, carpentry, mechanical, plumbing, painting, masonry, outdoors structures and fixtures, and completing logs, forms, and reports. Also responsible for the efficient maintenance of City parks. The class works according to some procedures; decides how and when to do things under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Inspects or monitors condition of buildings, structures, fixtures, equipment, and outside structures for needed maintenance or repairs
  • Initiates installation, modification, construction, maintenance or repair actions in response to inspections or work orders in regards to plumbing, HVAC, and electrical. 
  • Estimates materials and determines tools, support equipment, or other things needed for job; secures needed items and transports to job site.
  • Performs indoor maintenance including painting, carpentry, plumbing, electrical or mechanical repairs, fixture moving or repair, and other.
  • Performs outdoor maintenance including concrete work, painting, roof replacing or repairs, structure or fixture repair, and other.
  • Assists other departments or offices with maintenance tasks.
  • Maintains job-related forms such as logs, activity reports, material reports, and other.
  • Operate a wide variety of Maintenance equipment. 
  • Work in adverse weather conditions.
  • Work independently or with other staff.
  • Effectively communicate and deal with public.

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires a high school diploma or GED. Requires a minimum of four years of job-related experience.

  • Must have a good working knowledge of plumbing – repairs and maintenance, HVAC preventative maintenance, and electrical troubleshooting/minor repairs.

  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and a satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 

  • Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Law Enforcement (Police / Deputy), Government / Public Safety
Job.JobDescription:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to protect life and property, enforce laws, and investigate crime. The class is responsible for surveillance, law enforcement, investigations, apprehension, and reporting. The class works according to procedures; decides how and when to do things under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Conducts routine patrols in residential and business areas; maintains contact with businesses and residents to establish good relations.
  • Responds to calls for police service and responds to crimes, domestic disputes, disturbances, disputes among neighbors, juveniles, or other incidents; apprehends law breakers as necessary; conducts follow-up investigations of crimes and other incidents, conducts surveillance of areas for suspected or potential criminal activity
  • Provides information and/or assistance to the public, informing citizens of services in the community, or providing referrals to other city, county, or state agencies.
  • Maintains the peace and safety of the community by quelling public disturbances and maintaining order at group functions.
  • Provides for the safe and convenient flow of traffic and pedestrians within the community, investigates traffic accidents, enforces traffic violations, promotes vehicular and pedestrian safety, reports unsafe road conditions, and conducts DUI or other investigations.
  • Issues civil or legal documents such as traffic citations; prepares written reports, forms, and other documents as required; may testifies in civil and criminal court proceedings or give depositions.
  • Provides specialized police service when trained and assigned such as K-9, Bicycle Patrol, Motorcycle Patrol, or other.  
  • May perform administrative or specialized functions when trained and assigned such as administrative support services, property and evidence, field and firearms training, public information, athletics, or other. 

Minimum Requirements

Requires a high school diploma or GED. Applicants currently serving in the military or currently employed as a certified law enforcement officer, seeking to relocate to this area and hold a valid driver's license, will be eligible to test and interview. Police Recruit opportunity also available to anyone interested in becoming a Police Officer with our agency. Prior or current attendance at a Law Enforcement academy is not required to be eligible to test and interview. However, if offered a recruit opportunity, the applicant will be required to enroll in a State of Florida approved Criminal Justice Training Center for Law Enforcement Certification Training or Comparative Compliance Course prior to commencing employment. All applicants must pass the State Exam prior to becoming a Police Officer. Reserve Police Officer opportunities may also be available, as needed, and applicants must meet the minimum requirements noted within this description.

An eligibility list will be established for future openings.  

Employee must live within a 20-mile radius of the Leesburg city limits within 15 months of employment. 

Marginal Job Functions

This position gathers, organizes, analyzes, examines, or evaluates data or information and may prescribe action based on such data or information.  Persuades or influences others in favor of a service, point of view, or course of action; may enforce laws, rules, regulations, or ordinances.  Handles or uses machines, tools, or equipment that requires moderate instruction and experience such as protective equipment, police vehicles, firearms, computers, and software programs such as word processing, spreadsheets or custom law enforcement applications.  Performs skilled work involving rules/systems but solves problems almost constantly.   Performs addition and subtraction, multiplication and division and/or calculates ratios, rates and percent. Reads technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports, forms, and letters; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form. Performs technical tasks requiring a wide range of procedures and requiring intensive understanding of a restricted field or complete familiarity with the functions of a unit or small division of an operating agency; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results or occasional exposure to unusual pressure.  Guides others, making frequent decisions, affecting the individual, coworkers, and others that depend on the service or product.

Full job description

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Change the future with us.

At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future.  We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow’s reality. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds


Position Overview:

We are seeking a Director, Global Strategic Partnerships, responsible for managing our AWS (Amazon Web Services) partnership reporting to our global partner ecosystem team. You will be responsible for shaping and delivering on our strategy to build mindshare and use of Siemens Xcelerator portfolio with AWS and their clients. Your responsibilities will include developing business, GTM, and technical relationships with AWS and their client base to identify where we can unlock significant joint business potential.  Key business metrics for success include joint solutions, pipeline development, lead generation, and deal closure influenced by AWS.


Essential Functions:

The ideal candidate will possess a strong Partner management background along with an understanding of all the elements that are required to enable and grow our AWS partnership.  This role is senior in nature and will seek bring a consolidated approach to this partnership by aligning our teams to one strategy and enabling consistent execution.

  • Manage the strategic partner relationship, operational framework, and communications with AWS at the executive level
  • Develop and execute the strategic business plan to achieve mutual targets across market, sell, build, and run partnership motions

  • Design, build and execute joint GTM strategies that align with the business plan and objectives

Skills Required:

    influence without direct control over product, sales and marketing
  • Maximize impact of resources aligned to partnership and orchestrate engagement and alignment of global resources invested in developing the AWS partnership
  • Demonstrated ability to get things done, build consensus, resolve conflict, and solve tough business problems, working in concert with others
  • Highest levels of written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • A keen sense of ownership, drive, and execution
  • Knowledge of PLM and/or Siemens Digital Industries Software strategy and product portfolio desired

Education and Experience Requirement:

  • Prior experience working with AWS products & Services including AWS go-to-market strategy, partner programs, Cloud solutions, and marketplace
  • Will currently reside in the continental USA
  • The right person will be both strategic and tactical, possessing 10+ years of business development, strategic partnerships, account management, solution selling, or program/product management experience in the software industry.
  • Experience with managing software or digital-related partnerships (alliances, sales, or technical)
  • Very strong written, oral, and social communication skills
  • Strong ability to influence without direct control
  • Degree required.  MBA, Masters, or equivalent executive level experience

Working Conditions/Physical Requirements:

  • Normal office environment or virtual work environment
  • Up to approximately 25% of travel may be required
NOTE: Applicants must not require employer sponsored work Visa authorization, now or in the future for employment in the USA. 

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Job.JobTitle: Learning Program Manager for Partner Enablement - m/f/d
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Remote

About this job

Design and deliver a global partner enablement program for Siemens, consolidating fragmented learning content across Sales Units into a single, role-based learning experience. Work remotely from any Siemens location, coordinating with cross-functional teams to build partner certification paths and maintain content governance.

Good fit if you have experience designing B2B or partner learning programs, understand partner/channel ecosystems, and can coordinate content across multiple stakeholders without formal authority.

Full job description

Location: Any Siemens location in the world

Learning Program Manager for Partner Enablement

Overview

The Learning Program Manager for Partner Enablement will own the global partner enablement program that brings together what currently exists in silos across Sales Units into a single, coherent partner learning experience, working at the intersection of FS SEA and FS PAR.

How you will make an impact with us as Learning Program Manager for Partner Enablement (f/m/d):

Partner Enablement Program Design & Delivery

  • Audit existing partner enablement assets across all Sales Units – mapping what exists, where it lives, and where the gaps are.
  • Design and build a single global partner enablement program, consolidating fragmented Sales Unit content into one coherent, role-based learning journey.
  • Define the program architecture: learning paths by partner type, tier, and role, aligned to the global partner program framework owned by FS PAR.
  • Coordinate with FS PAR Programs and FS PAR PS&OP to translate partner certification standards and capability requirements into structured learning content.

Content Development & Governance

  • Commission and co-create partner-specific learning content with SMEs across Sales Units, FS PAR, and Marketing – applying the enablement design standards set by FS SEA SE.
  • Maintain the partner enablement content lifecycle: create, update, and retire assets in line with program and partner program changes.
  • Curate partner enablement content, ensuring partners and internal teams access the right assets at the right time.
  • Track content usage and quality, reducing duplication and retiring low-value material to keep the program lean and credible.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Needs Translation

  • Work with FS PAR to understand partner strategy, program changes, and enablement priorities – translating business requirements into concrete program briefs and delivery plans.
  • Partner with SMEs across FS PAR, Sales Units, and Marketing to develop partner-facing enablement assets, including content for Highspot, knowledge boards, and partner certification paths.
  • Coordinate with P&O on learning platform operations, curriculum frameworks, and certification infrastructure to make partner programs accessible, trackable, and scalable across the enterprise.
  • Align with FS SEA AC on adoption and change requirements when partner enablement programs accompany broader tool rollouts or process changes.

Program Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Track program effectiveness using defined success measures and adoption objectives – gathering feedback from partner audiences and Sales Units to assess relevance and impact.
  • Monitor learning adoption data and surface patterns or gaps to the Sales Enablement team, contributing inputs to the enterprise-level enablement measurement framework.
  • Maintain and update partner enablement content on a regular cycle – retiring outdated material and keeping the program catalogue current as partner strategy and program structures evolve.

What you bring

Experience & skills

  • Hands-on experience designing and managing learning programs in a B2B or partner/channel context – including role-based curriculum design, content production, and LMS delivery.
  • Practical knowledge of partner or channel ecosystems: familiarity with partner tiers, certification models, and the enablement needs of distributors, resellers, or system integrators.
  • Demonstrated ability to consolidate fragmented content from multiple sources into a structured, governed program – comfortable working across Sales Units or business divisions.
  • Experience coordinating with SMEs, content creators, and platform teams to build and maintain a scalable content library.

Ways of working

  • Collaborative and organized – able to manage multiple program workstreams in parallel, coordinating across FS SEA, FS PAR, Sales Units and marketing without formal authority over content owners or delivery partners.
  • Practical and delivery-focused – comfortable moving between program design, hands-on content build, and logistics coordination as the situation requires.
  • Comfortable working in a greenfield environment where enablement frameworks and governance models are still being established – willing to contribute to process design, not just follow established procedures.
  • University degree in a relevant discipline; advanced degree is a plus.
  • Familiarity with technology company operating models is a benefit, not a requirement.

Languages

High proficiency in written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus.

Please note, this position will be based in the Siemens location where the selected candidate currently is located. The role has been assessed as level 6 (GRIP level). The actual compensation range will vary based on work location, applicable salary structure, experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Candidates will receive compensation information relevant to their location during the recruitment process in accordance with local legal requirements and Siemens compensation practices. For further information regarding the compensation details that apply to you and your country, please contact the recruiter directly.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce.

At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us. 

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Title: Senior Project Manager, LV Electrical Products, Industrial Distribution

Location: Peachtree Corners, GA (Remote)

Are you looking for a company that empowers talent?

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation!

From Day 1, you are empowered to create an impact with your full potential and creativity to make a difference for tomorrow.

We truly have an inclusive and diverse team culture where you can be yourself. Our extensive global presence offers a diverse range of career opportunities across various industries, nations, and job domains, empowering our workforce to continuously enhance their skills and stay competitive.

Create a better tomorrow with us!

We are looking for a Dynamic Project Manager for Low Voltage Electrical Products including Switchgear, Switchboards, Busway, and downstream products. This position reports to the Director of Industrial Vertical in the Project Management Organization. The successful candidate will interface with both internal and external customers to execute mid and high-level complexity electrical distribution projects within the Industrial Market that include Chemical, Oil & Gas, Automotive, Food & Beverage, EV Infrastructure, and Aerospace among others. This position allows for remote working with less than 20% travel required.

Where you will shine:

  • Decision clarity under pressure—you separate noise from facts and act decisively
  • Customer stewardship—you reset expectations when confronted with customer issues and can make the best decision for Siemens and the customer while maintaining the customer relationship.
  • Resourcefulness—you make progress with limited authority and unlock cross‑functional help.

Over your first 90 days you can expect the following.

  • 30 days: You will receive training on our products, systems, processes, and organization. You will shadow a live project and then be assigned a new project with assistance from a buddy that is on our Team. You are receiving on the job training as you are managing the phases of your project.
  • 60 days: You will be assigned a second new project to manage and/or take over 1–2 projects that are already in progress. 
  • 90 days: You own a project portfolio consisting of 3–5 projects of varying sizes and scope. 

You will make an impact with the following responsibilities:

  • Project manager for multiple projects across the country
  • Accountable for order execution including schedule, financial, and commissioning performance
  • Create baseline project schedules and reset customer expectations (if required) upon project kickoff.
  • Set firm expectations on expected product release dates.
  • Use COMPAS to make configuration changes related to project changes or material adds to orders.
  • Collaborate with multiple internal and external stakeholders to resolve project issues.
  • Increase business unit margins through positive value adds to change orders, price escalations and selling extended warranties.
  • Track and keep customers updated on pressing project issues.
  • Track ship shorts
  • Provide Financial Invoice Summaries and reconciliation support to closeout project at the completion of contracted scope of supply.
  • Coordinate deliveries with project site
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex issues and challenges.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive improvements across organizations.
  • Apply skills to resolve complex problems to ensure successful delivery of projects pursuant to customer deliverables and agreed upon contract terms.
  • Display a high level of critical thinking in bringing successful resolution to high impact,
  • complex and/or cross-functional problems.
  • Develop risk mitigation plans to preempt potential problems through the application of
  • concepts, techniques, knowledge, processes, and lessons learned.
  • Comply with Siemens’ policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrate ownership of the project with minimal intervention from Sales.
  • Assist and support in warranty related claims while balancing best bottom-line results and customer experience.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • BA/BS in engineering or business administration.
  • 5 plus years of experience in the application and concepts of Low Voltage Products.
  • Experience with SAP, and exposure to Tableau etc.
  • Must be eligible to work in the US with no sponsorship now or in the future. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • BS in engineering
  • Working with distributors, contractors (electrical and general), and in construction market
  • Current PMI Project Management Professional certification or equivalent 
  • Demonstrates problem solving skills to stakeholders on various Low Voltage Electrical Systems products.
  • Maintains excellent organizational skills to store critical company and customer files including Emails, Purchase Agreements, Contract Drawings and Specifications, Bid Proposals, Project
  • Schedules, Meeting Minutes, Submittal documents

Job.JobTitle: Building Automation Systems Project Management Internship
Job.JobDescription:
Building Automation Systems Project Management Internship 

Location: Tyndall Air Force Base

Undergraduate: Rising Sophomore, Junior or Senior

Duration: 10 weeks
Start Dates: May 17, May 24, June 7 or June 14, 2027
Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

Who designs your future?  You do. 

Are you looking for an internship where you can showcase your technical aptitude and passion for problem solving to ensure customers can work in a comfortable, safe, and energy-efficient environment? Does gaining hands-on experience, real-world skills and valuable knowledge while developing yourself professionally sound exciting to you? 

Join our Siemens Smart Buildings Internship Program as a Building Automation Systems Project Management Intern in Summer 2027! 

What is Building Automation?

Siemens Building Automation Systems is a building management system (BMS) that automatically manages and controls all systems within a building. These systems include lighting, heating, cooling, ventilation, fire detection and notification, CCTV, door and window controls, water and waste management. It consists of sensors, controllers, software and communication devices. Siemens offers building automation systems for all building types and sizes, and for every use. The system is designed to manage a wide range of building systems, such as HVAC, lighting, security, fire safety, and other critical building functions.

Click HERE to learn more about Siemens’ Building Automation and Control Systems.

What you will do as a Building Automation Systems Project Management Intern

  • During this 10-week internship program, you will rotate through various departments at the local branch office, focusing on smart buildings and sustainable infrastructure
  • 80% of your time will be spent on project management-related activities (learning how to manage a construction project, on-the-job training, and shadowing, etc.)
  • 10% of your time with be spent with the sales department learning how we go-to-market and sell our solutions and services
  • 10% of your time will be spent in our service department, focusing on the service-related tasks needed to deliver world-class service to Siemens customers
  • You may get experience rotating through our core business segments, which include HVAC, Fire/Life Safety, Security, and Energy/Sustainability Systems

Responsibilities while working alongside current Project Managers and Associate Project Manager, you will:

  • Review project specifications, drawings, and project-specific documents to establish a project delivery plan
  • Develop and maintain a project schedule, as well as coordinate needs with the project team, identifying time-sensitive installation needs
  • Manage the procurement of supplies and materials to complete projects
  • Participate in project cost reviews
  • Track labor resources and project progress
  • Pursue project-specific change-order opportunities
  • Complete project-specific close-out documentation
  • Rotate through other departments within the branch office to learn about how our branch organization operates as a whole
 

The goal of this internship program is to develop future talent for the Siemens organization and help you identify where you may be interested in pursuing a career at Siemens post-graduation.  

To apply for the Building Automation Systems Project Management Internship Program, candidates must meet the following requirements:

  • Must be current enrollment as an undergraduate at an accredited 4-year U.S. college or university.
  • Pursing a degree in Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Energy/Sustainability and Built Environment.
  • Rising Sophomore, Junior or Senior
  • Ability to work 40-hours per week for the 10-week program (May - July or June - August)
  • You will be provided with a one-time lump sum housing stipend to assist with expenses associated with your room and board, if you are required to move more than 50 miles from your permanent home address. 
    • This housing stipend will be a fully taxable benefit and will be reported as income on your W-2 form.
  • This program does not support students on a Visa such as F1, J1, M1 and H1B as well as OPT/CPT.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications: 

  • Must be able to use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet
  • Must have reliable transportation to travel to job sites.  Miles traveled will be reimbursed.  
  • Skilled in using Windows laptops and adept at learning new software for programming and troubleshooting automation equipment.
  • Ability to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers
  • Demonstrated leadership potential
  • Strong analytical, writing, presentation and critical thinking skills
  • Good verbal and written communication skills in English

About this job

Full job description

Location: Any Siemens location in the world

Lead Incentive Compensation Analyst

Company Overview

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential

Position Overview

Welcome to Foundational Sales – a new global organization at Siemens level. Our mission is to build ONE Sales Fabric: a consistent, scalable, and data-driven go-to-market foundation that empowers our Sales Units to win in their Verticals and markets – and that makes it easier for our customers to do business with Siemens. Our work spans five focus areas – Process & Data Domain, Sales Enablement & Activation, Digital Sales Channel, Vertical Governance & Operations, and Partner Sales. Together, we create the shared standards, systems, and AI-enabled capabilities behind one coordinated face to the customer. Do you want to help redefine how a global tech company sells in the AI era? Then join us – and through radical collaboration and the “Together, unless” principle, help unlock the power of ONE.

Process & Data Domain sets clear common standards for internal-facing processes, data, and the application backbone – acting as the business interface to IT for how common sales applications and related data fit together across the company.

Within it, Global Sales Applications owns the main global sales tools – including Salesforce CRM, ICM / Anaplan, rebate management, and quoting applications – and works with IT DevOps and FS SEA to maintain, improve, roll out, and train users on these applications.

What we offer you: At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

Key Responsibilities

How you will make an impact with us as Incentive Compensation Analyst:

Incentive Compensation Administration

• Administer incentive compensation plans, quotas and crediting rules across Sales Units – supporting accurate compensation calculations, payout execution and dispute resolution in line with agreed governance controls.

• Maintain compensation documentation, plan rules and governance records, ensuring the incentive framework stays current, auditable and aligned with business decisions made by Sales Finance, HR and Sales leadership.

• Configure compensation rules, sales hierarchies, quota assignments and attainment calculations within the incentive management platform, working with IT DevOps to implement and test changes accurately.

• Support annual plan rollouts – coordinating plan communication, compensation statement generation and user onboarding activities across Sales Units.

Platform & Process Management

• Support the incentive management platform (ICM / Anaplan) and related business processes – maintaining system configurations, resolving operational issues and coordinating enhancements with IT DevOps.

• Partner with Salesforce CRM, ERP, Payroll and HR teams to maintain end-to-end process integrity across the incentive compensation lifecycle – from quota assignment and crediting through payout and reconciliation.

• Gather and document business requirements from Sales, Finance and HR, translating compensation plan logic and business rules into platform configurations and process specifications.

• Identify process gaps, data inconsistencies and integration issues between the incentive platform and connected systems, and coordinate resolution with the relevant IT and business stakeholders.

Data, Reporting & User Support

• Monitor compensation, territory and quota data quality – applying governance standards and resolving data issues that could affect calculation accuracy or payout integrity.

• Maintain compensation reports, performance dashboards and payout analytics that give Sales management and Finance clear, timely visibility of incentive outcomes.

• Analyse payout trends, attainment distributions and process exceptions to identify improvement opportunities and support fact-based decisions on compensation plan design.

• Respond to compensation enquiries from sales teams and managers, providing clear, accurate and timely resolution of calculation questions, disputes and plan clarifications.

Qualifications

• Three or more years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Compensation Administration, Finance or Commercial Operations, with direct involvement in incentive compensation programs.

• Hands-on experience supporting sales compensation and incentive management processes, including quota management, crediting, attainment calculation, payout execution and dispute resolution.

• Experience with incentive management or planning platforms such as Anaplan, Xactly, Varicent or CaptivateIQ; familiarity with Salesforce CRM is a plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience working with large datasets and delivering accurate, timely performance and compensation reporting.

• Confidence working across Sales, Finance, HR and IT teams, with the ability to translate complex compensation logic into clear platform configurations and process documentation.

• University degree in a relevant discipline; advanced degree is a plus. High proficiency in written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

We are Siemens:

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.

You’ll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We’re committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!.

Full job description

Research Intern – Scientific Machine Learning for Physics and Simulation

 

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. You will join the Physics x AI research lab within Siemens’ Data and Artificial Intelligence organization — our central research hub for artificial intelligence — for a Spring 2027 internship.

We are looking for a Research Intern in Scientific Machine Learning for Physics and Simulation. This position will be remote.

 

You’ll make an impact by:

•     Developing and evaluating neural surrogate models that predict physical fields and engineering quantities on complex geometries.

•     Incorporating physical laws, boundary conditions, and engineering knowledge into artificial intelligence models.

•     Studying model accuracy and generalization across geometries, meshes, and operating conditions.

•     Designing experiments with appropriate baselines, ablation studies, and reproducible evaluation.

•     Implementing research prototypes, data pipelines, and GPU training workflows, and validating predictions together with simulation experts.

•     Communicating findings through technical reports, presentations, and scientific papers.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:  

 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Currently enrolled as a PhD student in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Research experience in machine learning and deep learning, including developing and evaluating new methods.
  • Hands-on experience developing and training neural networks in Python with PyTorch or a comparable deep-learning framework, including designing experiments and comparing models against baselines.
  • A sound foundation in linear algebra, optimization, probability, and numerical computation.
  • A background in physics, engineering, or physical modeling, with the ability to learn new scientific concepts with guidance from domain experts, and clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimal travel required (less than 10%).
  • Proficient in English both written and verbal
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Publications at leading artificial intelligence conferences (for example, NeurIPS, ICML, or ICLR), or in relevant scientific journals.
  • Surrogate modeling, neural operators, geometry-aware machine learning, or graph neural networks for meshes, point clouds, or CAD geometry.
  • Physics-informed machine learning, differentiable simulation, uncertainty quantification, or learning from limited simulation data.
  • Scientific foundation models, multimodal learning, or generative artificial intelligence (pretraining, fine-tuning, diffusion, or flow-based models) for physical prediction, geometry generation, or inverse design.
  • Agentic artificial intelligence for tool use and simulation workflows, or reinforcement learning for engineering design, optimization, or control.
  • Computational fluid dynamics, heat transfer, numerical PDE methods, or multiphysics modeling (for example, Simcenter STAR-CCM+, OpenFOAM, or NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo), and GPU or distributed computing for large simulation datasets.

This position is centered on driving deep technical competency in the Industrial Metaverse, serving as a domain authority who continuously evolves the Siemens Xcelerator portfolio’s applicability in this space and in adjacent areas such as digital manufacturing, simulation-driven operations, and lifecycle intelligence. You will shape how customers understand, adopt, and expand their use of Siemens’ next-generation digital twin and Industrial Metaverse capabilities, translating emerging portfolio innovations into tangible customer outcomes. This role reports into a centralized Americas Presales organization within GS&CS and is identified internally as requisition PreSales Solutions Consultant III (DTC).


Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Trusted Advisory

  • Industrial Metaverse Strategy: Establish a trusted advisor partnership from both a business and technical perspective, guiding customers on the capabilities of the Siemens Digital Twin Composer and the Industrial Metaverse.
  • Business justification: Assist customers and sales teams with business justification for DTC Solutions, adoption roadmaps, and pricing strategies.
  • Enterprise Architecture: Gather, analyze, and advise customers on high-level business and technical requirements across product development, operations, manufacturing, and lifecycle processes.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Lead and orchestrate multi-disciplinary teams (sales, presales, solutions consultants, customer success, and partners) to execute coordinated technical sales strategies across the entire buying cycle.
  • Deal Bid Management: Lead the technical team response to complex client requests for information (RFI), proposals (RFP/RFQ), technical demonstrations, and Proof of Concept (PoC) evaluations.

Implementation Oversight & Governance

  • Deployment Leadership: Oversee and guide the customer through the successful implementation of proposed Siemens solutions, ensuring alignment with original business cases.
  • Technical Governance: Establish and coordinate regular client technical and management review boards to monitor account health, manage technical queries, and coordinate resolution resources.
  • Account Health Dashboarding: Maintain an accurate Salesforce and technical dashboard of all active customer opportunities, tracking status, technical maturity, effort, and business case realization. Identify and qualify expansion opportunities, focusing on account growth, adoption, and renewal risk.

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

  • Location: Remote.
  • Experience: 8–10+ years of enterprise software technical sales, software consulting, or enterprise software account management experience, with a proven track record in SaaS or hybrid SaaS models.
  • Industry Expertise: Deep domain knowledge of the energy, chemicals, or infrastructure sectors, including a strong understanding of sector-specific operational challenges, compliance, and procurement processes.
  • Technical Specialization: 5+ years of hands-on experience with design, simulation, or manufacturing methods. 
  • Leadership Track Record: Preferred: Proven experience leading and managing cross-functional teams of technical and business consultants (both internal and external) through complex deployments and selection processes.  This is preferred, not required.
  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to independently build relationships with C-suite and VP-level executives.

Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

Preferred Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

  • Deep familiarity with the broader Siemens Xcelerator portfolio, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Mendix, or digital manufacturing solutions.
  • Strong background in account-based selling, structured territory management, and disciplined CRM/Salesforce hygiene.
  • Knowledge of emerging industrial software market trends, competitive landscapes, and cloud-based simulation architectures.
