Full job description

Manager, Service Operations & Lifecycle Engineering

Transform the everyday with us

At Siemens, we enable sustainable progress by combining the real and digital worlds. Our technology helps customers improve how they produce, operate, and maintain critical industrial assets. We believe our business thrives when our people thrive, and we are committed to building a diverse, collaborative organization where employees can grow and make a meaningful impact.

This is a remote work opportunity

The Digital Industries Customer Services organization is seeking a strategic, people-focused Director of Service Operations & Lifecycle Engineering to lead a diverse technical services organization supporting customers throughout the industrial automation lifecycle.

This leader will drive operational performance while preserving Siemens’ core technical capabilities and customer trust across industrial automation, PLCs, drives and motion, distributed I/O, SCADA/HMI, embedded engineering, lifecycle modernization, and remote services, including Senseye support and WinCC V8 upgrades.

Equally important, the Manager will develop talent, scalable service offerings, and collaborative operating models to support emerging technologies, including Industrial Edge, software-defined automation, virtualization, industrial data, AI-enabled and predictive services, cybersecurity, advanced remote services, and next-generation automation architectures.

The overarching goal is to balance operational excellence today with strategic transformation, ensuring Siemens has the people, skills, technologies, and service capabilities needed for the future of industrial services.

You'll make an impact by

Leading the business and delivering operational excellence

  • Lead a large, geographically distributed engineering and service organization through approximately 5-6 management leaders, creating clear accountability while developing leadership capability throughout the organization.
  • Own workforce capacity, utilization, scheduling, backlog, service quality, customer satisfaction, profitability, safety, and operational performance.
  • Establish a disciplined operating rhythm with measurable KPIs covering utilization, execution quality, competency, customer outcomes, safety, financial performance, and workforce readiness.
  • Develop resource and capacity strategies that balance customer demand, technical competency, geography, and future business requirements.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for strategic customers and complex technical or execution challenges.
  • Maintain strong alignment with Siemens Environmental, Health & Safety requirements and all applicable company policies, laws, and regulations.

Shaping the future of service and engineering

  • Define and execute a 3-5 year technical capability strategy aligned with Siemens' evolving industrial automation, digitalization, and lifecycle-services portfolio.
  • Assess current competencies, installed-base needs, customer demand, portfolio direction, and succession risk to identify critical skill and capacity gaps.
  • Protect and strengthen expertise in foundational Siemens technologies while intentionally building capabilities around emerging technologies.
  • Build a workforce strategy that combines upskilling, cross-training, recruiting, partnerships, mentoring, and strategic use of specialists.
  • Establish competency roadmaps and succession plans for critical technical disciplines and leadership roles.
  • Evolve traditional reactive services toward lifecycle, modernization, remote, predictive, managed, and digitally enabled service models.
  • Partner with Siemens product, portfolio, and R&D organizations to prepare the services organization for new platforms and technology introductions.
  • Champion responsible adoption of AI, automation, digital tools, and engineering-productivity technologies within service execution.

Strengthening foundational technologies and lifecycle expertise

  • Ensure durable technical depth across SIMATIC PLC and automation systems, distributed I/O, industrial communications, HMI/SCADA, AC and DC drives, motion, industrial control systems, embedded engineering, and lifecycle modernization.
  • Create intentional pathways for experienced engineers to transfer critical knowledge and expand into adjacent and emerging technologies.
  • Balance support for the installed base with modernization strategies that improve reliability, cybersecurity, maintainability, and customer value.
  • Treat foundational expertise as a platform for innovation, not as a legacy capability to be displaced.

Building leaders and technical talent

  • Develop a cohesive leadership team capable of independently leading technical organizations while operating as one integrated Service Operations organization.
  • Coach managers in people leadership, workforce planning, performance management, technical competency development, financial accountability, and customer engagement.
  • Establish clear career pathways for technical experts, engineers, service and project leaders, and people managers.
  • Identify future technical and people leaders and create intentional succession and development plans.
  • Create a culture that values technical excellence, accountability, curiosity, collaboration, customer impact, safety, inclusion, and continuous learning.
  • Attract talent in strategic capability areas while retaining and evolving the deep domain knowledge already present within the organization.

Building a connected PSE organization

  • Partner across PSE engineering, service, solution, project, specialist, and leadership teams to reduce organizational and technical silos.
  • Establish mechanisms for sharing specialized engineering talent across customer engagements and organizational boundaries.
  • Promote common engineering methods, reusable architectures, technical standards, lessons learned, and knowledge-sharing communities.
  • Develop strong working relationships with Siemens Business Units, Product Management, R&D, Sales, and Customer Services organizations.
  • Create pathways for engineers to work across technologies and organizations, broadening capability and strengthening the overall PSE talent system.
  • Measure success by the collective outcome for the customer and Siemens, not by optimization of an individual team.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications

Basic qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, technology, business, or a similar from an accredited university.
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in industrial technology, engineering, automation, lifecycle services, or related technical organizations.
  • Responsibility for operational and financial performance, including staffing, utilization, capacity planning, project or service execution, and profitability.
  • Understanding of industrial automation and control environments involving technologies such as PLCs, drives, SCADA/HMI, distributed I/O, industrial networks, or embedded engineering.
  • Proficient in English both written and verbal
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.
  • Must reside within approximately 30 miles of a major airport and be willing to travel approximately 25%.

Preferred qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to develop technical talent, build succession plans, and identify future workforce capabilities.
  • Experience developing a technical organization through changes in technology, customer requirements, or business models.
  • Leadership or management of multiple technical teams within a complex organization.
  • Experience collaborating across organizational boundaries to deliver complex customer outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success transforming an established technical organization without compromising customer commitments or core technical competencies.
  • Experience creating and executing multi-year workforce, competency, or technology roadmaps.
  • Experience evolving traditional field or engineering services toward remote, lifecycle, predictive, managed, or digitally enabled service models.
  • Familiarity with emerging industrial technologies including Industrial Edge, virtualization, industrial data, AI, cybersecurity, digital twins, and software-defined automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and make thoughtful investment decisions about emerging technologies.
  • Strong business and financial acumen combined with technical credibility.
  • Proven ability to build collaboration across engineering, service, sales, product, R&D, and business organizations.
  • Track record of developing managers, technical experts, and future leaders.
  • Strong executive communication, customer-facing capability, professional integrity, and sound judgment.
  • Willingness to challenge established approaches while respecting the technical expertise and institutional knowledge of the organization.

What success looks like

  • A safe, accountable, and high-performing operation with strong execution quality, customer outcomes, utilization, and financial performance.
  • A leadership team that operates as one organization, develops its people, and can translate strategy into disciplined execution.
  • Visible 3-5 year capability and workforce roadmaps that address installed-base needs, emerging technology, and succession risk.
  • Growing technical talent in strategic areas without losing the foundational automation expertise customers depend on.
  • Greater collaboration and talent mobility across PSE, supported by reusable methods, shared expertise, and common priorities.
  • A growing portfolio of modernization, remote, predictive, and digitally enabled lifecycle services.

From resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation and advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose and deliver measurable value for customers.

Siemens Mobility is seeking a strategic Senior Maintenance Operations Manager for the Brightline Florida Full-Service Contract. This role is built for growth. You will progressively assume key Service Project Manager responsibilities, expanding your ownership of contractual performance, customer engagement, business operations, strategic planning, and financial oversight. If you excel at balancing operational excellence, customer expectations, employee engagement, and financial performance, and you are passionate about continuous improvement, join us and strengthen the long-term Siemens-Brightline partnership.

  • Serve as Siemens' senior operational representative to Brightline leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with FRA regulations, OSHA requirements, Siemens EHS standards, railroad operating rules, and contractual obligations.
  • Support overall financial performance of the Brightline Full-Service Contract.

This posting outlines the primary responsibilities of the role, but is not all-inclusive; additional duties may be assigned in alignment with business needs.

To thrive in this role, you have:

  • Demonstrated experience leading 24/7 maintenance organizations supporting revenue-service fleets.
  • Proven experience managing customer-facing service contracts and achieving contractual KPI commitments.
  • Strong knowledge of rolling stock maintenance, reliability engineering, asset management, maintenance planning, and fleet operations.
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary teams including engineers, planners, supervisors, technicians, and reliability specialists.
  • Experience with maintenance systems such as Maximo, SAP, Railigent, or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong financial, analytical, leadership, customer management, and communication skills.

Candidates should be willing to work in non-climate-controlled environments and inclement weather if required or if applicable.

We are looking for a Partner Strategy & Growth Manager. This role is remote and can be located anywhere in the US or Americas. 

How you will make an Impact with us

  • Building a collaborative community of regional partner marketing SPOCs to encourage peer learning, knowledge sharing, and cross-regional collaboration across the Americas.
  • Collaborating with regional partner marketing colleagues to share and scale best practices across marketing programs, partner events, sales enablement, and content and improve business outcomes across diverse markets.

  • Amplifying partner events, activities, and success stories across internal and external digital channels to strengthen visibility, engagement, and market presence. 

  

What you bring

This role requires an individual who combines partner marketing, growth strategy, program optimization, business acumen, and the ability to influence across diverse markets and cultures.

 

  • Education Bachelors degree
  • Experience & Skills 
  • 5+ years of experience in partner marketing, channel marketing, alliance marketing, growth marketing, field marketing, or partner ecosystem management.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish (required), with the ability to communicate effectively, build relationships, gain partner buy-in, and influence stakeholders across diverse markets throughout North and Latin America.
  • Strong understanding of B2B marketing, demand generation, pipeline development, and growth strategy.
  • Proven ability to identify performance trends, evaluate program effectiveness, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience optimizing marketing investments, MDF programs, campaigns, events, and partner engagement initiatives.
  • Strong analytical and business acumen with the ability to connect investments, execution, performance, and outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and drive adoption without direct management authority.
  • Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, and business environments.
  • Ability to build communities and facilitate knowledge sharing across geographically dispersed teams.
  • Experience translating data and best practices into compelling business cases, executive narratives, and measurable results.
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.

Languages: Fluent in English, Fluent in Spanish

About this job

Analyze vulnerability management and IT asset data for Siemens Digital Industries Software. Build dashboards, automated reports, and predictive models using Power BI, SQL, and Python to reduce security risk and improve operational efficiency.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in IT asset management, experience with Power BI and SQL, and familiarity with ServiceNow and Tanium platforms.

Full job description

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.


Company Overview

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.


Position Overview

The successful candidate will work with vulnerability management engineers, IT operations, asset management teams, and business stakeholders to analyze large datasets, improve data quality, automate reporting, and deliver actionable insights that reduce security risk and improve operational efficiency.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Analytics and Reporting: Analyze large datasets from operational platforms • Develop dashboards, KPIs, and automated reports using Power BI, SQL, and Python • Identify trends, compliance gaps, and operational risks • Build predictive analytics and forecasting models
  • Vulnerability Management Analytics: Analyze critical and high vulnerabilities, Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEVs), remediation SLAs, and risk exposure • Correlate data with asset ownership and business segments • Track patching effectiveness, exceptions, and recurring blockers
  • Asset Lifecycle and Inventory Management: Analyze asset inventory, ownership, and CMDB data quality • Track provisioning, turnover, retirement, and EOL or unsupported infrastructure • Investigate and reconcile discrepancies between Tanium, ServiceNow CMDB, and ITAM records
  • Automation and Operational Improvement: Build automated data pipelines, validation processes, and analytical models to eliminate manual reporting toil • Establish consistent reporting standards and data governance practices across functions

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience and deep understanding of IT asset management (ITAM) frameworks, hardware and software end-of-life (EOL) tracking, and CMDB governance 
  • Proven track record of replacing manual reporting spreadsheets with automated data pipelines and self-service dashboards, with proficiency in tools such as Power BI, SQL, and Python 
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze, clean, and reconcile large datasets, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and improve data hygiene
  • Experience building predictive analytics, forecasting models, or anomaly-detection scripts 
  • Familiarity with risk-based vulnerability management (incorporating KEVs, asset criticality, and remediation SLAs), and experience supporting vulnerability management, asset lifecycle tracking, or IT operations compliance 
  • Strong communication skills to translate complex technical data into meaningful insights for management and business stakeholders

Preferred Skills

  • Bachelor's degree preferred in computer science, Information Technology, or a similar technical degree 
  • Experience working with operational platforms such as ServiceNow (CMDB, Vulnerability Response, ITAM) and endpoint and asset visibility tools such as Tanium, highly preferred

We are Siemens:

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.

You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Position Summary 

The Industry Marketing Manager for Semiconductors turns industry strategy, customer insight, and Siemens’ portfolio strengths into focused go-to-market (GTM) priorities, differentiated messaging, executable campaign direction, and high-impact sales enablement materials. Serving as the marketing subject-matter expert for the semiconductor industry, you will connect market opportunities, customer needs, industry priorities, solution capabilities, and business objectives to create actionable strategies that accelerate awareness, engagement, pipeline creation, and revenue growth. Operating as a key integrator across industry leadership, product marketing, sales, technical experts, and implementation teams, success in this role requires both strategic industry leadership and the ability to navigate a complex, matrixed organization while maintaining a razor-sharp focus on customer relevance and business impact. 

Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Ownership & Evolution: Own and continuously evolve the semiconductor go-to-market intent, translating high-level strategy into clear target segments, buying groups, personas, Digital Thread and Solution Domain priorities, and campaign plans.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the industry marketing lead within cross-functional implementation. Bring customer and market relevance to delivery teams, clarify business rationale, surface dependencies and risks, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Audience & Persona Strategy: Lead buyer-audience definitions and validate persona-to-topic mapping to reflect how semiconductor companies organize, buy, and transform.
  • Messaging & Value Proposition: Develop and maintain industry messaging frameworks and briefs that connect customer challenges to differentiated Siemens value. Translate highly technical input into credible, outcome-led narratives for executive, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with industry leaders, solution managers, Digital Thread Factory leads, solution/core marketers, technical experts, and sales to align solution definition, audience strategy, and messaging.
  • Campaign & Content Direction: Lead integrated campaign definitions from strategy through handoff, providing complete inputs for campaign overviews, prioritized topics, audiences, imperatives, messaging, and content requirements while supporting content creators with clear strategic direction.
  • Sales Enablement: Own the creation and delivery of enablement and go-to-market materials that sellers use because they map directly to real customer priorities. Customer Insight & Market Intelligence: Build a continuous feedback loop through customer conversations, sales interactions, customer advocacy, events, market research, and performance data to validate assumptions and guide investment.
  • Customer Insight & Market Intelligence: Build a continuous feedback loop through customer conversations, sales interactions, customer advocacy, events, market research, and performance data to validate assumptions and guide investment.
  • Industry Fluency: Monitor fast-moving semiconductor market and technology developments, including AI and custom silicon, EDA, software-defined development, advanced packaging, silicon photonics, fab/sub-fab digitalization, manufacturing optimization, sustainability, and supply-chain resilience.
  • Governance & Execution: Resolve ambiguity, escalate gaps in ownership or portfolio readiness with clear business implications, and rigorously document decisions, trade-offs, and next steps.
  • Evangelism: Represent the semiconductor industry in internal planning, executive reviews, customer engagements, and key industry forums.
What Success Looks Like
  • Delivery of customer-relevant messaging with the deep technical credibility required by semiconductor audiences.
  • Tight, measurable alignment across industry, solution, campaign, sales, and technical stakeholders. A focused, evidence-based semiconductor campaign strategy that teams can easily understand and execute.
  • High adoption of campaigns and enablement assets by sales teams due to their direct connection to real-world buyer challenges.
  • A trusted, up-to-date industry point of view that adapts to market shifts and sharpens prioritization over time.

Data-Driven & Inquiring Mindset: Demonstrated customer mindset and research discipline; skilled at combining qualitative insights, market intelligence, competitive context, and performance data to challenge assumptions and guide decisions.

  • Adaptability: Comfortable thriving in environments characterized by ambiguity and constant change.

Associate Energy Engineers work alongside and partner with our sales team, other energy engineers, and project managers to develop cost-effective performance based contracts for targeted clients. The role reports into the Senior Energy Engineer.


As an Associate Energy Engineer, you will:

  • Perform Utility Data Analysis (UDA) by entering utility billing information, understanding the information contained on the bills, and having the ability to analyze this information vs. accepted standards.
  • Perform ASHRAE level I and II audits to identify Facility Improvement Measures (FIMs). Participate in facility site visits using observational skills to collect required data to perform engineering calculations. Analyzes blue prints in conjunction with site surveys to identify mechanical, electrical, and control systems and determine facility operational characteristics and potential FIMs to be investigated. 
  • Install metering equipment to gather true equipment usage information when necessary.
  • Perform basic energy savings calculations, making educated assumptions when applicable and interpreting data gathered from the field to estimate savings.
  • Present design concepts to others for budget pricing development.
  • Write scopes of work for FIM subcontractors.
  • Escort FIM subcontractors through the facility to clearly communicate the intended scope of work.
  • Analyze FIM subcontractor bids to help determine the best bid.
  • Develop design concepts and other written technical documentation to sales, management, and funding agencies concerning recommended FIMs, including accurate descriptions, savings potential, and back up data to verify FIMs. 
  • Prepare the application for governmental incentive funds, coordinate with associated consultants, and develop all documentation for final incentive collection.
  • Assist in the development of preliminary and final performance contracting proposals.
  • Assist in the development of performance contracting contracts utilizing standard templates incorporating FIM’s selected.

Full job description

Position Location: This role is remote.


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


The Head of Sales Excellence reports directly to the Head of Sales and serves as a key member of the Sales leadership team, responsible for strengthening the effectiveness, capability and future readiness of the Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings sales organization.

The Head of Sales Excellence brings together performance insights, execution and productivity, sales capability and incentive management to identify and lead systemic improvements that make strong sales performance more repeatable, scalable and sustainable. They are uniquely positioned to provide an integrated view of the health of Sales, anticipate emerging needs, and translate business strategy into a focused Sales Excellence agenda.


As the Head of Sales Excellence, you will:

Strategic Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Head of Sales, bringing insights, recommendations and an independent point of view on sales effectiveness.
  • Translate Sales strategy into a focused Sales Excellence roadmap, prioritizing resources and initiatives based on business impact.
  • Constructively challenge practices and investments that limit sales effectiveness or create unnecessary complexity.
  • Orchestrate work across Areas, businesses and partner functions to address systemic opportunities and barriers.

Sales Performance, Insights & Future Readiness

  • Establish the measures and leading indicators needed to understand sales performance, including funnel health, forecast effectiveness, conversion and productivity.
  • Translate data into actionable insights, identifying trends, risks and opportunities that require leadership attention.
  • Connect insights across Areas and businesses to identify systemic performance opportunities and anticipate emerging Sales needs.
  • Translate One Tech Company, customer and market trends, technology and business priorities into implications for future Sales capabilities and ways of working.

Sales Execution & Productivity

  • Define and continuously improve end-to-end Sales processes, standards and ways of working.
  • Establish common expectations for CRM, funnel and opportunity management, and sales hygiene while allowing appropriate Area flexibility.
  • Shape Sales requirements for CRM, CPQ, analytics and other sales technologies in partnership with technology owners.
  • Simplify and automate Sales processes to improve seller and sales-manager productivity and reduce administrative complexity.
  • Measure adoption and effectiveness of Sales processes and tools and continuously improve the seller experience.
  • Introduce and leverage AI, where appropriate, to improve sales productivity

Sales Capability

  • Define the capabilities sellers and sales leaders need to execute the business strategy and support future growth.
  • Translate Foundational Sales into practical capabilities, behaviors and leadership expectations.
  • Identify and prioritize systemic capability gaps based on business impact.
  • Partner across Sales, P&O, learning functions and business stakeholders to address priority capability needs.
  • Strengthen sales-leader coaching and measure sustained proficiency, behavior change and business impact.

Sales Incentive Management

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the Sales Incentive Management Office.
  • Lead Sales incentive governance and represent Sales priorities in cross-functional incentive decisions.
  • Evaluate plan effectiveness, complexity and unintended consequences and recommend improvements.
  • Partner with Sales leadership, Finance, P&O and global stakeholders on plan design, implementation, administration and governance.
  • Ensure appropriate controls, standards and effective communication of Sales incentive programs.

Leadership of the Sales Excellence Function

  • Set the strategy and priorities for the Sales Excellence organization and align resources to the highest-value Sales needs.
  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing team with clear accountabilities and decision rights.
  • Build the talent, capabilities and succession needed for the future Sales Excellence organization.
  • Champion accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement across the function.

Decision Rights & Accountability

  • The Head of Sales Excellence owns the Sales Excellence roadmap, frameworks, standards and systemic improvement agenda, including prioritization of Sales Excellence resources and initiatives.
  • The role is expected to recommend, challenge and orchestrate improvements across organizational boundaries while respecting the decision rights of Sales leaders and partner functions.
  • Area Sales leaders remain accountable for leadership, execution, coaching, adoption and business results.

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end sales processes, pipeline and opportunity management, forecasting, CRM and sales performance analytics.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into practical Sales capabilities, priorities and ways of working.
  • Experience using data and business insight to diagnose performance challenges and develop actionable recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and deliver outcomes across organizational boundaries without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Strong change leadership capability with demonstrated experience driving sustained adoption.
  • Experience leading, developing and building high-performing teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • Ability to operate successfully in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment.
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with sales incentive design, governance or management.
  • Experience leading large-scale Sales capability or enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Experience operating across multiple businesses, markets or organizational boundaries.
  • MBA or advanced business degree.

Position Overview:

Ready to start a hands-on career where your work keeps trains moving? Siemens Mobility in West Palm Beach, FL is looking for entry-level Train Service Technicians to join our team! As a key part of our maintenance crew, you’ll get trains clean, safe, and ready to roll by servicing locomotives, coaches, and train sets – emptying toilet systems, refilling water tanks, and fueling operations. You’ll help us uphold the highest safety and quality standards every step of the way. Positions are open on the 2nd or 3rd shift with a schedule that includes weekdays, weekends, and holidays. If you’re looking to get your foot in the door of the rail industry, this is your chance to hop on board!

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Perform basic train servicing tasks so trains are clean, safe, and ready for departure:
    • Empty and sanitize onboard toilet systems and refill water and windscreen washer tanks, keeping trains hygienic and fully stocked.
    • Refuel locomotives and connect trainsets to ground power, keeping equipment powered and ready for on time departures.
    • Clean HVAC components, supporting comfortable and reliable climate control.
  • Assist technicians with mechanical and electrical maintenance tasks as needed, helping keep repairs on schedule and trains available for service.
  • Follow Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) instructions and accurately log all tasks, defects, and incidents, ensuring reliable records and faster issue resolution.
  • Keep work areas and equipment clean and organized, creating a safe and efficient workspace.
  • Operate tools and equipment such as forklifts, cleaning systems, and basic hand tools to complete work safely and efficiently.
  • Support minor bodywork, welding, or painting tasks under supervision, helping return equipment to service-ready condition.
  • Follow all safety protocols and Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) regulations and communicate effectively with team members and supervisors, protecting your crew and keeping every shift running smoothly.

This posting outlines the primary responsibilities of the role, but is not all-inclusive; additional duties may be assigned in alignment with business needs.

To thrive in this role, you have:

  • High School Diploma / GED,
  • Basic literacy and numeracy skills to read instructions, complete checklists, and enter data in English,
  • Strong communication skills to report issues clearly and follow instructions in English,
  • Flexibility to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays,
  • Basic mechanical aptitude or a genuine interest in learning to use tools and equipment,
  • A commitment to following safety procedures and wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE),
  • Reliable transportation to and from the work site.

Physical Demands/Facility Information

The physical demands described here are representative of those necessary to successfully perform the essential job duties:

  • Frequently walk, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • Frequently required to climb stairs, steps, and ladders
  • Frequently required to work on elevated platforms.
  • Perform work overhead.
  • Occasionally lift and move at most 40 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to focus.
  • Pushing and pulling objects towards and away from origin of force.
  • Keyboarding on a computer or other machine by means of a traditional keyboard.
  • Gross and Fine Manipulation to include holding, grasping and pinching using hands and fingers.
  • Driving forklifts, golf carts, yard buggies etc.
  • The ability to hear, understand, and distinguish speech and/or other sounds in person or via communication radio.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

Candidates should be willing to work in non-climate-controlled environments and inclement weather if required or if applicable.

Full job description

Job Title: Standards and Codes Expert

Location: Remote

 

About Siemens

At Siemens, we're constantly innovating and pushing the boundaries of what's possible. Our commitment to excellence is reflected in everything we do, from groundbreaking technologies to sustainable solutions. We believe in empowering our people to make a real impact and contribute to a better future. Join a team where your expertise is valued, and your contributions help shape industries worldwide.

 

The Opportunity:

Are you a meticulous and knowledgeable individual with a passion for ensuring technical excellence and regulatory compliance? Do you thrive on understanding complex standards and translating them into practical applications? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as a Standards and Codes Expert!

In this pivotal role, you will be the go-to authority on a wide range of industry standards, codes, and regulations. Your expertise will be instrumental in guiding our engineering, product development, and project teams, ensuring that our innovative solutions not only meet but exceed all necessary compliance requirements. You'll play a critical part in safeguarding our reputation for quality, safety, and reliability.

 

What You'll Do:

 
  • Standards Monitoring & Gap Analysis: Proactively monitor and perform comprehensive gap analysis across a broad spectrum of critical regulatory bodies and industrial consortium, including NFPA, OCP, NERC, IEEE, and others relevant to our industry.
  • Internal Coordination & Requirement Translation: Drive internal coordination efforts by interpreting complex code and standard evolutions and translating them into clear, actionable engineering requirements for relevant Business Units (BUs) or for cross-BU collaboration.
  • Guidance & Interpretation: Provide expert interpretation and guidance to engineering, product development, sales, and project teams on the application of standards and codes throughout the entire product lifecycle, from design to deployment.
  • Compliance Assurance: Conduct regular reviews of designs, products, and processes to ensure adherence to all applicable standards and codes, identifying potential risks and recommending mitigation strategies.
  • External Representation & Advocacy: Represent Siemens in key working groups and committees, including IEEE, OCP, NERC, EMerge Alliance, and other relevant industry bodies, actively participating in discussions and influencing the development of future standards to align with our strategic interests and technological advancements.
  • Thought Leadership Contribution: Contribute to thought-leadership articles, white papers, and presentations to drive the evolution of standards and codes development in alignment with Siemens' strategic roadmap and technological advancements.
  • Training & Development: Develop and deliver training sessions to internal teams, enhancing their understanding and application of critical standards and compliance best practices.
  • Problem Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve compliance-related issues and challenges, offering practical and effective solutions.
 

Requirements:

 
  • Educational Foundation: A Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or a related field is preferred) with 5-10 years experience.
  • Professional Certification: Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.
  • Expert Knowledge: Demonstrated working knowledge of key standards and codes, including but not limited to NERC, NFPA, IEEE, and NEC standards and codes, particularly for electrification and automation/controls systems.
  • Direct Current Acumen: Familiarity with direct current power distribution systems.
  • Standards Committee Experience: Proven experience participating in technical committees/ working groups (e.g., OCP, NERC) is highly desirable.
  • Analytical Prowess: Exceptional ability to interpret complex technical documents, regulations, and legal texts.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and regulatory information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.
  • Collaboration: A strong team player with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external bodies.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Proactive and detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Continuous Learner: Eagerness to continuously learn and adapt to evolving industry standards and technologies
 

About Siemens We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

As a Senior Commissioning Technician you will participate in the installation, startup, commissioning, validation, and lifecycle transition of complex automation systems supporting hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and mission-critical data center facilities throughout the United States. 

You will serve as a technical resource during project execution, collaborating with engineering, project management, commissioning, service, subcontractor, and customer teams to ensure successful project delivery and customer satisfaction.  THIS POSITION REQUIRES 75% TRAVEL THROUGHOUT THE U.S.

 

As a Commissioning Technician – Building Automation, you will:

  • Participate in startup, checkout, commissioning, validation, and customer acceptance activities for Building Automation projects. 
  • Support installation verification, panel checkout, point-to-point testing, I/O validation, loop testing, and functional performance testing. 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving PLC controllers, field devices, instrumentation, networking components, control panels, and integrated automation systems. 
  • Assist with startup and commissioning of facility automation systems associated with HVAC, electrical distribution, backup power, environmental monitoring, and critical infrastructure systems. 
  • Review project drawings, specifications, network architectures, sequences of operation, control schematics, and commissioning documentation. 
  • Support integrated systems testing including FAT, SAT, functional testing, and customer witness activities. 
  • Perform system diagnostics and validate operation of buliding level controllers, HMIs, remote I/O, network communications, and automation interfaces. 
  • Coordinate technical activities with project teams, contractors, vendors, service personnel, and customer representatives. 
  • Document deficiencies, corrective actions, commissioning results, software backups, redlines, and turnover documentation. 
  • Support customer training and project closeout activities. 
  • Assist with service transition and lifecycle readiness activities to ensure successful long-term operation of installed systems. 
  • Serve as a technical resource supporting continuous improvement initiatives and best practices for data center automation delivery. 

 

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications: 

  • High School Diploma, GED, technical degree, military training, apprenticeship, or equivalent experience. 
  • 3+ years of experience supporting commissioning, controls, automation, building automation, industrial controls, electrical systems, or mission-critical facility infrastructure. 
  • Experience troubleshooting PLC-based control systems and automation technologies. 
  • Ability to read and interpret: electrical schematics, control drawings, specifications, network architectures, and sequence of operations documentation 
  • Experience supporting commissioning, startup, testing, troubleshooting, or validation of complex automation systems. 
  • 75% travel required
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Full job description

At Russelectric®️, a Siemens business, we are dedicated to designing and building custom power control systems and equipment that meet the stringent performance and reliability requirements of critical facilities such as Data Centers, Telecommunications, and healthcare. Founded in 1955 by Raymond G. Russell, Russelectric®️ has grown into one of the world's most respected manufacturers of automatic transfer switches and power control systems. 

As part of Siemens, a global leader in technology and innovation, we continue to uphold Raymond Russell's legacy of excellence and reliability. Together, we are committed to advancing the future of power control solutions, ensuring that our customers receive the highest quality products and services.


We are looking for Field Service Engineer to support critical power facilities. This positions will be based out of the Orlando, FL area. 

This position requires a qualified, hands-on, service-oriented technician to be involved with automatic transfer switch startups, modifications, warranty and emergency calls. Applicant should show desire to learn and advance to the Field Service Engineer level.

You will make an impact with the following skills and experience:

  • Applicant must carry a cell phone and be on call 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
  • Focus on work related to automatic transfer switches
  • Provide technical support of field startups (standard and non-standard systems), warranty efforts, remedial repairs, and preventative maintenance contracts
  • Supervising and ensuring compliance with all safety policies, procedures, guidelines and laws
  • Conduct client communication in a highly customer service-oriented manner and potentially expand the scope of project work as well as negotiate any extra charges associated with work performed
  • All work and decisions shall be conducted in strict compliance of all regulatory laws
  • Travel requirements: Up to 80% travel

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

  • High School Diploma / GED
  • 3+ years experience with the following:
    • Field Service Engineering
    • Electrical power including low voltage through medium voltage switchgear in support of critical power facilities (IE data centers, airports, etc…)
    • Experience with most types of automatic transfer switch testing
    • Reading schematics and blueprints for power control, automation and customer technical support
    • Familiarity with all applicable codes and industry standards
    • Proficient in taking care of client interactions and completing projects on time and within budget guidelines
    • Strong project management skills with excellent decision making, organization and management capabilities
    • Must be self-directed and very committed to customer satisfaction
  • Individuals must possess a valid Driver's license in good standing
  • Must be authorized to work in the US for any employer without sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering
  • Excellent customer service, time management and follow-up skills
  • Power distribution, DC/AC, Voltage Circuit Theory and practical troubleshooting skills

As a Building Automation Programmer, you will:

  • Program large, complex, and custom projects using PLC-based programming platforms and control logic.
  • Develop and implement PLC programs using Siemens TIA Portal, including structured control logic for mission-critical building automation and industrial control applications. 
  • Design, conﬁgure, and support visualization solutions, including HMI and SCADA interfaces, to provide operators with clear system status, alarms, trends, and control information.

  • Collaborate with the Design Team to identify speciﬁcation discrepancies, coordinate PLC integration requirements, and request clariﬁcation as needed.
  • Work both independently and in team dynamics in a remote environment.
  • Mentor, train, and provide technical assistance to other team members.
  • Travel as needed up to 25%

 

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications: 

  • High School Diploma, or state-recognized GED. 
  • Demonstrated experience programming commercial building automation, HVAC, or industrial control systems using PLC-based control strategies.
  • Solid knowledge of Siemens PLC programming, especially Siemens S7-1200/1500 platforms and Siemens TIA Portal.
  • 5+ years of experience with structured programming methods aligned with IEC 61131-3 programming standards; ladder logic is the preferred programming language for this role.
  •  5+ years of demonstrated experience with Siemens or third-party PLC platforms, control logic development, and system integration.
  • Demonstrated electro-mechanical aptitude to read and understand design drawings, control schematics, sequence of operations, points lists, and construction documents.

  • Experience with HMI/SCADA visualization platforms, drives technology, high-level programming languages such as Python or C#/.NET, robotics, or IT security in industrial systems

Full job description

Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world!

Siemens Grid Software’s consulting team PTI (Power Technologies International) is seeking a Senior Power Systems Consultant.

This is a remote role located within the contiguous U.S.

What You Will do:

  • Lead and perform consulting engagements related to power system analysis and design, power system dynamics and transients, generator interconnection, and grid code compliance.
  • Manage project execution, track progress, and make adjustments as needed to maintain scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
  • Build and maintain client relationships to ensure customer satisfaction, identify client needs, and develop opportunities for additional services.
  • Support business development activities through proposal preparation, technical approaches, project plans, budgets, schedules, and statements of work.
  • Mentor junior consultants and support their technical and professional development.
  • Develop automation tools and scripts to streamline repetitive tasks, improve quality, reduce errors, and increase overall efficiency.
  • Prepare technical reports and present study results, recommendations, and technical findings to clients and industry stakeholders.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • 8+ years of experience in transmission planning, power system operations, generator interconnection, or power system studies.
  • Experience performing power flow and dynamic stability analyses using PSS®E, TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, PowerWorld, or similar software tools.
  • Knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards and familiarity with RTO and regional transmission planning processes, criteria, and practices.
  • Strong communication, customer engagement, presentation, and technical report writing skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a specialization in Power and Energy Systems.
  • Consulting experience within the electric utility or power industry.
  • Experience with ERCOT and/or SPP transmission planning and generator interconnection processes.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python or similar tools.

Successful Performance in this Role:

In your first 12–18 months, you will:

  • Deliver high-quality power system studies on time and within budget.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with clients by providing clear, practical solutions to complex technical challenges.
  • Successfully manage multiple consulting engagements while maintaining strong client satisfaction.
  • Contribute to business growth through proposal development, identification of follow-on work, and expansion of existing client relationships.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, automation tools, and best practices that improve team efficiency and quality.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior consultants and engineers.

Siemens is seeking an experienced Senior PLC Programmer to design and program automation systems supporting mission-critical data center infrastructure.

This role is ideal for an experienced PLC/controls professional who has worked with Siemens SIMATIC S7 PLC, TIA Portal, SCADA/HMI systems, building automation, or critical facility controls and understands how mechanical and electrical systems operate together in highly available environments.

You will program and integrate controls for systems such as chilled water plants, CRAH/CRAC units, CDUs, generators, UPS systems, switchgear, ATS/STS equipment, power distribution, and environmental monitoring systems.


As a Senior PLC Programmer, you will:

  • Develop and program complex PLC control systems using Siemens SIMATIC S7 PLC and Siemens TIA Portal.
  • Create structured PLC control logic for data centers and other mission-critical facilities.
  • Program and integrate mechanical and electrical infrastructure including chilled water systems, CRAH/CRAC equipment, CDUs, generators, UPS, switchgear, ATS/STS, and power monitoring systems.
  • Develop and support HMI and SCADA visualization, alarms, trends, and operator controls.
  • Integrate PLC systems with BMS, EPMS, SCADA, DCIM, HMI, and other facility systems.
  • Test PLC programs and develop functional testing and commissioning documentation.
  • Support system startup, commissioning, troubleshooting, optimization, and issue resolution.
  • Interpret sequences of operation, control drawings, schematics, points lists, and construction documents.
  • Coordinate with engineering, design, graphics, project management, and field teams.
  • Document PLC programs, system configurations, integration requirements, testing results, and revisions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other team members.
  • Travel up to 25% to support projects and commissioning activities.


You'll make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED.
  • 5+ years of PLC programming and controls experience in building automation, HVAC controls, industrial automation, critical facilities, or similar environments.
  • Hands-on programming experience with Siemens SIMATIC S7 PLC and TIA Portal.
  • Experience developing structured PLC control logic using IEC 61131-3 programming methods, with strong ladder logic experience.
  • Experience integrating PLC-based control systems with field equipment and other automation platforms.
  • Ability to read and interpret control drawings, electrical schematics, sequences of operation, points lists, and construction documents.
  • Ability to troubleshoot PLC programs and integrated control systems.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience programming or commissioning controls in data centers or other mission-critical facilities.
  • Experience with BMS, EPMS, SCADA, DCIM, and HMI systems.
  • Knowledge of data center mechanical and electrical infrastructure including CRAH/CRAC, chilled water plants, CDUs, generators, UPS, switchgear, ATS/STS, and power distribution.
  • Experience with industrial communication protocols such as PROFINET, OPC UA, and Ethernet/IP.
  • 7+ years of PLC programming, controls, or system integration experience.
  • Associate or bachelor's degree in engineering, automation, controls, electronics, computer science, or a related technical field.

About this job

Principal Linux Infrastructure Engineer at Siemens supporting global R&D teams. Focus on Linux infrastructure automation, vulnerability management, OS patching, and improving development productivity using tools like Tanium and Puppet.

Good fit if you have 8+ years Linux system administration experience, proficiency with Puppet or Ansible, and software development background with Python or similar languages.

Full job description

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Position Overview:

The Principal Linux Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for ensuring DISW R&D teams remain efficient and productive while meeting Siemens guidelines and requirements. This role requires a strong understanding of R&D development and engineering processes and workflows, with a focus on improving efficiency, automation, and overall development productivity.

The position is accountable for reducing the overall risk posture of the Linux environment supporting R&D by prioritizing the remediation of existing vulnerabilities and establishing effective, repeatable vulnerability management processes. The Principal Linux Infrastructure Engineer serves as the primary point of contact for Linux-related issues across global R&D teams, providing expert support and guidance to stakeholders in all regions.

In addition, this role drives the improvement and automation of existing infrastructure and operational processes, including tools such as Tanium and Puppet, and partners closely with the CORE team to deliver solutions that align with Siemens standards and DI Software customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

The primary focus lies in improving a management framework for extensive computational infrastructure by means of automation. Emphasis is placed on OS patching, Vulnerability Management, and their mitigations and remediations in the Linux world. Utilizing a blend of proprietary and commercial software (Tanium etc.), our team orchestrates the deployment and oversight of a vast computational infrastructure supporting diverse software engineering teams. This role plays a pivotal part in establishing architectural strategies and standards to optimize the management of software development environment resources, promoting efficiency and consistency in resource provisioning and management, both on-premises and in public cloud environments. The incumbent will directly contribute to and guide teams in crafting automation solutions for operational and software development endeavors.  Additional responsibilities include:

  • Installation, maintenance, and support of system software used by groups in the development, release, maintenance and support of commercial software products. 
  • Providing a high level of support and consulting in all supported environments, usually requiring research 
  • Reducing overall risk posture within Linux env for R&D, prioritizing reduction of existing vulnerabilities and implementing an effective/repeatable vulnerability management process. 
  • Leading multiple complex technical projects and completes project tasks; analyzes detailed product issues. 
  • Evaluating new technologies and methods. Focusing on improving efficiency and automation to advance development productivity. 
  • Working without supervision on the most complex projects with complete latitude for discretion and independent judgment. 

Qualifications:

  • Automation Expertise: Proficiency in designing and implementing automation solutions for operational and software development teams. Experience with tools like Puppet and Ansible would be essential. 
  • Collaborative Communication: Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including Automation Specialists, DevOps, and Infrastructure Engineers. 
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop effective solutions to improve efficiency and reliability of infrastructure management. 
  • Configuration Management: Some experience and understanding of configuring and managing large-scale infrastructure components using configuration management tools. 
  • DevOps Practices: Familiarity with DevOps methodologies and practices, including continuous integration, continuous deployment (CI/CD), and version control systems like Git. 
  • Continuous Learning: Willingness to stay updated with the latest technologies and trends in automation, DevOps, and infrastructure management to drive innovation and improvement within the organization. 
  • Architectural Design: Capability to contribute to the establishment of architectural strategies and standards for managing software development environment resources. 
  • Technical documentation: Process and Tool documentation to share with teammates and other teams. 
  • AI and LLM Experience: Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve engineering productivity (e.g., scripting, documentation, troubleshooting). Experience building AI agents or LLM-based automation is a strong plus. 

Education and Experience: 

  • Bachelor’s degree with a preferable emphasis in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or Computer Engineering. 
  • Linux System Administration experience (8+ yrs) 
  • RHCE is a plus 
  • Break-fix and troubleshooting skills both on individual endpoints and at scale 
  •  PXE and Kickstart experience also desirable SW Development (5+ yrs) experience with Python, JavaScript, PowerShell, Puppet, Ansible, and web applications development highly desirable.  
  • Vulnerability Management in Linux environments.

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

About this job

Design and evolve deal enablement frameworks that translate Siemens' commercial strategy into clear guidance for global sales teams. The role bridges product, pricing, finance, and sales to ensure consistent, scalable execution across complex B2B software solutions and new business models.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in commercial operations, deal desk, or sales operations at a complex B2B enterprise software company, with experience designing global deal guidelines and IFRS 15 revenue recognition knowledge.

Full job description

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

Position Overview:

Siemens is a global technology powerhouse focusing on the areas of intelligent infrastructure, automation, and digitalization. Within Global Sales Excellence (GSE) HQ, our mission is to empower our sales and commercial teams with world-class operational frameworks, deal enablement structures, and streamlined processes. We champion operational excellence, ensuring that complex commercial strategies translate into clear, scalable, and frictionless execution for our teams and customers.

We are currently seeking a Deal Enablement Architect for the commercial and operational frameworks that enable products, business models and cross-business opportunities to be sold consistently, efficiently and at scale. The GSE HQ Deal Enablement Architect owns the design and evolution of the business-facing elements of the Global Deal Enablement Operating Model.

The role connects Product, Strategy, Pricing, Finance, Sales and operational stakeholders to translate commercial strategy into clear and practical guidance for the field. Its purpose is to ensure that Deal Guidelines, new products, new business models and cross-business propositions are designed for execution, with clear parameters, watch-outs and escalation pathways. The role challenges complexity at source and ensures lessons from execution are continuously fed back into better guidance and commercial design.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Deal Guidelines Architecture

  • Own providing Finance Enablement and Governance perspectives into the global architecture and lifecycle of Deal Guidelines.
  • Define the framework, structure and governance for global Deal Guidelines.
  • Translate commercial, financial, contractual and operational requirements into simple, actionable seller guidance.
  • Drive continuous simplification and rationalization of guidelines.
  • Define mechanisms to measure adoption, effectiveness and usability.
  • Analyze recurring questions, exceptions and escalations to identify remediation opportunities.
  • Convert repeatable expert judgement into clear rules and guidance.
  • Ensure changes in strategy, products or business models are reflected in Deal Guidelines.
  • Drive the principle that standard business should not require expert interpretation

2. Product Introduction Alignment

  • Establish Deal Enablement readiness as an integral component of product introduction.
  • Work across Product Segments, Strategy, Pricing, Finance and Operations to define:
  • How the product should be sold
  • Standard commercial parameters
  • Pricing and packaging considerations
  • Contracting and quoting implications
  • Permitted and non-standard scenarios
  • Known watch-outs
  • Required guidance
  • Exception and escalation routes
  • Challenge upstream product or commercial design where unnecessary complexity will create downstream seller friction or manual intervention.

3. New Business Model Readiness

  • Own Deal Enablement readiness for new and evolving commercial models.
  • Assess the impact of new business models on deal execution.
  • Identify gaps across commercial policy, pricing, processes, contracting, finance and operations.
  • Develop practical guidelines for new commercial structures.
  • Define boundaries between standard, guided and exception business.
  • Support initial transactions and capture lessons from early adoption.
  • Convert early-stage learning into repeatable guidance.
  • Avoid temporary workarounds becoming permanent complexity.

4. Cross-Business Collaboration

  • Develop scalable Deal Enablement concepts for opportunities spanning multiple businesses, portfolios or organizational structures, for example OneTech / OpsSW-type collaboration.
  • Define clear execution principles for cross-business opportunities.
  • Clarify commercial interfaces, responsibilities and decision points.
  • Identify conflicting policies or operating assumptions.
  • Develop reusable cross-business frameworks rather than deal-specific workarounds.
  • Simplify how sellers navigate organizational boundaries.
  • Partner with relevant business organizations to identify common models that can be standardized.
  • Organizational complexity should not become seller or customer complexity.

Key Deliverables:

Global Deal Guideline framework

  • Deal Guideline lifecycle and governance
  • Guideline adoption and effectiveness framework
  • Guideline simplification/remediation backlog
  • Product Introduction Deal Readiness framework
  • New Business Model readiness framework

Quick facts

About this job

Head of Planning, Forecasting & Incentive Management role at Siemens overseeing the strategy and architecture for quota management, forecasting, and incentive compensation systems. Leads a team building expertise in sales applications including Salesforce CRM, Anaplan, and related platforms across global sales units.

Good fit if you have ten or more years in sales operations or revenue operations, five or more years leading enterprise teams, and experience with Salesforce, Anaplan, and incentive management platforms.

Full job description

Location: Any Siemens location in the world

Head of Planning, Forecasting & Incentive Management

Company Overview

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential

Position Overview

Process & Data Domain sets clear common standards for internal-facing processes, data, and the application backbone – acting as the business interface to IT for how common sales applications and related data fit together across the company.

Within it, Global Sales Applications owns the main global sales tools – including Salesforce CRM, ICM / Anaplan, rebate management, and quoting applications – and works with IT DevOps and FS SEA to maintain, improve, roll out, and train users on these applications.

Key Responsibilities

• Shape the strategy and operating model for Planning, Forecasting & Incentive Management within FS PDD SA – defining how Siemens connects quota management, forecasting, incentive compensation and performance measurement into a coherent, scalable application framework across Sales Units.

• Build the PFI team as a credible centre of expertise within Global Sales Applications – establishing clear ways of working and productive interfaces with Sales Finance, HR, FS PDD PE (Process Engineering), FS PDD DAI (Data & AI Lab), IT DevOps, and SHERPA stakeholders.

• Lead and develop a diverse team – nurturing talent, fostering collaboration, and shaping a working culture that turns ambition into outcomes.

• Own the business architecture for the PFI application landscape – connecting Salesforce CRM, CPQ, ICM / Anaplan, incentive compensation, ERP and BI platforms into a unified framework that supports planning, forecasting, quota management and incentive administration.

• Define common business definitions, KPIs and measurement frameworks that ensure consistency across systems, data and reporting – establishing a single source of truth for sales performance across Siemens.

• Sponsor PFI-related transformation initiatives and technology roadmap topics, acting as the business owner for platform improvements delivered through IT DevOps in coordination with the SHERPA X programme.

• Ensure data integrity across the PFI application ecosystem, governing how planning, quota, forecasting and compensation data flow between systems and into executive reporting.

• Lead governance for performance metrics, compensation frameworks and seller scorecards – partnering with Sales, Finance, HR, Operations, IT and Analytics to drive alignment between business objectives and performance measures.

• Oversee executive dashboards and performance reporting, ensuring senior leadership has accurate, timely and actionable visibility of forecast, quota attainment, incentive outcomes and seller productivity.

• Drive analytics that improve seller productivity and business outcomes – evaluating the effectiveness of quota plans, compensation designs and sales programs, and translating findings into recommendations for leadership.

• Represent PFI in cross-FS and FS PDD SA governance discussions, surfacing application dependencies, data risks and platform decisions that require cross-functional alignment.

Qualifications

• Ten or more years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy or Performance Management, with deep expertise in quota planning, territory management, forecasting, incentive compensation and sales performance measurement.

• Five or more years leading teams and cross-functional transformation programs at enterprise scale, with a track record of delivering business architecture and technology change across global organizations.

• Demonstrated experience designing end-to-end business processes and application ecosystems that span planning, forecasting, incentive compensation and performance reporting. Familiarity with technology company operating models is a benefit, not a requirement.

• Strong understanding of Salesforce CRM, CPQ, Anaplan, incentive management platforms, ERP and BI tools, and how they connect to form a coherent sales performance management system.

• Experience leading a team and developing talent with an inclusive leadership style, with a strong collaboration mindset across departments and organizational boundaries. Thrives in a mixed greenfield and brownfield environment, comfortable with ambiguity, evolving scope, and decisions made in motion.

• University degree in a relevant discipline; advanced degree is a plus. High proficiency in written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus.

We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. Good fit if you have 5+ years in building automation or PLC controls design and can travel up to 25% near a major airport.

Full job description

Position Location: This role is a hybrid position and supports anywhere in the US.  Candidate must live one hour away from a major airport and will be required to travel periodically to a project sites.

As a Senior Building Automation Design Engineer – PLC & Industrial Controls, you will:

· Controls Design & Engineering Leadership

Lead the design of building automation and PLC-based control solutions for data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, central utility plants, and other critical environments. Translate project requirements, contract documents, and customer standards into complete control system design packages, including drawings, panel layouts, I/O lists, network architecture, bills of materials, sequences of operation, and commissioning documentation.

· Building Automation & PLC Control Strategies

Demonstrate expertise in engineering, contracting processes, and design-build project execution by designing PLC and DDC control strategies for HVAC systems, central plants, critical environments, and process systems, while ensuring compliance with submittal requirements, documentation standards, equipment safeties, alarms, interlocks, and fail-safe operational requirements.

 · System Integration & Network Architecture

Develop automation network architectures and integration solutions utilizing platforms and protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, Proﬁnet, EtherNet/IP, Siemens APOGEE, Desigo, and other enterprise-level systems.

· Technical Coordination & Project Execution

Collaborate with programmers, project managers, commissioning specialists, ﬁeld technicians, contractors, consultants, and customers to ensure designs are executable, technical issues are resolved, and project objectives are achieved.

· Engineering Review & Quality Assurance

Review plans, speciﬁcations, codes, and customer requirements while performing design reviews, quality assurance checks, technical evaluations, and risk assessments to ensure compliance and project success.

· Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement

Serve as a senior technical resource by mentoring engineers, supporting standards development, managing design changes and re-estimates, and driving consistency and best practices across complex automation and industrial controls projects.

You will make an impact with these qualiﬁcations:

Basic Qualifications

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED.
  • 5+ years of experience in building automation, HVAC controls, industrial controls, or PLC-based control system design.
  • Proven ability to lead the design of complex automation and controls projects with minimal supervision.
  • Strong knowledge of building automation systems, HVAC controls, PLC/DDC architecture, electrical controls, and engineering best practices.
  • Proﬁciency with design and drafting tools such as AutoCAD, Visio, or similar platforms.
  • Experience developing and reviewing controls documentation, including control narratives, I/O lists, panel layouts, network diagrams, and sequences of operation. 
  • Familiarity with industrial communication protocols and system integration, including BACnet, Modbus, Proﬁnet, and EtherNet/IP.
  • Experience collaborating with programmers and automation specialists to support implementation, commissioning, and ﬁeld execution of control systems.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without sponsorship.

 


Preferred Qualifications: 


  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, or a related ﬁeld.
  •  7+ years of experience designing Siemens or third-party PLC-based building automation, HVAC, industrial controls, or mission-critical facility systems.
  • Knowledge of PLC programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, or design using platforms such as Siemens TIA Portal, Siemens PLCs, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, or similar technologies.
  • Experience designing control systems for data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, cleanrooms, central utility plants, or other critical environments.  Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, lead technical reviews, support engineering standards, and coordinate multi-discipline design teams.
