About this job

Technical Marketing Engineer for Siemens EDA focused on Advanced IC Packaging solutions, particularly 2.5D and 3DIC design flows. Role involves developing technical marketing materials, building demonstration workflows using Tcl and Python, and engaging customers to translate design challenges into product solutions.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in 2.5D/3DIC design or EDA support, strong Tcl and Python scripting skills, and experience in customer-facing technical roles.

Full job description

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

Position Summary

The Technical Marketing Engineer is responsible for driving technical marketing and solution development for EBS-centered offerings in the area of Advanced IC Packaging, with particular focus on 2.5D and 3DIC design flows.

This role requires the ability to understand customer challenges and use cases, and to translate them into solution-oriented workflows by connecting planning, layout, and verification tools using scripting technologies such as Tcl and Python. The ideal candidate will be able to engage customers in technical discussions, articulate solution value, and help shape future workflow directions, including emerging approaches that may involve agent-based technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and deliver technical marketing materials such as videos, presentations, and lab/demo content for Advanced IC Packaging solutions.
  • Build and demonstrate solution workflows for 2.5D and 3DIC design by connecting multiple tools, including planning, layout, and verification tools, using Tcl and Python.
  • Engage customers in technical discussions to understand design challenges, workflow gaps, and use-case requirements.
  • Translate customer technical requirements and related business needs into actionable input for development teams.
  • Understand newly developed products and enhancement features, and communicate their technical value and applicability to customers.
  • Support the definition and evolution of solution concepts that address current and future customer workflows.
  • Collaborate with internal teams across product, development, and field organizations to align solutions with market needs.

Accountability / Expected Contributions

  • Understand the goals of each assigned project and the role expected within that project.
  • Proactively drive assigned responsibilities to support successful project execution and achievement of business objectives.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and contribute effectively in project-based activities.
  • Help identify and shape future solution opportunities based on customer engagement and market direction.

Required Qualifications

  • Native or near-native proficiency in English.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in 2.5D / 3DIC design, Advanced IC Packaging, or technically supporting such flows from an EDA perspective.
  • Strong understanding of design workflows spanning planning, layout, and verification.
  • Practical scripting experience using Tcl and Python to automate or integrate workflows across multiple tools.
  • Ability to engage directly with customers in technical discussions and help define solution use cases.
  • Ability to use Linux as an end user in a business or technical environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products for business use.
  • Formal academic background in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in technical marketing, application engineering, solution engineering, or other customer-facing technical roles.
  • Experience creating technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept workflows, or presentation materials.
  • Familiarity with EDA solution positioning for semiconductor or packaging design customers.
  • Interest in emerging workflow technologies, including AI- or agent-assisted solution approaches.

Travel Requirements

  • Customer visits are required.
  • Domestic travel will be the primary travel requirement.
  • International travel may also be required occasionally.

Work Environment / Additional Considerations

  • This role requires collaboration with teams in Asia and Europe.
  • As a result, work may occasionally take place during early morning or evening hours to accommodate global collaboration.

This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR).  Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.

Job.JobDescription:
Pioneering in America, from the first mile to the last. This is what drives us.

We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® certified—a reflection of our commitment to creating an environment where innovation thrives, and every voice matters. Apply today and be part of shaping the future with us!

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

Position Overview:

Ready to keep America's trains running strong? Siemens Mobility is hiring Rail Technicians at our Orlando, FL facility, with openings on 2nd or 3rd shifts. You'll be hands-on with the inspection, maintenance, and repair of a fleet of locomotives, coaches, and train sets, handling everything from day-to-day running maintenance to unscheduled repairs. Guided by maintenance instructions in our Computer Maintenance Management System (CMMS), you'll help make sure every train is safe, reliable, and ready to roll. Shifts include weekdays, weekends, and holidays, and may occasionally flex to other shifts based on operational needs. If you take pride in your craft and want to be part of a team that keeps the railway moving, this is your opportunity!

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Follow all available maintenance instructions to keep every train in compliance and meeting high-quality standards.
  • Document every defect, task, and incident in the CMMS so issues are tracked, resolved, and closed out with a complete record.
  • Perform body, welding, and paint repairs on locomotives, coaches, and train sets to return equipment to service looking sharp and running strong.
  • Keep your workstation and work areas clean and debris-free for a safer, more efficient workspace.
  • Represent Siemens Mobility and build strong working relationships with our customer, creating trust and lasting partnerships.
  • Comply with all Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) safety rules, laws, and regulations to protect yourself, your team, and the public.
  • Partner with leadership on site issues, systems, and facility operations to solve problems quickly and keep operations running smoothly.
  • Willing to perform other functions as needed, including forklift operation and daily cleaning, to keep the team and the site moving forward.

This posting outlines the primary responsibilities of the role, but is not all-inclusive; additional duties may be assigned in alignment with business needs.

To thrive in this role, you have:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with a railroad or in another technical field; relevant technical training may be considered with lesser work experience.
  • Strong preference for in-depth knowledge of the technical aspects of rolling stock and depot operations

Physical Demands/Facility Information

Job.JobTitle: Enterprise AI Principal - Intelligence Center X
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Remote

About this job

Enterprise AI Principal leads complex, first-of-a-kind agentic AI engagements for major industrial companies using Siemens' Intelligence Center X platform. You design enterprise ontologies and agentic solutions, work hands-on with customer data, and help shape the product roadmap based on strategic customer needs.

Good fit if you have presales or consulting experience with enterprise AI, ontology modeling, agentic applications, and industrial software platforms like Databricks or Snowflake.

Full job description

Bring Intelligence Center X to life for leading companies, through business-relevant enterprise agentic AI use cases.

About Intelligence Center X

Intelligence Center X (ICX) is Siemens' industrial AI platform. ICX combines Siemens' own core graph, ontology, machine learning and agentic AI technology with our industrial software foundations to bring truly differentiated capabilities to market. It connects a company's enterprise and operational data into an enterprise ontology, and uses machine learning and agentic AI to reason over it and act on it.

Our customers are leaders in automotive, aerospace and defense, semiconductors and electronics, industrial machinery, pharma and financial services.

How we engage with customers
Beyond typical demos, we work forward-deployed with the customer - on relevant data, against their problem - and build a working agentic AI solution, grounded in an enterprise ontology. It is how we establish value with customers: where they see the use case come to life, and where we earn the right to move forward.

The role
Enterprise AI Principals are our most experienced ICX Presales engineers. You lead the ideation and creation of our most strategic customer engagements — modelling complex domains as enterprise ontologies, designing agents and machine learning that reason over them and act on them, and delivering agentic applications that compel customers to invest in Intelligence Center X with Siemens.

This is a global role. You are based in the Americas, and you support opportunities worldwide within your areas of expertise. You:

  • Lead the most complex engagements - first-of-a-kind and hands-on, often combining ICX with Siemens' wider industrial software portfolio.
  • Set the standard - for how ICX is positioned and implemented, through reference architectures, patterns and value cases the field builds from.
  • Help shape the ICX roadmap - align roadmap and implementation, carry use cases and requirements back into product, and make what works repeatable. Identify and create opportunities for Siemens ICX R&D to work directly with lighthouse customers on new use cases.
  • Engage executives and strategic partners - build and defend the business case with senior customer stakeholders, mobilize Siemens leadership, and lead strategic partnerships with GSIs, ISVs and hyperscalers.
You work alongside sales leadership, our ICX Engineering teams, strategic partners and R&D.

An example engagement:
A manufacturer's leadership wants to know whether agentic AI can improve a mission-critical process that stretches across their enterprise. The use case has first-of-a-kind requirements, and the answer depends on connecting engineering, manufacturing, supplier and service data owned by four different organizations. You frame the ambition with the executive sponsor, architect the enterprise ontology and the agentic approach, and guide the team that builds it. Along the way, you bring in R&D to explore how the product can improve based on the customer's use case and requirements.

Who you are:
  • You are an experienced presales architect who is hands-on with agentic AI and ontology. You design end-to-end solutions, and you still build.
  • You lead at the executive level. You build and defend business cases with executives, and you can mobilize a large organization to unblock what a deal team cannot.
  • You build for reuse. Your patterns outlive your engagements, and others build on them.
  • You are entrepreneurial. You take ownership, move at startup pace and find a route to an outcome before the problem is fully defined - with some of the largest companies in the world.

Skills and experience
We look for experience in the following areas:

  • Technical leadership on strategic enterprise accounts - leading complex, first-of-a-kind solutions with executive buyers.
  • Senior technical consulting - leading strategic agentic AI, data and analytics engagements for client executives at a consultancy or systems integrator.
  • Presales solution architecture - end-to-end design across enterprise ontology, agentic applications and machine learning.
  • Ecosystem positioning - showing where ICX is differentiated and where it complements the platforms a customer already has, so it fits their enterprise agentic AI architecture.
  • Data engineering and analytics - making sense of how a company's data is spread across its systems, bringing it together and modelling it.
  • Modern data and AI platforms - experience working with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Google Cloud, AWS data lakes, Palantir or C3.ai.
  • Agentic AI - designing agents and AI solutions grounded in enterprise data: LLMs, retrieval, tool use, MCP.
  • Agentic development tools - Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar, used to build quickly and well.
  • Enterprise ontology - modelling a real business domain as an ontology or knowledge graph and putting it to work in an enterprise.
  • Machine learning and data science - building models that solve real business problems, such as forecasting, anomaly detection or classification.
  • Industrial software - product lifecycle management, manufacturing operations or industrial IoT.
  • Industry depth - manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, pharma, aerospace or financial services.

Travel
Some travel is expected, up to 25%. Global travel is possible, though not required. For people who want to spend even more time on site with customers, there is room for it.


Why us?
  • Grow with ICX. Lead as Siemens brings Intelligence Center X to the market as a leading industrial AI platform.
  • Shape the global practice. The standards you set become how ICX is built and positioned in every zone.
  • The problem every enterprise is working on. Agentic AI grounded in a company's own data and context.
  • Direct influence on the product. You lead the engagements that help shape the ICX roadmap.
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You’ll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We’re committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

Entry-level position servicing trains in Orlando, including fueling, refueling water tanks, sanitizing systems, and assisting with mechanical maintenance. Work includes 2nd or 3rd shifts on weekdays, weekends, and holidays.

Good fit if you have a high school diploma, basic mechanical aptitude, can work nights and weekends, and are legally authorized to work in the US.

Full job description

Pioneering in America, from the first mile to the last. This is what drives us.

We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® certified—a reflection of our commitment to creating an environment where innovation thrives, and every voice matters. Apply today and be part of shaping the future with us!

Position Overview:

Ready to start a hands-on career where your work keeps trains moving? Siemens Mobility in Orlando, FL is looking for entry-level Train Service Technicians to join our team! As a key part of our maintenance crew, you’ll get trains clean, safe, and ready to roll by servicing locomotives, coaches, and train sets – emptying toilet systems, refilling water tanks, and fueling operations. You’ll help us uphold the highest safety and quality standards every step of the way. Positions are open on the 2nd or 3rd shift with a schedule that includes weekdays, weekends, and holidays. If you’re looking to get your foot in the door of the rail industry, this is your chance to hop on board!

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Perform basic train servicing tasks so trains are clean, safe, and ready for departure:
    • Empty and sanitize onboard toilet systems and refill water and windscreen washer tanks, keeping trains hygienic and fully stocked.
    • Refuel locomotives and connect trainsets to ground power, keeping equipment powered and ready for on time departures.
    • Clean HVAC components, supporting comfortable and reliable climate control.
  • Assist technicians with mechanical and electrical maintenance tasks as needed, helping keep repairs on schedule and trains available for service.
  • Follow Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) instructions and accurately log all tasks, defects, and incidents, ensuring reliable records and faster issue resolution.
  • Keep work areas and equipment clean and organized, creating a safe and efficient workspace.
  • Operate tools and equipment such as forklifts, cleaning systems, and basic hand tools to complete work safely and efficiently.
  • Support minor bodywork, welding, or painting tasks under supervision, helping return equipment to service-ready condition.
  • Follow all safety protocols and Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) regulations and communicate effectively with team members and supervisors, protecting your crew and keeping every shift running smoothly.

This posting outlines the primary responsibilities of the role, but is not all-inclusive; additional duties may be assigned in alignment with business needs.

To thrive in this role, you have:

  • High School Diploma / GED,
  • Basic literacy and numeracy skills to read instructions, complete checklists, and enter data in English,
  • Strong communication skills to report issues clearly and follow instructions in English,
  • Flexibility to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays,
  • Basic mechanical aptitude or a genuine interest in learning to use tools and equipment,
  • A commitment to following safety procedures and wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE),
  • Reliable transportation to and from the work site.

This role supports Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) programs for Siemens field service operations performing work on electrical infrastructure systems. The position provides a strong field safety presence across customer sites, partnering closely with field teams and leadership to reinforce safe work practices, identify risk, and intervene when necessary.   • 5+ years of experience with the following:

    • OSHA regulations and electrical safety practices, including NFPA 70E
    • Electrical power distribution systems or industrial electrical equipment
    • Hazard recognition, jobsite inspections, and field-based safety coaching
    • Incident investigation, documentation, and corrective action follow-up
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 75% to customer job sites
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Additional years of experience in construction, industrial, or electrical safety leadership roles
  • Experience supporting medium- or low-voltage switchgear installation, commissioning, or service activities
  • Certifications or training such as OSHA 30-Hour Construction, OSHA 510/511, CHST (or higher), NFPA 70E, Fall Protection Competent Person, or First Aid/CPR

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence safe behaviors, manage difficult conversations, and build trust with field teams

Full job description

Position Location: This role supports our customers throughout the greater Tampa, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? 

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives. Transform the everyday with us! 

 

The Solutions Senior Sales Executive (or Account Executive) is committed to supporting our Solutions (New Construction) business within our commercial Smart Buildings Total Fire Alarm & Life Safety Solutions team. In this role, you will achieve booking and profit goals by developing and implementing plans to grow, develop, and manage contractor, consultant, authority having jurisdiction, developer, and end-user relationships; capitalize on sales opportunities within the territory; and effectively execute sophisticated deals independently within our established guidelines.  Our Sales Executives are ambassadors of quality Siemens technology, products and services, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customers will help them optimize and facilitate a safe, emergency-ready workplace. 

This position can be either a Sr. Sales Executive (mid-level) or an Account Executive (senior-level) based on directly related experience.

As a Solutions Senior Sales Executive/Account Executive, you will:

  • Understand market, competitor offerings, customers and decision influencers across the region, segments, and verticals within the region. Stay updated on automation, electrical, fire, mechanical, and IoT market trends.  
  • Develop a vertical market and account management plan for strategic growth. Identify new business opportunities and create “go-to-market” strategies for end-user customers.   
  • Maintain a qualified funnel of opportunities, achieve new order/booking and profit goals consistently.  
  • Collaborate with operations and internal teams for excellent customer outcomes. Partner with other sales divisions for new projects and accounts.

Location: Any Siemens location in the world

Job Title: Learning Portfolio Consultant (f/m/d) 
Department: Sales Enablement & Activation 
Location: Flexible / Siemens Global

Overview 

Sales Enablement & Activation defines and governs the sales motion architecture, orchestrates adoption and change for all tool rollouts and process changes, and designs shared standards and content for cross-unit enablement – unlocking cross-unit value and turning strong local capabilities into shared, scalable enterprise advantage. 

Within it, Sales Enablement defines enablement design standards and partners with SMEs and Sales Units to create sales-specific cross-unit content – governing what content exists, where it lives, and when it is used, while consolidating, standardising, and retiring low-value material to keep the sales asset base focused and current. 

The Big Picture

As our Learning Portfolio Consultant, you will own, govern, and streamline our cross-unit enablement catalogue. You will be the architect of portfolio clarity—turning local materials and central assets into a lean, credible, and easily accessible enablement engine that empowers sales teams globally.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Build the Single Source of Truth: Establish and maintain the comprehensive cross-unit enablement catalogue—mapping existing learning assets across all Sales Units and mapping them against real sales roles and skill baselines.
  • Rationalize & Reduce Overload: Hunt down overlap, duplication, and conflicting materials. Partner with stakeholders to consolidate resources, retire low-value assets, and keep our content landscape clean and high-impact.
  • Drive Content Governance: Apply lifecycle frameworks to audit currency and relevance. Coordinate regular reviews with content owners to ensure everything in the catalogue is up-to-date and tied directly to active sales motions.
  • Collaborate Across Boundaries: Engage with Sales Units, subject matter experts, and regional teams to build shared visibility and ensure local innovations feed into our broader enterprise advantage.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Portfolio Expertise: Hands-on background managing, auditing, and rationalizing learning or content portfolios at scale across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Governance Know-How: Deep familiarity with content lifecycle management—knowing how to review, consolidate, and gracefully retire out-of-date assets.
  • Analytical Mindset: Demonstrated ability to map learning content against competency frameworks and role catalogues to spot coverage gaps instantly.
  • A Builder's Pragmatism: You thrive in a greenfielding environment where frameworks are still taking shape. You know how to apply structure and drive momentum without waiting for perfection.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional coordination and influencing skills across time zones, backed by high proficiency in written and spoken English.

 

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you! 

Please note, this position will be based in the Siemens location where the selected candidate currently is located. The role has been assessed as level 8(GRIP level). The actual compensation range will vary based on work location, applicable salary structure, experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Candidates will receive compensation information relevant to their location during the recruitment process in accordance with local legal requirements and Siemens compensation practices.  For further information regarding the compensation details that apply to you and your country, please contact the recruiter directly.

Fire Inspectors play a vital role in preventing, detecting, and mitigating the impact of fires. You will perform tasks such as minor repairs and visual and functional testing on fire alarm systems in accordance with all national and local standards. In addition to your primary responsibilities, you will also act as a mentor, providing on-the-job training to entry level fire alarm inspectors, fostering a culture of growth and knowledge-sharing within our team.  Our fire inspectors significantly contribute to public safety, property protection, and overall emergency preparedness.

As a Fire Inspector, you will:

  • Follow and maintain high structured inspection schedules providing inspection, testing, and performing minor service and deficiency repairs for fire alarm equipment to comply with NFPA72 standards as well as state and local codes. Note deficiencies, remedies, and review pricing with customers. Complete service ticket documentation before leaving the customer site. Follow-up on corrective actions
  • Maintain complete and accurate documentation of all tests performed. Generate reports within Siemens tools and upload to city municipality websites
  • Provide instructions to customer personnel regarding proper operation and routine inspections. Assist with training
  • Work overtime when needed, and maintain stock, tools, and equipment in vehicles
  • Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures
  • Complete required training and certifications within the time requirements for this role


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications: 

  • 1+ year of experience performing Inspections, Testing, and Maintenance (ITM) of Fire Alarm and/or Fire Life Safety Systems or low voltage electrical or mechanical experience
  • Ability and willingness to work in a variety of environments in and around mechanical and electrical equipment, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high-lift equipment, working in ducts, above ceilings, and in outside/inside/heat/cold/day/night conditions; use hand tools, laptop (Microsoft proficient), email, smartphone, and tablet; carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Must be able to differentiate types/colors of wire
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship
  • Must obtain NICET Fire Alarm Certification Level I within 12 months

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate degree in electronics or related field preferred
  • 3+ years’ experience performing Inspections, Testing, and Maintenance (ITM) of Fire Alarm and/or Fire Life Safety Systems
  • Ability to read/understand design and construction documents

Project and system experience may include:

  • Transformers, motor control centers, medium-voltage contactors, integrated electrical house systems, cable systems, busways, connectors, and supporting systems.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree in accounting or finance, 6+ years of accounting/finance experience, and strong knowledge of GAAP/IFRS and internal controls.

Full job description

Area Head of Finance

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way our business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


The Area Head of Finance  works to meet business goals while partnering with area, sales and operations managers, project/service teams, Finance and Business Administration (FBA) colleagues, and auditors. This position is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days onsite and can be located in Orlando or Miami, FL.


As an Area Head of Finance, you will:

  • Acts as commercial partner to the Branch Managers and assumes responsibility for Area financial performance. Along with Branch management, is responsible for the Area’s financial performance including P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow.
  • Leads, manages, and oversees finance, accounting, and business administration activities for all SI RSS Businesses.
  • Responsible for assigned Areas’ day-to-day business transactions and strategic initiatives in strong collaboration with Area GMs and drives, implements and monitors in cooperation with the Branches Management – productivity initiatives to further improve profitability and competitiveness.
  • Partners with Commercial Project Managers, Sales, and Operations Managers on large, more impactful projects in the Areas to ensure adequate project controlling.
  • Ensure compliance with external and internal accounting and reporting guidelines and operational Area performance (operational balance, slip, absorption, & utilization).
  • Area cost center controlling and Mentor/lead Commercial Project Managers and other team members as applicable, as well as participate in special projects related to either the local business or in support of field or home office initiatives.
  • Analyze and report financial risks, opportunities, inconsistencies, and potential fraud indicators to Branch/Region Finance and Business Administration leadership.
  • Monitor operating expense controls and recommend cost-savings and continuous improvement actions to support financial performance goals.
  • Oversee inventory valuation by maintaining sound financial control policies, procedures, and reporting practices.
  • Provide financial guidance and support to enable high-quality employee performance, development, and accountability.
  • Deliver or coordinate financial training for sales, operations, and finance teams to strengthen understanding of policies, procedures, and controls that impact the integrity of the P&L and Balance Sheet.
  • May manage, directly or indirectly, employees performing finance and accounting functions in the region.
  • Participate in special projects supporting local business priorities, field operations, or home office initiatives.
  • Support contract execution and review contract terms to provide financial guidance, improve Net Working Capital, and mitigate contractual risk.
  • Serve as a company representative and liaison with customers and local authorities to build productive relationships and reinforce a positive Siemens Smart Buildings image.
  • Review and approve contracts, purchase orders, and change orders within delegated signature authority across relevant business activities.
  • Maintain relationships with the largest and most critical customers, as appropriate, to support business continuity and customer satisfaction.

You will make an impact with these qualifications: 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field 
  • 6+ years of broad Accounting / Finance experience
  • Demonstrated understanding of GAAP/IFRS and internal controls.
  • Demonstrated a history of taking on ever increasing levels of responsibility and being able to demonstrate ability to take initiative and act independently.
  • Competencies: Results driven; client-driven; ability to interact effectively within cross functional teams; collaborative style
  • Skills: Strong financial, leadership, interpersonal, analytical; proficiency with MS Suite of applications
  • Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States and will not require employer-sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United State

Machine Builder Solution Manager

Siemens Digital Industries Automation (DI AUT) is one of the world’s leading providers of industrial automation. Our innovative automation portfolio enables companies of all sizes in both the process and discrete manufacturing industries to accelerate their automation—and thus their digital transformation—across the entire value chain. This allows our customers to increase productivity and flexibility and become future-ready through technologies such as software-defined systems and artificial intelligence. Siemens Xcelerator—the open digital business platform—helps to implement this more easily, quickly, and at scale. Together with partners and a broad ecosystem, Siemens supports its customers on their journey toward becoming a Digital Enterprise.

Create and drive scalable, ready-to-sell Machine Builder solution offerings for Zone Americas that enable industry-specific applications.

Help machine builders transition from hardware-centric automation to software-defined, data-driven, and AI-enabled machine architectures.

Drive IT/OT integration and support Siemens’ Industrial Operations X strategy by leveraging:

  • Software-Defined Automation (SDA): SIMATIC AX, SIMATIC S7-1500V Virtual PLC, Industrial Edge, and related technologies.
  • Industrial AI: Eigen Engineering Agent and other AI-enabled automation solutions.
  • Simulation & Digital Engineering: TIA Simulation Cloud, SIMIT, Digital Twin and Digital Drivetrain solutions, including S7-PLCSIM Advanced, DriveSim Engineer, and related engineering and simulation tools.
  • Advanced Automation & Motion: SIMATIC S7 T-CPU applications, motion control, safety, Industrial IoT, and integrated digital threads across the machine lifecycle.
  • Cybersecurity: Promote secure-by-design machine architectures that help machine builders address EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) requirements, protect the installed base, and leverage embedded security capabilities and CRA-ready DI AUT offerings.

Connect customer and market needs with Siemens’ cross-portfolio capabilities to develop standard applications, reusable solution toolboxes (e.g., Packaging, Intralogistics, Converting, Data Center, Material Handling and others), and end-to-end machine concepts, ranging from cabinet-level solutions, where required, to holistic digital-thread scenarios that address customer business and machine-lifecycle challenges.

Collaborate across businesses, technology organizations, Sales and Marketing, regions, and global teams to bring together the required capabilities, enabling Machine Builder Sales and technical teams to win complex opportunities, accelerate solution adoption, and turn successful customer concepts into scalable, repeatable solutions for deployment across the Americas.

How you will make an impact

Machine Builder Portfolio & Solutions

  • Scout technologies across industry, technology, and general machine builder segments to identify relevant developments and opportunities.
  • Evaluate customer, market, and competitive trends to identify leading automation, digitalization, and Machine Builder solution opportunities.
  • Capture, consolidate, and prioritize Zone-specific customer and solution requirements, translating them into actionable inputs for Global Machine Builder Solution Management, PLM, and portfolio owners.
  • Translate global portfolio strategies, solution standards, and value propositions into effective Zone and LCB execution while feeding regional market intelligence and customer requirements back to Global.
  • Collaborate with Global Machine Builder Solution Management and Zone Market Development on Standard Application Development, reusable application concepts, and scalable solution toolboxes.
  • Enable Machine Builder Sales and technical teams with industry-, application-, and system-level expertise, localized content, solution know-how, and pre-sales standards to strengthen sales readiness and portfolio adoption.
  • Provide machine concept consulting for complex and high-value opportunities, developing end-to-end, cross-portfolio concepts ranging from cabinet solutions to Software-Defined Automation and holistic digital-thread scenarios.
  • Support customer workshops, demonstrations, pilots, and Proof-of-Concepts to validate technical feasibility, customer value, and business potential.
  • Convert successful customer concepts into scalable, repeatable solutions and reusable toolboxes, and support deployment and adoption across LCBs in the Americas.
  • Facilitate alignment across LCBs, Sales, SAC-MB, technical teams, Global Solution Management, and portfolio organizations to ensure consistent solution positioning and effective execution.

What you bring

We are looking for a strategic and technically driven Machine Builder Solution Manager to support commercialization, solution strategy, and technical enablement of the Machine Builder portfolio across the Americas, with a strong focus on Software-Defined Automation, Industrial AI, simulation and digital engineering, advanced automation and motion technologies, and cybersecurity.

The successful candidate will drive solution management, technical enablement, market intelligence, and Machine Builder growth initiatives, translating emerging technologies and customer needs into scalable, repeatable solutions while strengthening alignment among regional market requirements, global strategy, and portfolio development.

Education

  • Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Industrial Automation, or a related technical field.

Experience & Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in industrial automation, machine automation, digitalization, application engineering, solution management, OEM sales, portfolio management, technical sales, or a related customer-facing role.
  • Deep understanding of Machine Builder and OEM customer segments.
  • Demonstrated experience defining or deploying machine automation solutions that integrate PLCs, motion control, drives, HMI, safety, industrial networking, and software such as TIA Portal.
  • Experience with Software-Defined Automation, Industrial IoT, advanced automation and motion-control technologies for standard applications (e.g., Packaging, Intralogistics, Converting, Data Center, Material Handling and others), safety, and cybersecurity.
  • Working knowledge of SIMATIC S7 T-CPU applications, or the ability to rapidly develop expertise and translate the technology into Machine Builder use cases.
  • Experience converting customer requirements into scalable use cases, standard applications, reusable toolboxes, technical concepts, or portfolio requirements.
  • Experience supporting complex opportunities, customer workshops, demonstrations, Proof-of-Concepts, pilots, or early-adopter programs.
  • Understanding of interface concepts, interoperability, industrial data integration, cybersecurity, and lifecycle considerations for cross-portfolio solutions.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and machine-automation applications.

Business & Collaboration Skills

  • Strong customer-back mindset with the ability to connect technical capabilities to customer value, business potential, and scalable growth.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in clear business language for customers, Sales, management, and global portfolio teams.
  • Strong analytical, prioritization, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Collaborative working style and ability to operate effectively across countries, cultures, business units, and technical disciplines.
  • Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders in a matrix organization.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20-30% across the Americas.

Languages

  • Fluent English required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Industrial Automation, or a related technical field.
  • Experience in Machine Builder or OEM markets, with knowledge of packaging, material handling, robotics, machine tools, food and beverage, or related discrete-manufacturing segments.
  • Spanish and/or Portuguese fluency.
  • Hands-on experience with Siemens automation, motion, drives, industrial software, engineering, simulation, or virtual-commissioning portfolios.
  • Working knowledge of Eigen Engineering Agent, SIMIT, S7-PLCSIM Advanced, DriveSim Engineer or other related Siemens Simulation and Digital Engineering offerings.
  • Experience developing value propositions, go-to-market content, reference architectures, sales playbooks, or customer success stories.
  • Knowledge of applicable industrial standards, cybersecurity requirements, functional safety, regulatory compliance, or machine-lifecycle services.

We are looking for a U.S. Customs Assurance Manager. This position is remote.

We are seeking a U.S. Customs Assurance Manager to support U.S. Customs Operations through data analysis, compliance monitoring, reporting, and process improvement. This role combines practical customs knowledge with strong analytical skills to identify risks, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and translate complex trade data into actionable business insights.

The successful candidate will be comfortable investigating issues beyond system-generated results, explaining the regulatory basis for conclusions, and partnering across functions to improve customs compliance and operational performance. You use data and sound customs judgment to uncover risk, explain why an issue occurred, and help build scalable reporting and controls that strengthen U.S. Customs Operations.

You will make an impact by:

  • Develop and maintain customs reports, scorecards, and key performance indicators.
  • Analyze import and broker data to identify entry errors, recurring trends, compliance risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and support corrective actions for classification, valuation, country-of-origin, and entry discrepancies.
  • Design or support data validations, exception reporting, and monitoring controls that improve customs data integrity.
  • Support HTS classification reviews, USMCA and other free trade agreement activities, audits, and compliance assessments.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for Customs Operations and business stakeholders.
  • Partner with brokers, supply chain, logistics, procurement, finance, technology teams, and other stakeholders to resolve data and process issues.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual activities and improve reporting, visibility, and operational efficiency.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in International Trade, Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Logistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in customs compliance, customs operations, brokerage, trade analytics, supply chain analytics, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. import regulations and customs processes, including entry requirements, HTS classification, valuation, and country-of-origin principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify anomalies and trends, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, data validation, and reporting.
  • Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional environment.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in customs compliance, customs operations, brokerage, or trade analytics.
  • Hands-on experience applying customs regulations to classification, audit, USMCA or other free trade agreement, origin, valuation, or post-entry activities.
  • Experience creating dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, validations, or automated compliance reports.
  • Proficiency with Tableau, Power BI, Snowflake, SAP, Alteryx, Power Automate, or comparable analytics and automation tools.
  • Experience evaluating broker performance, entry accuracy, compliance trends, and root causes.
  • Experience supporting internal or external audits, corrective-action tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Licensed Customs Broker certification is a plus.

This is a remote position in the U.S.

This opportunity offers remote flexibility and a collaborative culture built on honesty, accountability, empowerment, and autonomy. You will have opportunities to shape client strategies, develop colleagues, and grow the practice.

You’ll make an impact as you:

  • Lead client discussions, identify business needs, explain trade-offs, and recommend action.

  • Improve delivery through automation, reusable tools, and standardized methods.
  • Align client and internal stakeholders, contributing as a hands-on specialist or project director.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, economics, finance, statistics, physics, mathematics, or a related analytical field.
  • 15+ years in commodity risk management, as well as energy trading, portfolio management, procurement, or related consulting.
  • Substantial power and/or natural gas risk experience, including hedging strategy and implementation. (Commodity risk management required.)
  • Strong quantitative foundations demonstrated through hands-on modeling, analysis, or validation during your career.
  • Ability to challenge methods, data, and assumptions and explain their commercial implications.
  • Experience developing risk programs for physical and contractual energy portfolios.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts and deliver actionable recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience leading complex projects, managing priorities, and owning delivery quality.
  • Experience mentoring colleagues and reviewing analytical work.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 20%.
  • Ability to work in the U.S. without current or future employer-sponsored work authorization.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in finance, financial engineering, quantitative finance, economics, or a related field.
  • Consulting or external client-advisory experience.
  • Success building client relationships, developing proposals, and winning engagements.
  • Entrade or other energy trading and risk management platform experience.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Python, SQL, R, or advanced Excel.
  • Experience across energy markets and client types, including utilities, municipalities, large users, and suppliers.
  • Experience developing thought leadership, presenting to executives, or creating advisory services.

Quick facts

About this job

Design and architect large-scale AI, HPC, and cloud infrastructure for Siemens' AI Factory globally. Role involves evaluating emerging technologies, developing reference architectures, and translating IT requirements for electrical, cooling, and facility teams.

Good fit if you have 10+ years in compute, storage, or hyperscale infrastructure and 5+ years in architecture or principal engineering roles with data center experience.

Full job description

AI Factory HPC Infrastructure Deployment Architect

 

Position Overview 

 

The AI Factory HPC Infrastructure Deployment Architect will serve as a global technical authority for compute, networking, storage, memory, and IT infrastructure architecture within Siemens' AI Factory organization. The role will track how AI, hyperscale, cloud, HPC, and enterprise platforms are evolving and convert those changes into actionable AI Factory reference architectures and go-to-market guidance. The successful candidate will bring practical experience building or architecting large-scale compute, network, and storage environments and enough data-center fluency to translate upstream IT decisions into clear implications for power, cooling, controls, physical topology, resiliency, and deployment strategy. A critical responsibility is to partner with electrical, thermal/liquid cooling, controls & automation, digital thread, and regional Solutions Architects, rack density, cluster topology, network fabrics, storage architecture, and workload behavior are accurately reflected in the complete AI Factory architecture. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Serve as the technical authority for AI, HPC, cloud, and enterprise infrastructure architectures. 
  • Evaluate emerging processor, accelerator, networking, memory, and storage technologies and assess their impact on AI Factory designs. 
  • Develop scalable reference architectures spanning compute, storage, networking, racks, clusters, and data hall environments. 
  • Translate IT infrastructure requirements into actionable inputs for electrical, cooling, controls, and facility design teams. 
  • Partner with customers, hyperscalers, enterprises, and technology partners on infrastructure strategy and architecture planning. 
  • Develop technical guidance, architecture frameworks, and thought leadership content supporting sales and go-to-market initiatives. 
 

Basic Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; Master’s preferred. 
  • 10+ years of experience in compute infrastructure, networking, storage, cloud, HPC, enterprise systems, or hyperscale environments. 
  • 5+ years in architecture, principal engineering, technical leadership, or equivalent roles. 
  • Proven experience designing or architecting large-scale infrastructure environments. 
  • Experience with AI infrastructure, accelerated computing, HPC, hyperscale, or high-density data centers. 
  • Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Ability to travel up to 30-50%. 
 

Technical Expertise 

  • Large-scale compute, AI, HPC, cloud, or hyperscale infrastructure environments. 
  • Server, CPU, GPU, and accelerator architectures. 
  • AI training and inference platforms. 
  • Data center networking including Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE, and AI fabrics. 
  • Enterprise and high-performance storage architectures. 
  • Linux, virtualization, containers, and distributed systems. 
  • Rack-level infrastructure, power, cooling, and high-density deployments. 
  • Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into scalable architecture strategies. 
 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep expertise in compute, HPC, networking, AI infrastructure, hyperscale systems, or a related domain. 
  • Broad knowledge across compute, networking, storage, and data center infrastructure. 
  • Strong systems thinking with the ability to translate technology trends into business and architectural value. 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive alignment across technical and business stakeholders. 
  • Executive presence with strong communication and presentation skills. 
  • Ability to simplify complex technologies into actionable architectural decisions. 
  • Innovation mindset with a passion for learning emerging technologies and industry trends.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Location: This role is based remotely, ideally based near Denver, Atlanta, Dallas, Detroit, Raleigh, or Chicago.

The Senior Data Center Electrical Architect – MV/LV leads the electrical architecture for Siemens’ AI Factory program, spanning high-, medium-, and low-voltage systems. This role is responsible for developing scalable, future-ready electrical designs that integrate both physical and digital power infrastructure across AI Factory and data center environments. 
 
The role collaborates closely with multi-disciplinary engineering, business, innovation, and R&D teams to translate complex electrical systems into reference architectures and reusable design frameworks deployed across Siemens portfolios and customer solutions.


You’ll make an impact by

  • Leading electrical architecture activities across HV, MV, and LV domains for AI Factory and data center programs.
  • Designing and integrating physical power infrastructure, including AC and DC systems, power conversion, backup generation, storage, and distribution.
  • Developing digital power architectures that enable advanced monitoring and control systems.
  • Enhancing Siemens offers related to energy management, SCADA, digital twins, grid models, and related services.
  • Co-creating with peers across disciplines to optimize Siemens reference architectures and client-specific AI Factory designs.
  • Creating scalable electrical system designs, libraries, and guidelines reused across portfolios, advanced development, and R&D teams.
  • Incorporating emerging NEC, NFPA, and UL standards into forward-looking electrical design concepts.


Core Competencies

  • Electrical Systems Architecture: Leads MV/LV electrical design across complex AI Factory and data center environments.
  • Digital Power & Grid Modeling: Applies advanced simulation and modeling tools to validate power system design.
  • Business Acumen: Translates electrical design decisions into scalable customer and portfolio value.
  • Standards-Driven Design: Integrates emerging NEC, NFPA, UL, and OCP requirements into future-ready architectures.
  • Collaboration & Influence: Works effectively across fast-paced, multi-disciplinary teams and platforms.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in MV/LV electrical system design or architecture.
  • Proficient in creating electrical single line diagrams and schematics.
  • Hands-on experience with electrical codes and standards.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required, up to 50%.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Systems.
  • Deep expertise in protection, selectivity, coordination studies, arc-flash mitigation.
  • Experience in integrating OEM components into an optimized skid for modular deployment.
  • Experience using Siemens grid modeling, electrical design, or power automation tools.

About Siemens Digital Industries Software
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a global leader in industrial software, empowering companies worldwide to drive innovation and digital transformation through our comprehensive portfolio of products and solutions. Our cutting-edge technology helps create precise digital twins, enabling customers to master the complexity of smart products and processes.


Join our dynamic Global Storage Team, a strategic pillar supporting Siemens Digital Industries Software's engineers and corporate staff across numerous R&D centers and offices worldwide. 


The Role

As a Senior Storage Administrator, you will be instrumental in driving efficiency and innovation by assisting with the automation of our enterprise storage infrastructure. You'll leverage your deep expertise in NetApp and EverPure/Pure Storage to deliver highly available, performant, and cost-effective solutions, playing a critical role in our digital transformation journey.


Key Responsibilities

The Senior Storage Administrator will also be responsible for critical storage operations support in a primarily NAS environment and will participate in a global on-call rotation. Must be able to perform problem resolution in an effective and timely manner in accordance with SLA's and customer expectations. Time management and prioritization skills will be required to accommodate business requirements and manage scheduled activities. Must work well in a team environment and possess strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Infrastructure Management: Storage platforms administration, monitoring, upgrading, installation and setup, configuration, testing, and deployments optimized for software development and build environments.

  • Performance Engineering & Tuning: Drive performance tuning, capacity planning, and troubleshooting in large-scale enterprise environments with high IOPs and throughput demands (supporting CI/CD pipelines, EDA workloads, and developer scratch spaces).

  • Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Spearhead process automation, expert scripting, and IaC to enable self-service storage provisioning for engineering teams.

  • Vendor & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with architecture, DevOps, and service delivery teams on new and existing infrastructure initiatives; manage vendor escalations for critical support issues.

  • Operations & Support: Handle tier-3 support tickets for complex customer/developer issues and participate in a global on-call rotation. Ensure reliable operations in a primarily NAS/SAN environment in accordance with strict SLAs.

Job Qualifications

  • Education: BS degree (or equivalent) in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MS degree is preferred.

  • Experience: 5+ years of directly applicable enterprise storage administration experience in large-scale corporate or software engineering environments.

  • Core Storage Expertise:

    • 5+ years working with Network Appliance NAS/SAN technologies, including in-depth experience with NetApp Cluster Mode (cDot) and management tools (e.g., Active IQ Unified Manager).

    • Hands-on administration and troubleshooting experience with Everpure Storage or modern all-flash scale-out platforms.

    • Robust understanding of Data Protection technologies, including SnapMirror/Snapvault replications and disaster recovery paradigms.

  • Software Development & Engineering Support Alignment:

    • Demonstrated experience supporting software development organizations, understanding the unique IO profile of software builds, test execution, compilation workloads, and artifact repositories.

    • Familiarity with High-Performance Computing (HPC) and EDA (Electronic Design Automation) storage requirements (handling high small-file IOPS, concurrency, and massive throughput).

  • Automation & Scripting: Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, Ansible, REST APIs, and Terraform/IaC to eliminate manual administrative toil.

  • OS & Networking Fundamentals: Solid understanding of networking protocols (NFS, SMB/CIFS, TCP/IP) and deep operating system administration skills (Linux and Windows) for diagnosing client-side storage bottlenecks, permissions, and mount issues.

  • Operations Mindset: Solid understanding of problem management, incident management, and change control processes in a global enterprise. Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Knowledge / Skills, Education, and Experience

  • Development Toolchain Familiarity: Exposure to modern developer tools and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, Docker/Kubernetes persistent volumes).

  • Certifications: NetApp Certified Storage Associate/Professional (NCSA/NCIE) or Pure Storage certifications highly desired. 

  • Virtualization & Cloud: Experience with OpenStack, VMware, or hybrid-cloud storage tiering.

Siemens Grid Software's consulting business Power Technologies International (PTI) is seeking a Portfolio Consulting Manager to lead a team focused on transmission planning and interconnection consulting services across the ERCOT and SPP regions. This leadership role combines people management, business development, customer engagement, and project execution. The successful candidate will lead a team of power system consultants while partnering with utilities, developers, and large energy users to address evolving grid reliability, electrification, and interconnection challenges.

Location: This is a remote role within the contiguous U.S.

What You Will do:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of power system consultants.
  • Grow Siemens PTI's transmission planning and interconnection consulting business in ERCOT and SPP.
  • Build and maintain relationships with utilities, developers, RTOs, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Lead customer engagements, proposal development, project planning, and contract execution.
  • Oversee the execution of transmission planning and interconnection studies, including steady-state, short-circuit, transient stability, and related reliability assessments.
  • Ensure successful project delivery with respect to scope, schedule, budget, quality, and customer satisfaction.
  • Manage portfolio performance, including revenue growth, profitability, utilization, forecasting, and resource planning.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering.
  • 10+ years of experience in transmission planning, operations, generator interconnection, load interconnection, or power system studies.
  • 2+ years of experience leading technical teams or managing consulting organizations.
  • Working knowledge of power system analysis tools such as PSS®E, TARA, PSLF™, PowerWorld, TSAT™, or PSCAD™.
  • Strong understanding of NERC Reliability Standards and regional planning criteria.
  • Excellent communication, customer engagement, and technical report writing skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a specialization in Power and Energy Systems.
  • Prior consulting experience in the electric utility industry.
  • Experience with utility-scale generation, renewable energy, or large load interconnection studies.
  • Experience with ERCOT and/or SPP planning and interconnection processes.

Success in this Role:

The successful candidate will balance three key areas of responsibility:

  • People Leadership - Build, mentor, and retain a high-performing consulting team.
  • Business Growth - Expand Siemens PTI's market presence and consulting portfolio across ERCOT and SPP through strong customer relationships and strategic business development.
  • Project Delivery - Ensure high-quality, profitable execution of complex customer engagements while maintaining customer satisfaction and long-term client relationships.

Engagement Manager - CTO in Process Industries

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! Siemens Digital Industries is hiring an Engagement Manager (EM) to lead architect a small portfolio of strategic end-user accounts in the process industries: Chemicals, Glass, Energy, Life Sciences, and Consumer Packaged Goods.

The scope of this role is automation in manufacturing environments — process control systems, batch and continuous production, plant-floor operations technology, predictive maintenance, IT/OT with an emphasis of industrial AI in operations, and the modernization of legacy control system installed base.

The EM spearheads the technical and commercial engagement across the process industries accounts. You will define the multi-year automation "first of's" and modernization roadmaps for each customer, architect the lifecycle program that delivers it, and lead the cross-functional team that sells and executes it. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; you will lead through influence across sales, product, services, marketing, and customer executive stakeholders.

This position is remote with the flexibility to reside anywhere within the Continental United States.

This position is remote with the flexibility to reside anywhere within the Continental United States.


You'll make an impact by:

  • You architect the automation in manufacturing vision and map the customer from where they are to where they want to be, with the lifecycle program to get them there.
  • Own the multi-year outcome roadmap for a small set of strategic accounts — from C-suite ambition (operational performance, modernization ROI, time-to-value, sustainability targets) to the technical execution that makes it real.
  • Protect scope integrity end-to-end. No surprise scope creep. No "we'll figure it out in execution." You are the integrity check between what was sold and what gets delivered.
  • Compress order closure speed on your accounts — you are the roadblock breaker, the escalation path, the deal architect.
  • Build next-wave pipeline from inside the install base, and the champion for new large labels — every closed deal is a launchpad for the next three. Cross-portfolio thinking is the default, not the upsell.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional account teams — sellers, application engineers, product specialists, service leads, and partners — toward one coherent engagement.
  • Coach by example. No org chart authority required — your influence comes from being the most prepared, most strategic, and most outcome-focused person in the room.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in the process industries — Chemicals, Energy, Life Sciences, or Consumer Packaged Goods. 
  • Worked as the end-user in any of the process industries
  • As senior Systems Integrator architecting automation solutions in these industries
  • You are an automation-in-manufacturing Subject Matter Expert — practitioner-grade.
  • You have personally designed, production automation systems: control system architectures, batch and continuous process control, IT/OT convergence, predictive maintenance, plant network and infrastructure design, and modernization/migration paths from legacy installed base to current-generation platforms. 
  • Demonstrated ownership of large, strategic end-user accounts — multi-site, multi-stakeholder, multi-year.
  • You have personally architected and sold lifecycle contracts. Multi-year service and lifecycle agreements, performance-based contracts, managed services, outcome-based agreements, and subscription or as-a-service commercial models.
  • The ability to translate technical complexity → executive clarity and back again.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.
  • Travel requirements 30%-35%.

Good fit if you have 8+ years installing and troubleshooting low voltage AC drives, a degree in electrical engineering or related field, and can travel 70% or more.

Full job description

Low Voltage Drives Field Service Engineer

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways.

Transform the everyday with us! 

This position will be a remote position with extensive travel required. The employee must live within an hour of a major airport.

You’ll make an impact by:

Siemens is seeking a Low Voltage Drives Field Service Engineer to provide expert onsite and remote support for industrial drive systems across customer facilities. This role supports installation, startup, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, upgrades, retrofits, and customer training for Siemens low voltage drive products and related automation systems.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical professional who enjoys solving complex problems in industrial environments, working directly with customers, and helping keep critical manufacturing and process operations running safely and reliably.

Seventy percent travel or more is expected and proximity to a major airport is required.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform field service activities for Siemens low voltage drives, including SINAMICS G120, G130, G150, S120, Masterdrives, DC drives, and related drive platforms.
  • Support installation, startup, commissioning, testing, tuning, troubleshooting, repair, preventive maintenance, and modernization work at customer sites.
  • Diagnose hardware, software, communication, motor, and power-related issues using electrical schematics, drive parameters, diagnostic tools, meters, and test equipment.
  • Provide technical and operational support for low voltage drives, motion control, PLC/HMI interfaces, motor control centers, and related industrial automation equipment.
  • Perform emergency break-fix service and scheduled service work in manufacturing, process, utility, marine, and heavy industrial environments.
  • Create clear service reports, timesheets, test records, recommendations, and follow-up actions after each assignment.
  • Communicate professionally with customers, project managers, technical support, sales, and internal service teams.
  • Train customer maintenance and operations personnel on proper equipment operation, inspection, maintenance, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Identify opportunities for spare parts, service agreements, upgrades, retrofits, training, and reliability improvements.
  • Follow Siemens safety procedures, customer site requirements, lockout/tagout practices, and applicable electrical safety standards.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electrical engineering technology, automation, mechatronics, or a related technical field; equivalent technical experience may be considered.
  • 8+ years of experience installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, or maintaining low voltage AC drive systems in industrial environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of variable frequency drives, motors, power electronics, control wiring, industrial networks, and electrical troubleshooting.

This role is designed for a remote work environment and requires frequent travel throughout the assigned territory. Candidates must be able to travel extensively and should live within convenient access to a major airport.

Siemens Industry Inc. is seeking an experienced, customer-focused Consulting Factory Automation Field Service Engineer to join our Services Execution Division.

We are looking for a Consulting Factory Automation Field Service Engineer. This home-office-based position reports to the Operations Manager, Factory Automation Field Service, and requires approximately 50-75% travel.

In this critical role, you will provide advanced technical support, engineering, troubleshooting, product expertise, and commissioning services for Siemens factory automation equipment and systems. You will support customers both on-site and remotely and serve as a key technical resource, particularly during complex and high-pressure situations.

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Providing expert second- and third-level technical and operational support for complex Siemens factory automation equipment and systems, including diagnosing and resolving issues that may not be covered by standard procedures.
  • Guiding and performing the installation, configuration, commissioning, and integration of Siemens automation hardware and software at customer sites.
  • Engaging directly with customers through active listening, clear communication, and structured problem-solving, while remaining composed and effective during demanding situations.
  • Conducting scheduled and emergency field service support, completing software version updates, and providing ongoing maintenance and troubleshooting assistance.
  • Integrating computer hardware and software components within automation systems.
  • Supporting project teams with startup and commissioning activities, including managing subcontractors and monitoring delivery when needed.
  • Implementing requested system changes using programming languages and methods that include LAD, FBD, GRAPH, SCL, and STL.
  • Guiding customers in maintaining and adjusting complex equipment and reviewing task plans, drawings, and installation schematics throughout task execution.
  • Following safe job practices, including completing daily safety briefs before work begins, and developing detailed daily field reports that document job activities.
  • Assisting with customer proposal planning by estimating labor hours, materials, travel expenses, and per diem costs.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, OR equivalent experience in industrial controls or another relevant technical discipline.
  • 10-15 years of successful experience in factory automation field service or an engineering/maintenance similar role.
  • At least 10 years of hands-on experience with Siemens factory automation equipment and software, listed below.
  • Proficiency with S7-Classic and TIA Portal software.
  • Experience with Profibus, PROFINET, wireless communication, and OPC UA protocols.
  • Strong knowledge of programmable logic controllers, advanced control systems, coordinated drive systems, and automation principles and concepts.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, communicate effectively with customers, listen actively, and remain composed under pressure.
  • Proficient in English both written and verbal.
  • Authorized to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now or in the future.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50-75% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with SIMOTION.
  • Knowledge of Siemens S7-1500T technology controllers and technology blocks.
  • Experience providing customer training.
  • Experience with Siemens SINAMICS drives.
