 PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS:
 
 Enters and exits vehicles quickly while wearing approximately 15 to 20 pounds of equipment.  Night vision and peripheral vision are important. Runs, climbs over fences and walls to subdue suspects.  Sits, while driving, for extended periods of time. Manual dexterity to use handcuffs, light flares, fire weapon, do CPR, etc. May lift objects and/or persons in excess of 50 pounds.  May stand for extended periods of time when directing traffic and controlling crowds.
 Exposed to extreme weather conditions such as heat, cold, rain and potentially dangerous environments.  Exposed to putrid odors, diseases, chemicals, and excessive noise.

Regional Administrative Assistant

Based in Orlando, Florida, Massey Services is one of the nation’s largest and most respected service companies, with a history of providing quality service for more than three decades. Celebrating consecutive years of profitable growth since 1985, Massey Services and its subsidiary organizations employ over 2,800 team members and operate over 2,400 vehicles that provide Residential and Commercial Pest Prevention, Termite Protection, Landscape and Irrigation Services to over 800,000 customers from 180+ Service Centers throughout Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Texas, South Carolina, North Carolina, Virginia, Tennessee and Oklahoma.

Job Functions and Duties

  • Maintain a professional image in both appearance and work area.
  • Answer all phone calls for Regional/Division Managers and respond to caller’s request by researching information and responding, taking messages, or routing calls. Ensure messages are delivered in a timely and accurate fashion.
  • Receive all incoming mail for Regional/Division Managers. Sort, open and respond accordingly. Ensure outgoing mail is processed daily.
  • Compose all correspondence for Regional/Division Managers. This could include correspondence with customers or team members, interoffice memorandum, or others.
  • Maintain schedule for Regional/Division Managers and ensure immediate access to them at all times.
  • Attend meetings and take notes on behalf of Regional/Division Managers. Follow-up as necessary to all relevant concerns, issues, or requests for information, reports, or data, following each meeting.
  • Act as liaison between Service Centers, Corporate Office, Regional/Division Managers and Executive Office. Ensure lines of communication are open and all appropriate information is communicated accurately and professionally.
  • Make all arrangements for regional meetings and handle the set-up and clean-up of regional functions. This includes everything from hotel accommodations, reservation of corporate training room space, ordering of food, pick-up of food or groceries, arrangement of items, refreshing items during meetings, and clean-up after meetings. (Meetings may take place early mornings, during the day, late afternoons, or even on the weekends.)
  • Travel with Regional/Division Manager to attend meetings or assist with service center issues.
  • Handle all customer inquiries and complaints immediately and keep Regional/Division Managers informed. Research customer information for Customer Care Department, upon request.
  • Work with Human Resources to ensure ESF’s for appropriate service centers are properly completed and submitted on a timely basis. Assist Human Resources with gathering appropriate information and documentation for personnel files.
  • Arrange interviews for Regional/Division Managers and ensure compliance with pre-employment program and system. Test applicants when necessary.
  • Gather daily, weekly and monthly operational reports. Compile weekly Sales Recap Reports based on sales information submitted from individual service centers every Friday.
  • Assist with preparing budgets each trimester. Work will include worksheets, as well as P&L’s data collection, compilation, printing and distribution following final Executive approval.
  • Attend technical training classes whenever possible to stay abreast of all technical information and changes.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Benefits package includes: Medical, Dental, Vision, Company Paid Life Insurance, 401(k) with company match, Short & Long Term Disability, Paid vacations & sick time, Tuition Reimbursement Program, and many more.

Experience, Education and Skills Required

High school diploma or equivalent required. College degree in business related field strongly preferred. Must possess computer expertise in Word, Excel and Power Point (minimum, other program knowledge helpful). Must possess exceptional oral and written communication skills, plus ability to compose professional letters. Extensive experience interacting with the public or in a customer service role required. Supervisory experience preferred. Must be flexible with regard to assignments and work hours (overnight out-of-town work may be required). Ability to create programs for field operations required. Ability to analyze numerical data required. Shorthand/speed writing preferred. Ability to prioritize work and complete tasks in a fast-paced environment required. Must possess excellent follow-through ability and good judgment.

Must possess ability to operate general office equipment. Must be organized, friendly and exhibit a willing-to-please demeanor at all times. Must be able to pass typing, math, spelling and other standard pre-employment tests.

Background checks completed on all candidates considered for hire

Job.JobTitle: Manager of Audit and Compliance - Orlando
Job.JobDescription:
Based in Orlando, Florida, Massey Services is one of the nation’s largest and most respected service companies, with a history of providing quality service for more than three decades. Celebrating consecutive years of profitable growth since 1985, Massey Services and its subsidiary organizations employ over 2,800 team members and operate over 2,400 vehicles that provide Residential and Commercial Pest Prevention, Termite Protection, Landscape and Irrigation Services to over 800,000 customers from 180+ Service Centers throughout Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Texas, South Carolina, North Carolina, Virginia, Tennessee and Oklahoma.

REPORTS TO: DIRECTOR OF TAX AND COMPLIANCE

SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • PROVIDE EFFECTIVE AUDIT OVERSIGHT, COMPLIANCE MANAGEMENT, AND INTERNAL CONTROL ASSURANCE.

Assist the Director of Tax and Compliance in maintaining strong internal controls and ensuring compliance with accounting standards, company policies, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements. Coordinate audit activities, monitor compliance initiatives, support tax reporting processes, and promote financial integrity throughout the organization.

  • STAFF DEVELOPMENT

Develop, mentor, and support accounting and compliance staff to assure ongoing professional growth, technical development, accountability, and consistent quality performance.

  • INTEGRITY AND IMAGE

Be committed to truth and integrity. Never compromise! Be consistent and fair. Be committed to our Company’s image. The public perception of our people, vehicles, equipment, and materials is essential to our success. Be committed to teamwork; think we and us!

JOB FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES:

  • AUDIT MANAGEMENT AND COMPLIANCE

o    Coordinate and manage annual external financial statement audits, interim audit procedures, internal audits, and compliance reviews.

o    Serve as the primary liaison among external auditors, consultants, tax professionals, and internal business stakeholders to facilitate efficient audit execution and timely completion.

o    Support the Director of Tax and Compliance in responding to audit requests and regulatory inquiries by gathering, reviewing, reconciling, and providing accurate documentation and workpapers.

o    Monitor compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), company policies, applicable regulatory requirements, and internal control standards.

o    Track audit findings, compliance issues, and management action plans. Follow up with responsible leaders to ensure corrective actions are implemented, documented, and resolved timely.

o    Assist with compliance reporting and regulatory examinations as needed.

  • INTERNAL CONTROLS AND RISK ASSESSMENT
    • Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls over financial reporting and selected operational processes.

o    Conduct periodic risk assessments to identify financial, operational, reporting, and compliance risks throughout the organization.

o    Recommend practical improvements designed to strengthen controls, improve efficiency, reduce risk, and support compliance objectives.

o    Develop, maintain, and document accounting and compliance policies, procedures, process narratives, and internal control documentation.

o    Partner with management to develop remediation strategies and monitor their implementation.

  • FINANCIAL ANALYSIS, REPORTING, AND TAX SUPPORT

o    Review accounting records, journal-entry support, account reconciliations, financial reports, and related documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with company policies and accounting standards.

o    Analyze financial data, account activity, and reporting trends to identify unusual transactions, inconsistencies, control weaknesses, or areas requiring management attention.

o    Provide accurate schedules, reconciliations, and workpapers necessary for the preparation of corporate federal, state, and local tax returns and other compliance filings.

o    Assist with periodic financial reporting, budgeting activities, tax reporting support, and special projects assigned by the Director of Tax and Compliance.

  • ACCOUNTING AND COMPLIANCE STAFF DEVELOPMENT

o    Motivate, train, supervise, and lead assigned accounting and compliance personnel consistent with the Company’s culture, leadership principles, guiding philosophy, and purpose.

o    Develop and mentor team members to strengthen technical accounting, audit, compliance, risk assessment, and internal control knowledge and prepare qualified employees for advancement opportunities.

o    Provide guidance and training to accounting, finance, and operational personnel regarding compliance requirements, internal controls, documentation standards, and audit expectations.

o    Review work assignments and job responsibilities to promote productivity, accountability, timely completion, and quality performance. Provide timely coaching and feedback.

  • OTHER
    • Maintain a clean, neat, safe, and professional work environment.
    • Assist the Director of Tax and Compliance, Controller, Vice President of Finance & Accounting, and other members of management with special projects, system implementations, and process-improvement initiatives.
    • Continually learn and remain current on accounting standards, auditing practices, tax regulations, compliance requirements, technology, and relevant industry practices.
    • Perform all other duties as assigned.

EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND SKILLS REQUIRED

  • The work generally requires a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. CPA, CIA, CISA, or another relevant professional certification is preferred. A minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in public accounting, internal audit, compliance, financial reporting, or corporate accounting is required. Experience coordinating external audits and evaluating internal controls is preferred.
  • The work draws upon and requires a thorough knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), internal control concepts, risk-assessment methodologies, audit procedures, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance requirements. Strong analytical, organizational, project-management, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills are necessary. The position requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, exercise sound judgment, and work effectively with employees and leaders at all organizational levels.
  • Must possess advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications and accounting or ERP systems. Must exhibit professionalism, integrity, discretion, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

TYPICAL PHYSICAL AND MENTAL DEMANDS

  • Requires the ability to sit and concentrate for long periods of time.
  • Requires the ability to move freely about the office building and to bend and reach to file and retrieve data.
  • Telephone usage is required.
  • Corrected vision and hearing to normal range are needed.
  • Requires the ability to communicate clearly.
  • Requires the ability to work in front of a computer monitor and on a keyboard and use general office equipment for extended periods of time.

THIS DESCRIPTION MAY NOT BE ALL INCLUSIVE AND EMPLOYEES ARE EXPECTED TO PERFORM ALL OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED AND DIRECTED BY MANAGEMENT. JOB DESCRIPTIONS AND DUTIES MAY BE MODIFIED WHENEVER DEEMED APPROPRIATE BY MANAGEMENT.

About this job

Facilities Administrative Assistant supporting Division Managers at Massey Services in Orlando. Responsibilities include phone and mail management, scheduling, correspondence, meeting coordination, and operational reporting for a multi-state pest control and landscaping company.

Good fit if you have high school diploma, strong Word/Excel skills, customer service experience, and flexibility for occasional overnight travel.

Full job description

Based in Orlando, Florida, Massey Services is one of the nation’s largest and most respected service companies, with a history of providing quality service for more than three decades. Celebrating consecutive years of profitable growth since 1985, Massey Services and its subsidiary organizations employ over 2,800 team members and operate over 2,400 vehicles that provide Residential and Commercial Pest Prevention, Termite Protection, Landscape and Irrigation Services to over 800,000 customers from 180+ Service Centers throughout Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Texas, South Carolina, North Carolina, Virginia, Tennessee and Oklahoma.

Job Functions and Duties

  • Maintain a professional image in both appearance and work area.
  • Answer all phone calls for Division Managers and respond to caller’s request by researching information and responding, taking messages, or routing calls. Ensure messages are delivered in a timely and accurate fashion.
  • Receive all incoming mail for Division Managers. Sort, open and respond accordingly. Ensure outgoing mail is processed daily.
  • Compose all correspondence for Division Managers. This could include correspondence with customers or team members, interoffice memorandum, or others.
  • Maintain schedule for Division Managers and ensure immediate access to them at all times.
  • Attend meetings and take notes on behalf of Division Managers. Follow-up as necessary to all relevant concerns, issues, or requests for information, reports, or data, following each meeting.
  • Act as liaison between Service Centers, Corporate Office, Division Managers and Executive Office. Ensure lines of communication are open and all appropriate information is communicated accurately and professionally.
  • Make all arrangements for regional meetings and handle the set-up and clean-up of regional functions. This includes everything from hotel accommodations, reservation of corporate training room space, ordering of food, pick-up of food or groceries, arrangement of items, refreshing items during meetings, and clean-up after meetings. (Meetings may take place early mornings, during the day, late afternoons, or even on the weekends.)
  • Travel with Division Manager to attend meetings or assist with service center issues.
  • Handle all customer inquiries and complaints immediately and keep Division Managers informed. Research customer information for Customer Care Department, upon request.
  • Work with Human Resources to ensure ESF’s for appropriate service centers are properly completed and submitted on a timely basis. Assist Human Resources with gathering appropriate information and documentation for personnel files.
  • Arrange interviews for Division Managers and ensure compliance with pre-employment program and system. Test applicants when necessary.
  • Gather daily, weekly and monthly operational reports. Compile weekly Sales Recap Reports based on sales information submitted from individual service centers every Friday.
  • Assist with preparing budgets each trimester. Work will include worksheets, as well as P&L’s data collection, compilation, printing and distribution following final Executive approval.
  • Attend technical training classes whenever possible to stay abreast of all technical information and changes.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Benefits package includes: Medical, Dental, Vision, Company Paid Life Insurance, 401(k) with company match, Short & Long Term Disability, Paid vacations & sick time, Tuition Reimbursement Program, and many more.

Experience, Education and Skills Required

High school diploma or equivalent required. College degree in business related field strongly preferred. Must possess computer expertise in Word, Excel and Power Point (minimum, other program knowledge helpful). Must possess exceptional oral and written communication skills, plus ability to compose professional letters. Extensive experience interacting with the public or in a customer service role required. Supervisory experience preferred. Must be flexible with regard to assignments and work hours (overnight out-of-town work may be required). Ability to create programs for field operations required. Ability to analyze numerical data required. Shorthand/speed writing preferred. Ability to prioritize work and complete tasks in a fast-paced environment required. Must possess excellent follow-through ability and good judgment.

Must possess ability to operate general office equipment. Must be organized, friendly and exhibit a willing-to-please demeanor at all times. Must be able to pass typing, math, spelling and other standard pre-employment tests.

Background checks completed on all candidates considered for hire

Responsibilities
1. Identify Business Processes and Practices for Improvement
Analyze operational and corporate procedures to identify areas for potential optimization and streamlining. Visit corporate departments and service centers and observe repeated practices. Study policies and procedures for inefficiencies, practices that do not scale with size, or slow and challenging routines. Prioritize efforts to improve these areas.
2. Recommend Business Strategy
Use knowledge of our business to identify new areas of investment and improvement. Proactively recommend process improvement. The identification and implementation of time-savers, automation, and error-prone, scalable processes is at the core of success. Create documentation, including policy and procedure for new business strategies.
3. Support the Implementation Plan of New Business Processes
Support initial training and deployment of new applications, hardware, and other solutions. This includes observation of use, shadowing of staff, installation of hardware and software, coordination with vendors, and any other implementation related tasks.
4. Train Users/Trainers on Next Generation Solutions
Create and conduct initial training for Field Training Managers and all team members. Train peers to deliver long-term support for initiatives. Provide support for initiatives identified for modernization.
5. Project a Quality Image
Be committed to truth and integrity. Never Compromise! Be consistent and fair. Be committed to our Company’s image. The public perception of our people, vehicles, equipment and materials is essential to our success. Be committed to teamwork; think “We” and “Us”.

Job.JobDescription:

Our team members enjoy competitive salaries, a well-rounded benefits package, generous paid time off (including 12 holidays, vacation, and sick leave), and an array of professional development opportunities.  We’re always looking to add to our team of more than 3,000 dedicated professionals who are leading online education worldwide with transformative digital solutions – personalized to every student.

Job Posting End Date:

Deadline to apply is 11:59 PM on

12-16-2026

Job Title:

Paraprofessional, Florida Scholars Academy - Tampa, FL (On-Site)

Contract Type:

Employee

Annual Salary:

$36,500.00 - $65,520.00

Location:

FL - FSA - LES PETERS ACADEMY

Job Description Summary:

Our Mission is to equip students for success by developing and delivering highly effective digital learning through an intuitive online platform.

FLVS does not discriminate in admission or access to, or treatment or employment in its programs and activities on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, marital status, disability, genetic information or any other reason prohibited by law.

The Position:

Position General Summary:

The Paraprofessional, Florida Scholars Academy is a valued member of the educational team, providing essential support to instructors, instructional leaders, and students within the juvenile justice system. This role involves working closely with instructors, school counselors, and facility providers to create a positive and inclusive learning environment, assisting in classroom management, and providing individualized support to students.

Essential Position Functions:

  • Deliver feedback to students which contributes to a climate where they are actively engaged in meaningful learning experiences.

  • Maintain effective and efficient record keeping procedures in accordance with state statues.

  • Provide a positive environment in which students are encouraged to be actively engaged in the learning process; provide small group and/or individual instruction to students as needed.

  • Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with students, parents/guardians, and other professionals on a regular basis.

  • Facilitate incoming parent questions and provide responses in a timely manner by conducting necessary research.

  • Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships by consulting regularly with internal and external stakeholders; collaborate with peers to enhance the overall quality of feedback.

  • Model professional and ethical standards when dealing with students, parents/guardians, peers, and the community.

  • Assume responsibility for meeting their grading assignments as set forth by the Instructional Leader.

  • Maintain a thorough understanding in the curriculum of course that is being supported and the school-wide student performance goals.

  • Provide services in person at the assigned facility to meet the needs of students under the supervision of the Department of Juvenile Justice (DJJ). 

  • Serve as an instructional facilitator in the absence of an Instructor, Florida Scholars Academy at the discretion of the Instructional Leader.

  • Compile and organize notes, documents, and other relevant materials from instructional staff to present at meetings (i.e. treatment sessions, virtual transition, and community re-entry team meetings); attend the meetings.

  • Assist with student intake and exit processes, proctoring exams, and monitoring student progress.

  • Support other academic related topics established at the discretion of the Superintendent of Schools, Florida Scholars Academy, Regional Director, Florida Scholars Academy, or Instructional Leader, Florida Scholars Academy.

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of basic technology, including software applications, hardware, and navigating digital tools, with the ability to effectively apply them to daily tasks and troubleshoot common issues.

  • Meet professional obligations through efficient work habits such as, meeting deadlines, honoring schedules, coordinating resources and meetings in an effective and timely manner, and demonstrating respect for others.

  • All work responsibilities are subject to having performance goals and/or targets established

 (These essential functions are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed. Employees will be required to perform other  job-related duties as required.)

Minimum Requirements:

Education/Licensure/Certification:

  • Associate’s degree or higher from an accredited college, two years of education from an accredited college or passing of any of the following examinations: CLAST (College Level Academic Skills Test), ETS Praxis Parapro, or another state-approved test, or equivalent years of experience

Experience:

  • One year of relevant experience

  • Prior experience working with special needs students, preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA's):

  • Operational knowledge of the Internet and Web-related technologies

  • Possesses strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to work independently with little direct supervision

  • Ability to work as part of a team

  • Ability to prioritize tasks and effectively manage time

  • Strong interpersonal skills

  • Excellent customer service skills

  • Strong organizational skills

  • Ability to understand and follow verbal and written instructions

  • Demonstrative skill in attention to detail

  • Ability to function effectively in a high demand environment

  • Ability to work independently and as a team member

  • Working knowledge of general office practices, methods, and equipment, including computer skills in Microsoft Office suite of products.  

  • Ability to compile, review, categorize, prioritize, analyze, and interpret data and/or information

CORE COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS:

JOB KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Team member carries out essential job functions with accuracy, engages in ongoing and relevant professional learning, applies new knowledge effectively, and demonstrates mastery of job-specific skills

PRODUCTIVITY

Team member produces high quality work, meets organizational and departmental deadlines, balances multiple responsibilities, manages time effectively, and seeks ways to improve processes and productivity

COMMUNICATION

Team member communicates clearly in written and verbal formats, collaborates effectively, demonstrates professionalism in all interactions, exhibits strong interpersonal skills, and contributes to a positive team and professional community

CUSTOMER FOCUS

Team member addresses the needs of internal and external customers, analyzes problems effectively, contributes to innovative solutions, seeks opportunities for improvement, and successfully adapts to change

Physical Requirements and Environmental Conditions:

  • Frequency of travel: Daily travel is required to the assigned residential facility. Frequent travel is required for meetings, training, and conferences; location may vary and may require overnight stays.

  • Light physical activities and efforts required working in an office environment

(Reasonable accommodations will be made in accordance with existing ADA requirements for otherwise qualified individuals with a disability.)

Job.JobTitle: Assistant Chief Engineer_Maintenance - Embassy Suites by Hilton Orlando LBV South
Job.JobDescription:
Scope of Position

The Assistant Chief Engineer plays a vital role in ensuring the functionality, safety, and efficiency of our facilities. He/she is responsible for the ongoing maintenance, projects, repair, and preventative maintenance of the hotel with a focus on improving efficiency, profitability, and service levels.

Position Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of progressive management experience in a hotel preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in hotel/building services or other appropriate engineering fields.
  • Knowledge of carpentry, plumbing, and electrical, is required.
  • Knowledge of hotel fire standards and procedures.
  • Knowledge on water treatment, hydraulics, mechanics, chillers, air flows, H.V.A.C., electronics, sound, TV, lighting, elevators, boilers, pumps, etc.
  • Ability to work independently and exercise judgment to resolve personnel and production concerns that arise, with minimal supervision.
  • Possess outstanding guest service skills and leadership capability.
  • Ability to operate a motor vehicle.

Responsibilities

  • Supervises the day-to-day operations of Engineering.
  • Maintains and operates equipment at optimum effectiveness, efficiency, and safety.
  • Assist the staff and management in handling requests for service calls, evaluating requests, and dispatching appropriate staff and contractors.
  • Assists in effectively planning, scheduling, and evaluating preventative maintenance programs.
  • Ensures compliance with all Engineering departmental policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Manages department's controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
  • Participate in the procurement and management of engineering supplies, parts, and equipment.
  • Inspect and evaluate the physical condition of facilities to determine the type of work required.
  • Recommend or arrange for additional services such as painting, repair work, renovations, and the replacement of furnishings and equipment.
  • Knowledge of Safety Data Sheets, product labeling, proper storing, and handling of materials.
  • Follows Occupational Health & Safety regulations.
  • Ensure all daily standup meetings are conducted.
  • Actively participate in training and continuing education of Engineering staff.
  • Ensure Associates receive ongoing training to understand their job tasks and guest expectations.
  • Assist in recruiting, interviewing, and hiring Associates; conduct performance appraisals, coach and counsel, progressive corrective action, motivate, develop, and train.
  • Supervises associate's ability to execute departmental and property emergency procedures.
  • Perform any other reasonable duties as required by management.

Education

  • High school diploma or GED; 2 years’ experience in engineering and maintenance or related professional area; experience in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing.

Skills and Abilities                                

  • Ability to communicate in the English language. Second language is a plus.
  • Must be a team player.
  • Able to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends and able to perform multiple tasks.
  • Experience using software programs such as Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook).
  • Able to work with and understand financial information and data, and basic arithmetic functions.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must be physically fit to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects and push carts weighing 50 pounds or more.
  • Requires standing/walking/reaching and bending throughout shift.

The Cook 3 Tropicale position requires a highly professional individual with good all-around culinary experience. Must have knowledge of sanitation, presentation, ability to follow recipes, while maintaining quality. Ability to work any station in the kitchen when necessary while maintaining strong communication and positive atmosphere with team.   • Knowledge of meat identification and cookery for various cuts of beef, pork, veal, lamb, poultry, and corresponding cooking techniques. 
  • Knowledge of fresh and saltwater fish, crustaceans, mollusks, and various mixed cooking techniques. Poaching, simmering, deep-frying, baking, broiling, sautéing, and pan-frying.
  • Knowledge of vegetable preparation. e.g., various cutting techniques such as brunoise, paysanne, dice, allumette, battonet, mince, julienne, Parisian, noissette. A solid knowledge of proper cooking preparations, boiling, blanching, steaming, grilling, pan frying, baking, and deep-frying.

  • Knowledge and ability to identify and prepare secondary sauces such as Mornay, chasseur, choron, beurre blance, marchand de vin, curry and normande.
  • Knowledge of pantry positions products i.e., lettuce identification, classical salad presentation and preparations. 
  • Knowledge in identification and preparation of basic soups such as consommé, clear, cream, puree, bisques, and chowders as well as speciality and national soups using the various and proper thickening agents.

  • Has basic knowledge and timely skills of various knife-cutting techniques, such as cutting, dicing, and slicing.
  • Must supply their own basic tools of the trade, i.e., Chef’s knife, paring knife, peeler, etc.
  • Refined skill set in the knowledge and preparation of garnishes.
  • Ensure equipment and kitchen cleanliness.
  • Keep production of food at an adequate level to prevent excess leftovers and waste.
  • Maintain regular attendance in compliance with the Hotel’s Standards, as required by scheduling, which will vary according to the needs of the Hotel.

About this job

Recreation Supervisor at Evermore Orlando Resort oversees recreational facilities and activities across a 1,100-acre resort near Disney World, including an 8-acre beach lagoon, golf courses, and water sports. The role involves staff management, facility inspections, guest service, and ensuring safety compliance across all recreation areas.

Good fit if you have recreation or hospitality management experience, strong leadership skills, lifeguard or CPR certification, can swim in deep water, and are flexible with varied schedules.

Full job description

Shape the Next Generation of Vacations!
Welcome to Evermore Orlando Resort—the resort that’s redefining the Orlando vacation experience. Just steps away from Walt Disney World®, Evermore stretches across 1,100 acres and offers a one-of-a-kind blend of spacious, upscale vacation homes, flats, and villas alongside the luxurious Conrad hotel. Our Team Members are true trailblazers, reimagining the vacation experience for each guest. Here, guests create their own adventure, enjoying the best of both worlds: the space and comforts of vacation home rentals combined with the amenities and services of a world-class resort.

Evermore is Orlando’s ultimate game changer. In a city known for its theme parks and endless lines, Evermore is the paradise guests crave on their days between park visits. Imagine endless relaxation around Orlando’s first and only beach paradise, Evermore Bay. Our stunning 8-acre crystal-clear lagoon is framed by zero-entry swim zones, beach bars, private cabanas, cozy firepits, and 20-acres of white sand. From beachside bars to a vibrant food hall and rooftop dining with views of the fireworks, we’ve crafted unforgettable experiences. Guests can challenge themselves on 2 Jack Nicklaus championship golf courses, enjoy water sports including kayaks and paddleboards, a family water slide, rope swing, and activities that fill their days including pickleball, bocce ball, and volleyball.

If you’re excited to help guests reimagine the Orlando vacation, join us! Become part of an energetic team bringing Evermore Orlando Resort to life!

  • Key Responsibilities:

    • Provide exceptional guest service as it relates to Evermore core values: Easy on Purpose, Unexpected Delight, Service Savvy, and Insightful Innovations.
    • Ability to utilize resort software: specific to activity information, reservations, and guest communication.
    • Exhibiting proper speaking and phone etiquette with the ability to communicate effectively, politely, graciously, and professionally with vendors, colleagues, and guests as it aligns to luxury service standards.
    • Ensure team members have the tools and means necessary to effectively deliver foundational and elevated bayside experiences concurrent with luxury standards.
    • Completing daily walk-throughs and inspections of all recreational facilities such as fitness centers, pool decks, beach and cabana areas, as well as indoor and back-office areas to ensure they are well-maintained in all equipment is in working order
    • Noting issues/opportunities and effectively reporting these to their responsible departments or related vendors to ensure the matter is addressed and corrected in a timely manner.
    • Initiating ideas and executing daily operational projects as needed.
    • Supporting the daily operation of the recreation department in all aspects regarding inventory and upkeep of supplies and stock, safety compliance, overall staff management, accurate activities execution, team meeting facilitation, service standard compliance and audits, and overall program development & enhancement.
    • Training staff on the monitoring of safety conditions of the bay, and relaying important safety information as it relates to activities, closures, and general cabana safety.
    • Ensuring accurate billing and compliance in regard to credit card payments, and cash/tip handling.
    • Ensure high standards of cleanliness, organization, and standard set up of Evermore Bay are consistently met.
    • Communicate effectively with other resort departments to ensure smooth operations and timely service delivery.

     

    Education, Skills, and Experience:

    • Associates degree in Recreation Management, Hospitality, or a related field or minimum 2 years in a prior Recreation role within a luxury resort or hospitality setting is preferred.
    • Proven aptitude when it comes to leading and training team members.
    • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
    • Strong organizational and time management skills, while working in a demanding and fast-paced environment.
    • Ability to problem-solve and find creative solutions to unexpected challenges, service failures, or guest concerns.
    • Lifeguard and or First Aid and CPR certification (or willingness to obtain).
    • Able to swim as the team works on and around the water, which in areas can be up to 12’ deep.
    • Flexibility to work weekdays, weekends, nights, early mornings, and holidays.
    • Ability to speak, read, write, and comprehend the English language at a level sufficient to communicate effectively with guests, co-workers, and vendors.
    • Ability to handle guest requests in a calm, detailed, and empathetic manner.
    • Adherence to property and company policies and procedures.
    • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment and prioritize job duties.

    Physical Requirements:

    • Able to safely lift, pull and push up to 75 pounds.
    • Excellent physical and temperature endurance to stand, walk, and remain active for extended periods of time, and participate in physical activities.
    • Ability to swim in deep water and potentially perform water rescues.
    • Able to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, bend, and reach periodically.
    • Tolerance for hot and humid Florida weather conditions, especially when working outdoors.
    • Ability to move swiftly and efficiently around the facility, including beach areas, pool decks, and gym facilities.
    • Effective verbal and non-verbal communication skills to interact with guests and colleagues.
    • Ability to clearly communicate in an emergency to direct guests and ensure their safety.
    • Willingness to adhere to strict regulations and enforce those regulations as necessary.

Evermore Culture 

At Evermore, our purpose is Togetherness, and our vision is to make a more together world possible. 

Through relational wellness, we cultivate an inclusive, people-first culture where collaboration, trust, and respect empower every Team Member to thrive. Our Values guide how we think, make decisions, and show up for our guests, one another, and the moments that matter most. We are committed to acting with integrity, striving for the extraordinary, and recognizing that our greatest success comes when we succeed together. 

We offer our Team Members competitive pay, along with a range of benefits including  FREE Life Insurance, FREE Short-Term Disability, FREE Long-Term Disability. Additionally, we provide affordable health benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for your dependents. Furthermore, we offer a 401K with employer match, a robust paid time off policy, parental and grandparent leave, as well as family and pet bereavement leave. We also have unique policies in support of our team and significant relationships in their lives.

EOE/M/F/D/V

Department of Transportation (DOT) & Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) Requirements:

The Department of Transportation (DOT) and the Federal Motor Safety Carrier Safety Administration (FMSCA) have stringent requirements for Commercial Driver's License (CDL) drivers to ensure safety on the roads. These requirements encompass various aspects, including qualifications, medical standards, testing, and ongoing compliance. DOT and FMSCA require CDL drivers to undergo mandatory drug and alcohol testing as per regulations, including pre-employment, random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion testing. This process can be facilitated through the Human Resources Team or an appropriate third-party provider. These requirements may include, but are not limited to:

  • Shuttle Drivers may be required to obtain a CDL, especially if the shuttle vehicle has a seating capacity exceeding a certain threshold.
  • DOT regulations may require shuttle drivers to pass a DOT medical examination to ensure they are physically fit to operate commercial vehicles.
  • Compliance with DOT regulations regarding the maximum number of hours a driver can drive a commercial vehicle, as well as mandatory rest breaks.
  • Pre-employment, random or post-accident drug and alcohol testing is required.

It's important for resort management to ensure that shuttle drivers are aware of and compliant with all relevant DOT and FMCSA regulations to maintain safety and legal compliance. Specific requirements may vary depending on the location and type of shuttle operations.

EA Studios - Quality Verification

Work Model

Hybrid Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

About Us

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Our Quality Verification and Standards (QVS) team is an important part of our development process, consistently delivering actionable insights that support our game teams to optimize software performance and elevate gameplay.

Who Do We Work With?

You will work closely with the American Football franchise teams, embedded directly within our Core Systems team supporting titles across Madden NFL and College Football.

About the Role

As an Associate Quality Designer (AQD), you will be embedded within our Core Systems development team, reporting to the Development Director. This is a collaborative role where you will partner daily with Engineers, Designers, Producers, and fellow QA/QV teammates to test and document features throughout early development, production, and release.

You will act as a catalyst for quality, ensuring that QA understands how Core Systems features are designed, that those features are tested effectively with a focus on bug prevention and containment, and that the final game experience lives up to our players’ expectations.

Your Responsibilities

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner daily with Core Systems engineers, designers, producers, and distributed QA teams to align on feature behavior, quality expectations, and test coverage.

  • Represent the QA/QV and player perspective in team meetings, stand-ups, and reviews through clear, constructive written and verbal communication.

Quality Strategy & Test Execution

  • Support the design and execution of test plans and quality workflows for assigned Core Systems features.

  • Focus on proactive bug prevention and containment, identifying risks early and helping the team verify fixes before issues reach players.

  • Contribute to evolving the team’s testing practices and documentation, championing a "player-first" mindset.

Quality & Data Analysis

  • Identify, reproduce, and clearly document high-impact or complex defects, providing actionable feedback that helps developers resolve issues quickly.

  • Gather and summarize testing results and observations from multiple sources to help inform team decisions.

  • Stay curious and open to learning new testing methodologies and best practices from peers across QVS and the wider studio.

Team Support & Knowledge Sharing

  • Collaborate closely with fellow Quality Designer to share context, review test documentation, and support day-to-day QA deliverables.

  • Support senior QVS team members in rolling out quality initiatives and improving shared team workflows.

Our Requirements

Experience & Knowledge

  • Foundational experience in quality assurance, software development, or game design—prior experience supporting QA in an embedded or collaborative team environment is a strong plus.

  • Understanding of core QA processes, bug prevention and containment practices, and defect/task tracking or collaboration tools (such as Jira).

  • Familiarity with how games and their underlying systems are structured, as well as the stages of game/software development (sprints, milestones, Alpha, Beta).

  • Passion for playing video games and familiarity with American Football titles and the broader sports gaming landscape.

Skills & Abilities

  • Team-first mindset: Thrives in a highly collaborative environment, actively seeks feedback, and works well across multiple disciplines.

  • Clear communication: Strong written and verbal English skills for documenting test cases, writing clear bug reports, and sharing updates with internal and external partners.

  • Problem-solving & curiosity: Eager to learn how complex systems work, ask thoughtful questions, and advocate for the player experience.

  • AI fluency: Experience or familiarity with AI tools and workflows is a plus.

Welcome to EA Mobile, home to developers working on iconic franchises such as Plants vs. Zombies, Design Home, Star Wars, Sim City, Golf Clash, Pogo, and more. At EA Mobile, we value creativity, continuous learning, data-driven decision-making, and strong product knowledge. We are looking for passionate individuals who thrive in a growth-oriented environment and are committed to collaborating in dynamic teams to deliver compelling experiences to millions of players worldwide.

The GM Pogo, will report to the Head of Mobile, Casual. You will lead Pogo's next chapter by shaping our product vision, expanding our casual game portfolio, and transforming how our teams build and operate live-service games.

Responsibilities:

  • You will define Pogo's long-term vision and align our game slate, live service, and monetization roadmap.

  • You will manage studio revenue, profitability, and budgets to meet financial targets.

  • You will lead the team of Heads of Product, Operations, Analytics, Creative, and Engineering.

  • You will establish measurable outcomes and test-and-learn frameworks across acquisition, retention, and player engagement.

  • You will resolve scope, quality, and capacity tradeoffs across an integrated product and technology roadmap.

  • You will champion AI-assisted rapid prototyping and tooling to streamline team workflows.

Qualifications:

  • You have 15+ years of experience in game development, product leadership, or live-service operations.

  • You have experience shipping and operating live-service or free-to-play games for a global audience.

  • You have experience leading multidisciplinary senior leaders through organizational and strategic change.

  • You have experience managing P&L, budgets, resource planning, and studio investment decisions.

Core Skills and Experience

  • You use analytics, telemetry, and player feedback to guide product strategy and commercial outcomes.

  • You communicate complex strategies clearly to executive stakeholders across corporate and publishing teams.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS 

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of paid sick time, company top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, and retirement benefits to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and long-term cash programs.

  • Respond to emerging threats such as APT and other forms of targeted attacks, organised crime, etc.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

As a Senior Finance Manager, you will guide the Catalyst Studios Finance team supporting our NHL, UFC, and F1 franchises. Reporting to the Senior Director, FP&A - American Football / Catalyst, you will serve as a trusted advisor to studio leadership and cross-functional partners—connecting financial planning, business performance, and development strategy. You will follow a hybrid work schedule, defined as three days a week from an Electronic Arts office.

In this collaborative role, you will mentor and develop your team while staying actively engaged in daily financial operations. You will use clear financial storytelling and sound business judgment to influence partners to make informed decisions that support sustainable growth, profitability, and long-term franchise success.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

● Serve as a strategic finance partner to studio, product, commercial, and finance leaders, influencing business decisions across franchise strategy, investment prioritization, resource allocation, and return on investment.

● Own financial planning and performance analysis across supported franchises, including full P&L management, forecasting, close analysis, risks and opportunities, scenario analysis, and executive reporting.

● Lead and coach Catalyst FP&A team, setting clear priorities, providing thoughtful guidance, and enabling high-quality decision support and strong business impact.

● Enhance team productivity and impact through prioritization, simplification, automation, standardization, and thoughtful change management.

Qualifications:

● Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.

● 8 + years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, investment analysis, corporate finance, or a related field; gaming experience helpful.

● Experience mentoring and coaching a high-performing team.

● Strong financial modeling skills, including driver-based forecasting, scenario analysis, business case development, and full P&L management.

● Experienced with accounting principles and GAAP

● Experience using modern financial systems, BI tools, and AI-enabled solutions to streamline reporting, enhance forecasting accuracy, and automate routine processes.

● Experienced in communicating analytical findings and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear and actionable insights across a variety of audience levels.

The Senior Security Software Engineer II reports to the Director, Developer Security in the Developer Security team. 

This role is aimed at engineers who operate beyond the scope of a single team or service. You will be responsible for identifying, shaping, and delivering solutions to complex, often ambiguous problems that span multiple systems and teams. You will help define and evolve the internal platforms that enable EA teams to build, ship, and operate software securely at scale. This includes working across software engineering, platform engineering, and SRE concerns, with a strong focus on developer experience, system reliability, and operational excellence.

Our environment is intentionally polyglot, and you’ll be expected to work pragmatically across multiple languages, frameworks, and infrastructure rather than specialising in a single stack. Success in this role is measured not just by the code you write, but by the impact you have on how systems are designed, how teams operate, and how effectively engineers across the organisation can deliver high-quality software.

You will play a key role in shaping the platforms and systems that power how EA builds and operates software. Your work will influence not just a single team, but how multiple teams across the company deliver reliable, secure, and scalable services to millions of players.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and drive large, cross-cutting technical initiatives that span multiple teams, systems, and domains

  • Define and break down ambiguous problem spaces, and lead them through to practical, high-impact solutions

  • Design and evolve internal platforms and shared services that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience

  • Establish and promote engineering patterns and best practices in areas such as system design, observability, and service reliability

  • Lead architectural decisions, making pragmatic trade-offs across performance, reliability, cost, and speed of delivery

  • Contribute directly to critical parts of the system where deep technical expertise is required

  • Improve how systems are operated in production, including monitoring, incident response, and long-term reliability improvements

  • Influence technical direction across teams through design reviews, collaboration, and hands-on leadership

  • Mentor engineers at multiple levels, particularly Senior engineers, helping to raise the overall technical bar

  • Partner with teams across EA to understand workflows and remove friction through better platform design and tooling

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ Years experience building and operating distributed systems at scale, with a strong understanding of production challenges and failure modes

  • A track record of delivering complex technical initiatives across multiple teams or domains, not just within a single codebase

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with deep proficiency in at least one modern programming language and the ability to work across others

  • Experience working across a broad, polyglot technology stack, for example:

    • Backend and services: Node.js, .NET, Rust, PHP

    • Frontend and web platforms: React, Angular, Next.js, TypeScript

    • Infrastructure and platform: Kubernetes, AWS (including EKS, ECS/Fargate), CI/CD systems (e.g. GitLab CI), GitOps tooling (e.g. ArgoCD)

  • Proven ability to design or evolve platform-level systems, internal developer platforms, or shared infrastructure

  • Solid understanding of SRE principles, including observability, SLIs/SLOs, incident management, and system health

  • Experience improving system reliability and developer productivity through automation, platform design, and intelligent tooling

  • Experience designing systems and workflows that are highly automatable and extensible, with well-defined interfaces for both human and programmatic use

  • Experience with modern delivery practices, including Infrastructure-as-Code and automated pipelines

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, define problems, and drive solutions without needing detailed direction

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience aligning engineers and stakeholders across teams

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with large-scale CI/CD or build systems

  • Experience improving developer experience and productivity across organisations

  • Background in high-availability or live service environments

About this job

Lead the Controls Engineering Department at Universal Orlando Resort, managing safety compliance, ride reliability, and show quality for high-technology attractions. Oversee engineering staff, capital project prioritization, budget management, and coordination across multiple departments.

Good fit if you have 10+ years in control and automation systems, PLC programming expertise, and experience with theme park technical environments.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

Manages Controls engineering efforts associated with safety compliance, improved ride reliability and enhanced show quality for all of the high technology ride and show attractions at Universal Orlando Resort. The manager will also assist the Vice President in maintaining cost controls within Engineering’s assigned budget. Work with the attractions to identify, define, and prioritize capital issues to realize optimum cost-of-ownership of Universal Orlando’s assets in Rides and Shows.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage and lead the Controls Engineering Department. Support the overall goals and priorities of the department to achieve the highest standards of safety and reliability. Inspire customer service attitude and instill a tradition of continuous process improvement throughout the team. Emphasize reduced cost-of-ownership of the Rides and Attractions through superior engineering and cost savings through improvements in preventative maintenance effectiveness and cost avoidance through proactive measures to reduce equipment failures and collateral damage.
  • Ensure that Controls reengineering tasks for the Rides and Attractions are performed to the highest standards of safety, reliability and quality. Ensure compliance with al applicable codes, regulations and standards including: AISC, ASME, ASTM, ANSI, AWS, JIC, NEC and OSHA among others. Ensure that downtime efforts are kept to a minimum through appropriate partnership with tech services, focusing on preventive maintenance.
  • Serve as Safety Control System expert to maintain configuration management of hardware and software documentation in accordance with Engineering guidelines for proper archiving and security. Prepare Ride control system documentation as required including ensuring all configurations files are in Asset Centre, etc. Prepare comprehensive Engineering reports showing technical analysis, design solutions and “learned best practices”. Conduct technical reliability evaluations of Engineering design concepts and design constructs. Develop risk analysis studies of new designs to improve ride reliability and maintainability.
  • Manage staff, including selection, hiring, induction, training, performance appraisal and IDP to ensure overall increase in knowledge, experience, responsibility and individual accountabilities Lead, motivate and inspire the Engineering Team by providing design reviews, staff meetings, stimulating culture and challenging environment that recognizes achievement, promotes effective communications and develops individuals to achieve their maximum level of performance and ensure a best in class Engineering Department. Manage Rockwell Assurance partners, and Obsolescence initiatives.
  • Coordinate and facilitate inter and intra-department partners and external resources including: Attraction maintenance group(s), Document Control, Environmental Health and Safety, Facilities, Finance, Human Resources, Landscape and Water Quality, Operations, Outside Vendors, Quality Assurance, Security, and Sustaining Engineering. Maintain, and encourage within subordinates, close and friendly working relationships; model by example.
  • Manage spending within assigned budget guidelines and minimize overtime worked. Assist in identifying and developing detailed budget plans for tasks and projects that reduce cost of ownership of the attractions.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s Degree from a four-year college or university in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology or related fields is required
  • Master’s Degree from an accredited college or university in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology or related fields is preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 10+ Years: Experience in an Engineering environment focuses primarily on control and automation systems, preferably in a theme park environment; interacting with other Engineering and Maintenance Department disciplines
  • Experience with:
    • Allen-Bradley PLC based control systems
    • AC and DC motors and motor control systems
    • Motion control systems
    • Show and animation control systems
  • Proficiency with personal computers using Win95, word processing and spreadsheets
  • Proficiency with complex diagnostic test equipment, proficiency in control systems drawings and technical documents.
  • Cognizance in ASTM regulations applying to theme parks, and the NEC are also required.
  • 8+ years project management functions especially in the area of technical compliance, scheduling and budgeting; performing technical support functions in regards to control systems, motor and motion control systems

AND

  • 10+ years demonstrated experience in electrical engineering, control system design and installation utilizing PLC’s, ladder logic, variable frequency drives and servo control systems, process and/or machine safety, field experience with Theme Park technical environment and process control fault analysis/isolation experience required
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • PLC controls programming, maintenance, and troubleshooting; required
  • AC/DC Drives (motor controls) Configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting; required
  • Cisco networking and wireless network certifications; preferred

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Strong analytical skills to perform engineering calculations for design, analysis, test and implementation of electrical and control systems.
  • High Level of knowledge and experience in the design of safety critical systems, ISO 13849-1, ISO 13849-2, ISO12100 standards, IEC60204-1, IEC62061, PL safety levels, and UL 508A, NEC, ASTM, ASTM F24 Standards and UO’s Safety Standards.
  • A strong background in servo controls as applied for hydraulic, pneumatic, and electromotive motion control systems is required.
  • High Level of knowledge of Allen Bradley PLC Systems, "C", Visual Basic, and other software platforms. Experience utilizing PLC-5, SLC-500, ControlLogix, CompactLogix, PanelBuilder 1400E, PanelBuilder32, RSView 32, RSLinx, RSLogix (5 thru 5000), RSNetworx, Allen-Bradley PLC, and AC/DC motor control systems.
  • Ability to perform engineering calculations commensurate with Baccalaureate training in electrical, electronic and software engineering.
  • Experience with generation of control system specifications, acceptance test procedures, technical compliance, system risk assessments and failure analysis.
  • Proven application experience utilizing the following products and networks. Anitech, Gilderfluke show system controllers, 1305, 1336, 750 series AB variable frequency drives, Data Highway Plus, Remote I/O, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Ethernet, DMX and SMPTE.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Global Product team is focused on driving product strategies to evolve and enhance the Guest experience across Universal Destinations & Experiences. As a Manager, Digital Product Owner, the primary function of this role will be to manage new capabilities across the entire product lifecycle, from product strategy, planning, definition, delivery, and implementation. The specific focus for this role will be digital product management for the onsite Guest and Team Member experience, Mobile or Web Applications.

Product Definition

Product Planning

Product Strategy

About this job

Lead strategy and delivery of AI-enabled products at Universal Studios that improve guest experiences, support team members, and enable operations. Partner with business, engineering, data science, and governance teams to guide products from discovery through production and optimization.

Good fit if you have product management experience with AI/ML systems, strong stakeholder alignment skills, and understand responsible AI standards and cloud platforms.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior AI Product Manager leads the strategy, definition, and delivery of AI-enabled products and capabilities that improve Guest experiences, support Team Members, and enable operational workflows. The role applies product management, analytical, and AI domain knowledge to identify opportunities, assess potential business value, and translate business needs into prioritized roadmaps, requirements, and measurable outcomes. The product manager partners with business stakeholders, engineering, architecture, data science, user experience, and governance teams to guide products from discovery and prototyping through production implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization. Through product prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and performance measurement, the product manager ensures AI investments address user needs, advance organizational priorities, and meet responsible AI standards.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

AI Product Strategy and Opportunity Definition

  • Lead discovery with business, technology, data science, and operational stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can improve Guest experiences, support Team Members, and enable operational workflows.
  • Develop product strategies and business cases that define the problem, target users, value proposition, expected benefits, investment considerations, risks, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.
  • Own product roadmaps and prioritize opportunities based on user needs, potential business value, technical feasibility, delivery effort, and organizational priorities.
  • Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and vendor solutions with technical partners, using research, experimentation, and prototype results to guide decisions to advance, revise, or discontinue opportunities.

AI Product Definition and Delivery

  • Translate prioritized opportunities into product capabilities, user journeys, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, incorporating data dependencies, AI quality expectations, human oversight, and fallback experiences.
  • Partner with user experience, engineering, architecture, data science, and control functions to define feasible, supportable solutions that meet cybersecurity, privacy, legal, accessibility, and responsible AI requirements.
  • Lead backlog prioritization, scope and release tradeoffs, dependency coordination, and stakeholder communication, partnering with Rapid Development to validate approaches and with Engineering, Architecture, and AI/ML Ops to progress validated capabilities into production.
  • Validate delivered capabilities against agreed acceptance criteria and user needs, using testing, demonstrations, and stakeholder feedback to guide release recommendations and further development.

Implementation, Measurement, and Optimization

  • Establish product success metrics and measurement plans with business and analytics partners, including relevant measures of adoption, user satisfaction, efficiency, quality, cost, and business impact.
  • Lead product launch readiness with business, delivery, and operational teams, coordinating user communication, training, workflow changes, and adoption activities.
  • Monitor product outcomes, user feedback, and AI quality and risk indicators with analytics, data science, engineering, and governance partners to assess realized value and identify improvements.
  • Own ongoing product direction for assigned capabilities, prioritizing enhancements, corrective actions, and lifecycle decisions based on performance, user needs, operating costs, and organizational priorities.Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Working knowledge of AI/ML techniques, including generative AI, agentic workflows, NLP, recommender systems, predictive modeling, mathematical optimization, evaluation methods, and MLOps principles, with the ability to assess their suitability and limitations for business use cases.
  • Familiarity with cloud AI/ML platforms, data-platform architectures, APIs, observability, experimentation, and production delivery patterns.
  • Ability to translate model outputs, AI capabilities, and data dependencies into user-facing products and operational workflows.
  • Proven success independently developing product strategies, roadmaps, feature definitions, and prioritized backlogs that deliver measurable business, Guest, and Team Member value.
  • Experience defining user journeys, functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and release priorities, including AI-specific expectations for quality, human oversight, and fallback experiences.
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery, product validation, implementation planning, launch readiness, adoption, and ongoing product support.
  • Strong financial modeling, experiment-design, and measurement skills to quantify product impact, risk, and return on investment.
  • Ability to synthesize insights from product analytics, Guest and Team Member feedback, operational data, market trends, and technical feasibility assessments to guide product decisions.
  • Strong leadership through influence, with the ability to guide decisions, motivate peers, and align executive, product, technical, and operational stakeholders.
  • Strong storytelling and executive communication skills, with the ability to convey complex AI/ML concepts, product tradeoffs, and strategic implications to diverse audiences.
  • Understanding of data privacy, cybersecurity, accessibility, responsible AI guidelines, model-risk management, and quality standards, with the ability to incorporate these requirements into enterprise AI product decisions.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, computer science, engineering, Data Science, or a related field is required.
  • Masters is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 7+ years in product management, technology, consulting, software development, digital marketing, digital experience design, data science or related fields.

About this job

Director leading data architecture strategy and modernization for Universal Studios' growth and AI transformation. Role designs enterprise data solutions, governs architecture standards, and builds the data architecture practice across the organization.

Good fit if you have deep expertise in enterprise data architecture, data governance frameworks, cloud platforms like Snowflake, and can lead complex technical teams.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Director, Principal Data Architect shapes the data foundation for Universal Destinations & Experiences’ (UDX) growth, innovation, and AI transformation. Leading the data architecture pillar, this role translates the Enterprise Data & AI vision into an executable strategy and target-state architecture that modernizes platforms and enables advanced analytics, intelligent automation, and AI-powered solutions.

The role leads the design of end-to-end data solutions, including data models, integration patterns, and data platform architecture. Partnering with business and technology leaders, the role connects architecture decisions to measurable improvements in guest experience, revenue, and operations. This hands-on leader develops the data architecture team, owns data governance design and architecture standards, and leads the Data Architecture Review Board—providing clear direction and decisive recommendations that enable teams to build trusted, secure, and reusable data capabilities at enterprise scale.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Data Strategy, Vision & Target-State Design: Treat data as a strategic business asset, ensuring architecture decisions are grounded in measurable business value, including guest experience, revenue, cost, and risk. Translate the enterprise data and AI strategy into the data architecture strategy, guiding principles, and multi-year target-state design aligned to UDX business priorities across guest, commercial, and operational domains. As part of target-state design, evaluate and recommend data platform capabilities, tools, and patterns (e.g., cloud data warehouse and lakehouse, streaming, integration, cataloging, observability), including build/buy/reuse decisions and rationalization of redundant capabilities. Work directly with business and technology stakeholders to translate needs into clear architectural direction, documented as architecture decisions.
  • Data Architecture Standards & Alignment: Author, publish, and continuously evolve UDX data architecture and data governance standards, including data modeling, integration and interoperability, metadata and lineage, master and reference data, and security and access patterns. Chair the Data Architecture Review Board (DARB), UDX’s decision-making body for data architecture, and own its charter, entry criteria, review cadence, decision rights, and escalation paths. Review solution designs from internal teams, delivery partners, and vendors, issue clear recommendations (approve, approve with conditions, or reject) in adherence with UDX standards, and govern exceptions and architectural debt through to closure.
  • Data Governance Design Ownership: Serve as the enterprise owner of data governance design, defining the governance framework, operating model, data ownership and stewardship structures, data domain definitions, data quality standards and controls, classification, lineage, and retention policies. Embed privacy-by-design, regulatory, and data residency requirements into architecture in partnership with Information Security, Privacy, and Legal. Define governance-by-design patterns so controls are built into platforms and pipelines, and partner with platform and engineering teams to ensure governance designs are implemented and adopted.
  • Data Readiness for AI: Define the architecture that makes enterprise data AI-ready, including canonical data models, semantic layers, ontologies and knowledge graphs, data contracts, and feature and vector data patterns supporting ML, generative AI, and agentic use cases. Establish standards for AI data quality, lineage, observability, and responsible use. Assess data readiness for proposed AI initiatives and define remediation paths before build commitments are made.
  • Practice Leadership & Development: Lead, coach, and develop data architects, including team members and partner resources, setting clear expectations and quality bars. Build a consistent, repeatable data architecture practice with standard artifacts, maturity metrics, and a community of practice. Communicate architecture strategy and decisions to executive, technical, and non-technical audiences.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Proven experience in data architecture, data engineering, enterprise data platforms, including significant experience leading architecture for complex enterprise environments.
  • Enterprise data architecture: expert command of conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling (relational, dimensional), data product and domain design, lakehouse and cloud data warehouse patterns, batch and real-time/streaming integration, APIs, and event-driven architecture.
  • Data governance design: deep expertise designing enterprise data governance frameworks and operating models, including ownership and stewardship, data domains, data quality controls, classification, metadata, lineage, and master data management, aligned to DAMA-DMBOK or equivalent.
  • Privacy & regulatory: working knowledge of privacy, security, and regulatory requirements such as GDPR/UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, Japan APPI, and PCI DSS, including cross-border data residency and sharing.
  • Cloud data platforms: deep knowledge of Snowflake and AWS/Azure data and AI services, ELT and transformation tooling (e.g., dbt), orchestration, cataloging, and data observability; ability to evaluate platforms objectively on capability, cost, performance, and scalability.
  • AI & advanced analytics: working knowledge of ML platforms and MLOps, feature stores, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic layers, ontologies/knowledge graphs, and AI data governance patterns.
