Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Orlando, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Lead engineering and operations for Universal's global mobile applications across parks in Orlando, Hollywood, and Japan. Oversee front-end development teams using Flutter, manage platform reliability, and drive innovation in guest-facing digital experiences.

Good fit if you have extensive mobile development experience, leadership background managing teams and stakeholders, and expertise in large-scale global technology implementations.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Manager, Mobile Solution Engineering & Operations is a key engineering and leadership role responsible for front-end applications leveraging mobile technologies at Universal Destinations & Experiences. This individual may lead not only individual contributors but also other leaders (i.e., Supervisors, and Managers) with a strong background in design, develop, deployment, and support of critical guest facing front-end applications globally, including mobile applications supporting Universal’s parks in Orlando, Hollywood, and Japan, as well as other future front-end experiences. This role is focused on leadership in diversity, building positive relationships throughout the company and their team, delivery, innovation, problem solving and support of quality, and, best-in-class experiences for our guests and team members.

This role along with their team and other potential leaders, will be responsible for front-end software engineering solutions using Flutter and other consumer facing technologies; and will be a thought leader for modular design, software reusability, empowerment of our business partners, and release / operational integrity. Partners with Leadership, other Digital Technology groups, Corporate Technology, Infrastructure, Security, Product, Innovation, PMO; business divisions; functional support partners like Finance, Sourcing, and HR. This position has a strong focus on innovation, problem solving, design and development of new digital experiences based on existing physical theme park experiences and launching new businesses in both physical and virtual spaces. Has an engineering mindset working with both our business and technology partners thinking 3 – 5 years into the future to ensure supportability, maintainability, and extensibility.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Technology Strategy & Delivery

  • Manage in collaboration with other leaders, day-to-day activities in support of global mobile team and front-end engineering strategy, design, development with a big picture vision beyond the mobile space. Understanding that technology organizations can only be successful together.
  • Oversee and encourage other leaders, and individual contributors to implement simple, scalable, flexible, secure, and cost-effective technology design & engineering.
  • Demonstrates an engineering mindset thinking how to best build solutions that stand the test of time and can easily be maintained, reused, and extended as business and guest needs evolve.
  • Proactively manage a mixture of internal resources and external partners to achieve both best in class technology solutions while achieving speed to market.
  • Achieve consistently high platform reliability and uptime of newly developed digital technology solutions to ensure superior “Digital Show Quality” for the Guest and Team Member experience.Oversees the day-to-day incorporation of high-quality automation of processes, develops, quality engineering, and release management, cloud into every-day work.
  • Helps oversee the day-to-day iincorporation of high-quality automation of processes, develops, quality engineering, and release management, capitalizing on cloud first.

Platform Stability & Operational/Delivery Excellence

  • Ensures achievement of consistently high platform reliability and uptime of digital technology solutions to ensure superior “Digital Show Quality” for Universal’s digital solutions.
  • Drive focus on operational excellence throughout the organization & partners, including (but not limited to) processes, governance, efficient working approaches, collaboration.
  • Ensure positive trend in key performance indicators of the digital platform. Partner with PMO, Product, and architecture for on-time delivery of solutions, proactively mitigate risk of “scope creep” and and negative guest or business impacts.

Cross-Team Collaboration, Team Culture, Staff Development

  • Lead and mentor by setting the example for direct reports including other leaders (ie., Supervisors or Managers) and individual contributors in day-to-day collaboration across the organization.
  • Work with executive leadership in providing clear decisions along with their implementation. Demonstrate to your team how to work with senior leadership and support decisions once made.
  • Coach and build confidence in staff to make and implement good technical and business decisions using technology and analytical thinking.
  • Promote and demonstrate working culture of accountability and technology depth to support Universal’s physical and virtual business aspirations.
  • Support and champion Universal Culture of team-member satisfaction through effective communication, planning, risk management, and coaching of high-potential candidates.
  • Work seamlessly with other Digital and Technology & teams and leaders to architect and build best in class solutions and experiences.

Administrative

  • Manage appropriate departmental budgets; review/approve related budget expenditures with executive leadership team. Demostrate an “act as an owner” mentality.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Extensive knowledge of mobile languages and design patterns including but not limited to Flutter, Dart, MVC, and MVVM; preferred
  • Understanding of mobile API and end-to-end backend system design, with ability to triage and debug problems to pinpoint their source in the development stack.
  • Experience in large scale global technology implementations; program planning and implementation.
  • Excellent analytical, written, and oral communication skills, and be able to explain complex concepts both concisely and simply to technical & non-technical audience; also, able to communicate effectively with non-native English speakers.
  • Demonstrated ability to define and execute strategic initiatives.
  • Expertise in front-end/back-end integration design through various integration methods; familiarity with multiple client technologies and their interaction models.
  • Strong knowledge of Flutter’s plugin ecosystem, BLoC, CMS Driven Widget Design, Atomic Design, Widget Trees, and other Flutter UI concepts; preferred
  • Proficient with Git, Git flow and other branching strategies
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer business needs and translate them into practical applications and operational solutions.
  • Experience with enterprise CMS, CDN, Global Design Systems, DAM tools, and WCAG 2.0 accessibility standards.
  • Experience in executive communication, relationship building and decision making; experience with stakeholder and partner management.
  • Budget Management
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Degree in engineering, technology, analytics, or related fields preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 9+ years in progressive technology & software engineering required.
  • 5+ years’ experience leading digital, mobile, custom software engineering; proven success engineering consumer mobile experiences in a tourism/entertainment industry is preferred;
  • or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Orlando, FL
  • Experience: 7+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Infrastructure Architect defining enterprise infrastructure patterns across on-prem datacenters and public cloud at Universal Studios in Orlando. Responsible for hybrid architecture standards, infrastructure-as-code, reliability, capacity planning, and governance across compute, storage, networking, and cloud services.

Good fit if you have 9+ years in technology delivery, 7+ years with Azure or AWS, and experience with infrastructure-as-code and architecture review boards.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Infrastructure Architect is responsible for defining and governing enterprise infrastructure patterns across on-prem datacenters and public cloud. This role spans compute, storage, networking, virtualization/containers, IaaS/PaaS, and SaaS integrations, from bare metal through cloud-native, ensuring secure, resilient, and scalable designs. Partners with other teams to drive standardization and best practices around automation (IaC), zero-trust controls, monitoring/observability, backup/DR, and lifecycle/capacity planning; leads cost optimization and vendor/technology selection. The architect a part of the architecture review board and is responsible for reference architectures and roadmaps and enforce compliance to reference designs. The individual works with architecture and technology leadership to drive a global standardized infrastructure vision and roadmap. This leader must be able to inspire UDX culture.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Hybrid Infrastructure Architecture & Standards – Set and enforce reference architectures, patterns and guardrails across on-prem datacenters and public cloud compute (compute, storage, network, virtualization/containers, SaaS). Own the end-to-end stack, from bare metal and hypervisors to IaaS/PaaS and SaaS integrations.
  • Platform Engineer, Performance & Automation – Drive Infrastructure-as-Code, configuration management and pipeline-drive delivery. Partner with NBC Operations & Technology teams, and UDX infrastructure and DevOps teams to align on patterns, reference architectures and remove manual drift. Standardize performance baselines, load testing and tuning.
  • Reliability, Observability & Continuity – Architect for availability, performance and scalability with clear SLOs, capacity planning and lifecycle management. Specify logging, metrics and tracing standards. Ensure backup/restore and DR strategies are in place and ensure operational excellence with runbooks.
  • Capacity Planning, Governance & Roadmaps – Participate in architecture review board, maintain infrastructure technology roadmaps to support annual planning and long-range planning. Help reservations/savings plans and hardware refresh with demand curves. Partner with other teams to ensure cost modeling/FinOps is performed on new designs. Evaluate vendors and standardize on approved services to control sprawl and total cost of ownership.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, systems engineering, information technology or similar preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 9+ years in technology delivery and implementation.
  • 7+ years’ experience in global/large scale/enterprise solution and platform development.
  • 7+ years’ hands on experience with Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS) implementations.
  • Extensive experience in front-end and back-end integration design.
  • Extensive Experience in executive communication and collaboration.
  • Experience in stakeholder and partner communication.
  • Experience with the software development lifecycle;
  • or equivalent combination of education and experience.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws.
  • Extensive experience designing and deployment of cloud and on-prem infrastructure
  • Experience evaluating architecture designs and making recommendations for infrastructure implementation, deployment and provisioning.
  • Repeated experience with UML artifacts.
  • A technical background with an understanding of high-level networks, routers, switches, firewalls, BGP, and SANs.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code deployments.
  • Experience with capacity planning across cloud and on-prem infrastructure
  • Experience with an architecture review board (ARB).
  • Demonstrated ability with Cloud FinOps and cost modeling.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.
  • Preferred certifications with AWS and/or Microsoft Azure

The Senior Campaign & Journey Automation Developer designs, builds, and optimizes complex audiences, campaigns, and customer journeys within Adobe Experience Platform, including Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Adobe Campaign Orchestration (ACO), and Federated Audience Composition (FAC). This role translates business and marketing requirements into scalable technical solutions, owns implementation decisions, and provides technical leadership throughout sprint delivery. The Senior Developer partners with Marketing Data Operations, Direct Marketing, Data Science, and Scrum teams to resolve dependencies, mitigate delivery risks, and deliver high-quality solutions while mentoring less experienced developers.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Business-First Solution Execution
    • Translate marketing and customer requirements into scalable campaign and journey solutions.
    • Make implementation decisions that balance business needs, scalability, performance, maintainability, and technical risk.
    • Identify technical and delivery risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Audience Creation & Campaign Development
    • Design and build complex, reusable audiences aligned with targeting, personalization, and measurement objectives.
    • Apply strong knowledge of datasets, schemas, data relationships, and identity resolution to ensure audience accuracy.
    • Partner with Direct Marketing to refine audience logic, targeting rules, and measurement frameworks.
    • Build and maintain scalable, multi-channel campaigns and customer journeys.
    • Troubleshoot complex data, identity, and execution issues.
    • Develop reusable templates, configuration patterns, automation capabilities, and platform optimization improvements.

    • Serve as a technical lead for campaign and journey development within Scrum teams, supporting sprint planning, refinement, and estimation.
    • Lead the technical execution of sprint commitments and communicate progress, dependencies, risks, and blockers to the Scrum team, Scrum Master, and Product Owner.
    • Proactively manage dependencies, maintain delivery quality, and resolve or escalate blockers and risks.
    • Mentor Developers through solution and configuration reviews, technical coaching, and execution support.
  • Governance & Quality Assurance
    • Validate campaign and journey readiness and ensure adherence to established governance, QA, and deployment standards
    • Reduce rework and production defects through thorough solution reviews, testing, and QA discipline.

  • Adobe Marketing Technology Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform and relevant campaign or journey capabilities, including AJO, ACO, and FAC
  • Advanced Data & Audience Development: Strong expertise in audience segmentation, identity resolution, and leveraging complex datasets to drive targeting accuracy and personalization at scale
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience using Snowflake or comparable cloud data platform to support campaign data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Data, Product, and Technology teams to deliver high-quality, on-time outcomes
  • Agile & Scrum Delivery: Experienced in sprint planning, estimation, and execution within fast-paced Scrum environments, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery
  • Problem Solving & Optimization: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot complex data, platform, and execution issues while driving continuous improvement

  • Mentorship: Experience mentoring junior developers through technical guidance, code reviews, and best practice sharing

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing Technology, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant education and practical experience will be considered.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing technology, campaign automation, journey orchestration, or a related discipline (required)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform and one or more campaign or journey orchestration capabilities, such as AJO, ACO, or FAC (preferred)

  • Experience with additional campaign platforms such as Unica or Salesforce Marketing Cloud is beneficial
  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions (required)
  • Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Technology, and Data teams (required)
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills (required)
  • AJO Business Practitioner Certification (preferred)

The Program Manager has overall responsibility for the successful planning and execution of complex attraction technology and sustainment initiatives. This role requires an understanding of attraction systems, including emerging platforms such as guest interface systems, gaming systems, facial recognition, machine vision, and AI applications. The Program Manager collaborates with Engineering, Maintenance, Creative, Attraction Technology, business partners, and external vendors to define scope, coordinate resources, manage project information, and support successful program execution in alignment with approved schedules, budgets, quality standards, and business objectives.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the planning and execution of projects for complex attraction systems. Drive innovation through integration of emerging technologies such as guest interface systems, gaming platforms, facial recognition, machine vision, and AI applications. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams and external vendors to conduct comprehensive ride system assessments, including obsolescence studies and prioritized recommendations. Oversee project implementation schedules, ensuring alignment with deliverables, budgets, and deadlines. Facilitate stakeholder engagement and subject matter expert input to define scope, develop roadmaps, and maintain timeline integrity. Navigate and resolve conflicting feedback to achieve consensus and maintain project momentum. Ensure sustainment projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to established quality standards, while maintaining alignment across leadership and partner teams.
  • Lead or actively participate in project kickoffs, presenting key deliverables, initial specifications, timelines, and budget frameworks. Oversee and manage assigned capital projects related to technical systems, ensuring alignment with budget estimates, cash flow forecasts, and milestone commitments. Conduct regular reviews with project managers to assess risks, track progress, and ensure achievement of quarterly targets. Collaborate with Finance and leadership to communicate budget changes and secure necessary approvals. Maintain accountability for staying within agreed-upon budgets, proactively informing stakeholders of any changes to scope, assumptions, or emerging issues. Monitor project budgets and schedules daily, manage work-back schedules, and process all project change orders. Identify and resolve potential delays or compliance risks, ensuring tactical quality across all client partner deliverables and facilitating smooth handoffs from vendors.
  • Drive effective communication and informed decision-making by developing and maintaining detailed project plans that promote awareness while preserving project scope. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, IT, Creative, Ride & Show, and Operations teams to ensure strategic alignment and seamless execution. Prepare and deliver program status updates and strategic recommendations to senior leadership, ensuring transparency and accountability. Document all project opportunities with comprehensive scope definitions, visuals, and technical specifications.

EXPERIENCE:

This role is responsible for identifying and assessing business risks, developing and executing risk-based audit programs, leveraging data analytics and technology to evaluate processes and controls, and delivering clear, actionable recommendations that enhance operational effectiveness and support organizational objectives. The A&A Manager independently leads assurance and advisory engagements from planning through reporting, provides leadership and oversight to Senior Analysts, and partners with stakeholders across the organization to drive process improvements, address emerging risks, and deliver value-added solutions through a collaborative and consultative approach. MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Provide regular updates on project status and task progress to internal stakeholders. Maintain accurate records and documentation in Maximo or other asset management systems.

EXPERIENCE:

The Manager, Franchise Management – Sustainment & Placemaking is responsible for leading, overseeing, and documenting Sustainment & Placemaking initiatives across Universal Orlando Resort. This role develops, implements, and executes strategic programs, policies, procedures, and operational guidelines that drive long-term asset preservation, guest experience enhancement, and brand consistency. The position serves as a key partner across business functions, with responsibilities centered on core pillars: Sustainment Strategies, Placemaking Excellence, and Intellectual Property (IP) Partnerships, ensuring alignment with business objectives, operational standards, and franchise partner requirements.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Show Quality & Sustainment
    • Partner with Operations, Technical Services, Entertainment, and Creative teams to uphold the creative, visual, and experiential Show Quality of attractions, themed environments, and guest-facing spaces—including scenic finishes, graphics, animation, special effects, show lighting and audio, color standards, and environmental storytelling—while coordinating technical performance concerns with accountable operating and maintenance teams.
    • Lead cross-functional Show Quality assessments with Operations and Technical Services; identify improvement opportunities and develop sustainment plans that preserve and enhance original creative and design intent.
    • Oversee the accuracy, reporting, and follow-up of daily Show Quality inspections and audits performed by accountable teams; identify trends, escalate risks, and track identified deficiencies through documented resolution with designated owners.
    • Manage strategic prioritization and planning for the Show Quality capital portfolio; recommend annual investment priorities based on guest impact, asset condition, operational risk, creative and brand integrity, and business objectives.
    • Support and partner with Creative, Operations, and Technical Services on the development and implementation of sustainment strategies that preserve attraction quality, guest experience standards, environmental storytelling, and overall park presentation.
  • IP Partnership
    • Serve as the primary steward for Intellectual Property (IP) approvals related to post-opening modifications within licensed environments, ensuring all proposed changes are submitted, reviewed, and approved in accordance with IP partner requirements.
    • Maintain complete, accurate, and accessible records of IP submissions, feedback, decisions, approvals, denials, and supporting materials for future reference, audits, and project planning.
    • Coordinate with design, creative, and project teams to meet established IP requirements, approval milestones, and submission processes throughout development, execution, and closeout.
    • Serve as the primary coordinating point of contact for annual IP partner reviews, including schedules, site visits, stakeholder communications, executive briefings, meeting logistics, and follow-up action plans.
    • Build and maintain collaborative IP partner relationships through proactive communication and timely updates on relevant projects, operational observations, sustainment activity, and planned changes affecting licensed properties.
  • Communication & Collaboration
    • Develop and maintain strong relationships with IP partners through proactive communication, providing timely project updates, operational insights, sustainment status reports, and awareness of future initiatives impacting licensed properties.
    • Collaborate closely with Art Directors, Placemaking, Technical Services, Operations, and external vendors throughout all project phases to ensure compliance with IP requirements, creative intent, and established approval processes.
  • Planning & Implementation
    • Represent Sustainment and Placemaking in cross-functional planning forums, aligning project stakeholders on creative priorities, delivery dependencies, and action plans with clear accountability across Creative, Operations, and Technical Services.
    • Support the development and implementation of sustainment strategies that preserve attraction quality, guest experience standards, environmental storytelling, and overall park presentation.

About this job

Lead UXUI and system design for Universal Parks and Resorts' global digital products including websites, apps, and interactive touchscreens. This two-year project role focuses on end-to-end product design, brand solutions, and cross-functional collaboration to enhance customer engagement and revenue growth.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Sr. Manager, UXUI role will be a core member of the Global UXUI Experience Design team at Universal Parks and Resorts and lead brand solutions centered on UXUI and system design from inception to execution, framing product needs from a holistic and global perspective.

This candidate will work with a cross functional team focused on identifying opportunities to enhance customer engagement by executing an elegant and seamless experience as well as maintain high quality experience design frameworks for our products (websites, apps, interactive touch screens) to ensure we present a coherent brand image.

This person is a key member in creating opportunities for audience engagement, revenue growth through design executions, measuring demand and loyalty marketing across the customer buying process.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the holistic view of the product’s design across integration (customer and technical) points to provide a superior, seamless experience from daily improvements to longer-term strategies.
  • Lead brand solutions centered on UXUI and system design from inception to execution, framing product needs from a holistic and global perspective.
  • Communicate with business and design leaders and act as point of contact for specific commerce related design initiatives.
  • Synthesize product design and consumer trends, propose hypothesis, test via A/B testing tools, document and recommend clear, specific solutions to meet consumer needs.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Demonstrated success creating end-to-end digital product designs in the consumer technology sector.
  • Should have exceptional brand, visual, and interaction design skills and a depth of experience working across the user-centered design process: from conducting and leveraging research (quantitative and qualitative) to prototyping and implementation to testing and evaluation.
  • Strong UI design background and foundational skills: Typography, layout, composition, color theory, iconography, UXUI, motion/interaction design and branding.
  • Experience creating and documenting UI toolkits, style guides, and front-end frameworks for design and development teams.
  • Experience leading cross-functional reward, loyalty, and customer community projects intended to drive engagement and business value.
  • Requires strong domain knowledge in marketing, loyalty, rewards, messaging, and engagement.
  • Experience in building cross-channel experiences in growth marketing.
  • Experience utilizing user-centric design methodology: Gathering/shaping requirements, defining user stories, storyboarding features and iterating based on user feedback/testing.
  • Knowledge of current challenges in the marketing environment such as attribution of marketing touch points, understanding customer lifetime value, and the use of data science led personalization.
  • A desire to tackle and solve problems, from big picture strategy to granular details.
  • Independent, self-motivated, thoughtful, strategic and a clear communicator.
  • Passionately advocate for the user.
  • Experience leading projects with cross functional teams.
  • Comfortable with agile transformation.
  • Some experience in workshop and training facilitation preferred.
  • A positive attitude, open mind, and desire to collaborate and learn.
  • Highly proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, InVision, and Abstract.

SCOPE:

  • The Sr. Manager, UXUI role will be a core member of the Global UXUI Experience Design team at Universal Parks and Resorts. We are responsible for Global UXUI; design concept, development and delivery of digital product across web, app and other digital applications for all Universal vacation destinations worldwide.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree is required; Bachelor’s degree or higher is required – Graphic Design, Human Centered Interaction and/or Interaction Design

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of 5-7 years of relevant experience in ecommerce sites, rewards/engagement and loyalty programs working with data-driven product development teams.

  • Familiarity with Big Data concepts, tools, utilities, protocols, and practices
  • Familiarity with Cloud Computing architectures, protocols, and practices
  • Demonstrated ability of strong customer relationship skills.

The Adobe Target Analyst supports the execution, quality assurance, and ongoing sustainment of digital experimentation and personalization experiences across web properties. This role partners closely with the Optimization, Product, Engineering, and Digital Experience teams to build and deploy Adobe Target experiences, validate A/B tests, maintain winning experiences and production hotfixes, troubleshoot platform issues, and ensure Target activities continue to operate reliably through website releases and changes.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Adobe Target Experience Development & Deployment
    • Build, configure, and deploy Adobe Target experiences in support of A/B testing, personalization, and digital optimization initiatives.
    • Partner with the Optimization team to translate test requirements and experience designs into functional Adobe Target activities.
    • Implement winning test experiences at 100% traffic allocation when appropriate, providing a temporary production solution until the functionality can be developed natively by Product and Engineering teams.
    • Build and deploy Adobe Target hotfixes and experience updates to address production issues while longer-term technical solutions are being developed.
    • Ensure Target implementations follow established experimentation, development, and platform standards.
  • Quality Assurance & Experimentation Support
    • Perform comprehensive quality assurance for web experimentation initiatives prior to launch, validating Adobe Target configuration, audience qualification, experience delivery, DDE implementation, and overall launch readiness.
    • Validate experiences across applicable browsers, devices, audience conditions, and user journeys to ensure intended functionality and guest experience.
    • Partner with Experimentation Managers, Developers, Product teams, and other stakeholders to troubleshoot implementation issues and resolve defects prior to activation.
    • Support pre-launch and post-launch validation of Adobe Target activities to confirm experiments and personalization experiences are functioning as expected.
  • Production Support & Experience Sustainment
    • Own the ongoing maintenance and operational health of Adobe Target-powered production experiences, hotfixes, and sustained winning tests.
    • Monitor, maintain, troubleshoot, and update live Adobe Target activities to ensure experiences continue functioning as intended.
    • Support the sustainment of personalization initiatives and other long-running Target experiences by identifying potential issues and coordinating required updates.
    • Identify and escalate risks or technical issues that may affect experimentation, personalization, guest experience, or data integrity.
  • Release Coordination & Cross-Functional Partnership
    • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Web, and Digital Experience teams to understand upcoming website releases and assess potential impacts to active Adobe Target activities.
    • Represent Adobe Target and experimentation considerations during product launch, release readiness, and deployment discussions.
    • Act as a communication bridge between website delivery teams and the Experimentation team, proactively identifying changes that could affect active tests, audiences, personalization experiences, or Target functionality.
    • Coordinate validation of Adobe Target activities before and after website releases to minimize disruptions to active experiences.
    • Maintain expertise in Adobe Target functionality, implementation approaches, and platform capabilities, and provide guidance on best practices.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Working knowledge of Adobe Target or a comparable experimentation, personalization, or digital optimization platform.
  • Basic understanding of A/B testing, experimentation, personalization, audience targeting, and digital optimization concepts.
  • Basic understanding of web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, browser developer tools, and how website changes may affect digital experiences.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to perform thorough quality assurance across digital experiences, audience conditions, and user journeys.
  • Ability to identify, document, troubleshoot, and escalate technical issues in partnership with Product, Engineering, and other technical teams.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple activities, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced digital environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts and implementation considerations to business and technical partners.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams while also working independently on assigned responsibilities.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Digital Media, Business, or a related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in digital marketing technology, experimentation, personalization, web analytics, website operations, digital product development, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with Adobe Target strongly preferred. Experience with another enterprise experimentation or personalization platform may be considered.
  • Experience building, configuring, maintaining, or quality-assuring digital experiences, website content, personalization activities, or A/B tests preferred.
  • Exposure to HTML, CSS, JavaScript, browser developer tools, or other front-end web technologies preferred.
  • Experience working with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Analytics, Optimization, or Digital Experience teams in a cross-functional environment preferred.


Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

About this job

Lead visual development and art direction for Universal Destinations & Experiences campaign videos, brand films, and motion design. This hands-on role translates brand strategy into compelling moving media, guides creative execution, and partners with postproduction and multimedia teams.

Good fit if you have 7+ years in motion design or video art direction, advanced Adobe Creative Suite skills, and experience leading high-profile branded video projects.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Manager, Brand Creative - Motion & Video leads visual development and art direction for campaign video, brand films, and motion design across Universal Destinations & Experiences. The role translates brand strategy into compelling moving media, stewards brand standards, and guides execution from concept to delivery. This hands-on creative leader partners with Postproduction and Multimedia teams.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Campaign Visual Development

  • Develop visual concepts and design approaches for marketing campaigns, promotional videos, brand films, social content, and related media.
  • Translate brand strategy, campaign objectives, and creative briefs into distinctive visual treatments, style frames, and design explorations that advance strategic goals.
  • Collaborate with creative and editorial partners to ensure visual design supports narrative intent and audience engagement.
  • Present and articulate visual concepts to creative leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

Video Art Direction

  • Establish the visual language of video content through composition, typography, graphic treatments, imagery, color, and screen design.
  • Guide art direction from initial concept through animation, editorial integration, creative review, and final execution.
  • Steward brand standards and visual identity systems, ensuring moving media advances brand and strategic goals and meets intellectual-property requirements.
  • Provide clear, actionable creative feedback to motion designers, editors, animators, and external partners.

Motion Design and Hands-On Execution

  • Lead creative development of motion identities, broadcast-style graphics packages, title sequences, and animation systems.
  • Personally design style frames, motion graphics, animations, and other high-priority assets as project needs require.
  • Develop adaptable design systems and motion toolkits for consistent execution across campaign video, digital out-of-home, and in-park screen environments.
  • Apply deep motion design expertise to evaluate craft, feasibility, and technical execution.

Creative Collaboration and Mentorship

  • Partner with the Senior Post Manager on video projects, complementing editorial creative direction with specialized visual art direction.
  • Collaborate with the Senior Manager, Design — Multimedia on shared motion, event, and presentation initiatives as needed.
  • Mentor motion designers and other creative contributors; guide external creative partners and support future team development.
  • Coordinate with centralized Project Management on creative milestones, reviews, and deliverables without assuming primary production-management ownership.
  • Follow established UDX Environmental, Health & Safety policies and perform other duties as assigned.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Exceptional art direction and design expertise focused on video, animation, and screen-based storytelling.
  • Demonstrated experience developing visual concepts that translate brand strategy and campaign goals into compelling promotional content and motion identities.
  • Ability to translate creative strategy into style frames, visual systems, and polished moving-image work.
  • Strong creative judgment and experience guiding designers, animators, editors, and external partners.
  • Advanced hands-on motion design and animation capability with a portfolio of original work.
  • Understanding of editorial storytelling and postproduction workflows without requiring ownership of editorial operations.
  • Ability to balance multiple high-visibility creative assignments and communicate design decisions clearly.
  • Strong understanding of brand stewardship, visual identity standards, legal, licensor, and intellectual-property requirements.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

SPECIFIC QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
  • Strong working knowledge of Premiere Pro and video postproduction workflows.
  • Experience designing motion graphics for varied screen formats; familiarity with environmental video, digital out-of-home, and in-park displays is preferred.
  • Ability to develop storyboards, style frames, motion tests, and scalable visual systems.
  • Working knowledge of Cinema 4D, Maya, or Blender is a plus; familiarity with emerging creative technologies and responsible AI tools.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree in motion design, graphic design, animation, film, visual arts, or a related field required.
  • Equivalent professional experience may be considered in accordance with company policy.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in motion design, video art direction, animation, or related creative work.
  • Demonstrated experience leading visual development on complex, high-profile campaign or branded-video projects.
  • Experience in entertainment, media, advertising, hospitality, or another consumer-facing industry preferred.
  • Ability to support key productions and events, including occasional travel, evenings, and weekends.

JOB SUMMARY:

Composite Technicians are responsible for fabricating and repairing fiberglass and carbon fiber items. This includes designed modifications, both structural and cosmetic of ride vehicles, show figures and other props and products as directed by both Engineering and Management directives. This position is detailed orientated and involves crafting, cutting, trimming, sanding, assembly, vacuum bagging among other operations involved in the successful production of composite materials. It is essential to have a complete understanding of “Lay Up Charts”, drawings, blueprints, and engineered speciation’s to insure the quality and structural integrity of parts that are being repaired and manufactured.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs structural and cosmetic fiberglass and carbon fiber repairs to ride vehicles which may include direction of Management, Quality Control and the engineering group. Suggests optional procedures for repairs on new and damaged parts and implements changes as needed or directed.
  • Performs structural and cosmetic fiberglass and carbon fiber repairs to a variety of props, show figures and miscellaneous animation parts. Determines type of resin and catalyst and accurately measures predetermined amounts required for saturation and adhesion of material for the application.
  • Selects precut layers of mat, cloth, carbon fiber and wood bracing if required for projects being repaired or manufactured.
  • Applies multiple layers of mat / fiber to surfaces assuring adhesion and repeating the process until the desired thickness, contour and strength is achieved.
  • Performs gel coating as needed on ride vehicles, props, materials, and miscellaneous parts using spray and brush techniques which may include direction of Management, Engineering and the Quality Control Dept.
  • Hand lays sections of saturated mat or cloth into place on molds, using proper tooling to insure placement of material is correct. Uses brushes, rollers and squeegees as needed to smooth out air pockets, air bubbles and wrinkles to achieve full contact and proper adhesion.
  • Design, manufacture and repair both hard and soft molds for composite material products that are used throughout the venues.
  • Performs hand sculpting of different materials for a variety of props, show figures and miscellaneous parts utilizing catalyzed foam, clay, latex and foam sheets and blocks.
  • Safely and properly create a vacuum bag barrier on repaired parts and operate a vacuum pump to evacuate all air from the repair area.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree or GED is required while a completion of a related technical school course is preferred
  • Previous training in automotive body work, marine or aerospace industries is essential

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5-7 Years: Structural lay up of composite matting materials as well as grinding and prep for repairs of finished products required
  • Additional experience of properly preparing indications and feathering composite materials to insure all affected areas of discrepancies have been removed
  • Knowledge of spraying and brushing of gel coatings is required

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Valid Florida Drivers License/ required to operate company vehicles

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for directing and managing all aspects of the development of all of the Facility Construction for major land, attraction or hotel development (the “Project”), including all planning, budgeting, scheduling, estimating, design, construction, fabrication, delivery, and commissioning required to open the Project within the assigned budget, quality, schedule, creative and guest experience targets.

Organize and establish effective Project management; coordinate and manage design decisions and construction document production; avoid contract claims and disputes; minimize change orders during construction phases; effectively manage changes in the Project; eliminate interface disruptions between project participants; maintain, and where possible improve the Project schedule and budget; insure quality design and construction work; emphasize “hands-on” management of field operations; establish and maintain a competent and experienced staff;  implement efficient and timely document control.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Construction/Fabrication/Implementation - Responsible for the qualification, procurement, selection, contracting and performance of all Contractors, Vendors, Manufacturers, Fabricators, etc. required to complete the facility development of the Project. Ensure that all project procedures are being followed as it relates to Correspondence, RFI’s, Directives, Shop Drawings, Submittals, Meeting Minutes, Punch Lists, Deficiency Lists, Notices, Pay Applications, etc. necessary to successfully implement the new theme park facilities.
  • Budget/Scheduling - Responsible for maintaining the overall project budget and schedule within the targeted objectives set forth during project approval.
  • Creative/Architectural Development - Responsible for the coordination and implementation of the creative/architectural content done by the Creative team or outside consultants. Responsible for the final delivery of the creative/architectural vision that meets the initial objectives set forth during the concept development.
  • Design Management - Responsible for the qualification, procurement, selection, contracting and performance of any and all Architectural, Engineering and Technical Designers hired to complete the facility design phase of the Project. Responsible for the successful completion of the design that meets the creative/architectural intent within the budget and schedule established for the project.
  • Personnel Management - Responsible for the hiring and selection of the necessary project team required to implement the project. Responsible for the performance of each of the project team individuals as it relates to the successful opening of new attractions. Responsible for the development and growth of project team.
  • Project Reporting - Responsible for the management, tracking and reporting of all the necessary project components inclusive of budget, schedule and progress of the project to upper management. Responsible to maintain accurate documentation necessary to insure a successful project completion within the targeted budget and schedule.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

  • License(s) in Architecture or Engineering preferred.

  • Directly supervises members of the facility project team.  Size of the facility project team varies from team to team. The project team will consist of Architects, Engineers, Project Manager’s, Schedulers, Estimators, Technical personnel ranging from 10 – 35 people in addition to the management of outside Architects, Construction Management, Scheduling, Estimating, Technical, Import and Procurement consultants. Team will consist of high level/experienced employees who are typically degreed/licensed professionals in the engineering, architecture or construction management fields. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws.

  • Preferred qualifications include:

    • ON-THE-JOB TRAINING: Minimum of 6 months to learn internal process and procedures and an additional 6 months to develop necessary familiarity with available resources in the industry to properly accomplish successful project completion.

    • LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors

    • MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.

    • REASONING ABILITY: Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.

    • RELATIONSHIPS OUTSIDE WORK UNIT: Influences decisions of major nature. High degree of tact & diplomacy to obtain favorable decisions or maintain good will.

    • OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Project, and Prolog.

SCOPE: 

Non-routine; general policies applied to frequently changing situations. Complex; established procedures not available. Major decision-making.

EDUCATION:  

Bachelor’s degree is required in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or a related field. Master’s degree in is preferred in Engineering, Architecture, Business Administration, or a related field.

EXPERIENCE: 

15-20 Years of experience in the development and management of major projects with hospitality/entertainment/theme park experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for performing the highly skilled, discipline-specific tasks required to ensure the smooth operation of Universal Orlando Facilities as it pertains to all industrial, commercial and non-commercial plumbing equipment, utilities and infrastructure.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Service and repair all UO plumbing systems, including, but not limited to: water closets; urinals; sinks; faucets; drinking fountains; water softeners; water heaters; steam effect boilers; potable backflow preventers; circulating pumps; tempering valves; mixing valves; high pressure fog/mist lines; nozzles and pumps and all related potable water and piping assets by complying with all NSF, ADA and State Plumbing codes and regulations. Interface with Contractors and Code Enforcement Agencies.
  • Service all UO infrastructure, including, but not limited to: sanitary lines; grease lines; oil lines; grease traps; interceptors, lift stations pumps and controllers/PLC. Operate large cable commercial sewer machines and high-pressure line jetting equipment.
  • Service all UO natural gas systems, including, but not limited to, all above ground and below ground pipes, valves and fittings.
  • Service all steam boilers and piping. Perform daily water conductivity tests on boiler feed water. Maintain all flame, water, natural gas and pressure controls as well as all other safety devices. Conduct diagnostics and troubleshooting efforts through the onboard boiler PLC HMI. Service all makeup water feed pumps and associated piping.
  • Service all water based fire protection systems, including, but not limited to: all fire hydrants; fire sprinkler systems; fire pumps; industrial backflow preventers and all related fire infrastructure.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Technical school is preferred
  • Associate degree (AA) is preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 6+ equivalent years in industrial and commercial construction, maintenance facility or a fast paced service company dedicated to plumbing repair is required
  • 1+ year in theme park industry is preferred

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • A valid Florida Driver’s License is mandatory for the operation of company vehicles.
  • Additionally, a Journeyman, Contractor, or Masters licenses with a minimum of 8,000 hours of relevant job experience that is issued by a Municipality, City, County, State, for the MEP trades is required.
  • Moreover, a current Backflow Test and Repair certification or current Midwest Energy Association (MEA) and updated Operator Qualifications (OQ) certification are required within 6 months.

About this job

Lead creative design and multimedia development for Universal Destinations & Experiences executive presentations, live events, and brand communications in Orlando. Translate complex business objectives into visual narratives while establishing design standards and mentoring creative teams.

Good fit if you have 7+ years multimedia or presentation design experience, strong Adobe and PowerPoint skills, and have led designers on high-visibility projects.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Manager, Design - Multimedia, leads creative development and hands-on design for executive presentations, leadership communications, live events, and multimedia experiences for Universal Destinations & Experiences. This role translates complex business and brand objectives into compelling visual stories, establishes design standards, and guides internal and external creative resources. The position is partners with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams to deliver clear, engaging, brand-aligned communications.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Multimedia Creative Leadership
    • Lead visual concept development and design direction for executive presentations, leadership communications, sales summits, and corporate events.
    • Translate strategic business messages and complex information into clear, compelling visual narratives.
    • Establish presentation and multimedia design standards that elevate quality and reinforce brand consistency.
    • Provide hands-on creative direction and design for high-visibility initiatives.
  • Presentation and Executive Communications
    • Lead the design of sophisticated executive presentations integrating typography, data visualization, imagery, video, and animation.
    • Partners with executives and communications stakeholders to structure narratives, clarify messaging, and improve audience engagement.
    • Create and refine presentation templates, visual systems, and reusable assets for consistent communication.
    • Personally design and refine priority presentation materials when specialized expertise is required.
  • Live Events and Multimedia Experiences
    • Develop visual identities, screen content, and multimedia graphics for conferences, leadership meetings, roadshows, and partner experiences.
    • Collaborate with Events, Production, and technical partners to adapt creative for large-format displays and live environments.
    • Guide design development from concept through reviews, approvals, and final creative delivery.
    • Integrate motion and video elements in collaboration with Postproduction and motion specialists.
  • Team and Partner Leadership
    • Lead, mentor, and develop multimedia designers and guide freelance and agency creative partners.
    • Provide constructive creative feedback and maintain high standards for craft, clarity, and brand alignment.
    • Coordinate with the centralized Project Management organization on priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
    • Partner with Brand, Marketing, Commercial, Communications, Events, and Postproduction teams.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Demonstrated leadership in presentation design, multimedia design, and live-event visual communications.
  • Exceptional visual design craft, typography, composition, information design, and storytelling skills.
  • Experience partnering with executives and translating complex business objectives into clear visual communications.
  • Ability to provide hands-on design execution while guiding and developing other designers.
  • Experience directing creative for large-format event screens and multimedia environments.
  • Ability to collaborate across Brand, Communications, Events, Production, and Project Management.
  • Strong understanding of brand standards, approvals, and intellectual-property requirements.
  • Portfolio demonstrating outstanding executive presentations, multimedia design, and live-event work.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree in graphic design, multimedia, communications, visual arts, or a related field required.
  • Equivalent professional experience may be considered in accordance with company policy.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in multimedia design, presentation design, experiential design, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading designers and complex, high-visibility creative initiatives.
  • Experience in entertainment, travel, tourism, hospitality, media, or another consumer-facing industry preferred.
  • Ability to support key events, including occasional travel, evenings, and weekends.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and/or Keynote, including sophisticated presentation design and templates.
  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
  • Working knowledge of After Effects, video integration, animation, and data visualization workflows.
  • Experience designing for live-event screens, large-format displays, and A/V environments.
  • Familiarity with emerging creative technologies and responsible AI-enabled design tools.

JOB SUMMARY:

Supervises the operations, maintenance, monitoring, scheduling, installation and improvements of resort wide life safety, security control, environmental building management and utilities related systems, infrastructure associated equipment and components to include: Electrical, Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning, Mechanical, Plumbing, Electronic Control and Energy Management. Formulates, implements, tracks and validates energy conservation initiatives to reduce consumption of site wide Utility commodities. Oversees Utility services, meter readings, billings and payments.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develops and communicates resort wide MEP maintenance & utilities annual budgets for utility departments. Supervises all Electrical, HVAC, Mechanical, Plumbing, Electronic Control and Fire Alarm work such as routine, quick calls, preventative & predictive maintenance, discretionary and emergency repairs.
  • Coaches and counsels all utility trade technicians.  Develops, reviews and delivers employee performance evaluations as well as personnel development plans.
  • Supervises routine utilities maintenance, PM schedules, and operations. Ensures all emergency work and repairs are being performed.  Ensures safety related items are completed as soon as possible. Coordinates activities with other Utilities Supervisors. 
  • Establishes, implements and monitors site wide energy conservation goals and initiatives.  Strives to reduce utility costs as they relate to Electrical, HVAC, Mechanical, Plumbing and Environmental equipment and operations. Ensures inspections and adjustments are performed on all utility controls to achieve maximum equipment efficiency and reduces variable operational costs as they apply to monthly billing cycles.
  • Communicates with utilities and government agencies to secure reliable service, cost effective rates, and meet or exceed all applicable regulatory responsibilities.
  • Assists and coordinates, as requested through work orders, with ride & show and facility maintenance on all utilities / M.E.P. issues to ensure ride / venue readiness, reliability and maximum operational availability.
  • Performs other M.E.P. and supervisory duties as assigned by the Manager, Utilities.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION: 

  • High school degree or GED is required.
  • Associate’s degree (AA) or equivalent from two-year college or technical school is preferred. 

EXPERIENCE: 

  • 3-5 Years: Supervisory experience required in conjunction with 5-7 Years: (Required) Combination of operation and maintenance of Industrial / Commercial Utilities systems & components and associated auxiliary equipment; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • Required: Licensed as one or more of the following: Journeyman Electrical, Journeyman Plumber, HVAC License A or B and Universal Refrigerant Handling EPA Certification.
  • Preferred: Contractor license as one or more of the following: Electrical, HVAC, Plumbing.
  • Preferred: Government or military Utility trade designation or certification.

JOB SUMMARY:

Supports the Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) business partners to implement and maintain EHS policies and procedures in alignment with the Universal Orlando Resort (UOR) EHS policies and procedures and Universal Destinations & Experiences (UDX) EHS Standards. EHS policies and procedures are designed to protect Team Members, Guests, and the environment, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements and internal policies.

As an EHS liaison, the Senior Specialist serves as a high-impact individual contributor responsible for driving EHS excellence across the organization. This role requires strong leadership presence, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence decisions at all levels, including senior leaders. The Senior Specialist proactively identifies risks, leads initiatives, and partners across functions to strengthen safety, culture, and performance. Partners with assigned UOR business partners, providing day-to-day guidance to drive risk reduction and ensure effective management systems are in place across disciplines, including environmental compliance, occupational health, Guest, and Team Member safety.

This position requires a balance of technical expertise and operational engagement — ensuring that UOR’s EHS programs achieve continuous improvement in EHS culture, performance, and regulatory compliance. As an individual contributor, this position is responsible for managing day-to-day tasks and completing assigned projects within the established strategic framework of the department.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Management

  • Applies EHS knowledge, both existing and newly acquired, to support safe operations and decision making.
  • Operates as an effective individual contributor, delivering high‑quality work with minimal oversight.
  • Demonstrates familiarity with relevant codes and regulations and applies them appropriately within the scope of work.
  • Proactively initiates work, takes ownership of tasks, and drives assignments to completion.
  • Enhances existing strategies and contributes to the development of new approaches to improve performance and outcomes.
  • Understands and solves EHS‑related problems using sound judgment, analytical thinking, and established methodologies.
  • Manages day‑to‑day responsibilities while maintaining awareness of long‑term goals, strategies, and organizational priorities including applying tactical thinking to evaluate needs, determine next steps, and plan work strategically.
  • Shows interest in pursuing professional certification and actively works toward meeting eligibility requirements when not already certified.
  • Conducts and applies risk assessments to identify hazards, evaluate exposure, and collaborates with internal and external partners to develop effective solutions.
  • Holds extensive knowledge of business operations within assigned areas of responsibility and understands how EHS integrates into broader organizational goals.

Leadership

  • Provides guidance to an assigned group of UOR business partners (Supervisors and their direct reports) in the implementation and continuous improvement of UOR’s EHS programs and processes in alignment with UDX EHS Standards and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Establishes and maintains a culture where safety, health, and environmental stewardship are core operational priorities.
  • Influences the decisions and actions of others through strong communication, credibility, and relationship‑building.
  • Understands how decisions impact the department and contributes to alignment with broader organizational objectives.
  • Demonstrates the ability to communicate difficult or sensitive messages with clarity, professionalism, and empathy.

Engagement & Inclusion

  • Promotes a culture of proactive engagement and shared accountability for safety and environmental excellence among UOR Operational division Team Members.
  • Assists Team Members and partners to support shared goals and operational needs.
  • Facilitates and participates in meetings, discussions, and cross‑functional initiatives.
  • Learns about different partners and their interaction with the organization.
  • Actively participates in meetings, contributing ideas, insights, and constructive feedback.
  • Actively gives and receives feedback to coworkers and leadership to support continuous improvement across the organization.

TSAT / GSAT

  • Builds and maintains strong partnerships within area of responsibility to promote transparency, collaboration, and trust in EHS operations.
  • Leads coordinated responses, ensures consistent communication, and partners with UOR business partners to drive alignment on corrective and preventive actions related to Guest and Team Member incidents.

Financial / Budgeting

  • Monitors performance and ensures compliance by documenting and verifying metrics.
  • Validates operational conformance.
  • Uses data to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Collaborates with EHS and business partners to develop annual operating plans aligned with UDX EHS, NBCUniversal, and UOR business priorities.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Professional Certification – Required (or ability to sit for professional examination)
    • One or more of the following: Associate Safety Professional (ASP), Occupational Hygiene and Safety Technician (OHST), Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM), Construction Health and Safety Technician (CHST), Safety Trained Supervisor (STS), Certified Instructional Trainer (CIT), or equivalent
  • Technical EHS Skills & Competencies
    • Possess business acumen, strong analytical skills, strategic thinking, organizational behavior, communication skills, ability to influence and work on a team, and be a self-starter.
    • Strong computer skills with word processing, presentation development and delivery.
    • Comprehensive and working knowledge of applicable EHS regulations; establishing goals and objectives, and financial implications of EHS operations.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Required: A Bachelor’s degree in related field required; or equivalent experience.
  • Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in an EHS element, Public Health, Civil or Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related field.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience should be in a diverse, changing, and rapid pace environment.
  • Required:
    • 7+ years relevant work experience in EHS required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
    • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills.
    • Experience in 5 or more functions that include, but are not limited to:
      • Compiling metrics, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
      • Training
      • Inspections, sampling and monitoring
      • Hazard recognition and mitigation
      • Conducting investigations and Risk Assessments
      • Implementing directives and standards
      • Technical report preparation
      • Issuance and review of safe work permits
      • Risk Management
      • Investigations
      • Performance measurement / conformance validation

Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Developer, DDM Development & Campaign Automation is a senior technical contributor responsible for delivering personalized, omnichannel customer communications at scale through Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) and Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This role focuses on building, testing, and deploying email, push, SMS, and related messaging channels, while driving technical excellence, scalable personalization, and operational efficiency across high-volume, business-critical campaigns.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Adobe Journey Optimizer Platform & Channel Execution
    • Implement email, push, SMS, and emerging messaging channels within AJO.
    • Apply best practices for responsive templates, accessibility, localization, and deliverability.
    • Serve as a senior technical resource for complex journeys and advanced personalization use cases.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to rendering, data dependencies, and channel behavior.
    • Follow established QA, testing, and release management processes.
    • Ensure compliance with CAN-SPAM, TCPA, GDPR, and internal data governance standards.
    • Maintain documentation, templates, and implementation standards.
    • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and process optimization.
  • Personalization & Dynamic Content Development
    • Build and execute scalable personalization using dynamic content, decisioning logic, and real-time attributes.
    • Translate segmentation and data requirements into reusable and efficient solutions.
    • Develop modular components and templates to support consistent execution across campaigns.
    • Partner with data and analytics teams to ensure personalization is accurate and measurable.
  • Campaign Development & Deployment
    • Build, QA, and deploy campaigns across email, push, and SMS channels.
    • Ensure all deliverables meet quality, performance, and compliance standards.
    • Support high-volume lifecycle and triggered communications with accuracy and timeliness.
    • Participate in release processes and validate readiness for production deployment.
  • Agile Delivery & Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Contribute technical input during intake, backlog grooming, and sprint planning.
    • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Creative, QA, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams.
    • Align development work with sprint priorities and enterprise change management processes.
    • Support continuous improvement through retrospectives and knowledge sharing.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Strong expertise in customer journey orchestration, event-driven messaging, and channel execution across email, SMS, and push.
  • Adobe Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Adobe Campaign Orchestration (ACO), Federated Audience Composition (FAC), and Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Knowledge: Working knowledge of Content Builder, Automations and Journeys
  • Working knowledge of APIs, data flows, identity resolution, and integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and dynamic content.
  • Ability to translate data and segmentation requirements into scalable implementations.
  • Strong understanding of QA processes, deliverability, and campaign performance considerations.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
  • Effective collaboration skills in cross-functional, agile environments.
  • Customer-focused mindset with attention to accuracy, timing, and experience quality.
  • Adobe Journey Optimizer certification preffered.
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, Digital Marketing, Business, or a related field required (or equivalent practical experience).

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing technology, digital messaging, or campaign development.
  • Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign Orchestration, Federated Audience Composition, Adobe Experience Platform (preferred)
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Builder, Automations and Journeys (preferred)
  • Proven experience building and executing personalized messaging at scale.
  • Experience working in Agile / Scrum environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and dynamic content.
  • Experience operating in large, matrixed organizations.
  • Familiarity with enterprise customer data models and CDP platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-volume lifecycle or triggered communications.
  • ; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
