About this job

Principal Project Planner Scheduler provides complex planning and scheduling support for theme park development projects at Universal Studios Orlando. Responsibilities include creating program and project schedules using Primavera software, coordinating across multiple disciplines, managing schedule milestones, and reporting progress to executive management throughout the project lifecycle.

Good fit if you have 9+ years of engineering/construction planning and scheduling experience, 8+ years of Primavera software experience, and a bachelor's degree in engineering, architecture, or construction management.

Full job description

This is an evergreen posting to express interest in upcoming opportunities. ​While there may not be an immediate opening at this time, applications submitted through this posting will be reviewed and considered as positions become available.

JOB SUMMARY:

Provides complex planning and scheduling support to executive management in lead capacity of planning/scheduling responsibilities at the Portfolio, PMO, or land level development project assignments. Supports the project team with planning and schedule development on large multi-disciplined program(s)/project(s) throughout the entire project life cycle spectrum from concept development through turnkey completions, consistent with project needs and appropriate policies and procedures. Scope of planning and scheduling responsibilities include development/establishment of program/project schedules, show/ride concept development, show, ride, facility, area development designs, building construction, show/ride production, installation, and commissioning stages.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prepares program project life cycle and project master schedules and statuses the project schedules utilizing Primavera software. Develops comprehensive plans and schedules from multiple discipline drawings and specifications. Prepares project plans and works with scoping/strategy documents to develop integrated project master schedules. Prepares schedule contract milestones for bid packages.
  • Provides project team with Schedule guidance during all phases of the project. Coordinates with estimating/finance teams to develop appropriate level of detail scope definition and durations for schedule activities to support project monitoring and project controls reporting needs. Coordinates with contractors, vendors, and responsible project team members to develop and integrate activity durations and logic sequences required to perform project work. Integrates project schedule input from all internal and external project organizations.
  • Leads planning and coordination meetings as required to support planning and monitoring functions. Collects/reports progress, evaluates progress variances, develops work-around plans, and coordinates resolution of variances. Conducts resource loading/resource analysis and develops and statuses earned value tracking tools and progress curves as required. Produces reports as required to support project team needs and executive management reporting. Frequently communicates, reports, and interacts with project and core team members including vendors and outside consultants on complex topics.
  • Implements highly effective project control tools and reports and provides insightful analysis that contributes to schedule certainty.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • Proven prior project controls leadership, supervisory experience preferred
  • Solid working knowledge of theme parks, show/ride product lines and design and construction.
  • 8+ years of primavera scheduling experience required
  • Possess strong understanding of design and construction progress measurement.
  • Working knowledge of architectural/engineering and show and ride design and production.
  • Must be a well-organized self-starter with strong communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Solid understanding of practical project controls applications and earned value measurement.
  • Ability to supervise staff, consultants, and suppliers including setting goals, prioritization of tasks, coordinating work, and managing time.
  • Strong meeting leadership, facilitation, and alignment skills
  • Strong communication, collaboration, technical writing, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to successfully influence and lead a team.
  • Ability to appropriate delegate and coach/mentor talent.
  • Ability to successfully negotiate schedule changes with vendors and contractors.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills
  • Thorough knowledge of planning techniques

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or an applicable field required. Advanced degrees preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

9+ years engineering/construction planning and scheduling experience required. 8+ years theme park planning/coordination experience preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Responsible for performing nightly preventative, diagnostic, and corrective maintenance of all audio and visual equipment; provides repair of large computer controlled audio/visual, electronic messaging, projection, network, and lasers.

CTS Certification preferred

JOB SUMMARY:

As Learning Experience Designer within the Leadership Capability & Learning COE, you are the team’s primary design expert responsible for translating strategic capability priorities into high-quality, engaging, and effective development experiences (e-learning, instructor-led training, etc.). You create solutions that are modern, immersive, and genuinely impactful. Where others see a slide deck, you see an opportunity for a simulation. Where others see a workshop, you see a multi-modal experience that extends into the flow of work. Where others see a leadership program, you see a design challenge.

You work in close partnership with the Sr. Manager, Leadership Capability, who sets the strategic design direction – diagnosing capability gaps and defining what behavior change needs to happen. Your role is to bring that direction to life with craft, creativity, a deep understanding of how adults learn, and a strong point of view on the tools, technologies, and emerging practices that can make learning more effective. You operate with significant creative autonomy within that partnership, bringing your own ideas, pushing the boundaries of what development experiences can be, and continuously raising the bar for what great looks like.

Beyond individual experiences, you are also the visual and design standard-bearer for the COE. You own how this function presents itself to leaders, the business, and the broader organization. That means owning the COE's visual design standards and templates so that every deliverable that comes out of this function looks and feels like it belongs to the same world.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design & Build Immersive Learning Experiences
    • Design and build simulations, scenario-based experiences, experiential labs, and immersive learning environments that put leaders in realistic situations and require them to make real decisions.
    • Develop engaging, high-quality e-learning and digital learning assets that extend development into the flow of work, not just for formal learning moments but for the spaces in between.
    • Translate the defined capability priorities and design direction into concrete learning experiences, bringing creative solutions to the build.
    • Prototype rapidly, pilot with real learners, gather feedback, and iterate, always optimizing for behavior change over production polish.
    • Build a reusable library of design assets, templates, and components that accelerate future work and ensure design consistency across the COE's portfolio.
  • Set & Own Visual Design Standards
    • Establish and maintain visual design standards for the Leadership Capability & Learning COE – defining the look, feel, and quality bar for all deliverables including program materials, participant guides, presentations, and digital assets.
    • Build a template library that is practical, flexible, and easy for others to use so that design standards get maintained even when you are not the one producing the output.
    • Bring visual storytelling expertise to the design of leadership experiences, ensuring that the narrative arc of every program, module, and asset is as intentional as its instructional design.
    • Translate complex leadership concepts, capability frameworks, and development models into visuals that are immediately legible to a theme park operations leader as much as to an HR professional.
    • Elevate the quality of how the COE communicates its strategy, impact, and value through decks, one-pagers, infographics, and other visual communication formats.
  • Own Learning Technology & Innovation
    • Own all internal instructional design and learning production tools – selecting, managing, and maintaining proficiency in the technologies that power the COE's design work.
    • Actively monitor and experiment with emerging learning technologies including AI-powered development tools, immersive and simulation platforms, adaptive learning technologies, and other innovations reshaping how people develop.
    • Bring a point of view on what the COE should be doing differently based on what you are seeing in the field – not just executing on existing ideas but challenging the standard.
    • Partner with Learning Operations on any technology decisions that intersect with leader-facing platforms, ensuring alignment on sustainability, budget, and operational support. Integrate AI meaningfully into design and delivery – not as a gimmick but as a genuine capability enabler that makes development more personalized, more scalable, and more effective.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Learning Technology, experience design, or a related field – or equivalent demonstrated experience with a portfolio that proves it.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years of experience designing and building learning or development experiences end to end.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in e-learning authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, Adobe Captivate, or equivalent.
  • Strong visual design and visual communication skills with a portfolio that demonstrates high-quality, polished work across multiple formats and modalities. Portfolio submission is required with application.
  • Working knowledge of adult learning theory and learning science, with the ability to articulate why design choices work and how they connect to how adults actually learn.
  • Experience designing beyond the classroom (simulations, scenario-based learning, experiential modules, or immersive digital learning assets).
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint or equivalent presentation design at a genuinely high visual standard.
  • Preferred:
    • Experience with AI-powered learning tools, immersive learning platforms, or adaptive learning technologies.
    • Experience establishing or contributing to visual design standards, template systems, or brand guidelines for a team or function.
    • Background in experience design, interaction design, or UX – even if not in an L&D context.
    • Experience working in a COE, consulting environment, or complex matrixed organization where strategic direction was often ambiguous and design solutions had to be built without a complete brief.
    • Experience in a fast-moving, operationally complex industry – hospitality, entertainment, retail, or similar environments where practicality and speed matter as much as craft quality.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Works with the attraction maintenance teams, UO Engineering, and Reliability Centered Maintenance departments to identify critical risk assets and components, ensuring proper predictive maintenance techniques are utilized. Maintains certifications in Vibration Analysis, Ultrasound, and Infrared Thermography.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform vibration, ultrasound, oil sampling and IR predictive maintenance towards mechanical and electrical systems throughout the UO theme park environment. Coordinate with Ride & Show maintenance team to access and execute work route on high criticality assets. Works with venue to communicate and coordinate corrective actions as direct result of predictive maintenance activities. Assists with both down-time related and venue requested testing and analysis.
  • Analyzes and interprets the data results from predictive maintenance measurements conducted on high criticality assets. Evaluate Asset health based on data gathered and compare with baselines and other knowledge. Communicate to appropriate ride management by creating detailed and actionable reports in order to effectively plan and schedule any required repairs. Articulates benefits of predictive maintenance practices to venue partners.
  • Supports all predictive maintenance projects and initiatives. Works closely with Leadership, Vendors, Venue APMs, and Engineering to facilitate planning, installation, execution, and evaluation of projects. Coordinates assigned project activities between ride planners, ride supervisors, ride managers, ride technicians, and departments outside of Tech Services, such as IT and other outside parties. This includes, but is not limited to, remote monitoring, continuous monitoring, and other permanently installed reliability solutions.
  • Assist with Motor Circuit Analysis program by performing regular and requested data collection and venue requested downtime related data collection and analysis.
  • Analyzes venue assets and components to create a criticality risk matrix by identifying failure modes, detectability, probability of failure, and overall consequences of failures. Ranks assets and components to advise on additional predictive maintenance requirements to increase venue reliability and increase guest satisfaction.
  • Provide input and entry into CMMS system for the completion of predictive maintenance work orders, creation of predictive maintenance follow up corrective actions, requalification results and all report outs accompanying such work actions.
  • Document and actively maintain all testing locations and testing procedures within specified accessible electronic location.
  • Utilize continuous improvement methodologies to identify gaps in process and predictive technologies as it pertains to ride reliability. Stays current on predictive technologies and equipment as it relates to the maintenance and reliability of UO mechanical and electrical systems.
  • Achieves Level I certifications in Vibration Analysis, Ultrasound, and Infrared Thermography in accordance with the standards and requirements of ASNT within 6 months of hire. Completes training on Motor Circuit Analysis basic data collection and analysis within 1 year of hire.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION: 

  • High school degree or GED required; Associate’s degree (AA) or equivalent from two-year College or technical school is preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

  • 3+ Years: Experience in trouble shooting and repair of complex electro-mechanical systems, as well as hydraulic and mechanical systems either in the theme park industry or other industrial industries.
  • Experience in predictive maintenance disciplines such as vibration analysis, ultrasound, infrared thermography, oil sampling and analysis is preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience. 

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • Ability to attain the following certifications within an agreed upon timeframe:
  • NAARSO Level 1
  • Vibration Analysis Level 1
  • Ultrasound Level 1
  • Infrared Thermography Level 1
  • Valid Florida Driver’s License/required to operate company vehicles.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • The team member will be expected to remain in the position for a minimum of two years due to the extensive training requirements.
  • Position will require schedule flexibility which could change by shift or days off from day to day or week to week as PdM work orders require.

About this job

Support capacity planning and attendance forecasting across Universal Orlando's admission products, including Epic Universe, Annual Passes, and Halloween Horror Nights. Develop analyses and recommendations that balance guest access, operating capacity, and business objectives using Excel, Snowflake SQL, and Power BI.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in finance, analytics, revenue management, or capacity planning, with strong SQL and Power BI skills.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

Serve as a business partner to Universal Orlando leadership by supporting capacity management, admission access, and related planning across the destination. Develop analyses and recommendations that balance attendance demand, operating capacity, guest access, and business objectives while ensuring decisions adhere to applicable legal requirements and established program guidelines. Support capacity planning and access management across key products and programs, including Epic Universe, Annual Passes, Halloween Horror Nights, and complimentary admission programs. Partner with Finance, Revenue Management, Marketing, Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders to evaluate demand, establish and maintain capacity controls, and support collaborative decisions regarding block out dates and other admission restrictions. Use analytical tools and models to monitor utilization, forecast demand, identify capacity risks and opportunities, and translate complex data into clear recommendations for leadership.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage and support capacity planning across key admission products and programs, including Epic Universe, Annual Passes, Halloween Horror Nights, and complimentary admission programs. Monitor demand, utilization, and available capacity; develop forecasts and scenario analyses; and recommend capacity allocations and access controls that balance guest access, operational considerations, and business objectives.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders on block out dates and other mechanisms used to manage demand during constrained periods.
  • Partner closely with Marketing to inform product and pricing decisions through financial and demand analysis, evaluating potential impacts to consumer behavior, revenue, profitability, and broader business objectives.
  • Provide insights that help balance commercial opportunities with financial considerations and assess the effectiveness of implemented strategies.
  • Monitor actual performance against capacity plans and expectations, identify emerging risks and opportunities, and recommend adjustments to capacity levels, allocations, or program parameters.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness and business impact of capacity-management decisions and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Develop and maintain analytical tools, reporting, forecasts, and scenario models supporting capacity-management decisions. Use Excel, Snowflake SQL, Power BI, and other analytical tools to evaluate alternatives, identify trends, and translate complex data into actionable recommendations.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Highly collaborative, with the ability to work across Finance, Revenue Management, Marketing, Operations, Legal, and other stakeholder groups
  • Ability to balance guest access, operating capacity, financial objectives, program requirements, and legal considerations when developing recommendations
  • Experience with capacity planning, demand forecasting, inventory or access controls, ticketing, admissions, or a comparable analytical business process
  • Able to translate financial and operational analysis into clear recommendations and decision materials that support business decisions
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and hands-on experience using Snowflake SQL or a comparable data platform to develop forecasts, scenario analyses, and data-quality checks
  • Experience developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports, with the ability to reconcile results across source systems, models, and dashboards

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree or GED is required.
  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Analytics, Economics, or equivalent is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in finance, analytics, revenue management, capacity planning, forecasting, ticketing, admissions, or a related area. Demonstrated experience analyzing large datasets, developing forecasts and scenarios, partnering across functions, and communicating recommendations that support complex business decisions. Experience with Snowflake SQL, Power BI, and advanced Excel is preferred.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in strategic finance, corporate strategy, or investor relations, with expert PowerPoint and financial modeling skills and experience presenting to executives.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Director, Strategic Finance at UDX reports to the Sr. Director, Financial Strategy and is a highly visible individual contributor who serves as a strategic partner and primary point of contact for executive leadership and peers across the organization. The role combines financial analysis, executive storytelling, investor-relations insight, and business strategy to support critical decisions across Universal Destinations & Experiences.

The Director leads key elements of UDX’s strategic finance and executive reporting agenda, developing executive presentations and decision-support materials that connect business performance, external insights, strategic priorities, and investment considerations. Success requires exceptional presentation development and strategic storytelling, strong financial judgment, and the ability to rapidly translate complex information into concise, executive-ready narratives.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Executive Reporting & Strategic Communications

  • Lead key components of the UDX operational rhythm, including business reviews, annual planning, long-range planning, strategic check-ins, and other executive-level presentations.

  • Independently develop executive-ready presentations that translate complex financial, operational, and strategic information into clear, compelling narratives.
  • Own the quality and accuracy of executive materials, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy and leadership priorities.

Investor Relations & Leadership Insights

  • Partner with UDX Executive Leadership, FP&A and NBCUniversal to develop UDX perspectives and supporting analysis for earnings-related materials, investor discussions, and other external financial communications.
  • Synthesize investor, analyst, and external commentary about the business, key industry participants, and relevant sector themes into concise updates for UDX executive leadership.
  • Develop executive briefings that highlight recurring investor themes, external perceptions, emerging questions, and implications for

UDX messaging, strategy, and performance narratives

  • Maintain a clear, fact-based bridge between internal business performance and external financial narratives while protecting confidential information and ensuring alignment with approved disclosures.
    Investment Evaluation & Decision Support
  • Lead financial evaluation of strategic initiatives through robust financial models, scenario analyses, and decision frameworks.
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to develop business cases, challenge assumptions, evaluate risks and opportunities, and present recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Oversee post-investment reviews to assess performance against original business cases and incorporate lessons learned into future decisions.

Process Improvement & Strategic Influence

  • Improve strategic finance processes, reporting tools, and governance to increase efficiency, consistency, and decision usefulness.
  • Establish best practices for executive reporting, analytical storytelling, presentation development, and data visualization.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and influence outcomes through analytical rigor, executive communication, and strategic partnership rather than formal authority.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to shape concise executive narratives from complex financial and operating information.
  • Expert PowerPoint and executive presentation-development skills, including persuasive visual storytelling for senior leadership audiences.
  • Experience supporting Investor Relations, earnings-related communications, external financial narratives, or comparable executive reporting processes.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to build credibility with senior leaders and corporate stakeholders.

  • Sound judgment in interpreting external commentary and distinguishing investor perspectives from approved company positions.

SPECIFIC QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling

  • Knowledge of the tourism, leisure, media, or consumer experience industries
  • High emotional intelligence, executive presence, and interpersonal skills

The Senior Director combines financial governance, workforce planning, sourcing, vendor, and partner management. This leader will work closely with UDX Finance, Legal, Talent, and Procurement to align GT&I strategic priorities with UDX and NBCU corporate policies and controls.   • Leads and administers the end-to-end process by which the divisional project teams fund, track and report on expenditures.
  • Partner with UDX Finance review to prepare and conduct periodic reviews for the Global Technology & Innovation senior leadership team.

JOB SUMMARY:

Provide advanced analytical decision‑support to Universal Destinations & Experiences leadership by owning complex workforce and operational analyses that inform strategic and tactical decision‑making across a dynamic, guest‑facing environment. This role applies deep industrial engineering, operations research, and advanced analytics expertise to drive sustained improvements in efficiency, service delivery, workforce effectiveness, and financial performance.

The Senior Industrial Engineer operates with a high degree of independence, leads complex analytical efforts end‑to‑end, and serves as a trusted advisor to operational leaders and members of the Senior Leadership Team (SLT). In addition to delivering high‑impact analyses, this role mentors junior engineers, shapes analytical standards, and helps advance analytical maturity across the organization.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Independently scope, design, and deliver complex analytical and decision‑support solutions using industrial engineering and business analytics principles. Apply advanced analytical techniques, including statistics, process flow analysis, queuing theory, mathematical optimization, scenario modeling, and prescriptive optimization methods, to evaluate trade‑offs and recommend data‑driven actions.
  • Own labor planning, workforce utilization, budgeting, scheduling, and productivity models for assigned business areas. Balance cost efficiency with service levels, guest experience outcomes, and operational constraints. Anticipate downstream impacts of recommendations and proactively assess risks, sensitivities, and alternatives.

  • Apply advanced trend analysis, forecasting techniques, and statistical methods to assess performance drivers and emerging risks. Identify opportunities to automate, standardize, and scale analytics by productionizing metrics, models, and decision logic using modern analytics and productivity tools within cloud‑based platforms.

  • Mentor and support Associate and Industrial Engineers by providing technical guidance, reviewing analytical work, and coaching on problem structuring, modeling approaches, and communication of insights. Contribute to onboarding, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of analytical standards across the team.
  • Lead analytical workstreams on cross‑functional initiatives, coordinating with operations, finance, technology, and other partners. Facilitate analytical working sessions and contribute to shaping broader analytical roadmaps and priorities.
  • Develop and deliver clear, compelling analytical narratives for senior and executive audiences. Lead the creation of executive‑level presentations, dashboards, and materials that translate complex analyses into insights that inform strategic and operational decisions.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and programming tools (Python, R), with demonstrated ability to independently develop complex queries, analytical workflows, and reusable code bases.
  • Proven experience owning and delivering production‑ready analytics and decision‑support solutions, including standardized metrics, governed datasets, automated workflows, and sustained operating models.
  • Demonstrated expertise applying optimization and operations research techniques in resource‑constrained, variable‑demand service environments.
  • Experience directly influencing operational and strategic decisions with senior and executive stakeholders, balancing efficiency, risk, service levels, and guest or customer experience outcomes.

  • Strong consulting, facilitation, and communication skills, including the ability to clearly influence diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring junior engineers or analysts and contributing to team capability development.
  • Strong project and workstream leadership skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
  • Willingness to support a 24/7/365 operation, including periods of high demand such as weekends and holidays.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Required: 4–7 years of progressively responsible experience in industrial engineering, analytics, operations research, or a related analytical role.
  • Preferred: Experience leading or owning analytical work in hospitality, theme park, resort, retail, dining, entertainment, airline, cruise, or other high‑volume service environments with complex demand patterns and operating constraints

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time, 24/7 operation
  • Location: Orlando, FL
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Associate Engineer responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining ride and show control systems at Universal Orlando parks, including downtime recovery, fault analysis, and design improvements. Role includes 24/7 on-call rotation and requires adherence to ASTM F24 and multiple safety standards.

Good fit if you have 0-1 years control systems experience with PLCs, troubleshooting skills, and a bachelor's degree in electrical or computer engineering.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsibilities will encompass a wide range of tasks including downtime recovery, troubleshooting, fault analysis, redesign projects, obsolete part migration, and the integration of control and mechanical hardware ensuring the seamless operation of Ride & Show systems across all attractions.  On-call 24/7, carrying the Engineering Duty Phone on a rotational basis, and serving as the primary liaison for the Engineering department, addressing issues across disciplines to support Ride & Show and Operations. All work will adhere strictly to ASTM F24 Committee guidelines and comply with relevant codes, regulations, and standards such as AISC, ASME, ASTM, ANSI, AWS, JIC, NEC, and OSHA, ensuring the highest levels of safety and compliance.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Troubleshoots electromechanical systems while conducting fault identification and failure analysis to facilitate downtime recovery during the day-to-day operations of Universal Orlando (UO) parks while being the main liaison between Engineering and partners in Ride and Show and Operations.
  • Provides design solutions for Ride & Show systems ranging from basic to moderate levels of complexity to improve safety, operational reliability, show quality, and serviceability of equipment. Places an emphasized focus on improving system diagnostics, technical training of Ride & Show and Engineering Team Members, and Preventive Maintenance improvement.
  • Generates engineering documentation to validate design solutions that have been implemented by the engineer including but not limited to control system hardware analysis, firmware analysis, code comparison documentation, change bulletins, CAD drawing changes, and training procedures. Generates Acceptance Test Procedures to validate all system design changes in accordance with Universal Destinations & Experiences (UDX) standards and procedures.
  • Utilizes project management skills to coordinate project efforts, assigned by Engineering management, with Operations and Ride & Show divisions to make effective use of the venue and Team Member resources to drive projects to completion.
  • Documents project status of assigned tasks to give regular and insightful updates to the appropriate attraction management, both operations and Ride & Show as well as Engineering Management. Maintains configuration management of controls hardware and software (drawings) documentation in accordance with Engineering’s guidelines and procedures for proper archiving and security.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering Technology, Computer Engineering required, or related field preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

  • 0-1 years of experience in control systems and installations utilizing PLCs, ladder logic, variable frequency drives and technical fault analysis/identifications in a theme park or equivalent environment required, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

PREFERRED:

  • Knowledgeable in ASTM and F24 standards.
  • Experience in the design of safety-critical systems.
  • Experience with servo controls as applied to hydraulic, pneumatic, and electromotive motion control systems.
  • "Hands-on" experience with PLC and automated control systems.
  • Experience with motor control centers, motor starters, and variable speed drives.
  • Knowledge of the generation of control system specifications, and acceptance test procedures.
  • Experience utilizing the following products and networks:
  • Programmable Logic Controllers & Programming Software: Rockwell Automation, Siemens, Beckhoff, Omron and/or Pilz
  • Variable Frequency Drives: Rockwell Automation, ABB, Siemens, and/or Schneider Electric
  • Human Machine Interfaces: Standalone HMIs (PanelView, SIMATIC, and/or Comfort Panel) and SCADA Systems (FactoryTalk View Studio Suite, WinCC, ICONICS and/or Ignition)
  • Industrial Communication Networks: Ethernet I/P, EtherCAT, PROFINET, PROFIBUS, DeviceNet, ControlNet, Data Highway Plus, Remote I/O and/or MODBUS)
  • AC and DC motors and motor control systems.

REQUIRED:

  • Experience with troubleshooting and problem-solving of electrical, mechanical, and/or control systems.
  • Experience communicating and collaborating with diverse teams to complete complex tasks.
  • Experience working in diverse teams to accomplish a common goal.
  • Experience communicating effectively across varying skill sets and knowledge bases to define tasks and project status.
  • Experience keeping detailed records through a project lifecycle from initiation to completion
  • Knowledge of a high-level programming language ("C", Visual Basic or JAVA).
  • Knowledge of electrical standards UL 508A, NFPA and NEC.


Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Manager, Technical Services – Ride & Show
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Manages the mechanical, controls, and animation maintenance activities in area of responsibility. Develops and oversees all routine, capital, and expense budgeting and sets direction and priorities of all maintenance functions for the area of responsibility.  Manages and leads supervisors and assistant managers to include continuous improvement, personal development, and administration in area of responsibility.  Oversees system and component design changes, directs the activities of outside vendors and construction for all attraction additions and/or modifications.  Oversees, revises, and implements the preventative and predictive maintenance programs to ensure compliance with OEM specifications and increased operational readiness and show quality.  Develops, executes, and oversees TSAT action plans, safety plans and training plans specific to area of responsibility.  Ensures guest safety and team member safety in all attractions within area of responsibility.  Manages and administers the annual NDT requirements of all attractions in area of responsibility.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Reviews with staff annual, preventative, and predictive maintenance plans to ensure the capital investment is kept in like new condition.  Sets improvement goals for the department, gives direction to ensure goals are met, and communicates all goals to the team.  Ensures the safety of all guests and team members through a proactive approach in managing safety issues, the proper use of PPE, regular discussions with the team in regards to safety and continuous job safety analysis of all tasks.
  • Sets the priorities and oversees any modifications and/or engineering modifications to ensure timely completion of tasks.  Analyzes operational performance of the attractions and manages priorities of maintenance activities.
  • Supervises and leads training and development of all direct reports in assigned area.  Administers development plans on a regular basis and as required.  Manages schedules and personnel records for direct reports.  Ensures compliance to all Universal Orlando policies and procedures.  Ensures safety is the top priority of assigned area for both guests and team members.
  • Ensures operational throughput requirements are supported on a daily basis.  Coordinates work efforts with operational needs of the attractions, working directly with all affected departments to ensure the highest level of customer service.
  • Ensures all areas of responsibility are in compliance with ASTM F-24 guidelines as well as original manufacturer’s requirements. 
  • Builds and manages routine budget for responsible area to include all expenses needed to achieve goals.  Monitors overtime for responsible area, ensuring only used when absolutely necessary.  Builds capital and expense plans for responsible area as required.
  • Develops, executes, and oversees safety plans specific to area of responsibility and in alignment with the Technical Services Ride & Show safety plan.  Develops, executes, and oversees training plans for area of responsibility increasing the preparedness of the entire team.  Develops, executes, and oversees TSAT action plans for area of responsibility driving increases in overall engagement.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

SCOPE:

Manages all maintenance activities for rides, shows, and guest interactive areas for specific area.   Manages routine, expense and capital budgets for specific area.  Leads and supervises all direct reports and manages all hourly personnel in specific area.

EDUCATION: 

  • High school degree or GED:  Required
  • Technical school:  Preferred
  • Associate’s degree:  Preferred (General Education or Technology)     
  • Bachelor’s degree:  Preferred (Mechanical/Electrical Engineering)    
  • Master’s degree in:  Not Required

EXPERIENCE: 

  • 7 to 10 years’ experience in theme park Maintenance is required. 
  • 7 to 10 years’ supervisory experience is required. 
  • Four years manager, ride and show experience is preferred.
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • NAARSO level 1 certification is required.
  • NAARSO level 2 certification is preferred.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Location: Orlando, FL

About this job

Seasonal paramedic position at Universal Orlando providing medical care to employees and guests. Requires Florida paramedic certification, BLS, and ACLS, plus one year of field experience.

Good fit if you have FL paramedic certification, BLS and ACLS current, and one year of paramedic field experience

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

Under the direction of the supervisor, the paramedic will provide initial medical care for UO employees and guests and complete required paperwork. Paramedic will work within protocols as determined by the medical director.

Pay Rate: $24.50 - $25.50 per hour

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Strictly adheres to and actively promotes all Health Services policies and procedures and Standing Orders while performing duties.

  • Provides timely documentation for each team member and guest completely, legibly and accurately; documenting the appropriate assessment and treatments; documenting on the appropriate paperwork and electronic files. Provides copies and files documents as required.
  • Authorizes treatment for team members to receive outside medical care. Notifies supervisors off all team members and guests sent off property for further treatment.

  • Maintains professional appearance and actions at all times. Presents in uniform as outlined by UO policy and department uniform standards and Team Member handbook
  • Remains current on all department and UO changes or directives, reviews Health Service homepage daily, department communication boards and asks supervisor clarifying questions.
  • Participates in staff meeting, in-service programs and program development activities as required or requested.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

FL Paramedic Certification, Basic Life Support and Advance Cardiac Life Support.

EXPERIENCE:

1 year of experience in the field

JOB SUMMARY:

As a member of the Universal Creative senior leadership team, the Senior Vice President, Global Project Hub is responsible for establishing the enterprise governance framework, project controls, standards, and operational processes that enable successful project execution across all Universal Creative portfolios.

The Senior Vice President provides strategic leadership for the Global Project Hub, leading a multidisciplinary team of subject matter experts responsible for enterprise estimating, planning and scheduling, project controls, financial governance, logistics, reporting, and delivery methodologies. The role establishes enterprise standards, provides executive advisory support, and drives consistency, accountability, and operational excellence across the global project portfolio.

Serving as the enterprise authority on project governance, this position partners with portfolio leadership to provide strategic oversight, financial insight, risk management, and best practices that improve project performance while ensuring projects remain aligned with Universal Creative's business objectives.

The Senior Vice President also serves as the primary business liaison to executive leadership across Universal Creative portfolios, supporting long-range portfolio planning, strategic communications, organizational alignment, capital planning, and budget development while cultivating executive relationships with internal stakeholders and joint venture partners to ensure successful delivery of enterprise objectives.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Global Project Hub Leadership
    • Provide strategic vision and leadership for the Global Project Hub, aligning enterprise project support functions with Universal Creative business objectives.
    • Lead multidisciplinary teams of subject matter experts responsible for estimating, planning and scheduling, project controls, logistics, architectural and engineering support, reporting, and enterprise project methodologies.
    • Establish enterprise standards that enable consistent execution, operational excellence, and scalable support across all global portfolios.
    • Develop organizational capabilities and leadership talent that strengthen enterprise project delivery and continuous improvement.
    • Serve as the primary business liaison with executive leadership across Universal Creative portfolios, ensuring strategic priorities remain aligned with enterprise objectives.
  • Enterprise Governance & Project Controls
    • Establish and govern enterprise-wide project management standards, methodologies, stage gates, approval processes, and project controls across all Universal Creative portfolios.
    • Develop and maintain standardized approaches for scheduling, estimating, forecasting, reporting, change management, cost controls, and risk management.
    • Drive consistency in project delivery methodologies while continuously improving governance frameworks, operational processes, and performance metrics.
    • Lead enterprise adoption of emerging technologies, digital tools, and industry best practices that enhance project execution and organizational effectiveness.
    • Establish governance frameworks and enterprise standards for the engagement, performance, and oversight of consultants, contractors, manufacturers, fabricators, vendors, and strategic partners, ensuring consistent expectations, accountability, quality, and delivery excellence across all portfolios.
    • Develop enterprise processes supporting procurement governance, correspondence, RFIs, directives, submittals, meeting documentation, project controls, and change management that enable predictable project execution across the organization.
  • Financial & Business Governance
    • Establish enterprise financial governance standards supporting capital project planning, estimating, forecasting, and budget development.
    • Provide executive oversight and strategic guidance regarding project financial health, cost trends, contingency utilization, forecasting accuracy, and budget realism.
    • Partner with Finance and portfolio leadership to improve capital planning, financial transparency, and executive decision-making.
    • Evaluate enterprise financial performance metrics and recommend improvements that optimize investment decisions and project outcomes.
    • Support development and communication of long-range planning strategies across Universal Creative portfolios while aligning financial priorities with enterprise objectives.
  • Executive Advisory & Portfolio Support
    • Serve as the executive advisor to portfolio leadership, providing strategic guidance regarding project controls, schedule recovery, estimating accuracy, financial performance, governance, enterprise risk, and organizational effectiveness.
    • Partner with executive leadership to identify organizational risks, remove barriers, and implement enterprise solutions that improve project delivery across all portfolios.
    • Build and maintain strategic relationships across Universal Creative, Universal Destinations & Experiences, portfolio leadership, and external partners to ensure cross-functional alignment and successful execution of enterprise initiatives.
    • Provide executive oversight for enterprise procurement strategies, vendor performance, sourcing approaches, and strategic partnerships that improve quality, consistency, and long-term organizational value.
    • Cultivate executive relationships with joint venture partners and external stakeholders to support collaboration, portfolio integration, and successful execution of strategic initiatives.
  • Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
    • Champion a culture of operational excellence through continuous improvement, enterprise performance measurement, benchmarking, and process optimization.
    • Develop and monitor enterprise KPIs that measure organizational effectiveness and project performance.
    • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve organizational efficiency, and strengthen executive decision-making across the Global Project Hub.
    • Lead organizational transformation initiatives that improve enterprise capability, governance maturity, and operational excellence.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Global travel required.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and creative environment.
  • Ability to lead organizational transformation, enterprise governance, and strategic change across a global organization.
  • Ability to effectively present complex business, operational, financial, and strategic information to executive leadership, boards, and key stakeholders.
  • Strong executive decision-making, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop enterprise governance frameworks, project controls, financial governance, and organizational standards.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and executive relationship-building skills.
  • Comprehensive understanding of project delivery methodologies, capital planning, estimating, scheduling, forecasting, financial analysis, organizational performance, and enterprise risk management.
  • Ability to build executive partnerships across internal organizations, external partners, consultants, vendors, and joint venture stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in project management methodologies, enterprise systems, and executive reporting tools.
  • Passion for the themed entertainment industry and commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Finance or related discipline required.
  • Master's degree preferred.
  • Professional Architecture or Engineering license preferred.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

15+ years of progressive executive leadership experience in project governance, project controls, capital project management, portfolio management, or large-scale development organizations, including responsibility for enterprise scheduling, estimating, financial oversight, governance frameworks, organizational leadership, strategic planning, and operational excellence. Global leadership experience strongly preferred.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Global EHS Sr. Manager – Ergonomics and Human Factors partners on the development and execution of human-centered design strategies focused on performance wearables, costumes, and puppetry systems. This role ensures that performer safety, mobility, comfort, cognitive load, and overall human performance are optimized through ergonomic design principles. The role partners closely with Creative, Production, Engineering, and EHS teams to integrate ergonomics into the design, fabrication, and use of costumes and puppets across global productions. The objective is to reduce injury risk, enhance performer capability, and enable artistic intent through safe, innovative design.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Specialized Design Integration (Costumes & Puppetry):

  • Partner with Creative, Costume, and Puppet Design teams to:
    • Optimize mobility, fit, thermal comfort, and visibility
    • Minimize biomechanical strain and fatigue
    • Improve usability and safety of wearable systems
  • Conduct ergonomic design reviews for:
    • Character costumes and full-body suits
    • Puppetry systems (manual and assisted)
    • Performance-related props and equipment
  • Establish ergonomic design standards and approval processes within creative workflows

Global Ergonomics & Injury Prevention Programs:

  • Lead enterprise-wide ergonomics programs targeting reduction of musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs) and overexertion injuries
  • Develop standardized tools, risk assessment methodologies, and control strategies
  • Identify high-risk tasks across both performance and operational environments
  • Drive implementation of engineering and administrative controls

Broader EHS Policy and Program Support:

  • Support and contribute to global safety policies, including:
    • Creation of global health and safety policies
    • Partner with site EHS teams to update/create local health and safety programs
    • Operational safety and hazard identification
  • Partner with EHS leadership to integrate ergonomics into:
    • Incident investigations and root cause analysis
    • Safety management systems (SMS)
    • Global policies and governance frameworks
  • Provide technical expertise for regulatory compliance and risk mitigation

Operational & Production Support:

  • Collaborate with Production and Operations teams to embed ergonomics into:
    • Rehearsals and performance schedules
    • Backstage workflows and task design
    • Maintenance and fabrication activities
  • Support site-level implementation of ergonomics improvements globally
  • Participate in design reviews for new builds, shows, and capital projects

Data, Analytics & Continuous Improvement:

  • Establish KPIs and metrics for ergonomics and safety performance
  • Analyze injury trends, leading indicators, and performer feedback
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives using data-driven insights
  • Leverage technology (motion analysis, wearables, observational tools) to inform decisions

Training & Capability Building:

  • Develop global training programs on ergonomics, human factors, and injury prevention
  • Build capability across EHS, Creative, Engineering, and Operations teams
  • Establish and lead a network of site-level ergonomics champions
  • Mentor regional safety and ergonomics practitioners

Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Collaborate with senior leaders across EHS, Creative, and Operations
  • Influence decision-making to prioritize human-centered design and safety
  • Balance artistic vision with practical ergonomics and risk mitigation
  • Interface with external experts, consultants, and industry bodies
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Must be a self-starter with extensive knowledge of applicable EHS regulations, strong communication skills to identify and analyze information in a range of workplace conditions.
  • Ability to influence and work in a team by applying communication, engagement, and skills to promote and support change.
  • Strong analytical skills necessary to resolve and interpret problems associated with high level risk assessments.
  • Understand basic operational concepts related to High-Risk Operations and Risk Assessment.
  • Must be able to effectively manage multiple tasks to ensure compliance and completion with all.
  • Must be able analyze and assess labor and equipment required to complete a project and initiate a plan to successfully execute.
  • Strong computer skills with Microsoft Office, presentation development and delivery
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

SPECIFIC QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Certified Professional Ergonomist (CPE) or equivalent
  • CSP, CIH, or related EHS certification
  • Deep expertise in biomechanics, human performance, and fatigue management
  • Knowledge of safety management systems and injury prevention strategies
  • Strong understanding of wearable system design and material considerations
  • Ability to integrate ergonomics into both creative and operational environments
  • Advanced data analysis and problem-solving skills
  • Strong influencing and cross-functional leadership capabilities
  • Leads through influence in a global, matrixed organization
  • Balances safety, performance, and creative excellence
  • Drives enterprise consistency while enabling local flexibility
  • Champions continuous improvement and innovation
  • Reduction in MSDs and performer-related injuries
  • Integration of ergonomics into global EHS programs and capital processes
  • Adoption of ergonomics standards across creative and operational teams
  • Improvement in leading indicators (risk assessments, corrective actions)
  • Performer and employee safety perception and feedback

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Ergonomics, Human Factors, Kinesiology, Engineering, Industrial Design, Occupational Health, or related field
  • Master’s degree preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 10+ years in ergonomics, human factors, or occupational safety/health
  • Experience in global or multi-site environments
  • Direct experience with costume design, wearable systems, puppetry, or performance environments strongly preferred
  • Proven success delivering injury reduction and integrating ergonomics into operations and design

Including, but not limited to bakery, production kitchen, propane and natural gas, and electrical equipment. Perform preventative maintenance and rehab all kitchen equipment back to manufacturer’s specifications.

  • Preventative maintenance and rehab of all kitchen equipment to required manufacturers specifications.
  • Provide proper documents for ordering parts as needed for equipment.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Director, Digital Technical Production & Guest Data Operations
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Director, Digital Technical Production & Guest Data Operations is responsible for owning and operating the technical production backbone across Universal Destinations & Experiences owned and operated digital channels, including websites, online stores, mobile apps, email, SMS, chatbot, push/in app messaging, and direct mail. This role also owns Guest Data Operations, ensuring the integrity, governance, and operational readiness of guest data that powers commercial activation and measurement.
As a senior leader within the Commercial Operations & Analytics organization, this role provides critical operational enablement across the commercial and personalization lifecycle—connecting strategy to activation and ensuring scalable, reliable execution across digital platforms and data domains. The role partners closely with portfolio planning, analytics, UX/UI, marketing activation, ecommerce, and technology teams and operates with enterprise-wide scope, decision rights, and accountability.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Digital Technical Production Operations (Owned & Operated Channels)
    • Own end-to-end technical production operations across all owned and operated digital channels, including websites, online stores, mobile apps, email, SMS, chatbot, push/in app messaging, and direct mail.
    • Lead cross-functional production teams responsible for campaign execution, always-on merchandising, content operations, and launch of new capabilities and ventures, including scaling MarTech platforms to achieve personalization and commercial strategies.
    • Establish and maintain production intake models, prioritization mechanisms, workflow standards, and operational SLAs that enable speed, quality, and scale.
    • Ensure consistent execution quality, platform stability, and brand integrity across all digital touchpoints.
    • Oversee production readiness, release coordination, testing support, issue escalation, and operational optimization for owned channels.
    • Continuously evolve technical production models, tooling, and ways of working in partnership with Technology and UX/UI teams.
  • Executive Leadership & Commercial Operating Model Enablement
    • Serve as a senior leader within the Commercial Operations & Analytics organization, accountable for digital production, personalization execution and guest data operations as foundational elements of the commercial operating model.
    • Translate commercial strategy, portfolio priorities, and activation roadmaps into scalable operational execution.
    • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing leadership team (Directors, Senior Managers), establishing clear accountability, performance expectations, and succession planning.
    • Define and enforce enterprise standards for technical production execution, operational rigor, and guest data stewardship.
    • Partner closely with peer leaders including VP, Portfolio Planning & Transformation; VP, Commercial Data & Analytics; VP, Global UX/UI Design; and Sr. Director, Digital Capabilities & Innovation.
    • Represent production and guest data operations in executive planning, roadmap, and investment discussions.
  • Guest Data Operations & Governance
    • Own Guest Data Operations strategy and execution, ensuring reliable, governed, and activation-ready guest data across the commercial ecosystem.
    • Translate marketing, digital experience, and commerce requirements into operational data needs in partnership with Technology and Data Engineering teams.
    • Establish and enforce data governance standards, including data ownership, access controls, privacy compliance, and stewardship models.
    • Lead data quality management practices, including validation, monitoring, and remediation across guest data pipelines.
    • Maintain a centralized data catalog and metadata framework documenting data definitions, lineage, and usage standards.
    • Serve as the primary guest data and personalization steward responsible for MarTech data platforms and tools administration and operation (e.g. Adobe, Snowflake, SFMC, Unica).
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established company policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Proven executive-level leadership experience within complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Deep expertise in digital technical production across web, mobile, ecommerce, and direct digital channels.
  • Strong command of guest data operations, including governance, stewardship, quality management, and operational enablement.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate within and help shape enterprise commercial operating models.
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills and ability to drive alignment across strategy, activation, design, technology, and data teams.
  • Strong executive communication skills, with experience advising and influencing senior leadership.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience across digital production, technical operations, commercial platforms, and/or guest data operations.
  • Demonstrated success leading large, cross-functional teams and enterprise-scale operational domains.
  • Experience operating at the intersection of marketing, ecommerce, digital experience, and data enablement.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

About this job

Arborist II at Universal Orlando performs specialized tree maintenance including pruning, removal, and health evaluation using bucket trucks and climbing techniques. The role emphasizes palm care and strict adherence to rigging protocols and safety standards.

Good fit if you have climbing experience, a CDL-B or CDL-A license, and background in arboriculture or high-end landscaping.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Arborist II is responsible for operating bucket trucks and heavy equipment to perform specialized tree maintenance, with an emphasis on palm care and pruning. This role involves executing tree pruning and removals in accordance with established rigging protocols. The Arborist II also evaluates basic tree health, implements corrective actions as needed, and upholds strict safety standards to ensure efficient and effective operations.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Operate all heavy equipment, being adept in the use of a bucket truck and high reach to prune, move, install, and remove trees. Being proficient in the operation and maintenance of all 2-cycle equipment i.e.: Chain saws, power pole saws, and back-pack or handheld blowers. Identify nutritional needs, infestations, and diseases while performing routine work. Sanitize equipment between trees.
  • Climb trees for proper maintenance and removal, within UO climbing and rigging guidelines. Including the ability to perform specific climbing knots i.e.: Bowline hitch, half hitch, double half hitch, and slip knot.
  • Perform rigging of trees for proper pruning and removal by applying current best practices. Provide correct hand signals for heavy equipment operation to ensure safe operation.
  • Complete Maximo Work Orders.
  • Install, maintain, and remove supporting systems including bracing, propping, guying, and cabling on trees and palms.
  • Performs housekeeping tasks as related to vehicles, assigned housekeeping area(s), tools and equipment, tool and equipment storage, lockers, personal tool bag, and safety-related items; Follows established departmental 5S guidelines.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION:

This Job Description covers 3 Tiers associated with the Arborist II Job Title, beginning with Tier 1 and ending with Tier 3.

Tier 1

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred
  • CDL-B License or CDL-A License Required

EXPERIENCE:

  • Basic Climbing Experience (6mos)
  • One of the following:
    • 6+ Months Arboriculture Experience
    • 6+ Months performing High End Landscaping (Resort/Theme Park)

Tier 2

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred
  • CDL-B License or CDL-A License Required

EXPERIENCE:

Previous level & tier requirements plus:

  • 1+ Yrs. Climbing
  • One of the following:
    • 2+ Yrs. Arboriculture Experience
    • Horticulture Degree or Horticulture Program Certificate

Tier 3

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred
  • CDL-B License or CDL-A License Required

EXPERIENCE:

Previous level & tier requirements plus:

  • 4 Years Arboriculture Experience
  • ISA Certification
  • MOT Card Holder
  • 4 Years Bucket Truck Operation

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Senior technical role in Universal's architecture organization focused on improving security of applications and platforms. Works hands-on with development teams on secure architecture, code review, vulnerability assessment, and embedding security throughout the software development lifecycle.

Good fit if you have 9+ years in software engineering or security, strong application security expertise, hands-on coding experience, and familiarity with AI-enabled development tools.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Security Solution Architect is a highly technical role of the UDX Global Architecture organization responsible for improving the security of UDX applications and platforms through secure architecture, software engineering, and emerging security tooling. This role partners with development teams, Architecture, and NBC Cyber to identify vulnerabilities, define remediation, and embed security throughout the software development lifecycle. The Senior Security Solution Architect takes a hands-on approach to security by reviewing architectures and code, validating findings, developing proofs of concept, and helping teams implement secure solutions. The role uses conventional security tools and frontier AI models/tooling to accelerate security analysis and remediation, including issues in existing platforms.

The role translates NBC Cyber requirements and recognized industry standards into practical UDX implementation patterns, reference designs, standards, and methods within Architecture Standards & Methods. This position does not establish NBC or UDX cybersecurity policy but translates NBC Cyber requirements into UDX solutions.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Security Architecture, Analysis & Remediation:

  • Assess existing and proposed solutions, identify and validate security weaknesses, define secure architectural designs, patterns and reference architectures. Provide architecture expertise and guidance to delivery teams through implementation in partnership with NBC Cyber.

Secure SDLC & Development Partnership:

  • Embed security into development practices, code review, testing, and CI/CD. Work directly with development teams on findings, proofs of concept, remediation approaches, and automated controls.

Security Implementation Patterns, Standards & Methods:

  • Translate NBC Cyber requirements and industry standards into UDX implementation patterns, reference designs, standards, and methods. Maintain this guidance within Architecture Standards & Methods. Partner and engage with other architects and domain experts and participate in solution review board meetings.

Emerging Technology & AI-Enabled Security:

  • Use frontier AI models and emerging security tooling to analyze code and architecture, identify vulnerabilities, accelerate remediation, and improve secure engineering practices. Conduct research on emerging technologies in support of system development efforts and recommend technologies that will increase security, cost effectiveness and system flexibility.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required:

  • Strong application security and secure software design expertise.
  • Strong software development background with the ability to read, write, and review code, APIs, and SDKs.
  • Strong experience in architecture practices including UML diagrams, and OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specifications.
  • Strong knowledge of OWASP practices, authentication and authorization, API and microservice security, secrets management, dependency risk, input validation, and cryptography fundamentals.
  • Experience with threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, prioritization, and remediation.
  • Strong understanding of secure SDLC and DevSecOps practices including CI/CD, code review, and automated testing.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security concepts including IAM, networking, containers, serverless, APIs, and infrastructure as code.
  • Ability to translate cybersecurity requirements and industry standards into practical architecture and engineering patterns.
  • Strong architecture documentation skills, including standards, reference patterns, and technical guidance.
  • Practical experience with at least one frontier AI-enabled software development model and tooling
  • Strong analytical, collaboration, and communication skills across development, architecture, security, and leadership teams.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering or similar required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 9+ years of IT experience in software engineering, security, architecture, or large integrated solutions; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in solution architecture and application security.
  • Hands-on software development experience with modern application architectures, APIs, and integration patterns.
  • Experience identifying, validating, and remediating software security vulnerabilities.
  • Experience integrating security practices and tooling into the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and cloud-native application security.
  • Experience developing security architecture patterns, implementation standards, or technical guidance.
  • Practical experience applying AI-enabled development or security tooling to software analysis, testing, or remediation.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Solutions Architect’s role is to design application architecture for specified projects to meet security, performance, reliability, reusability, scalability, and maintainability requirements. Project work includes participating in and designing solution options to existing platforms, systems, applications and microservices. This individual will also be involved design of new systems and platforms. Responsible for leading technical discussions with stakeholders and others to drive decisions and solution design. Coach and guide agile delivery teams through technical solutions and work with product owners and product managers to implement end-to-end solutions. Maintain technical knowledge of UPR systems and act as a subject matter expert. Provide documentation and support to teams involved in the solution.

The Solutions Architect will have to work with cross functional teams that will include Product Owners, Data Architects, Delivery Teams, IT Security, DevOps, Infrastructure Teams and Agile Scrum Masters and others in the organization to succeed. Project work includes web applications, native mobile applications, microservices, DevOps, and platform design. This architect will have the opportunity to work on international enterprise multi park solutions.

Be a subject matter expert for development teams as part of implementation. Document and maintain the organizations existing solutions architecture and technology portfolio; make recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives. Review new and existing solutions design projects and procurement or outsourcing plans for compliance with standards and architectural plans. Interface and coordinate tasks with internal and external technical resources. Collaborate with Project Managers, vendors and IT stakeholders to provision estimates and develop overall implementation plan for installation, customization, and integration efforts. Model business and systems processes based on findings through use case scenarios, sequence diagrams, swaggers, workflow diagrams, and data models.

Ensure that proposed and existing solution architectures are aligned with Data Architecture and Enterprise Architecture. Provide architectural expertise and direction to other architects, and software delivery teams. Develop, document, and communicate plans for investing in solutions architecture, including analysis of cost reduction opportunities. Conduct research on emerging technologies in support of systems development efforts and recommend technologies that will increase cost effectiveness and systems flexibility. Provide technical assessments for new work efforts. Lead development of formalized solution methodologies. Build and maintain repository for deliverables and methodologies.
