JOB SUMMARY:

Provide analytical decision‑support for Universal Destinations & Experiences leadership, influencing data‑driven operational and workforce decisions. This role applies industrial engineering, operations research, and advanced analytics to drive measurable improvements in efficiency, service delivery, and financial performance, while supporting a seamless, high‑quality guest experience. Leverage quantitative methods in operational planning, capacity and demand analysis, and productivity improvement to design, implement, and sustain scalable decision‑support solutions in a high‑volume, guest‑facing environment characterized by demand variability and operational constraints.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, operationalize, and sustain end‑to‑end analytical and decision‑support solutions using industrial engineering and business analytics principles. Apply structured analytical techniques—including probability and statistics, process flow analysis, queuing theory, mathematical optimization, scenario modeling, and prescriptive optimization solvers—to diagnose problems, evaluate trade‑offs, and recommend actionable solutions. Develop and maintain decision‑support models for labor planning, workforce utilization, budgeting, scheduling, and hiring strategies, balancing cost efficiency with service levels, guest experience outcomes, and operational realities.

Continuously elevate analytical solutions by applying advanced analytics techniques, modern programming practices, and modern analytics and productivity tools to improve speed, quality, scalability, and long‑term impact.

Engineer, standardize, and maintain analysis‑ready datasets by consolidating, cleaning, and translating data from multiple enterprise systems into governed sources of truth. Apply advanced trend analysis and statistical techniques—including forecasting, classification, and anomaly detection—to understand performance drivers and validate insights.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to automate and scale analytics by productionizing metrics, models, and decision logic using modern analytics and productivity tools within cloud‑based platforms, supporting both real‑time and scenario‑based decision‑making across fluctuating demand conditions.
  • Develop clear, compelling business cases and presentations for audiences ranging from frontline operators to senior and executive leadership. Create dashboards and visualizations as part of standardized performance and decision‑support systems that help stakeholders evaluate scenarios, understand trade‑offs, and act with confidence. Translate complex analytical findings into concise narratives that drive alignment and action.
  • Participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policies, procedures, and training. Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Provide leadership, management, and coaching
  • Establish standards and best practices to maximize team performance and company advancement
  • Develop growth plans and foster individual and professional growth
  • Keep key stakeholders updated on product roadmap developments and advancements
  • Manage issues, risks, and escalations as needed to support the product team
  • Work closely with IT and other internal organizations to ensure alignment
  • Contribute to the success of the larger team by driving joint collaboration, visioning, and planning
  • Provide other Team Members with support in continued growth opportunities through shared product experiences
  • Participate and drive formal mentorship opportunities to help other Team Members improve their product skills

Product Planning

  • Establish the product roadmap and coordinate with key partners to manage product delivery and implementation timelines
  • Partner with other Digital Product Managers to ensure product dependencies and integration points are considered during roadmap and release planning
  • Establish product backlog priorities for release and sprint planning, considering new capabilities, minor enhancements, and defect fixes

Product Strategy

  • Proactively evaluate Guest experience strengths and pain points from all perspectives, to identify opportunities for new and/or improved experience delivery capabilities
  • Develop and frame up product recommendations with associated cost, value and experience analysis, to gain approval and funding for development
  • Collaborate and liaise with key business partners to establish product goals and objectives
  • Ensure product alignment with the holistic experience transformation vision
    Product Definition
  • Partner with the UXUI team to establish experience interactions and designs based on high level feature requirements
  • Drive detailed product Feature definition, including functional and non-functional requirements
  • Support product implementation across the domestic sites, capturing site specific functional requirements in partnership with on-site stakeholders

Product Delivery

  • Facilitate product backlog grooming with the Delivery scrum team
  • Define and document product user stories to enable technical design, development, and testing
  • Participate in scrum team Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily-stand ups, and retrospectives

Product Implementation and Support

  • Perform product validation throughout the development cycle, to ensure alignment with functional requirements.
  • Maintain close partnership with Business Transformation to ensure that product functionality aligns with Operational and Business capabilities.

  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.

  • Demonstrated analytical and technical skill set, with an ability to synthesize and analyze product-related data across an array of sources (e.g. Marketing, Consumer Insights, Industrial Engineering, etc.), to evaluate product effectiveness
  • Extremely strong communication and presentation skills, with an ability to influence senior leadership by developing and clearly framing up options, analysis and recommendations

    Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Experience with large scale transformation initiatives
  • Demonstrated ability to define and execute strategic initiatives

  • Defining a customer journey and digital product roadmap
  • Product backlog management, including Feature definition, requirements, prioritization and sprint planning
  • Close partnership with a Technology Delivery team
  • Stakeholder engagement and relationship building
  • Executive communication, with the ability to influence decision making
  • Excellent analytical, written and oral communication skills, and be able to explain complex concepts both concisely and simply;

About this job

Creates project estimates for Universal attractions, hotels, restaurants, and theme parks during design and construction phases. Manages large estimating scopes, supervises estimating resources, and ensures projects track to budget while collaborating with project teams on cost analysis and risk management.

Good fit if you have 7+ years of construction and estimating experience on themed entertainment, retail, hotel, or theme park projects and hold a bachelor's degree in construction management or engineering.

Full job description

This is an evergreen posting to express interest in upcoming opportunities. While there may not be an immediate ​opening at this time, applications submitted through this posting will be ​reviewed and ​considered as positions become available.

JOB SUMMARY:

Generates project estimates for all projects ranging from new attractions, retail, restaurants, and resort hotels to entirely new theme parks. Completes subsequent estimating activities as projects progress through design and construction, to compare to budget. Manages the estimating process for large scopes of work. Responsible for all components of the project to include Facility, Show, Ride, Soft Costs and other project costs.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborates on project estimates for projects including estimate refinements prepared by the individual project estimators or outside estimating firms. Reviews continually evolving design documents and estimates to ensure the projects are tracking on budget.
  • Assists project team with contractor and vendor change order negotiation.
  • Performs function of lead estimator for large scopes of work, which requires supervision of in-house or contracted estimating resources, as scope of work indicates. 
  • Develops RFP cost breakdowns for Facility, Show and Ride bids. Works with project team to establish bid alternates. Provides post-bid cost analysis and award recommendation.
  • Works with project team to identify project trends/risks and provides estimated values. Leads the management of risk throughout project lifecycles.
  • Works with Finance to establish proper budget breakdown and associated budget codes for management and reporting.
  • Works with project team to establish work package/buyout plan.
  • Prepares budget estimate summaries and presents to Senior Leadership.
  • Participates in Contractor subcontractor buy-out process, providing owner representation/oversight.
  • Researches market conditions for cost trends and local means and methods (both locally and internationally). Develops location cost factors and escalation factors.  Analyzes Universal Creative historical costs and disseminates to appropriate year and location.  Incorporates current and historic costs into a central database. Develops comparisons for various attractions and non-attraction facilities.
  • Creates “value engineering” (VE) components with the project team to mitigate cost overruns.
  • Identifies, tracks and records key project metrics for input into UC historical database.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Individual must be capable of presenting cost estimates to upper management positions and third-party clients, including the Executive Project Director, Senior Vice President of Attraction Development, and the President of Universal Creative.

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineer in related business fields is required.  Master’s degree in Construction Management or Business Administration preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

7+ years’ on-site construction and estimating experience on retail, food, hotel, theme parks and themed entertainment projects, knowledge of show and ride estimating, and facility impacts required. 10+ years’ on-site construction and estimating experience for owners and/or contractors for in the Resort/Entertainment field of commercial construction; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Manager, Lead Architect (Commerce Experience Preferred)
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Sr. Manager, Lead Architect – Commerce is a technology leadership role responsible for providing architectural vision, technical leadership, and team leadership across Universal Destinations & Experiences’ global commerce platforms and global architecture teams. This individual leads a team of architects responsible for the design, modernization, and governance of solutions supporting digital commerce, payments, ticketing, reservations, loyalty, and related revenue-generating capabilities that enable exceptional guest and team member experiences.

This role is accountable for ensuring solution architectures align with enterprise standards, business objectives, and technology roadmaps while driving scalability, security, resiliency, and operational excellence. The position partners closely with business, product, engineering, operations, and technology leaders to deliver strategic initiatives, guide platform investments, and advance the evolution of Universal’s commerce ecosystem through modern architecture practices and industry-leading solutions.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Commerce Architecture Strategy - Lead the architecture strategy, roadmap development, and solution design for Universal Destinations & Experiences’ global commerce platforms. Provide architectural leadership across digital commerce (b2c and b2b). Ensure technology investments align with business objectives, enterprise architecture standards, and long-term platform modernization strategies. Serve as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders on architecture decisions, technology direction, and emerging industry trends.
  • Architecture Delivery & Governance - Oversee the development and governance of solution architecture deliverables supporting commerce initiatives. Ensure architecture designs are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with enterprise standards, design patterns, and technology roadmaps. Provide technical oversight for complex integrations across commerce, finance, guest experience, and operational systems. Establish and maintain architecture metrics, standards, and review processes to drive consistency and quality across solutions.
  • Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Data, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver integrated technology solutions. Facilitate alignment between architecture teams and key stakeholders to ensure solutions support both business and technical objectives. Lead architecture discussions, technology evaluations, and strategic planning efforts across multiple initiatives and value streams. Act as a subject matter expert for commerce and transaction-processing ecosystems.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development - Lead, mentor, and develop a team of solution and application architects responsible for supporting commerce capabilities. Provide guidance on architecture best practices, decision-making, prioritization, and professional development. Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement while ensuring effective communication across teams. Drive team performance through coaching, succession planning, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Broad technical knowledge with demonstrated success designing and implementing complex enterprise solutions in large-scale organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate technology strategy and architecture direction.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, solution architecture, and software delivery methodologies.
  • Ability to influence technical and business stakeholders across multiple organizational levels.
  • Deep understanding of digital commerce, payments, order management, loyalty, ticketing, and reservations platforms.
  • Knowledge of commerce platforms such as SAP Commerce Cloud and related commerce ecosystems required.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise integration patterns including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and distributed systems.
  • Experience designing highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient customer-facing transaction platforms.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, SaaS platforms, microservices, and modern application design patterns.
  • Knowledge of relational and NoSQL database technologies and data integration principles.
  • Ability to develop architecture roadmaps, technology standards, and governance processes that align with business objectives.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex business and technical challenges.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership and technical teams.
  • Ability to lead, mentor, and develop architects while fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and work effectively across Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Finance, Operations, and business organizations.
  • Knowledge of payment processing, PCI compliance, and transaction management concepts preferred.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical discipline preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 9+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, solution architecture, or platform architecture roles.
  • 9+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale commerce, customer experience, or transaction-processing solutions.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing architects, engineers, or other technical professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience developing architecture strategies, technology roadmaps, and solution designs for complex, highly integrated enterprise environments.
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions supporting digital commerce, payments, order management, ticketing, reservations, loyalty, customer identity, or related business capabilities.
  • Experience leading architecture efforts across cloud-native, SaaS, and hybrid technology environments.
  • Experience with enterprise integration patterns including APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and distributed systems.
  • Experience presenting technical strategies, architecture recommendations, and investment decisions to executive leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Experience establishing architecture governance processes, standards, and best practices across multiple teams and initiatives.
  • Experience supporting large-scale, customer-facing platforms requiring high availability, scalability, security, and operational resilience.
  • Experience with SAP Commerce Cloud, or comparable enterprise commerce platforms required.
  • Experience in hospitality, travel, entertainment, retail, theme park, destination, or other high-volume guest-facing industries preferred.
  • Experience supporting omni-channel commerce ecosystems integrating digital commerce, payments, loyalty, and customer engagement platforms preferred.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for developing, establishing, and integrating comprehensive project plans and schedules throughout the project’s lifecycle. Responsible for initiating, integrating, monitoring and statusing internal and/or external project schedules into a comprehensive program or integrated project master schedule. This includes providing project controls advisements and progress analysis for senior management decision making as well as tracking current and future resources and production progress based on the Integrated Master Schedule. Scope of planning and scheduling responsibilities include development/establishment of project schedules, show/ride concept development, show, ride, facility, area development designs, building construction, show/ride production, installation, and commissioning stages.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prepares project life cycle and project master schedules and statuses the project schedules utilizing Primavera software. Develops comprehensive plans and schedules from multiple discipline drawings and specifications. Prepares project plans and works with scoping/strategy documents to develop integrated project master schedules. Prepares schedule contract milestones for bid packages.
  • Provides project team with Schedule guidance during all phases of the project. Coordinates with estimating/finance teams to develop appropriate level of detail scope definition and durations for schedule activities to support project monitoring and project controls reporting needs. Coordinates with contractors, vendors, and responsible project team members to develop and integrate activity durations and logic sequences required to perform project work. Integrates project schedule input from all internal and external project organizations.
  • Leads planning and coordination meetings as required to support planning and monitoring functions. Collects/reports progress, evaluates progress variances, develops work-around plans, and coordinates resolution of variances. Conducts resource loading/resource analysis and develops and statuses earned value tracking tools and progress curves as required. Produces reports as required to support project team and leadership reporting. Frequently communicates, reports, and interacts with project and core team members including vendors and outside consultants on complex topics.
  • Contributes to highly effective project control tools and reports and provides insightful analysis that contributes to schedule certainty.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • Proven prior project controls leadership, supervisory experience preferred
  • Solid working knowledge of theme parks, show/ride product lines and design and construction.
  • 5+ years of primavera scheduling experience required
  • Possess strong understanding of design and construction progress measurement.
  • Working knowledge of architectural/engineering and show and ride design and production.
  • Must be a well-organized self-starter with strong communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Solid understanding of practical project controls applications and earned value measurement.
  • Ability to coordinate staff, consultants, and suppliers including setting goals, prioritization of tasks, coordinating work, and managing time.
  • Solid meeting leadership, facilitation, and alignment skills
  • Solid communication, collaboration, technical writing, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to successfully influence and guide a team.
  • Ability to negotiate schedule changes with vendors and contractors.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills
  • Knowledge of planning techniques

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or an applicable field required. Advanced degrees preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

7+ years engineering/construction planning and scheduling experience required. 5+ years theme park planning/coordination experience preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobTitle: Project Engineer (Show Engineering) - 2 Year Project Role
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Support the development of project scopes, schedules, and budgets while managing multiple vendors and providing technical leadership. Establish effective project management practices, guide design decisions, and ensure timely delivery of project milestones. Collaborate with the Manager, Project Engineering to manage changes and resolve challenges among stakeholders, while also participating in verification and validation testing. Provide technical solutions across diverse UDX venues and advise stakeholders on best practices and compliance with UDX standards and specifications.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • The Project Engineer leads the full lifecycle of venue systems—including design, production, fabrication, installation, focus, programming, commissioning, and turnover—while providing technical leadership and mentorship to the project team. They oversee scopes, schedules, and budgets, foster collaboration across departments, and work closely with the Manager, Project Engineering to develop documentation and schedules for both Capital and Expense Programs. Responsibilities also include supporting contractual documentation such as Scopes of Work (SOW), RFIs, RFPs, and specifications, and delivering clear, concise updates and presentations to senior leadership and stakeholders at all levels. This role requires strong communication skills, adherence to GAP policies and procedures, and support for system training and documentation improvements across platforms like SharePoint, MAXIMO, and PMWeb.
  • Oversees contractor’s mock-up, prototype, and acceptance testing efforts to ensure final installed systems meet scope of work and contract specifications. Review all improvements to insure they follow all applicable codes, regulations and standards including ISO, IEC, AISC, ASME, ASTM, ANSI, AWS, NEC, OSHA, NFPA, F24 and IEEE standards.
  • Support Subject Matter Experts in multiple disciplines for mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic or control systems. Support the development and review FMEAs and Safety Risk Assessments for new and existing Venues and Scope of Work for contracts and projects.
  • Review designs and documentation from vendors/contractors ensuring compliance with contractual requirements and specifications.
  • Develop and conduct Acceptance Test Procedures for Venues.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in applicable technical field required
  • Advanced degree is preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years’ of experience in direct theme park specific technical/engineering roles required or similar experience in related technical field
  • Significant vendor management experience
  • 3+ years of projects experience within the entertainment/theme park industry required
  • Experience in Theme park development, construction, show and ride systems design or fabrication is preferred
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

About this job

Strategic communications leader responsible for developing and executing enterprise-wide internal communications plans, content strategy, and messaging that align with business priorities. Supervises a small team and partners with senior leadership to shape company perception as an Employer of Choice.

Good fit if you have experience developing communications plans with measurable results, managing content across multiple channels, and leading small teams.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Manager, Communications is a strategic leader responsible for developing and executing communications strategies that align with business priorities and advance understanding of the company’s ambition and growth strategy. This role is key to shaping the perception of the company as an Employer of Choice, developing and writing key internal communications and content, including executive communications, while also aggregating UDX content from various Destinations, Divisions, Business Segments and Global Functions, ensuring brand, voice, and IP standards are represented accurately.

Partnering closely with the Senior Director, the Senior Manager will develop high-impact enterprise-wide communications plans and content that have clearly stated objectives and outcomes; craft narratives and key messages; support executive-level communications including town hall presentations, talking points and scripts, videos and organizational updates; create editorial calendars spanning internal communications channels and forums.

The Senior Manager supervises and coaches a small team, emphasizing development, accountability and high performance. This highly visible role requires strong relationship-building skills, sound judgment and the ability to influence others through a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Communication Planning
    • Develop and implement communication objectives and plans, inclusive of strategies and tactics, that support enterprise priorities and initiatives, ensuring alignment with UDX focus areas and messaging.
    • Partner with senior leadership and key stakeholders to craft clear, engaging and effective communication content and messaging that resonates with various employee audiences.
    • Continuously measure and assess the impact of communication initiatives, using insights to refine strategies and improve effectiveness.
    • Identify opportunities and benchmark best practices to expand the reach and resonance of communication channels.
  • Editorial Content Strategy and Channel Oversight
    • Oversees and manages the production of enterprise-wide publications (digital or print), email, digital, video, social and web platform/Intranet and print content. Reviews and edits content, ensuring messaging is clear, balanced, engaging, consistent and effective. Provides timely and constructive feedback to content producers. Manages outside vendors, as appropriate and ensures delivery of aligned scopes of work.
    • Partners with other business groups to ensure Team Member focused content aligns and supports overall plans and strategy. Ensures brand, voice, and IP standards are represented accurately.
    • Drive implementation and alignment of enterprise editorial content strategy and own internal-facing editorial content calendar to deliver consistent, high-quality messaging across internal channels, that also enhances and amplifies enterprise-wide content.
    • Have proven experience supporting senior level executives at internal events, including preparing messaging, briefing books, related content.
  • Culture Building, Storytelling and Engagement and Events
    • Identify, source and create compelling content that tells the company’s story, showcases key initiatives and amplifies employee voices.
    • Engage with employees at all levels to uncover impactful narratives that enhance internal brand awareness and foster a sense of community.
    • Work closely with other Communications teams, Talent & Culture, executive leadership, and other departments to ensure a cohesive and compelling internal storytelling approach.
    • Generates editorial programming that tells our powerful Team Member stories to inspire our internal audience and build affinity with our external audience.
    • Support the planning and execution of internal events, town halls and leadership roadshows to enhance employee engagement and alignment.
    • Collaborate with senior leaders to ensure their messages are delivered effectively, using the right channels and formats to reach employees.
    • Manage logistics, content development and post-event engagement strategies to maximize impact.
  • Client Partnerships and Team Leadership
    • Fosters effective relationships with our key client groups and divisional partners. Leads cross-functional task forces, as identified, that serve to collectively elevate company communication initiatives. Identifies opportunities for enhanced collaboration with divisional partners.
    • Provides leadership, support, coaching and development of direct reports and functional subject matter experts ensuring that they have the development and skills necessary to provide a consistent delivery of performance.
  • Measurement & Analysis
    • Establish KPIs for associated efforts and monitor communications effectiveness to constantly improve impact.
    • Evaluates and monitors data (email, social media, web platforms; survey results, etc.) and develops action plans to address the analysis. Identify opportunities to increase the capture of metrics to further enhance the analysis of the impact of our messaging.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Proven ability to use research and insights to plan, develop, execute and evaluate communications plans in support of company initiatives. Works collaboratively across functions, divisions and locations.
  • Experience with high impact communications, both internal and externally focused, that have generated measurable results. Must have entrepreneurial spirit and execute within a corporate environment.
  • Demonstrate a proven ability to engage senior leaders and deliver measurable results through strong team engagement, development and retention.
  • Competence in dealing with sensitive or controversial matters on a frequent and recurring basis and ability to effectively apply issues and crisis management skills to mitigate risk and organizational impact.
  • Ability to be nimble and adapt, demonstrating effectiveness at handling multiple concurrent, often conflicting priorities.
  • Proven aptitude for quick creative thinking with acute attention to detail within demanding deadlines.
  • Ability to produce content aligned to storytelling strategies and effectively measure its performance.

Maintain and repair all plumbing systems at Universal Orlando, including potable water, natural gas, steam, fire protection, and sanitary infrastructure. Requires minimum 3 years industrial or commercial plumbing experience and a valid Florida Driver's License.

Good fit if you have 3+ years industrial or commercial plumbing experience and a valid Florida Driver's License.

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for performing the skilled, discipline specific tasks required to ensure the smooth operation of Universal Orlando Facilities as it pertains to all industrial, commercial and non-commercial plumbing equipment, utilities and infrastructure.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain, service and repair all UO plumbing systems, including, but not limited to: water closets; urinals; sinks; faucets; drinking fountains; and all associated piping by complying with all NSF, ADA, and State Plumbing codes and regulations. Perform all plumbing utility locates and/or leak detection using the appropriate method.
  • Maintain, service and repair all UO infrastructure, including, but not limited to: sanitary lines; grease lines; oil lines; grease traps; lift stations; and interceptors. Operate large cable commercial sewer machines and high-pressure line jetting equipment.
  • Maintain, service and repair all potable water systems as it pertains to UO Facilities, including, but not limited to: water softeners; water heaters; steam effect boilers; potable backflow preventers; circulating pumps; tempering valves; mixing valves; high pressure fog/mist lines; nozzles and pumps; and all related potable infrastructure.
  • Assist and support Plumbing Tech I’s with the service and repair of UO natural gas systems, including, but not limited to: all above ground and below ground pipes; valves; and fittings. Perform all leak and cathodic protection surveys. Locate underground gas piping using line locate equipment as needed and/or mandated by the Public Service Commission. Utilize appropriate leak detection equipment to identify and locate underground gas leaks.
  • Assist and support Plumbing Tech I’s with the service and repair of all high-pressure steam boilers and piping. Perform daily water conductivity tests on boiler feed water. Maintain all flame, water, natural gas and pressure controls as well as all other safety devices. Maintain, service and repair all makeup water feed pumps and associated piping. Support annual state inspections on fireside as well as perform wet side boiler inspections.
  • Assist and support Plumbing Tech I’s with the service and repair of all water based fire protection systems, including, but not limited to: all fire hydrants; fire sprinkler systems; fire pumps; industrial backflow preventers; and all related fire infrastructure.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

SCOPE:

Maintain, service, troubleshoot, repair and operate all commercial and industrial plumbing systems to ensure the continuous smooth operation of Universal Orlando. Including, but not limited to: potable water, industrial water, natural gas, sanitary, storm, grease, high pressure steam and fire protection systems; compressed air piping; and chilled water piping. Maintain all facility plumbing in accordance to all applicable codes, standards, and UO specifications.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree or GED is required
  • Technical school is preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in industrial and commercial construction, maintenance facility or a fast paced service company dedicated to plumbing repair is required
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • A valid Florida Driver’s License is required to operate company vehicles
  • A Certification of Training issued by either a State Regulatory Agency or construction trade school is preferred
  • A valid Journeyman Plumbing License is preferred

Full job description

Job Summary:

The Auditor, Qualitative Research will complete field assignments at various locations where they engage in conversations and observations while posing as authentic guests. The auditor will observe ticket sales, in-park operations, and other experiences as they occur using direct participation and observation to gather information. Auditors are responsible for taking notes during interactions, documenting what they experience and observe, and writing detailed reports that clearly explain what happened so someone who was not there can understand the experience. This role requires strong communication and observation skills, attention to detail, the ability to work independently in the field, and a willingness to receive and apply ongoing coaching and feedback.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Conduct covert visits to assigned locations, posing as customers or potential customers to evaluate knowledge, quality, customer service, cleanliness, and overall experience.
  • Discreetly record shorthand notes and observations of locations and interactions without breaking character and alerting others that you are conducting an auditing report.
  • Provide detailed, in-the-moment written reports on all assigned locations/criteria, including photo and video documentation as assigned. Log and submit mileage expense reports and retain and submit accurate itemized receipts.
  • Conduct fixed counts/observations of guest behaviors, interactions, or other observable phenomenon. Conduct brief, semi-structured interviews to collect data on topics of interest.
  • Attend and participate in mandatory in-person quarterly training and learning workshops.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

High school degree or GED is required.

1+ Year: clerical, customer service, data entry, computer experience preferred. Mystery Shop experience a plus; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Manage product strategy and delivery for guest and team member digital experiences across Universal's mobile, web, and enterprise applications. This is a two-year assignment focused on the full product lifecycle from strategy through implementation.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Global Product team is focused on driving product strategies to evolve and enhance the Guest & Team Member experience across Universal Destinations & Experiences. As a Manager, Digital Product Owner, the primary function of this role will be to manage new capabilities across the entire product lifecycle, from product strategy, planning, definition, delivery, and implementation. The specific focus for this role will be product management for the onsite Guest and Team Member experience, Mobile, Web or Enterprise Applications.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Product Definition

  • Partner with the UXUI team to establish experience interactions and designs based on high level
    feature requirements.
  • Drive detailed product Feature definition, including functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Support product implementation across the Global sites, capturing global and local site specific
    functional requirements in partnership with stakeholders.

Product Delivery

  • Facilitate product backlog grooming with Systems Integrators and or Delivery scrum teams.
  • Define and document product user stories to enable technical design, development, and testing.
  • Participate in scrum team Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily-stand ups, andretrospectives.

Product Implementation and Support

  • Perform product validation throughout the development cycle, to ensure alignment with
    functional requirements.
  • Maintain close partnership with Business Transformation to ensure that product functionality
    aligns with Operational and Business capabilities.
  • Represent and support the product as the ongoing subject matter expert.
  • Develop an ongoing approach for measuring the success of newly implemented experience enhancements, to enable well-informed future product planning.

Product Planning

  • Establish the product roadmap and coordinate with key partners to manage product delivery and
    implementation timelines.
  • Partner with other Digital Product Managers to ensure product dependencies and integration
    points are considered during roadmap and release planning.
  • Establish product backlog priorities for release and sprint planning, considering new capabilities,
    minor enhancements, and defect fixes.

Product Strategy

  • Proactively evaluate Team Member and Guest experience strengths and pain points from all
    perspectives, to identify opportunities for new and/or improved experience delivery capabilities.
  • Develop and frame up product recommendations with associated cost, value and experience
    analysis, to gain approval and funding for development.

    preferred; Master’s degree preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

    and operational Enterprise applications
  • Managing the digital experience for a consumer website and/or mobile app and/or enterprise app
  • Experience with large scale transformation initiatives.

Responsible for executing advanced, discipline-specific tasks necessary to maintain and optimize the operation of Universal Orlando Facilities. This includes comprehensive diagnostics, repair, and maintenance of industrial, commercial, and non-commercial HVAC and refrigeration systems. Duties encompass troubleshooting complex mechanical and control issues, performing precision calibrations, conducting system performance assessments, and ensuring compliance with all relevant safety and operational standards.

About this job

Controls Engineer II redesigns and develops show and ride control systems for theme park attractions at Universal Studios Orlando. Role focuses on reliability improvements, troubleshooting, fault analysis, and mentoring junior engineers while ensuring compliance with ASTM F24 and industry standards.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of PLC and control systems experience in theme parks or equivalent engineering environment with safety-critical systems knowledge.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

Performs moderately complex re-design and development efforts of show and / or ride control and software systems for theme park rides and attractions to provide increased reliability and operational improvements. Will be required to support downtime recovery efforts when necessary. Duties include troubleshooting, fault analysis, redesign assignments, test and start-up integration of Ride and Show systems. All work shall be in conformance with ASTM F24 Committee guidelines and compliant with applicable codes, regulations and standards including: AISC, ASME, ASTM, ANSI, AWS, JIC, NEC, and OSHA, among others.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides and implements detailed design solutions ranging from moderate to complex in order to implement solutions focusing on the improvement of Ride & Show systems in the categories of operational reliability, safety, and serviceability of Ride & Show equipment. Places an emphasized focus on improving system diagnostics, technical training of Ride & Show and Engineering Team Members, and Preventative Maintenance improvement.
  • Troubleshoots electromechanical systems while conducting fault identification and failure analysis to facilitate downtime recovery during the day-to-day operations of UO parks while being the main liaison between Engineering and our partners in Ride and Show and Operations.
  • Utilizes project management skills to coordinate and document project status of assigned tasks to give regular and insightful updates to the appropriate attraction management, both operations and Ride & Show as well as Engineering Management. Maintains configuration management of controls hardware and software (drawings) documentation in accordance with Engineering’s guidelines and procedures for proper archiving and security.
  • Generates engineering documentation to validate design solutions to be implemented by the engineer including but not limited to control system hardware analysis, firmware analysis, code comparison documentation, change bulletins, CAD drawing changes, and training procedures. Generates Acceptance Test Procedures to validate all system design changes in accordance with UDX standards and procedures. Prepares and conducts maintenance training on controls equipment. Performs engineering calculations for design, analysis, test, and implementation of electrical and control systems.
  • Provides mentorship to early career controls engineers at the Associate and Engineer 1 levels.
  • Monitors and interfaces with vendors/ride manufacturers to resolve problems and design issues. Prepares and reviews equipment specifications and performs technical evaluation of vendor products/services.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Computer Engineering, or related field required
  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Computer Engineering, or related field preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of engineering experience in control systems and installation utilizing PLCs, ladder logic, variable frequency drives, servo controls and control fault analysis/isolation in a theme park; or 7+ years of engineering experience in control systems and installation utilizing PLCs, ladder logic, variable frequency drives, servo controls and control fault analysis/isolation in an equivalent engineering environment required
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Certification in Functional Safety from a recognized institution is preferred.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Knowledgeable in ASTM and F24 standards
  • Experience in the design of safety-critical systems utilizing ISO 12100, ISO 13849, IEC 60204, and IEC 62061.
  • Experience with servo controls as applied to hydraulic, pneumatic, and electromotive motion control systems.
  • Knowledge of the generation of control system specifications, and acceptance test procedures.
  • "Hands-on" experience with PLC and automated control systems.
  • Experience with motor control centers, motor starters, and variable speed drives.
  • Experience working in diverse teams to accomplish a common goal.
  • Experience communicating effectively across varying skill sets and knowledge bases to define tasks and project status.
  • Experience keeping detailed records through a project lifecycle from initiation to completion.
  • Knowledge of a high-level programming language ("C", Visual Basic or JAVA).
  • Knowledge of electrical standards UL 508A, NFPA and NEC.
  • Experience utilizing the following products and networks.
  • Programmable Logic Controllers & Programming Software: Rockwell Automation, Siemens, Beckhoff, Omron and/or Pilz.
  • Variable Frequency Drives: Rockwell Automation, ABB, Siemens, and/or Schneider Electric
  • Human Machine Interfaces: Standalone HMIs (PanelView, SIMATIC, and/or Comfort Panel) and SCADA Systems (FactoryTalk View Studio Suite and Machine Edition, WinCC, ICONICS and/or Ignition)
  • Industrial Communication Networks: Ethernet I/P, EtherCAT, PROFINET, PROFIBUS, DeviceNet, ControlNet, Data Highway Plus, Remote I/O and/or MODBUS)
  • AC and DC motors and motor control systems.
  • Experience with troubleshooting and problem-solving of electrical, mechanical, and/or control systems.
  • Experience communicating and collaborating with diverse teams to complete complex tasks.
  • Analytical skills to perform engineering calculations for design, analysis, test, and implementation of electrical and control systems.
  • Proven ability to provide control system management.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Manager, Project Support - GAP facilitates the strategic global vision for departmental/project processes, compliance, training, and SOP documentation within the GAP division. This position provides integration, analytical, decision and communication support to drive alignment on behalf of the key stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. In addition to leading GAP’s strategic processes, the Senior Manager, Project Support - GAP leads stakeholder integration for all levels of Design, Development, and Delivery across all lines of business within Universal Destinations & Experiences (UDX) to deliver key metrics related to documentation for the delivery of capital projects.

Prepare Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and GOP across all project management processes. Assist the Director in development of the Long-Range Plans (LRP) for GAP by analyzing several data sources including IBE (Rockwell: Install, Base Evaluation), Maximo, Guest Experience & Analytics, GSAT, Quality Control Reports, PMWeb, etc. Manage the integration and data analysis the Venue Sustainability Evaluation (VSE). Partner with stakeholders to fulfill VSE requirements. Facilitate the establishment of venue baselines for Reliability, Operations, and critical component use rates in contribution to VSE activities. Facilitate training of internal/external stakeholders and teams regarding safety, documentation, processes, systems, and project management.

  • Build and develop process improvement tools to support the GAP organization, utilizing existing resources and identifying new resources for continuous improvement. Develop dashboards, schedules, and reporting platforms.
  • Facilitate comprehensive risk management plan, utilizing scalable planning methods in anticipation for project risks and opportunities.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.

Senior Director managing all aspects of major attraction project development at Universal Orlando, including design, construction, budgeting, scheduling, and team leadership. Oversees contractors, vendors, creative teams, and project staff to deliver guest experiences on budget and schedule.

Good fit if you have 15+ years managing major projects in hospitality, entertainment, or theme parks, plus a bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering, or construction management.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for directing and managing all aspects necessary for the development of Major Attraction Projects, including all planning, budgeting, scheduling, estimating, design, construction, fabrication, delivery, and commissioning required to open the attraction within the assigned budget, quality, schedule, creative and guest experience targets.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Construction/Fabrication/Implementation- Responsible for the prequalification, procurement, selection, contracting and performance of all Contractors, Vendors, Manufacturers, Fabricators, etc. required to complete the development of the new attraction. Insure that all project procedures are being followed as it relates to Correspondence, RFI’s, Directives, Shop Drawings, Submittals, Meeting Minutes, Punch Lists, Deficiency Lists, Notices, Pay Applications, etc. necessary to successfully implement the new attractions
  • Personnel Management- Responsible for the hiring and selection of the necessary project team members required to implement the project. Responsible for the performance of each of the project team individuals as it relates to the successful opening of the new attraction. Responsible for the development and growth of the project team.
  • Creative Development- Responsible for the management and development of the creative content done by the Creative team members or outside consultants. Responsible for the final delivery of a guest experience that meets the initial objectives set forth during project approval. Responsible for the prequalification, procurement, selection, contracting and performance of any and all designers and vendors contracted to develop creative concepts.
  • Design Management- Responsible for the prequalification, procurement, selection, contracting and performing of any and all Architectural, Engineering, Technical Designers and Creative Designers hired to complete the design phase of the attraction. Responsible for the successful completion of the design within the budget and schedule established for the project.

  • Project Reporting- Responsible for the management, tracking and reporting of all of the necessary project components inclusive of budget, schedule and progress of the project to upper management. Responsible to maintain accurate documentation necessary to insure a successful project completion within the targeted budget and schedule.

Typically supervises higher-level management.

SCOPE: 

Responsible for directing and managing all aspects necessary for the development of Major Attraction Projects. Major decision-making.

EDUCATION:  

Bachelor’s degree preferred in Architectural, Engineering or Construction Management.

EXPERIENCE: 

15+ Years: of experience in the development and management of major projects with hospitality/entertainment/theme park experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.  The planning horizon is three years.  Planning requires knowledge of in-depth division operating plan and understanding of overall Company goals.  Responsible for management of standard policies and procedures within a major function and may coordinate work processes across divisions.  Accountable for divisional key performance indicators (Annual Operating Plan, GSAT, TSAT.); or equivalent combination of education and experience.

JOB SUMMARY:

Maintain the original aesthetics and function of the animated figures, props, and sets within the Rides and Shows. The responsibilities will include cleaning, repairing, installing, and finishing/painting skins, shells, costumes, props, and set pieces as well as access into these assets for Ride and Show Mechanics. Knowledge of all techniques, materials, and tools involved in silicone skin repair, fiberglass repair and finishing, scenic painting, faux finishing, airbrushing, automotive painting, carpentry, sculpting, mold making, casting, fabrication, sewing, costuming, patterning, wig care, mechanical work, and problem solving will be utilized.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and install flexible and non-flexible skins, coverings (including costumes, wigs, fur, and feathers), and support structures for animated figures. This includes planning/preparing for work, cleaning, repairing, painting of silicone and fiberglass skins and shells, cleaning of work area, and documenting work. Mends or replaces costumes and other figure coverings. Painting processes to include properly assessing, mixing, and applying airbrush and/or faux paint techniques, automotive paint applications, as well as wet/dry brush and sponge painting
  • Maintain sets within Rides and Shows to include planning/preparing for work, cleaning, sculpting, construction, painting, cleaning of work area, and documenting work. Maintenance of show sets to include mending or replacing backdrops, curtains, scrims, and other set related soft materials. Painting techniques to include brushing, rolling, blending, spraying, and faux finishing techniques of show sets.
  • Maintain, fabricate, and install show props to include planning/preparing for work, cleaning, molding, casting, construction, finishing/painting, cleaning of work area, and documenting work.
  • Assist Ride and Show Maintenance with access into figures, props, and sets for their inspections and repairs to include mechanical disassembly and assembly of parts related to animated figures.
  • Maintain, fabricate, and install/embed fasteners and attachments for animated figures, sets, and props. This can include buckles, straps, zippers, snaps, stand-offs, tabs, and various inserts.
  • Inspect figures, sets, props, shop facilities, equipment, and tools for any wear/damage and document findings. Assist in show quality walk-throughs, assessing animated figures, show sets and props for necessary repairs and improvements.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree or GED is required
  • Associate’s degree is preferred - Visual Arts, Scenery Production, Technical Theater, Costuming or equivalent
  • Bachelor’s degree is preferred - Visual Arts, Scenery Production, Technical Theater, Costuming or equivalent

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years set/prop fabrication and maintenance with the finishing aspect of animated figures is required
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Valid Florida Driver’s License/ required to operate company vehicles

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

About this job

Repair and maintain fiberglass ride tracks, slides, and interactive figures at Universal Orlando using layup, gelcoat application, and painting techniques. Requires 5+ years of composite material experience and knowledge of spray and brush gelcoat application.

Good fit if you have 5+ years working with fiberglass composites, automotive bodywork or marine repair experience, and a valid Florida driver's license.

Full job description

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for fabricating, maintenance and repair for all fiberglass ride tracks to include structural, interior, exterior and top riding surface. This includes layup, repair, filling, fairing, gel coat application and restoration of fiberglass and gelcoat to ensure safe and operationally ready attractions. Repairs and maintenance also conducted on fiberglass interactive figures and props using both automotive and waterbase paints. This position is detailed orientated and involves crafting, cutting, trimming, sanding, assembly, planning and time management. Knowledge of techniques, materials, and tools involved in repairs as well as tool maintenance and care is imperative. Depending on location, operation or usage of a high reach may be required.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs structural and cosmetic fiberglass repairs to slides and ride tracks which may include direction of Management, Quality Control and Engineering. Suggests optional procedures for repairs on new and damaged parts and implements changes as needed or directed.
  • Performs gel coating on slides, riding surfaces and ride tracks to include spray and brush techniques, color matching, fading and blending to achieve the desired appearance and quality, which may include direction of Management, Engineering and Quality Control.
  • Responds to, plans and assists in recovery and repair of attraction fiberglass/gelcoat surfaces of water attractions slides to ensure operational readiness. Partner with other departments to ensure repairs fulfill required specification and successfully completed based on current weather conditions, accessibility and allotted time
  • Maintain interactive figures, tap stations, props and scales to include, planning/preparing for work, cleaning, repairing, painting, and cleaning work area. Assist Ride and Show Maintenance with access into figures, props and tap stations for their inspections and repairs to include mechanical disassembly and assembly of parts. Maintain, fabricate and install fasteners and attachments for animated figures, tap stations, and props. This can include buckles, straps, zippers, snaps, stand-offs, tabs and various inserts.
  • Completes inspections on slides, ride tracks, figures, tap stations and props for any wear/damage and document and communicate findings through Maximo and counterparts, such as Ride and Show Technicians and Quality Control.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree or GED is required
  • Technical school is preferred
  • Other: Previous training in automotive bodywork, marine or aerospace industries is essential

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years: Structural lay up of composite matting materials, as well as, grinding and prep for repairs of finished products required
  • Additional experience of properly preparing indications and feathering composite materials to ensure all affected areas of discrepancies have been removed
  • Knowledge of spraying and brushing gel coatings is required
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Valid Florida Drivers License/Required to operate company vehicles

Job.JobTitle: Part-Time Cafeteria Assistant at Buffalo Ridge
Job.JobDescription:
The Villages Charter School (VCS) opened in August 2000 and is one of the most successful public charter schools in Florida. In fact, VCS has been a "High Performing Charter School", earned a "School of Excellence" and has received 23 straight "A" ratings from the Florida Department of Education! Recently, VCS earned the “Cognia School and Systems of Distinction” from the international accreditation group Cognia.

The Villages Charter School spans two campuses.  Our Buffalo Ridge campus has three elementary attendance centers and one middle school building. Our newest campus, “Middleton”, opened in August 2023 with a K-8 center and a state-of-the-art high school complex.

VCS currently serves over 4100 students, kindergarten through 12th grades with an overall capacity of 6500 (500 students per grade level) across both campuses.

The Villages Charter School offers a world-class comprehensive K-12 curriculum and state-of-the-art facilities taught by an instructional staff second to none. 

We invite you to look over our school website (www.tvcs.org) to learn more and we welcome you to apply to join our incredible team.

DESCRIPTION:

The Villages Charter School is accepting applications for a Part-Time Food Service Assistant at the Buffalo Ridge campus.

SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position will be expected to prepare, serve, season and cook meats, vegetables, desserts and other foods along with assisting the Kitchen Manager with other duties and tasks associated with the daily food service operations.

 ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

The expectations include the following and other duties as assigned:

  • Daily preparation, to include washing, cutting, stirring, straining and maintain regulated food temperatures.
  • Carry pans and trays of food to and from work stations, service line, stove, refrigerator and sinks.
  • Cook, store, organize, set up, restock and efficiently serve food.
  • Loading food and supplies for transportation and drive to and from cafeteria locations as needed.

Job.JobTitle: Full-Time Behavior Technician at the Autism Center
Job.JobDescription:
The Villages Charter School Autism Center is dedicated to meeting the educational needs of students on the autism spectrum. The center supports students’ academic, social, and emotional development through a combination of individualized instruction, specialized programs, and targeted therapies provided by our highly trained staff. Through incorporating principles of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), students will receive the support they need in a nurturing educational environment focused on individualized learning and growth.

The Villages Charter School Autism Center, LLC (TVCS AC) is a subsidiary of The Villages Charter School, Inc., which operates by a charter agreement approved by the Sumter County Board of Education and the Florida State Department of Education. Both The Villages Charter School (“VCS”) and The Villages Charter School Autism Center, LLC (TVCS AC) are Charter in the Workplace schools (see also School of Choice). Unlike traditional county schools, our enrollment criteria are based upon the place of employment of one of the parents/guardians rather than the geographic address of their home. It was founded and is provided funding by The Villages of Lake-Sumter, Inc. as a business partnership charter school primarily for the benefit of the children of employees of The Villages of Lake-Sumter, Inc. and those Business Partners who have in the past and continue to participate in the development of The Villages.

The Autism Center is located on the Buffalo Ridge campus, serving K-7 students, offering a comprehensive support system tailored to each child’s unique needs through a collaborative approach involving special educators, therapists, behavioral specialists, and families.

DESCRIPTION:

The Villages Charter School Autism Center is seeking multiple Behavior Technician (BT) candidates to function as a first line of behavioral and social/emotional support to students with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). 

SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Behavior Technician (BT) is responsible for supporting the classroom staff with implementation of ABA-based behavioral interventions. The BT is responsible for assisting the teacher(s) and/or other school personnel by performing assigned tasks in the classroom and during wrap-around services. The goal is to provide a quality educational program for students within a specialized school setting.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

The list of essential functions as outlined herein, is intended to be representative of the tasks performed within this position and not necessarily descriptive of any one position. The omission of an essential function does not preclude management from assigning duties not listed herein if such functions are a logical assignment to the position.

The expectations include the following:

  • Uphold and model TVCS Autism Center Core Values
  • Understand and apply basic principles of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) in classroom settings as directed by the ESE team.
  • Support with implementation of instructional strategies and social skills curriculums as set forth by the ESE team.
  • Collect and record student data for behavior intervention monitoring (per student individual Behavior Intervention Plan (BIP) to submit to the Behavior Analyst.
  • Direct implementation of behavior reduction/social skill interventions outlined on the students BIP or as recommended by the Behavior Analyst (can be 1:1, small group setting, etc.).
  • Assist staff in the supervision of students (this may involve during 1:1 instruction, escorts for transitions, provide approved crisis management strategies, etc.).
  • Assist with students’ self-care/hygiene needs (included, but not limited to changing diapers; toilet training; feeding; dressing; hand washing).
  • Maintain accurate and complete records of students' skill activities and behavioral data, which may require the use of a computer to enter and graph student data, complete visuals, create schedules, and/or pull reports.
  • Ability to use current technology to perform job functions and participate in training programs offered to increase skill level and best practice techniques. 
  • Ability to approach situations with optimism and perseverance.
  • Ability to communicate with parents, co-workers and professional contacts in a courteous and professional manner while following TVCS AC guidelines.
  • Ability to exercise reasonable judgment and maintain confidentiality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of High school diploma or GED required.
  • At least 1 year of direct experience with children/adolescents with behavioral needs.
  • Familiarity with Autism and Applied Behavior Analysis is preferred
  • Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and work collaboratively as a team member.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to manipulate objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms, and talk and hear. The employee may be required to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds with assistance. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Noise level in the work environment is moderate.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Work is routinely performed in an indoor and outdoor classroom setting.

TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT:

197 days – Non-Exempt. Length of the work year and hours of employment are those established by the Board. Additional days may be available for work during Fall, Winter, Spring, and Summer camps. 

All prospective employees will be required to be fingerprinted through the Clearinghouse, instructions provided when hired. If you have questions regarding the Clearinghouse, please see https://info.flclearinghouse.com/. 

EVALUATION:

Performance of this job will be evaluated in accordance with provisions of TVCS AC policy on evaluations of personnel.

Engine Service Associate performs maintenance and repair on gas and electric golf cars at The Villages in Florida. The role includes diagnosing engine problems, replacing parts, reassembling engines, and providing customer service.

Good fit if you have a high school diploma or GED, can perform mechanical repairs, and work well with customers.

Full job description

 Within the spirit of “Making People’s Dreams Come True”, this position is responsible for performing engine service on gas and electric golf cars. These duties are accomplished while delivering Raving Fans customer service to both internal and external customers.
