Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

As an Associate Analyst in AI Security Engineering, you will support the secure development, deployment, and operation of AI/ML and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions. You will assist with security testing, control implementation, monitoring, and documentation under the guidance of more senior team members. This role focuses on building foundational skills in cybersecurity, software engineering, and AI security while contributing to high-visibility initiatives and learning to identify and mitigate AI-specific risks.

Work you'll do

As an Associate Analyst on the AI Security Engineering team, you will be responsible for:

  • Support the implementation and testing of security controls for AI/ML and GenAI applications under the direction of senior team members
  • Conduct vulnerability scans, code scans, and adversarial testing, including prompt injection and data leakage checks, and document findings
  • Monitor AI security tooling, logs, and alerts; triage routine issues; and escalate potential incidents or risks to appropriate team members
  • Support the integration of security checks into continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD), development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), and machine learning operations (MLOps) pipelines using established patterns and scripts
  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, control evidence, and status reporting; follow established policies and procedures for AI security, data protection, and access control
  • Participate in team meetings and working sessions, seek feedback, and build secure coding, cloud security, and AI/ML knowledge through training and on-the-job experience

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Cyber Security vigilantly protects Deloitte and client data. The team leads a strategic cyber risk program that adapts to a rapidly changing threat landscape, changes in business strategies, risks, and vulnerabilities. Using situational awareness, threat intelligence, and building a security culture across the organization, the team helps to protect the Deloitte brand. 

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in addressing cybersecurity principles (confidentiality, integrity, availability, access control, and encryption) and artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI (GenAI) security risks, including prompt injection and data exposure and programming or scripting in Python or JavaScript.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Candidates must be at least 18 years of age at the time of employment.

Preferred:

  • CompTIA Security+ certification or Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) fundamentals or associate-level certification
  • Experience using AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Experience with version control, continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD), development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), or machine learning operations (MLOps) tools

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/2/2026.

Work You’ll Do

As a Project - Consultant, Controllership on the Specialized Finance Solutions team, you will be responsible for:

  • Support accounting operations for the U.S. Department of the Interior (DOI), including property, plant, and equipment (PP&E); leases; accounts payable; accounts receivable; reimbursable agreements; and Intragovernmental Payment and Collection (IPAC) transactions.
  • Prepare and support monthly financial reporting deliverables.

  • Reconcile accounting data and maintain documentation that supports reporting and operational processes.
  • Coordinate assigned tasks, monitor deadlines, and communicate status, issues, and deliverables with engagement and client stakeholders.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to support the evolving business objectives of the organization. We work with the CFO, CAO, controller, and treasurer to develop an efficient, high quality, data-driven, tech-enabled controllership and treasury function that empowers our clients to drive more value to their business partners and to their investors.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Manager leading healthcare revenue cycle transformation engagements for Deloitte's consulting practice. Design operating models, process improvements, and growth strategies while managing client relationships and collaborating with software, data, and AI experts.

Good fit if you have 6+ years of revenue cycle operations experience, 5+ years designing optimized solutions, and can travel 50% for client work.

Full job description

Position Summary

Position Summary

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 2, 2026.

Work you'll do

As a Manager, Industry Solutions, Healthcare – Revenue Cycle on the Healthcare Solutions team, you will be responsible for...

  • Leading and delivering small engagements or components of large, complex engagements for healthcare clients focused on revenue cycle transformation.
  • Designing operating models, process improvements, competitor benchmarking, cost transformation, customer/product innovation, and growth strategy recommendations.
  • Managing day-to-day client stakeholder relationships and overseeing quality of deliverables, combining direct management with hands-on delivery.
  • Contributing to Deloitte thought leadership and business development (e.g., proposals, solution design) and leading development of junior team members.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional experts in software, data, AI, and cloud to design sector-specific solutions that drive measurable impact.

The team

Our Industry Solutions offering provides verticalized solutions that transform how clients sell products, deliver services, generate growth, and execute mission-critical operations. We deliver integrated business expertise with scalable, repeatable technology solutions specifically engineered for each sector.

Deloitte’s Healthcare Consulting practice is one of the largest in the world. Our practice delivers distinctive services to the country’s largest national and regional health plans, 10 of the 10 largest healthcare systems and 8 of the 10 largest for-profit healthcare systems in the US. Our healthcare practice seeks to transform the delivery of care, modernize the industry and enhance our clients’ business and operational models.

Many Providers have felt the heavy impact of various government regulations and have experienced a period of decreasing margins and increasing emphasis on cost controls. Our healthcare professionals enable health care providers (from physicians to integrated delivery systems) to improve the cost effectiveness and quality of their care delivery capabilities. Deloitte Consulting can help clients address these and other challenges in today's complex health care environment.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in revenue cycle operations within a healthcare provider, consulting, or technology vendor environment.
  • 5+ years of experience translating requirements into optimized designs, including identification of design alternatives and implications on functionality, effort, performance, and operations.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft PowerPoint.
  • 4+ years of experience leading workstreams and/or small teams within the context of a larger project.
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience in one or more of the following revenue cycle functions: Patient Access, Coding, Revenue Integrity, HIM, Charge Integrity, Patient Financial Services.
  • Proficiency and experience with financial, billing, and reimbursement data.
  • Working knowledge of the UB-04, MA claim form, HCFA-1500, claim form and claim scrubber.
  • Experience with hospital and physician financial and patient accounting systems, such as Epic, Cerner, Soarian, SMS, McKesson, Invision, HBOC, MEDITECH, IDX, and Eclipsys.
  • Experience with tools that enable gathering insights through advanced analytics (Python, Tableau, etc.) and querying language (SQL).
  • Basic understanding of automation and machine learning techniques as it applies to healthcare.
  • Advanced degree in business or health care-related field (e.g., MHA, MBA).

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Offensive Security Consultant - Red Team and AI - 376428
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $82,600 to $162,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 2+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Conduct offensive security assessments including red team operations, penetration testing, and AI security testing for Deloitte's clients. The role combines traditional security testing with AI-enabled offensive techniques and assessment of AI systems in production.

Good fit if you have 2+ years in cyber assessments, red teaming, or penetration testing and hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.

Full job description

Position Summary

Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte & Touche LLP could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte’s Offensive Security Operations Team to help drive our clients’ innovations and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide. Here, AI is part of how we test, report, and learn, and we test the AI systems our clients are putting into production.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As an Offensive Security Consultant, you will be on the front lines with our clients, supporting their offensive security needs and the security of the AI systems they are deploying. Working with our Offensive Security Operations Team, you will provide attack-oriented professional services such as (but not limited to): Red/Purple Team Operations, Penetration Testing, Breach and Attack Simulation, Cloud Penetration Testing, Social Engineering, AI Security Testing, and a variety of ad-hoc technical assessments to address unique cyber concerns for clients. In this role, you will:

  • Deliver professional services, including but not limited to Red Team Assessments, Purple Team Assessments, Network Penetration Tests, Web Application and API Penetration Tests, Compliance Penetration Tests, Cloud Penetration Tests, Wireless Security Assessments, Onsite and Remote Social Engineering, and a variety of technical projects
  • Apply AI to reconnaissance, attack path analysis, tooling and script development, and report drafting, with human review of outputs and documented quality checks
  • Test AI-enabled systems, including LLM applications, agents, and retrieval augmented generation pipelines, for prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, excessive agency, and AI supply chain weaknesses, using MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
  • Evaluate AI-enabled and autonomous testing platforms, and explain their strengths and limits to clients and teammates
  • Follow approved AI models, client data handling rules, and confidentiality requirements when using AI on engagements
  • Create clear assessment reports, both technical and managerial, that describe the engagement, scope, risks, and remediation guidance
  • Apply security testing frameworks and standards such as OSSTMM, OWASP, NIST SP 800-115, Lockheed Martin’s Cyber Kill Chain, and MITRE ATT&CK
  • Use AI, automation, orchestration, and scripting to reduce manual effort and create new attack simulation capabilities as client needs evolve
  • Utilize commercial and open-source security tools, including but not limited to Nmap, Burp Suite, Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, BloodHound, Wireshark, and AI-enabled offensive platforms
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on enterprise security risk, with working knowledge of architecture, identity and access management, Active Directory and Entra ID, and common attack paths across on premises, hybrid, and cloud environments
  • Identify, exploit, and report on misconfigurations and control weaknesses across enterprise environments, including identity and access management, network security controls, data protection, and logging/monitoring
  • Assess CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code deployments, and serverless/container technologies for exploitable weaknesses and viable attack paths into enterprise and cloud environments
  • Incorporate current adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, including identity and cloud focused techniques, into red and purple team engagements against hybrid and multi-cloud environments
  • Work with client defenders in purple team exercises to improve detection coverage and measure improvement
  • Foster client relationships by providing support, information, and guidance
  • Assist with practice development by improving existing offerings, contributing to new offerings, and participating in internal technical training as needed
  • Contribute to marketing and business development activities, including research, whitepapers, proposals, proofs of concept, conference speaking, and other thought leadership
  • Continually strengthen relevant skills, knowledge, and abilities to stay at the forefront of the information security industry, including AI-assisted offensive techniques and AI/ML security
  • Maintain a strong desire to learn, adapt, and improve alongside a rapidly growing company
  • Perform other duties as assigned

A successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to own assigned tasks and support project workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to seek and apply guidance from others

The team

At Deloitte, our Cyber specialists help organizations manage cyber risk and create value through stronger security, visibility, and privacy. Our program design, implementation, operation, and response services, coupled with our deep industry and mission knowledge, help us protect and defend our clients’ most valuable assets, support secure digital transformation efforts, and adapt rapidly to emerging threats.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 2+ years of experience in Consulting with experience in performing cyber focused technical assessments, red teaming, penetration testing, or adversarial simulation, delivering engagements such as network penetration tests, red/purple team assessments, and social engineering exercises
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in offensive security work, in professional, lab, or research settings, and the ability to describe a repeatable AI-assisted workflow, including tools, inputs, review steps, and known limitations
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML attack surfaces, including MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and experience testing or evaluating AI-enabled systems
  • Experience using or evaluating AI-enabled or autonomous testing platforms, with an understanding of where human oversight is required
  • Commitment to responsible AI use on client engagements, including approved models, client data handling, and human review of AI outputs
  • Working knowledge of enterprise and cloud computing environments and core security concepts (e.g., identity and access management, network security controls, logging and monitoring, serverless and container technologies), with the ability to identify and exploit weaknesses across them
  • Experience applying industry-standard security testing frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK, NIST SP 800-115, OWASP, Lockheed Martin’s Cyber Kill Chain)
  • Proficiency with common offensive security tooling (e.g., Nmap, Burp Suite, Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, BloodHound, or comparable commercial/open source tools)
  • Scripting or automation experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) to support tooling and process efficiency
  • Demonstrated experience producing clear technical and management-level assessment reports
  • Experience supporting engagement workstreams and working with senior team members
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be a U.S. citizen

Preferred

  • Relevant offensive security certifications, such as OSCP, OSCP+, GPEN, or CRTO, and an AI red team credential such as OSAI+ or an equivalent
  • Experience in a consulting environment
  • Experience building or customizing AI tooling, such as agents, MCP servers, or retrieval over TTP libraries
  • Published research, a portfolio, or open-source contributions that demonstrate AI-assisted offensive security work
  • Experience with cloud security frameworks such as the Cloud Security Alliance Cloud Controls Matrix
  • Experience with FedRAMP and understanding of FedRAMP 20x guidelines for both Penetration Testing and Red Team guidelines

  • Support team members in resolving complex claims.

This role is aligned to Deloitte Delivery Center locations in Lake Mary, Florida, and Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania.

Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

We are seeking a creative and collaborative Manager to join the Global AI Governance, Confidentiality, and Privacy Team. This role will drive practical learning, communications, guidance, awareness and digital resources that enable the safe, compliant, and responsible use of AI systems. Working under the direction of the AI literacy program lead, the Manager will coordinate day-to-day delivery and collaborate across globally diverse teams.

The ideal candidate will combine knowledge of AI governance and related risk domains with creative problem-solving, strong writing and visual storytelling, and disciplined project execution. This individual will develop engaging AI literacy materials, manage communications and collaboration resources and bring hands-on experience working with AI tools. They will translate complex topics into accessible content, coordinate contributors, and deliver high-quality outputs with appropriate review and safeguards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive high-quality AI literacy outputs, such as learning and development deliverables, through strong project management, including production schedules, milestones, and launch plans under the program lead’s direction.
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders and subject matter experts to turn AI developments, risks, and approved guidance into timely, relevant learning content, often within demanding timelines.
  • Develop practical, role-based scenarios that explain responsible AI use, confidentiality, privacy, human oversight, and when to seek advice.
  • Coordinate course development and delivery with learning teams and contributors, from content brief through production and launch.
  • Create engaging storyboards, presentations, job aids, and toolkits using clear writing, visual storytelling, and audience-focused design.
  • Manage review cycles, consolidate feedback, and check learning materials for accuracy, accessibility, consistency, and approved messaging.
  • Deliver course launch communications and awareness campaigns that build engagement and reinforce practical learning.
  • Maintain Teams and SharePoint learning resources, keeping approved materials easy to find, current, version-controlled, and appropriately permissioned.
  • Facilitate learning sessions and stakeholder discussions; use feedback to identify content gaps and improve learner experience.
  • Manage assigned projects and workstreams, coordinating timelines, dependencies, contributors, and handoffs within agreed priorities.
  • Improve workflows and reuse content through approved digital tools, AI, and/or agents, validating outputs and protecting confidential information.
  • Lead ad hoc projects and activities as needed across Global Confidentiality, Privacy, and AI governance team, such as project planning, reporting, meeting preparation and management, time management, communications and leadership updates.
  • Support business priority matters such as helping with Global AI use case reviewer, advising on strategies to promote trustworthy AI, and assist in enhancing future AI compliance by design initiatives.


The team

Global Risk & Brand Protection protects, preserves and enhances the Deloitte brand. We navigate the dynamic risk landscape across the areas of risk management, confidentiality & privacy, cyber security oversight, regulatory, independence & conflicts, and Anti-Corruption/financial crimes. We foster trusting relationships across the Deloitte network through collaboration, facilitation and responsive guidance.



Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in AI governance, AI risk, confidentiality, privacy, compliance, technology risk, learning and enablement, communications, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects or workstreams, coordinating contributors, and delivering quality outputs to agreed timelines.
  • Working understanding of AI-related risk, regulatory, compliance, and ethical considerations, including when to seek specialist advice.
  • Experience developing engaging communications, awareness campaigns, learning materials, or employee enablement resources, with evidence of creative problem-solving and audience-focused design.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to translate technical or regulatory concepts into clear, business-friendly content.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Teams and SharePoint, including coordinating channel-based collaboration, creating and maintaining pages and document libraries, and managing content organization, version control, and access permissions within established standards.
  • Strong practical skills in PowerPoint, Word, and Excel for content development, presentations, project tracking, and reporting.
  • Hands-on experience working with AI tools and/or agents in a professional context, such as supporting content development, knowledge retrieval, or workflow improvement; able to explain use cases, limitations, output validation, and responsible-use safeguards.
  • Experience coordinating stakeholders across functions or locations, gathering requirements, incorporating feedback, and escalating decisions appropriately.
  • Ability to work independently within agreed priorities, manage competing deadlines, and adapt to changing requirements.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, including using data and stakeholder feedback to identify issues and recommend practical improvements.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of AI governance and compliance, data risk management, privacy, data processing and technologies, machine learning, data science, and their applications.
  • Background in creative digital arts and training.
  • Ability to collaborate with diverse teams and influence decision-making at all levels.
  • Understanding of relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards related to AI governance and privacy.
  • Experience with instructional design, scenario-based learning, visual storytelling, or marketing and employee engagement campaigns.
  • Experience maintaining SharePoint knowledge hubs or learning resource sites, including content lifecycle management and usability improvements.
  • Change Management Experience.
  • Project Management Experience.



Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Full job description

Position Summary

Manager – Life Sciences Compliance Transformation

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organizations. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 03/15/2027.

Work you’ll do

As a Manager on our Life Sciences Compliance consulting team, you’ll help pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device companies meet the challenges of increasingly complex global regulations and modernize their compliance programs, using systems, data and AI to manage risk while enabling business strategy. You’ll lead engagements and workstreams, act as a day-to-day client leader, and coach a small team across a range of projects, from compliance program assessments and monitoring to operating model redesign and AI-enabled program transformation.

  • Lead compliance program assessments and advise client leaders on risk assessments, policies, training, healthcare professional and organization engagements, promotional practices, patient support, transparency reporting, and third-party risk.
  • Redesign compliance processes and operating models, clarify roles and decision rights, translate policies and controls into business requirements, and evaluate technology options and business cases.
  • Lead monitoring, auditing, and AI-enabled risk detection; support investigations and remediation; and incorporate explainability, human review, audit trails, and performance measurement into monitoring programs.
  • Manage engagement scope, workplans, budgets, deliverables, and client relationships; present recommendations to executives; and coach teams of compliance, data, and technology professionals.
  • Develop proposals, thought leadership, reusable assets, and AI-enabled offerings, using approved AI tools to improve delivery and reviewing outputs before relying on them.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Regulatory & Financial Risk offering supports clients' regulatory and compliance needs, balancing risk and regulatory requirements with enhancing business value and optimizing outcomes. We deliver enhanced value through strategic transformation, end-to-end implementation, and a focus on business-as-usual sustainability across processes, controls, and data & analytic infrastructures.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of experience in life sciences compliance in professional services (consulting, advisory, or law firms), including compliance program design, operation, or assessment and application of life sciences compliance laws, regulations, and industry codes, including the Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA), Food and Drug Administration (FDA) promotional requirements, Physician Payments Sunshine Act and state transparency laws, and U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) and U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Office of Inspector General (HHS-OIG) compliance program guidance; and 2+ years leading teams, including coaching and developing staff.
  • Experience leading process, operating model, or systems change, including defining business requirements.
  • Hands-on experience using generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools in your day-to-day work.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1–2 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with AI-enabled or analytics-based monitoring, or compliance technology implementations for healthcare professional engagement, transparency reporting, monitoring, or case management.
  • Experience working with technology teams to design or improve compliance tools.
  • Experience with AI governance or responsible AI programs.
  • Experience with compliance programs spanning multiple countries or markets.
  • Experience developing or selling an offering, product, or managed service.
  • The ideal candidate will possess a self-starter approach and comfort with ambiguity.
  • Juris Doctor (JD), Master of Business Administration (MBA), or Master of Public Health (MPH) degree; or Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP) or Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC) certification.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $110,700 to $218,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 3+ years

About this job

Senior Consultant role with Deloitte's Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team in Miami, supporting life sciences clients on compliance transformation. You'll lead end-to-end compliance projects using data, AI, and emerging technologies to help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies modernize compliance programs and manage global regulatory risk.

Good fit if you have 3+ years of professional services experience advising life sciences clients on compliance, knowledge of key life sciences regulations, and hands-on experience with AI tools and compliance transformation.

Full job description

Position Summary

Senior Consultant – Life Sciences Compliance Transformation

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organizations. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 03/15/2027.

Work you’ll do

As a Senior Consultant on our Life Sciences Compliance consulting team, you’ll help pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device companies meet the challenges of increasingly complex global regulations and modernize their compliance programs, using systems, data and AI to manage risk while enabling business strategy. You’ll own deliverables end to end, do the analysis, and work directly with client teams and our technology colleagues across a range of projects, from compliance program assessments and monitoring to operating model redesign and AI-enabled program transformation.

  • Support compliance risk and program assessments and translate findings into practical recommendations, policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), training, and communications.
  • Map current-state processes, controls, and handoffs; design future-state processes, responsible, accountable, consulted, and informed (RACI) matrices, control designs, and traceability from policy to control to system.
  • Plan and conduct compliance monitoring and auditing, including live monitoring of speaker programs and field interactions, transaction testing, and investigation support; analyze healthcare professional (HCP) spend, engagements, events, field activity, and transparency data to identify patterns, outliers, and risk signals.
  • Translate compliance needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and data mappings; support technology evaluations, fit-gap analysis, user acceptance testing, training, and go-live.
  • Lead workstream deliverables and day-to-day client interactions, including workplans, status reporting, budget tracking, issue and decision logs, materials for executive audiences, and quality reviews.
  • Contribute to proposals, reusable assets, thought leadership, and artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled solutions; share new AI techniques and coach Consultants.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Regulatory & Financial Risk offering supports clients' regulatory and compliance needs, balancing risk and regulatory requirements with enhancing business value and optimizing outcomes. We deliver enhanced value through strategic transformation, end-to-end implementation, and a focus on business-as-usual sustainability across processes, controls, and data & analytic infrastructures.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of professional services experience in consulting, advisory, or law firms advising life sciences or healthcare clients on compliance or regulatory matters.
  • Experience applying life sciences compliance laws, regulations, and guidance, including the Anti-Kickback Statute; False Claims Act; Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA); Food and Drug Administration (FDA) promotional requirements; Physician Payments Sunshine Act and state transparency laws; Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA); Pharmaceutical Research and Manufacturers of America (PhRMA) Code; Advanced Medical Technology Association (AdvaMed) Code; Corporate Integrity Agreements; and U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) and U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Office of Inspector General (HHS-OIG) compliance program guidance.
  • Experience supporting compliance transformation efforts, including process mapping, controls design, or requirements gathering; hands-on experience using generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools in day-to-day work; and experience in at least one of the following: compliance system requirements and design, data and analytics, applying AI to improve compliance processes, or AI-assisted prototype development.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1–2 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience using Power BI, Tableau, Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, low-code tools, artificial intelligence tools, or automation workflows.
  • Experience supporting compliance technology implementations, including healthcare professional engagement, customer relationship management (CRM), transparency reporting, or case management platforms.
  • Experience directing and reviewing the work of team members.
  • The ideal candidate will possess a self-starter approach and comfort with ambiguity.
  • Juris Doctor (JD), Master of Business Administration (MBA), Master of Public Health (MPH), or a compliance certification, such as Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP) or Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC).
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel to develop analyses and Microsoft PowerPoint to create presentations.

The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Senior Manager – Anti Money Laundering (AML) and Financial Crime Transformation & Analytics

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organization. As a Senior Manager on the Financial Crime consulting team, you will advise financial institutions and other regulated organizations on anti-money laundering (AML), sanctions, fraud, and analytics-enabled transformation.

  • Assess financial-crime programs and develop analytics strategies, investment roadmaps, and operating models covering governance, risk assessments, controls, data quality, and technology.

  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.

Job ID 376233

Position Summary

Are you passionate about technology and interested in joining a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo? If so, read on to learn about an opportunity with Deloitte Technology US (DT-US).

Recruiting for this role will end on December 21, 2026.

Work you’ll do

The Deputy BISO is the ES BISO’s senior delegate and second-in-command for the Enterprise Solutions security portfolio. In partnership with the ES BISO, you will translate security strategy into operating priorities, lead day-to-day portfolio execution, and represent the BISO function with senior business, technology, Cyber, risk, and compliance stakeholders.

You will make and drive day-to-day decisions within established governance and risk boundaries, elevate material or reserved decisions to the ES BISO, and provide seamless leadership coverage when the ES BISO is unavailable. You will lead through others—setting direction, strengthening risk visibility, and ensuring decisions and remediation move to closure.

As manager, you are expected to own outcomes end to end, exercise sound judgment with minimal oversight, and influence across teams without relying on direct authority. You will partner with business leaders to enable cloud, AI, and technology adoption securely and at pace.

Portfolio Leadership and Risk Visibility

  • Own the operating rhythm for portfolio-level cyber risk visibility, including executive dashboards, metrics, briefings, recommendations, and decisions required.
  • Direct risk assessments across applications, infrastructure, cloud services, data, identity, and third parties; prioritize issues based on business impact and risk.
  • Oversee exception governance, vulnerability management, remediation prioritization, and escalation; hold owners accountable for agreed actions and closure.
  • Represent the ES BISO in governance forums and lead complex escalations within delegated authority, bringing decisions requiring BISO or other leadership approval forward with clear options and recommendations.

Application, Cloud, and AI Security

  • Set priorities to advance application security maturity across critical business applications, working with technical owners and security specialists to drive measurable improvement.
  • Provide portfolio-level guidance across cloud, AI, identity, data, infrastructure, and third-party risk; engage subject-matter experts where deeper technical assessment is needed.
  • Oversee security reviews of AI and GenAI use cases—from intake through approval and monitoring—including copilots, LLM-based tools, automation, and third-party AI services. Ensure risks such as data leakage, prompt injection, insecure integrations, excessive agent permissions, and unapproved (“shadow”) AI are assessed and addressed.
  • Guide cloud security assessments across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS environments, including Azure and AWS, covering identity, network, encryption, logging, and data protection against applicable standards and control expectations.
  • Partner with cyber engineering, critical infrastructure, and privacy teams to align their priorities with the Enterprise Solutions risk portfolio.

Audit, Compliance, and GRC

  • Own coordination of BISO responses to audits, control assessments, internal reviews, and compliance activities; align evidence and remediation with the appropriate control owners.
  • Maintain portfolio risk registers, action logs, and issue trackers as decision and accountability tools—not just status records—and ensure timely follow-up and escalation.
  • Lead BISO-side coordination for incidents affecting Enterprise Solutions, including stakeholder alignment, impact tracking, communications, escalation, and lessons learned, in partnership with incident-response teams.

Business Partnership and Team Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted senior partner to directors and other leaders; anticipate emerging needs and bring clear recommendations, trade-offs, and decisions, not just status.
  • Translate technical findings into business impact and actionable choices; help leaders balance risk and business objectives through practical mitigations.
  • Lead the distributed Enterprise Solutions BISO team across the US and USI. Set priorities and expectations, review work early, coach team members, resolve delivery barriers, and hold workstreams accountable for quality and outcomes.
  • Establish and reinforce secure-by-design practices and security awareness across Enterprise Solutions, in partnership with business and technology leaders.

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Technology-US helps power Deloitte’s success. Deloitte Technology-US drives Deloitte, which serves many of the world’s largest, most respected organizations. DT-US develops and deploys cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The ~3,000 professionals in DT-US deliver services including:

  • Cyber Security
  • Technology Support
  • Technology & Infrastructure
  • Applications
  • Relationship Management
  • Strategy & Communications
  • Project Management
  • Strategic Financial Management

DT-US Cyber Security

The Enterprise Solutions BISO team partners with Deloitte business functions and the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) organization to enable secure, resilient business operations across a broad, business-critical portfolio.

Areas of focus include:

  • Risk & Compliance
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Data Protection
  • Cyber Design
  • Incident Response
  • Security Architecture
  • Business Partnership

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum 6 years of relevant years of experience in information security, cyber risk, technology risk, IT controls, compliance, audit, or privacy including experience in risk management, including risk assessments, control assessments, exception management, and remediation oversight.
  • Minimum 1 year of people and/or process management experience.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. 

Preferred:

  • Demonstrated experience leading teams, distributed workforces, or complex cross-functional programs; able to set direction, delegate, coach, and hold others accountable.
  • Experience in application security and vulnerability management, including influencing technology owners and driving remediation to closure.
  • Experience assessing cloud security in Azure, AWS, or other major cloud environments, including SaaS and third-party services.
  • Working knowledge of AI/GenAI security risks and governance, with the ability to guide business teams through risk evaluation and mitigation.
  • Knowledge of relevant frameworks and regulatory requirements, such as NIST, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
  • Experience using GRC and reporting platforms, such as ServiceNow, Archer, or Power BI.
  • Demonstrated ability to represent a function independently with senior leaders, translate technical risk into business decisions, and influence without direct authority.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, AWS or Azure security certifications, or credentials in AI governance and security.
  • Experience with AI governance frameworks and guidance, such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, or the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
  • Experience with cloud security posture management, container security, or secure DevOps.
  • Experience with vulnerability management tools such as Nessus or Qualys, application security testing tools, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience in one or more complementary domains, such as security architecture, incident response, identity and access management, data protection, or privacy.
  • Experience with critical infrastructure security or cyber engineering programs.
  • Experience applying AI/GenAI to improve security reporting, risk analysis, or workflow automation.
  • Consulting or Big Four experience leading complex stakeholder engagements.

Job.JobTitle: AWS Cloud Engineer - Software Engineering Solutions - Top Secret Clearance
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

 

Work You’ll Do

As a Center Delivery Senior Consultant, Software Engineering Solutions on the HCI team, you will join the infrastructure team supporting a new unified importer identity and onboarding platform — providing full visibility across every importer entity and individual applying on its behalf, all running on AWS.

You'll design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure for identity verification, biometric matching, and ACE Portal integration, working alongside developers, identity/policy specialists, and stakeholders through Release 1, Release 2, and ongoing O&M. You will work on core AWS infrastructure supporting a mobile identity-verification app, Salesforce orchestration, and ACE Portal integration, as well as biometric/identity services, including hosting and scaling Iprove (facial recognition/liveness) within AWS environment. In addition, integration infrastructure connecting to ATS/NVC (vetting), Salesforce, and ACE. Environments supporting Release 1 (Year 1 launch) and Release 2 running in parallel with steady-state O&M. Security infrastructure supporting the ATO process — access controls, audit logging, encryption for a system handling PII and biometric data. Scheduling/appointment infrastructure for background check and fingerprinting workflows, if in scope.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and maintain AWS infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across two concurrent release tracks. Configure networking, IAM, and security groups per federal requirements
  • Stand up and scale compute for biometric/ML workloads under real onboarding volume
  • Implement monitoring/logging/alerting (CloudWatch) to support O&M
  • Support integration between AWS-hosted services, Salesforce, ATS/NVC, and ACE
  • Support ATO documentation and audits (access control evidence, data flow diagrams, encryption, vulnerability scanning)
  • Collaborate with identity/policy stakeholders on credentialing infrastructure. Support patching, tuning, and capacity planning as the platform scales

A successful candidate would possess:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

 

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Active Top Secret clearance
  • 3+ years of experience building/operating production AWS infrastructure. 
  • 3+ years of experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar). 
  • 3+ years of experience working with AWS core services: VPC, IAM, EC2/ECS/Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch. 
  • 3+ years of experience integrating with third-party or legacy government systems, such as federal security/compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, NIST 800-53, ATO). 
  • 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tooling and automated deployment. 
  • Reside a commutable distance to Deloitte office in Gilbert, AZ, Mechanicsburg, PA, or Lake Mary, FL
  • Able to travel up to 10%

Preferred:

  • 2+ years of experience with identity verification, biometric, or credentialing systems
  • 2+ years of experience with Salesforce integration patterns
  • 2+ years of experience with CBP, DHS, or other federal law-enforcement systems
  • 2+ years of experience supporting systems through an ATO process
  • AWS certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Security Specialty)

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate - Cyber Platform Engineer Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Fort Lauderdale, FL
  • Experience: 6+ years

About this job

Lead Managed Services Engineer II role engineering, integrating, and sustaining security platforms including SIEM, EDR, XDR, vulnerability management, and PAM for a large banking client. Responsibilities include platform deployment, API integration, data pipeline management, AI-enabled security capabilities, and high-availability operations.

Good fit if you have 6+ years in security engineering or platform operations, hands-on experience with SIEM/EDR/XDR/PAM platforms, Kubernetes on AWS/GCP, Python/PowerShell scripting, and can commute daily to Fort Lauderdale.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Cyber Platform Engineer engineers, integrates, and sustains the technology platforms that make up a large banking client’s Technology estate. The role owns the technical health of critical security platforms, from architecture and build through integration, upgrade, and lifecycle management, with a focus on resilience, performance, and coverage. It combines strong platform engineering skills with hands-on knowledge of enterprise security products. The role partners with security operations, infrastructure, vendors, and engineering teams, and applies AI to operationalize AI-enabled security capabilities safely.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

  • Engineer, deploy, integrate, and sustain security platforms, including Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), extended detection and response (XDR), vulnerability management, privileged access management (PAM), and email and web security.
  • Integrate security platforms with enterprise applications, infrastructure, and cloud services using application programming interfaces (APIs), connectors, and event-driven workflows; automate onboarding, configuration, health monitoring, and reporting with infrastructure as code and scripting.
  • Build and maintain pipelines that feed the SIEM and security data lake; apply data-quality and normalization standards; monitor pipeline health; and perform Level 3 troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
  • Maintain high-availability and disaster-recovery readiness for cyber platforms; support audit and regulatory evidence requests; and manage vendor relationships, licensing, upgrade planning, and roadmap input.
  • Evaluate, integrate, and operationalize artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled security capabilities, including AI-assisted security operations center tooling, copilot features, and machine learning-driven analytics; engineer secure data flows and access controls; and validate AI outputs before use.
  • Support platform operations outside standard business hours when business needs require.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in security engineering, platform engineering, or security technology operations.
  • Experience engineering and operating Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), extended detection and response (XDR), vulnerability management, and privileged access management (PAM) platforms, including platform integration, upgrades, and operations.
  • Experience deploying Kubernetes on Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Google Cloud Platform (GCP); developing Python or PowerShell scripts, Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs, and webhooks; using infrastructure as code, containers, and cloud-native architectures; building log-ingestion, parsing, normalization, and data-pipeline tooling; performing high-availability, disaster-recovery, and capacity-management activities; and evaluating artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), or large language model (LLM)-enabled security tooling, including data-access and integrity risks, the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), and use of automation and AI-assisted tools to support platform operations and validate outputs.

Cybersecurity engineer who deploys and operates Wiz Cloud, Wiz Defend, and Wiz Outpost for enterprise cloud security at a large banking client. Manages cloud security posture, detection and response, and threat visibility across AWS and GCP, including Wiz Outpost deployments for data residency and air-gapped environments.

Good fit if you have 6+ years of cybersecurity engineering with 2+ years of Wiz platform experience, strong AWS and GCP expertise, and can commute to Fort Lauderdale.

Full job description

Position Summary

The CNAPP Platform Manager is a cybersecurity engineer who deploys and operationalizes Wiz Cloud, Wiz Defend, and Wiz Outpost to support enterprise cybersecurity operations for a large banking client. The role drives cloud security posture management, cloud detection and response, and threat visibility across AWS and GCP, and acts as a force multiplier for SOC, detection engineering, and cloud platform teams. The role owns Wiz Outpost for deployments for data residency, air-gapped, and sovereign cloud requirements, and extends cloud security to AI workloads.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Wiz Platform Enablement: Deploy, configure, and operationalize Wiz Cloud, Wiz Defend, and Wiz Outpost across enterprise cloud environments. Onboard AWS and GCP accounts, projects, and workloads, and build integration frameworks that surface risks, misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, and active threats in real time. Develop custom policies, security graphs, and controls aligned to enterprise standards.
  • Wiz Outpost Deployments: Architect, deploy, and manage Wiz Outpost for data residency, air-gapped, and sovereign cloud requirements. Configure Outpost infrastructure for secure, performant, and compliant scanning, and troubleshoot connectivity, scanning pipelines, and operational health. Integrate Outpost with landing zone and VPC / VPN architectures in partnership with cloud platform and network engineering teams.
  • Cybersecurity Operations Support: Integrate Wiz findings into SIEM, SOAR, and ticketing workflows for SOC and detection engineering teams. Build automated remediation and alerting pipelines from posture and threat signals and develop runbooks and response playbooks for Wiz Defend detections with security operations.
  • Cloud-Native Security Engineering: Design and enforce controls across container (Kubernetes / EKS / GKE), serverless, and microservices architectures. Implement IAM policies, network security controls, and least-privilege access across AWS and GCP, and promote IaC security best practice with Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Governance and Compliance: Establish cloud security guardrails and governance aligned to organizational risk posture. Conduct risk assessments, support audit and compliance requirements, and embed security controls in CI/CD with DevSecOps and platform engineering teams.
  • AI-Enabled Cloud Security: Apply AI security posture management (AI-SPM) concepts to discover and secure AI models, pipelines, and generative AI services such as Amazon Bedrock and Vertex AI. Use AI-assisted Wiz features with validation of outputs.

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of cybersecurity engineering experience, including 2+ years of experience with the Wiz platform: Wiz Cloud (cloud security posture management, cloud infrastructure entitlement management, and vulnerability management), Wiz Defend (cloud detection and response and runtime threat detection), and/or Wiz Outpost.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or 6+ years of cybersecurity engineering experience.
  • Experience configuring Wiz security graphs, authoring custom policies, integrating application programming interfaces, and deploying or managing Wiz Outpost in customer-managed or regulated cloud environments, including configuration, network integration, and operational support.
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) Identity and Access Management (IAM), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), AWS Lambda, Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Amazon GuardDuty, and AWS Security Hub; and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) IAM, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Security Command Center, including landing zones and private connectivity through AWS PrivateLink, VPC peering, or virtual private network (VPN).
  • Experience integrating cloud security tooling with security information and event management (SIEM), security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR), and ticketing platforms, including Splunk or Google Chronicle, threat detection, incident response, and alert triage.
  • Experience using Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform or AWS CloudFormation, and Python or Bash for pipeline and workflow automation.
  • Experience applying the MITRE ATT&CK Cloud Matrix, Center for Internet Security (CIS) Benchmarks, National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework, artificial intelligence security posture management (AI-SPM), and controls for Amazon Bedrock or Vertex AI, including validation of outputs from AI-assisted security-platform features.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate - Security Controls Engineer Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Security Controls Engineer designs, engineers, and automates the security controls that protect a large banking client’s cloud and hybrid environments. The role standardizes controls across AWS and GCP, maintains the control library against NIST, ISO, and CIS frameworks, and turns control evidence into continuous, automated assurance. It also performs risk assessments, identifies compensating controls for non-compliant items, and provides technical leadership to architecture and project teams. The role works with cybersecurity, technology risk, internal audit, and engineering teams, and applies AI to control mapping and evidence review under human accountability.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Design and standardize information security controls across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments; maintain a control library mapped to the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), NIST Special Publication (SP) 800-53, and Center for Internet Security (CIS) Controls.
  • Build and maintain automated control monitoring and evidence collection using Python, PowerShell, Terraform, and Open Policy Agent (OPA) policy-as-code; integrate results with ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM), Archer, or OneTrust.
  • Assess AWS and GCP security architectures using the AWS Well-Architected Framework and Google Cloud Security Command Center; identify, assess, and mitigate risks and define compensating controls for non-compliant items.
  • Perform automated and manual security testing of applications and infrastructure; validate results, analyze source code, analyze root cause and impact, and guide corrective actions.
  • Provide timely technical evidence for internal audit and regulatory requests; collaborate with cybersecurity, technology risk, and engineering stakeholders to influence secure solution delivery.
  • Apply generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and prompt engineering for control mapping and evidence review in alignment with the NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework and Federal Reserve Supervisory Letter SR 11-7 expectations, while retaining human accountability for final control conclusions.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity control engineering, security engineering, technology risk, or security assurance, including 2+ years securing AWS and GCP environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science or Cybersecurity preferred), or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience designing and automating security controls, performing information security risk assessments, and developing compensating controls for non-compliant items.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience maintaining a control library mapped to NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27001, Cloud Security Alliance (CSA) Security, Trust, Assurance, and Risk (STAR), and CIS Controls.
  • Experience with AWS Well-Architected Framework, Google Cloud Security Command Center, AWS and GCP identity and access management security models, Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3), Google Cloud Storage, Google Compute Engine, and infrastructure-as-code security using Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Experience using Python, PowerShell, Terraform, OPA policy-as-code, and ServiceNow IRM, Archer, or OneTrust for control monitoring and evidence collection.
  • Experience using GenAI for control mapping and evidence review, including RAG and prompt engineering, and applying the NIST AI RMF and SR 11-7.
  • Experience performing information security risk governance in banking or financial services.
  • Certifications such as HashiCorp Terraform, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate Manager - Lead PBAC Engineer
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Lead PBAC Engineer is a senior engineering lead responsible for designing, deploying, and governing identity and access management systems for a large banking client, with a focus on Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC). The role leads engineering activities in coordination with the technology team, sets the technology domain roadmap, and drives quality standards within the existing and planned framework. It combines identity governance, automated provisioning and deprovisioning, and enterprise access management with Python and PowerShell automation, and operates within a large-scale, highly regulated financial services environment.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Design, implement, and maintain Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC) and Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions; define integrations and enhancements that support the IAM roadmap.
  • Build and maintain automation for user provisioning, deprovisioning, and access-control management using Python and PowerShell.
  • Lead technical decisions, provide guidance to engineering team members, and partner with internal and external stakeholders on IAM policies and solution requirements.
  • Diagnose IAM incidents, identify business impact and root causes, and implement corrective actions that minimize business disruption.
  • Maintain IAM documentation; support security audits and penetration testing; assess control issues and escalate risks appropriately.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience, and 6+ years of Identity and Access Management (IAM) engineering experience.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC) solutions using PlainID or Axiomatics and automating provisioning, deprovisioning, and access-control workflows using Python or PowerShell.
  • Experience administering Active Directory or Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), Okta or Azure Active Directory (Azure AD), and integrations using Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), OAuth, or OpenID Connect.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.

  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Microsoft SC-300, SailPoint, Okta, or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification.
  • Experience developing IAM metrics, benchmark analyses, and reports.
  • Experience conducting IAM security audits, penetration testing, or remediation of access-control findings.
  • Experience with artificial intelligence (AI)-driven identity analytics or non-human identity governance.
