About this job

Architect end-to-end marketing and advertising technology solutions across platforms like Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce Data Cloud, and emerging AI tools. Design composable, future-ready stacks spanning customer data, journey orchestration, identity resolution, and AdTech integration.

Good fit if you have 4+ years hands-on MarTech/AdTech experience, 3+ years CDP and identity resolution expertise, and can travel 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be the connective tissue across our clients’ marketing and advertising technology ecosystems, spanning customer data platforms, journey orchestration and decisioning, campaign and content platforms, and adjacent AdTech capabilities, all increasingly powered by AI and agentic technologies. You will move fluidly across platforms and vendors rather than anchoring to a single stack, advising clients on the art of the possible, designing composable, future-ready architectures, and leading implementation across MarTech, AdTech, and AI-enabled solutions.

This role suits a technologist who treats the pace of change in this space as the appealing part of the job: someone who stays current on emerging platforms and AI capabilities, pilots new tools ahead of the market, and brings that point of view to clients and internal teams alike.

Recruiting for this role ends on February 19, 2027

Work you'll do

As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:

  • Architecting end-to-end solutions across the marketing technology landscape (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform/AEP, Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, Target; Salesforce Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce; and comparable platforms) to enable unified customer profiles, journey orchestration, and omnichannel personalization
  • Bridging MarTech and AdTech ecosystems by integrating CDPs with ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, identity resolution, and measurement/attribution platforms to enable addressable, privacy-safe advertising and cross-channel activation
  • Architecting and maintaining identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph solutions, including identity matching logic, resolution accuracy, and data collection strategies that feed a unified, enterprise-wide view of the customer
  • Embedding AI and agentic capabilities into client marketing and advertising ecosystems, including generative content and personalization, AI assistants/copilots, and next-best-action or agent orchestration, and continuously evaluating emerging tools as the landscape evolves
  • Advising clients on future-state architecture design, feasibility, level of effort, cost, and the art of the possible, across composable, API-first MarTech and AdTech stacks
  • Leading technical pre-sales and solutioning (hunter/farmer cycles), translating business and marketing goals into technical designs, estimates, and phased implementation roadmaps
  • Leading integration and solution delivery across multiple platforms, third-party systems, and client stakeholder groups during technical design and implementation
  • Building and leading high-performing, cross-functional, geographically distributed teams of architects, engineers, and analysts, and establishing reusable frameworks, accelerators, and playbooks
  • Evaluating and recommending composable architecture approaches that enable clients to assemble modular, best-of-breed MarTech/AdTech capabilities rather than defaulting to a single monolithic platform

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Genuine curiosity and a pioneer's mindset: energized, not unsettled, by a marketing and advertising technology landscape that is constantly introducing new platforms, tools, and AI capabilities
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience across marketing technology and/or advertising technology platforms, including implementation experience with at least two major MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud/Data Cloud, mParticle, Segment, Tealium, or comparable)
  • 3+ years of experience architecting Customer Data Platform (CDP) solutions, including data modeling, identity resolution, audience segmentation, and activation
  • 3+ years of experience with identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph technologies or platforms (e.g., Acxiom, LiveRamp, or similar), including identity matching logic and resolution accuracy
  • 2+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales or solution architecture engagements, including level-of-effort, cost estimation, and roadmap development
  • 2+ years of experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting MarTech/AdTech workloads
  • 1+ years of experience with AI/agentic capabilities embedded in MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., AI assistants/copilots, generative personalization, agent orchestration)
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience with composable architecture / MACH (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless) principles
  • Working knowledge of the AdTech ecosystem, including ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, programmatic buying, identity/addressability solutions, and measurement and attribution
  • Adobe Certified Expert/Professional and/or Salesforce certifications spanning CDP, Marketing Cloud, or Agentforce
  • Experience integrating MarTech platforms with AdTech data, identity, or clean-room solutions (e.g., LiveRamp, The Trade Desk, Google Marketing Platform)
  • Experience collaborating with identity partners to evolve identity graph coverage and improve enterprise-wide customer data mapping and digital tracking accuracy
  • A demonstrated track record as an early adopter, piloting new platforms, tools, or AI capabilities ahead of broad market adoption and driving their adoption within teams or client organizations
  • Experience training or leading offshore or nearshore delivery teams in a Global Delivery model
  • Programming or scripting experience in Python, SQL, or Java
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related technical field

Requisition code: 376109
Job ID 376109

Quick facts

  • Pay: $122,000 to $240,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 3+ years

About this job

Channel Sales professional role at Deloitte in Miami focused on building relationships within the Anthropic ecosystem to generate qualified pipeline. You will work across sales, account teams, and marketing to create joint go-to-market opportunities and drive demand generation.

Good fit if you have 3+ years in channel sales, alliance management, or partner-focused roles, and experience with complex matrixed organizations and CRM pipeline management.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Team

The Sales Center of Excellence supports Deloitte’s businesses in identifying, nurturing, and closing sales opportunities. Channel Sales professionals work alongside Sales Executives, Partners, Principals, Managing Directors, alliance leaders, marketing, and account teams to activate strategic relationships, generate demand, and create qualified opportunities that support Deloitte’s growth agenda.

Position Summary 

Are you a relationship-oriented sales professional with an entrepreneurial mindset, relevant industry and Anthropic experience, and a demonstrated ability to activate partner ecosystems? Deloitte Consulting LLP is seeking a Channel Sales professional to expand market presence, strengthen Anthropic relationships, and generate qualified pipeline across Cross Industry.

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/29/2027

Work you’ll do

As a Channel Sales professional, you will activate the Anthropic ecosystem to create market awareness, uncover new opportunities, and generate qualified pipeline for Deloitte. You will work closely with Sales Executives, account teams, Anthropic stakeholders, and Marketing to turn relationships and market insight into actionable growth opportunities. You will:

  • Build and maintain a strategic relationship map across Anthropic, including sales leaders, client executives, industry leaders, account teams, solution specialists, and other influential stakeholders.
  • Identify relationship gaps, priority connections, and engagement opportunities that increase Deloitte’s visibility and access across the Anthropic ecosystem and internally.
  • Partner with Sales Executives and Deloitte account teams to identify target accounts, develop contact strategies, and activate joint go-to-market opportunities.
  • Help frame the purpose and desired outcomes of joint opportunity calls, recommend approaches that have worked in other accounts, and bring forward relevant examples from similar clients to spark opportunity creation.
  • Facilitate and support joint account planning, relationship-mapping sessions, pipeline reviews, and opportunity-creation calls with Anthropic and Deloitte stakeholders.
  • Create repeatable engagement approaches that help account teams use Anthropic relationships, industry insights, and solution capabilities to open doors and advance early-stage opportunities.
  • Work closely with marketing to plan and execute joint demand-generation initiatives, including events, workshops, webinars, campaigns, and targeted account-based marketing activities.
  • Convert marketing activity, partner interactions, and market intelligence into qualified opportunities by ensuring timely follow-up, clear ownership, and disciplined pipeline tracking.
  • Capture and share leading practices, client examples, market signals, and successful co-sell approaches to improve opportunity creation across the territory.
  • Track and report on key performance indicators, including relationship coverage, joint activities, marketing-sourced leads, pipeline created, pipeline influenced, and conversion to qualified opportunities.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations on where to focus relationship-building, marketing investment, and joint sales activity to maximize pipeline generation and growth.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • A proven track record in channel sales, alliance management, business development, partner marketing, or inside sales.
  • Experience developing relationships with partner sales organizations, technology providers, systems integrators, or other strategic ecosystem partners.
  • Strong relationship-mapping and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to navigate complex organizations and connect the right people at the right time.
  • The ability to translate client, partner, and market insights into practical opportunity-creation strategies.
  • Experience working with sales and marketing teams to develop and execute demand-generation and pipeline-creation initiatives.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and follow-up skills.
  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills, including the ability to manage activity, pipeline, and performance data in a CRM environment.
  • Knowledge of enterprise software solutions, consulting services, and the broader Anthropic marketplace.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of experience in channel sales, alliance management, business development, partner marketing, or related go-to-market roles.
  • Experience working within a complex, matrixed organization and coordinating cross-functional sales and marketing activity.
  • Demonstrated success developing partner relationships and generating pipeline through joint go-to-market activity.
  • Experience with pipeline management, CRM reporting, and measuring the effectiveness of demand-generation activity.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Anthropic, including its technology, sales organization, partner ecosystem, and go-to-market model.
  • Established relationships with Anthropic sales representatives, client executives, industry leaders, or channel stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting account-based marketing, joint campaigns, industry events, or other co-marketing programs.
  • Experience selling or supporting the sale of complex, project-based professional services.
  • Undergraduate degree; advanced degree preferred.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate Manager - Identity Security Architect and Engineering Lead
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Identity Security Architect & Product Engineering Lead drives the design, engineering, and deployment of next-generation identity security capabilities across a large banking client. The role leads initiatives in attack path analysis, identity threat protection, behavioral analytics, authentication modernization, policy-based access control (PBAC), and identity-driven attack containment. It combines deep IAM architecture and Zero Trust expertise with hands-on product engineering on Sgnl.ai, PlainID, Entra ID, and CrowdStrike Identity Protection, and collaborates with cybersecurity, infrastructure, engineering, architecture, and product teams to support the organization’s cyber defense transformation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

  • Define and execute enterprise identity security roadmaps aligned with Zero Trust principles; design scalable identity and access management (IAM) architectures for workforce, privileged, and machine identities; and establish standards for authentication, authorization, and access governance.
  • Lead engineering, deployment, and integration of Sgnl.ai, PlainID, CrowdStrike Identity Protection, Entra ID, and authentication and authorization platforms across enterprise applications and infrastructure; translate business requirements into secure, scalable solutions; partner with product vendors and internal engineering teams; and support planned work outside standard business hours when business needs require.
  • Expand attack path mapping to identify and remediate exploitable identity-based attack vectors; implement identity threat detection, risk scoring, and attack containment; and improve visibility into entitlements, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and access risks.
  • Modernize authentication services and user experiences by accelerating strong authentication, adaptive access controls, policy-based access control (PBAC) initiatives with PlainID, and identity-aware authorization models.
  • Implement behavioral biometrics, user behavior analytics, AI-driven identity analytics, and non-human identity governance; design identity-risk models that enable adaptive authentication, access decisions, continuous verification, and Zero Trust access controls.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity, identity and access management (IAM), identity architecture, or security engineering.
  • Experience designing IAM architectures and engineering, integrating, and operationalizing Sgnl.ai, PlainID, CrowdStrike Identity Protection, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory) for enterprise applications and infrastructure.
  • Experience with single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, identity governance, access management, privileged access management, federation, application programming interfaces (APIs), automation, authentication protocols, Zero Trust Architecture, identity threat detection and response (ITDR), attack path analysis, policy-based access control (PBAC), risk-based authentication, behavioral analytics, cloud-native architectures, and non-human identity governance.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 day per week times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20–25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, IAM, identity architecture, or security engineering, including leading identity transformation programs.
  • Experience applying National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Zero Trust Architecture or NIST Cybersecurity Framework guidance.
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, or Certified Identity and Access Manager (CIAM) certification.

A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 to $265,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Software Developer / Engineer, IT / Technology, Cloud Engineer
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

About the role

We’re seeking an experienced AWS DevOps Cloud Specialist to help engineering teams build, automate, and manage cloud application delivery. You’ll support deployment pipelines and release management across the development life cycle, troubleshoot deployment issues, and identify ways to improve the speed and reliability of delivery.

 

Work You’ll Do

As a US Delivery Center Senior AWS Infrastructure/DevOps Engineer on the team, you will:

  •  Partner with engineering teams to implement application build and deployment processes and pipelines.
  • Develop and maintain tools and scripts that automate DevOps operations.
  • Maintain multiple DevOps environments based on project needs.
  • Support feature and product releases through production deployment.
  • Troubleshoot deployment issues with application and systems engineers.
  • Recommend tools and process improvements that strengthen delivery speed and reliability.
 

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in an IT-related field.
  • At least six years of relevant professional experience.
  • U.S. citizenship.
  • CompTIA Security+ certification or equivalent, and Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) certification.
  • Foundational knowledge of AWS services and infrastructure, including VPC, EC2, S3, EBS, EFS, ELB, security groups, and network ACLs.
  • Knowledge of core DevOps practices, including configuration management, continuous integration, infrastructure as code, continuous delivery/deployment, and continuous monitoring.
  • Experience integrating automated testing or deployment verification into DevOps processes.
  • Demonstrated experience with relevant version control, configuration management, build, and deployment tools, such as Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket, CodeCommit, Chef, or Ansible.
  • Experience with cloud build and deployment tools such as GitLab, Beanstalk, OpsWorks, CodeBuild, or CodeDeploy.
  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future 
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg)  
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance
Preferred: 
  • Experience deploying applications to containers using Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Amazon ECS, or Fargate.
  • Experience with cloud deployment languages and infrastructure-as-code tools such as CloudFormation, Terraform, Chef, or Ansible.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Fort Lauderdale, FL
  • Experience: 6+ years

About this job

Build and maintain Cognos and Tableau dashboards, reports, and data visualizations for cybersecurity risk metrics at a large banking client. Role involves SQL analysis, ETL processes, data quality assurance, and delivering monthly and ad hoc reports to executive management.

Good fit if you have 6+ years IT/security experience with 5+ years in reporting and analytics, proficiency in Cognos, Tableau, SQL, and can work within commutable distance of Fort Lauderdale.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Cybersecurity Reporting Specialist is an experienced reporting and analytics professional with expertise in Cognos, Tableau, SQL, ETL, data visualization, and executive reporting. The role delivers actionable cybersecurity metrics, risk reporting, dashboards, and data-driven insights for a large banking client. It combines business intelligence, data analysis, report automation, quality assurance, and stakeholder communication within a complex enterprise environment.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for...

  • Build and maintain detailed Cognos and Tableau business intelligence reports, interactive dashboards, and datasets for cybersecurity programs; maintain historical risk data and support report and dashboard enhancements.
  • Gather and process risk data from program owners; produce monthly and periodic information security reports, metrics, and near-real-time reporting through the reporting application.
  • Analyze data using Structured Query Language (SQL), Excel, and Access; design and document business requirements for automated upstream data feeds; and support daily, weekly, and monthly Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) jobs.
  • Conduct quality control for reports by validating data and presentation accuracy, comparing source data with published Portable Document Format (PDF) reports, and resolving formatting and data discrepancies.
  • Deliver monthly and ad hoc cybersecurity metrics to executive management, senior security management, risk committees, technology leaders, and practitioners; present findings in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, or PDF to support decision making.
  • Use approved artificial intelligence (AI) tools to draft queries, summarize trends, and check reporting logic; validate every output against source data and never submit sensitive or customer data to unapproved tools.

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Undergraduate degree and 6+ years of experience in information technology or information security, including 5+ years of reporting and analytics experience.
  • Experience building and maintaining Cognos and Tableau reports, dashboards, data visualizations, and datasets for interactive analytics; using SQL, relational databases, Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) processes, Excel, Access, Visual Basic for Applications (VBA), Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint, and Portable Document Format (PDF) reporting; and analyzing cybersecurity risk data.
  • Experience using generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools to draft queries and summaries, with validation against source data.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience in financial services.
  • Industry cybersecurity certifications.
  • Experience using Power BI or Splunk.
  • Master's degree in data science preferred.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate Manager - Threat Modeling Lead
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Strategic and hands-on Threat Modeling Lead with over 8 years of dedicated experience integrating advanced threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and adversarial analysis into modern software development lifecycles. Expert in executing industry-standard methodologies including STRIDE, PASTA, and LINDDUN, with specialized depth in securing cloud platforms, APIs, and microservices architectures. Proven proficiency in utilizing specialized threat modeling suites (IriusRisk, Threat Modeler, OWASP Threat Dragon) mapped directly to MITRE ATT&CK, D3FEND, and CAPEC frameworks. Planning practical security for emerging technologies through threat modeling of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI systems using NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, and the OWASP LLM Top 10.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

  • Lead end-to-end security architecture reviews and structured threat modeling assessments using STRIDE, PASTA, and LINDDUN.
  • Assess and design security controls for cloud platforms, application programming interfaces (APIs), containerized environments, and microservices architectures.
  • Model security risks for artificial intelligence systems and large language models (LLMs), including adversarial machine learning threats, using the Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF).
  • Integrate automated threat modeling and security checks into the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), and infrastructure as code (IaC) pipelines.
  • Administer enterprise threat modeling platforms and map potential system weaknesses to adversary techniques and defensive countermeasures using MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE D3FEND, and Common Attack Pattern Enumeration and Classification (CAPEC).
  • Partner with Identity and Access Management (IAM), DevOps, security operations (SecOps), and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) teams to implement security mitigations.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in infrastructure security, information security, threat modeling, application security, or security architecture.
  • Experience conducting threat modeling and security architecture reviews for distributed systems, cloud platforms, APIs, or microservices using STRIDE, PASTA, or LINDDUN.
  • Experience integrating security controls into the software development lifecycle, including SAST, DAST, SCA, or IaC pipelines.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience using IriusRisk, Threat Modeler, or OWASP Threat Dragon.
  • Experience mapping threats and mitigations to MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE D3FEND, or CAPEC.
  • Experience conducting threat modeling for artificial intelligence systems or LLMs using OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, or NIST AI RMF.
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP), SABSA Chartered Security Architect, or Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certification.

The role places special emphasis on critical vulnerabilities that need manual tracking and evidence of inspection because automated scanning signatures are not yet available, and on vulnerabilities of significant interest to key regulators. It keeps a real-time view of the organization’s risk posture and reports it clearly to senior management.

  • Inspect and validate remediation evidence from engineering and application teams before recording a vulnerability as closed.
  • Maintain tracking and reporting for vulnerabilities of interest to regulators, including data needed to support transparency and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate with IT engineering, operations, and product owners to advance remediation, resolve pending issues, and escalate past-due vulnerabilities or vulnerabilities without a remediation plan.
  • Develop reports, metrics, and operational dashboards that communicate remediation status, trends, and insights to senior management.

Leads detection engineering lifecycle management for a banking client's Security Operations Center, with focus on AI system monitoring. Full job description

Position Summary

The Cyber Detection Engineering Manager leads detection engineering lifecycle management for the Security Operations Center (SOC) of a large banking client, with a specific focus on detection use cases that monitor AI systems. The role is the connective tissue between detection engineers, threat intelligence analysts, data engineers, platform teams, and business stakeholders, driving structured program delivery from detection concept through production deployment and continuous improvement.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead the detection engineering lifecycle from use-case intake and prioritization through development, validation, deployment, tuning, and continuous improvement.
  • Define and deliver detection use cases for artificial intelligence (AI) systems, including model abuse, prompt injection, data exfiltration through AI interfaces, and anomalous AI pipeline activity.
  • Coordinate detection engineering, SOC operations, threat intelligence, data platform, cloud engineering, and business stakeholders to manage dependencies, risks, and delivery milestones.
  • Establish program governance, detection-as-code practices, use-case tiering, MITRE ATT&CK coverage mapping, and key performance indicators (KPIs) and objectives and key results (OKRs).
  • Maintain use-case catalogs, decision logs, delivery plans, risk registers, roadmaps, and executive status reporting.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of program or project management experience, including 3+ years supporting cybersecurity, Security Operations Center (SOC), or detection engineering functions; Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, Business, or experience meeting the 6+ years and 3+ years thresholds.
  • Experience using Agile, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies and Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, or Smartsheet.
  • Experience with detection use-case development, security information and event management (SIEM) rule authoring, alert tuning, detection validation, detection-as-code practices, MITRE ATT&CK coverage mapping, and artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) system monitoring.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Program Management Professional (PgMP), Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agilist, or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) Associate certification.
  • Experience developing detection coverage for model abuse, prompt injection, data exfiltration through AI interfaces, or anomalous AI pipeline activity.
  • Experience maintaining detection use-case catalogs, risk registers, roadmaps, and executive status reports.

Job ID 376062

Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 6+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Deloitte seeks a Manager to design and deliver ServiceNow cybersecurity and IT operations solutions for enterprise clients. You will lead solution architecture, guide delivery teams through full implementations, and help clients integrate security, risk, asset, and operations capabilities.

Good fit if you have 6+ years ServiceNow architecture experience, led implementations of cyber or asset products, and can manage engagements end to end as the day-to-day lead.

Full job description

Position Summary

Cyber ServiceNow Solution Architect

Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking a Manager with strong ServiceNow solution architecture and cybersecurity expertise to design and deliver integrated security, risk, asset intelligence, and IT operations solutions for enterprise clients.

In this role, you will lead architecture and implementation activities, translate business and security requirements into scalable designs, guide delivery teams, and help clients connect ServiceNow capabilities with their broader enterprise environments. You will bring delivered depth in at least one cyber product, or in the asset and configuration foundation those products depend on, and the ability to design across adjacent capabilities.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work You’ll Do

Solution architecture & design

• Lead solution architecture and functional/technical design for ServiceNow Cyber programs across Security Incident Response, Unified Security Exposure Management, IRM, Third-Party Risk Management, Business Continuity Management, and AI Control Tower, built on ITAM and ITOM data, including relevant OT security use cases.

• Facilitate discovery workshops with cybersecurity, risk, asset management, infrastructure, security operations, and business stakeholders.

• Translate requirements into architecture diagrams, solution decisions, process flows, integration specifications, and implementation backlogs.

• Define platform approaches for data models, CMDB/CSDM, service relationships, access controls, reporting, integration, and extensibility.

• Evaluate fit-for-purpose configurations, supported extensions, and integration options to minimize unnecessary customization.

• Design connections among Security Incident Response, Unified Security Exposure Management (including Vulnerability Response), HAM Pro, SAM Pro, Discovery, Service Mapping, and IRM risk, control, third-party risk, and business continuity workflows.

Delivery & client leadership

• Run engagements end to end as the accountable day-to-day lead, from scoping and planning through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and transition to operations.

• Provide architectural guidance to developers, technical consultants, and business process specialists.

• Own the engagement’s scope, plan, staffing, risks, and status reporting, along with its design decisions, dependencies, technical estimates, and quality checkpoints. Deliver within the approved plan and hours, and raise any drift early.

• Lead design reviews, solution demonstrations, and integration discussions with client leadership and technical teams.

• Support asset intelligence, infrastructure visibility, and critical-service mapping needed for vulnerability prioritization and cyber resilience.

• Coach Senior Consultants and Consultants through technical reviews, design feedback, and structured knowledge transfer.

Business development & practice development

• Support pursuits through discovery workshops, solution demonstrations, proposals, estimates, and statements of work.

• Contribute repeatable patterns, architecture standards, technical accelerators, and cyber-focused asset and operations offerings.

• Identify opportunities to extend client solutions across risk, security operations, asset lifecycle, and operational visibility.

• Evaluate relevant AI automation, Now Assist, and AI governance opportunities for client use cases, including AI Control Tower.

The team

Our Cyber Strategy & Transformation offering develops and transforms cyber programs in line with client strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. It keeps the enterprise ahead of the evolving threat landscape and gives stakeholders confidence in the organization’s cyber posture. It includes design of the cyber organization, governance, and risk assessments.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

• 6+ years of relevant experience in enterprise technology, cybersecurity, integration, or consulting.

• 6+ years implementing or architecting ServiceNow enterprise solutions.

•  5+ years’ experience as solution architect, technical lead, or implementation lead on complex ServiceNow engagements.

• Led the architecture of at least one of the following through a full implementation, including its integrations. A cyber product: Security Incident Response, Unified Security Exposure Management or Vulnerability Response, IRM, Third-Party Risk Management, Business Continuity Management, or AI Control Tower. Or the asset and configuration foundation those products depend on: HAM Pro, SAM Pro, Discovery, and CMDB/CSDM.

• Knowledge of the business process behind that product, such as incident response, vulnerability and exposure management, control testing, third-party risk assessment, business continuity planning, or asset lifecycle and software compliance, and experience working directly with the teams who run it.

• Experience delivering at least two full-lifecycle ServiceNow implementations.

• Working command of platform architecture and the data foundation that cyber work depends on: CMDB/CSDM, Discovery, asset data, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST APIs, MID Server, and access controls.

• Experience connecting ServiceNow with enterprise security, asset, or infrastructure platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to run a ServiceNow engagement end to end as the day-to-day lead, managing scope, plan, team, and the client relationship through go-live within the approved plan, while leading workshops and producing architecture deliverables.

• Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

• Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred

• ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect (CMA); CSA and CAD; and the Certified Implementation Specialist certification that matches your product.

• CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, or an equivalent security or risk certification.

• Experience with HAM Pro, SAM Pro, ITOM Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and CMDB identification/reconciliation.

• Experience connecting asset and configuration data to security outcomes, such as vulnerability prioritization, end-of-support exposure, or asset ownership for incident response.

• Experience in more than one cyber product: Security Incident Response, Unified Security Exposure Management, IRM, Third-Party Risk Management, Business Continuity Management, or AI Control Tower.

• Familiarity with OT asset discovery, Purdue Model, ISA/IEC 62443, and industrial cybersecurity.

• Integrations with Armis, Veza, Splunk, Sentinel, CrowdStrike, Tenable, Qualys, or comparable platforms.

• Knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NERC CIP, or relevant industry standards.

• Experience with AI-enabled workflows, agentic automation, and AI governance use cases, including AI Control Tower.

It keeps the enterprise a step ahead of the evolving threat landscape and gives stakeholders confidence in the organization's cyber posture. Includes design of the cyber organization, governance, and risk assessments.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

• 4+ years of hands-on ServiceNow implementation and development experience.

• Strong JavaScript development skills and experience with ServiceNow scripting, Flow Designer, application configuration, and APIs.

• Built at least one of the following through a full implementation, including its integrations. A cyber product: Security Incident Response, Unified Security Exposure Management or Vulnerability Response, IRM, TPRM, BCM, or AI Control Tower. Or the asset and configuration foundation those products depend on: HAM Pro, SAM Pro, Discovery, CMDB/CSDM, Service Mapping, or Event Management.

• Working knowledge of the business process the build serves, such as incident response, vulnerability and exposure management, control testing, third-party risk assessment, business continuity planning, or asset lifecycle and software compliance.

• Experience implementing enterprise integrations using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, or comparable approaches.

• Working knowledge of ServiceNow data models, access controls, secure development, and technical delivery standards.

• Experience with full-lifecycle implementation activities, including testing, deployment, and production support.

• Ability to own a workstream’s technical deliverables, explain your technical reasoning clearly, troubleshoot complex issues, and guide other developers.

• Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred

• ServiceNow CAD and CSA; and the Certified Implementation Specialist certification that matches your product.

• Experience with HAM Pro, SAM Pro, ITOM Discovery, Service Mapping, and CMDB/CSDM integration.

• Experience linking asset intelligence and infrastructure dependency data to vulnerability management and security operations.

• Knowledge of Armis, Veza, Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, CrowdStrike, Splunk, or Microsoft Sentinel.

• Experience with ATF, CI/CD, source control, Now Assist, AI Control Tower, or AI-enabled workflows.

Job ID 375998

Position Summary

Cyber ServiceNow Technical Consultant

Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking a ServiceNow Technical Consultant to develop, configure, test, and deploy enterprise solutions across cybersecurity, risk management, IT asset management, and IT operations.

You will work with solution architects, senior technical consultants, and business process specialists to build ServiceNow solutions that strengthen security operations, improve technology asset visibility, connect infrastructure data, and support operational resilience. You will own one deliverable within a workstream at a time, such as an integration, a workflow, or a set of tested stories, and build it under the direction of a Senior Technical Consultant. This role is suited to hands-on developers seeking to deepen their experience with integrated cybersecurity solutions.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work You’ll Do

ServiceNow development & configuration

• Develop, configure, and support ServiceNow applications across Security Incident Response, Unified Security Exposure Management, IRM, TPRM, BCM, AI Control Tower, ITAM, and ITOM.

• Own one deliverable at a time, taking approved user stories and technical designs through to scripts, workflow configurations, and tested application features.

• Develop Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, Flow Designer workflows, and other supported components.

• Configure tables, forms, access controls, notifications, workspaces, reports, and dashboards.

• Follow approved architecture, secure coding, configuration, documentation, and development standards.

Cybersecurity, risk & asset management

• Support implementations of Security Incident Response, Unified Security Exposure Management (including Vulnerability Response), IRM risk and compliance, TPRM, BCM, and related cybersecurity workflows.

• Configure workflows for security incidents, vulnerability remediation, controls monitoring, and risk reporting.

• Support HAM and SAM implementations involving asset records, normalization, lifecycle status, ownership, entitlement data, and software compliance.

• Develop workflows for asset intake, assignment, lifecycle transitions, end-of-life identification, and remediation.

• Support integration of technology asset data with CMDB, vulnerability response, and security operations processes.

IT operations, integration & testing

• Support technical work across Discovery, CMDB, CSDM, Service Mapping, and Event Management, particularly where data supports cyber visibility and resilience.

• Assist with configuration item relationships, identification/reconciliation, Service Graph Connectors, and data quality validation.

• Build and troubleshoot REST/SOAP integrations, IntegrationHub flows, MID Server components, import sets, and transform maps under technical leadership.

• Develop and run unit, integration, and automated tests, and resolve defects through system testing and hypercare.

• Maintain technical designs, configuration records, testing evidence, deployment steps, and handover materials.

• Participate in Agile ceremonies, development reviews, demonstrations, and technical knowledge sharing.

• Explore reusable development approaches, Now Assist, AI Control Tower, and AI-enabled automation relevant to client requirements.

The team

Our Cyber Strategy & Transformation offering develops and transforms cyber programs in line with a client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. It keeps the enterprise a step ahead of the evolving threat landscape and gives stakeholders confidence in the organization's cyber posture. Includes design of the cyber organization, governance, and risk assessments.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

• 2+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development, implementation, or platform configuration experience.

• Practical JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting knowledge, with experience configuring workflows, forms, tables, or access controls.

• Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, XML, and enterprise integration concepts.

• Hands-on build or configuration experience in at least one of the following. A cyber product: Security Incident Response, Unified Security Exposure Management or Vulnerability Response, IRM, TPRM, BCM, or AI Control Tower. Or the asset and configuration foundation those products depend on: HAM, SAM, Discovery, CMDB, or Service Mapping.

• Understanding of development, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and documentation practices.

• Ability to collaborate with technical leads, functional consultants, and client stakeholders.

• Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

• Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred

• ServiceNow CAD and CSA; and a Certified Implementation Specialist certification in a cyber product.

• Experience with Security Incident Response, Unified Security Exposure Management or Vulnerability Response, IRM risk and compliance, TPRM, BCM, HAM Pro, or SAM Pro.

• Experience with ITOM Discovery, CMDB/CSDM, Service Graph Connectors, or Service Mapping.

• Familiarity with IntegrationHub, MID Server, import sets, transform maps, and ATF.

• Exposure to vulnerability scanners, SIEM, EDR, endpoint security, or IT/OT asset discovery tools.

• Basic knowledge of asset lifecycle risk, vulnerability remediation, critical services, or operational resilience.

• Experience with Agile delivery, source control, CI/CD, Now Assist, AI Control Tower, or AI-enabled workflows.

  • Schedule: Full-time

About this job

Deloitte Space is hiring a Lead Product Manager/Architect to shape cybersecurity solutions for commercial satellite operators and space companies. You will define technical vision, architecture standards, and deployment approaches across space, ground, and user segments while leading cross-functional teams.

Good fit if you have 6+ years in product or solution architecture for cyber, aerospace, or mission-critical systems and can translate security requirements into scalable designs.

Full job description

Position Summary

Position Summary

Deloitte Space is expanding flight-proven satellite cybersecurity capabilities and supporting managed services into the commercial space market. Building on flight heritage from Deloitte-1, this role will help scale cyber-resilient solutions for emerging space companies, satellite operators, primes, and large constellation operators.

The Lead Product Manager/ Architect will serve as the senior technical authority for the offering. This role will shape the technical vision, architecture, engineering standards, and delivery roadmap across cyber, software, hardware, AI, space, ground, and user segments. The ideal candidate can translate complex mission and security requirements into scalable, commercially viable solutions that can be deployed repeatably across clients.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Cyber Space Lead Product Manager on the Deloitte Space team, you will be responsible for…

• Define target architectures, interfaces, trust boundaries, security patterns, and the technical roadmap across space, ground, and user segments.

• Establish engineering standards and release-readiness gates; lead technical-vision discussions with clients and executives; guide workstream leads; and make architecture tradeoffs that protect system integrity and mission outcomes.

• Lead integration across cyber, software, hardware, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering teams; resolve dependencies and transition research into production.

• Create repeatable deployment approaches for satellite, constellation, and client-environment variations.

• Direct system-level testing, security validation, mission-readiness, operational acceptance, failure analysis, and delivery controls aligned to Space Attack Research and Tactic Analysis (SPARTA), Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC), National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Authority to Operate (ATO), and Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs).

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

• Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

• Effective written and verbal communication skills

• Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

• Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

• Ability to lead projects or workstreams

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

• Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

• Ability to meet deadlines

• Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

The Deloitte Space team develops cybersecurity and technology offerings for commercial space organizations, satellite operators, and large constellation operators.

The team brings together cyber, software, hardware, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering professionals to create deployable solutions across satellite, ground, and user segments.

Qualifications

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or Information Technology

• 6+ years of experience in product engineering, solution architecture, systems architecture, or technical product leadership delivering cyber, aerospace, space, embedded, or mission-critical systems.

• Experience leading delivery of cyber or space systems to production and operations across cyber, software, hardware, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering workstreams.

• Experience designing secure architectures across cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and space or embedded environments, including identity, key management, secure boot and update, segmentation, data protection, logging, telemetry, and supply-chain controls.

• Authored reference architectures, patterns, or platforms adopted by multiple teams or deployed across multiple client or operating environments.

• Experience translating one or more of the following into delivery controls and system designs: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Authority to Operate (ATO), Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), or Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) requirements.

• Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

• Experience taking a product or platform to market commercially through pilots, co-development, or first-of-kind deployments, or experience with satellite mission operations or aerospace delivery environments.

• Experience with embedded and real-time systems integration, including C, Portable Operating System Interface (POSIX), or real-time operating systems.

• Experience deploying artificial intelligence or machine learning models in constrained environments, including Python or PyTorch.

• Experience using ground-segment, continuous integration/continuous delivery, or DevOps technologies, including Docker, Grafana, MQ Telemetry Transport (MQTT), Node.js, GitHub Actions, automated security scanning, or containerized deployments.

• Background in Space Attack Research and Tactic Analysis (SPARTA) threat frameworks.

• Active security clearance (Secret or higher) for government-adjacent commercial work.

Design, build, and optimize cloud-based data engineering solutions on Databricks for enterprise clients. Lead data architecture projects, establish best practices, and develop teams while working across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of Databricks data engineering experience, 1+ year leading technical teams, and a Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join Deloitte’s AI & Engineering practice and help organizations transform enterprise technology platforms, modernize data environments, and unlock value through innovation. As a Databricks Engineer in our AI & Data practice, you will design, build, and optimize cloud-based data engineering solutions that support large-scale transformation. You will work with business and technology leaders to modernize data platforms, enable analytics and artificial intelligence use cases, and drive measurable business outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to deliver enterprise-scale Databricks solutions that improve performance, expand digital capabilities, and help clients scale data-driven decision-making across the enterprise.

Recruiting for this role ends on 18/05/2027.

Work you’ll do

As a Data Engineer III on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for:

  • Champion Best Practices: Establish, document, and promote best-in-class approaches for data architecture, integration, and modelling
  • Pipeline Ownership: Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of robust data pipelines and data architectures that support large-scale, enterprise data needs
  • Drive Excellence: Initiate and manage efforts to improve data quality, operational efficiency, and process scalability
  • Team and Technology Lead: Evaluate, pilot, and integrate new big data and analytics technologies, ensuring the organization remains at the cutting edge. Lead, coach, and develop teams of data engineers and architects, fostering technical growth and effective project delivery
  • Data Governance: Consult on, design, and implement governance, security, and compliance strategies tailored to modern cloud data ecosystems
  • Communication: Communicate technical concepts and business value to diverse stakeholders, including executives, business leads, and technology teams
  • DevOps and Automation: Oversee the implementation of CI/CD practices with tools such as Azure DevOps, AWS Code Pipeline, Jenkins, TFS, or PowerShell for streamlined deployments and operations

 The successful candidate would possess these skills -

• Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
• Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
• Ability to lead projects or workstreams
• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
• Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
• Ability to meet deadlines
• Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Qualifications 

Required:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering with a focus on Databricks on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Experience with Lakehouse architecture, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, cloud-native databases, storage solutions, and distributed compute platforms
  • Experience with data warehousing, third normal form (3NF), dimensional modeling, enterprise data lakes, incremental data loads, and metadata-driven ingestion and data quality frameworks using PySpark
  • 1+ year leading complex, cross-functional data projects and technical teams, including experience with Delta Live Tables, Autoloader, Structured Streaming, Databricks Workflows, Apache Airflow, Unity Catalog, automated continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and performance optimization of data engineering pipelines, code, and compute resources
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in one or more of AWS, Azure, and GCP cloud ecosystems and associated big data services
  • Experience tuning and optimizing performance in Databricks and Apache Spark environments
  • Experience with Databricks Lakeflow

Experience with artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions

Job ID 375983

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate Manager - Cloud Platform Lead
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Cloud Engineer, IT / Technology, Cybersecurity Analyst
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Cloud Platform Lead designs, builds, and operates the resilient, secure, and automated platforms that host and deliver a large banking client’s cyber capability. The role covers the infrastructure, automation, and data foundations behind security tooling, including log pipelines, security data platforms, and container and cloud environments. It brings strong software and infrastructure engineering skills to reduce complexity, improve reliability, and increase delivery speed. The role works with cybersecurity, infrastructure, and application teams, and applies to AI both to improve platform operations and to support AI workloads.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

  • Design, build, and operate scalable platforms for cyber tooling and data, including security data lakes, log pipelines, and internal developer platforms across on-premises infrastructure, private cloud, and AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Implement infrastructure as code with Terraform, configuration management with Ansible, and continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines for repeatable, auditable platform delivery; automate operational tasks with scripting, application programming interfaces, and event-driven workflows.
  • Operate Kubernetes and container platforms, including hardening, patching, upgrades, observability, service-level objectives, alerting, incident response, post-incident reviews, and Level 3 support.
  • Lead capacity planning and high-availability and disaster-recovery design for mission-critical security services; embed secrets management, least privilege, network segmentation, and compliance evidence in platform designs.
  • Build and operate platform services for artificial intelligence and machine learning workloads, including model serving, vector stores, large language model gateways, machine learning operations and large language model operations pipelines; apply artificial intelligence for IT operations to support incident detection and root-cause analysis.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Experience designing, building, or operating production platforms in Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including hybrid environments, Kubernetes, Linux, and networking.
  • Experience supporting security information and event management (SIEM) platforms, security data lakes, or log pipelines; using Terraform, Ansible, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) tooling, Git, and Python, Go, or Bash; and implementing infrastructure as code (IaC), observability, service-level objectives, alerting, incident response, high availability, and disaster recovery.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Software Developer / Engineer, IT / Technology, Cloud Engineer
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Fort Lauderdale, FL
  • Experience: 6+ years

About this job

Design, build, and operate secure Google Cloud platforms for banking clients as a Lead Managed Services Engineer II. Responsibilities include GCP infrastructure architecture, Terraform and CI/CD pipeline development, GKE and Cloud Run operations, security integration, and enabling AI workloads with appropriate controls.

Good fit if you have 6+ years in cloud platform engineering or DevOps with GCP experience, proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools, and knowledge of IAM, VPC Service Controls, and Kubernetes.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Cloud Platform DevOps Engineer with designs, builds, and operates secure, compliant, and highly automated Google Cloud platforms for a large banking client. The role owns the landing zone, guardrails, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD capabilities that let engineering teams deliver workloads quickly and safely. It combines cloud platform engineering with DevOps & DevSecOps and site reliability practices, embedding security controls by default. The role works with cybersecurity, cloud, application, and risk teams, and applies AI to platform operations while enabling secure AI workloads on GCP.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Design and engineer the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) organization hierarchy, folders, projects, Shared Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), and hybrid connectivity; implement organization policies, Identity and Access Management (IAM), VPC Service Controls, Cloud Key Management Service (Cloud KMS), and Cloud Armor as secure-by-default reference architectures.
  • Build and maintain Terraform modules, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab, or Cloud Build, embedded security gates, and GitOps workflows for platform delivery.
  • Operate Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and Cloud Run platforms using hardened baselines, image signing, and secrets management; drive reliability through monitoring, service level objectives (SLOs), incident response, and disaster recovery.
  • Integrate Security Command Center, Cloud Logging, and security information and event management (SIEM) tooling with cyber operations; implement policy-as-code, drift detection, and automated compliance evidence.
  • Enable Vertex AI and Gemini workloads with network isolation, access controls, data governance, and logging; apply artificial intelligence operations (AIOps) and AI-assisted engineering tools under appropriate controls, including review and validation of outputs, to improve incident triage and pipeline quality.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Cyber Operate team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation, and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive Secure.Vigilant.Resilient.™ cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in cloud platform engineering, DevOps, or site reliability engineering, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP) implementation experience and experience designing landing zones, Shared Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), or hub-and-spoke network architectures.
  • Experience building and operating GCP infrastructure and delivery pipelines using Terraform or CloudFormation; Git, GitOps, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools, GitHub Actions, GitLab, or Cloud Build; Python, Bash, or Go; Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, Kubernetes, Helm, Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus, or Grafana; and batch or streaming services such as Dataflow, Dataproc, or Pub/Sub.
  • Experience implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM), VPC Service Controls, Security Command Center, Cloud Key Management Service, Cloud Armor, Cloud Audit Logs, static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), infrastructure-as-code and container scanning, secrets management, software supply chain controls, service level objectives, incident response, disaster recovery, policy-as-code, drift detection, compliance evidence automation, and Vertex AI or Gemini workload controls.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 day per week times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Google Cloud certifications: Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, or Professional Cloud Security Engineer.
  • Experience delivering cloud platforms in GCP and Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Experience applying cloud control requirements associated with the Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC), New York State Department of Financial Services (NYDFS), Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), or Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX).
  • Master's degree.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Are you a Sales Executive (SE) with an entrepreneurial mindset, proven experience in managed services, and a track record of driving complex, outcome-focused sales? If so, Deloitte Consulting LLP is seeking a high-performing client relationship and solutions Sales Executive to lead the pursuit and growth of clients within our Operate practice, which focuses on selling Application management, Infrastructure, Data, Cloud, Cyber, Engineering and BPaaS services.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/16/2026. 

Work you’ll do

  • Build and nurture executive-level client relationships and current and greenfield clients, serving as a trusted advisor on managed services and outcome-based solutions that drive operational transformation and efficiency.
  • Drive significant growth of the Deloitte Operate pipeline by identifying, developing, and advise on closing opportunities in the Health Care sector, with a focus on Health Care Payers and Providers.

  • An ability to gain access and influence decision-makers at all levels in client organizations.
  • 10+ years’ experience managing complex client relationships and generating IT outsourcing deals, preferably in managed services.
  • Proven track record in meeting/exceeding a quota in a Sales Executive role.
  • Demonstrated experience selling to and serving clients in the Health Care sector (Payers or Providers).

  • Ability to travel up to 60%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients/industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Proven track record in selling managed/outsourced solutions, with experience navigating long sales cycles and large deals.
