Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Human Capital team helps organizations create value through people performance. We work with clients to reimagine work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise and to transform their HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today’s world, you will help clients answer questions like: How do I access, develop, and motivate my workforce? What should my AI strategy be for the HR function? Do I have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to make work better for humans and humans better at work.

Recruiting for this role ends on 09/30/2026.

Work You'll Do

As a Senior Consultant on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading the design, coordination, and delivery of Oracle HCM Cloud technical integrations across enterprise systems
  • Defining integration strategy and overseeing inbound/outbound interfaces, middleware coordination, data mapping, and end-to-end validation
  • Partnering with HR, security, and technology stakeholders to ensure solutions are aligned to functional, technical, and compliance requirements
  • Leading data conversion planning and execution, including extraction, cleansing, transformation, load support, reconciliation, and cutover readiness
  • Managing technical risks, dependencies, defects, and issue resolution across integrations and conversions throughout the project lifecycle
  • Supporting testing, deployment, go-live, and post-production stabilization to help ensure successful Oracle HCM Cloud implementation outcomes

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our HR Strategy & Technology offering develops leading global HR strategies and implements HR technologies that drive transformation, maximize the workforce experience, and sustain HR effectiveness and value while navigating a world of disruption.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience delivering Oracle HCM Cloud technical solutions
  • 2+ years of experience with leading the integrations for a full-life cycle implementation of Oracle Cloud HCM
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance for this role
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Experience delivering across multiple Oracle HCM Cloud implementations within large-scale, multi-stakeholder public sector programs supporting 10,000+ employees
  • Experience in government and public sector implementations
  • Oracle HCM Cloud certified

Position Summary

Physical AI Senior Manager – Manufacturing & Supply Chain 

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don’t miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce! 

Recruiting for this role ends on 2/14/2027 

The team 

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value. 

Work You’ll Do 

  • Lead Physical AI strategy and advisory for manufacturing and supply chain clients, identifying high-value use cases and translating value hypotheses into roadmaps and business cases.  
  • Shape end-to-end solutions and architectures across sensing, vision, data, models, simulation, edge deployment, and MLOps/ModelOps, with clear operational acceptance criteria.  
  • Drive PoCs and pilots to measurable outcomes by defining experiments, data strategies, evaluation metrics, and scale-up plans, while addressing real-world OT/IT, safety, reliability, cybersecurity, and operating constraints.  
  • Advance client delivery and market growth through partner-ready architectures and assets, pursuit and proposal support, executive workshops, and leadership and mentoring of multidisciplinary teams. 

A successful candidate would possess these skills: 

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team 
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills 
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead workstreams 
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment 
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines 
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others 

Qualifications 

Required 

  • 10+ years of relevant experience, including client leadership, team leadership, and sustained contribution to business development/pursuits. 
  • Experience in at least two of the following domains: 
    • Computer vision for industrial environments (e.g., inspection, defect detection, safety, tracking, manufacturing assembly) 
    • Robotics and autonomy (e.g., industrial robotics, mobile robotics and AMRs, perception-to-action workflows) 
    • Simulation, digital twins, physics-based modeling for factories, lines, cells, warehousing, and logistics (e.g., discrete event, physics, MILP) 
    • Synthetic data generation and validation approaches for model development
    • Edge AI deployment (e.g., performance, reliability, lifecycle operations) 
  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Manufacturing and supply chain domain experience in areas such as discrete or process manufacturing, quality systems, maintenance and reliability, intralogistics, warehouse operations, plant OT/IT constraints, safety, and compliance. 
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. 

Preferred 

  • Collaborate with technology partners—including NVIDIA, Siemens, AWS, and similar ecosystems—to translate platforms into client-ready architectures and programs; compare and compose solutions across vendor stacks. 
  • Bring manufacturing and supply chain technology experience across IIoT and sensing, process and product optimization, automation and controls, fleet operations, data science, and OT cybersecurity. 
  • Lead client-facing advisory, PoCs, and implementations from requirements and acceptance criteria through deployment and operational handover. 
  • Design production governance and operating models for Physical AI, including monitoring and drift management, incident response, data management, human oversight, and safety integration; create reusable accelerators, reference architectures, demos, or other thought leadership. 
  • Hold a relevant graduate degree (MS/PhD) and contribute to business development through pipeline creation, proposal leadership, account growth, and executive stakeholder management.

Job.JobTitle: SAP AI Transformation – Manager – SAP Finance
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 8+ years

About this job

Manager role in Deloitte's SAP practice focused on SAP Finance, leading Agentic ERP transformations for clients. Responsibilities include managing SAP S/4HANA FICO implementations, directing client workshops, overseeing data migration and cutover, and advising on finance process transformation using AI-enabled approaches.

Good fit if you have 8+ years SAP consulting or ERP implementation experience, led 2+ SAP FICO workstreams, and have 3+ years hands-on FICO functional configuration.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join Deloitte’s SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You’ll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

In this SAP AI Transformation role, you’ll contribute to Agentic ERP transformations that help clients advance toward the autonomous enterprise. Combining SAP expertise with AI-enabled delivery approaches, cross-functional collaboration, and industry insight, you’ll help address complex business challenges and create measurable client impact.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/15/2027.

Work you’ll do

As a Manager in Deloitte’s SAP practice, with a focus on SAP Finance, you will work side by side with functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact solutions that support Agentic ERP transformations. With Deloitte Ascend™, you’ll leverage AI accelerators and SAP capabilities to help clients modernize business processes and advance toward the autonomous enterprise.

This role requires a highly motivated professional who moves with speed and precision, builds practical solutions, and engages confidently with senior stakeholders and delivery teams to help generate measurable business impact.

  • Lead delivery of SAP Finance and Controlling implementations, managing integrated work plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, resources, and deliverable quality across workstreams.
  • Direct client workshops—including opportunity identification, fit-to-standard, solution design, and playback—to align business and technical stakeholders and drive timely decisions.
  • Guide the translation of finance requirements into SAP S/4HANA designs, overseeing functional design and configuration across relevant FICO areas, including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, and Profitability Analysis.
  • Manage cross-functional integration across procurement, sales, supply chain, tax, treasury, reporting, and other relevant workstreams; resolve dependencies and escalate decisions when needed.
  • Oversee data migration, testing, defect resolution, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization, ensuring readiness and quality gates are addressed.
  • Advise clients on finance-process transformation, including AI-enabled and automated improvements to close, reporting, controls, analytics, and performance; apply Deloitte Ascend™ accelerators where appropriate and ensure human review of AI-generated outputs.
  • Serve as a trusted day-to-day advisor to business and senior client stakeholders, communicating delivery status, risks, decisions, and recommendations and driving alignment on next steps.
  • Lead and coach engagement team members, set expectations, review work products, and support resource planning and performance; contribute to proposals, estimates, reusable assets, and SAP Offering development.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations to enable an Autonomous Enterprise. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree; or an associate degree and 10+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), or consulting experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • 8+ years of experience in SAP consulting, ERP implementation, or SAP/ERP technology transformation in consulting or industry.
  • Experience supporting 3+ full-lifecycle SAP implementations from initiation through go-live and hypercare; leading an SAP FICO workstream or workstream area on 2+ implementations; and delivering SAP S/4HANA FICO activities on 2+ implementation, transformation, or migration programs.
  • 3+ years of hands-on SAP FICO functional configuration and business process design experience in one or more of the following areas: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, or Profitability Analysis.
  • Experience leading and coaching engagement team members on 2+ SAP implementation or transformation programs, including setting expectations, assigning work, reviewing work products, providing feedback, and supporting resource planning.
  • Experience leading client finance stakeholder workshops on 2+ SAP implementation or transformation programs to document requirements and design decisions and guide SAP Finance configuration, testing, or deployment.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Experience applying artificial intelligence (AI) tools—including generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning, conversational AI, or AI agents—to enterprise transformation, including solution design, implementation, testing, or human-in-the-loop review and validation.
  • Experience supporting SAP cloud programs or SAP transformation programs deployed across multiple countries.
  • Experience applying SAP Activate, Agile, or Waterfall methodologies on SAP implementation programs.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, estimates, solution designs, or client presentations.
  • Experience coaching or mentoring junior team members and reviewing their work products.
  • One or more SAP certifications.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 to $265,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Capital Projects Senior Consultant - Data Centers
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $110,700 to $218,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 4+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Consultant advising clients on data center capital projects across the full lifecycle, from feasibility through operational handover. Lead workstreams on development and expansion programs, managing delivery, cost, schedule, risk, and working with design teams, contractors, and operations staff.

Good fit if you have 4+ years in capital projects or construction, experience with Primavera P6, knowledge of data center systems, and can travel up to 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team delivers integrated, end-to-end support and advisory services covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. Work alongside clients every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and provide practical solutions at every stage of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.

Do you want to help clients identify key business issues to drive meaningful change? Join our team of Infrastructure & Capital Projects professionals who bring industry experience, innovation, and specialized knowledge to help our clients make the best decision for their business. Are you interested in helping clients answer critical, mission-based questions such as ‘how do we complete major infrastructure projects on-time and within budget?’ and ‘how do we make use of new technologies to improve the construction process?’ If you are seeking a role that offers you the opportunity to create value and minimize risk for our clients, while allowing you to develop personally and professionally, consider a career at Deloitte!

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.

Work you’ll do

As a Senior Consultant on the Capital Projects team, you will be responsible for:

  • Advising clients on data center capital projects across the project lifecycle, including feasibility and site assessments, utility coordination, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handover.
  • Leading workstreams for data center development, expansion, and upgrade programs, helping clients manage delivery, cost, schedule, risk, and project governance.
  • Assessing project plans, controls, schedules, and risks, including dependencies on utility power and long-lead equipment such as substations, switchgear, UPS, generators, chillers, and cooling systems.
  • Reviewing and analyzing project schedules, construction documents, and design information to identify constructability, coordination, sequencing, and delivery risks; partnering with technical design authorities as needed.
  • Supporting project cost and schedule assurance, risk analysis, procurement planning, change management, data analytics, and actionable performance reporting.
  • Supporting commissioning and operational readiness by reviewing plans, test documentation, integrated systems testing, and turnover processes.
  • Working with client stakeholders, design teams, contractors, equipment vendors, utility providers, and operations teams to resolve issues and advance project outcomes.
  • Leading teams and workstreams; providing coaching, oversight, and support to delivery teams and staff.
  • Supporting proposal development, client relationship development, business development, and practice recruiting and staffing efforts.

A successful candidate would possess these skills: 

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Infrastructure and Real Estate team are trusted advisors to clients in managing physical assets throughout their lifecycle.  We help them unlock value from their real estate portfolios and functions by developing strategies, optimizing operating models and organizational design, and leveraging technology enablement. 

Qualifications required

  • Bachelor’s degree in architecture, engineering or construction management, or a related field
  • 4+ years of experience supporting capital projects, construction, or project delivery, including data center, mission-critical facilities, or similarly complex infrastructure or building projects
  • Experience with project controls and schedule development or analysis using Primavera P6
  • Experience working on major construction projects, including reviewing and analyzing construction documents
  • Experience assessing cost, schedule, risk, procurement, or project governance processes
  • Familiarity with data center project interfaces across electrical power, mechanical cooling, controls, and building systems
  • Experience in business development, strategic planning, and managing client relationships
  • Experience supervising, training, and developing junior staff on client requirements as well as assessing staff performance
  • Experience using artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools and digital technologies to improve efficiency, support analysis, and enhance the quality of work products

Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. Position Summary

Physical AI Manager – Manufacturing & Supply Chain

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don’t miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

Recruiting for this role ends on 2/14/2027

The team

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

Work You’ll Do

You will serve as the functional and domain expert for Physical AI—where AI meets the physical world—across manufacturing and supply chain operations. You will help shape advisory engagements, drive workstreams within proofs of concept (PoCs), and support implementation programs that combine robotics, computer vision, simulation, digital twins, synthetic data, and edge AI, frequently in partnership with ecosystem alliance providers (e.g., NVIDIA, Siemens, AWS and others). Candidates should be comfortable in factories, warehouses, and client conference rooms, and able to translate between controls engineers, data scientists, and frontline operations.

Key responsibilities 

  • Support Physical AI strategy and advisory for manufacturing and supply chain clients. Help identify high-value use cases (e.g., quality inspection, safety, intralogistics, material handling, asset monitoring, autonomous operations), develop value hypotheses, and translate to roadmaps and business cases.
  • Contribute to solution shaping and end-to-end architecture spanning sensors, vision, data pipelines, model development, simulation, edge deployment, and operations (i.e., MLOps and ModelOps).
  • Drive PoC and pilot workstreams to measurable outcomes. Define experiments, data collection plans, synthetic data approaches (when appropriate), and evaluation metrics, and contribute to scale plans from pilot-to-plant and factory/network rollout.
  • Apply real-world constraints to AI solutions: latency, reliability, safety, OT/IT connectivity, cybersecurity, model drift, human-in-the-loop workflows, and maintenance/operating model considerations.
  • Collaborate with alliances and product teams to translate partner platforms into draft reference architectures, demos, and repeatable delivery assets.
  • Contribute to pursuits and proposals: support scoping, estimating, staffing, risk and assumption framing, and executive-level storytelling. 
  • Manage and develop day-to-day delivery teams: data science, ML engineering, software and edge, vision, robotics and controls, and manufacturing experts, and contribute to capability-building and market activation.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

Qualifications 

Required 

  • 6+ years of relevant experience, including client leadership, team leadership, and sustained contribution to business development/pursuits. 
  • Experience in at least two of the following domains: 
    • Computer vision for industrial environments (e.g., inspection, defect detection, safety, tracking, manufacturing assembly) 
    • Robotics and autonomy (e.g., industrial robotics, mobile robotics and AMRs, perception-to-action workflows) 
    • Simulation, digital twins, physics-based modeling for factories, lines, cells, warehousing, and logistics (e.g., discrete event, physics, MILP) 
    • Synthetic data generation and validation approaches for model development
    • Edge AI deployment (e.g., performance, reliability, lifecycle operations) 
  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Manufacturing and supply chain domain experience in areas such as discrete or process manufacturing, quality systems, maintenance and reliability, intralogistics, warehouse operations, plant OT/IT constraints, safety, and compliance. 
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred

  • Experience collaborating with technology partners (e.g., NVIDIA, Siemens, AWS, and/or similar ecosystems) to translate platforms into deliverable architectures and programs, including hands-on experience with NVIDIA and Siemens tooling relevant to Physical AI.
  • Exposure to manufacturing and supply chain technology such as sensing and IIoT connectivity, process and product optimization, automation and process control, fleet operations, machine learning and data science, cybersecurity for OT
  • Demonstrated experience supporting client-facing advisory, PoCs, and implementations (not just research), including requirements, acceptance criteria, and operational handover.
  • Graduate degree (MS/PhD) in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Applied Physics, Operations Research, or related field.
  • Familiarity with governance and operating models for Physical AI in production, such as model monitoring and drift, incident response, data management, human-in-the-loop, and safety and controls integration.
  • Contribution to reusable accelerators, reference architectures, demo assets, publications, or enablement materials, and experience supporting business development (e.g., proposal contributions, account expansion).

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate Manager - Cloud Identity Platform Engineer
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Cloud Engineer, IT / Technology, Cybersecurity Analyst
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Cloud Identity Platform Engineer designs, builds, hardens, and operates Active Directory and hybrid identity services for a large banking client. The role creates and tests Active Directory in AWS, both AWS Managed Microsoft AD and client-managed, and documents the deployment and management standards that govern it. It also applies AD hardening, tiering, and attack path reduction, supports hybrid identity with Entra ID and privileged access controls, and troubleshoots client issues. The role partners with cybersecurity, infrastructure, privileged access, and application teams, and applies AI to identity analysis and engineering with peer review.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Design, build, test, and manage Active Directory environments in Amazon Web Services (AWS), including AWS Managed Microsoft AD and client-managed Active Directory.
  • Configure Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS), Domain Name System (DNS), and Group Policy; document deployment and management standards, including entitlement delegation, organizational unit design, user and group management, and backup and restore procedures.
  • Apply Active Directory tiering, hardening, and attack-path reduction; use PowerShell, BloodHound, PingCastle, and Purple Knight to identify and remediate configuration issues; and partner with the security operations center (SOC) on identity detections using Defender for Identity, CrowdStrike Identity Protection, Semperis, or Silverfort.
  • Support hybrid identity and application integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, privileged access management (PAM), multifactor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), federation, Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), and Kerberos/New Technology LAN Manager (NTLM) authentication; integrate identity services with automation workflows, security information and event management (SIEM) event collection, and security tooling.
  • Troubleshoot client issues affecting AWS Active Directory, including Domain Name System (DNS) and virtual local area network (VLAN) connectivity, using event data and diagnostic methods; document root causes and resolutions; and support business needs that may require work outside standard business hours.
  • Apply artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted analysis to attack-path and entitlement reviews, use AI-assisted scripting with peer review and testing, and govern non-human and AI-agent identities through least-privilege access, named owners, and review dates.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in identity and access management, Active Directory engineering, or security engineering.
  • Experience designing, deploying, testing, or managing Active Directory in Amazon Web Services (AWS), including AWS Managed Microsoft AD and client-managed Active Directory; Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS), Domain Name System (DNS), and Group Policy; and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, including Terraform, for AWS storage, network, infrastructure, compute, load-balancing, and database services.
  • Experience with Active Directory tiering, hardening, attack-path reduction, organizational unit (OU) design, entitlement delegation, user and group management, backup and recovery, hybrid identity, Microsoft Entra ID, privileged access management (PAM), multifactor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), federation, Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), Kerberos, New Technology LAN Manager (NTLM), PowerShell, BloodHound, PingCastle, Purple Knight, virtual local area networks (VLANs), event collection, automation workflows, security information and event management (SIEM) integrations, Active Directory incident troubleshooting, and one or more of the following: Defender for Identity, CrowdStrike Identity Protection, Semperis, or Silverfort.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • One or more of the following certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or Google Cloud Certified - Professional Cloud Security Engineer.
  • Experience authoring deployment standards, runbooks, or operational documentation for identity services.
  • Experience applying artificial intelligence-assisted analysis or scripting to identity engineering workflows with peer review and testing.

Position Summary

Are you ready to help organizations deliver benefits experiences that support their people and business priorities? As a Senior Consultant in Total Rewards, Benefits Administration, you will help clients assess, improve, and transform benefits-administration processes, technology, and service delivery.     • Effective written and verbal communication skills

Deloitte's Total Rewards practice helps organizations address the people, process, technology, and governance considerations that shape their rewards and benefits programs. Required:

    • 3+ years of experience analyzing business processes, documenting requirements, or supporting system implementation activities.
    • Experience creating client-ready presentations, process documentation, project plans, or status reports using Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Excel, or Microsoft Word.

  • Experience supporting benefits-administration technology implementations or optimization initiatives.

Position Summary

Performance Improvement & Restructuring Working Capital Senior Consultant

Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. We offer comprehensive end-to-end support and advisory services, covering areas such as valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. The team works closely with clients at every stage of their journey, helping them navigate challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and implement practical solutions before, during, and after major transformational projects or transactions creating lasting impact.

Join Deloitte's Working Capital team within the Turnaround & Restructuring group of the Performance Improvement & Restructuring offering, where you will help clients unlock liquidity, improve cash flow, and execute critical transformations. Bring your analytical and consulting experience to complex client situations and help deliver practical, data-driven outcomes.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work You’ll Do

As a Senior Consultant, Working Capital, on the Turnaround & Restructuring team, you will be responsible for:

  • Analyzing transaction-level financial and operational data to identify working-capital improvement opportunities across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Forecast-to-Fulfill processes.
  • Developing data visualizations, dashboards, and integrated reports that help project teams and clients evaluate business questions, monitor performance, and make informed decisions.
  • Assessing process maturity, cash-flow optimization, and forecasting practices; identifying opportunities to improve receivables, payables, inventory, and cash management.
  • Supporting the design and implementation of operational, working-capital, and cash-management frameworks that sustain tactical improvements and cash-generation outcomes.
  • Contributing to multidisciplinary project teams, client meetings, pursuits, and practice-development initiatives while managing priorities across multiple workstreams.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

PI&R defines and leads enterprise Board and C-Suite agendas for non-distressed, underperforming, and distressed clients to improve margins, operational and financial performance, navigate financial difficulties, and improve cashflow to fund critical transformations.

Within PI&R, the Turnaround & Restructuring market offering helps companies, acquirers, private equity firms, boards, management teams, and other stakeholders address liquidity, operational, and performance challenges. The Working Capital team uses transaction-level analysis, cash forecasting, process assessments, and implementation support to identify and realize cash opportunities across order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, and forecast-to-fulfill. Working with multidisciplinary Deloitte teams, professionals help clients strengthen receivables, payables, inventory, and cash-management practices during transformation, turnaround, and restructuring situations.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, or Computer Science
  • 4+ years of work experience in working capital, performance improvement, supply chain/inventory optimization, sourcing/procurement, or sales/accounts receivable; or a graduate degree and 2+ years of work experience in these areas.
  • 3+ years participating in and delivering performance improvement initiatives or projects involving supply chain/inventory optimization, sourcing/procurement, or sales/accounts receivable that deliver cost reduction or increased cash flow.
  • 3+ years of experience extracting, mining, and visualizing datasets using Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Access, Structured Query Language (SQL), Alteryx, Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, or QlikView; experience using Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting negotiations and facilitating stakeholder discussions, and 2+ years of experience presenting to executives in a professional services setting.
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

  • Experience preparing written analyses and presentation materials for executive audiences.

Job.JobTitle: Software Engineer II - Full-stack Developer with Anthropic Experience
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Software Engineer II with Anthropic AI Experience, AI & Engineering/Engineering as a Service

Agentic AI is moving from experimentation to production, and organizations everywhere are racing to figure out how to build it responsibly and at scale. We're growing a team of engineers who want to work at the center of that shift: designing and building autonomous, multi-agent systems powered by Anthropic's Claude models for some of the world's largest organizations.

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/30/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Consultant, Software Engineer II, on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and delivering full-stack software and AI-enabled solutions for client engagements.

  • Design, build, test, and maintain scalable full-stack features across front-end and back-end systems.
  • Develop and support microservices, application programming interfaces, continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines, containerized workloads, and infrastructure as code.
  • Integrate large language model platforms and generative artificial intelligence application programming interfaces, including Anthropic Claude, to deliver context-aware features, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, tool-calling workflows, and automation solutions.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions, estimate work, and contribute to code reviews.
  • Troubleshoot defects, improve application performance, write automated tests, and support production readiness activities, including incident response and on-call rotations.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on full-stack development, including 3+ years of full system lifecycle development from requirements through production deployment.
  • 3+ years of experience designing, developing and delivering AI/ML solutions
  • At least 6 months of hands-on experience developing agentic AI solutions using Claude Agent SDK including agent orchestration, tool integration, permissions or MCP integration
  • At least 6 months of hands-on experience developing and deploying production solutions using Anthropic Claude models
  • At least 6 months of experience applying prompt engineering, context engineering, structured outputs and related techniques to improve the performance, reliability and usability of AI solutions
  • 3+ years of hands-on full-stack development experience using at least one back-end language such as Python, Java, .NET, Go, or Node.js and at least one modern front-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • 2+ years of experience in a client-facing development role, including 2+ years building and consuming Representational State Transfer (REST) and/or GraphQL application programming interfaces.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform, including Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, and one year of hands-on experience integrating Anthropic Claude application programming interfaces into software applications in a commercial setting.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or another technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment using tools such as Jira or Linear.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or a portfolio demonstrating software development work.
  • Industry-recognized cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Developer, Azure Developer Associate, or Google Cloud Professional Developer.

About this job

Lead digital asset transformation engagements for financial services clients at Deloitte's AI & Engineering team. Develop strategies for stablecoins, tokenized securities, blockchain payments, and advise on platform integration with core banking systems.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in financial services strategy or consulting, 6+ years in digital assets or blockchain, and 4+ years leading teams.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 04/19/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Manager, Digital Assets Transformation on the AI & Engineering, Industry Solutions team, you will be responsible for:

Lead engagements and major workstreams for banks, broker-dealers, asset managers, and market infrastructure clients.

  • Develop digital asset strategies, business cases, and target-state operating models for stablecoins, tokenized deposits, tokenized securities and funds, real-world assets, institutional custody and trading, and blockchain-based payments and settlement.
  • Guide functional design, platform design, and integration of digital asset capabilities with core banking and capital markets platforms.
  • Structure problems, test hypotheses, develop recommendations, review deliverables, and present findings to senior client executives.
  • Build client relationships, contribute to proposals and thought leadership, identify follow-on opportunities, and coach junior team members.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our AI and Engineering, Industry Solutions offering provides verticalized solutions that transform how clients sell products, deliver services, generate growth, and execute mission-critical operations. We deliver integrated business expertise with scalable, repeatable technology solutions specifically engineered for each sector.

Deloitte’s Financial Services Industry consulting practice is the largest in the world, serving over 90% of Fortune 500 banking, insurance, securities, investment management, and real estate companies.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 8+ years of experience in strategy, operations, product, or business and technology transformation within a management consulting firm or financial institution, including a bank, broker-dealer, asset manager, or payments company
  • 6+ years of experience in digital assets, blockchain, or tokenization, including stablecoins, tokenized deposits or securities, crypto custody and trading, or blockchain-based payments and settlement, within a consulting firm, financial institution, or digital asset company
  • 6+ years of experience delivering banking or capital markets consulting engagements or technology transformation initiatives for financial institutions, including functional design, target-state definition, and end-to-end execution across the project lifecycle; or 6+ years of industry experience in payments, treasury, securities services, or market infrastructure
  • 4+ years of experience leading teams or major workstreams, reviewing deliverables, coordinating work across business and engineering teams, managing client relationships, presenting recommendations to senior client executives, contributing to proposal responses and thought leadership, and coaching junior team members
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience defining problem statements, developing approaches when project scope or requirements are not fully defined, and influencing stakeholders without direct reporting relationships in matrixed organizations
  • Experience conducting quantitative and qualitative research, market sizing, and business case development for digital asset products
  • Experience creating executive presentations, target operating models, and roadmaps for business and technical audiences
  • Experience applying regulatory, risk, and compliance requirements to digital asset initiatives, including federal stablecoin legislation; Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) oversight; bank regulatory guidance on crypto activities; Bank Secrecy Act/Anti-Money Laundering (BSA/AML) and Travel Rule requirements; sanctions screening; and Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) frameworks
  • Experience in one or more digital asset domains, including stablecoins and tokenized deposits, tokenized securities and funds, institutional custody, digital asset trading and prime services, or blockchain-based cross-border payments; and experience with public and permissioned blockchain networks, smart contracts, wallet and key management, custody models, interoperability, digital asset and market infrastructure platforms (e.g., Fireblocks, Anchorage, BitGo, Paxos, Circle, Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Broadridge DLR, Kinexys), and their integration with core banking, treasury, or capital markets systems. Experience with Ethereum or Canton is preferred.
  • Advanced degree (e.g., Master of Business Administration (MBA), Master of Science in Engineering (M.S. Engineering), or equivalent) or relevant professional certification (e.g., Project Management Professional (PMP), Six Sigma, Lean, Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), or a blockchain or digital asset credential)

Job.JobTitle: Specialist Lead, Government Client Contracts Management (Fed Health)
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $84,300 to $140,600 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Manage the full contract lifecycle for federal health clients, including reviewing executed awards, modifications, and compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulations. Lead contract administration, coordinate with account teams, and support proposal development and negotiation.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of government contract management experience and knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulations and multiple contract types.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Prime Contracts team is responsible for the reviewing and processing of all fully executed net new awards, option periods, and contract modifications as well as coordination for at risk items for the Deloitte GPS Practice. This position requires a strong working knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulations, and commercial contracting principles. Supports the execution of all facets of the contract life cycle. Performs contract administration duties for federal contracts and ensures the accuracy of the contracts and financial systems. Exercises increased independence and judgment in reviewing and analyzing moderately complex contracts actions. Maintains a keen awareness of requirements and status associated with assigned contracts. Effectively, manages personal portfolio and advises account teams on contracts administration matters. Compiles and analyzes contract related data; and maintains historical information and documentation.

Work you'll do

As a Specialist Lead, Government Client Contracts Management on the Prime Contracts team, you will be responsible for...

  • Proactively provides support to the development, review, and negotiation of contracts, modifications, prime contractor NDA and teaming agreements and subcontracts consistent with company policies.
  • Ensure contract data is entered into appropriate forms and databases. Checks existence, accuracy, and completeness of electronic documents and contract systems related data.
  • Reviews Federal solicitations, requests for information, quotes, proposals, and identifies business risks, documents the findings, and provides recommendations.
  • Has a keen understanding and knowledge of key terms and conditions of assigned contracts that would affect performance or compliance with the ability to convey salient information to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Prepares standard contract language (e.g., technical/price assumptions, certifications & representations, proposal questions, organizational conflict of interest certificates, etc.) for inclusion into proposals.
  • Receives and interprets federal customers' post submission, proposal clarifications and/or deficiencies. Completes distribution of questions to the proposal team/awaits inputs, assists with the coordination of proposal changes. Remits revised proposal offer to the Contracting Officer.
  • Develop relationships with external client stakeholders and attend industry and government events.
  • Collaborate and coordinate across GPS teams to provide comprehensive solutions and insights to internal and external clients related to contracts portfolio.
  • Reviews for compliance with federal contract regulations and various reporting requirements.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

The Prime Contracts team is responsible for contract management and administration supporting accounts across Deloitte’s Government and Public Services practice. This role will work directly with Contracts professionals, Project Engagement Leadership, Enterprise Solutions points of contact, and other internal and external stakeholders to coordinate the information and decisions required to support compliant contract management and operational execution.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of experience in contract management, contract administration, or government contracting support
  • Exposure to multiple contract types (e.g. FFP, LH, T&M, CPFF) and solicitation types (e.g. FAR Parts 8, 15, and 16)
  • Ability to travel 5-15%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting contracts within the Federal environment
  • Experience with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) requirements
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM) certification

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

  • Lead the development of customer experience and experience management solutions that align business priorities, operating models, data, and technology.
  • Advise stakeholders on Qualtrics solution architecture, including survey programs, workflows, data models, reporting, and governance.
  • Direct end-to-end design, configuration, quality assurance, and deployment of Qualtrics solutions across customer, employee, and product experience programs.
  • Support integrations between Qualtrics and customer relationship management (CRM), human resources information systems (HRIS), data warehouse, and other enterprise platforms using application programming interfaces (APIs), web services, and single sign-on (SSO).
  • Lead multidisciplinary delivery teams, manage client relationships and delivery risks, and contribute to experience management proposals and practice development.

Our Customer Strategy & Design team discovers, designs, and prototypes customer growth strategies and innovation portfolios.

Job.JobTitle: SAP AI Transformation - Consultant – SAP BAIP
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Join Deloitte’s SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You’ll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

In this SAP AI Transformation role, you’ll contribute to Agentic ERP transformations that help clients advance toward the autonomous enterprise. Combining SAP expertise with AI-enabled delivery approaches, cross-functional collaboration, and industry insight, you’ll help address complex business challenges and create measurable client impact.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/15/2027.

Work you’ll do

As a Consultant in Deloitte’s SAP practice, with a focus on SAP Business AI Platform (BAIP), you will work side by side with functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact solutions that support Agentic ERP transformations. With Deloitte Ascend™, you’ll leverage AI accelerators and SAP capabilities to help clients modernize business processes and advance toward the autonomous enterprise.

This role requires a highly motivated professional who moves with speed and precision, builds practical solutions, and engages confidently with senior stakeholders and delivery teams to help generate measurable business impact.

  • Support assigned SAP Business AI Platform (BAIP) implementation tasks, such as configuration, testing, documentation, and issue resolution, under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Help translate documented business and technical requirements into solution components using relevant SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and SAP artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities.
  • Prepare materials for fit-to-standard, requirements, and solution-design workshops; participate in discussions; and document decisions and follow-up actions.
  • Track assigned activities, dependencies, risks, and open issues, and escalate concerns to the appropriate team lead.
  • Support testing and validation of BAIP solutions, document results, and assist with defect resolution.
  • Work with functional and technical team members across supply chain, commercial, finance, and other areas to support BAIP integration with end-to-end business processes.
  • Contribute to project documentation, proposals, and reusable assets, and share knowledge with teammates.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations to enable an Autonomous Enterprise. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree; or an associate degree and 4+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), or consulting experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • 2+ years of full-time work experience in SAP, ERP, technology implementation, or consulting.
  • Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle SAP implementation, from project initiation through go-live and hypercare, including experience supporting an SAP S/4HANA implementation.
  • 1+ year of hands-on functional configuration experience with one or more of the following SAP technologies: SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP AI Foundation (Generative AI Hub), SAP AI Core, or Joule Studio.
  • Experience working with client stakeholders to gather, document, or validate business and technical requirements for SAP implementation projects.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Experience applying AI tools—including generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning, conversational AI, or AI agents—to enterprise transformation initiatives, such as solution design, implementation, or testing.
  • Experience applying SAP Activate, Agile, or Waterfall methodologies on SAP implementation programs.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, estimates, solution designs, or client presentations
  • One or more SAP certifications, such as SAP Generative AI Developer or Joule Studio Developer.

Requisition code: 375652
Job ID 375652

Quick facts

  • Pay: $175,700 to $292,900 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 12+ years

About this job

Lead federal acquisition strategy and proposal development for Deloitte's Government and Public Services team. Drive capture of large, complex federal contracts across GSA and enterprise vehicles while mentoring pursuit teams and building government partnerships.

Good fit if you have 12+ years in federal acquisition, proposal management, and complex deal capture with proven leadership and strategic contracting expertise.

Full job description

Position Summary

Are you ready to take on the challenge of being a trusted business advisor with the opportunity to influence business strategy at one of the world's leading professional services firms? If you have experience with the complete acquisition proposal lifecycle and an interest in leading high-stakes proposal opportunities, Deloitte's Government and Public Services (GPS) team is the place for you! Join our team of professionals in delivering strategic and tactical guidance to senior leadership in support of pursuit development efforts.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026

Work You’ll Do

Deloitte’s GPS Sales Excellence team is looking for a Federal Acquisition Service (FAS) Capture Executive with extensive experience in driving, shaping, and capturing large, complex deals in the Federal markets. This role supports GPS-wide growth strategies by advising account teams on strategic contracting options across Federal Acquisition Service (GSA/AAS/FEDSIM) and Enterprise Contract Vehicles (ECVs) to create a competitive advantage in the GPS markets they serve. Additionally, the role involves capturing new government-wide contract vehicles to expand the FAS portfolio. As part of a multi-disciplinary team focused on "Driving to Win," you will meld business, management, technical, and cost elements to position for the most complex pursuits and offer strategies for winning proposals and delivering the work. Your efforts will include driving capture and proposal readiness from early positioning and shaping efforts, through the development and implementation of win strategies, pre-Request for Proposal activities, and continuing through written/oral proposal development, negotiations, award, and transition. In this role, you will:

Lead and Collaborate:

  • Act strategically by consistently demonstrating expertise and skills to add value and provide guidance
  • Brainstorm solutions with stakeholders, offering experience-based advice to drive strategy and solutions
  • Foster strategic collaborations and engagement across business areas and teams, promoting effective partnerships and mutual success
  • Reach out to government and industry partners to build alliances that support the development and capture of future megadeals
  • Demonstrate creativity and original thinking
  • Manage team members of various specialties and seniority levels, acting as a mentor and coach, providing consistent guidance, direction, and feedback
  • Contribute to creating an environment that encourages the development and growth of our professionals
  • Handle multiple, concurrent projects; adjust to shifting priorities, stringent deadlines, last-minute requirements, and frequent evening/weekend hours to accomplish tasks within non-negotiable client deadlines

Position:

  • Orchestrate and/or conduct discussions with stakeholders to understand requirements and risk areas
  • Understand core requirements and client needs
  • Attend industry forums to present Deloitte offerings/solutions to increase PWIN across the portfolio of FAS deals (MAD discussions, placemat development, Industry Day, and Due Diligence meetings)

Capture and Proposal Development:

  • Understand contract vehicle differentiators to inform contract vehicle selection/acquisition shaping strategy
  • Integrate into proposal teams across all GPS federal sectors to provide contract vehicle expertise during the capture process
  • Drive Capture and partner with other Capture Executives, Pursuit Leaders, and Account leadership to submit winning and compliant proposals for new government-wide vehicles

Research:

  • Utilize various research tools and databases to gather historical information that informs fact-based shaping recommendations
  • Assess incumbent and likely competitor teams

Eminence:

  • Develop external relationships with government-wide contract administering agencies and other industry partners to promote Deloitte's brand eminence within the greater government-wide acquisition community

People and Project Management:

  • A collaborative team player with an exceptional ability to work effectively with individuals at all levels, including senior executives
  • Proven ability to influence others, from staff to senior leaders, through a strong presence, thoughtful challenges, and sound judgment
  • Strong interpersonal and political skills, adept at building relationships, understanding team dynamics, taking initiative, and solving problems
  • An attentive listener, capable of quickly grasping ideas to be reflected in written documents and presentations
  • Skilled in coaching and mentoring pursuit team members
  • Ability to read situations and adapt leadership style to achieve desired results
  • Capable of working with grace and efficiency in a demanding, deadline-driven environment
  • Proficient in managing multiple projects simultaneously
  • Demonstrated initiative and problem-solving abilities
  • Attention to detail and exceptional follow-up skills
  • Ability to analyze information and make sound observations and recommendations quickly

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s GPS practice is passionate about making an impact with lasting change. We collaborate across our organization to bring the full breadth of Deloitte to support government clients and aspire to be the premier integrated solutions provider in helping transform the government marketplace.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • A minimum of 12 years of work experience
  • At least 3 years of experience with GSA, AAS, and/or FEDSIM
  • Proven experience in Federal contracting, strategic capture, solutions, and proposal development
  • Have a comprehensive knowledge of Enterprise Contract Vehicles, how they are used to support long term capture and delivery
  • Demonstrated ability to shape contract vehicles available for government-wide use
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and oral
  • Strong negotiation skills
  • Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. This may include overnight travel
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Secret Clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven ability to establish relationships both internally and externally
  • Experience with the market research stage of the acquisition lifecycle, including writing or reviewing Requests for Information, Sources Sought, White Papers, and other formats for communicating contract vehicle recommendations
  • Top Secret Clearance
