Requisition code: 375630
Job ID 375630

Position Summary

Deloitte’s Retail and Consumer Products sector advises companies by identifying, understanding, and responding to changing trends, business models, and opportunities in a rapidly evolving retail landscape. Our integrated teams serve clients to make strategic decisions, helping them to thrive in this dynamic market environment.

Our Merchandising Transformation practice combines expertise across assortment, planning, pricing, and inventory with enterprise technology, data, and applied AI to modernize how merchandising decisions are made. We help clients redesign the processes, systems, operating models, and data structures behind their most important commercial choices.

The Merchandising Transformation practice is looking for a Senior Manager to help us grow our reach in the Retail and Consumer Products sector. You’ll work alongside merchants and planners to build the capabilities clients need to move faster and perform better. Join us!

Recruiting for this role ends on February 16, 2027

Work you’ll do

Merchandising Transformation projects typically focus on improving how retail and consumer companies plan, buy, price, allocate, and manage their products, data, and vendors. Our engagements connect merchandising strategy to the processes, data, technology, and AI that support it.

As a Merchandising Transformation Senior Manager, you will work alongside merchandising, planning, finance, supply chain, data, and technology leaders to shape their merchandising agenda and bring it to life through merchandising transformations with measurable outcomes. You’ll partner across our enterprise to bring the best of Deloitte to your clients.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Our Merchandising Transformation practice brings together former merchants and planner, core data specialists, technology and AI professionals, and business strategists. Many of us have worked as merchants, planners, and buyers ourselves. We value people who bring curiosity, rigor, and a genuine interest in how retail works.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 10+ years of consulting experience, including leading merchandising, retail strategy, or retail planning transformations or technology-enabled change
  • 8+ years of experience in the retail sector, including industry experience in merchandising, planning, strategy, or stores
  • 8+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas, with the ability to work effectively across adjacent areas: core merchandising and merchandise data (item setup, hierarchies, governance); integrated merchandise planning (financial planning, assortment, product development, forecasting, allocation, replenishment, space); or AI-enabled and agentic merchandising
  • 3+ years of merchandising experience interacting with finance, supply chain, store operations, marketing, and other cross-functional partners
  • 3+ years of analytics experience, including forecasting, optimization, scenario modeling, and segmentation
  • 1+ years of experience establishing AI-enabled workflows, incorporating AI tools into daily work and client delivery, and driving AI adoption across teams and clients; building a prototype or solution using AI, including personal projects, is a strong plus
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Experience translating business needs into functional requirements, data needs, and technology solutions
  • Experience with enterprise merchandising and planning platforms, such as SAP, Oracle Retail, Blue Yonder, or o9
  • Understanding of AI architecture, agentic workflow design, and human-in-the-loop decision models
  • Experience quantifying merchandising and AI opportunities in terms of revenue, margin, inventory, productivity, or decision quality
  • Familiarity with the data foundations behind merchandising, such as product and vendor master data and governance
  • Experience supporting business development and growing and developing consulting teams
  • Working knowledge of data quality, taxonomy, matching, enrichment, and remediation, and familiarity with GS1 product data standards
  • Experience leading ERP modernization, large-scale data remediation, or master data implementations
  • Hands-on experience with master data platform implementations, such as STIBO Systems or Informatica, canonical data models, or match, merge, and link capabilities
  • Experience with platforms such as RELEX, Anaplan, or Toolio, or comparable solutions

About this job

Support organizational change management and strategic communications for IT implementation projects at Deloitte's Government and Public Services practice. Develop training plans, conduct stakeholder interviews, and coordinate across workstreams to deliver end-user adoption support.

Good fit if you have 3+ years leading organizational change management for Agile IT projects, training delivery experience, and an active Secret clearance.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Human Capital team helps organizations create value through people performance. We work with clients to reimagine work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise and to transform their HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today’s world, you will help clients answer questions like: How do I access, develop, and motivate my workforce? What should my AI strategy be for the HR function? Do I have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to make work better for humans and humans better at work.

Work You'll Do

As a Change Management Workstream Support Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Support the development and execution of organizational change management and strategic communications plans, including stakeholder messaging and readiness activities.
  • Conduct stakeholder interviews, document feedback, and coordinate with the Design Workstream to inform user needs and future requirements.
  • Develop and deliver end-user training plans, materials, workshops, and software training sessions.
  • Support Help Desk strategy and provide end-user support and adoption communications before and after releases.
  • Coordinate with Design, Agile, and Testing Workstreams to support releases; travel to military bases and allied exercises to deliver briefings and user support.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Organization, Workforce, & Change offering shapes market-leading organizational strategies, delivers impactful change, and generates client value through the workforce, while leveraging data-driven insights and exceptional delivery execution.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Active Secret clearance required
  • 3+ years of experience leading organizational change management (OCM) and strategic communications for information technology implementation projects delivered using Agile methods, including two-week sprints
  • Experience designing training content, facilitating end-user training or workshops, and providing end-user support for software products
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred: 

  • Completion of Palantir training or experience supporting Palantir software
  • Experience supporting supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, or fulfillment programs

Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

Global Operate is seeking a highly motivated and creative External Advisor Relations Manager to support its strategic growth agenda. Operate is Deloitte’s next-generation managed services capability, spanning all Deloitte businesses. Working with the Global Analyst Relations team, Global Operate Marketing and member firms worldwide, you will strengthen Deloitte’s market presence by helping to facilitate engagement with key industry analysts and third-party advisors. You will drive advisor content, awareness and education to build endorsement of Deloitte’s capabilities and support client pursuits. The role requires a proactive, globally minded collaborator who can foster alignment and implement scalable strategies across diverse markets.

Rsponsibilities:

  • Work with the Global Analyst Relations team which leads and strengthens relationships with strategic external advisors globally, helping to build advisor understanding of Deloitte’s offerings and market differentiators.
  • Facilitate meaningful connections between Deloitte’s Operate leaders, subject matter experts and advisors, coordinating briefings and inquiries, developing content, and identifying proactive engagement opportunities.
  • Contribute to the development and execution of a global external relations strategy focused on increasing Deloitte's positive endorsement in the market around Operate capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with the Global Analyst Relations team to ensure alignment of strategies and activities, leveraging best practices and shared resources.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities for stronger advisor advocacy, directly supporting client pursuits and market-winning efforts.
  • Create compelling content and messaging tailored for analyst and advisor audiences.
  • Manage and coordinate Global Operate participation at key analyst and advisor events, aligning stakeholders, messaging, content, and follow-up to maximize the impact of each engagement.
  • Work cross-functionally with internal stakeholders, including Marketing, Market Intelligence, Sales, Service Lines, and Leadership, to integrate external relations into broader market initiatives.
  • Provide guidance and support to member firms on effective advisor engagement strategies, particularly in incorporating broader markets outside of established regions.
  • Contribute to building a scalable framework for external relations that can adapt to the evolving needs of Global Operate and effectively incorporate emerging markets.
  • Lead the external promotion of analyst and advisor accolades across the member firm network.
  • Monitor advisor research, reports, and market commentary, providing timely insights and recommendations to internal stakeholders regarding advisor engagement and impact.


The team

The Global Operate Team is comprised of professionals with various areas of focus that collectively provide mission critical services to support Global Operate’s overall success. Whether focused on sales excellence, delivery transformation, quality and risk management, contracts management, finance and operations, capability build, communications and change management, knowledge management, marketing and market intelligence, or other activities, these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people can effectively serve clients every day.



Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in sales, pursuits, marketing, or analyst/advisor relations management within professional services.
  • Commercially astute, with a keen understanding of business drivers, market dynamics, and how advisor relations can contribute to Deloitte's Operate growth and competitive advantage.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuasively.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, capable of building and maintaining credible relationships with senior stakeholders, both internal and external.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across diverse teams and geographies.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.
  • Comfortable with data analysis and reporting to demonstrate impact and inform strategy.



Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Job ID 375616

Position Summary

Deloitte’s Retail and Consumer Products sector advises companies by identifying, understanding, and responding to changing trends, business models, and opportunities in a rapidly evolving retail landscape. Our integrated teams serve clients to make strategic decisions, helping them to thrive in this dynamic market environment.

Our Merchandising Transformation practice combines expertise across assortment, planning, pricing, and inventory with enterprise technology, data, and applied AI to modernize how merchandising decisions are made. We help clients redesign the processes, systems, operating models, and data structures behind their most important commercial choices.

The Merchandising Transformation practice is looking for a Senior Consultant/ to help us grow our reach in the Retail and Consumer Products sector. You’ll work alongside merchants and planners to build the capabilities clients need to move faster and perform better. Join us!

Recruiting for this role ends on February 16, 2027

Work you’ll do

Merchandising Transformation projects typically focus on improving how retail and consumer companies plan, buy, price, allocate, and manage their products, data, and vendors. Our engagements connect merchandising strategy to the processes, data, technology, and AI that support it.

As a Merchandising Transformation Senior Consultant/Consultant, you will work alongside merchandising, planning, finance, supply chain, data, and technology teams to activate their merchandising agenda through merchandising transformations with measurable outcomes. You’ll partner across our enterprise to bring the best of Deloitte to your clients.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Our Merchandising Transformation practice brings together former merchants and planners, core data specialists, technology and AI professionals, and business strategists. Many of us have worked as merchants, planners, and buyers ourselves. We value people who bring curiosity, rigor, and a genuine interest in how retail works.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 2+ years of direct experience as a merchant, buyer, planner, allocator, category manager, merchandising analyst, or closely related retail practitioner
  • 2+ years of experience in one of the following: buying and category management, merchandise or assortment planning, allocation and replenishment, pricing and promotions, product or vendor data, or merchandising operations
  • 1+ years of AI fluency with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot, applied to merchandising work
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university
  • Ability to travel up to 30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Experience with merchandising or planning systems
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or Python, or of product and vendor data concepts
  • Understanding of effective prompting, output validation, and responsible use of data in AI-enabled workflows
  • Prior consulting exposure or experience in project-based, cross-functional teams
  • Interest in and ability to develop across multiple merchandising areas over time
  • Experience with Oracle Retail, SAP, Blue Yonder, Anaplan, or other merchandising systems

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $128,000 – $252,500.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Requisition code: 375613
Job ID 375613

Position Summary

Deloitte's Sales & Service practice partners with the world's leading life sciences companies to reimagine how their commercial, medical, and field organizations operate, and to bring that vision to life on Veeva Vault CRM. This role is built for consultants who lead with functional depth. Candidates should have actually run, designed, or advised on processes like Key Account Management, Speaker and Event Management, Field Alignment, or Medical Interaction workflows, and be able to translate that operating knowledge into a future state vision. From there, they will work closely with technical teams, including Veeva AI agents, to build it. You will define where the client is today, articulate where they need to go, and own the future state narrative that anchors the transformation, not just configure the tool that gets them there.

Recruiting for this role ends December 31, 2026

Work you'll do

As a Veeva Vault CRM Implementation Senior Consultant, you will be responsible for the following.

  • Leading current state assessments, including legacy Veeva CRM audits and field retain-or-retire decisions, and future state visioning for core Life Sciences commercial and medical processes such as Key Account Management, Speaker and Event Management, Field Alignment and Territory Planning, Medical Interactions, and Consent and Preference Management, and articulating that journey to client stakeholders
  • Acting as the functional voice in the room. This means challenging legacy process assumptions, identifying where standardization should win over customization, and defining what "better" looks like before a single screen gets built
  • Partnering with solution architects and platform teams (including Veeva Professional Services and other delivery partners) to translate future state process design into Veeva Vault CRM capabilities, ensuring the build stays true to the business intent and not just the ticket
  • Identifying and scoping opportunities for native Veeva AI agents in Vault CRM to augment or reimagine these processes. Examples include supporting KAM account planning, event follow up, or medical interaction follow up, along with defining the human in the loop model around it
  • Facilitating design workshops, process walkthroughs, and governance conversations with client business owners to convert domain expertise into build ready requirements (user stories with acceptance criteria and a decision log)
  • Developing business cases, future state process maps, and executive ready narratives that connect process transformation to measurable outcomes
  • Providing planning, design, and advisory support across the sales and medical technology lifecycle, from process design through requirements, configuration oversight, testing, go-live, hypercare, and adoption
  • Acting in a mentoring capacity to support the career development of colleagues, particularly in building functional to technical fluency
  • Supporting business development efforts, including Statements of Work, proposal development, and client presentations
  • Contributing to internal practice development including methodology, toolkits, training, and recruiting, with a focus on codifying process playbooks for Life Sciences commercial and medical functions
  • Running demonstrations of standard Veeva Vault CRM against the redesigned processes, with a client-specific talk track, and driving fit/gap decisions on what fits as is, what needs configuration, and what needs customization
  • Coordinating with Veeva Professional Services, technical implementation partners, and client IT so that decisions, specifications, and handoffs stay aligned across vendors
  • Documenting market and regional differences (for example US, EU, Canada, and Japan) as design exceptions, each with an owner and a client approval

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Deep enough functional fluency in at least one Life Sciences business process domain, such as Events, Field Excellence, or Medical Affairs, to be the credible expert in the room with client business owners and not just the platform expert
  • Comfort operating at the intersection of business process and technology, including staying engaged through how a future state gets built and where AI or agentic capabilities fit
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business intent into structured, build ready detail
  • Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to run a room of client stakeholders through a future state conversation and land on decisions rather than just document opinions
  • Ability to lead workstreams independently while collaborating across cross functional technical and business teams
  • Executive level written and verbal communication, since this role regularly represents transformation vision to senior client stakeholders
  • Meticulous attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger operating model picture
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast paced, evolving environment
  • Experience with a CRM migration or replatforming, including legacy assessment, fit/gap against a standard platform, and decisions on which fields and data to retain or retire
  • Experience working across multiple vendors and delivery partners on a single program
  • Strong requirements documentation craft: user stories with acceptance criteria, decision logs, and traceability from process to requirement

The Team

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences for life sciences organizations. We blend functional process expertise, technology, and creativity, with Veeva Vault CRM as a core platform and agentic AI as an increasingly central design lever, to help clients define where they're going and get there.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of professional experience in consulting or relevant Life Sciences industry roles, such as commercial operations, field operations, medical affairs, or sales operations
  • 3+ years of hands on ownership of at least one core Life Sciences business process, such as Key Account Management, Speaker or Event Management, Field Coaching, or Medical Interactions, either as a practitioner or as a consultant who led its redesign
  • Hands-on experience with Veeva CRM or Vault CRM, as a consultant, configuration owner, or business owner
  • Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

  • Experience translating business process requirements into technology solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Veeva Vault CRM, including a move from an earlier Veeva CRM version to Vault CRM
  • Veeva CRM or Vault CRM certification (administrator or configuration), if held
  • Direct experience defining or scoping AI use cases within a commercial or medical process, such as account planning, next best action, or case triage
  • 2+ years of hands on experience configuring or advising on Life Sciences capabilities specifically, across personas such as Field Sales, KAM, MSLs, or Field Reimbursement Managers
  • Experience with adjacent platforms such as Veeva Align, Reltio or other MDM tools, Snowflake, or Informatica integrations
  • Experience delivering in an Agile, sprint-based environment (SAFe a plus)

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $131,000 to $198,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart-of-the-business solutions.

 

Work You’ll Do

As a Manager, Technical Transformation on the Technical Transformation team, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead solution design workshops, define decision models, and configure business rules in OPA/OIA.
  • Manage end-to-end OPA/OIA implementation activities, including requirements traceability, configuration, and documentation.
  • Direct integration design and development between OPA/OIA and enterprise applications, including application programming interfaces and data flows.
  • Oversee test planning, defect resolution, release readiness, and production support for OPA/OIA deployments.
  • Lead project teams, coordinate stakeholders, and manage technical workstreams across delivery milestones.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others
 

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Oracle offering drives business transformation services to improve performance and value delivered by the full suite of Oracle solutions.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

 

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of experience developing and implementing Oracle Policy Automation (OPA) / Oracle Intelligent Advisor (OIA) solutions.
  • Experience in solution design and rules configuration using OPA/OIA.
  • Experience designing, developing, and testing OPA/OIA integrations.
  • Experience leading workstreams through testing, release, and production support activities.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud.
  • Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
  • Experience writing Oracle Structured Query Language (SQL) queries.

Job.JobTitle: Front Office Strategy & Customer Transformation Senior Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. 

Recruiting for this role ends on February 16, 2027 

Work you’ll do

You’ll work across marketing, sales, and service to help clients transform their customer-facing functions, from setting the growth strategy through the operating model, technology, and execution needed to deliver it.

Growth Strategy, Transformation, & Value Realization

  • Develop customer growth strategies built on clear “Where to Play” and “How to Win” choices: which markets and segments to prioritize and how to win in each
  • Shape value propositions and strategic imperatives tied to measurable financial outcomes such as top-line growth, margin improvement, cost reduction, and ROI
  • Translate business and operational challenges into structured enterprise strategies and prioritized initiatives
  • Build implementation roadmaps and business cases that secure investment and sequence the work
  • Guide clients from strategy through launch, helping drive adoption and keeping initiatives tied to the business results they were designed to deliver

Customer Experience

  • Set customer experience priorities across the journey from lead to loyalty to improve acquisition, growth, satisfaction, and retention

·       Advise clients on strategies to improve customer experience, satisfaction, and retention across contact center, care navigation, and digital self-service channels

  • Design differentiating experiences for large, complex front-office launches, partnering with creative teams to connect design to business value

Commercial Operating Model

  • Redesign marketing, sales, and service operating models, processes, and ways of working to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and agility
  • Define the capabilities and management routines needed to execute and sustain the strategy
  • Help Fortune 500 clients build next-generation commercial teams, modernizing their talent mix and approach to a blended human and agentic workforce

Technology, Data, and AI

  • Define the technology and data requirements behind customer-facing objectives, partnering with technologists to build modern tech stacks
  • Drive adoption of digital, AI, and other innovative capabilities across the front office

The team

Deloitte's Customer Strategy and Design practice is the strategic and experiential hub of Deloitte Digital. We excel in customer experience, marketing strategy, commercial transformation, and innovation/design, offering insights to navigate disruption and shape client agendas. Our team includes business strategists, operations experts, designers, and technologists focused on customer-centered solutions. We specialize in customer segmentation, go-to-market strategy, channel optimization, service design, UX design, and customer analytics. Join us to drive impactful customer experiences and market success. 

Qualifications

Required:

·       10+ years of experience in front office functions spanning marketing, sales, and customer/commercial growth teams – focused on strategy, operations, and transformation.

·       7+ years of experience designing or improving marketing and sales operating models, organization structures, or processes, including B2B marketing in Energy, Chemicals, or Industrials

·       7+ years of experience in strategy roles, with resume evidence of leading at least one customer or business strategy, one service strategy spanning digital self-service, contact center, or field service, and one commercial marketing initiative involving sales-enablement materials or campaign execution.

·       4+ years of experience of hands-on use of at least one marketing or sales platform (e.g., Adobe, Salesforce, AWS, Google, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365).

·       5+ years of experience working with large brands across the Energy, Chemicals, or Industrials sectors

·       Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

·       Ability to travel up to 50% on average based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred:

·       Expertise building business cases for transformational change and operational / technical investment – understanding the cost and revenue drivers that drive the business

·       Understanding of marketing and sales measurement and ROI

·       Involvement in shaping or leading broader Customer Experience (CX) initiatives

·       Business development and sales experience in Consulting or similar business environment – cultivating opportunities, building proposals, and shaping commercial deals

Job.JobTitle: Front Office Strategy & Customer Transformation Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. 

Recruiting for this role ends on February 16, 2027

Work you’ll do

You’ll work across marketing, sales, and service to help clients transform their customer-facing functions, from setting the growth strategy through the operating model, technology, and execution needed to deliver it.

Growth Strategy, Transformation, & Value Realization

  • Develop customer growth strategies built on clear “Where to Play” and “How to Win” choices: which markets and segments to prioritize and how to win in each
  • Shape value propositions and strategic imperatives tied to measurable financial outcomes such as top-line growth, margin improvement, cost reduction, and ROI
  • Translate business and operational challenges into structured enterprise strategies and prioritized initiatives
  • Build implementation roadmaps and business cases that secure investment and sequence the work
  • Guide clients from strategy through launch, helping drive adoption and keeping initiatives tied to the business results they were designed to deliver

Customer Experience

  • Set customer experience priorities across the journey from lead to loyalty to improve acquisition, growth, satisfaction, and retention

·       Advise clients on strategies to improve customer experience, satisfaction, and retention across contact center, care navigation, and digital self-service channels

  • Design differentiating experiences for large, complex front-office launches, partnering with creative teams to connect design to business value

Commercial Operating Model

  • Redesign marketing, sales, and service operating models, processes, and ways of working to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and agility
  • Define the capabilities and management routines needed to execute and sustain the strategy
  • Help Fortune 500 clients build next-generation commercial teams, modernizing their talent mix and approach to a blended human and agentic workforce

Technology, Data, and AI

  • Define the technology and data requirements behind customer-facing objectives, partnering with technologists to build modern tech stacks
  • Drive adoption of digital, AI, and other innovative capabilities across the front office

The team

Deloitte's Customer Strategy and Design practice is the strategic and experiential hub of Deloitte Digital. We excel in customer experience, marketing strategy, commercial transformation, and innovation/design, offering insights to navigate disruption and shape client agendas. Our team includes business strategists, operations experts, designers, and technologists focused on customer-centered solutions. We specialize in customer segmentation, go-to-market strategy, channel optimization, service design, UX design, and customer analytics. Join us to drive impactful customer experiences and market success. 

Qualifications

Required:

·       6+ years of experience in front office functions spanning marketing, sales, and customer/commercial growth teams – focused on strategy, operations, and transformation.

  • 4+ years of experience designing or improving marketing and sales operating models, organization structures, or processes, including B2B marketing in Energy, Chemicals, or Industrials
  • 3+ years of experience of hands-on use of at least one marketing or sales platform (e.g., Adobe, Salesforce, AWS, Google, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365).

·       4+ years of experience in strategy roles, with resume evidence of leading at least one customer or business strategy, one service strategy spanning digital self-service, contact center, or field service, and one commercial marketing initiative involving sales-enablement materials or campaign execution.

·       4+ years of experience working with large brands across the Energy, Chemicals, or Industrials sectors

·       Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

·       Ability to travel up to 50% on average based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred:

·       Expertise building business cases for transformational change and operational / technical investment – understanding the cost and revenue drivers that drive the business

·       Understanding of marketing and sales measurement and ROI

·       Involvement in shaping or leading broader Customer Experience (CX) initiatives

·       Experience leading team-based work and project delivery resulting in successful outcomes that are on-time and on-budget

·       Experience working with senior leaders (heads of marketing, sales, service and commercial functions) or their direct reports to shape strategy and vision

·       Experience helping marketing organizations optimize their planning and budgeting process prioritize their people and budget allocations to drive greatest financial returns

·       Experience with both B2B or B2B2C sales and marketing channels and tactics (e.g., events/tradeshows, affiliate marketing, inside sales, sales enablement)

·       Understanding of the martech/adtech landscape and implications of AI to marketing organizations

·       Knowledge and experience of the above qualifications, primarily in a B2B or B2B2C environment

·       Strong executive presence and relationship building

·       Strong executive communication and ability to craft compelling narratives

·       1+ years of experience using artificial intelligence tools in day-to-day workflow

    The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $163,400 – $322,100.

As a Marketing Managed Services Senior Manager (Banking & Capital Markets) on the Digital Foundry, Operate, & Innovation team, you will be responsible for…

  • Bringing deep expertise across the marketing operations landscape, including campaign execution, content management operations, marketing automation and orchestration, customer data platforms, channel deliverability, and performance measurement, and applying it to shape B&CM offerings in early pursuits and, over time, to deliver them for clients. 
  • Leading B&CM business development and pursuit activities for Marketing Managed Services programs including business process outsourcing (BPO) contract models, or business process as a service (BPaaS) opportunities, including qualification, solution positioning, estimation inputs, and proposal development.
  • Shaping compelling solutions and go-to-market narratives for outsourced and managed delivery models, informed by pricing economics, client operating models, provider landscapes, and agentic transformation pathways.
  • Building trusted client relationships and supporting account growth by identifying client needs and shaping opportunities with account teams and subject matter experts.
  • Delivering large-scale BPO, BPaaS, and managed services programs from solution design through implementation, transition, and ongoing delivery.
  • Defining operating models, delivery roadmaps, and implementation plans that align business objectives, technology capabilities, and service delivery requirements.
  • Advising clients on modernization opportunities across business operations, digital platforms, automation, analytics, and innovation.
  • Overseeing program governance and performance, including financial and risk management, and executive reporting.
  • Developing market-facing points of view and client materials, and mentoring teams in solution development, delivery, client service, and business development.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Experience leading BPO, BPaaS, managed services, or technology-enabled transformation programs.
  • Ability to identify, build and sustain senior client relationships and identify opportunities to address client needs.
  • Experience contributing to business development, including early-stage pursuit shaping, proposal development, and client presentations.
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams and guide cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a professional demeanor.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to high-quality work.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to mentor others and provide clear, actionable guidance.

The team

Our Digital Foundry, Operate, & Innovation offering balances strategy, technology, creativity, and managed services to solve your biggest client challenges. We design and deliver services to run digital businesses, manages innovation and assets, and commercializes IP to drive growth across all Customer offerings.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 10+ years of experience selling and leading technology transformation, large operate/managed services marketing agency programs, business process outsourcing (BPO) contract models, or business process as a service (BPaaS) programs
  • 5+ years of experience with developing successful go-to-market strategies, pipeline shaping, business development, and account management
  • 8+ years of experience in operating model design, managed services, or service delivery transformation
  • 5+ years of experience leading program teams, workstreams, or direct reports
  • Experience developing transformation roadmaps, governance structures, and executive-level program reporting
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Requisition code: 375456
Job ID 375456

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

We’re seeking a data protection professional to build and mature Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) capabilities, with supporting Data Loss Prevention (DLP) expertise. You’ll work with security, privacy, data governance, and IT stakeholders to understand how sensitive data is handled, establish practical governance, and improve how it is discovered, classified, monitored, and protected across SaaS, cloud, and other environments.

This role is primarily focused on DSPM program development and implementation, including stakeholder engagement, data classification and tagging, policy tuning, and integrations. It also requires hands-on experience with DLP controls and their role in a broader data protection program.

Work You’ll Do

As a Delivery Center, DPSM Implementations Engineer on the Digital Trust and Privacy team, you will be responsible for…

  • Build and mature a Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) program, including governance, an operating model, processes, and measures of effectiveness.
  • Partner with security, privacy, data governance, IT, and data owners to assess data ownership, business context, protection needs, and remediation priorities.
  • Discover and assess sensitive data across software-as-a-service (SaaS) applications, cloud environments, and other data stores; define and apply data classification and tagging approaches.
  • Configure and tune DSPM rules, policies, and risk findings; integrate DSPM capabilities with SaaS platforms, cloud environments, identity and access controls, DLP tools, and security operations workflows.
  • Translate DSPM findings into prioritized remediation plans; design, implement, and tune DLP controls across endpoint, email, web, and cloud channels.
  • Develop program documentation, operating procedures, and stakeholder reporting; support audit and compliance evidence requests.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Digital Trust & Privacy offering enables trust and safety of online communications and digital products, protecting users, consumers, and patients from harm. Enables clients to provide consumer confidence in knowing with whom they are dealing and ensuring the integrity of access to data.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

 

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of cybersecurity experience, including experience implementing DSPM and DLP capabilities.
  • Experience establishing or expanding a Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) program, including governance, operating models, processes, and measures of effectiveness.
  • Experience configuring Data Security Posture Management platforms, such as Cyera, Varonis, Netskope DSPM, or BigID; applying data classification and tagging; tuning DSPM rules or policies; and integrating capabilities with SaaS applications, cloud environments, identity and access controls, and security operations workflows.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and tuning Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls across endpoint, email, web, and cloud channels using Microsoft Purview, Forcepoint, Symantec, Digital Guardian, Netskope, or Zscaler.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg) or Geo-Hub locations (Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, and Philadelphia)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance

Preferred:

  • Experience developing or operating data governance, privacy, or security operating models.
  • Experience applying National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800-53 (NIST SP 800-53), Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS), Internal Revenue Service Publication 1075, or Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) requirements to data protection controls.
  • Experience integrating DSPM or DLP with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) or Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) platforms.
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), CompTIA Security+, Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or SC-401 certification.
  • Experience using PowerShell or Python for automation and reporting.

Job.JobTitle: ConvergeSPORTS - Commercialization Group Product Manager - Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $141,200 to $278,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Product Manager for Audience Extension Network, a sports monetization platform combining fan data, adtech, and retail media. Requires developing product vision, roadmap strategy, and translating data into commercial narratives for sports teams and leagues.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in product management, media, or adtech; understand retail media and audience monetization; and can build pitch materials from data insights.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Team

ConvergeSPORTS is a product-driven business that combines Deloitte’s sports industry experience with proprietary data, AI-native decision intelligence, and reusable Converge product capabilities to help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world’s largest professional services firm. Audience Extension Network is the monetization layer that helps teams and leagues reach fans beyond the arena by combining first-party fan data, partner inventory, and premium publisher reach. The product sits at the intersection of sports media, retail media, adtech, sponsorship, and data-driven audience activation.

Position Summary

This role is a commercially minded Product Manager for Audience Extension Network. The person in this role will define the product vision, shape the roadmap, and turn market insights and large data sets into narratives, demos, and commercial opportunities. They will work closely with product, engineering, data science, and sales to ensure the product can be pitched, sold, and delivered in a repeatable way. The ideal candidate understands retail media and audience monetization, is comfortable working through data-rich narratives, and can confidently support pitches, client conversations, and commercial deal shaping.

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/01/2027.

Work you’ll do

You will own the product thinking behind Audience Extension Network and help turn the offering into a repeatable commercial engine. You will connect the data spine, market needs, and go-to-market strategy so the business can show up in the right place and monetize fandom more effectively.

  • Define and maintain the product roadmap for Audience Extension Network across audience curation, measurement, targeting, activation, and monetization.
  • Translate large fan, media, campaign, and partner data sets into insights, narratives, and opportunity sizing that support commercial decisions.
  • Partner with sales, marketing, design, engineering, data science, and external partners to shape requirements and prioritize product investments.
  • Support pitches, demos, executive presentations, and client workshops with clear product storytelling and strong commercial framing.
  • Build product collateral such as one-pagers, pitch decks, case studies, demo scripts, and market-facing narratives.
  • Track market, competitor, and category movement across retail media, sports media, sponsorship, and adtech and use those signals to inform roadmap choices.
  • Use feedback from clients, sponsors, publishers, and internal sellers to refine the product experience and improve commercial traction.
  • Help shape pricing, packaging, and commercialization plans so the product can be sold consistently and credibly.
  • Own backlog prioritization and product decisions in partnership with delivery teams so the product can move from concept to repeatable execution.
  • Contribute to where we show up in market by supporting marketing, networking, conferences, and broader brand-building activities.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Commercially sharp and comfortable shaping buyer-facing narratives from product and data insights.
  • Able to pitch, present, and influence senior stakeholders with clear executive storytelling.
  • Strong with large data sets, dashboards, and turning analysis into client-ready recommendations.
  • Retail media fluent, with a working understanding of audience monetization, adtech, and how value is created across the media and sponsorship ecosystem.
  • Comfortable partnering with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Data teams to move opportunities from insight to pitch to close.
  • Strong sales support instincts, including RFPs, proposals, pitch materials, pricing narratives, and deal support.
  • Understands where and how the business shows up in market, including conferences, networking, brand-building, and thought leadership.
  • Able to connect sports industry context to commercial strategy, buyer needs, and repeatable go-to-market motions.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, product marketing, commercial strategy, media, consulting, adtech, or adjacent digital businesses.
  • Experience working with large data sets, analytics outputs, or dashboards and translating them into executive-ready narratives or product decisions.
  • Experience supporting pitches, selling, commercial conversations, or client workshops.
  • Strong understanding of retail media, audience monetization, or digital media economics.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience in sports media, sponsorship, audience activation, retail media, or adtech.
  • Experience with Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau, SQL, or similar tools for insight generation and executive storytelling.
  • Experience building product narratives, case studies, pricing materials, or sales enablement content.

The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200-$278,300.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $110,700 to $218,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Lead commerce technology modernization engagements at Deloitte, managing technical architecture, platform design, and full stack development from discovery through implementation. Mentor engineering teams and drive quality and scalability across enterprise solutions.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of full stack development, led teams of 10+ globally, delivered 2+ large-scale platform modernizations, and have 5+ years cloud experience on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Full job description

Position Summary

L45 - Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation

Recruiting for this role ends December 18, 2026

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation, you will be responsible for leading commerce technology engagements from discovery through implementation while helping clients modernize platforms and improve digital experiences.

  • Lead the technical architecture for commerce engagements, including system design, integration patterns, and technology selection.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions to gather technical requirements, assess current-state processes and platforms, and translate findings into solution architecture and delivery plans.
  • Guide and mentor full stack developers through code reviews, engineering standards, and implementation best practices across front-end and back-end development.
  • Design, build, and maintain full stack applications, application programming interfaces, and data integrations to support scalable commerce solutions.
  • Drive quality, performance, security, and scalability across delivery, including testing approaches, continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines, and issue resolution.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of full stack development experience architecting and delivering high-performance enterprise technology solutions (for example, web, mobile, commerce, or integration platforms), including work that predates generative AI.
  • Experience leading cross-functional engineering teams of 10+ members globally and conducting code reviews for enterprise platform implementations.
  • 2+ large-scale platform modernization programs delivered for enterprise digital platforms.
  • 5+ years of experience implementing enterprise solutions on at least one major hyperscaler (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform), including building and managing continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • 3+ years of experience designing and optimizing relational and NoSQL database solutions and building Representational State Transfer (REST) or GraphQL application programming interfaces (APIs).
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience owning technology roadmaps and making build-versus-buy or platform selection recommendations for enterprise commerce solutions.
  • Experience working with any commerce packaged solutions Ex: SAP CC, SFCC, Adobe Commerce, CommerceTools, Shopify
  • Experience using automated testing frameworks such as RestAssured, Karate, or Selenium to increase test coverage.
  • Experiance in frontend development using frontend frameworks Ex: React, VUE, and Next 
  • Experience in optimizing the applications using BFF (Backend for frontend) 
  • Experience building the applications using integrating with headless / composable platforms. Including CMS, Payments, Tax, ERP systems 
  • Experience in application performance optimization using performance test tools
  • Certified in AI development tools (Claud, Gemini, Copilot) 
  • Experience with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), HyperText Markup Language 5 (HTML5), and JavaScript.
  • Experience with Agile software development methodology.
  • Cloud or architecture certification.
  • Experience with Kubernetes or Apache Kafka.
  • Experience applying AI coding or design agents and agentic software development lifecycle (ADLC) practices with documented delivery-speed or quality measures.

Requisition code: 375419
Job ID 375419

Quick facts

  • Pay: $180,200 to $355,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Lead complex life insurance and annuity strategy projects for Deloitte's Human Capital practice, working on product pricing, capital management, and underwriting modernization. Work involves advising insurance executives on pricing strategy, AI-enabled solutions, and risk management across multiple business lines.

Good fit if you have 10+ years life insurance actuarial experience, ASA or FSA credentials, and 5+ years connecting pricing, reserving, and capital in advisory or carrier roles.

Full job description

Position Summary

Human Capital

Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.

Recruiting for this role ends on February 1, 2027. 

Work you'll do

As a Senior Manager on the Actuarial & Insurance Solutions team, you will be responsible for leading large, challenging and complex projects, which are expected to include many of the following activities:

  • Leading client engagements in all aspects of product and underwriting strategy, across multiple distribution channels, multiple target customer segments, and multiple mix of business combinations depending on the manufacturer’s / distributor’s target customer segments.
  • Leading client engagements that connect capital management strategy to life insurance and annuity product pricing, helping Business leaders, CFOs and chief actuaries optimize product-level return on equity
  • Working with business unit leaders on product and underwriting strategy to deliver innovative products in innovative ways, improving the new business and underwriting functions to deliver products quickly and transparently in a digital-first manner
  • Leading and working in cross-functional teams to create AI-enabled solutions for insurance product development, pricing and predictive model development, and deployment of products and pricing in insurance carrier systems
  • Advising clients on macro risk and capital strategies, including reinsurance, hedging, and other risk-reward mechanisms that influence in-force management and new product pricing
  • Advising clients both strategically and tactically in new business, improving straight-though processing, as well as touchless underwriting and suitability processes.  
  • Serving in a lead  / co-host role for the Deloitte Life Insurance New Business & Underwriting Executive Forum, a periodic forum that brings together new business leaders from top insurance companies
  • Developing actuarial approaches for new product development, pricing strategy, target market assessments, competitive assessments of product design and crediting/rating, and profitability analysis
  • Leading client service projects that holistically redesign the cross-functional product development process for life insurance and annuities, to ensure life insurance companies consistently bring the desired volume of products to market at intended speed.  
  • Connecting pricing engagements to the firm's established valuation, reserving, and capital requirement work, given the overlap in skill sets and the dependency of pricing on reserving and capital; and expanding capital management market penetration to include product strategy and pricing advisory and implementation services 
  • Overseeing pricing model and assumption development, pricing model modernization, and delivery quality across medium to large teams
  • Advising on Asset/Liability Management (ALM) and investment engagements that connect liabilities to assets strategically
  • Advising on the operating model of the risk, capital, product, and pricing functions of insurance clients, including the potential impact of AI on talent and process
  • Contributing to a pricing model repository, competitive benchmarking, and market research supporting life and annuity in-force and new business products
  • Providing Board- and CXO-level advice on Return on Capital and Return on Equity strategies
  • Contributing to market and technical research, data resource and tool development, recruiting, training, strategic planning, and business development
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including translating actuarial and capital concepts for CFO and Board audiences
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Actuarial and Insurance Solutions 

Our Actuarial & Insurance Solutions practice helps insurance clients execute on analytically-driven strategic business priorities and modernization of actuarial, product, and pricing operations. One aspect of these services is the PRICE (Product Return on Insurance, Capital & Equity) offering, focused on connecting capital strategy, product design, and pricing to strengthen return on equity (ROE) and return on capital (ROC). As carriers face growing pressure to balance competitively priced products with long-term profitability, our team brings together actuarial product strategy, risk, and capital expertise to advise Boards, CFOs, chief actuaries, and product and underwriting leaders. Join a growing team built to close the gap between strategic capital management decisions, product design, and new business operations.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 10+ years of life insurance and/or annuity actuarial experience
  • Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) or Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA)
  • 5+ years of experience connecting pricing, reserving, and capital concepts in an advisory or carrier setting
  • Ability to travel 0-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

  • 6+ years of experience leading teams
  • 6+ years of product, ALM, ERM, and/or hedging experience, including 3 years of pricing experience
  • 4+ years of consulting experience 
  • 4+ years of experience with capital allocation frameworks such as Risk-Based Capital (RBC) or Solvency II
  • 3+ years of experience with statutory and/or GAAP reporting.
  • 5+ years of experience creating advanced Microsoft Excel models, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and data analysis
  • 5+ years of experience developing client-ready Microsoft PowerPoint presentations for executive-level and Board audiences
  • 2+ years of experience advising CFOs or Boards on Return on Equity or Return on Capital strategy, methodology, and execution

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $180,200 to $355,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Sales Performance Management (SPM), Transformation Senior Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Sales Performance Management, Transformation Senior Consultant

Our Deloitte Sales & Service team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce

Recruiting for this role ends on January 31, 2027.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, you’ll work with clients and engagement teams to transform Sales Performance Management (SPM) processes and technology. You’ll connect business needs with platform capabilities—supporting solution design, configuration, data and integration work, testing, deployment, and adoption.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Assessing sales planning and incentive compensation processes, systems, data, and pain points; helping define target-state capabilities and transformation roadmaps
  • Working with Sales, Finance, Operations, and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into process designs, user stories, functional specifications, and technical solution designs
  • Configuring and implementing SPM solutions, including plans, quotas, territories, crediting, calculations, workflows, reporting, and analytics
  • Supporting platform migrations, including source-to-target data mapping, data quality and cleansing, integration requirements, reconciliation, and validation
  • Collaborating on integrations between SPM platforms and CRM, ERP, HRIS, and data warehouse systems
  • Leading assigned workstream activities, including design reviews, configuration, testing, defect resolution, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization
  • Supporting change management, user training, and adoption to help clients realize value from their SPM investments
  • Managing deliverables, timelines, dependencies, and risks, while providing guidance to junior colleagues
  • Contributing to proposals, client presentations, practice methods and tools, training, and recruiting

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  •   Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  •   Effective written and verbal communication skills
  •   Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  •   Ability to build and sustain professional relationship
  •   Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  •   Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  •   Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  •   Ability to meet deadlines
  •   Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Consultant, or Compensation Analyst for a mid-to-large sized organization; or, direct consulting experience
  • 3+ years of experience designing, configuring, and implementing solutions in Varicent, Spiff, Oracle Incentive Compensation, Pigment, and/or Anaplan
  • Ability to travel at least 50% of the time on average based on the work you do and the clients and industry/ sectors you serve 
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available 
  • Bachelor’s Degree (BS or BA), or equivalent number of years of experience

Preferred

  • Previous Big Four experience and/or an advanced degree in a related specialization area
  • Experience supporting SPM transformation, implementation, migration, or modernization programs
  • Knowledge of sales planning and incentive compensation processes, including quota setting, territory design, crediting, and commissions
  • Experience with requirements and solution design, platform configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, or deployment
  • Familiarity with data quality and reconciliation, change management, user enablement, and Agile or other structured delivery methods

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.
