A reasonable estimate of the current range is $120,000 to $210,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success.   • Deploy, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot applications and services hosted in Microsoft Azure.
  • Provision and manage Azure resources, support CI/CD deployments and releases, and contribute to environment management, performance tuning, capacity planning, and cost optimization.

  • Collaborate with business analysts, architects, testers, and stakeholders in Agile delivery activities.

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. This role leads a client workstream to redesign the software and systems engineering lifecycle (requirements, architecture, development, test, change, release) into governed, AI-enabled work.   • Define agent roles, tool boundaries, guardrails, and approval points; partner with architects/platform teams for deployment.
  • Define approaches for managing software variants, features, and releases across products.
  • Baseline and track value (cycle time, rework, test effort) and communicate outcomes to client stakeholders.
  • Run delivery hygiene (weekly status, RAID, steering committee materials) and support workstream financial tracking.
  • Coach Senior Consultants; escalate risks, dependencies, and decisions to Senior Manager/engagement leadership.

  • 4+ years in one or more of the following: requirements management, test engineering/test automation, change/issue management, or release/CI-CD practices
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with major ALM/requirements platforms and enterprise integrations (ALM–PLM and ALM–CI/CD)
  • Fluency in requirements and systems engineering practices (quality, decomposition, interfaces, verification planning; model-based concepts)
  • Experience designing traceability across requirements, design, code, test, and release—and linking to hardware/product data in PLM
  • DevOps familiarity, including defining where AI acts as an assistant vs. a gated control step in the pipeline
  • Experience with software variant/feature/release management across product lines
  • Experience setting acceptance criteria and evaluation approaches for AI-generated requirements, tests, and/or code (human review evidence and thresholds)
  • Awareness of safety-critical or regulated software processes/standards (e.g., ASPICE, ISO 26262, IEC 62304)

Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!


Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don’t miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

Recruiting for this role ends on 2/14/2027

The Work You’ll Do

The Knowledge Based Engineer Senior Consultant executes hands-on work to capture engineering knowledge and translate it into governed, machine-executable rules and models used by engineers and AI-enabled workflows. This role is expected to be productive quickly, owning modules end-to-end (e.g., a product area rule set or defined knowledge domain), working directly with senior engineers, and building, testing, and documenting reusable knowledge assets.

  • Facilitate knowledge capture with senior engineers (interviews, decision replay on past cases, rule extraction) and translate judgment into executable knowledge assets.
  • Use GenAI-enabled methods to extract and structure knowledge from documents and prior decisions; validate outputs with expert engineers.
  • Model rules, parameters, and constraints into a structured knowledge model linked to requirements, parts/variants, and supplier/product data as applicable.
  • Build design/calculation automation or configuration logic integrated with engineering systems (e.g., CAD, PLM, requirements repositories).
  • Build and test retrieval and agent workflows that consume the knowledge layer, including rule deference logic and human approval points.
  • Maintain traceability from outputs to source/rule; document assumptions, owners, and versions to support governance and reuse.
  • Capture exceptions and approved fixes and feed them back into the knowledge base (continuous improvement loop).
  • Support deployment by partnering with architects/platform teams; draft client-ready deliverables, demos, and concise storylines.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of consulting or industry related experience
  • 3+ years in embedded, automation, data, or digital engineering
  • Software or systems engineering background
  • Experience in one of the following:
    • Rule/constraint modeling; design or calculation automation; parametric/template-driven design; configurators, or
    •  Knowledge modeling (ontologies/taxonomies/knowledge graphs or structured engineering data models), or
    • Python-based LLM/RAG application work (retrieval + evaluation/validation)
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Has shipped or supported something real in production
  • Mechanical, electrical, or systems design background
  • Model-based systems engineering or simulation exposure
  • Cloud AI/ML certification
  • Regulated documentation exposure
  • Prior Consulting experience

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, IDT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future. This role sits within Products+ at the portfolio level, driving product management excellence across the portfolio of products.

Products+ is Deloitte’s enterprise software business, with revenue rivaling publicly traded software companies and customer relationships spanning more than a decade. We combine that scale and staying power with Deloitte’s industry expertise to build the next generation of AI-powered products.

Position Summary

Deloitte is looking for a leader to strengthen engineering excellence across product lines. You will help define and embed organization-wide engineering standards, expand how we find and develop exceptional engineering talent, and turn successful practices into capabilities that benefit every team. This role helps empowered product teams build useful, secure, reliable software through clear expectations, shared learning, and stronger engineering judgment.

You will partner closely with the CTO and product-line engineering leaders to turn technical direction and the engineering bar into practical standards, guidance, and development opportunities. Common Platform and Developer Experience own shared tooling and infrastructure; product teams own their technical decisions and delivery within those standards. This role connects those groups, supports adoption, and helps standards evolve with evidence from engineering work.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/25/2026. 

Work you’ll do

Raise engineering standards, develop talent, and help great practices spread across the organization.

Define and embed engineering standards

  • Translate the CTO’s engineering bar into clear organization-wide standards for software design, code quality, testing, security, accessibility, reliability, and maintainability, in partnership with engineering leaders and relevant specialists.
  • Make standards practical through reference examples, design guidance, review criteria, and reusable patterns that teams can apply in different product contexts.
  • Strengthen how engineers frame technical problems, document design tradeoffs, review code, test software, and manage technical debt.
  • Establish shared expectations for AI-enabled engineering, including verification, code review, security, data protections, and accountability for generated work.
  • Help engineering leaders assess adoption and address gaps through coaching and peer review, with clear decision rights for teams and specialists.
  • Keep standards current by incorporating lessons from product teams, changes in technology, and evidence about software quality and customer outcomes.

Expand how we recruit and develop great engineers

  • Partner with engineering leaders and recruiting to define the technical capabilities, problem-solving skills, and domain knowledge each product needs.
  • Identify promising talent across varied backgrounds, including engineers in consulting and client delivery, internal technology teams, open-source communities, and adjacent technical disciplines who demonstrate the ability to build and maintain product software.
  • Create targeted job descriptions and sourcing strategies that welcome relevant experience beyond traditional software-product organizations.
  • Develop practical assessments that reveal engineering judgment, coding and debugging ability, system design, learning ability, collaboration, and attention to quality.
  • Translate engineering career expectations into clear, observable examples of excellent work at different levels, and help leaders apply those expectations consistently in hiring, feedback, and development.
  • Build onboarding, mentorship, and practical learning opportunities that develop product-engineering habits and familiarity with shared engineering standards.
  • Use hiring and development outcomes to continuously improve how we recruit, support, and grow engineers.

Spread effective practices across the organization

  • Discover practices that are producing better software, technical decisions, and product outcomes across product lines, and turn them into useful examples, coaching, and peer learning.
  • Build engineering communities that share expertise, review approaches, and help teams apply lessons beyond their own codebases.
  • Identify effective AI-enabled engineering practices, test their value with teams, and help successful approaches spread with appropriate verification and review.
  • Improve access to current technical guidance and shared knowledge so teams can learn from one another and avoid repeatedly solving the same problems.
  • Address organization-wide barriers to effective engineering, such as unclear decision rights, inconsistent expectations, and gaps in collaboration with product and design.
  • Bring recurring needs and adoption feedback to Common Platform and Developer Experience to inform their priorities.
  • Measure whether standards and practices improve the work. Combine team feedback with evidence such as onboarding time, rework, defects, and maintainability; avoid treating activity counts as measures of individual performance.

The successful candidate will possess these skills:

  • An ability to recognize engineering talent across varied backgrounds and develop people through coaching, mentorship, and structured learning.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and change-management skills, including the ability to interpret engineering measures in context.
  • The ability to influence across teams, build alignment with engineering leaders, and translate organizational expectations into everyday engineering practice.

The successful candidate will achieve these outcomes:

  • Engineering standards are clear, current, and consistently applied across product lines, with guidance that teams can use in their everyday work.
  • Software quality, security, accessibility, reliability, and maintainability improve as teams apply shared standards and learn from one another.
  • Engineers make stronger technical decisions and receive consistent expectations and useful feedback about their development.
  • Effective AI-enabled practices spread across teams and deliver measurable improvements in productivity and work quality, supported by appropriate verification and review.
  • Recruiting reaches strong candidates from a wider range of relevant backgrounds, and assessments consistently reflect the engineering bar.
  • New engineers reach meaningful contribution sooner, and engineers at every level have practical opportunities to develop their skills and judgment.
  • Successful practices and technical knowledge spread across product lines, reducing repeated mistakes and duplicated effort.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering and engineering leadership, with a track record of improving engineering practices across multiple teams or product lines.
  • 5+ years of experiences of using strong engineering judgment and a practical understanding of software design, testing, secure development, and maintainable production systems.
  • 3+ years of experience defining engineering standards and helping autonomous teams apply them consistently without unnecessary process or approval layers.
  • 3+ years of demonstrated a track record of turning effective practices into guidance, learning opportunities, and measurable improvements that engineers adopt.
  • 2+ years working with AI-enabled engineering tools and workflows, with sound judgment about where they improve work and where correctness, security, data access, or human review matter.
  • Ability to travel 20-25% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500-$265,100.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in product management or product operations, with a track record of identifying friction and delivering adopted improvements.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, IDT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future. This role sits within Products+ at the portfolio level, driving product management excellence across the portfolio of products.

Products+ is Deloitte’s enterprise software business, with revenue rivaling publicly traded software companies and customer relationships spanning more than a decade. We combine that scale and staying power with Deloitte’s industry expertise to build the next generation of AI-powered products.

Position Summary

Deloitte is looking for a leader to improve how Product Management operates across the organization. You will identify and remove obstacles to PM productivity, expand how we find and develop exceptional product talent, and raise the standard of product management by discovering what works and helping others adopt it. This role builds the connective tissue that helps empowered product teams move faster and make better-informed decisions; it does not add centralized control or turn Product Operations into a shadow PMO.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/25/2026.

Work you’ll do

Build the systems, talent pipelines, and practices that help product managers do their best work.

Make PMs more productive

  • Work directly with PMs to understand where time, effort, and attention are lost—from fragmented information and repetitive tasks to unclear decisions and unnecessary coordination.
  • Prioritize improvements based on their effect on PM effectiveness, product quality, and time available for users.
  • Simplify workflows, clarify responsibilities, and remove processes that create more work than value.
  • Build and maintain the insight infrastructure, operating cadences, templates, taxonomy, and tool configuration that let teams spend more time with users and less time fighting systems.
  • Make planning, roadmap reviews, launch and beta management, product/GTM alignment, and feedback loops useful to teams—not artifacts produced mainly for leadership oversight.
  • Identify effective AI-enabled practices already emerging across the organization, make the most useful workflows and tools available more broadly, and help PMs use them responsibly to improve their work.
  • Test improvements with small groups, measure their impact, and scale what works.

Expand how we recruit and develop great PMs

  • Partner with product leaders and recruiting to define the capabilities, user understanding, and domain knowledge each product needs.
  • Identify promising talent in roles beyond traditional product management, including people who deeply understand a product’s users because they have done their work, supported them, or built solutions for them.
  • Create targeted job descriptions and sourcing strategies that explicitly welcome relevant non-PM backgrounds.
  • Develop assessments that reveal product judgment, learning ability, analytical thinking, communication, and user empathy.
  • Help select and hire candidates with strong potential, then build training, mentorship, and practical assignments that turn that potential into effective PM performance.
  • Use hiring and onboarding outcomes to continuously improve the recruiting process.

Raise the standard of product management

  • Define clear, observable expectations for excellent PM work at different levels.
  • Discover practices that are producing better decisions and product outcomes across the organization.
  • Turn those practices into useful examples, coaching, peer learning, and reusable workflows.
  • Strengthen how PMs understand users, frame problems, prioritize opportunities, collaborate with engineering and design, and assess results.
  • Help teams connect each major product bet to a measurable outcome, and ensure ownership and decision-making authority travel together.
  • Design lightweight governance mechanisms when needed: clear decision rights, published criteria, a single accountable owner, and fast turnaround. Facilitate these mechanisms without becoming the decision-making gatekeeper.
  • Measure whether practices improve the work, and adapt them to different product contexts.

The successful candidate will possess these skills:

  • An ability to recognize product talent across varied backgrounds and develop people through coaching and structured learning.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and change-management skills.
  • The ability to influence across teams and move between organizational design and hands-on execution.

The successful candidate will achieve these outcomes:

  • PMs spend less time navigating internal friction and more time understanding users and making consequential product decisions.
  • Teams can quickly find current customer evidence, product context, and clear operating guidance; product decisions are increasingly grounded in recent, traceable insight.
  • Effective AI-enabled practices spread across teams and deliver measurable improvements in productivity and work quality.
  • Recruiting reaches strong candidates from a wider range of relevant backgrounds.
  • New PMs develop the skills and judgment to contribute effectively.
  • High-performing practices spread across teams, and the quality of PM work improves.
  • Operating mechanisms are lightweight and team-enabling: fewer unnecessary artifacts and meetings, clearer decision rights, and faster resolution of cross-functional issues.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university
  • 5+ years of experience in product management, product operations, or a related role improving how product teams work.
  • A 5+ year track record of identifying friction and delivering improvements that people adopt.
  • A 5+ year track record of identifying friction and delivering improvements that people adopt.
  • Articulated examples of strong product judgment and a practical understanding of the demands placed on PMs.
  • Articulated examples of experience designing operating mechanisms that enable autonomous teams while avoiding unnecessary process, meetings, and approval layers.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of familiarity with AI-enabled tools and workflows, with sound judgment about where they improve work and where accuracy, source traceability, access permissions, or human review matter.
  • Ability to travel 20-25% on average.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Position Summary

Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Epic MyChart Senior Consultant, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as an Analyst without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long-term, onsite and/or remote client service delivery.

Recruiting for this role ends December 11, 2026


Work you'll do

As an Epic MyChart Senior Consultant you’ll design and configure Epic MyChart , workflow analysis and optimizations: results routing, questionnaires, messaging etc.

Responsibilities

  • MyChart configuration for projects, upgrades, and optimizations, working with the client to understand workflow and design through deployment and stabilization.
  • Configure and support capabilities such as appointment scheduling, e-Check-in, questionnaires, result release, telehealth, mobile access, and billing self-service.
  • Facilitate build demonstrations; translate clinical and operational needs into practical workflows and system requirements.
  • Assist with development of test plans, assist with issue resolution, and support production troubleshooting as needed.
  • Manage impacts, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications; mentor junior team members and client staff.

* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

The team

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Our Industry Solutions offering provides verticalized solutions that transform how clients sell products, deliver services, generate growth, and execute mission-critical operations. We deliver integrated business expertise with scalable, repeatable technology solutions specifically engineered for each sector.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active Certification in Epic MyChart
  • Experience with Epic MyChart build, implementation and support.
  • Excellent collaboration skills are essential, as this role will work closely with business partners throughout design and implementation activities.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of hands-on Epic build experience
  • Experience in application workflows, troubleshooting, testing and support
  • Excellent analytical problem-solving, communication and project management skills
  • Demonstrative understanding of technical documentation
  • Demonstrative understanding of Change control processes

  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong desktop skills including Word, Excel, PowerPoint

Requisition code: 375150
Job ID 375150

Quick facts

  • Pay: $116,200 to $229,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 4+ years

About this job

Lead Moveworks AI Assistant implementation projects for Deloitte's Human Capital practice, working across discovery, design, build, test, and deployment. Configure AI agents and integrations to automate employee support workflows in HR and IT, collaborating with client stakeholders and enterprise systems like ServiceNow and Workday.

Good fit if you have 4+ years implementing enterprise platforms like Moveworks or ServiceNow, plus experience with system integrations and APIs.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/14/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant on the Moveworks team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading Moveworks implementation projects and workstreams across discovery, design, build, test, and deployment activities using an agile deployment methodology
  • Establishing user journeys and user stories to support the design and configuration of the Moveworks AI Assistant, including knowledge management, conversational flows, and enterprise search capabilities
  • Configuring and optimizing AI agents, plugins, and integrations within the Moveworks platform to automate employee support workflows across HR, IT, and other enterprise functions
  • Collaborating with client stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, document current-state service delivery operations, and support joint design sessions
  • Managing project plans, milestones, risks, scope, and deliverables while supporting integrations with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, and other human resources information system or information technology service management platforms

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our HR Strategy & Technology Offering is dedicated to developing leading global HR strategies and implementing cutting-edge HR technologies. We drive transformation and maximize the workforce experience, ensuring sustained HR effectiveness and value. In a world of disruption, our solutions empower organizations to navigate challenges seamlessly, enhancing their HR capabilities and fostering a resilient workforce.

Our Moveworks Team is dedicated to delivering AI-powered employee experience solutions that help clients transform their HR and IT service delivery practices. We drive significant cost savings, increased efficiency, a stronger competitive advantage, and improved employee experience through intelligent automation and agentic AI capabilities.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 4+ years of experience supporting system integrations, including hands-on work with application programming interfaces (APIs), Representational State Transfer (REST), or Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), and troubleshooting integration issues
  • 4+ years of experience implementing enterprise platforms, such as Moveworks, Workday or ServiceNow, across configuration support, testing, and deployment activities
  • Ability to travel 0-30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

  • 4+ years of experience with solution architecture and system design for AI-driven employee experiences, including virtual assistants, automation, or orchestration across HR or IT platforms
  • 2+ years of experience with Moveworks platform configuration, Agent Studio, or similar conversational artificial intelligence platforms
  • 2+ years of experience collaborating with HR, IT, information security, and platform teams to deliver technical solutions and resolve issues
  • 2+ years of project management experience
  • 2+ years of Big 4 consulting experience
  • 2+ years of experience designing or implementing an HR shared service center or employee service delivery transformation initiatives

Job.JobTitle: Vice President, Sales Executive - AI & Engineering - GPS Marketplace
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Are you an accomplished technology sales leader who understands how cloud, data, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and engineering can help public-sector and higher education organizations deliver better outcomes?

Deloitte is seeking a GPS AI & Engineering Sales Executive to help grow our State, Local & Higher Education market. In this role, you will work with state and local governments, public higher education systems and institutions, and selected private higher education clients to shape and close opportunities that advance mission delivery, modernize operations, improve constituent and student experiences, and strengthen organizational resilience

You will join Deloitte’s Government & Public Services Client & Market Acceleration Team, working alongside account leaders, offering leaders, delivery professionals, alliance teams, and industry specialists. Together, we identify client priorities, develop differentiated solutions, shape pursuits, and bring the right capabilities to market

This is an opportunity to combine executive relationship building, consultative selling, market development, and technology acumen in a role with visible impact across complex public-sector and higher education environments

What you’ll do

As a Sales Executive, you will develop qualified pipeline and close opportunities that expand Deloitte’s cloud, AI, data & analytics, and technology-enabled engineering and consulting services across the State, Local & Higher Education (SLHE) market.

  • Establish Deloitte as a trusted leader in cloud, AI, engineering, and technology-enabled transformation for state, local, and higher education clients
  • Develop and execute territory, account, and pursuit strategies that support growth and exceed sales objectives
  • Prospect, qualify, and build relationships across states, municipalities, counties, agencies, public authorities, university systems, colleges, and universities
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management, opportunity planning, forecasting, and pursuit governance, including pipeline coverage of approximately three times annual sales quota
  • Connect Deloitte’s technology capabilities to measurable mission outcomes, including improved constituent services, student and faculty experiences, research enablement, administrative modernization, affordability, security, and operational resilience
  • Serve as a trusted cloud and technology sales advisor to account teams and clients
  • Shape differentiated value propositions, win themes, solution approaches, and economic models for complex opportunities
  • Advise account leaders and pursuit teams on sales strategy, solution architecture, procurement approaches, commercial considerations, and ecosystem partners
  • Lead or support strategic pursuits and capture efforts involving formal procurements, cooperative purchasing vehicles, complex buying groups, and large-scale modernization programs
  • Collaborate with GPS sector and offering leaders to develop repeatable market strategies across priority domains
  • Develop joint go-to-market and account strategies with hyperscalers and other ecosystem platforms, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud
  • Identify opportunities involving technology resale, managed services, cloud operations, and other recurring or technology-enabled offerings when appropriate
  • Connect clients and account teams with Deloitte cloud, AI, engineering, cyber, data, and industry specialists to design secure, scalable, and mission-aligned solutions
  • Manage the sales process from opportunity identification through closure and maintain ownership of the sale

A successful candidate would also possess these skills

  • A track record of building trusted relationships with senior public officials, agency executives, CIOs, technology leaders, university administrators, and other senior stakeholders
  • The ability to build and grow business with cloud and technology ecosystem partners
  • Strong executive presence, business judgment, written communication, presentation, negotiation, and facilitation skills
  • Demonstrated leadership in complex pursuits and account-growth initiatives
  • The ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and align account, offering, alliance, technical, and delivery stakeholders
  • A consultative approach to shaping solutions that address mission outcomes, service delivery, affordability, security, privacy, and operational resilience
  • Comfort operating as a self-directed business builder while contributing effectively within

The team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services practice works with public-sector and higher education organizations to address complex mission, operational, and technology challenges. Within GPS, the Client & Market Acceleration Team identifies, qualifies, and closes opportunities by bringing together account leadership, industry knowledge, technical capabilities, delivery experience, and alliance relationships.

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of client mission, business strategy, technology innovation, and marketplace growth. You will collaborate across a matrixed organization and help clients translate emerging technologies into practical, secure, and sustainable outcomes.

Basic qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, public administration, education, computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • At least 10 years of combined experience in public-sector contracting, business development, capture, account growth, or direct sales
  • Between 7-10 years of successful experience selling cloud, AI, engineering, or technology-enabled consulting services in the U.S. public sector, with emphasis on state and local government and/or higher education
  • Demonstrated technical fluency with hyperscale cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud
  • Working knowledge of the State, Local & Higher Education technology landscape, including mission priorities, budget cycles, procurement processes, cooperative purchasing vehicles, public-sector contracting requirements, and the technology partner ecosystem
  • Experience selling complex, project-based professional services involving multiple stakeholders, formal procurements, extended decision cycles, and transactions of varying size
  • Experience developing and executing strategic and tactical plans across a defined market, territory, or account portfolio
  • Ability to travel up to 25%, based on client and business needs
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred qualifications

  • Business or technical certification from a leading cloud services provider, such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, or Google Cloud Digital Leader
  • Experience selling to and relationships with SLHE government agencies, including health and human services, transportation, justice and public safety, finance and administration, digital government, higher education enterprise platforms, research administration, student success, data and AI, cybersecurity, or cloud modernization
  • Experience developing joint solutions or go-to-market strategies with hyperscalers, software providers, systems integrators, or other technology ecosystem partners
  • Experience with public-sector contract vehicles, cooperative purchasing vehicles, or other formal procurement channels
  • Demonstrated understanding of how cloud, data, AI, cyber, and engineering capabilities can be translated into measurable mission and business outcomes.
  • Strong ownership, follow-through, and resilience across long sales cycles and complex decision environments
  • The ability to gain access to and influence senior decision makers while navigating public accountability and diverse stakeholder interests

Why join this opportunity

  • Help public-sector and higher education clients modernize services that directly affect constituents, students, faculty, researchers, and communities
  • Work across cloud, artificial intelligence, data, cybersecurity, engineering, and digital transformation
  • Collaborate with senior Deloitte leaders, technical specialists, delivery teams, and leading technology partners
  • Shape market strategy and repeatable solutions in high-priority GPS domains
  • Lead complex, high-visibility pursuits where strong relationship management and commercial creativity matter
  • Build a broad executive network across government, higher education, technology, and professional services

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $175,300.00 to $322,900.00.

You may also be eligible to participate in a sales incentive program, whereby you may be eligible to receive certain incentive compensation amounts based on achievement of certain sales goals set forth each year, subject to the terms and conditions of any applicable program document.

Job.JobTitle: Consultant Risk and Forensics - Data Management
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Consultant Risk and Forensics - Data Management

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organization. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 03/05/2027.

Work you will do

As a Consultant Risk and Forensics on the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team, you will be responsible for:

  • Execute eDiscovery, contract analytics, and unstructured data activities on client engagements with guidance from senior team members.
  • Use Relativity and other discovery and unstructured data technologies to organize, review, and analyze engagement data.
  • Prepare written reports and presentation materials, and contribute to client discussions.
  • Use generative AI according to engagement guidance to support analysis and improve efficiency.
  • Track assigned tasks, communicate progress, raise questions or issues, and collaborate with engagement teams to deliver accurate, timely work.
  • Contribute to initiatives that strengthen the practice’s tools, methods, and capabilities.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team
Our Forensic, Discovery, & Financial Crime offering provides services to support anti-money laundering, discovery, business disputes, and investigations. We help protect brands from financial crime and other corporate misconduct, and empower government organizations with advanced tradecraft and technology to combat emerging and evolving threats.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, Economics, or Finance.
  • 2+ years of consulting or industry experience in forensics, eDiscovery, information governance, or content archiving.
  • Experience using an eDiscovery platform: Relativity, Nuix, or Brainspace.
  • Experience with contract analytics, unstructured data analytics, or generative artificial intelligence (AI) platforms, including Pramata, Harvey, or Legora.
  • Coursework or experience with databases and file systems.
  • Experience using Tableau or Microsoft Power BI.
  • Coursework or experience using a programming or query language: Java, Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, C#, or Visual Basic for Applications (VBA).
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1–2 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, Economics, or Finance.
  • Experience applying natural language processing, machine learning, or generative artificial intelligence to eDiscovery, contract analytics, or unstructured data analytics.
  • Experience with information governance, document retention, regulatory archiving, write once, read many (WORM) storage, or Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Rules 17a-3 and 17a-4.
  • Experience using Elasticsearch.
  • Experience developing or implementing records taxonomies.
  • Experience using Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure cloud services.

A reasonable estimate of the current range is $86,700 to $170,900.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Manager Risk and Forensics - Data Management
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Manager Risk and Forensics - Data Management

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organizations. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 03/05/2027.

Work you will do

As a Manager Risk and Forensics on the Forensic, Discovery, & Financial Crime team, you will be responsible for:

  • Manage day-to-day engagement delivery, including scope, work plans, timelines, resources, and the quality of deliverables.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of reports, findings, and recommendations for client stakeholders and engagement leadership.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership using Relativity and other eDiscovery and unstructured data technologies, including generative AI tools.
  • Define resource requirements, assign responsibilities, and adjust staffing priorities as engagement needs evolve.
  • Supervise, coach, and develop consultants and senior consultants, providing clear direction and actionable feedback.
  • Develop and maintain client relationships, manage expectations and delivery issues, and lead practice-improvement initiatives.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team
Our Forensic, Discovery, & Financial Crime offering provides services to support anti-money laundering, discovery, business disputes, and investigations. We help protect brands from financial crime and other corporate misconduct, and empower government organizations with advanced tradecraft and technology to combat emerging and evolving threats.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, Economics, or Finance. 6+ years of consulting experience in forensics, eDiscovery, information governance, or content archiving.
  • Experience leading project teams and managing client engagements, including scope, work plans, timelines, resource allocation, delegation, oversight of deliverables, client presentations, and supervision, coaching, and development of team members.
  • Experience with eDiscovery platforms such as Relativity, Nuix, or Brainspace; contract and/or unstructured data analytics and generative artificial intelligence (AI) platforms such as Pramata, Harvey, or Legora; databases and file systems; data visualization tools such as Tableau or Microsoft Power BI; and at least one programming language: Java, Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, C#, or Visual Basic for Applications (VBA).
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1–2 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree.
  • Experience with natural language processing (NLP), machine learning, and generative artificial intelligence (AI).
  • Experience with information governance, document retention, regulatory archiving, write once, read many (WORM) storage, and Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Rules 17a-3 and 17a-4.
  • Experience using Elasticsearch.
  • Experience developing and implementing records taxonomies.
  • Experience using Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Microsoft Azure cloud services.

Job.JobTitle: Manager Knowledge Based Engineering - Supply Chain
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $141,200 to $278,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Fort Lauderdale, FL
  • Experience: 8+ years

About this job

Lead a client workstream converting engineering knowledge into machine-executable Knowledge-Based Engineering assets to improve cycle time and quality. Work with a team across onshore and offshore delivery on design automation, knowledge governance, and AI-assisted decision-making integrated with CAD and PLM tools.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in software or systems engineering with 5+ years leading teams, plus 3+ years implementing rule-based or design automation solutions.

Full job description

Position Summary

We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don’t miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

Recruiting for this role ends on 02/14/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Strategy, Growth and Transformation professional on the US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering team, you will lead a client workstream that converts tacit and documented engineering knowledge—including design rules, calculations, standards, lessons learned, and prior decisions—into governed, reusable, machine-executable Knowledge-Based Engineering (KBE) assets. You will help clients redesign engineering decision-making using deterministic rules for common cases, artificial intelligence (AI) agents for exceptions, and engineer approval to deliver measurable improvements in cycle time, rework, and quality.

  • Lead a workstream team of four or more practitioners across onshore and offshore delivery through knowledge discovery, modeling, build, testing, deployment, and coaching of Senior Consultants.
  • Facilitate knowledge capture with senior engineers through interviews, decision replay of historical cases, and rule extraction to preserve engineering judgment before automation; define deterministic rules and constraints versus artificial intelligence agent reasoning with human-in-the-loop approvals; and design knowledge models—including rules, parameters, constraints, ontologies, and taxonomies—with solution and technical architects.
  • Direct design automation and configuration capabilities integrated with engineering data and tools, including Computer-Aided Design (CAD), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and requirements-management tools; define agent roles, tool boundaries, and approval points; and partner with platform teams for deployment.
  • Establish knowledge governance, including ownership, review and approval, versioning, retirement, and exception-to-knowledge feedback loops; baseline current-state effort, rework, and cycle time; and track value realization from knowledge reuse.
  • Manage delivery activities, including weekly status reporting; risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies (RAID); steering committee materials; and workstream financial tracking. Facilitate workshops with engineering stakeholders, drive adoption through pushback and change resistance, and escalate risks, dependencies, and decisions to the Senior Manager and engagement leadership.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, digital engineering, embedded/automation, engineering data, or engineering transformation (industry and/or consulting), including 5+ years leading a team/workstream.
  • 3+ years of experience in rule-based, knowledge-based, configurator, or design automation solutioning into production.
  • 4+ years of experience in one or more of the following: rule/constraint modeling, parametric/template-driven design, engineering calculation automation, configurators, or knowledge modeling.
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with ontologies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, and structured models linking rules to requirements, parts/variants, suppliers, and bill of materials (BOM) structures.
  • Experience in software and systems engineering environments, including application lifecycle management (ALM) and product lifecycle management (PLM), and rule engines tied to product structures and variant logic.
  • Experience using generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) to extract and structure knowledge from documents and past decisions, validated with expert engineers through source-grounded, traceable outputs.
  • Experience combining deterministic rules with large language model (LLM) reasoning, including clear criteria for when agents must defer to rules versus require approval.
  • Experience orchestrating agent workflows on a major cloud platform, including human approval steps, memory, and evaluation.
  • Knowledge governance experience (rule ownership, change control, versioning, and curator/steward roles); mechanical, electrical, or systems design background; Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) exposure; or offshore delivery experience.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200 to $278,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $128,000 to $252,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 7+ years

About this job

Lead end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud Learning implementations for government and public sector clients, managing requirements, design, testing, and post-go-live support. Requires 7+ years delivering Oracle HCM solutions and 4+ years leading full lifecycle Learning module implementations.

Good fit if you have 7+ years Oracle HCM Cloud experience, 4+ years leading Learning module implementations, and hold a bachelor's degree.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Human Capital team helps organizations create value through people performance. We work with clients to reimagine work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise and to transform their HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today’s world, you will help clients answer questions like: How do I access, develop, and motivate my workforce? What should my AI strategy be for the HR function? Do I have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to make work better for humans and humans better at work.

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/31/2027.

Work You'll Do

As a Manager on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Facilitating requirements and design workshops, providing guidance on solution design and best practices, and managing risks and stakeholder communications while ensuring alignment with compliance, policy, and operational requirements
  • Driving high-quality functional documentation and disciplined delivery execution to minimize rework and support traceability
  • Anticipating and manage cross-functional impacts across HR, security, reporting, and integrations
  • Supporting change management, cutover, training, and transition to steady-state support to promote user adoption and successful business outcomes
  • Applying working knowledge of integrations, security, reporting, payroll, benefits, and finance dependencies to guide solution decisions and delivery planning
  • Supporting cross-functional teams across functional, technical, integration, data conversion, and testing workstreams to ensure quality delivery, timely issue resolution, and milestone achievement
  • Leading the end-to-end implementation of large-scale Oracle HCM Cloud Learning solutions, including planning, design, configuration oversight, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our HR Strategy & Technology offering develops leading global HR strategies and implements HR technologies that drive transformation, maximize the workforce experience, and sustain HR effectiveness and value while navigating a world of disruption.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 7+ years of experience delivering Oracle HCM Cloud solutions, to include experience in all phases of the technology implementation lifecycle such as requirements gathering, design, build, go-live, and testing
  • 4+ years of experience with leading the full life cycle implementation of both Oracle HCM Cloud Learning module(s)
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance for this role
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Experience delivering across multiple Oracle HCM Cloud implementations within large-scale, multi-stakeholder public sector programs supporting 10,000+ employees
  • Experience in government and public sector implementations
  • Oracle HCM Cloud certified

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You’ll Do

As a Delivery Senior Consultant, Configuration and Integration Solutions on the team, you will:

  • Develop end-to-end Salesforce solutions using Configuration and Customization - APEX Class, Triggers, Visualforce pages, Lightning components etc

About this job

Develop and customize Salesforce solutions across multiple clouds, including front-end interfaces with Lightning Web Components and back-end Apex development. Good fit if you have Salesforce customization and configuration experience, front-end development skills with JavaScript and LWC, back-end Apex development, and can obtain a security clearance

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You’ll Do

As a US Delivery Center Delivery Consultant, Configuration and Integration Solutions on the team, you will:

  • Develop and customize Salesforce user experiences using Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura, and Visualforce, integrated with back-end services (Apex/controllers)
  • Deliver responsive, cross-device interfaces and optimize front-end performance for complex, data-heavy pages
  • Partner with design, product, and engineering to implement features end-to-end; troubleshoot and resolve UI defects
  • Produce and maintain technical approach/design documentation and adhere to coding standards for clean, maintainable code
  • Build and enhance solutions across Salesforce clouds (Sales, Service, Marketing, Experience/Communities, Knowledge) and configure the security model (Profiles, Permission Sets, OWD)
  • Create and distribute reports/dashboards, perform data loads/migrations (Data Loader/Import Wizard), and develop/maintain automation (Flow; legacy Workflow/Process Builder as needed)

  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future 
  • Ability to obtain a security clearance and maintain it
  • Salesforce customization/configuration across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service, Experience Cloud, and Knowledge
  • Migration from Salesforce Classic to Lightning Experience, including Visualforce-to-Lightning conversions and Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS) adoption
  • Front-end development with JavaScript, SLDS, and Lightning Web Components (LWC)

About this job

Senior Consultant role with Deloitte's Customer Strategy & Design practice supporting healthcare clients in product strategy, design, and implementation. You will conduct customer research, define product requirements, and lead workstreams while partnering with client product teams and internal engineering, data, and design teams.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in consulting or product roles, 5+ years in healthcare (health plans, providers, or pharmacy), and 4+ years in customer research or service design.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join Deloitte's Customer Strategy & Design practice to support healthcare clients in product strategy, design, and implementation. Our teams help health plans, providers, and pharmacy organizations shape and deliver digital experiences for their members, patients, and providers. In this client-facing consulting role, you will turn customer research, journey mapping, and service design into product requirements and experiences, partnering with client product teams and Deloitte engineering, data, and design teams. Recruiting for this role ends on Feb 1, 2027

Work you'll do

As a Healthcare Product Strategy & Design Senior Consultant, you will support healthcare clients with product strategy, design, and implementation. Specifically, you will be responsible for:

  • Conduct customer research, journey mapping, and service design to identify and address high-friction experiences across benefits, pharmacy, and navigation.
  • Define product requirements and shape epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, partnering with client product teams and Deloitte engineering, data, and design teams to bring experiences to life.
  • Support product strategy and roadmap development for member, patient, and provider experiences, balancing experience outcomes with cost.

  • Use AI tools to accelerate everyday work, such as research synthesis, drafting, and analysis, and help clients explore AI-enabled member and provider experiences.
  • Senior Consultants: lead a workstream or project, guide team members, and manage day-to-day client interactions.
  • Consultants: contribute to workstreams, with a focus on research, synthesis, and analysis.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Curiosity and comfort using AI tools to accelerate everyday work
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

The team

Deloitte's Customer Strategy and Design practice is the strategic and experiential hub of Deloitte Digital. We excel in customer experience, marketing strategy, commercial transformation, and innovation/design, offering insights to navigate disruption and shape client agendas. Our team includes business strategists, operations experts, designers, and technologists focused on customer-centered solutions. We specialize in customer segmentation, go-to-market strategy, channel optimization, service design, UX design, and customer analytics. Join us to drive impactful customer experiences and market success.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in consulting, in-house strategy, customer experience (CX), or product roles, including leading a workstream or project.
  • 5+ years of experience working with or within health plans, healthcare providers, and/or pharmacy organizations.
  • 5+ years of experience in experience-driven product work, including defining requirements, shaping user stories, and partnering with product and engineering teams to bring experiences to life.
  • 4+ years of experience in customer research, journey mapping, or service design.
  • 2+ years of experience using AI tools to accelerate everyday work, such as research synthesis, drafting, and analysis.
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, is based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience in management consulting advising health plans, healthcare providers, pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) organizations, specialty pharmacies, or digital pharmacies.
  • Experience in engineering, software development, data, or technical product management.
  • Experience participating in client working sessions and presenting analyses or recommendations to stakeholders

About this job

Consultant supporting end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud Core HR implementations for public sector clients, including planning, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Work involves managing cross-functional teams and coordinating integrations, security, reporting, and payroll dependencies.

Good fit if you have 2+ years delivering Oracle HCM Cloud solutions and 1+ years leading a full Core HR implementation, plus ability to obtain Public Trust clearance.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Human Capital team helps organizations create value through people performance. We work with clients to reimagine work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise and to transform their HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today’s world, you will help clients answer questions like: How do I access, develop, and motivate my workforce? What should my AI strategy be for the HR function? Do I have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to make work better for humans and humans better at work.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/31/2027.

Work You'll Do

As a Consultant on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Supporting high-quality functional documentation and disciplined delivery execution to minimize rework and support traceability
  • Anticipating and manage cross-functional impacts across HR, security, reporting, and integrations
  • Supporting change management, cutover, training, and transition to steady-state support to promote user adoption and successful business outcomes
  • Applying working knowledge of integrations, security, reporting, payroll, benefits, and finance dependencies to guide solution decisions and delivery planning Directing cross-functional teams across functional, technical, integration, data conversion, and testing workstreams to ensure quality delivery, timely issue resolution, and milestone achievement
  • Delivering end-to-end implementation of large-scale Oracle Core HR solutions, including planning, design, configuration oversight, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our HR Strategy & Technology offering develops leading global HR strategies and implements HR technologies that drive transformation, maximize the workforce experience, and sustain HR effectiveness and value while navigating a world of disruption.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 2+ years of experience delivering Oracle HCM Cloud solutions
  • 1+ years of experience with supporting or leading a full-life cycle implementation of Oracle Cloud HCM Core HR module
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance for this role
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Experience delivering across multiple Oracle HCM Cloud implementations within large-scale, multi-stakeholder public sector programs supporting 10,000+ employees
  • Experience in government and public sector implementations
  • Oracle HCM Cloud certified
