Job.CustomJobTypeName: Payroll Specialist, Accounting / Finance / Banking, Cloud Engineer
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $116,200 to $229,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 3+ years

About this job

Senior Consultant leading full-cycle Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll implementations for Deloitte's government and public sector clients. You will serve as subject matter expert in payroll module configuration, manage payroll compare cycles, and work across cross-functional teams to deliver integrated HCM solutions.

Good fit if you have 5+ years delivering Oracle HCM Cloud solutions, 3+ years leading payroll module configuration, a bachelor's degree, and can obtain Public Trust clearance.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Human Capital team helps organizations create value through people performance. We work with clients to reimagine work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise and to transform their HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today’s world, you will help clients answer questions like: How do I access, develop, and motivate my workforce? What should my AI strategy be for the HR function? Do I have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to make work better for humans and humans better at work.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work You'll Do

As a Senior Consultant on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for full-cycle Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll implementations, ensuring seamless delivery and quality execution across all project phases
  • Lead the functional configuration of the Oracle Payroll module, ensuring all system designs and setups align with client business processes, compliance needs, and operational requirements
  • Direct and validate Payroll compare cycles, proactively identifying discrepancies, analyzing root causes, and establishing effective remediation strategies to ensure accurate payroll processing
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to design and optimize integrated Payroll solutions that support broader HCM Cloud capabilities and deliver holistic value to clients
  • Anticipate client needs, proactively address potential challenges, and formulate actionable solutions to resolve complex client issues, while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships and elevating client satisfaction

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our HR Strategy & Technology offering develops leading global HR strategies and implements HR technologies that drive transformation, maximize the workforce experience, and sustain HR effectiveness and value while navigating a world of disruption.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5 + years of experience delivering Oracle HCM Cloud solutions, to include experience in all phases of the technology implementation lifecycle such as requirements gathering, design, build, go-live, and testing
  • 3+ years of experience with leading the configuration of the Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll module
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance for this role
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Experience delivering across multiple Oracle HCM Cloud implementations within large-scale, multi-stakeholder public sector programs supporting 10,000+ employees
  • Experience in government and public sector implementations
  • Oracle HCM Cloud certified

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

 

Work You’ll Do

As a Project Support Specialist Security Engineer III on the Project team, you will be responsible for…

  • Coordinate federal ATO activities by tracking authorization milestones and preparing security documentation.
  • Collect and organize control implementation evidence from system owners, cybersecurity teams, and information system security officers (ISSOs).
  • Support the development and maintenance of system security plans, plans of action and milestones (POA&Ms), risk assessments, and authorization packages.
  • Conduct client requirements analysis and data analysis; develop written recommendations and presentations; coordinate stakeholders, work plans, and milestones; and support implementation.
  • Assess alignment with the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and agency requirements; document findings and recommendations.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Digital Trust & Privacy offering enables trust and safety of online communications and digital products, protecting users, consumers, and patients from harm. Enables clients to provide consumer confidence in knowing with whom they are dealing and ensuring the integrity of access to data.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

 

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Active Public Trust security clearance required
  • 3+ years of consulting experience in client requirements analysis, data analysis, recommendation and presentation development, stakeholder coordination, work-plan and milestone management, and implementation support.
  • 3+ years of experience with the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework.
  • 3+ years of experience conducting cyber assessments, such as NIST/RMF security control assessments, cybersecurity maturity assessments, vulnerability assessments, and cybersecurity risk assessments.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred: 

  • Experience supporting federal Authority to Operate (ATO) activities, including security documentation, system security plans, plans of action and milestones (POA&Ms), risk assessments, and authorization milestones.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Bring your experience in accounts receivable disputes and deduction resolution to Deloitte’s Project Talent Model. As a Consultant within Managed Services, you will support dispute resolution activities, help improve cash recovery outcomes, and contribute to process improvements that strengthen finance operations. This role offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative delivery environment with limited travel and a focus on operational excellence.

Work you'll do

You will be responsible for supporting dispute resolution activities, analyzing deduction trends, and helping improve accounts receivable performance.

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of customer deductions, including short payments, pricing discrepancies, shipping errors, and compliance-related fees
  • Conduct deep-dive research and validate disputes using enterprise resource planning systems, customer portals, proof of delivery, and supporting documentation
  • Communicate with customers and cross-functional stakeholders to gather information, challenge invalid claims, and drive timely resolution
  • Maintain complete dispute case files to support audit readiness and consistent decisioning
  • Serve as an escalation point for analysts; lead customer and internal negotiations to challenge invalid claims and secure repayment or documentation-based denial
  • Process approved credits and support recovery efforts for invalid deductions with complete and accurate documentation
  • Track dispute trends, identify root causes, and support process improvements that reduce recurring deductions and improve workflow efficiency
  • Coach analysts on investigation methods, documentation standards, prioritization, and customer communications

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

The Enterprise Performance Portfolio helps clients improve the value they realize from investments in finance, supply chain, and information technology operations. By connecting strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operate services, the team helps organizations address complex business challenges and improve day-to-day performance. As clients continue to evolve their digital operations, this team plays an important role in helping them strengthen how they serve customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders. This section is based on the source posting’s Enterprise Performance Portfolio description .

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in accounts receivable, dispute management, deduction management, or financial analysis
  • Strong proficiency using an enterprise resource planning system, such as SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel for analysis, tracking, and reporting
  • Ability to work in or relocate to the Lake Mary, Florida area
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Candidates must be at least 18 years of age at the time of employment.

Preferred:

  • Experience investigating customer deductions, short payments, pricing discrepancies, or shipping errors
  • Experience compiling documentation to support credit approval or deduction denial
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Customer Service, Collections, or process teams
  • Experience identifying dispute trends and root causes through reporting or data analysis
  • Experience supporting process improvement initiatives in finance or order-to-cash operations

Quick facts

  • Pay: $141,200 to $278,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 6+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Lead architect role at Deloitte's AI & Engineering team modernizing mainframe applications for enterprise clients. You'll design large-scale software solutions, lead technical teams across geographies, and drive migration to cloud platforms while maintaining hands-on development work.

Good fit if you have 5+ years mainframe modernization experience, strong COBOL and JCL background, AWS expertise, and proven application architecture leadership.

Full job description

Position Summary

Mainframe Application Modernization Lead Software Engineer and Architect – AI & Engineering/EaaS

Lead Software Engineer II

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/31/2027.

Work You'll Do

You will bring considerable technical, functional and leadership experience as part of our Software Engineering team. You’ll be responsible for leading teams who support the design, development and deployment of large-scale complex software solutions at an enterprise level. Your team will support various applications and the complex programs surrounding these applications including internal consultants, near-shore and off-shore technologists and multiple vendor relationships. You’ll work across geographies, with accountability for the success, effectiveness and delivery of multiple work streams.  In addition, you’ll do the following:

  • Lead and drive discussions to come up with technical architecture and design, working with the team to shape requirements, develop technical design solutions, resolve ambiguities, focus on deliverables, meeting deadlines, quality metrics, etc.
  • Work hands-on on a regular basis – in the role of a senior developer and/or architect
  • Manage day-to-day project execution working with your established teams.
  • Establish technical design/development guidelines, templates and standards.
  • Interact regularly with other stakeholders not limited to end-user clients, project management teams, development teams, offshore development teams, testing and other cross-functional teams.
  • Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key internal clients, organize and participate in and lead aspects of the development process and contribute to the development of key technology strategies.


Work you’ll do:

  • Architect and Design: assist in the design and development of enterprise-grade application architecture applications and platforms, with a focus on scaling for production in a legacy modernization environment. This includes defining the technical architecture, selecting appropriate technologies, and ensuring solutions are robust, scalable, and secure.
  • Support modernization efforts across clients’ services capabilities working with a highly matrixed collaborative environment, working as a valued member of a cohesive architecture and development team.
  • Assist in the design and deployment of applications using Cloud Native principles on a hyperscaler platform (AWS, Azure, GCP). Leverage a wide range of hyperscaler tools and services, including containers (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless functions, and managed databases. Should have experience in leveraging various GenAI tools to accelerate software development life cycle.
  • Assist in the management and delivery components of client engagements that identify, design, and implement technology and creative business solutions for large companies. 
  • Responsibilities include, among others, managing small teams in the identification of business requirements, functional design, process design (including scenario design, flow mapping), prototyping, testing, training, defining support procedures.
  • Review and evaluation of key attributes of existing application modernization architectures
  • Assist in the recommendation of improvements to existing Application Architectures

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering, or a related technical field with a strong foundation in development (Java or .NET) with early experience as a full stack developer.
  • Strong experience with AWS – background should include a combination of skills around legacy stacks AND modern technology stacks.
  • 5+ years’ hands-on experience with COBOL
  • 5+ years’ hands-on experience – JCL & Batch Processing
  • 7+ years’ hands-on experience working on full-life-cycle mainframe application modernization projects in the commercial sector.
  • 5+ years’ hands-on experience working with IBM DB2 for z/OS.
  • 6+ years’ experience as an Application Architect, with a strong focus on application development and scaling solutions for production environments. 
  • 6+ years of experience with on-prem to AWS Cloud migration/integration which should include migration patterns (auth, middleware, data stores, event patterns, caching, telemetry); serverless patterns; data migration
  • 4+ years providing hands-on technical assistance to the delivery team, reviewing designs and code for architectural fit, monitoring engineers and serving as the primary technical liaison between business stakeholders and engineering.
  • 8+ years of experience leading large-scale global technology teams responsible for requirements definition, requirements management, and requirements validation;
  • 1+ years’ experience designing and delivering production-grade AI solutions such as LLM applications, RAG systems, agentic workflows, intelligent automation or ML-enabled products.
  • Experience owning the end-to-end solution architecture which includes defining integration patterns, data flows, and technical design decisions across systems.
  • Experience driving the technical delivery on-site (not remotely), translating business requirements into detailed technical designs, sequencing work across integration and data layers, ensuring the solution is built to spec from design to deployment. 
  • Deep understanding of AI/ML concepts, including experience with LLMs and their application in enterprise settings.
  • Familiarity with various hyperscaler tools and services.
  • Hyperscaler Architect certification is required (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or GCP Professional Cloud Architect).
  • Experience leading the configuration and change management teams responsible for application deployments including the coordination of database changes and other necessary application configurations.
  • 3+ years implementing CI/CD and DevSecOps with Cloud Build, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% nationally based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with architecture design patterns such as MVP or MVC, Gang of Four, etc.
  • Experience with JQuery, JavaScript and common JavaScript Patterns
  • Experience or passion for implementing cloud solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI-compatible APIs, enterprise
  • Master’s degree in computer science or engineering.

Wages and Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.   • Lead the end-to-end delivery of security operations center (SOC) services, including threat intelligence, threat hunting, detection engineering, security information and event management (SIEM) engineering, automation, and incident response.

Position Summary

Software Engineer III- AI & Engineering/Engineering as a Service

You are a hands-on technical leader who designs, builds and ships scalable software systems while mentoring junior engineers and driving technical best practices across the organization. You will architect full-stack and agentic AI solutions, guide distributed engineering teams, and engage with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to deliver high-impact solutions.

  • Creating and maintaining documentation: solution design, data model, security model, and operational runbooks
  • Contributing to knowledge-sharing—reusable components, patterns, accelerators, and internal community of practice assets

Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the requires clearance for this role
  • 4+ years of experience delivering enterprise applications (low-code and/or traditional) with strong business-to-technical translation skills
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building Power Apps, with 1+ years focused on model-driven apps
  • 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Dataverse data modeling and security design
  • 3+ years of experience with Power Automate (cloud flows), including error handling and integration scenarios
  • 1+ years experience designing solutions to address client requirements, including data, security, and non-functional requirements (performance, auditability, supportability)
  • 1+ years experience working in an Agile delivery environment (backlog, user stories, sprint ceremonies)
  • 1+ years experience understanding of ALM concepts for Power Platform (solutions, managed/unmanaged, environment promotion, deployment practices)
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Ability to work in a hybrid model while residing within a commutable distance of Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg, or GeoHub locations in Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, or Philadelphia
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance

Preferred: 

  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., Power Platform App Maker, Power Platform Developer, Power Platform Functional Consultant)
  • Experience with Power Platform extensibility: PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, plugins, or integration middleware
  • Experience with Dynamics 365 implementations (Customer Service, Sales, Field Service, etc.) and common patterns for model-driven apps
  • Familiarity with governance and operating models (CoE setup, environment strategy, DLP (data loss prevention) policies, telemetry/monitoring)
  • Experience with accessibility, UX patterns for model-driven apps, and adoption practices (training, change enablement)
  • Prior Government & Public Services consulting and/or professional services experience
  • Experience with RPA tools like UiPath, Blue Prism or Automation Anywhere.
  • Proven expertise in designing and deploying AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, including conversational flow design, Power Automate integration, and custom connector development

Job.JobTitle: Senior Tax Analyst, Deloitte Global Finance
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

Support Global Tax

  • Prepare U.S. federal operating partnership income tax returns (Form 1065), including Schedules K-1, K-2, and K-3, as applicable, and related supporting workpapers for management review.
  • Prepare U.S. income tax returns for foreign corporations (Form 1120-F), including supporting income allocation calculations and workpapers.
  • Prepare applicable state and local partnership and corporate income tax returns, apportionment calculations, and related tax adjustments.
  • Assist in preparing the annual income tax provision, including current and deferred tax calculations, effective tax rate reconciliations, and supporting journal entries.
  • Perform tax research, document findings, and support tax planning activities in collaboration with Global Finance and Global Business professionals.
  • Organize and validate source data, reconcile supporting schedules, and address review comments to deliver accurate, well-documented tax workpapers.

Tax Team Collaboration and Leadership

  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across locations and time zones to meet team priorities and deadlines.
  • Willingness to share learnings and best practices across the broader team
  • Provide day-to-day assistance and share technical knowledge with analysts, with guidance from tax managers.
  • Communicate effectively with tax and finance counterparts in the United States, Canada, and other global locations.


The team

Global Finance provides the most cutting-edge and insightful research and analysis of the financial health of the entire Deloitte organization around the world. We advise, guide, and monitor global initiatives in five major areas: tax, member-firm reporting, finance and accounting, strategic projects, and financial analysis.



Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or taxation.
  • Minimum 3 years of U.S. tax experience involving operating partnership income tax returns (Form 1065) and/or corporate income tax returns (Form 1120), gained in an accounting or consulting firm or an in-house tax function.
  • Experience preparing tax returns using GoSystem Tax RS.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook, including advanced Excel capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Detail oriented but able to look at the big picture, team player and self-motivated

Preferred

  • U.S. Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license, or progress toward a CPA designation.
  • Experience with Form 1120-F, Schedules K-2 and K-3, and multistate income tax compliance.
  • Exposure to income tax provision calculations under U.S. GAAP or IFRS.
  • Willingness to learn tax compliance requirements in foreign jurisdictions where Deloitte Global has reporting obligations.



Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Job ID 374978

Position Summary

As an Insider Risk Specialist, you will help protect the Firm’s people, information, technology, brand, and reputation. You will analyze technical and behavioral information, identify potential insider risk, support investigations, and help mature the program through data-driven insights and innovative solutions.

This role is well suited for a professional with experience in intelligence analysis, digital forensics, cyber investigations, insider risk, or a related discipline. Success requires curiosity about human behavior, sound judgment, and the ability to make well-reasoned decisions when information is incomplete.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/9/2026

Work you’ll do

As an Insider Risk Specialist, you will:

  • Conduct insider risk assessments and analysis using information from multiple technical, behavioral, and business data sources.
  • Assemble, correlate, evaluate, and interpret information to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential high-risk behavior.
  • Use user and entity behavior analytics tools to develop a holistic understanding of potential insider risk.
  • Conduct data, trend, and reporting analysis and present findings to key stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot root causes, develop solutions, test functionality across environments, and document findings.
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders across Security, Confidentiality & Privacy, Talent, Office of General Counsel, and Deloitte Technology.
  • Contribute to program operations, process improvements, training initiatives, and broader program maturity.
  • Maintain accurate case management documentation and handle sensitive information with appropriate discretion.

The successful candidate will possess:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

(EXTERNAL) The Insider Risk Program resides within the Deloitte U.S. Firm’s Confidentiality and Privacy Office. The Confidentiality and Privacy Office is part of the Risk and Brand Protection organization within Deloitte LLP

(INTERNAL) The Insider Risk Program is a part of Deloitte’s Enterprise Solutions within the Risk and Brand Protection group under Confidentiality and Privacy. This role is not client facing; we support our client-facing professionals in delivering high-quality trusted service to our clients.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Two to four years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Insider risk or insider threat
    • Intelligence analysis – corporate or government
    • Large data analysis
    • Digital forensics
    • Cybersecurity investigations
    • A related analytical field
  • Understanding of insider risk or insider threat principles and investigative processes.
  • Experience analyzing information from multiple data sources and identifying trends or patterns.
  • Exposure to cybersecurity applications, investigative tools, behavioral analytics, or related technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply critical thinking and risk-based judgment.
  • Demonstrated ability to brief senior or non-technical audience with clear, bottom line up front communication.
  • Ability to travel occasionally, generally 0–10%.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Direct work experience in:
    • Insider risk or insider threat programs.
    • Confidentiality, privacy, cybersecurity, investigations, or security operations.
  • Experience with case management platforms and investigative lifecycle processes.
  • Experience using user and entity behavior analytics or similar behavioral analysis tools.
  • Experience with large-scale data analysis, trend analysis, reporting, or dashboard development.
  • Understanding of OSINT methods, public-record research, commercial intelligence databases or threat monitoring.
  • Experience in corporate or government intelligence analysis.
  • Experience producing intelligence products, investigative reports, assessments, or executive briefings.
  • Understanding of human behavior and its application to risk assessment.

What Success Looks Like:

Successful team members are intellectually curious, self-motivated, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. They connect technical evidence with human behavior and business context, make defensible decisions without waiting for perfect information, communicate findings clearly, and contribute to a trusted, collaborative remote team.

Position Summary


Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation. 

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Join Deloitte’s AI & Engineering team and help clients transform technology platforms, modernize operations, and unlock new sources of growth. In this role, you will work with cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges, improve performance, and support the development of innovative, technology-enabled solutions. You will contribute to large-scale transformation efforts that help clients enhance operations, accelerate digital initiatives, and create measurable business value.

Recruiting for this role ends on 03/01/2027.
 
Work you’ll do

As a Healthcare Payer Consulting Manager on the Industry Solutions team, you will be responsible for:
•Leading end-to-end transformation programs, workstreams, or full engagements for health plan clients across business and technology teams, focused on health plan operations transformation, including core administrative functions, pharmacy operations, and operating model redesign. You will draw on experience in at least one core health plan domain and work across payer, pharmacy benefit manager (PBM), and provider functions.
•Driving assessment and redesign of end-to-end processes across claims, enrollment, billing, customer service, utilization management, care management, and pharmacy or PBM operations.
•Shaping strategic direction with senior clients by setting future-state vision, transformation objectives, delivery priorities, strategic options, multi-year road maps, investment priorities, and measurable value outcomes. 
•Manage day-to-day delivery, team performance, quality of work product, and client stakeholder communication across complex transformation programs.
•Supporting business development, proposal development, thought leadership, and go-to-market initiatives within AI & Engineering and Healthcare Industry Solutions, and mentoring junior practitioners with clear guidance on project delivery, problem solving, and client service excellence.
 
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
•Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
•Effective written and verbal communication skills
•Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
•Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
•Ability to lead projects or workstreams
•Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
•Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
•Ability to meet deadlines
•Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others
 
The team
Our Industry Solutions offering provides verticalized solutions that transform how clients sell products, deliver services, generate growth, and execute mission-critical operations. We bring together business insight and scalable technology solutions designed for sector-specific needs.
Deloitte’s Healthcare Consulting practice serves many of the largest national and regional health plans and healthcare systems in the United States. The practice helps organizations transform care delivery, modernize operations, and strengthen business and operating models.
 
Qualifications
Required:
•Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience in health care, health plan operations, or consulting.
•5+ years of experience in health plan operations, core administration, pharmacy operations, or pharmacy benefit manager operations; experience leading process redesign, operating model transformation, or large-scale business transformation initiatives.
•Experience managing project delivery, workstreams, or cross-functional teams and developing client deliverables using Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint.
•You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
•Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
Preferred:
•Master’s degree in Business Administration, Master of Health Administration, or similar field
•Experience supporting health plan clients in areas such as claims, enrollment, billing, service operations, care management, or utilization management
•Experience with transformation programs involving business process modernization, technology enablement, or service delivery redesign
•Experience contributing to business development, proposals, or internal thought leadership
•Experience leading teams in a consulting environment
•Experience working with senior client stakeholders

Job.JobTitle: Experienced Engineer, Identity and Access Management
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

 

We are seeking a motivated Junior Microsoft Entra ID Administrator to join our Identity and Access Management team. This entry-level position supports the secure operation of Microsoft Entra ID services, including identity administration, authentication, application access, Conditional Access, external identities, governance, monitoring, and operational support.

The successful candidate will work with experienced administrators and security engineers while developing hands-on expertise in cloud identity and identity security.  Key responsibilities include:

 

  • Administer Microsoft Entra users, groups, roles, enterprise applications, and related directory objects through approved processes.
  • Support MFA, passkeys/FIDO2, Temporary Access Pass, and other approved authentication methods.
  • Assist with Conditional Access analysis, testing, documentation, deployment, and troubleshooting.
  • Support SSO integrations using SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect.
  • Troubleshoot authentication and application-access issues using Entra sign-in and audit logs.
  • Support app registrations, service principals, certificates, secrets, application assignments, and Microsoft Graph permissions.
  • Assist with B2B collaboration, guest access, cross-tenant access, access reviews, and privileged-access processes.
  • Support tenant governance activities, configuration baselines, monitoring, and drift reviews.


    • Qualifications

    Do you possess the following?:

    • Foundational understanding of identity, authentication, authorization, MFA, SSO, and least privilege.
    • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, or a comparable identity platform.
    • Basic PowerShell experience or demonstrated ability to learn scripting.
    • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
    • Ability to follow controlled procedures and recognize when an issue requires approval or escalation.
    • Interest in developing a career in identity security and cloud administration.
    • Experience gained through internships, service-desk work, technical coursework, certifications, or personal lab environments will be considered.



    Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Job.JobTitle: Salesforce Agentforce Life Sciences Managed Services Consultant_Products and Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

THE TEAM

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.

This role is aligned to the Converge for Life Sciences portfolio, Deloitte's AI-enabled platform portfolio for the modern life sciences enterprise. Converge by Deloitte combines proprietary data assets, advanced analytics, and AI-driven decision intelligence to help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical product organizations accelerate the pace of discovery, development, and commercialization, while improving compliance and operational visibility across the enterprise.

This role is 100% dedicated to FastForward offering which is built on Salesforce Agentforce for Life Sciences and accelerates the enablement of commercial field operations for life science organizations.

WORK YOU'LL DO

We're seeking a Managed Services Consultant to own each FastForward account from go-live through the life of the client relationship. They run two streams of work: client success, including monthly cadences, QBRs, and adoption guidance. The second is application managed services: planning and coordinating the ongoing release cycle for configuration changes and new feature enablement. This is an experienced individual-contributor role for someone equally comfortable running a client success relationship and managing a technical delivery cycle with a development team. Day to day, the Managed Services Consultant will have the following key responsibilities:

CUSTOMER SUCCESS & ADOPTION 

  • Own the post-implementation handoff from the delivering Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE) and establish the managed services relationship with client stakeholders at go-live.
  • Lead a monthly cadence with each client to assess where adoption stands, surface blockers, and set priorities for the period ahead.
  • Conduct quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to review progress against stated goals and advise on which upcoming AFLS and Agentforce capabilities are worth adopting and when.

APPLICATION MANAGED SERVICES

  • Work with each client to plan and prioritize change requests and new feature enablement against their available monthly capacity.
  • Translate agreed priorities into clear development briefs for the development team.
  • Manage delivery by tracking release timelines, communicating status to client stakeholders, surfacing risks, and signing off on completed work before it goes live.

PRODUCT FEEDBACK & TEAM CONTRIBUTION

  • Build reusable managed services assets: onboarding guides, adoption playbooks, and configuration templates that accelerate future client handoffs.
  • Contribute to the product group's shared knowledge base by documenting managed services patterns, client learnings, and approaches that scale across accounts.
  • Bridge client field experience and the product organization, translating adoption patterns and client needs into structured insights for the product roadmap.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 4+ years of professional experience in customer success, managed services, or technical account management in life sciences applications or enterprise SaaS, with demonstrated client-facing ownership.
  • Experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, Veeva CRM, or IQVIA OCE in a pharma commercial context.
  • Hands-on technical experience configuring or building on Salesforce (administrator-level configuration, flows, validation rules, and other declarative/point-and-click tools), sufficient to review, validate, and guide configuration work independently.
  • Experience presenting to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Must be based in the Eastern Time zone.

Preferred

  • Experience in life sciences or healthcare commercial technology environments (e.g., CRM, field engagement, patient services, or market access).
  • Experience with Salesforce Agentforce or comparable AI-agent / GenAI capabilities embedded in enterprise applications.
  • Experience in post-go-live client success or managed services, including account cadences, adoption management, and feature backlog prioritization.
  • Familiarity with data loading, integration patterns, and CRM data models common to life sciences commercial operations, as well as CLI-based deployment or configuration-as-code approaches.
  • Project management experience, including planning, tracking timelines, and managing risk across a delivery or release cycle.

COMPENSATION

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. Job.JobTitle: Associate Director Cybersecurity Architecture - Quantum Security
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $137,400 to $282,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 10+ years

About this job

Leadership role defining and executing Deloitte's enterprise quantum-security strategy and post-quantum cryptography migration. Requires 10+ years cybersecurity experience with 4+ years in highly regulated environments, and a bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or Engineering.

Good fit if you have deep cryptography and enterprise security strategy experience in regulated industries

Full job description

Position Summary

Are you passionate about technology and interested in joining a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo? If so, read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity with Deloitte Technology-US (DT-US). We are curious and life-long learners focused on technology and innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/7/2026.

Work you’ll do

The Associate Director, Quantum Security is a leadership role within DT-US Cyber Risk and Compliance Function with a matrixed relationship to Cyber Operations, Security Architecture, Cyber Design, and Technology and Business leaders across the US Member Firm. The role is accountable for defining and executing the enterprise quantum-security strategy and leading the multi-year migration to quantum-resistant cryptography across Deloitte's technology environment.

As a key member of the DT-US Cyber Security leadership team, the Associate Director serves as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, ensuring Deloitte protects long-lived sensitive data against "harvest now, decrypt later" threats, aligns to NIST and NSA guidance, and builds the cryptographic agility needed to adapt as standards evolve. The role also serves as Deloitte's senior technical voice with major industry partners and standards communities.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the enterprise quantum-security strategy and multi-year PQC migration roadmap aligned to business objectives, regulatory requirements, and enterprise risk appetite.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on quantum risk, regulatory drivers, investment needs, and progress, including briefings to senior leaders and governance forums.
  • Lead enterprise cryptographic discovery and inventory across applications, infrastructure, networks, PKI, IoT/OT, cloud, and vendor-managed systems, and establish crypto-bill-of-materials (CBOM) practices.
  • Prioritize systems by data sensitivity, data shelf life, and exposure to harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks and oversee remediation planning and execution.
  • Direct design and implementation of NIST-standardized algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) and hybrid approaches across TLS, VPN, code signing, PKI and certificate management, HSMs, key management, and firmware signing.
  • Co-Sponsor proof-of-concept testing, performance benchmarking, and interoperability validation, and drive cryptographic agility so algorithms can be replaced without major re-engineering.
  • Ensure alignment with NIST guidance (FIPS 203/204/205, FN-DSA, NIST IR 8547, SP 800-208, NCCoE publications) and NSA CNSA 2.0 requirements and timelines, along with applicable federal directives and FIPS 140-3 validated module requirements.
  • Establish and lead cryptographic governance, including policies, standards, and risk-based decision frameworks, and embed quantum-risk considerations into enterprise risk, third-party risk, procurement, and architecture review processes.
  • Serve as a liaison to major technology vendors, cloud providers, HSM and PKI vendors, and consortia, evaluating vendor roadmaps and holding suppliers accountable for PQC readiness in contracts.
  • Represent Deloitte in industry working groups, standards forums, and information-sharing communities (e.g., NIST NCCoE, PQC Alliance, sector ISACs) and engage clients and regulators as a thought leader.
  • Manage the program budget, resourcing, and delivery milestones, ensuring alignment to risk reduction, regulatory compliance, and business priorities.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of cryptography, PKI, and security architecture professionals while building quantum-security competency across the organization through training, reference architecture, and playbooks.

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Technology-US helps power Deloitte’s success. Deloitte Technology-US drives Deloitte, which serves many of the world’s largest, most respected organizations. DT-US develops and deploys cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The ~3,000 professionals in DT-US deliver services including:

  • Cyber Security
  • Technology Support
  • Technology & Infrastructure
  • Applications
  • Relationship Management
  • Strategy & Communications
  • Project Management
  • Strategic Financial Management

DT-US Cyber Security

DT-US Cyber Security vigilantly protects Deloitte and client data. The team leads a strategic cyber risk program that adapts to a rapidly changing threat landscape, changes in business strategies, risks, and vulnerabilities. Using situational awareness, threat intelligence, and building a security culture across the organization, with integration into the global cyber security capabilities that to protect the Deloitte brand.

Areas of focus include:

  • Risk & Compliance
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Data Protection
  • Cyber Design
  • Incident Response
  • Security Architecture
  • Business Partnership

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Engineering.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in cybersecurity, including experience defining and executing enterprise security or cryptographic strategies aligned to business objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.
  • Minimum 4 years supporting highly regulated environments (e.g., federal, defense, audit and financial services, or critical infrastructure).
  • Minimum 2 years of people and/or process management experience
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree (master’s or higher) in Information Security, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of post-quantum cryptography and migration challenges such as key and signature sizes, performance, and hybrid modes.
  • Deep knowledge of standards and guidance, including:
    • NIST FIPS 203/204/205, FN-DSA, NIST IR 8547, SP 800-208, and NCCoE migration publications
    • NSA CNSA 2.0, NSM-10, and OMB M-23-02
    • FIPS 140-3 / CMVP, Zero Trust architecture, and federal mandates
  • Deep understanding of PKI, TLS, key management, HSMs, and secure software and firmware signing.
  • Experience leading an enterprise cryptographic inventory or large-scale crypto-migration program preferred.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, drive enterprise-wide change in matrixed environments, and translate complex technical risk into business terms.
  • Experience engaging vendors, industry consortia, and standards bodies; record of speaking, publishing, or standards participation preferred.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CISA, GIAC, or equivalent experience strongly preferred.

The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $137,400 to $282,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Accounting / Finance / Banking, Marketing / Communications / PR
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

If you’re a marketer, creative, communicator, storyteller, or strategist, our unique blend of talented pros needs one more ingredient: you. Deloitte’s full-service Marketing, Brand & Communications organization is seeking collaborative creatives, skillful strategists, and marketing masterminds to lead our businesses in exciting new directions. At Deloitte, we combine world-class creativity and business knowledge, insightful strategic thinking, and Deloitte’s powerful brand equity to create undeniable impact. If you find opportunity where others don’t, thrive in a supportive and diverse team environment, keep your finger on the pulse of cultural trends and the latest technology, and apply new ideas to challenge the status quo, then we want your talents in our mix. Together we’ll discover new ways to transform out-of-the-box concepts into work that feels like marketing magic.

In this role, , you’ll play a central role in Tax’s events strategy, from conferences to client experiences, creating moments that deepen client relationships and position our leaders as trusted voices in the market. Every day you’ll have the opportunity to use your skills to bring big ideas to life. We celebrate inquisitive team players who can regularly anticipate, adjust, and act in a rapidly changing market and marketing landscape—and find new opportunities within it.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 10, 2027

Responsibilities

Event Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

  • Develop the marketing strategy for Tax’s client event portfolio, including proprietary events, hosted experiences, thought leadership forums, and third-party conferences and sponsorships, and drive prioritization against business goals
  • Own the overarching messaging framework for Tax events, developing positioning, audience strategy, and ROI approach that tie each event to key business issues and client needs
  • Lead market analysis (competitive, trends, and white space) across the event landscape and make recommendations to business stakeholders on where Tax should show up and how
  • Own the integrated channel strategy that surrounds events (pre-event, onsite, and post-event) to drive pipeline and growth for the business

Client Experience & Activation

  • Oversee the development and execution of event, hospitality, and client experience plans, ensuring exceptional standards and alignment with Tax’s business and client relationship goals
  • Review and approve activation plans, including creative, copy, and onsite assets, ensuring consistent messaging across all channels
  • Partner with Tax leadership as a strategic advisor, driving an agenda that aligns our offerings to key business issues and client needs by shaping client engagement, market opportunities, audience strategy, and event content and speakers.
  • Collaborate with Public Relations to build a media strategy for events that amplifies Tax leadership with trade and tier one outlets, using conferences as a key opportunity to develop content for future use.

Operations, Measurement & Reporting

  • Manage overall operations of the event portfolio, including planning, activity prioritization, vendor and agency management, and budgeting
  • Partner with Risk, Legal, and Independence teams to ensure events and activations meet firm and regulatory requirements
  • Implement and optimize workflows and tracking systems that support team collaboration, creative approvals, and asset management, with clear status on priorities, deadlines, and deliverables
  • Oversee work with internal and external agency partners and media teams to develop and measure integrated paid, owned, earned, and property marketing plans
  • Develop and deliver regular reporting on attendance, engagement, pipeline impact, success stories, and ROI to Tax leadership, business leadership, and marketing excellence leadership
  • Drive adoption of AI, automation, data, and emerging marketing technologies to improve audience targeting, personalization, content development, event operations, measurement, and team productivity.

Collaboration & Team Leadership

  • Collaborate with marketers aligned to offerings, sectors, and geographies to integrate content and event strategies, delivering One Deloitte to our clients
  • Align with campaign marketers on the on-time, on-budget delivery of events and event-driven campaigns
  • Lead and mentor team members, providing guidance and feedback to support their growth, and coach others on their career development aspirations
  • Represent the team at key firmwide meetings, planning sessions, and external partner meetings

Successful Candidate Will Possess

  • A demonstrated leader who can generate their own ideas and experiences and inspire their teams to do the same
  • Executive presence, a professional client service manner, and a demonstrated ability to take initiative and interact with all levels of management, including senior partners and C-suite clients
  • Strategic and creative thinking, with meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to plan and manage budgets to ensure proper prioritization and utilization of resources
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple complex workstreams and fixed deadlines in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
  • Strong relationship-building skills with internal stakeholders, agencies, and external partners
  • Ability to lead junior team members, provide guidance and feedback, coach others on their career development aspirations, and help coachees expand their networks and broaden their understanding of the firm

The Team

Deloitte’s Marketing, Brand & Communications team combines the power of Deloitte’s brand with inspired marketing minds to produce envy-inducing business results. From events to social media to digital assets and execution, our blend of insights from our expert marketers and world-class creative talent produces attention-grabbing campaigns anchored in data-infused strategies. When stakeholders need next-level solutions that support their business priorities, Marketing, Brand & Communications is the partner that can transform big ideas into big impact.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in marketing, with a focus on business-to-business strategic marketing and event or sponsorship marketing
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing or related discipline
  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale client events, hospitality, or experiential programs, from strategy through execution and measurement
  • Experience with event property reviews and approvals, and with negotiating and managing sponsorship or event partner agreements
  • Experience managing event budgets, agencies, and vendors
  • Prior experience working on a virtual team within a highly matrixed organization, preferably for a global corporation or professional services firm
  • Strong digital and marketing technology fluency, including Microsoft Office, generative AI and automation tools, CRM and marketing automation platforms, event technologies, and data and analytics solutions, with demonstrated ability to apply technology to improve marketing effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing tax, legal, financial, or other professional services to senior-level B2B audiences
  • Sponsorship experience within B2B sponsorships
  • Understanding of Agile methodology and experience in Workfront
  • Experience with event technology and measurement tools (registration, CRM integration, attendee analytics)

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $118,700 to $218,600.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

The Clients and Markets Acceleration Team's (CMAT) Growth Platforms Team is comprised of professional relationship managers, marketers, and architects dedicated to driving successful technology relationships. Within the Specialized cohort, this team activates GTM strategies, runs cadence and governance, and manages Pod health, performance, and capacity across a cluster of Prioritized Specialized alliances.

Position Summary

Do you excel at supporting alliance-driven pipeline development, seller enablement, and go-to-market execution? If so, you may be a great fit for our Channel Sales Lead role supporting the Cloud & Application Security cluster. You will help strengthen co-sell activity, improve pipeline visibility, and support partner-enabled sales execution across alliance teams, sales, marketing, and subject matter specialists.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/4/2026.

Work you'll do

As the Channel Sales Lead, you will:

  • Alliance Positioning: Help position Deloitte through alliance and technology relationships by tailoring messaging, materials, and differentiators to the opportunity.
  • Pipeline Support: Build and maintain a partner-enabled pipeline through lead identification, qualification, and active partner contact management.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Orchestrate communications, follow-ups, and next steps across Deloitte and alliance stakeholders to support decision-making and momentum.
  • Seller Enablement: Develop and support enablement sessions, playcards, guides, and quick-reference materials that improve co-sell execution.
  • CRM & Forecast Discipline: Maintain accurate, current pipeline and CRM data to improve reporting, forecasting, and governance visibility.
  • Planning & Governance: Support planning sessions, agendas, materials, logistics, action tracking, and risk management for alliance activities.
  • Events & Executive Meetings: Support conferences, webinars, executive meetings, and related follow-up actions.
  • Insight Sharing: Customize and distribute relevant thought leadership and market content to strengthen positioning, offers, and pursuit messaging.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Strong stakeholder coordination and follow-through across alliance, sales, marketing, and specialist teams.
  • Sound judgment in tailoring messaging and curating insights that strengthen market positioning and pursuit outcomes.
  • Ability to manage multiple planning, governance, and event workstreams with attention to detail and consistency.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Required education or equivalent experience
  • 4+ years of experience in alliance sales, channel sales, business development, sales support, go-to-market execution, or account coordination.
  • 4+ years of experience supporting partner-enabled pipeline development, lead qualification, co-sell coordination, and CRM/pipeline reporting hygiene.
  • 2+ years of experience developing or tailoring client-facing messaging, sales collateral, or partner enablement materials such as playcards, guides, or session materials.
  • 2+ years of experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, planning sessions, governance activities, or executive/partner events.
  • Bachelor's degree required, or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • 1+ years of experience with co-sell tools, deal registration platforms, partner portals, or CRM/reporting systems such as Salesforce dashboards and pipeline hygiene checks.
  • 1+ years of experience supporting account-based marketing, campaign follow-up, or content localization for alliance or partner audiences.
  • 1+ years of experience coordinating event logistics, executive briefing centers, or proposal and oral-presentation support.
  • 1+ years of experience using Excel or business intelligence/reporting tools for pipeline analysis.
  • Experience working across two or more alliance, partner, or technology ecosystems in a co-sell or channel-influenced sales context.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $100,400-$197,900.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Deloitte is seeking a Data and Technology Specialist, Project to support a client project with data and information technology services. In this role, you will analyze financial services data, support data integration and reporting solutions, and help deliver timely insights for critical client operations. This Project Delivery role is designed for a professional with specialized data analytics skills aligned to a current client need.

Work you'll do

As a Data and Technology Specialist, Project on the Government & Public Services team, you will be responsible for delivering data analytics and technology support.

  • Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, validate data quality, and support decision-making.
  • Build and maintain extract, transform, and load (ETL) workflows that integrate source-system data into analytics-ready datasets.
  • Develop data visualizations and reporting products that communicate insights to client stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with business and technology teams to document requirements, test solutions, and resolve data issues.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Business Finance offering enables finance to drive strategic value through transformation and synchronization of planning, costing, budgeting and forecasting across finance and other functions. Using advanced, scalable data and tech platforms, we also generate actionable insights and analytics, streamline decision making and enable data driven profitable growth. Manages risk and opportunities associated with diverse and complex grant programs through end-to-end grants management solutions.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • 4+ years of work experience
  • 1+ years of experience in financial services
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred: 

  • Experience using Databricks
  • Experience using IBM InfoSphere DataStage or IBM InfoSphere QualityStage
  • Experience using Microsoft Power BI
  • Experience using Microsoft Azure SQL Server
  • Experience applying accounting concepts in data analysis
  • Experience performing data analysis, developing data visualizations, and building extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes
