Job ID 374908

Position Summary

As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be the connective tissue across our clients’ marketing and advertising technology ecosystems, spanning customer data platforms, journey orchestration and decisioning, campaign and content platforms, and adjacent AdTech capabilities, all increasingly powered by AI and agentic technologies. You will move fluidly across platforms and vendors rather than anchoring to a single stack, advising clients on the art of the possible, designing composable, future-ready architectures, and leading implementation across MarTech, AdTech, and AI-enabled solutions.

This role suits a technologist who treats the pace of change in this space as the appealing part of the job: someone who stays current on emerging platforms and AI capabilities, pilots new tools ahead of the market, and brings that point of view to clients and internal teams alike.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 13, 2027

Work you'll do

As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:

Architecting end-to-end solutions across the marketing technology landscape (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform/AEP, Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, Target; Salesforce Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce; and comparable platforms) to enable unified customer profiles, journey orchestration, and omnichannel personalization

Bridging MarTech and AdTech ecosystems by integrating CDPs with ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, identity resolution, and measurement/attribution platforms to enable addressable, privacy-safe advertising and cross-channel activation

Architecting and maintaining identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph solutions, including identity matching logic, resolution accuracy, and data collection strategies that feed a unified, enterprise-wide view of the customer

Embedding AI and agentic capabilities into client marketing and advertising ecosystems, including generative content and personalization, AI assistants/copilots, and next-best-action or agent orchestration, and continuously evaluating emerging tools as the landscape evolves

Advising clients on future-state architecture design, feasibility, level of effort, cost, and the art of the possible, across composable, API-first MarTech and AdTech stacks

Leading technical pre-sales and solutioning (hunter/farmer cycles), translating business and marketing goals into technical designs, estimates, and phased implementation roadmaps

Leading integration and solution delivery across multiple platforms, third-party systems, and client stakeholder groups during technical design and implementation

Building and leading high-performing, cross-functional, geographically distributed teams of architects, engineers, and analysts, and establishing reusable frameworks, accelerators, and playbooks

Evaluating and recommending composable architecture approaches that enable clients to assemble modular, best-of-breed MarTech/AdTech capabilities rather than defaulting to a single monolithic platform

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Genuine curiosity and a pioneer's mindset: energized, not unsettled, by a marketing and advertising technology landscape that is constantly introducing new platforms, tools, and AI capabilities

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience across marketing technology and/or advertising technology platforms, including implementation experience with at least two major MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud/Data Cloud, mParticle, Segment, Tealium, or comparable)
  • 7+ years of experience architecting Customer Data Platform (CDP) solutions, including data modeling, identity resolution, audience segmentation, and activation
  • 7+ years of experience with identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph technologies or platforms (e.g., Acxiom, LiveRamp, or similar), including identity matching logic and resolution accuracy
  • 5+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales or solution architecture engagements, including level-of-effort, cost estimation, and roadmap development
  • 5+ years of experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting MarTech/AdTech workloads
  • 2+ years of experience with AI/agentic capabilities embedded in MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., AI assistants/copilots, generative personalization, agent orchestration)
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience with composable architecture / MACH (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless) principles
  • Working knowledge of the AdTech ecosystem, including ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, programmatic buying, identity/addressability solutions, and measurement and attribution
  • Adobe Certified Expert/Professional and/or Salesforce certifications spanning CDP, Marketing Cloud, or Agentforce
  • Experience integrating MarTech platforms with AdTech data, identity, or clean-room solutions (e.g., LiveRamp, The Trade Desk, Google Marketing Platform)
  • Experience collaborating with identity partners to evolve identity graph coverage and improve enterprise-wide customer data mapping and digital tracking accuracy
  • A demonstrated track record as an early adopter, piloting new platforms, tools, or AI capabilities ahead of broad market adoption and driving their adoption within teams or client organizations
  • Experience training or leading offshore or nearshore delivery teams in a Global Delivery model
  • Programming or scripting experience in Python, SQL, or Java
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related technical field

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $163,400 - $322,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Our Enterprise Operations as a Service offering provides services to meet our clients’ needs for on-going operations of their technology and business process investments through multi-year contracts.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required clearance for this role
  • 7+ years of experience designing, developing, and customizing Oracle EBS Finance modules
  • Experience with 2+ Oracle EBS Finance implementations
  • Leading Hands-on development experience across the EBS technology stack: PL/SQL, Oracle Forms and Reports, Oracle Application Framework (OAF), Oracle Workflow, BI Publisher (including e-text templates), XML Publisher, Concurrent Programs, and Open Interfaces/APIs.
  • Experience building integrations with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including REST/SOAP services, file-based integrations, and EBS-to-Cloud connectivity.
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance

Preferred: 

  • Prior federal agency experience and working knowledge of Federal Financials, Accounting Treatment Manual (ATM) Update, G-Invoicing Process, Federal reporting and disbursement processes such as Treasury disbursement, GTAS, CARS, and DATA Act.

Microsoft Dynamics Manager, Functional Transformation

  • Direct multidisciplinary onshore and offshore teams, coaching team members and ensuring delivery accountability.

Required

  • Demonstrated 4+ years designing conceptual architectures for enterprise solutions, including Dataverse security model implementation
  • Completed multiple data migrations and integrations using tools such as Power Automate, Dataflows, Data Gateways, Custom Connectors, and Azure integration services across at least 3 projects
  • Practical 3+ years of experience with modern DevOps practices, including management of content repositories, version control (such as Git), and implementation of CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) pipelines
  • Demonstrated administration of Dynamics CRM and Power Platform, including successful deployment and maintenance of Center of Excellence (CoE) toolkit in production environments
  • Advanced technical proficiency with C#, Dataverse Web API, Plugin development, JavaScript, Power FX, and PowerShell across client-facing projects

  • Proven track record of developing and extending Dataverse solutions through custom Plugin development, JavaScript, Azure Functions, and PowerApps Component Framework (PCF) for at least 3 engagements

Quick facts

  • Pay: $116,200 to $229,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time

  • Experience: 4+ years

About this job

Senior Consultant role with Deloitte's Forensic, Discovery, & Financial Crime team in Jacksonville. Executes eDiscovery, contract analytics, and unstructured data projects while supervising consultants and managing client relationships using AI, Relativity, and related technologies.

Good fit if you have 4+ years of consulting in forensics or eDiscovery, experience with Relativity and data analytics tools, programming skills in Java/SQL/Python/C#/VBA, and can commute daily to Jacksonville.

Full job description

Position Summary

Senior Consultant Risk and Forensics - Data Management

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organizations. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 03/05/2027.

Work you will do

As a Senior Consultant Risk and Forensics on the Forensic, Discovery, & Financial Crime team, you will be responsible for:

  • Execute day-to-day activities on client engagements involving eDiscovery, contract analytics, and unstructured data projects.
  • Prepare and present oral and written reports and presentations that communicate engagement findings and project progress.
  • Use generative artificial intelligence, Relativity, and other discovery and unstructured data technologies to improve project outcomes and delivery efficiency.
  • Define resource requirements; supervise and train consultants to support timely engagement delivery.
  • Build and maintain client relationships, support client satisfaction, and participate in initiatives that strengthen practice capabilities.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team
Our Forensic, Discovery, & Financial Crime offering provides services to support anti-money laundering, discovery, business disputes, and investigations. We help protect brands from financial crime and other corporate misconduct, and empower government organizations with advanced tradecraft and technology to combat emerging and evolving threats.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics disciplines, Economics, or Finance.
  • 4+ years of consulting experience in Forensics, e-Discovery, Information Governance, or Content Archiving.
  • Experience working with eDiscovery platforms, including Relativity, Nuix, or Brainspace.
  • Experience with contract and/or unstructured data analytics and generative artificial intelligence platforms, including Pramata, Harvey, or Legora.
  • Experience working with databases and file systems.
  • Experience with data visualization programs, including Tableau or Microsoft Power BI.
  • Experience programming in at least one of the following: Java, Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, C#, or Visual Basic for Applications (VBA).
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1-2 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree
  • Experience with natural language processing, machine learning, and generative artificial intelligence.
  • Experience with information governance, document retention, regulatory archiving, write once, read many (WORM) storage, and Securities and Exchange Commission Rules 17a-3 and 17a-4.
  • Experience using Elasticsearch.

Job.JobDescription:

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Tampa, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Develop and deploy data science and AI/ML solutions for government clients using Python and data engineering methods. Role requires active TS/SCI clearance and on-site work in Tampa, Florida.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in data science with AI/ML and Python experience, hold an active TS/SCI clearance, and can work on-site in Tampa.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join Deloitte’s AI & Engineering team as a Project Data Management Engineer III and help public-sector clients use data, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) to address mission needs. You will apply Python, data engineering, and data science methods to develop and operationalize data-driven solutions for a client-site engagement in Tampa, Florida. Working alongside multidisciplinary professionals, you will help modernize technology platforms, improve operations, and deliver measurable outcomes.

Work you'll do

As an AI & Data Science Engineer III on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for:

  • Develop, test, and deploy data science and artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) solutions that support government mission objectives.
  • Build Python-based data processing pipelines and workflows for raw and structured datasets.
  • Analyze data quality, model performance, and solution results to inform implementation decisions.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, technical teams, and client stakeholders to translate analytical needs into technical requirements.
  • Document methods, models, data sources, and results to support solution delivery and operational use.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of experience in data science, including artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), Python, raw data processing, and data engineering
  • Active TS/SCI security clearance required
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 5 times a week in Tampa, Florida
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Rust

Job.JobTitle: Lead Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer II
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

As a Lead Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer II, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte’s engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering—together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio—consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a role-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross-functional teams to set production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence.

Work You'll Do:

  • Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability—ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient.
  • Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Set production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production—gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow.
  • Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability—codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks—operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation; and review the work of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
  • Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery.
  • Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements—progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement—rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Set production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production—holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
  • Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering—cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering—together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
  • Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate—and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
  • Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
  • Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The successful candidate will possess:

  • Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
  • 6+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large-scale, distributed, cloud-native systems in production, with experience in most of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C#/.NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks.
  • 3+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large-scale systems—defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging—e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre-production and production; and segregation-of-duties controls (least-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk.
  • 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering and cloud platform ownership on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—plus container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), infrastructure-as-code, networking, and multi-environment management.
  • 1+ years of experience establishing reliability and operational standards—SLO discipline, runbooks, and performance and resilience budgets—including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards.
  • Prior experience operating AI/ML and agentic workloads in production—their reliability failure modes (drift, train/serve skew, output variance), MLOps/LLMOps, and the AI control plane (model/LLM gateway, guardrails) from the operability and performance side.
  • Prior experience with load and performance testing under simulated production traffic (e.g., LoadRunner, k6, or JMeter), chaos engineering (e.g., Azure Chaos Studio, AWS Fault Injector), capacity planning, autoscaling, and cloud/AI cost engineering (FinOps tooling/dashboards, including GPU/inference and token cost attribution).
  • Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.
  • Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to operate high-quality, resilient platforms and products at scale.
  • Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to one of the select locations available for this role 
  • Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $105,400 to $207,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Consultant role securing how enterprise data is ingested, transformed, and used by generative AI and agentic systems. Combines client advisory with hands-on engineering to design secure data architectures, lead integrations with security services, and guide junior practitioners.

Good fit if you have 3-5+ years in cybersecurity and AI engineering with production experience securing RAG or agentic workloads and data platforms like Pinecone, Weaviate, or Snowflake.

Full job description

Position Summary

As a Sr Consultant: AI Data Security in Deloitte's Cyber for AI team, you will own technical workstreams that secure how enterprise data is ingested, transformed, retrieved, and used by GenAI, RAG, and other agentic systems. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering to translate requirements into architecture, integration, and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations, and help estimate delivery work.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work You'll do

As a Sr Consultant: AI Data Security on the Data team, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead discovery and data-flow analysis for RAG applications, agents, vector stores, enterprise sources, and downstream outputs.
  • Design secure data architectures for ingestion, transformation, embeddings, indexes, retrieval, context assembly, caching, and memory.
  • Lead integrations with classification, catalog, lineage, data loss prevention (DLP), encryption, secrets management, and fine-grained authorization services; engineer entitlement-aware retrieval and metadata-filtering patterns across structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Plan and execute control testing for tenant isolation, access filtering, data leakage, and pipeline reliability; own a data security workstream; manage dependencies and milestones; and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
  • Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort, and estimation inputs to pursuits.

The Team

Deloitte's Cyber for AI team helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security, and operations. We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data, or infrastructure risk.

Within the team, the Data capability focuses on how enterprise data is discovered, classified, retrieved, transformed, and protected across RAG pipelines, vector stores, model context, and agent memory.

Qualifications

3-5+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains and experience designing, integrating, and securing production generative AI, RAG, or agentic workloads, including model, tool, and enterprise data connections.

Required Experience:

  • Designing and securing RAG or agentic data paths across ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, retrieval, prompt context, outputs, and memory, and experience with data security patterns in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Implementing vector, search, and/or data platforms including Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Azure AI Search, Vertex AI Vector Search, Databricks, or Snowflake
  • Data security controls for classification, tagging, lineage, fine-grained access, metadata filtering, encryption, key management, tokenization, redaction, and DLP.
  • Designing, building, and reviewing data pipelines using Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, cloud-native data services, Git, and CI/CD practices.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field.
  • Ability to travel 20% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred Experience:

  • Managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
  • AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices, or AI-specific monitoring.
  • Building reusable technical assets, delivery methods, or automation for client engagements.
  • Machine learning tools and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow.
  • AI data services such as Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Microsoft Foundry with Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI RAG Engine, or Databricks AI capabilities.
  • Enterprise data security and governance platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Amazon Macie and Lake Formation, Google Sensitive Data Protection, BigID, Collibra, Immuta, or Privacera.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
  • Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE)
  • AWS / Azure / GCP Cloud certifications
  • Databricks and/or Snowflake certification(s)
  • Data Engineering certifications

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

AI & Data

Job ID 374614

Position Summary

As a Manager: AI Data Security in Deloitte's Cyber for AI team, you will lead client engagements that secure how enterprise data is ingested, transformed, retrieved, and used by RAG and agentic systems. You will translate business and risk objectives into target architecture, remain directly involved in critical design and engineering decisions, and guide teams from assessment through implementation. You will also shape solutions during pursuits and help build repeatable delivery assets.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Manager: AI Data Security, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading AI data security assessments, architecture workshops, and implementation programs for RAG and agentic systems.
  • Translating data use cases and risk requirements into target architectures spanning sources, pipelines, vector stores, retrieval, context, outputs, and memory.
  • Remaining directly involved in design reviews, entitlement and metadata decisions, critical pipeline and policy reviews, and resolution of high-risk technical issues.
  • Managing engagement scope, teams, milestones, quality, and client expectations while maintaining a clear path from design to production adoption.
  • Coordinating data security dependencies across identity, cloud, network, AI engineering, application security, privacy, and operations teams.
  • Shaping solutions during pursuits through workshops, demonstrations, proofs of concept, estimates, and delivery plans.
  • Developing reusable secure RAG patterns, validation tooling, and delivery methods.
  • Coaching practitioners on engineering quality.

The Team

Deloitte's Cyber for AI team helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security, and operations. We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data, or infrastructure risk.

Within the team, our Data capability focuses on how enterprise data is discovered, classified, retrieved, transformed, and protected across RAG pipelines, vector stores, model context, and agent memory.

Qualifications

6+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI architecture & engineering experience, including leading production generative AI or agentic implementations across models, orchestration, identity, data, and infrastructure.

Required Experience:

  • Designing and implementing data security controls in either AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud with experience with data security patterns in the other two platforms.
  • Architecting and implementing secure RAG and agentic data platforms across structured and unstructured enterprise sources.
  • Vector, search, and data platforms including tenant isolation, document- or row-level entitlements, metadata filtering, and identity-aware retrieval.
  • Integrating classification, catalog, lineage, fine-grained access, encryption, key management, tokenization, redaction, and data loss prevention (DLP) technologies into production data paths.
  • Reviewing or developing Python and SQL pipelines, access-control logic, validation tooling, and CI/CD integrations.
  • Leading client-facing technology or cyber engagements with responsibility for scope, teams, timelines, quality, and executive stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Ability to travel 20–50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred Experience:

  • Managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
  • AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices, or AI-specific monitoring.
  • Building reusable technical assets, delivery methods, or automation for client engagements.
  • Machine learning tools and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow.
  • AI data services such as Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Microsoft Foundry with Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI RAG Engine, or Databricks AI capabilities.
  • Enterprise data security and governance platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Amazon Macie and Lake Formation, Google Sensitive Data Protection, BigID, Collibra, Immuta, or Privacera.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
  • Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE)
  • AWS / Azure / GCP Cloud certifications
  • Databricks and/or Snowflake certification(s)
  • Data Engineering certifications

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Senior Consultant: AI Security, Infrastructure
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

As a AI Infrastructure Senior Consultant in our Cyber for AI team, you will lead technical workstreams that secure how artificial intelligence (AI) agents, workloads, and users authenticate, receive permissions, and access enterprise tools and data.

You will combine client advisory and hands-on engineering to translate requirements into architecture, integration, and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations, and help estimate delivery work.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As an AI Infrastructure Senior Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:

  • Owning an infrastructure workstream, managing dependencies and milestones, providing day-to-day guidance to consultants, and contributing technical demonstrations, prototypes, architecture, effort, and estimation inputs to pursuits.
  • Leading discovery and architecture analysis for managed AI services, self-hosted model stacks, cloud foundations, networks, and operational tooling.
  • Designing and deploying secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Kubernetes-based platforms.
  • Leading implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets management, artifact controls, infrastructure as code (IaC), and policy enforcement.
  • Engineering and reviewing Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience, and controlled enterprise integration.
  • Planning and executing platform security, resilience, and operational testing.
  • Diagnosing complex failures and driving issues through resolution.

The Team

Deloitte's Cyber for AI team helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data, or infrastructure risk. Infrastructure capability in our team focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation, and observability.

Qualifications

3-5+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains and experience designing, integrating, and securing production generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or agentic workloads, including model, tool, and enterprise data connections.

Required:

  • Hands-on experience designing and securing cloud, network, Kubernetes, container, and model-serving platforms in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including secure AI landing zones.
  • Experience implementing network segmentation, private connectivity, egress controls, Domain Name System (DNS), Transport Layer Security (TLS), firewalls, gateways, service meshes, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience implementing or reviewing infrastructure automation, Kubernetes configurations, deployment pipelines, and operational diagnostics using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Azure Bicep.
  • Experience in CI/CD pipelines, policy-as-code, Kubernetes role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, admission controls, and secrets management.
  • Programming capabilities with Python, Go, Bash, PowerShell, HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL) and/or YAML and Git.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field.
  • Ability to travel 20% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience in consulting, client delivery, or customer-facing engineering, including developing reusable technical assets, guiding junior engineers, or contributing to engineering standards.
  • Experience across both managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
  • Experience with AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices, or AI-specific monitoring.
  • Experience using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow for machine learning development, deployment, or monitoring.
  • Experience with AI platforms and model-serving technologies such as Amazon Bedrock/Bedrock AgentCore, SageMaker AI, Microsoft Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, vLLM, KServe, NVIDIA Triton, NVIDIA Inference Microservices (NIM), or Ray Serve.
  • Experience securing GPU infrastructure, model and container registries, software supply chains, signed artifacts, service meshes, or multi-tenant inference environments.

Certifications (preferred)

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) and/or Security Specialist (CKS)
  • AWS / Azure / GCP Cloud certifications
  • Certified Terraform Associate / Infrastructure Engineer Professional

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.

At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

Job ID 374603

Position Summary

Are you passionate about technology and interested in joining a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo? If so, read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity with Deloitte Technology US (DT - US). We are curious and life-long learners focused on technology and innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/7/2026.

Work you’ll do

US Cyber Data Protection team is responsible for securing and protecting confidential data of Deloitte US Member Firm, our Clients and our Employees. Team’s core mission is to implement consistent cyber security controls to protect Firm’s data and data entrusted to us by our Clients, to build their trust and protect our brand. We are seeking an experienced, strategic Cyber Engineering Associate Director to join the US Cyber Data Protection team in the Deloitte Technology US Organization within Deloitte Services LP.

The US Cyber Data Protection - L35 Consultant Cyber Engineering will be responsible for onboarding, adoption and on-going support of Enhanced Cyber Data Protection Controls to Client Service Professionals working on Large Financial Services Industry (FSI) Clients and other large Non-FSI Client Service Professionals. The L35 Consultant Cyber Engineering will work with Client Account Managers (CAM) and PPMDs of large FSI and Non-FSI Client teams in onboarding and adoption of enhanced cyber controls covering Data Loss Prevention, Cloud Access Security Broker, Web URL Filtering, Admin Rights Management, Removable Media Protection and Application Allowlisting/Blocklisting. The Consultant will work with CAMs and provide onboarding assistance, control testing & deployment, hypercare support, and ongoing operational support. The Consultant will work with CAMs through intake process, Cyber Control policy creation, policy testing, Active Directory group creation and maintenance, coordination with Global Cyber Service teams, exception reconciliation, un-authorized software remediation, communications, hypercare support to Client Engagement teams and ongoing maintenance and support to Client Service teams after enhanced controls are adopted. Role will collaborate with Client Account Managers, Lead Client Service Partners, Global Cyber Engineers, FSI/Non-FSI Client Service Professionals and US Technology and C&P Stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Standardize, scale and implement proactive enhanced cyber security controls on Client Service Professionals laptops working across large client service teams in the US Member Firm.
  • Run Enhanced Control onboarding from start to finish, including questionnaire intake, policy creation, policy testing, policy tuning, policy rollout and on-going maintenance and support.
  • Tailor and adjust the control set to each Client’s requirements, including deciding which controls apply and how they are configured.
  • Deploy and maintain controls across Endpoint DLP, SMTP DLP, CASB, Web URL Filtering, Admin Rights Management, and software discovery and removal technologies.
  • Create and maintain Active Directory groups that support control deployment.
  • Build and maintain client-specific keyword lists and detection rules for controls that monitor or block sensitive data transfers.
  • Create and maintain tenant alignment for cross-border Client Service Professional populations
  • Lead software remediation, including removal of risky or unauthorized software from laptops.
  • Monitor block alerts and user impact and perform agile policy tuning to resolve false positives.
  • Work with Global Cyber Service teams to roll out enhanced controls across jurisdictions.
  • Coordinate with Global cyber service partners for policy configuration, testing and tuning.
  • Provide hypercare support using teams channel to engagement teams during and after rollout.
  • Manage and support new business exception requests and reconcile prior pre-approved GenAI access and USB device exceptions.
  • Develop knowledge base articles and align with the CXO Call Center and TSS so frontline support can handle user issues.
  • Turn lessons learned and exception data into reusable templates and SOPs.
  • Report impact metrics i.e. users blocked, block alerts, software removed to leadership.
  • Partner with client account managers, Client PPMDs, client-facing teams, and OGC/C&P stakeholders on escalations, policy exceptions, and decisions.
  • Maintain clear documentation, runbooks, and ServiceNow records.
  • Assist with communications to Client Service Professionals.
  • Take over execution, support, and documentation work from senior staff.

What you’ll bring

  • Working knowledge of DLP, CASB, URL Filtering, and Endpoint Privilege Management tools
  • Strong Excel and data reconciliation skills
  • Familiarity with Active Directory and ServiceNow
  • Excellent documentation, technical support, and stakeholder coordination skills
  • A self-starter mindset and comfort in a fast-moving, high-visibility environment

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Technology US (DT - US) helps power Deloitte’s success, which serves many of the world’s largest, most respected organizations. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The ~3,000 professionals in DT - US deliver services including:

  • Cyber Security
  • Technology Support
  • Technology & Infrastructure
  • Applications
  • Relationship Management
  • Strategy & Communications
  • Project Management
  • Financials

Cyber Security

Cyber Security vigilantly protects Deloitte and client data. The team leads a strategic cyber risk program that adapts to a rapidly changing threat landscape, changes in business strategies, risks, and vulnerabilities. Using situational awareness, threat intelligence, and building a security culture across the organization, the team helps to protect the Deloitte brand.

Areas of focus include:

  • Risk & Compliance
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Data Protection
  • Cyber Design
  • Incident Response
  • Security Architecture
  • Business Partnership

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Engineering.
  • Minimum 5 total years of various technology related experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of combined experience in the IT/Cybersecurity space with knowledge of DLP, CASB, Web Proxy URL Filtering and similar data protection technologies.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Working knowledge of endpoint data protection concepts such as USB and removable media protection, print data exfiltration prevention and unauthorized software blocking.
  • Strong Excel and data reconciliation skills.
  • Familiarity with Active Directory and ServiceNow ticketing processes.
  • Master’s degree in a relevant field
  • Experience supporting regulated clients, especially financial services industry
  • Experience with policy tuning and false-positive reduction, including keyword-based DLP rules.
  • Experience with GenAI governance or AI usage controls.
  • Experience with change management, user communications, or support enablement (KB articles, call center alignment).
  • Experience with multi-jurisdiction or cross-border policy rollouts.
  • Experience in a consulting or professional services environment.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, CISSP associate, vendor-specific certifications).

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $84,300 to $173,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Team’s core mission is to implement consistent security controls to protect Firm’s data and data entrusted to us by our Clients to build their trust and protect our brand. We are seeking an experienced and energetic US Cybersecurity Data Consultant with outstanding communication, analytical and cyber security technical skills to join our Cyber Data Protection team within Deloitte Technology US (DT - US) Organization.

If you’re an experienced, hands-on IT professional with strong systems administration, engineering, IT technical support and/or cyber security technical skills who’s interested in growing in the cybersecurity field, this may be the job for you. As part of our Cyber Data Protection team, you will be assisting in designing, deploying, and managing cyber technology and process solutions to reduce the potential of data compromise. You will be assisting with testing of data protection and data security solutions. You will work to enhance and mature existing cyber security data protection capabilities for Deloitte US Member Firm and provide on-going support for them. You will require an understanding of the ecosystem of data protection including well-rounded understanding of the information security domains and their inter-relations across that ecosystem. You will be responsible for providing technical product and troubleshooting assistance to Deloitte Employees. You will work closely with management, leads, peers, development teams, business analysts, and end users to ensure data protection technologies and data protection controls for systems are operating appropriately without causing business impact.

The successful candidate would possess these skills (choose the applicable skills from the options below based on the role and level).

As part of the US Cyber Data Protection team, you will have the following core responsibilities:

  • Assist with the development, deployment, and support of cyber data protection solutions.
  • Assist with the implementation of data security controls and design principles.
  • Provide Tier 2 technical support to Deloitte end users for several of the cyber data protection services supported by the team that includes but not limited to Data Loss Prevention, Data Minimization, Data Classification and Rights Management, CASB, Web Security, Web Application Firewall, Zero Trust Network Access, Next Generation Anti-virus and Endpoint Detection and Response technology, Endpoint Admin Rights Management/Privilege Management technology, PKI Certificate Lifecycle Management, Encryption Key Management, Digital Code Signing, Removable Media Protection, Data Discovery Roll Off Scans etc.
  • Assist in maturing existing data protection solutions protecting against data exfiltration.
  • Assist in rolling out new data protection services for employees, getting them adopted and providing on-going support for those services.
  • Assist with technology and software reviews based on data protection and endpoint risks.
  • Provide technical engineering and troubleshooting support to employees for data protection services.

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Technology US (DT - US) helps power Deloitte’s success, which serves many of the world’s largest, most respected organizations. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The ~3,000 professionals in DT - US deliver services including:

  • Cyber Security
  • Technology Support
  • Technology & Infrastructure
  • Applications
  • Relationship Management
  • Strategy & Communications
  • Project Management
  • Financials

Cyber Security

Cyber Security vigilantly protects Deloitte and client data. The team leads a strategic cyber risk program that adapts to a rapidly changing threat landscape, changes in business strategies, risks, and vulnerabilities. Using situational awareness, threat intelligence, and building a security culture across the organization, the team helps to protect the Deloitte brand.

Areas of focus include:

  • Risk & Compliance
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Data Protection
  • Cyber Design
  • Incident Response
  • Security Architecture
  • Business Partnership

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Engineering
  • Minimum 5 total years of various technology related experience
  • Minimum 2 years of experience Information Security/Cybersecurity domain
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Knowledge and/or proven record of successfully managing technology implementation projects and providing on-going support for at least two (2) of the following Cyber Security capabilities:
    • Data Loss Prevention (Netskope DLP)
    • Web Application Firewall (Imperva WAF, Radware WAF, Akamai WAF, Cloudware WAF)
    • Zero Trust Network Access (Akamai, Palo Alto)
    • Prisma Access Browser
    • Privileged Access Management (Beyondtrust, Cyberark, Delinea etc.)
    • Cloud Access Security Broker (McAfee Skyhigh, Netskope CASB, Zscaler etc.)
    • Web Security (Netskope SWG, ZScaler, Forcepoint Proxy, Broadcom WSS etc.)
    • Data Retention and Destruction (Symantec Network Discovery, Office365 Security Compliance Center, Avepoint, Varonis etc.)
    • Next Generation Antivirus and Endpoint Detection and Remediation Technology (Crowdstrike Falcon, Cylance ATP, Microsoft Defender etc.)
    • Data Classification and Rights Management (Microsoft AIP, Boldon James, Titus etc.)
    • Key & Certificate Lifecycle Management (Venafi CMS, Vormetric KMS etc.)
  • Public Key Infrastructure (Digicert, GeoTrust, Verisign etc.)
  • Data Encryption and Code Signing
  • Experienced with implementing and managing data protection strategies across data at rest, data in motion, and data in use.
  • Experience with troubleshooting issues and assisting end users to mitigate technical challenges.
  • Familiarity with change management and deployment processes in large IT organizations
  • Working knowledge with common IT technologies such as Windows Server, Linux/Unix, Databases, Active Directory/LDAP, virtualization, end-user devices etc.
  • Working knowledge of IT / security principles such as encryption, identity, cloud, etc.
  • Experience with PowerShell command-line scripting is a plus.
  • Professional security certification is desirable, such as Security+ or CISSP
  • Understanding of industry best practices related to risk assessment, mitigation, and incident response.
  • Knowledge of data protection regulations and standards (e.g., ISO 27001, ISO 27018, NIST 800-171)
  • Understanding of networking and core networking protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, SMTP, HTTP, and distributed networks)
  • Knowledge in different types of VPN, Encryption Standards, Certificates
  • Understanding of security controls in public cloud environments (i.e., Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform) and SaaS services hardening.
  • Ability to write technical reports and communicate technical content to business users.

About this job

Negotiation Manager coordinating US domestic and global contract negotiations for Deloitte's Easier to Do Business program. Role involves triaging requests, aligning stakeholders, monitoring progress, and supporting issue resolution across cross-functional teams.

Good fit if you have 8+ years of client service experience, strong communication skills, and can manage multiple priorities across global stakeholders.

Full job description

Position Summary

Deloitte’s Easier to Do Business (Easier) program helps simplify the contracting process, strengthen client relationships and enhance opportunities and revenues. Contracting and negotiating can often be a complicated and time-consuming process, but it doesn’t have to be.

Easier assists Lead Client Service Partners (LCSPs) and their account leadership teams with an established approach to help facilitate and streamline the contracting process, every step of the way. 

Our team culture is collaborative and encourages team members to take initiative, continuous learning, and creative problem solving. Our team works with a strong sense of camaraderie towards collective success, creative brainstorming to deliver value, and commitment to excellence.

The role

As a Negotiation Manager on the US Easier Team, you will serve as a central coordinator for US domestic and global contract negotiations. You will triage requests, align the appropriate stakeholders, coordinate negotiation plans and actions, monitor progress against key performance indicators, and support timely issue resolution and process improvement.

The role will be highly cross-functional. The Negotiation Manager will work closely with the Easier to Do Business Program Leader and overall Easier Team. The successful candidate will help coordinate and support other groups, including US and Global account leadership: Global and US Lead Client Service Partners (LCSPs), country/regional LCSPs, Client Account Managers and Client Relationship Executives.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 2, 2026

Work you’ll do:

We are seeking to recruit an experienced manager who will take on the role of Negotiation Manager within the US Easier Team. The ideal candidate will be able to:

  • Successfully manage US domestic and global contract negotiations by playing a central coordination role between all Deloitte internal parties involved.
  • Triage contracting requests including assess the need, answer questions immediately if possible or appropriate; assign contracting resources (e.g., Senior Contracting Partner (SCP), Office of General Counsel (OGC), Risk, Specialist(s)) as required, support development of the negotiation plan, manage the completion of individual tasks within the negotiation plan.
  • Work closely with the assigned negotiation teams including the SCP, OGC, Risk, Specialist(s) and client team, as necessary, to move the contract negotiation forward swiftly, including ensuring timely responses are received to issues put to US businesses/risk/member firms for consultation.
  • Support the rapid issue resolution process to effectively resolve disagreements, including utilizing the escalation process as needed.
  • Confirm contracting/negotiation protocols are applied.
  • Collaborate and coordinate contracting efforts with the Global Easier team (Americas, Asia Pacific and EMEA), as needed.
  • Participate in maintaining Easier’s Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) System, including managing the Inbox where contracting requests are received.

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  •   Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team 
  •  Effective written and verbal communication skills
  •  Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  •  Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  •  Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  •  Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  •  Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  •  Ability to meet deadlines
  •  Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others 

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in business or management
  • 8+ years of client service work experience (or current Manager, Level 55 equivalent)
  • 4+ years of experience utilizing Microsoft PowerPoint for the creation of presentations, storyboards, or other content
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred:

  • Master’s Degree
  • Understanding of the overall contracting process (e.g. MSAs, SOWs, amendments)
  • Familiarity with the Deloitte Member Firms and client services offered.
  • Stakeholder Management
    • Ability to work cross-functionally with a wide range of global stakeholders, executives, and Firmwide leadership.
    • Provide mentorship to and training to fellow colleagues and teammates.
  • Process Improvement
    • Support strategic initiatives aimed at fostering innovative thinking and approaches by developing or updating processes, tools, and/or templates.
  • Project Management
    • Manage and lead meetings (i.e., coordinate, draft agendas, capture discussions, and drive momentum around actions).

Job.JobTitle: Accounting & Finance Data, Reporting, and Automation Engineer - State, Local, and Higher Education
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Position summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Work You’ll Do

As a Senior Consultant for General Business Finance Data Analytics & Insights team, you will be responsible for the design, build, and maintain automations that streamline accounting and finance processes for state, local, and higher education clients. You will work closely with client finance teams and our consultants to turn manual, error-prone work into reliable, auditable, and scalable workflows. You will also build the data pipelines, reporting tools, and control checks that help clients close faster, reconcile with confidence, and stay ready for audit.

  • Design and build automations for recurring finance and accounting processes, such as bank reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable matching, journal entry preparation, accrual calculations, and month-end and year-end close checklists.
  • Develop process automation and workflow solutions using tools such as Power Automate, UiPath, or similar platforms, with appropriate exception handling and human review points.
  • Build and maintain data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) pipelines that pull data from ERP and other information systems, including Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft, into reporting environments.
  • Write SQL queries and scripts to validate data, identify anomalies, and support general ledger analysis, reconciliations, and chart of accounts clean-up.
  • Design and maintain dashboards and recurring financial reports for controllers, treasurers, budget offices, and boards, including fund-level, grant-level, and capital asset reporting.
  • Build automated control testing and monitoring routines aligned to the COSO framework, producing evidence that supports internal audit, external financial statement audits, state audits, and Single Audits under Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200).
  • Document automations thoroughly, including process maps, logic, data lineage, access controls, and runbooks, so that clients can maintain and audit them independently.
  • Establish version control, testing, and change management practices for automations, and ensure they comply with client IT security and data governance policies.
  • Train client staff on how to operate, monitor, and modify automations, and transition ownership to permanent teams at the end of an engagement.
  • Evaluate client processes to identify automation opportunities, estimate return on investment, and recommend a prioritized roadmap.
  • Support backfill and interim engagements where automations reduce workload for embedded consultants, and ensure those automations are documented for the returning staff member.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

The General Business Finance Data Analytics & Insights team helps finance organizations turn financial and operational data into reliable reporting and actionable insights.

The team combines data engineering, analytics, visualization, and finance process knowledge to support decisions across planning, performance management, and business operations.

Professionals collaborate with stakeholders to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and access to information.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, information systems, computer science, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
    • Building finance or accounting automations using RPA, AI, or other workflow tools;
    • Developing query-based reporting output, data validation, or ETL processes;
    • Scripting in various languages for financial data analysis; or
    • Implementing ERP, reporting, or data integration solutions for finance teams.
  • Working knowledge of accounting fundamentals, including general ledger structures, reconciliations, journal entries, and the chart of accounts. Familiarity with fund accounting and GASB or FASB standards is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with automation and intelligence platforms or a business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
  • Understanding of internal controls, COSO principles, and audit requirements, with the ability to design automations that produce audit-ready evidence.
  • Familiarity with data governance, information security, and access controls in regulated environments.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain and security clearances needed for the client and/or project.
  • Ability to work independently across multiple client environments, manage competing priorities, and travel as needed.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future 

Preferred:

  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, window functions, and query optimization, with experience working against relational databases.
  • Experience with ERP (such as SAP, Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft) or other systems (for example Workiva, Balckline, One Stream, Anaplan, etc), is preferred.
  • Experience supporting federal, state, local government, or higher education clients
  • Experience with data warehousing or lakehouse architecture
  • Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) orchestration tools
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments
  • Experience using Git-based version control and continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Accounting Information systems, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or Statistics
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to explain technical solutions clearly to non-technical finance stakeholders.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
