Position summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Work you'll do

As part of our Accounting and Finance Technology practice within the Finance Transformation team, you will serve as a finance-process expert who also configures, supports, and analyzes the financial technology platforms state, local, and higher education clients rely on. You will translate accounting and budgeting requirements into system design, lead implementation and optimization workstreams, and help clients get more value from their ERP, financial reporting, budgeting, and related fintech investments. Example responsibilities include:

  • Lead functional workstreams for ERP and financial system implementations, upgrades, and optimizations, including SAP, Workday Financials, Oracle Cloud ERP, PeopleSoft, Banner, Ellucian, and similar platforms used by public and higher education institutions.
  • Gather and document business requirements for general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, procurement, grants and sponsored programs, capital assets, cash and treasury, and budgeting, translating them into system configuration specifications.
  • Configure and test system functionality, including chart of accounts structures (fund, function, object, and program), approval workflows, accounting rules, and security roles that align with segregation-of-duties requirements.
  • Support budget development and monitoring processes using budgeting and planning solutions such as Anaplan, OneStream, Hyperion, or similar tools, including position budgeting and allocation models.
  • Advise on financial reporting solutions, including the design of management, grant, and fund-level reports, and the preparation of Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) and board reporting outputs.
  • Ensure systems support accounting standards and compliance requirements, including GASB and FASB guidance, GASB 87, 96, and 101 considerations, Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200), and state reporting requirements.
  • Analyze financial data from system outputs to validate configurations, identify process gaps, and recommend improvements, using SQL, Excel, or reporting tools as needed.
  • Support system testing, data conversion, cutover planning, and go-live readiness, including user acceptance testing and reconciliation of legacy and new system balances.
  • Design and deliver training and process documentation for client finance and IT staff, and help build internal capability so clients can sustain their systems after go-live.
  • Lead project workstreams and manage deliverables, timelines, and risks, coordinating with client stakeholders, technical teams, and other consultants.
  • Provide clear guidance and direction to junior consultants and analysts on functional design, accounting treatment, and system usage.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Finance Transformation offering focuses on the transformation of corporate functions through the centralization and optimization of how these services are delivered – delivering resilient, agile, and cost-effective outcomes that drive the CFO agenda, including solutions and capabilities to drive ERP enabled transformation through functional design, implementation and governance of process, controls, and policies. Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to support the evolving business objectives of the organization. We work with the CFO, CAO, controller, and treasurer to develop an efficient, high quality, data-driven, tech-enabled controllership and treasury function that empowers our clients to drive more value to their business partners and to their investors.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, information systems, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in governmental, higher education, or similar finance environments, with hands-on accounting or finance responsibilities such as general ledger, reconciliations, budgeting, grants accounting, or financial reporting.
  • Working knowledge of GASB and FASB standards, fund accounting, and the chart of accounts structures used by public and higher education institutions.
  • Experience leading or contributing to system implementations, upgrades, or process redesign projects, including requirements gathering, testing, and go-live support.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain any security clearance needed for the project and/or client.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Demonstrated experience configuring, supporting, or analyzing at least one major ERP, Experience with ERP (such as SAP, Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft) or other systems (for example Workiva, Balckline, One Stream, Anaplan, etc), is preferred.
  • Experience documenting business requirements, process flows, or test scripts
  • Experience in government or public sector environments
  • Experience with finance transformation, shared services, or global business services initiatives
  • Certified Public Accountant or Certified Management Accountant credential
  • Project Management Professional
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams, manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, and meet deadlines.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and accounting concepts clearly to finance leaders, IT teams, and end users.
  • Ability to analyze data using SQL, Excel, or reporting tools to validate system configurations and support decision-making.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, a professional demeanor, and the ability to build and sustain professional relationships with client stakeholders.

Position Summary

Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work You’ll Do

As a US Delivery Center Snowflake Data Engineer on the team, you will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines using Snowflake capabilities.
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes for data ingestion, transformation, and integration.
  • Support migrations from legacy systems to cloud-based platforms.
  • Develop and maintain database solutions using Microsoft SQL Server and SSIS.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to understand requirements and deliver data solutions.
  • Integrate data with business intelligence tools to support reporting and analytics.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD processes for code deployment and release management.
  • Promote data quality, performance, security, and clear documentation.
The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Required:

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps deployment practices.
  • Strong SQL development, troubleshooting, and performance-tuning skills.
  • Analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with strong written and verbal communication skills for engaging technical and business stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg)

About this job

Lead client engagements securing cloud, network, and AI infrastructure at Deloitte's Cyber for AI team. Translate business and risk objectives into target architectures, oversee design and implementation, and build repeatable delivery assets across generative AI and agentic workloads.

Good fit if you have 6+ years in cybersecurity and AI engineering with hands-on production experience architecting secure AI landing zones and leading client engagements.

Full job description

Position Summary

As a Cyber for AI: Manager, Infrastructure in Deloitte's Cyber for AI team, you will lead client engagements that secure the cloud, network, container, and model-serving foundations used for generative artificial intelligence (AI) and agentic workloads. You will translate business and risk objectives into target architectures, remain involved in design and engineering decisions, and guide teams from assessment through implementation. You will also shape solutions during pursuits and help build repeatable delivery assets.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work You'll Do

As a Cyber for AI: Manager, Infrastructure on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading secure AI landing-zone assessments, architecture workshops, and implementation programs across cloud, network, Kubernetes, and model-serving platforms.
  • Translating workload, risk, performance, and operational requirements into target architectures for managed and self-hosted AI environments.
  • Providing hands-on technical oversight through design reviews, infrastructure as code (IaC) and policy decisions, configuration and code reviews, and resolution of technical issues.
  • Managing engagement scope, teams, milestones, quality, and client expectations.
  • Coordinating dependencies across AI engineering, identity, data, application security, DevSecOps, and operations teams.
  • Shaping solutions during pursuits through workshops, demonstrations, proofs of concept, estimates, and delivery plans; develop reusable landing-zone blueprints, automation, and delivery methods
  • Coaching practitioners on engineering quality.

The Team

Deloitte's Cyber for AI team helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation, and observability.

The team combines AI engineering and cyber capabilities across identity, data, infrastructure, application security, and operations. We work with clients to integrate security controls into the platform and delivery lifecycle so teams can move from experiments to production while managing access, data, and infrastructure risks.

Qualifications

6+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains and experience architecting and leading production generative AI or agentic implementations, including technical decisions involving models, orchestration, identity, data, and infrastructure.

Required Experience:

  • Architecting and implementing secure AI landing zones across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud environments including network, Kubernetes, container, and model-serving platforms.
  • Security infrastructure including private connectivity, segmentation, egress control, gateways, service meshes, secrets, encryption, and operational telemetry.
  • Implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD, and policy-as-code using Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, Open Policy Agent, Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or comparable tools.
  • Kubernetes configuration, deployment pipelines, and operational diagnostics.
  • Leading client-facing technology or cyber engagements including scope, team management, delivery timelines, and quality management.
  • Coordinating across AI Engineering, Identity, Data, Application Security, and DevSecOps teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field.
  • Ability to travel 20% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred Experience:

  • Managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
  • AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices, or AI-specific monitoring.
  • Building reusable technical assets, delivery methods, or automation for client engagements.
  • Machine learning tools and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow.
  • AI platforms and model-serving technologies such as Amazon Bedrock/Bedrock AgentCore, SageMaker AI, Microsoft Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, vLLM, KServe, NVIDIA Triton, NVIDIA Inference Microservices (NIM), or Ray Serve.
  • Securing graphics processing unit (GPU) infrastructure, model and container registries, software supply chains, signed artifacts, service meshes, or multi-tenant inference environments.

Certifications Preferred:

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) / Security Specialist (CKS)
  • AWS / Azure / GCP Cloud certifications
  • Certified Terraform Associate / Infrastructure Engineer Professional

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

SAP IS-U Retail Senior Consultant supporting Deloitte's Enterprise Performance team on long-term client projects in Fort Lauderdale. Serves as subject matter expert for Retail Access processes, utility operations, and provides technical guidance with minimal travel requirements.

Full job description

Position Summary

Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced SAP IS-U Retail Senior Consultant, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Talent Model. Project Talent Model (PTM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long-term, onsite client service delivery.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026

Work you’ll do/Responsibilities  

As a Consultant at Deloitte, you will work within an engagement team and be responsible for supporting the overall project goals and objectives. In this role, you will interact with stakeholders and cross-functional teams. It is expected that you will be able to perform independent tasks as well as provide technical guidance to team members, as needed.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for Retail Access processes, including supplier-related transactions, enrollment and change activities, market requirements, exception management, and regulatory and operational support.
  • Act as a liaison between the business area and technical support organizations to ensure business needs are properly documented and translated into technical requirements.
  • Advanced knowledge of utility Customer Service operations, SAP utility system processes, query and reporting tools, and data analysis.
  • Support business continuity, governance, risk identification, escalation, operational reporting, and execution of departmental priorities.
  • Provide strategic and in-depth research, analysis, and recommendations related to Customer Service business processes, operational performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management.

The Team 

Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart-of-the-business solutions.

Enterprise Operations as a Service provides multi-year managed service contracts to support enterprise technology investments and key business processes. We ensure continuous modernization and transformative business changes through five key services: SAP Operations, Oracle Operations, IT Operations, Supply Chain Operations, and Finance Operations. Our mission is to help businesses thrive by maintaining their essential operations and enabling growth.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of SAP IS-U experience
  • Experience in Retail Access processes, including supplier-related transactions, enrollment and change activities, market requirements, exception management, and regulatory and operational support.
  • Experience in utility Customer Service operations, SAP utility system processes, query and reporting tools, and data analysis.
  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred

  • Analytical/ Decision Making Responsibilities
  • Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products
  • Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
  • Excellent Written and Communication Skills
  • Ability to deliver technical demonstrations

Position Summary

As a Manager: AI Security, Identity in Deloitte's Cyber for AI team, you will lead client engagements that secure how AI agents, workloads, and users authenticate, receive permissions, and access enterprise tools and data. You will translate business and risk objectives into target architectures, guide teams from assessment through implementation, and remain directly involved in critical design and engineering decisions. You will also shape solutions during pursuits and help build repeatable delivery assets.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

The team

Deloitte’s Cyber for AI team helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security, and operations.

We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data, or infrastructure risk.

Within the team, the Identity capability focuses on how agents, workloads, and people are identified, authenticated, authorized, and governed across enterprise and cloud environments.

Work you'll do

As a Manager: AI Security, Identity on the Identity team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading identity security assessments, design workshops, and implementation programs for generative AI and agentic systems.
  • Translating business, risk, and platform requirements into target architectures for agent identity, workload identity, delegated access, and lifecycle governance.
  • Remaining directly involved through design reviews, policy and integration decisions, critical configuration or code review, and resolution of high-risk technical issues.
  • Developing reusable identity patterns, automation, and delivery methods.
  • Managing engagement scope, teams, milestones, quality, and client expectations while coordinating identity dependencies across AI engineering, data, cloud, network, application security, and operations teams.
  • Shaping solutions during pursuits through workshops, demonstrations, proofs of concept, estimates, and delivery plans
  • Coaching practitioners on engineering quality.

Qualifications

6+ years of cybersecurity experience, including a year or more of artificial intelligence (AI) engineering experience, Required:

  • Consulting experience leading client-facing technology or cyber engagements including scope, teams, timelines, quality reviews, and executive communication.

·       Architecting and leading production generative AI and/or agentic implementations across models, orchestration, identity, data, and infrastructure.

  • Experience with identity security patterns & integrating cloud IAM and AI platforms with enterprise identity providers, identity governance and administration (IGA), privileged access management (PAM), cloud infrastructure entitlement management (CIEM), secrets management, and application programming interface (API) security technologies in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
  • Experience architecting and implementing non-human identity, workload identity, delegated authorization, secrets, and privileged-access controls; applying OAuth 2.0 or 2.1, OpenID Connect, token exchange, PKI, mTLS, and RBAC/ABAC or relationship-based access control.
  • Experience reviewing or developing identity integrations and policy automation using Python, TypeScript, Java, and/or Go with APIs, JSON or YAML along with Git, and CI/CD practices.
  • Ability to travel 20–50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field.

·       Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience across managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
  • Experience with AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices, or AI-specific monitoring.
  • Experience building reusable technical assets, delivery methods, or automation for use across client engagements.
  • Experience with machine learning tools and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow.

·       Experience with agent-focused identity capabilities, including Microsoft Entra Agent ID or Model Context Protocol (MCP) authorization, or with policy engines, identity graphs, or authorization platforms such as Open Policy Agent (OPA), Cedar, OpenFGA, or Neo4j.

Credentials (preferred):

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
  • Cloud certifications from Azure, AWS, Google Cloud.
  • Identity certifications from Okta, Ping, SailPoint, Saviynt, or CyberArk.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 to $265,100. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Manager, Client Excellence, Global Consulting Services
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do
  • Own the strategy and execution of GLCP support programming across four dimensions: Account Leadership, GLCP Development, Account Growth initiatives, and Performance Management.
  • Set direction for and lead the day-to-day operations of the Client Excellence team, serving as the primary point of accountability for team output.
  • Lead execution of the GLCP onboarding program in partnership with Industry Leaders, including welcome calls, onboarding materials, briefing packs, and targeted development sessions.
  • Own and execute the GLCP succession planning process in collaboration with GCS Industry Leaders, GLCSPs, and Member Firms to ensure leadership continuity across strategic accounts.
  • Design, refresh, and deliver GLCP development offerings so content, formats, and delivery approaches remain relevant to current needs.
  • Analyze and synthesize Market, Client, and Account data to develop actionable insights that inform leadership decisions and advance GTM priorities.
  • Own the GLCP performance management lifecycle, including expectations, goal setting, mid-year reviews, year-end reviews, and consensus processes.
  • Lead and continuously improve program and PMO processes, reporting cadences, communications, and integrated ways of working across the four dimensions.
  • Partner with GCS Industry Leaders, GCS Member Firm Growth Leaders across SR&T and T&T, broader GCS Growth leadership, GLCPs, and account teams to align priorities and execution.
  • Lead and develop both onshore and offshore resources, fostering collaboration across geographies and time zones while providing coaching, mentoring, and career development support.
  • Operate with substantial autonomy in setting priorities, directing execution, allocating team capacity, and resolving complex stakeholder issues with limited senior oversight.


The team

Deloitte’s Global Consulting Services professionals support our global businesses to drive impact and create enduring value for clients in Strategy, Risk & Transactions (SR&T) and Technology & Transformation (T&T). We deliver purpose-driven services and solutions and provide a consistent, best-in-class "One Deloitte" experience around the world.



Qualifications
  • Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in client program management, communications, or PMO/reporting functions, ideally within a large, global, matrixed professional-services organization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
  • Demonstrated team leadership, people management, coaching, and development experience.
  • Superior written and oral communication skills, including the ability to prepare senior stakeholder-ready materials and tailor messaging to the audience.
  • Advanced stakeholder-management skills and the credibility to work across GCS pillars, senior leaders, GLCPs, and account teams.
  • Strong project and program management, PMO, reporting, and time-management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple assignments independently under pressure.
  • Proven ability to operate with autonomy, exercise judgment under uncertainty, and resolve ambiguous, high-stakes, deadline-driven issues with limited oversight.
  • Working knowledge of GLCP support programming across Account Leadership, GLCP Development, Account Growth initiatives, and Performance Management.
  • Experience designing, developing, and implementing new processes or solutions; experience integrating previously distributed work into a coherent operating model is a plus.
  • Mastery of Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Comfort working in a global, matrixed, fast-paced environment with diverse stakeholder expectations.



Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. 

Recruiting for this role ends on February 5, 2027

Work you’ll do

As a Senior Consultant in Deloitte’s Customer Experience Management practice, you will leverage your knowledge of best-in-class technology (Medallia, Qualtrics, Sprinklr) to collaborate with clients to strategize, configure, and implement world-class customer feedback, analytics, and engagement solutions. As a trusted advisor, you will be responsible for supporting the overall project goals and objectives. It is expected that you will be able to craft quality deliverables, effectively manage the team and day-to-day relationships, and provide both technical and functional guidance to team members as needed.

Essential job responsibilities include:

Platform Implementation & Technical Configuration

  • Configure and implement customer experience platforms (Medallia, Qualtrics, Sprinklr) to address unique business needs.
  • Lead in technical design and build, including integrations, enhancements, and ongoing platform support, such as API-based integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Adobe, Snowflake), SSO/OIDC setup, and data ingestion/export processes.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize system performance, working closely with client and internal technical teams.

Functional Consulting & VOC Strategy

  • Manage relationships with business stakeholders and work to translate their objectives into VOC (Voice of Customer) solutions, journey maps, and actionable roadmaps.
  • Lead client assessments and development of technical/functional roadmaps to enable structured VOC strategies.
  • Develop and deliver workshops on strategy, analytics, and customer journey visioning.

Project Management & Delivery

  • Manage assigned projects and teams, reporting on progress, timelines, and deliverables through structured executive status reports.
  • Manage and collaborate with cross-functional teams (analytics, developers) to drive project execution and ensure high-impact outcomes.
  • Apply Agile project management principles—helping organize governance, facilitate agile ceremonies, and enable collaborative decision-making.

Analytics & Insights

  • Design and develop dashboards, real-time reporting, and analytics suites, including text/speech analytics and sentiment drivers.
  • Help clients interpret platform data, convert insights into actions, and measure progress (KPI frameworks, NPS improvement, etc.).
  • Ensure solutions allow stakeholders to make data-driven decisions.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth. 

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or related discipline.
  • Certifications in Medallia
  • Experience (2+ years) in hands-on configuration of CX platforms (ex: Medallia, Qualtrics, Sprinklr).
  • 1+ years of basic project management experience (Agile frameworks preferred).
  • Understanding of API integrations, SSO/OAuth setup, and data transformation (ETL) concepts.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% on average based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; comfortable working with sophisticated data sets and deriving actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills for engaging both technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience in client-facing consulting or advisory roles.
  • Exposure to VOC strategy, customer journey mapping, or analytics program delivery.
  • Familiarity with cloud data solutions or dashboarding platforms.
  • Exposure to REST APIs, JSON/XML data handling, and webhooks/event-driven integrations.

A reasonable estimate of the current range is $86,700 to $170,900.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/02/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Manager, Technical Transformation on the Business Finance team, you will be responsible for leading the design, integration, and architectural governance of OneStream solutions that support enterprise performance management objectives across multiple pods or projects.

  • Lead the design and implementation of OneStream solutions for financial consolidation, planning, budgeting, and reporting
  • Align business requirements with scalable technical architectures that support federal government and enterprise finance use cases
  • Oversee integrations between OneStream and enterprise platforms, including enterprise resource planning and data warehouse environments
  • Provide architectural governance across multiple pods or projects in parallel to support solution quality, consistency, and performance
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across development, functional, and business process teams to drive configurations, best practices, and delivery outcomes

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Business Finance offering enables finance to drive strategic value through transformation and synchronization of planning, costing, budgeting and forecasting across finance and other functions. Using advanced, scalable data and tech platforms, we also generate actionable insights and analytics, streamline decision making and enable data driven profitable growth. Manages risk and opportunities associated with diverse and complex grant programs through end-to-end grants management solutions.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required clearance for this role

  • 5+ years of OneStream experience supporting budgeting, planning, and/or federal government use cases, including core finance processes such as financial consolidation, planning, budgeting, and reporting
  • 3+ years integrating enterprise performance management and corporate performance management platforms with enterprise systems, including enterprise resource planning and data warehouse environments
  • 2+ years leading implementations within an agile or hybrid-agile software development lifecycle and coordinating development, functional, and business process teams across multiple pods or projects
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Active OneStream Certified Professional certification as a Lead Architect or Core Platform Architect
  • Experience supporting multiple pods or projects in parallel
  • Additional experience with complex, multi-system application landscapes
  • Additional OneStream certifications

Job.JobTitle: Cyber SAP Internal Controls Manager/ Engineering Manager II
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 6+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Manager role on Deloitte's Cyber Enterprise Security team leading SAP internal controls strategy, design, testing, and deployment across ERP environments. You'll oversee business process and IT general controls workstreams, guide teams through control implementation, and ensure alignment with regulatory requirements including SOX.

Good fit if you have 6+ years designing SAP ERP controls, 3+ years in SOX or comparable regulatory requirements, and can travel 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Cyber SAP Internal Controls Manager/ Engineering Manager II

Join Deloitte’s Cyber Enterprise Security team and help clients strengthen SAP risk management, internal controls, governance, and compliance across enterprise transformation, ERP and cloud modernization, and implementations. The Manager will lead business process and IT general controls strategy, design, testing, and deployment across SAP ERP environments. This role helps organizations manage risk and enable business operations by addressing controls and regulatory compliance requirements across SAP ERP platforms, integrations, and transformation programs.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Manager on the Cyber Enterprise Security team, you will:

  • Lead the assessment of business-process and technology risks arising from transformation and implementation initiatives, translating findings into implications for the client’s risk and controls environment.
  • Own the SAP controls workstream across business, functional, and technical teams; connect SAP configurations and custom development to practical, risk-based control requirements.
  • Direct the design of automated and manual business process controls across SAP-enabled processes and IT general controls, ensuring the design addresses identified risks and can be implemented and sustained.
  • Advise clients on controls for AI-enabled business processes and contribute to the design and implementation of fit-for-purpose AI governance.
  • Facilitate executive and working-level workshops to align stakeholders on risk priorities, control design decisions, ownership, and implementation readiness.
  • Oversee segregation-of-duties and critical or sensitive access analyses; recommend and help define appropriate mitigating controls.
  • Plan and oversee control design testing, evaluate evidence and results, resolve gaps with stakeholders, and communicate findings and remediation needs.
  • Apply relevant regulatory requirements, including SOX where applicable, to controls design, testing, and supporting documentation.
  • Lead transition and knowledge-transfer activities so control owners and stakeholders understand their responsibilities and are prepared to operate the controls.
  • Manage engagement with internal audit, compliance, and other assurance stakeholders, aligning on control objectives, evidence needs, and issue resolution.
  • Coordinate with client and delivery teams to govern control deployment, track dependencies and risks, and support readiness for implementation or go-live.
  • Own the quality and timely delivery of work products—including risk and control matrices, test procedures, job aids, impact assessments, and other controls documentation.
  • Guide and develop team members, review their work, and manage workstream priorities, progress, and deliverable quality.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Enterprise Security Offering helps organizations embed security across digital transformation initiatives by securing the technical backbone of the business while enabling change. The team supports capabilities across security architecture, secure development and deployment, cyber, cloud and application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, information systems, business, or a related field
  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing internal controls (automated, -manual controls) in an SAP ERP environment
  • 3+ years of experience with key business processes (e.g., record to report, procure to pay, order to cash, etc.) and their inherent risks and controls
  • Experience evaluating SAP ERP configuration and translating business requirements into automated control designs; able to explain the configuration and control logic for at least 3 control examples.
  • Experience assessing risks and controls in at least 2 IT general control domains, such as access management, change management, or IT operations.
  • 3+ years of experience with segregation of duties frameworks and mitigating controls
  • 3+ years’ experience applying SOX or comparable regulatory requirements to SAP ERP controls, including supporting control documentation, testing, or remediation
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the clients and industries/sectors you serve and specific project requirements
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

  • Experience with SAP ERP implementations or transformations
  • Experience with automated solutions for continuous control monitoring, access management, cloud governance, etc. (e.g., SAP Process Control, SAP Identity Access Governance)
  • Experience with controls for SAP ERP Cloud applications (e.g., SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, Business Technology Platform, etc.)
  • Experience with pre-go live control testing, audit support, or compliance programs

Job.JobTitle: Accounting, Finance, and Controls Senior Consultant: State, Local, and Higher Education
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Position summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Work you'll do

As part of our Controllership and Treasury Transformation team, you will support state, local, and higher education clients with accounting operations, financial controls, audit readiness, asset accountability, and financial data analysis. Example responsibilities include:

  • Support accounting operations for state agencies, counties, municipalities, and public or private universities, applying Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) standards for public entities and Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) standards for private institutions, along with fund accounting principles.
  • Perform general ledger analysis, account reconciliations, journal entry review and preparation, and chart of accounts design or cleanup, including fund, function, and object code structures.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and fiscal year-end close activities, including accruals, adjustments, and preparation of supporting schedules.
  • Assist with internal controls design and testing aligned to the COSO framework, and help clients prepare for external financial statement audits, state audits, and Single Audits under Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200) for federal grant funds.
  • Support Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) preparation, including schedules, note disclosures, and coordination with auditors.
  • Support capital asset accounting for land, buildings, infrastructure, equipment, and construction in progress, including depreciation, asset tagging and verification, and capitalization thresholds.
  • Support accounting for inventory, operating materials and supplies, and internal-use software, including implementation of GASB 51 for intangible assets and, where applicable, GASB 87 leases and GASB 96 subscription-based IT arrangements.
  • Perform data validation, control testing, and reporting, using SQL and Excel to extract and analyze data from ERP systems such as Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft, Banner, or Ellucian.
  • Support grant and sponsored program accounting, including cost allocation, drawdown reconciliation, and tracking of compliance requirements.
  • Support treasury and cash management activities, including bank reconciliations, investment reporting, and cash flow analysis, as part of the broader transformation scope.
  • Document current-state processes, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and help design and implement improved workflows, policies, and procedures.
  • Deliver knowledge transfer and training to client staff so that process improvements are sustained after the engagement.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to support the evolving business objectives of the organization. We work with the CFO, CAO, controller, and treasurer to develop an efficient, high quality, data-driven, tech-enabled controllership and treasury function that empowers our clients to drive more value to their business partners and to their investors.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Governmental or higher education accounting (GASB or FASB-based) and fund accounting;
    • General ledger analysis, account reconciliations, journal entries, and chart of accounts design;
    • Internal controls, COSO-based control testing, and audit readiness for financial statement, state, or Single Audits;
    • Capital asset accounting, including land, buildings, infrastructure, equipment, construction in progress, and depreciation;
    • Grant or sponsored program accounting, including cost allocation and compliance under Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200);
    • Accounting for inventory, operating materials and supplies, internal-use software, leases (GASB 87), or subscription-based IT arrangements (GASB 96);
    • SQL, Excel-based reporting, data validation, or control testing using ERP data; or
    • Treasury, cash management, or bank reconciliation activities.
  • Working knowledge of GASB standards, and familiarity with FASB standards for private universities, is preferred.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain any security clearances needed for the project and/or client.
  • Experience preparing or supporting month-end, year-end, or CAFR close activities.
  • Ability to work across multiple client environments, manage competing priorities, and travel as needed.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • 3+ years of experience supporting government or higher education clients
  • Experience working in a consulting or project-based delivery environment
  • Experience with ERP (such as SAP, Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft) or other systems (for example Workiva, Blackline, One Stream, Anaplan, etc), is preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and train client staff.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $95,600 to $188,400.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Senior Manager: AI Security, Infrastructure
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

As a Cyber for AI Infrastructure Sr. Manager on Deloitte's Cyber for AI team, you will help clients address cloud and infrastructure security challenges across managed and self-hosted artificial intelligence (AI) platforms. This role combines client leadership with hands-on delivery using infrastructure security and AI engineering experience to architect, build, and deploy production-grade solutions. You will lead teams, shape technical solutions during pursuits, develop reusable accelerators, and deliver outcomes for clients and teams.


Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Cyber for AI Infrastructure Sr. Manager on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:

  • Advising security, infrastructure, technology, and AI leaders on secure platform strategy for managed and self-hosted AI workloads.
  • Leading multi-workstream infrastructure programs from current-state assessment and target architecture through implementation and operational adoption.
  • Defining scalable control patterns for network isolation, Kubernetes, model serving, graphics processing unit (GPU) environments, infrastructure as code, policy enforcement, software supply chain, and observability.
  • Providing hands-on technical oversight through architecture reviews, critical prototypes, platform decisions, and resolution of complex delivery issues.
  • Leading pursuits and account growth by shaping differentiated solutions, demonstrations, scope, estimates, pricing inputs, and delivery approaches.
  • Overseeing client relationships, engagement quality, delivery risk, and customer satisfaction while building practice capability through offerings, alliances, reusable accelerators, technical guidance, and development of future leaders.

The team

Deloitte's Cyber for AI team helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security, and operations.

We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data, or infrastructure risk.

Within the team, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation, and observability.

Qualifications

8+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience including hands-on production work in both domains and experience shaping and delivering production generative AI or agentic programs, including managed or self-hosted architectures and enterprise control integration.

Required Experience:

  • Designing and securing AI landing zones and infrastructure across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud including cloud and network architecture, Kubernetes, container, GPU, and model-serving platforms.
  • Security infrastructure including private connectivity, segmentation, egress control, service-to-service security, tenant isolation, secrets management, encryption, resilience, and observability.
  • Implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD, and policy-as-code using Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, Open Policy Agent, Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or comparable tools.
  • Reviewing architecture, automation, platform configuration, and critical prototypes.
  • Guiding teams through infrastructure decisions.
  • Leading consulting client engagements, technical pursuits, executive relationships, delivery quality, and account growth.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field.
  • Ability to travel 25% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred Experience:

  • Managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
  • AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices, or AI-specific monitoring.
  • Building offerings, reusable technical assets, alliance relationships, or market-facing points of view.
  • Machine learning tools and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow.
  • AI platforms and model-serving technologies (Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, SageMaker AI, Microsoft Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, vLLM, KServe, NVIDIA Triton or NVIDIA Inference Microservices (NIM), or Ray Serve).
  • Securing GPU infrastructure, model and container registries, software supply chains, signed artifacts, service meshes, or multi-tenant inference environments.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) / Security Specialist (CKS)
  • AWS / Azure / GCP Cloud certifications
  • Certified Terraform Associate / Infrastructure Engineer Professional

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.

At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $163,400 to $322,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Manager, Industry Solutions, Investment Wealth Management
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

As a Manager in Investment and Wealth Management, you will help organizations define strategic priorities, solve complex business issues, and drive large-scale transformation initiatives. This role involves working with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to shape growth strategies, improve performance, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings structured problem solving, experience leading workstreams, and the ability to translate analysis into actionable recommendations.

Work you'll do

As a Manager on the Investment and Wealth Management team, you will be responsible for…

  • Lead end-to-end business and technology transformation programs across Investment Management, Wealth Management, Asset Servicing, and Retirement operations.
  • Manage technology platform selections and implementations, including vendor scans, RFPs, due diligence, requirements, testing, conversion, and cutover.
  • Design and execute target-state operating models, business processes, and workflow transformation initiatives to improve scalability, controls, and efficiency.
  • Lead investment data strategy and transformation efforts, including data governance, architecture, integrations, reporting, and modernization initiatives.
  • Deliver IBOR, ABOR, portfolio accounting, performance measurement, and reconciliation transformation programs.
  • Drive alternatives and private markets initiatives, including private equity, private credit, partnership accounting, investor servicing, and wealth distribution enablement.
  • Support institutional asset managers with front-, middle-, and back-office modernization, including investment operations, trading, accounting, performance, and reporting capabilities.
  • Enable wealth management transformation across advisor platforms, custodians, Turnkey Asset Management Platforms (TAMPs), client reporting, planning tools, and digital wealth ecosystems.
  • Oversee cross-functional teams, third-party vendors, and stakeholders while managing governance, risk, budgets, roadmaps, and executive communications.
  • Advise senior executives on business cases, technology strategy, platform modernization, and enterprise transformation priorities. 
  • Leading workstreams for strategy, growth, and transformation engagements across business functions and client priorities
  • Conducting market, customer, financial, and operational analyses to inform recommendations, decision-making and competitive analyses
  • Developing executive-level deliverables, including presentations, business cases, and implementation roadmaps
  • Managing day-to-day client interactions and coordinating cross-functional teams to support timely delivery
  • Coaching junior team members and overseeing quality of work products across project activities

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

The Investment and Wealth Management team helps clients address enterprise priorities through strategic planning, business analysis, and transformation execution. The team works with leaders across segments to solve complex problems, identify growth opportunities, and improve organizational performance. Professionals in this practice collaborate across functions and bring structured, data-informed approaches to help clients achieve business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree
  • 8+ years relevant consulting and/or investment/wealth management experience
  • 8+ years of experience in translating requirements into optimized designs, and identifying design alternatives and implications on functionality, effort, performance and operations
  • 8+ years of experience leading smaller engagements or components of large, complex strategy and/or operations transformation engagements
  • 8+ years of experience identifying client business issues, owning responsibility for the quality of deliverables, managing stakeholder relationships, and developing persuasive recommendations
  • 8+ years of experience collaborating with financial services industry senior executives, and comfort delivering presentations to management.
  • 6+ years’ experience developing and presenting proposal responses
  • Travel up to 50%, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred Qualifications

  • 6+ years’ experience in one or more of the following various sector packages; Aladdin, Simcorp, Charles River, Fidessa, EZE, Calypso / Murex, Bloomberg AIM, Portware, FlexTrade, FIS, Eagle PACE, IMS Markit EDM, Ipreo (iLevel and ival), eFront, Investran, Geneva, InvestOne, and/or other IBOR, OMS, investment accounting, or trading platforms across institutional, wealth, and private markets.  Market Intelligence experience: DST SalesConnect, Market Metrics Matrix, and Fishtank.
  • Experience with various phases of the implementation lifecycle, from system selection to implementation sequencing and planning, project management, application & technical design, interface& data conversion, application build, environment management, testing, go live planning, etc.
  • Experience with front-to-back investment operations and the end-to-end trade lifecycle, including portfolio management, trading, reconciliation, accounting, performance, reporting, and asset servicing.
  • Strong understanding of investment data, data governance, data architecture, and enterprise data management concepts.
  • Experience with alternatives and private markets, including private equity, private credit, partnership accounting, fund administration, and investor servicing.
  • Understanding of institutional asset management and wealth management business models, distribution channels, custodians, advisors, and TAMPs.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Senior Consultant: AI Security, Identity
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

As a Sr. Consultant: AI Security, Identity in our Cyber for AI team, you will lead technical workstreams for secure artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workloads including how users authenticate, receive permissions, and access enterprise tools and data. You will combine client advisory and hands-on engineering to design architectures, integrations, and production controls; guide junior practitioners; lead demonstrations; and support delivery estimates.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

The team

Deloitte’s Cyber for AI team helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems by embedding security controls in platforms and delivery lifecycles. The Identity capability focuses on how agents, workloads, and people are identified, authenticated, authorized, and governed across enterprise and cloud environments while managing access, data, and infrastructure risk.

Work you'll do

As a Sr. Consultant: AI Security, Identity on the Identity team, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead discovery sessions to map user-to-agent-to-tool access paths, privilege boundaries, and identity lifecycle requirements.
  • Design identity architectures and integrations for AI agents and workloads, including federation, credentialless access, delegated authorization, policy enforcement, and connections across cloud and enterprise platforms.
  • Engineer and review token exchange, on-behalf-of access, consent, session controls, and just-in-time privilege patterns; test production controls and resolve authentication and authorization issues.
  • Own identity workstreams, manage dependencies and delivery milestones, and guide consultants.
  • Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes and contribute architecture, effort, and estimation inputs to pursuits.

Qualifications

3-5+ years of cybersecurity experience, including 1+ year of artificial intelligence (AI) security engineering experience.

Required:

  • Production work designing, integrating, and securing generative AI, RAG, or agentic workloads with model, tool, and enterprise data connections.
  • Designing and implementing identity controls for service accounts & principals, managed identities, workload federation, secrets, and short-lived credentials for one or more public cloud platforms.
  • Implementing OAuth 2.0 or 2.1, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, JWT, token exchange, PKI, mTLS, including delegated and on-behalf-of access patterns.
  • Implementation experience with identity, identity governance, privileged access, cloud IAM, and secrets-management platforms. (i.e. MS Entra, AWS IAM / STS, Google Cloud IAM, Okta, Ping, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, and/or HashiCorp Vault.
  • Building or reviewing identity integrations or automation using Python, TypeScript, Java, and/or Go with APIs, JSON or YAML along with Git, and CI/CD practices.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Ability to travel 20–50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Previous consulting, client delivery, or customer-facing engineering experience, including developing reusable technical assets, guiding junior engineers, or contributing to engineering standards.
  • Experience across managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.

  • Experience with machine learning tools / frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow.

Preferred

  • 6+ years of experience with distributed data platforms in the Hadoop ecosystem, preferably Cloudera, including HDFS, Hive, Pig, Sqoop, and MongoDB.

  • Cloud Platform & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience designing and deploying solutions on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including cloud-native data services (Databricks, Snowflake) and applying infrastructure engineering principles alongside software architecture.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Human Capital team helps organizations create value through people performance. We work with clients to reimagine work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise and to transform their HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today’s world, you will help clients answer questions like: How do I access, develop, and motivate my workforce? What should my AI strategy be for the HR function? Do I have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to make work better for humans and humans better at work.

Work You'll Do

As a Change Management Workstream Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation Lead on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Design and deliver end-user training, workshops, and software training guides with delivery teams
  • Develop Help Desk strategy and provide end-user support and adoption communications before and after releases.
  • Partner with the Design Workstream to conduct stakeholder interviews, gather feedback, and inform future requirements
  • Develop and execute organizational change management and strategic communications plans, including stakeholder messaging, leadership briefings, and readiness activities
  • Coordinate with Design, Agile, and Testing Workstreams to support releases; travel to military bases and allied exercises to deliver briefings and user support

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Organization, Workforce, & Change offering shapes market-leading organizational strategies, delivers impactful change, and generates client value through the workforce, while leveraging data-driven insights and exceptional delivery execution.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Associates degree
  • Active Secret clearance required
  • 5+ years of experience leading organizational change management (OCM) and strategic communications for information technology implementation projects delivered using Agile methods, including two-week sprints
  • Experience working with Military Personnel as customers or end users, or military experience
  • Experience supporting supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, or fulfillment programs
  • Experience designing training content, facilitating end-user training or workshops, and providing end-user support for software products
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred: 

  • Experience supporting a Help Desk or Service Desk for software users
  • Experience with Palantir Training
  • Experience delivering briefings or training to military personnel or government stakeholders
