About this job

Lead Oracle HCM Cloud technical integrations for enterprise systems, including strategy definition, data conversion, and go-live support. Work with Deloitte's Government & Public Services practice on HR transformation projects serving public sector clients.

Good fit if you have 3+ years delivering Oracle HCM Cloud solutions and 2+ years leading full-lifecycle integrations, with ability to obtain Public Trust clearance.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Human Capital team helps organizations create value through people performance. We work with clients to reimagine work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise and to transform their HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today’s world, you will help clients answer questions like: How do I access, develop, and motivate my workforce? What should my AI strategy be for the HR function? Do I have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to make work better for humans and humans better at work.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/30/2026.

Work You'll Do

As a Consultant on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading the design, coordination, and delivery of Oracle HCM Cloud technical integrations across enterprise systems
  • Defining integration strategy and overseeing inbound/outbound interfaces, middleware coordination, data mapping, and end-to-end validation
  • Partnering with HR, security, and technology stakeholders to ensure solutions are aligned to functional, technical, and compliance requirements
  • Leading data conversion planning and execution, including extraction, cleansing, transformation, load support, reconciliation, and cutover readiness
  • Managing technical risks, dependencies, defects, and issue resolution across integrations and conversions throughout the project lifecycle
  • Supporting testing, deployment, go-live, and post-production stabilization to help ensure successful Oracle HCM Cloud implementation outcomes

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our HR Strategy & Technology offering develops leading global HR strategies and implements HR technologies that drive transformation, maximize the workforce experience, and sustain HR effectiveness and value while navigating a world of disruption.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of experience delivering Oracle HCM Cloud technical solutions
  • 2+ years of experience with leading the integrations for a full-life cycle implementation of Oracle Cloud HCM
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance for this role
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Experience delivering across multiple Oracle HCM Cloud implementations within large-scale, multi-stakeholder public sector programs supporting 10,000+ employees
  • Experience in government and public sector implementations
  • Oracle HCM Cloud certified

You will oversee and drive the success of your workstream, ensuring solutions meet technical, operational, and user requirements while guiding and mentoring both onshore and offshore team members to facilitate effective collaboration and skill development. Your expertise will contribute to the overall project, aligning workstream activities with broader project goals and timelines. In this role, you will build strong working relationships with client stakeholders, managing day-to-day expectations and maintaining clear communication within your area of responsibility. You will be expected to effectively explain technical concepts to both business and technical audiences, ensuring alignment and stakeholder buy-in, as well as developing clear, well-structured presentations and process diagrams using MS Visio and MS PowerPoint. 

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  •   Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  •   Effective written and verbal communication skills
  •   Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

The team

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.

Required

  • Minimum 6 years of professional experience in consulting or industry roles, with at least 4 years focused on Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions
  • Demonstrated 3+ years designing conceptual architectures for enterprise solutions, including Dataverse security model implementation
  • Completed multiple data migrations and integrations using tools such as Power Automate, Dataflows, Data Gateways, Custom Connectors, and Azure integration services across at least 3 projects
  • Practical 2+ years of experience with modern DevOps practices, including management of content repositories, version control (such as Git), and implementation of CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) pipelines
  • Demonstrated administration of Dynamics CRM and Power Platform, including successful deployment and maintenance of Center of Excellence (CoE) toolkit in production environments
  • Advanced technical proficiency with C#, Dataverse Web API, Plugin development, JavaScript, Power FX, and PowerShell across client-facing projects
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent number of years of experience
  • Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available


Preferred

  • Familiarity with other cloud platforms (AWS, Google) and CRM applications (Salesforce, Oracle, SAP, ServiceNow)
  • Hands-on 4+ years of experience utilizing Power Platform and broader Microsoft cloud technologies (such as Azure, Dynamics 365, and Office 365) to address business requirements
  • Proven track record of developing and extending Dataverse solutions through custom Plugin development, JavaScript, Azure Functions, and PowerApps Component Framework (PCF) for at least 3 engagements
  • Strong understanding of multiple SDLC methodologies (Agile, SCRUM, RUP, etc.)Excellent oral and written communication, including presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint)

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

PLM (Centric/Flex) Techno-functional CPG Solution Architect Manager

Join Deloitte’s Supply Chain & Network Operations practice and help clients modernize product lifecycle processes through digital transformation. In this role, you’ll work with leading organizations to address complex business and technology challenges, deliver PLM-focused solutions, and create measurable impact across the value chain. If you are energized by solving complex problems, working across teams, and shaping innovative solutions, this role offers the opportunity to grow your career while helping clients build more connected, responsive operations. 

 Recruiting for this role ends on 06/16/2027. 

 Work you'll do 

As a Techno-functional PLM Solution Architect on the Supply Chain & Network Operations team, you will be responsible for: 

  • Delivering end to end complex Product Lifecycle Management transformations in a fast-paced, team environment 
  • Providing expertise and guidance in the design and implementation of market-leading PLM platforms 
  • Conducting business assessments to identify gaps, build roadmaps, and develop the business case for PLM transformation. 
  • Guiding workstream leads across functional areas including Product Development engineering, quality, regulatory, manufacturing, and IT
  • Ensuring deliverable quality across design, configuration, integration, data migration, and validation workstreams 
  • Supporting Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) pursuits and development of practitioners in the product development practice 
  • Contributing to knowledge-sharing forums that strengthen Deloitte’s capabilities and support client problem-solving 
  • Be flexible in delivery across multiple industries including Footwear & Apparel, Food & Beverage, Consumer Packaged Goods, and Retail 
  • Architecting PLM solutions including information and data model design and application architecture interfaces 

A successful candidate would possess these skills: 

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team 
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills 
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product 
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams 
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment 
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others 

The team 

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value. 

You will work closely with operations leaders, plant managers, and IT teams to design and implement solutions that enhance production efficiency, quality, visibility, and traceability across the manufacturing value chain. 

Qualifications 

Required: 

  • 6+ years of experience architecting Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions 
  • Delivery experience of Centric PLM and/or FlexPLM
  • Experience with software development lifecycle activities, including requirements gathering and solution design 
  • Experience delivering PLM programs in one or more of the following industries: Footwear & Apparel, Food & Beverage, Consumer Packaged Goods, Retail 
  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. 

Preferred: 

  • Certification or training in Centric PLM and/or Flex PLM

About this job

Manager role in Deloitte's HR BPaaS Solution Hub designing payroll outsourcing solutions for sales pursuits. Translates client requirements into staffing models, delivery strategies, and pricing while partnering with sales, delivery, and global teams.

Good fit if you have 6+ years in payroll outsourcing or BPO, 4+ years in solution architecture or workforce planning, and experience with staffing models and benchmarking data.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Manager, Payroll Solutions Architect is a core member of the HR BPaaS Solution Hub and is responsible for solutioning HR Business Process as a Service opportunity during active sales pursuits.

This role translates client requirements into commercially viable and delivery-ready solutions, including staffing models, role structures, delivery location strategies, productivity assumptions, and pricing inputs. The Solution Architect applies market benchmarking, operational experience, technology-enabled efficiencies, and Deloitte’s BPaaS delivery capabilities to ensure that every pursuit is supported by a solution that is both competitively positioned and executable as priced.

The role partners closely with sales teams, account leaders, delivery leadership, pricing and commercial teams, and global delivery centers. Success requires the ability to move quickly under pursuit deadlines while bringing analytical rigor, operational credibility, and clear communication to complex HR outsourcing opportunities.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/04/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Manager, Payroll Solutions Architect on the HR BPaaS Solution Hub team, you will be responsible for…

  • Partner with sales teams and account leaders on active Human Resources (HR) payroll business process as a service (BPaaS) and business process outsourcing (BPO) pursuits; serve as the primary solution architecture resource from opportunity qualification through proposal development and client presentations; translate client requirements, process volumes, service expectations, and operating-model objectives into solution designs; and identify assumptions, dependencies, risks, and decision points affecting scope, staffing, pricing, or delivery feasibility.
  • Design staffing models for proposed Payroll BPaaS engagements, including headcount, role mix, skill profiles, supervisory structure, span of control, shift, coverage, language, and time-zone models; incorporate process volumes, complexity, seasonality, service expectations, productivity assumptions, and transition considerations; evaluate alternative scenarios; and translate models into pricing and commercial analyses.
  • Identify opportunities to improve proposed solutions through automation, process standardization, workflow redesign, technology-enabled productivity gains, and continuous improvement; assess how Deloitte capabilities and proprietary tooling can improve efficiency, quality, scalability, and client value; and communicate how technology and process innovation support measurable business outcomes.
  • Determine delivery location strategies across the United States, Mexico, and India; evaluate process complexity, client requirements, cost targets, language needs, time-zone coverage, talent availability, and operational risk; develop blended onshore, nearshore, and offshore delivery models; and coordinate with delivery center leadership to validate assumptions, resource availability, and operating feasibility.
  • Build and maintain staffing calculators, productivity models, pricing templates, assumptions libraries, solution playbooks, and cross-deal knowledge repositories; collaborate with delivery leadership to confirm solutions can be executed as priced and support post-win transitions; draft proposal and request-for-proposal (RFP) content; and maintain knowledge of the competitive HR BPaaS and BPO landscape, client expectations, delivery models, and technology trends.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

The HR BPaaS Solution Hub supports Deloitte’s growth in HR managed services by bringing together solution architecture, sales, delivery, pricing, commercial, and technology capabilities.

The team helps clients operate and transform critical HR processes through scalable, technology-enabled service models. Our work spans process design, workforce planning, global delivery strategy, automation, analytics, and managed services operations.

Solution Hub serves as the connection point between client needs and delivery execution. By combining functional HR knowledge, quantitative modeling, market benchmarks, and Deloitte’s technology-enabled capabilities, the team helps ensure that HR BPaaS opportunities are positioned with both commercial precision and operational credibility.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years of experience in payroll outsourcing, business process outsourcing (BPO), shared services, or managed services.
  • 4+ years of experience in one or more of the following: solution architecture, pricing, workforce planning, capacity planning, delivery operations, or managed services design; experience supporting payroll processes; and experience developing staffing models, workforce plans, capacity models, or productivity assumptions for payroll outsourcing, BPO, shared services, or managed services.
  • 4+ years of experience applying Avasant, ISG, or Everest benchmarking data to business cases; developing and maintaining Microsoft Excel staffing calculators, pricing inputs, and scenario analyses; using generative artificial intelligence (AI) and automation tools in solution development, analysis, or service delivery; contributing to proposals, RFP responses, client presentations, or executive-level solution narratives; and working across sales, delivery, pricing, commercial, technology, and global delivery teams in United States, Mexico, and India delivery models while managing multiple active pursuit deadlines.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Master’s or MBA degree.
  • At least 6 years of experience building BPO pricing models, managing engagement margins, and optimizing global delivery economics across offshore and nearshore centers.
  • At least 6 years of experience solutioning multi-process or multi-country HR BPaaS or BPO opportunities; developing blended United States, nearshore, and offshore delivery models; applying benchmark data to staffing ratios, cost-per-transaction models, productivity assumptions, or operating-model business cases; and evaluating how process complexity, volume, seasonality, language requirements, service coverage, automation, and location affect delivery economics.
  • At least 6 years of experience with HR technology platforms, workflow tools, automation, AI, analytics, or agentic AI solutions, including Deloitte HR BPaaS capabilities such as SimplrOps and Ascend.
  • At least 4 years of experience partnering with delivery leaders to validate transition plans, operating assumptions, and delivery readiness; building reusable solutioning assets, estimation tools, pricing models, or operating-model playbooks; and managing globally distributed delivery teams or governance frameworks for multi-country BPO engagements.
  • 8+ years of management consulting experience with demonstrated success developing business and exceeding sales targets; and experience supporting client workshops, oral proposal presentations, executive-level pursuit discussions, drafting proposals, and presenting operating models to senior client stakeholders.

About this job

Support Deloitte's Global Sales team in guiding pursuit teams through complex deal cycles, from strategy development to RFP response. Responsibilities include facilitating win strategy sessions, coordinating global resources, and managing market campaign activation.

Good fit if you have 8+ years of sales experience, strong presentation coaching skills, and expertise in sales excellence or complex deal management.

Full job description

Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

While this position is posted in the US, we can only accept applications from those performing a Deloitte Global (DTTS) role at this time. 


The Global Sales Team helps Member Firms grow by increasing win rates, driving sales excellence transformation across the firm, and providing seamless connectivity across the Global network. Through its various functions the Global Sales Team provides expert coaching & pursuit support across our most complex and strategic deals, provides sales training and community connectivity, and delivers both competitive market insights and internal analytics to shape member firm go to market strategies.

The Sales Pursuits and Activation Manager, Global Consulting Services is responsible for working with Global Sales Coaches to guide pursuit teams through all aspects of the pursuit lifecycle, from deal shaping, stakeholder interactions, Deloitte differentiation and RFP-response development. The Global Sales Pursuits and Activation Manager brings expertise in sales excellence strategy and disciplines, including Get-to-Green, pursuit differentiation, and creating compelling narratives for our clients.The Global Sales Pursuits and Activation Manager is also responsible for supporting the development and activation of Global Sales market campaigns, aligning emerging market trends with Deloitte-differentiated capabilities to codify heart of the business transformations that can be scaled globally.

Specific Responsibilities:

  • Support the preparation and facilitation of win strategy sessions with pursuit teams to create a unique and differentiated sales approach for the opportunity; ensuring resulting strategies are actioned throughout the pursuit
  • Prepare and facilitate regular pursuit strategy sessions with pursuits teams to deep dive into Get to Green (G2G) factors, and set concrete actions and accountability to move to position of preference.
  • Bring pursuit leading practices, lessons learned and competitor intel, using a mixture of existing collateral, experience and AI support, to help strengthen and differentiate propositions.
  • Assess and understand the global resources required to deliver the highest quality solution and help facilitate these connections across the global Deloitte network. Orchestrate and activate global Deloitte resources (e.g., Global Creative Services, market intelligence, alliance teams) to enhance storytelling and pursuit differentiation.
  • Bring innovative approaches for presentations, pursuit materials, and other pursuit activities to support strategy, messaging, and differentiation.
  • Support presentation/workshop preparation and rehearsal process, driving differentiated messaging and approaches.
  • Provide strong presentation coaching, both to individuals and the broader team, to elevate presentation performance.Manage the development and execution of market campaigns, collaborating industry, sector, offering and/or priority alliance leaders to shape go-to-market strategies, strengthen alliance partnerships, and scale opportunities globally.
  • Leverage sales tools and platforms (e.g., Jupiter, Salesforce, AI-enabled insights) and strong analytical capabilities to assess pipeline performance,  identify trends, and drive data-informed sales and GTM (go-to-market) decisions.
  • Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders across member firms (sales, industry, offering, alliances) to drive alignment and advance strategic pursuits.
  • Support global sales governance rhythms (e.g., pipeline and pursuit reviews), reinforcing consistency and alignment to global priorities.


The team

Deloitte’s Global Consulting Services professionals support our global businesses to drive impact and create enduring value for clients in Strategy, Risk & Transactions (SR&T) and Technology & Transformation (T&T). We deliver purpose-driven services and solutions and provide a consistent, best-in-class "One Deloitte" experience around the world.



Qualifications
  • 8+ Years of Experience
  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Superior oral and written communication skills, ability to adjust communication style based on the audience, exceptional ability to prepare executive-ready materials that "tell-the-story" succinctly and logically, ability to flex the communication and messaging to the audience and context.
  • Strong project management and time management skills, strong attention to detail, ability to work independently under pressure, and manage multiple assignments.
  • Experience in Sales Excellence or working with complex deals.
  • Experience leading and coaching presentations, including leading a structured preparation/rehearsal process and providing effective presentation coaching.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering creative and differentiated concepts to sales/pursuit materials and presentations

Are you passionate about technology and interested in joining a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo?   • Provide technical ownership for the US Attack Surface Management team’s dangling DNS and Infoblox threat-management activities
  • Establish, implement, and operate the new dangling DNS and Infoblox threat-management process and supporting product
  • Drive product adoption and mature operating procedures, workflows, and controls for DNS exposure and threat management, including tuning DNS security policies and configurations, assessing and documenting exception requests, and periodically validating approved exceptions
  • Continuously monitor externally visible assets for dangling DNS exposures and review Infoblox threat events, including validating indicators, assessing risk, escalating confirmed or suspected threats, and coordinating containment and remediation activities

  • Conduct technical investigations to validate findings, assess risk, determine ownership, and identify required remediation actions
  • Coordinate remediation across asset owners, DNS teams, infrastructure teams, and other stakeholders, and track issues through closure
  • Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and performance metrics covering DNS exposures, Infoblox threat events, investigation status, remediation progress, aging, closure trends, and key risk indicators for technical stakeholders and leadership, and support compliance and audit requirements by maintaining process documentation and control evidence, responding to inquiries, tracking identified gaps, and reporting remediation status
  • Escalate significant risks, unresolved findings, ownership gaps, and remediation delays to the appropriate teams and leadership
  • Apply independent judgment to prioritize investigations and remediation based on exposure, threat context, and business risk
  • Collaborate across the US Attack Surface Management team and partner functions to integrate the new operational scope without delaying broader ASM priorities
  • Communicate technical findings, risk implications, and remediation actions clearly to technical stakeholders and leadership

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Cloud Engineer, IT / Technology, Cybersecurity Analyst
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Responsible for ensuring the delivery of the cloud security strategy, and for the architecture and implementation of the cloud cybersecurity systems that carry it out, in partnership with US Infrastructure and US Cybersecurity leadership. Establishes and maintains the capabilities required to secure data and applications operating in dynamic cloud computing environments, provides oversight into and integration of security solutions, and monitors security controls to ensure compliance with firm standards.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/7/2026.

Work you’ll do

This role is a key driver in determining the firm's cloud security strategy and roadmap. The Manager sets direction on cloud controls and best practices for the firm's cloud foundations, evaluates new solutions, and develops the supporting elements required to adopt new technologies in a safe and secure manner, including the controls required by data classification and compliance obligations.

That partnership with US Infrastructure extends into design and delivery of cloud security solutions, focused primarily on public cloud environments with some responsibility for on-premises environments. The role also partners with Deloitte Global on cyber strategy, keeping US cloud security direction aligned with global priorities and standards. The Manager supports cross-functional cloud teams in advancing capabilities across cloud security architecture, engineering and operations, contributes to the cloud security program and governance agenda, and helps develop strategic relationships with key alliance partners.

Responsibilities:

Strategy and partnership

  • Act as a key driver in determining the firm's cloud security strategy, technology standards, roadmaps, and practices under the oversight of US Cybersecurity leadership, and contribute to the overall vision and governance of the cloud security program
  • Partner with US Infrastructure to define requirements and deliver cloud security solutions that meet Deloitte policies, primarily across public cloud environments and secondarily on-premises
  • Partner with Deloitte Global on cyber strategy, aligning US cloud security direction with global standards, initiatives, and priorities
  • Help drive strategic relationships with key alliance partners and technology vendors
  • Evaluate new solutions and develop the supporting elements required to incorporate new technologies safely and securely, based on data classification and compliance requirements
  • Monitor cloud security industry trends, developments, and emerging threats
  • Incorporate business drivers, needs and strategies to address future business and technology needs
  • Communicate the implications of architectural decisions, issues and plans to business and IT leadership

Architecture and engineering

  • Work across cloud teams and business units to define security requirements and design cloud platform solutions
  • Architect and design comprehensive solutions that meet business security requirements in support of a given project or capability
  • Lead cloud security architecture on assigned projects using any Cloud Service Provider (CSP)
  • Ensure the secure design and implementation of SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS technologies that support security initiatives
  • Guide the implementation of new cloud infrastructure methodologies, concepts, and changes to security services in line with business requirements and security guidelines
  • Design or evaluate new tools for improving platform availability using automated protection mechanisms
  • Work closely with development teams on Infrastructure as Code, automation, and orchestration
  • Work in Agile methodology and partner with scrum teams on secure application and infrastructure solution architecture, planning user stories for sprints while addressing requirements and orchestrating security impact
  • Enable shift-left security by embedding automated controls, policy-as-code, and security scanning directly into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows

Controls, operations and governance

  • Manage cloud security processes and supporting tools
  • Validate security controls to ensure adherence with firm security standards
  • Review control designs and validate their implementation to confirm they are effective
  • Collaborate with cloud engineers to address security risks and drive the implementation of controls across the entire cloud platform lifecycle, providing mitigation recommendations
  • Provide operational support and participate in Agile teams focused on business unit success

Leadership and collaboration

  • Oversee the implementation of cloud security capabilities performed by the US Infrastructure team, which does not report into this role, working across multiple technical disciplines, including developers, subject matter experts, database administrators, system administrators, and system architects, to provide technical direction and confirm that delivered solutions conform to the approved architecture, standards, and control requirements
  • Mentor engineers and architects in modern cloud best practices
  • Provide technical guidance and foster a collective understanding of data flows and the security issues encountered in cloud applications and services
  • Develop relationships with product teams by helping them leverage compliance and security to drive value for their products and practices
  • Lead others in the resolution of highly sensitive and confidential issues on behalf of the team
  • Act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders and participate in their decision-making process, including presenting alternatives and information
  • Monitor service standards for the internal teams and business units the role supports
  • Exhibit a high level of professional flexibility, volunteering innovation and new ideas

Work Complexity and Independent Judgment:

  • Work is substantially complex and varied, and regularly requires the selection and application of technical and detailed guidelines
  • Independent judgment is required to identify, select and apply the most appropriate methods, as well as to interpret precedent
  • Supervision typically consists of receiving direction on the more complex projects and on new job duties and priorities

Problem Solving and Decision Making:

  • Regularly makes recommendations to management on areas of significance to a channel or function within the firm
  • Frequently expected to recommend new solutions to problems, improve existing methods, procedures and services, and generate new ideas
  • May review decisions made by other individuals on more routine matters

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 6 years of directly related experience in cloud-based development and security management, including subject matter expertise in the area(s) managed
  • Minimum 1 year of people and/or process management experience
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience at depth with at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Azure including Azure Resource Manager and Azure Commercial offerings, or GCP) across IaaS, PaaS and SaaS environments, with working knowledge of the others
  • Hands-on experience designing both small and large-scale solutions with an emphasis on security and performance
  • Solid understanding of Zero Trust architecture and its practical application, including least-privilege and just-in-time access, identity-centric controls, and continuous verification
  • Background in general security practices such as identity and access management (IAM), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), encryption and key management, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and security information and event management (SIEM)
  • Working DevOps experience, sufficient to design and enable shift-left security controls in CI/CD pipelines, including Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, orchestration, and containerized workloads
  • Knowledge and experience across IT infrastructure with security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, and other relevant security-related regulations
  • Experience deploying web and service-based applications in Windows and Linux environments
  • Understanding of general design principles for web applications, data lakes, and AI/ML capabilities
  • Demonstrated experience developing multi-tier and cross-platform architecture plans, including enterprise workflows and distributed intranet/internet architecture
  • Experience with large-scale enterprise cloud projects from ideation through to finished production product
  • Experience as an Enterprise Security Architect and/or Systems Engineer, designing cloud frameworks or implementing cloud security
  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks Prisma Cloud and/or Cortex
  • Working knowledge of the following capabilities delivered through those platforms: CNAPP – Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform, CSPM – Cloud Security Posture Management, CWPP – Cloud Workload Protection Platform, CIEM – Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management, DSPM – Data Security Posture Management, KSPM – Kubernetes Security Posture Management, ASPM – Application Security Posture Management, IaC security scanning and policy-as-code enforcement in CI/CD, WAAS – Web Application and API Security, CDR – Cloud Detection and Response, XDR – Extended Detection and Response (Cortex XDR), SOAR – Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (Cortex XSOAR), XSIAM – Extended Security Intelligence and Automation Management, ASM – Attack Surface Management (Cortex Xpanse)
  • Experience implementing microsegmentation and Zero Trust network access (ZTNA) at enterprise scale
  • Any of AWS, GCP, Azure or CCSP certification

Job.JobTitle: Client and Business Cyber Services Associate Director - BISO
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Are you passionate about technology and interested in joining a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo? If so, read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity with Deloitte Technology-US (DT-US). We are curious and life-long learners focused on technology and innovation, including how AI is reshaping the way secure software gets built.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/7/2026.

Work you’ll do

The Associate Director, Government & Public Services (GPS) Business Information Security Officer (BISO) is a leadership role within the DT-US Cyber Security function, with a matrixed relationship to Cyber Operations, Security Architecture, Cyber Design, and Technology and Business leaders across the US Member Firm. The role is accountable for leading Cloud Security, Application Security, and AI security for GPS, and for ensuring GPS meets current Federal and Department of Defense (DoD) security and compliance requirements.

The US Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) oversees the strategy and governance of information security, risk management, and information security operations for the entire Deloitte US firm, including GPS, an US$8 billion business line serving Federal, Defense, state, and local clients. As a key member of the DT-US Cyber Security leadership team, the Associate Director serves as a trusted advisor to GPS and executive stakeholders, drives secure software and AI practices across the development lifecycle, and works across the organization to protect critical assets.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure security controls and compliance for cloud and hybrid environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), aligned to FedRAMP (Rev. 5 and FedRAMP 20x), the DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (SRG) and its impact levels, and NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.
  • Work proactively with colleagues across the organization to champion cyber security requirements for cloud, Zero Trust, and vulnerability management.
  • Oversee and operationalize the security objectives of the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), aligned to the NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF, SP 800-218) and secure-by-design principles, including software supply chain security (SBOMs, dependency and provenance controls) and support for federal secure software attestation requirements.
  • Integrate AI across every phase of the SSDLC (requirements, design and threat modeling, build, test, release, and operations), governing both AI-assisted development (code assistants and agentic tools) and AI-enabled solutions in line with NIST SP 800-218A, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0) and Generative AI Profile, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
  • Establish AI security practices including model and data provenance, prompt injection and adversarial testing (AI red teaming), AI bill of materials, human oversight, and continuous monitoring of AI systems.
  • Drive GPS readiness and evidence for Federal and DoD client requirements, including the Risk Management Framework (NIST SP 800-37 and DoDI 8510.01), NIST SP 800-171, DFARS 252.204-7012, the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) program (32 CFR Part 170 and DFARS 252.204-7021), DISA STIG hardening, and CUI protection.
  • Protect critical assets and align and prioritize cyber security investments using a risk-based approach consistent with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0.
  • Develop plans to enforce established cyber security standards, minimize vulnerabilities, and strengthen the business information technology posture, including continuous monitoring and remediation.
  • Develop cyber security and AI risk metrics that report exact status, inform leadership, and drive remediation plans.
  • Partner with delivery, legal, procurement, and client teams to manage contractual flow-down and compliance obligations and engage vendors and cloud providers on security and AI readiness.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of security professionals while building cloud, application, and AI security competency across the organization through training, reference architectures, and playbooks.

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Technology-US helps power Deloitte’s success. Deloitte Technology-US drives Deloitte, which serves many of the world’s largest, most respected organizations. DT-US develops and deploys cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The ~3,000 professionals in DT-US deliver services including:

  • Cyber Security
  • Technology Support
  • Technology & Infrastructure
  • Applications
  • Relationship Management
  • Strategy & Communications
  • Project Management
  • Strategic Financial Management

Cyber Security

Cyber Security vigilantly protects Deloitte and client data. The team leads a strategic cyber risk program that adapts to a rapidly changing threat landscape, including AI-enabled threats, and to changes in business strategies, risks, and vulnerabilities. Using situational awareness and threat intelligence, and building a security culture across the organization, with integration into the global cyber security capabilities that help protect the Deloitte brand.

Areas of focus include:

  • Risk & Compliance
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Data Protection
  • Cyber Design
  • Incident Response
  • Security Architecture
  • AI Security & Governance
  • Business Partnership

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Engineering.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in cybersecurity and/or risk management, including
  • Minimum 4 years supporting highly regulated environments (e.g., federal, defense, audit and financial services, or critical infrastructure).
  • Demonstrated experience driving security and compliance for cloud, including FedRAMP and DoD Cloud Computing SRG authorizations.
  • Minimum 2 years of people and/or process management experience
  • Must be able to obtain US Government security clearance or public trust determination, as required.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Demonstrated ability to drive organizational changes in cyber security for the application development lifecycle, including integrating security and AI governance into the SSDLC and DevSecOps pipelines.
  • Working knowledge of secure AI and machine learning practices, including AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, data poisoning, and model supply chain risk.
  • Working knowledge of OWASP, application security, software supply chain security (SBOM, SLSA), and vulnerability remediation processes.
  • Deep knowledge of standards and guidance, including:
  • NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, SP 800-171, SP 800-37 (RMF), SP 800-218 (SSDF), SP 800-218A, NIST CSF 2.0, and NIST AI RMF 1.0
  • FedRAMP (Rev. 5 and 20x), DoD Cloud Computing SRG, DoDI 8510.01, DISA STIGs, DFARS 252.204-7012, and CMMC
  • ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 42001, Cloud Security Alliance Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM), and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
  • Understanding of and ability to apply trends in global security and risk management, including Zero Trust architecture and the evolving Federal and DoD regulatory landscape.
  • Ability to frame and communicate security and risk-related concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences at various levels, and to influence senior stakeholders in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CSSLP, CISA, GIAC, or equivalent experience strongly preferred; DoD 8140 qualification a plus.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $130,900 to $268,700.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $128,000 to $252,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Senior Consultant supporting Market Access, pricing, and reimbursement engagements for Life Sciences clients at Deloitte's Miami office. You'll work on client strategy across payer dynamics, value communication, and evidence generation while building consulting expertise.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in market access, healthcare strategy, or Life Sciences consulting, with demonstrated experience on pricing and reimbursement projects for pharma or biotech clients.

Full job description

Position Summary

Throughout the health ecosystem, you’ll find courageous and inspiring people who are committed to driving transformation, advancing health equity, and leading a well-being revolution. Where you find innovators committed to sustainable progress, you’ll find Deloitte’s Life Sciences & Health Care practice. Our leaders work side-by-side to orchestrate and deliver on the business of science and health. We bring trusted, flexible approaches that help foster innovation, harness new technologies, and formulate consumer-driven strategies to engineer a digitally enabled, equitable future of health – starting today.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 4th, 2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, Life Science Market Access on the Deloitte Life Sciences & Health Care practice team, you will support the delivery of Market Access, pricing, and reimbursement engagements for Life Sciences clients while continuing to build your consulting and domain skillset.

  • Support Market Access workstreams spanning pricing, reimbursement, payer strategy, value communication, and evidence generation.
  • Work with client access strategy, medical, and commercial leaders to help address market access priorities and contribute to actionable recommendations.
  • Translate business questions into structured analyses, synthesized insights, and client-ready deliverables.
  • Contribute to day-to-day client delivery, including working sessions, timelines, risks, dependencies, and communications.
  • Participate in practice initiatives, professional development, and the use of analytics and artificial intelligence-enabled tools to improve delivery quality and efficiency.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Demonstrated learning agility and openness to feedback and coaching
  • Demonstrated interest in continuing to build consulting, market access, and Life Sciences knowledge
  • Experience preparing client-ready deliverables for internal or external stakeholders

The team

An evolving customer and regulatory landscape, mounting pipeline of next-gen assets and portfolio pressures, and intensifying competition are presenting new organizational and operational hurdles for Life Sciences companies. These complex market dynamics are requiring new levels of rigor and insight in business strategy development and problem-solving, both domestically and globally.

We are looking for practitioners who will work alongside Life Sciences organizations from bio-technology firms to global big pharma to medical devices, to drive business value through end-to-end delivery of solutions based on strategy development for heart of business issues.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in Market Access, pricing, reimbursement, Life Sciences, healthcare, or strategy consulting
  • 5+ of experience supporting projects or analyses related to Market Access, payer strategy, reimbursement, healthcare strategy, or Life Sciences commercial topics
  • 5+ Experience serving pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other Life Sciences clients through project support, analysis, or engagement delivery is preferred
  • Ability to travel 30%+, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to artificial intelligence tools in day-to-day workflow
  • 2+ years evaluating healthcare value chain economics and stakeholder incentives
  • Foundational understanding of the US Life Sciences ecosystem, including payer dynamics, reimbursement pathways, access challenges, and evidence requirements
  • Experience supporting workstreams in pricing, reimbursement, payer strategy, value communication, or evidence generation
  • Experience participating in client working sessions and presenting analyses or recommendations to stakeholders
  • Experience using analytics tools to support business insights and recommendations
  • Experience collaborating with technical teams to translate business requirements into analytical or technology-enabled solutions

  • Supporting practice growth through proposals, solution shaping, workplans, follow-on opportunities, and thought leadership.
  • Leading, coaching, and developing teams while fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture.

  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and manage complex, multi stakeholder engagements.

The team

Required

Job ID 374105

Quick facts

  • Pay: $88,600 to $147,600 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 6+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Solutions Manager for Deloitte's Third Party Risk Management Program in Jacksonville. Lead scoping, design, and implementation of TPRM system enhancements, manage projects end to end, and drive data-driven process improvements across the firm.

Good fit if you have 6+ years in professional services with experience in third-party due diligence, risk management, or process management, plus proven project leadership.

Full job description

Position Summary

Do you drive tech-enabled process improvements, collaborate with stakeholders on improvement requirements, keep projects and tasks moving, and drive crisp decisions and follow-through—turning priorities into measurable progress? Can you juggle competing priorities and still translate them into a clear action plan—fast? Are you tech-savvy and innovation-minded—able to spot opportunities to streamline work, improve visibility, and modernize how teams operate using tools and automation? If so, the Specialist Manager role supporting the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) Program might be for you.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/11/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Solutions Manager on the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) Program team, you will be responsible for…

  • Lead the scoping, design, and implementation of TPRM system and program enhancements that address risk-domain and business requirements.
  • Support TPRM initiatives end to end, including project planning, requirements development, process implementation, testing, and adoption.
  • Translate end-user needs and complex technical concepts into practical system and process solutions tailored to varied audiences.
  • Identify and lead data-driven process improvements that streamline workflows, strengthen governance and operational effectiveness, and deliver measurable results.
  • Evaluate and apply AI and other digital tools to improve team processes, efficiency, consistency, and work quality, while validating outputs and protecting sensitive information.
  • Support the TPRM program roadmap, strategy, governance, risk oversight, and risk-sensing capabilities; strengthen visibility and coordination across the program.
  • Build and apply comprehensive knowledge of Deloitte U.S. third-party due diligence policies, processes, risk-scoring methods, business rules, and TPRM Gateway capabilities, including relevant risk domains.
  • Coordinate across relationship management, business analysis, project management, user acceptance testing, and system configuration activities to advance program priorities.
  • Respond to escalated inquiries and represent the TPRM team with client service teams, partners, internal stakeholders, and external third parties.
  • Develop polished briefings, presentations, talking points, agendas, leadership readouts, and written updates; use data and digital tools to support clear, accurate communication.
  • Analyze and validate data, identify issues and trends, and recommend practical solutions using sound judgment, attention to detail, and appropriate quality reviews.
  • Build stakeholder alignment, influence decisions, and drive accountability without direct authority; support colleagues’ development and reinforce a collaborative, compliance-focused environment.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

The TPRM Team oversees the Deloitte U.S. Firms’ internal third-party risk management program, operating within Risk & Brand Protection (R&BP). The team designs the processes and technologies (including the TPRM Gateway) to evaluate and monitor risk exposure, providing firm leadership with transparency into the third-party ecosystem, risk exposure (e.g., conflicts, independence, trade, cybersecurity), and risk decisions.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience working for a professional services organization providing one or more of the following: regulatory and compliance, audit, consulting, financial advisory, enterprise risk management, technology development or other related services.
  • Substantive direct experience in one or more of the following: third party due diligence, ethics and compliance programs, risk and controls, process management or change management; and substantive direct experience managing a team.
  • Experience leading project(s) from initiation through delivery, coordinating stakeholders, managing milestones, and driving the work to successful completion.
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business, MIS (Management Info Systems), or related field
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience using or deploying artificial intelligence tools in business or risk-management workflows
  • Experience with a global professional services firm

Requisition code: 374061
Job ID 374061

Position Summary

The Team

Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) Team

The I&DT team exists to build what Deloitte's next decade demands. We don't optimize the past. We place deliberate bets on the technologies and markets that will define the future of industry, and we build the platforms, products, and commercial engines to win there. IntelligentOps is one of those bets: a decision intelligence product purpose-built for the complexity of large-scale operations, and a cornerstone of how Deloitte delivers durable, scaled value to operations-intensive clients.

The core focus of this role is IntelligentOps, Deloitte's decision intelligence and execution product for supply chain and manufacturing operations. IntelligentOps connects data, existing enterprise systems (ERP, MES, PLM, OT), and AI agents on a unified common core, enabling operations leaders to move faster, act with greater precision, and scale operational outcomes without adding systems or complexity.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026. 

Work you’ll do

The Lead Architect owns the technical vision for IntelligentOps solutions and is accountable for architectures that scale across clients, solutions, and industries. IntelligentOps solutions are made up of modules, which call on engines, the pre-built agentic actions that do the underlying work. All of it connects to client systems and builds on shared foundations. You will guide how these pieces fit together and how they are built, reused, and delivered to clients, with a focus on moving forward the solutions we sell and deliver.

Technical Direction

  • Set the technical direction and multi-year architecture roadmap for IntelligentOps solutions, modules, and engines, and for how they build on shared foundations.
  • Translate product and client requirements into a scalable technical architecture that holds up across multiple solutions, modules, and client environments.
  • Make and document key architecture decisions, including technology selection, build versus buy, and integration approach, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to leadership.

Patterns, Standards, and Guardrails

  • Define reusable architectural patterns, reference architectures, and engineering guardrails that help teams build new modules and engines faster and more consistently.
  • Set standards for scalability, performance, security and access control, data modeling, reliability, operability, and observability, including how IntelligentOps integrates with client ERP, MES, PLM, QMS, and OT/IoT systems and with AI agents.
  • Work with Product, Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), and leadership to make sure implementations adhere to the architecture, and resolve exceptions and gaps.
  • Design engines as reusable, standardized capabilities that modules can call on, so a capability is built once and reused across modules, solutions, and clients.
  • Define the architecture for AI agent orchestration and agent-to-agent interoperability, including model validation, governance, and human oversight controls.
  • Set the approach for automated deployment and release of solutions, modules, and engines into client environments across cloud providers.
  • Build resiliency, high availability, and scalability patterns, such as failover and graceful degradation, into reference architectures so reliability is designed in rather than added after incidents.

Innovation and Proofs of Concept

  • Identify, scope, execute, and document proofs of concept that test new technologies and approaches, building reference implementations hands-on.
  • Decide which proofs of concept graduate into the product, and partner with Engineering to turn them into production-ready patterns.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of architects and engineers, raising the bar on technical quality and on how efficiently the team builds and ships.
  • Capture implementation lessons from FDEs and client engagements and feed them back into the architecture and the product roadmap.

The successful candidate possesses these skills:

  • Ability to set technical direction and bring engineers, product leaders, and executives along with it, including when you do not have formal authority.
  • Pragmatic judgment with a bias toward simple designs that scale.
  • Clear communication that explains complex technical tradeoffs to both engineering and executive audiences.
  • Ability to build credibility with engineers by building and coding, not only by designing.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree.
  • 10+ years of experience designing and building enterprise software at scale and serving as an architect or technical lead long enough to have lived with the consequences of your own decisions.
  • 3+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing other architects and engineers, and raising the bar for the whole team.
  • 5+ years of experience architecting cloud-native systems on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including containerized deployment (Kubernetes), infrastructure as code, and CI/CD automation.
  • 2+ years of experience using or evaluating agentic systems in production, including harness design, tool-use interfaces, sandboxed execution, and evaluation approaches that test against real execution.
  • 2+ years of experience using agentic coding tools daily on real production work; having a considered view of where they help, where they fail, and how to verify what they produce.
  • Hands-on proficiency writing code, building proofs of concept or reference implementations, and earning credibility with engineer by showing the work.
  • Demonstrated experience defining when to standardize and when to leave room for speed, and being able to explain that tradeoff to both engineers and executives.
  • Experience establishing set patterns or standards that multiple teams adopt without being forced to, including security, access control, and integration with enterprise systems.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Experience with agent interoperability standards, such as Agent2Agent (A2A), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and with event-driven architecture patterns.
  • Experience designing ontologies, knowledge graphs, or semantic data models for enterprise or operational data.
  • Experience integrating with ERP (SAP, Oracle), MES, PLM, or OT/IoT systems in manufacturing or supply chain environments.
  • Cloud architect certification, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.

A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200-$278,300.

Job.JobTitle: Audit and Assurance - Information Technology Auditor - Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Lead information technology audit and assurance engagements for Deloitte's Audit & Assurance practice in Jacksonville. Manage IT general control audits, third-party assurance reports like SOC engagements, and mentor junior team members while assessing technology risks across complex organizations.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in professional services or IT audit, experience with IT general controls and frameworks like SOC or Sarbanes-Oxley, and can travel up to 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Deloitte’s Audit & Assurance practice helps organizations address information technology risk, strengthen controls, and increase confidence in financial reporting. As an Information Technology Auditor - Manager, you will lead audit and assurance engagements that assess technology environments, support reporting and regulatory requirements, and help clients navigate operational, cyber, and third-party risks. You will work with complex organizations across industries, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and deliver insights that help clients improve control effectiveness and business resilience. This role also offers the opportunity to lead teams, develop talent, and contribute to high-impact client service in a dynamic environment.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/03/2027.

Work you’ll do

As an Information Technology Auditor - Manager on the Audit & Assurance team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading information technology general control audits and testing controls across applications, operating systems, and databases
  • Managing third-party assurance engagements, including System and Organization Controls (SOC) 1, SOC 2, and SOC 3 reports
  • Advising on internal control assessments, digital control design, implementation, and operating effectiveness
  • Evaluating risks associated with system implementations, cloud environments, and cyber security controls
  • Planning engagements, overseeing day-to-day execution, reviewing workpapers and deliverables, and coaching junior team members

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team 
Our team culture is collaborative and encourages team members to take initiative and seek on-the-job learning opportunities. Audit & Assurance services are focused on engagements related to independent External Audit services, Accounting, Controls & Reporting Advisory, and Specialized Assurance & Sustainability. We bring together the diverse skills and industry experience of our people, leading-edge technology, and a global network to deliver high-quality audits of financial statements and internal controls over financial reporting, along with assurance reports and valuable advice and insights across the corporate reporting landscape. Learn more about Audit & Assurance

Qualifications
Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems Administration, Finance, or Internal Audit
  • 5+ years of experience in professional services, external audit, or information technology audit
  • Experience auditing information technology general controls and testing controls for applications, operating systems, and databases
  • Experience with logical security, change management, computer operations, internal control environments, and Sarbanes-Oxley and/or Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) frameworks
  • Experience planning and scoping engagements, developing and executing test plans, reviewing workpapers and deliverables, and leading teams
  • You should reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 3 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the type of work you perform and the clients served
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • At least one of the following certifications: Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Chartered Accountant (CA), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), Certified Defense Financial Manager (CDFM), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Computer Hacking Forensic Investigator (CHFI), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), or Certification in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA)
  • Experience with SAP, NetSuite, PeopleSoft, or Oracle controls
  • Experience with third-party assurance reports, including System and Organization Controls (SOC) 1, SOC 2, or SOC 3
  • Experience with system implementations, cloud audits, or cyber security audits
  • Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or management consulting firm

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $100,350k to $201,500k.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Position Summary

About Us

The AI Transformation Team, part of the Applied AI Strategic Growth Market (AAI SGM), is dedicated to accelerating the adoption and delivery of agentic AI solutions within Deloitte. We work at the intersection of business and technology, rapidly evaluating, prototyping, and scaling AI-powered solutions that drive measurable value.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/04/2026.

Role Description:

The Applied AI SGM AI Transformation Team is seeking a Applied AI Software Engineer III to join our intake solutioning team for top-prioritized agentic AI solutions in our Enterprise Solutions.

You will support the end-to-end process for agentic AI solutions: use case intake, solution feasibility assessment, solution design, requirements gathering, technology and tooling selection, and initial prototyping. You will also serve as the link between business stakeholders and technical development teams, ensuring clear handoffs and robust solution foundations. This role requires a blend of traditional software engineering skills, cloud solution architecture experience, and hands-on expertise with generative AI models and agentic frameworks.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • 5+ years of applicable experience
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Python and Git, grounded in core software engineering practice including modular design, API design, testing, code review, and CI/CD.
  • Cloud Solution Architecture: Experience designing and deploying solutions on Azure, GCP, or AWS, including the security, integration, and cost considerations that shape design.
  • Design Trade-offs and Technical Judgment: Ability to translate business objectives into technical options, and to explain the effort, risk, and value of each in terms stakeholders can act on, driving decisions on scope, sequencing, and architecture.
  • Generative AI APIs: Hands-on experience integrating and orchestrating solutions using APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar providers.
  • AI Tool Experience: Hands-on experience with AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, ideally including code generation work with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.
  • Agentic Frameworks: Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Vertex AI Agent Development Kit, or OpenAI Agents SDK.
  • Solution Evaluation: Ability to assess build vs. buy decisions, evaluate risk, data requirements, ROI, and timelines.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration and Design Trade-offs: Experience working with business and technical stakeholders to prioritize and align solution opportunities, translating business objectives into technical options and explaining the effort, risk, and value of each in terms stakeholders can act on.
  • Project and Team Leadership: Experience scoping and sequencing delivery work, managing timelines across concurrent intakes, coordinating handoffs with development teams, and mentoring less experienced engineers.
  • Responsible AI and Risk: Familiarity with data privacy, confidentiality, and auditability requirements for enterprise AI, human-in-the-loop design, and agent-specific risks such as prompt injection and tool permission scope.
  • Agent Interoperability (preferred): Exposure to emerging standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) for connecting agents to enterprise tools, data sources, and other agents.
  • Full Solution Lifecycle (preferred): Experience taking solutions from intake through prototyping to deployment and adoption.
  • Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $102,500 to $210,600.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Salesforce Life Sciences Technical Lead
