Job.JobTitle: Cyber SAP Internal Controls Senior Consultant/ Senior Engineering Management Specialist
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $105,400 to $207,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 3+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Consultant role on Deloitte's Cyber Enterprise Security team supporting SAP risk management, internal controls, and compliance. You will design and test business process and IT controls, lead stakeholder workshops, and help organizations manage regulatory requirements across SAP ERP environments.

Good fit if you have 3+ years designing internal controls in SAP ERP, 2+ years with SOX or comparable regulatory requirements, and can travel 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Cyber SAP Internal Controls Senior Consultant/ Senior Engineering Management Specialist

Join Deloitte’s Cyber Enterprise Security team and help clients strengthen SAP risk management, internal controls, governance, and compliance across enterprise transformation, ERP and cloud modernization, and implementations. The Senior Consultant will support business process and IT general controls strategy, design, testing, and deployment across SAP ERP environments. This role helps organizations manage risk and enable business operations by addressing controls and regulatory compliance requirements across SAP ERP platforms, integrations, and transformation programs.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Enterprise Security team, you will:

  • Identify risks within the client’s business processes and technical environment, and impacts to the client’s current state risk and controls framework, based on the scope of the transformation / implementation project
  • Work with business/functional and technical teams to understand SAP configurations and custom development, and translate risks into control requirements
  • Design automated and manual business process controls and IT general controls to manage the risks identified
  • Design and develop controls for AI-enabled business processes and help shape AI governance programs
  • Lead workshops with client stakeholders to align on risks and control design
  • Analyze segregation of duties risks and critical/sensitive functions and define mitigating controls as necessary
  • Coordinate testing of the designed controls and review testing evidence to validate the control design effectiveness
  • Apply clients’ regulatory environment (e.g., Sarbanes Oxley (SOX)) to controls design and testing
  • Transition and conduct knowledge transfer to control owners and relevant stakeholders
  • Facilitate discussions with internal audit and compliance stakeholders as needed
  • Collaborate with client stakeholders, business/functional teams, and technical teams on controls governance and deployment readiness
  • Develop deliverables and work products, such as risk and control matrices, control test procedures, control job aids, control impact assessments, or other controls documentation

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead workstreams and train/develop junior team members
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Enterprise Security Offering helps organizations embed security across digital transformation initiatives by securing the technical backbone of the business while enabling change. The team supports capabilities across security architecture, secure development and deployment, cyber, cloud and application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, information systems, business, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience designing and implementing internal controls (automated, manual controls) in an SAP ERP environment
  • 2+ years of experience with key business processes (e.g., record to report, procure to pay, order to cash, etc.) and their inherent risks and controls
  • Experience evaluating SAP ERP configuration and translating business requirements into automated control designs; able to explain the configuration and control logic for at least 2 control examples.
  • Experience assessing risks and controls in at least 2 IT general control domains, such as access management, change management, or IT operations.
  • 2+ years of experience with segregation of duties frameworks and mitigating controls
  • 2+ years’ experience applying SOX or comparable regulatory requirements to SAP ERP controls, including supporting control documentation, testing, or remediation
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the clients and industries/sectors you serve 
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

  • Experience with SAP ERP implementations or transformations
  • Experience with automated solutions for continuous control monitoring, access management, cloud governance, etc. (e.g., SAP Process Control, SAP Identity Access Governance)
  • Experience with controls for SAP ERP Cloud applications (e.g., SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, Business Technology Platform, etc.)
  • Experience with pre-go live control testing, audit support, or compliance programs
  • Professional certifications such as CPA, CISA, CIA, CRISC, or SAP certifications
  • Experience working in consulting or professional services environments

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Human Capital team helps organizations create value through people performance. We work with clients to reimagine work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise and to transform their HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today’s world, you will help clients answer questions like: How do I access, develop, and motivate my workforce? What should my AI strategy be for the HR function? Do I have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to make work better for humans and humans better at work.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 18th, 2026

Work You’ll Do

As a Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation on our team, you will:

  • Lead the design, solutioning, and configuration of Workday HCM Time Tracking & Absence modules
  • Drive end-to-end implementation activities including requirements gathering, system configuration, testing, and deployment
  • Conduct and facilitate client meetings to guide decision-making and drive project milestones
  • Provide subject matter expertise on Workday HCM Time Tracking & Absence best practices, enhancements, and optimization opportunities
  • Mentor junior team members and oversee the quality of Workday deliverables
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for client stakeholders, building strong relationships based on credibility and technical acumen
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines

The Team

Job.JobTitle: US Tax Manager, Deloitte Global Finance
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Tampa, FL
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Review U.S. federal, state, and local tax returns including Forms 1065 and 1120-F, income tax provisions, and related calculations. Provide leadership to analysts and collaborate with Global Finance professionals on tax research and planning initiatives.

Good fit if you have 7+ years of U.S. tax experience with partnership or corporate returns, hold a CPA license, and know GoSystem Tax RS.

Full job description

Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

U.S. Tax Responsibilities

Support Global Tax

  • Review U.S federal operating partnership income tax returns (Form 1065), including Schedules K-1, K-2, and K-3, as applicable, and related supporting schedules.
  • Review U.S. income tax returns for foreign corporations (Form 1120-F), including supporting income allocation calculations and workpapers.
  • Review applicable state and local returns, including operating partnership and corporate income tax filings, apportionments, and related tax adjustments.
  • Review the annual income tax provision and related tax calculations including current and deferred tax calculations, effective tax rate reconciliations, journal entries.
  • Participate in tax research, documentation, and planning while working side by side with Global Finance and various Global Business professionals.

Tax Team Collaboration and Leadership

  • Promote effective collaboration and contribute successfully in a team environment.
  • Share knowledge, lessons learned, and leading practices across the broader team.
  • Provide day-to-day leadership, support, and informal coaching to analysts and senior-level professionals.
  • Collaborate effectively with U.S. counterparts and management-level stakeholders.


The team

Global Finance provides the most cutting-edge and insightful research and analysis of the financial health of the entire Deloitte organization around the world. We advise, guide, and monitor global initiatives in five major areas: tax, member-firm reporting, finance and accounting, strategic projects, and financial analysis.



Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of U.S. tax experience involving operating partnership income tax returns (Form 1065) and/or corporate income tax returns (Form 1120) gained in an accounting or consulting firm or in an in-house tax function.
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, taxation, or a related business discipline.
  • U.S. Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license.
  • Experience preparing tax returns using GoSystem Tax RS.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook, including advanced Excel capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet demanding deadlines.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with U.S. operating partnership and corporate taxation, book-to-tax adjustments, financial statements, and income tax provision calculations under U.S. GAAP or IFRS.
  • Interest in contributing to tax provision, planning, research, and broader finance initiatives in addition to tax compliance.
  • Willingness to learn tax compliance requirements in the foreign jurisdictions where Deloitte Global has reporting obligations.



Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

As a Project Integrated Eligibility Senior Consultant on the GPS HST Technology team, you will be responsible for:

  • Support analysis and documentation of eligibility policies, business rules, and operational processes for public sector health and human services programs, including Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, and related benefit programs. 
  • Collaborate with eligibility workers, policy staff, and program stakeholders to translate legislation, policy guidance, and operational requirements into system requirements and business processes. 
  • Support eligibility determination design, case management workflows, notices, enrollment processes, interfaces, and program operations within integrated eligibility environments. 
  • Assist with development and execution of user acceptance testing (UAT), scenario-based testing, and validation of eligibility outcomes against policy requirements. 
  • Analyze defects, operational issues, and enhancement requests to identify business impacts and support resolution planning.

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

  • Current state public assistance system experience that supports eligibility and benefits determination and case management
  • Experience supporting State client(s) in one or more of the following areas: eligibility determination, benefits calculation, benefits issuance, and/or information management
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Ability to travel 0 - 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred:

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 8+ years

About this job

Lead ServiceNow HRSD implementations and expansions for Fortune 500 clients at Deloitte's Human Capital practice. Manage concurrent engagements, serve as senior advisor on AI-powered employee experience solutions, and build trusted relationships with director and VP-level stakeholders.

Good fit if you have 8+ years implementing enterprise platforms like ServiceNow or Workday, 2+ years delivering ServiceNow HRSD, and experience managing director-level client relationships.

Full job description

Position Summary

Senior Manager, ServiceNow HRSD Program and Solution Management

Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/04/2027

Work you'll do

Deloitte is at the center of how Fortune 500 organizations are deploying and expanding HRSD, agentic AI and generative AI-powered employee experiences at scale. As a Senior Manager, you will take on broader ownership across the ServiceNow portfolio - leading engagement teams, shaping account strategy, and serving as a senior client advisor on how HRSD, conversational AI, large language models (LLMs), and intelligent automation can transform HR and IT service delivery across new implementations, use case expansions, and platform optimization efforts.

You will be responsible for:

  • Leading concurrent ServiceNow HRSD engagements, including new implementations, use-case expansions, and optimization efforts; manage scope, budgets, staffing, timelines, risks, and delivery quality.
  • Serving as the primary client relationship lead across account and program teams, building trusted-advisor relationships with senior HR, IT, and Information Security stakeholders, including director- and VP-level sponsors.
  • Leading the design and integration of ServiceNow HRSD and AI Assistant solutions, including conversational AI, agentic workflows, enterprise search, and large language model (LLM)-powered knowledge retrieval, across ServiceNow, Workday, and other human resources information system (HRIS) and information technology service management (ITSM) platforms.
  • Advising clients on responsible adoption of generative and agentic AI, including governance, data security, change management, and employee trust alongside technical configuration; identify and mitigate project risks, staffing gaps, and scope changes with senior leadership.
  • Develop and mentor engagement teams; establish delivery standards and quality checkpoints; and drive account and practice growth through value propositions, business cases, proposals, scoping, pricing, client presentations, go-to-market activities, and thought leadership.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our HR Strategy & Technology Offering is dedicated to developing leading global HR strategies and implementing cutting-edge HR technologies. We drive transformation and maximize the workforce experience, ensuring sustained HR effectiveness and value. In a world of disruption, our solutions empower organizations to navigate challenges seamlessly, enhancing their HR capabilities and fostering a resilient workforce.

Our ServiceNow HRSD Team is at the forefront of delivering value-based HRSD solutions and applying generative AI and agentic AI to the employee experience, helping clients transform their HR and IT service delivery practices. We drive significant cost savings, increased efficiency, a stronger competitive advantage, and improved employee experience through intelligent automation, conversational AI, and agentic AI capabilities.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of enterprise platform implementation experience, including ServiceNow, Workday, or another HRIS.
  • 2+ years of experience delivering and implementing ServiceNow HRSD.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL

About this job

Design conversational AI systems and omnichannel experiences for enterprise clients, including LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and agentic task flows. Lead client workshops and create conversation design specifications, prototypes, and evaluation frameworks.

Good fit if you have 6+ years in conversation design or CX architecture, 2+ years with enterprise AI products, and hands-on experience with LLM frameworks and agentic patterns.

Full job description

Position Summary

AI Conversation Design Senior Consultant

Our Deloitte Sales & Service team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce

Recruiting for this role ends on December 31, 2026.


Work you'll do

As an AI Conversation Design Senior Consultant, you will: 

  • Architect multi-turn, multi-agent LLM systems, including orchestration, tool-use patterns, handoffs, and agentic task flows.
  • Design omnichannel conversational experiences across voice, chat, messaging, copilots, and in-app agents; define intent models, RAG strategies, personas, prompts, guardrails, and escalation protocols.
  • Create conversation design specifications, flow diagrams, and annotated dialogue samples; rapidly prototype agentic experiences and deliver client-facing POCs and demos.
  • Define evaluation frameworks and test suites for LLM-powered experiences; partner with AI engineers on red-teaming, feedback loops, and post-launch improvements.
  • Lead client workshops and design sprints; translate AI capabilities into business-aligned experience narratives and collaborate with technical teams to deliver feasible solutions. Contribute to proposals, thought leadership, and the development of Deloitte’s conversational AI capabilities.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  •   Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  •   Effective written and verbal communication skills
  •   Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  •   Ability to build and sustain professional relationship
  •   Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  •   Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  •   Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  •   Ability to meet deadlines
  •   Ability to provide clear guidance to others


The team

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.


Qualifications

Required

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in conversation design, UX, CX architecture, or digital experience transformation.
  • 2+ years designing conversational experiences for enterprise AI products or contact center deployments.
  • At least one production or pilot project involving an LLM-powered assistant, with hands-on responsibility for prompt or system-instruction design, conversation flows, or RAG-enabled experiences.
  • Demonstrated experience designing at least two agentic patterns, such as tool use/function calling, agent orchestration, memory, multi-step task flows, or human handoffs.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise conversational platform or LLM framework, such as Amazon Connect, Genesys, NICE, Salesforce, LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, or Google Vertex AI.
  • Experience creating conversational design artifacts using at least one tool such as Figma, Miro, Lucidchart, or Voiceflow.
  • Experience applying responsible AI considerations—such as safety guardrails, fallback behavior, or escalation paths—to a deployed or pilot LLM experience.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent number of years of experience.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.


Preferred

  • Experience designing copilots, agent-assist, or employee productivity experiences.
  • Experience with Salesforce Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or ServiceNow Now Assist.
  • Experience using contact center KPIs—such as CSAT, containment, average handle time, or first-contact resolution—to assess or improve conversational experiences.
  • Experience with multimodal AI or designing for regulated-industry requirements.
  • Consulting experience supporting client workshops, executive presentations, proposals, or agile delivery.
  • Advanced degree in a relevant discipline.

Job.JobTitle: Delivery Consultant, AI and Analytics Solutions
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work You’ll Do

As a Delivery Consultant, AI and Analytics Solutions on the team, you will:

  • Working across client and delivery teams to design and build model-driven apps using Dataverse, including forms, views, business rules, commands, and dashboards
  • Translating business requirements into data models, solution components, and user experiences aligned to standards and reuse
  • Configuring and extending Dataverse (tables, relationships, column types, validation, calculated/rollup columns) and implementing security (roles, teams, business units, field security)
  • Designing process automation using Power Automate (cloud flows and Desktop), including approvals, integrations, notifications, and exception handling
  • Integrating Power Platform solutions with Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Azure services, and external systems via connectors, APIs, and custom integration patterns
  • Establishing and promoting development standards: solution layering, environment strategy, naming conventions, ALM, and deployment pipelines
  • Supporting testing and quality practices: unit/system testing, defect triage, performance tuning, and release readiness
  • Participating in design and code reviews (including Power Fx, JavaScript where applicable, and plugin/workflow approaches), ensuring maintainability and security
  • Partnering with stakeholders to identify modernization opportunities and roadmap enhancements (e.g., legacy app replacement, workflow digitization, case management)
  • Creating and maintaining documentation: solution design, data model, security model, and operational runbooks
  • Contributing to knowledge-sharing—reusable components, patterns, accelerators, and internal community of practice assets

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • 4+ years of experience delivering enterprise applications (low-code and/or traditional) with strong business-to-technical translation skills
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building Power Apps, with 1+ years focused on model-driven apps
  • 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Dataverse data modeling and security design
  • 3+ years of experience with Power Automate (cloud flows), including error handling and integration scenarios
  • 1+ years experience designing solutions to address client requirements, including data, security, and non-functional requirements (performance, auditability, supportability)
  • 1+ years experience working in an Agile delivery environment (backlog, user stories, sprint ceremonies)
  • 1+ years experience understanding of ALM concepts for Power Platform (solutions, managed/unmanaged, environment promotion, deployment practices)
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg) 
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance

Preferred: 

  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., Power Platform App Maker, Power Platform Developer, Power Platform Functional Consultant)
  • Experience with Power Platform extensibility: PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, plugins, or integration middleware
  • Experience with Dynamics 365 implementations (Customer Service, Sales, Field Service, etc.) and common patterns for model-driven apps
  • Familiarity with governance and operating models (CoE setup, environment strategy, DLP (data loss prevention) policies, telemetry/monitoring)
  • Experience with accessibility, UX patterns for model-driven apps, and adoption practices (training, change enablement)
  • Prior Government & Public Services consulting and/or professional services experience
  • Experience with RPA tools like UiPath, Blue Prism or Automation Anywhere.
  • Proven expertise in designing and deploying AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, including conversational flow design, Power Automate integration, and custom connector development

About this job

Lead end-to-end ServiceNow delivery for enterprise clients, managing scope, quality, and team performance. Oversee implementation and operations across ITSM, ITOM/CMDB, and AI solutions while managing a team of ServiceNow professionals.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in technology delivery with 5+ years on ServiceNow, 3+ years leading delivery and managing teams, and ServiceNow CSA certification.

Full job description

Position Summary

Deloitte’s Enterprise Operations as a Service (EOaaS) practice helps organizations transform critical business operations through a combination of operational excellence, technology enablement, and managed services. We support clients across finance and supply chain, as well as SAP, Oracle, and emerging platforms, by applying automation, analytics, and Generative AI to improve performance, increase agility, and unlock long-term value.

This is an opportunity to build your career while helping leading organizations navigate complex transformation and deliver measurable impact.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/15/2027

Work you’ll do

As a ServiceNow Delivery Manager on Enterprise Operations as a Service team, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead end-to-end delivery for ServiceNow engagements within the Enterprise Operations as a Service offering, managing scope, milestones, quality, risks, and outcomes.
  • Provide direction across the ServiceNow platform, with hands-on expertise in core platform capabilities and various modules such as ITSM, ITOM/CMDB, and emerging AI solutions; guide solution design and drive resolution of complex technical challenges.
  • Oversee implementation, enhancement, and ongoing maintenance activities, balancing new delivery with production stability and user support.
  • Coordinate timely triage and resolution of production incidents and user issues, ensuring the right technical resources are engaged and stakeholders receive clear updates.
  • Manage and develop a team of ServiceNow professionals, including work allocation, capacity and resource planning, performance, and skills development.
  • Establish delivery governance, dashboards, KPIs, and status reporting to track progress, productivity, risks, resource needs, and operational health.
  • Build strong working relationships with US and global delivery counterparts, client stakeholders, and partner teams; communicate status, dependencies, challenges, and decisions proactively.
  • Support business development efforts and identify opportunities to improve delivery and grow the team’s capabilities, including practical use of ServiceNow AI features as the platform and its capabilities evolve

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Enterprise Operations as a Service team helps organizations maximize the value of their ServiceNow investments and modernize critical business operations. We deliver multi-year managed services across ServiceNow and associated boundary applications, supporting clients through transition, stabilization, steady-state operations, enhancements, and continuous improvement.

By combining ServiceNow expertise, industry and process knowledge, delivery experience, and Deloitte capabilities in automation, analytics, and artificial intelligence, we help clients improve operational performance, increase agility, enhance user experience, and enable ongoing technology modernization.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree and ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
  • 8+ years of professional experience in technology delivery, application support, or platform operations, including 5+ years delivering or supporting ServiceNow solutions.
  • 3+ years of experience leading ServiceNow delivery or operations in managed services, platform operations, or application support environments, and 3+ years of people management experience, including coaching or mentoring team members.
  • Experience configuring or developing ServiceNow platform capabilities, integrations, and solutions, including ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM/CMDB and at least one additional product, such as HRSD, CSM, ITAM, ITBM/SPM, or SecOps.
  • Experience managing application development, system integration, or platform implementation programs, using Agile practices such as sprint planning, backlog management, and release coordination.
  • Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

  • Experience contributing to proposals or designing operating models for ServiceNow or managed services.
  • Experience defining or managing key performance indicators (KPIs), service-level agreements (SLAs), or continuous improvement initiatives.

Job ID 373791

Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking an experienced Technical Accounting Manager within the Chief Accounting Officer organization’s Financial Reporting function. This role provides guidance on complex, non-routine accounting matters, including revenue recognition, leases, consolidation, investments, joint ventures, and mergers and acquisitions. The Manager independently researches technical issues, develops accounting positions, reviews contracts, updates accounting policies, and engages with senior stakeholders across the organization. The role also supports system enhancements and ad hoc projects, while monitoring standard-setting activity to help the firm remain current and compliant with evolving US GAAP requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on November 30th 2026.

Work you’ll do

As a Specialist Manager, Technical Accounting on the Technical Accounting team, you will be responsible for:

  • Review complex arrangements involving revenue, leases, investments, consolidation, joint ventures, and other topics to identify accounting issues and determine the appropriate accounting treatment in accordance with US GAAP.
  • Researching accounting guidance, evaluating fact patterns, and preparing technical accounting memoranda, position papers, and client-ready analyses
  • Support the Accounting Policy team in writing, reviewing, and updating the Firm’s accounting policies across a range of accounting topics to ensure policies remain current and reflective of the latest applicable standards.
  • Monitor FASB standard-setting activity and interpretive guidance from the AICPA and Big Four technical publications; assess the relevance and potential impact of proposed and final standards on the Firm’s accounting positions and financial reporting.
  • Critically review merger, acquisition and divestiture (MA&D) transactions under ASC 805, Business Combinations, ensuring accurate identification and resolution of accounting issues.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, Corporate Development, and Finance Business Partners to evaluate MA&D transactions and support the proper application of accounting policy and purchase price allocation valuation considerations.
  • Ensure MA&D transactions, joint ventures, and other wholly owned subsidiaries maintained off ledger are recorded and reported accurately and timely, while confirming MA&D controls operate effectively to preserve data integrity and reliable financial information.
  • Support discussion with business leadership, Office of General Counsel, Quality Risk Management, Finance Business Partners, and consultation with National Office Partners, Principals, Managing Directors on complex accounting issues.
  • Support system enhancement and transformation initiatives, with a particular focus on revenue recognition system requirements.
  • Translate accounting requirements into functional and technical design Support system enhancement and transformation initiatives, with a particular focus on revenue recognition system requirements.
  • Translate accounting requirements into functional and technical design specifications to support system enhancements, automation solutions, and end-to-end process improvements.
  • Identify and drive process improvement opportunities to increase efficiency and strengthen controls within the Technical Accounting function.
  • Support firm-wide special projects by evaluating technical accounting implications, identifying key issues and advising on appropriate accounting treatment

The successful candidate will posses these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Our Technical Accounting team supports complex accounting matters, including accounting policy, financial reporting, transaction accounting, and implementation of new accounting standards. Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate Manager - GCP Cloud DevOps Engineer
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Software Developer / Engineer, IT / Technology, Cloud Engineer
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking a Lead Managed Services Engineer II to design, automate, and operate enterprise-scale cloud capabilities that support clients’ critical cyber assets. In this role, you will apply Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Terraform, infrastructure as code, and DevOps practices to build secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. You will collaborate with Cyber Operate, data engineering, and artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) teams to support evolving client needs, operational excellence, and secure cloud delivery.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Design, build, and maintain Terraform modules and infrastructure-as-code workflows across development, test, staging, and production environments.
  • Provision and operate Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, including Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Firestore, Identity and Access Management (IAM), Secret Manager, Google Cloud Load Balancing, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), virtual private clouds (VPCs), subnets, firewall rules, private connectivity, Domain Name System (DNS), and Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) certificates.
  • Develop continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, infrastructure versioning, automated code-review processes, governance controls, and deployment strategies for infrastructure and applications.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, observability, high availability, and disaster recovery practices; investigate production incidents and document root-cause findings.
  • Create operational runbooks, architecture documentation, and support procedures for managed cloud environments.
  • Partner with data engineering and AI/ML teams to support infrastructure for data platforms and AI workloads, including Vertex AI Agent Engine, Vertex AI Search, and Model Armor.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required 6+ years of experience in:

  • Experience with Terraform module development and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure provisioning across development, test, staging, and production environments.
  • Experience configuring Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Firestore, Secret Manager, Google Cloud Load Balancing, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Identity and Access Management (IAM), virtual private clouds (VPCs), subnets, firewall rules, private connectivity, Domain Name System (DNS), and Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) certificates.
  • Experience developing continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines with Cloud Build or GitHub Actions for infrastructure and application deployments, including version control, code review, and deployment processes.
  • Experience using Cloud Monitoring for monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability; production incident investigation; operational runbook development; and architecture documentation.
  • Experience building application programming interfaces (APIs) or data connectors using Python, Cloud Functions, or Cloud Run; and supporting data platforms using BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, or Cloud Composer.
  • Experience supporting infrastructure for Vertex AI Agent Engine, Vertex AI Search, or Model Armor.
  • Experience configuring IAM policies, service accounts, and security controls for cloud infrastructure.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 day/week times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree
  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer certification
  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate certification
  • Experience supporting identity lifecycle management, security operations, threat intelligence, or application security.

Job.JobTitle: Salesforce Agentforce for Life Sciences - Forward Deployed Engineer- Products and Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

THE TEAM

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.

This role is aligned to the Converge for Life Sciences portfolio, Deloitte's AI-enabled platform portfolio for the modern life sciences enterprise. Converge by Deloitte combines proprietary data assets, advanced analytics, and AI-driven decision intelligence to help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical product organizations accelerate the pace of discovery, development, and commercialization, while improving compliance and operational visibility across the enterprise.

This role is 100% dedicated to FastForward offering which is built on Salesforce Agentforce for Life Sciences and accelerates the enablement of commercial field operations for life science organizations.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/14/2027.

WORK YOU'LL DO

We're seeking a Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE) to own the full FastForward client lifecycle, from pre-sales through implementation and into long-term managed services. This is an experienced individual-contributor role for someone who operates end to end: leading demo-driven discovery, delivering implementations as the client's primary point of contact, and owning the post-go-live relationship. Day to day, the pFDE will have the following key responsibilities:

PRE-SALES DISCOVERY & SOLUTION SHAPING

  • Lead demo-driven discovery with prospective clients by managing FastForward demo environments, aligning capabilities to each prospect's commercial context.
  • Partner with the engagement lead on pursuit execution: sequencing milestones, handling technical objections, and contributing inputs to proposals and RFPs.

IMPLEMENTATION & DEPLOYMENT

  • Serve as the client's primary delivery lead through implementation, coordinating workstreams, managing client communication, and driving toward a clean go-live.
  • Work with technical team to define the implementation design
  • Manage project scope, timeline, and risk, surfacing and resolving issues before they affect go-live dates or the client relationship.
  • Brief the development team on what to build; review and sign off on their deliverables before work reaches the client.

PRODUCT FEEDBACK & TEAM CONTRIBUTION

  • Build reusable delivery assets — implementation playbooks, demo scripts, and reference configurations that accelerate future engagements.
  • Contribute to the product group's shared knowledge base — documenting implementation learnings, patterns, and approaches that scale across engagements.
  • Bridge field experience and the product organization — translating client needs and market observations into structured insights, and contributing to go-to-market and solution positioning materials.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 4+ years of consulting and/or life science industry experience with demonstrated client-facing ownership across the full delivery lifecycle.
  • Experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, Veeva CRM, or IQVIA OCE in a pharma commercial context.
  • Hands-on technical experience configuring or building on Salesforce (administrator-level configuration, flows, validation rules, and other declarative/point-and-click tools), sufficient to build and run product demonstrations without engineering support.
  • Experience presenting to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred

  • Experience in life sciences or healthcare commercial technology environments (e.g., CRM, field engagement, patient services, or market access).
  • Experience with Salesforce Agentforce or comparable AI-agent / GenAI capabilities embedded in enterprise applications.
  • Experience in post-go-live client success or managed services, including account cadences, adoption management, and feature backlog prioritization.
  • Familiarity with data loading, integration patterns, and CRM data models common to life sciences commercial operations, as well as CLI-based deployment or configuration-as-code approaches.
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400-$207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Specialist Lead managing federal government contracts for Deloitte's GPS Practice, handling contract reviews, modifications, compliance, and stakeholder coordination. Role requires expertise in Federal Acquisition Regulations and Veterans Affairs contracts within a hybrid work model.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in contract management, 2+ years supporting Veterans Affairs, knowledge of multiple contract types, and can work hybrid 2-3 days per week.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Prime Contracts team is responsible for the reviewing and processing of all fully executed net new awards, option periods, and contract modifications as well as coordination for at risk items for the Deloitte GPS Practice. Possesses a strong working knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulations, and commercial contracting principles. Supports the execution of all facets of the contract life cycle. Performs contract administration duties for federal contracts and ensures the accuracy of the contracts and financial systems. Exercises increased independence and judgment in reviewing and analyzing moderately complex contracts actions. Maintains a keen awareness of requirements and status associated with assigned contracts. Effectively, manages personal portfolio and advises account teams on contracts administration matters. Compiles and analyzes contract related data; and maintains historical information and documentation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/01/2026. 

While all locations will be considered, this role offers a flexible hybrid scheduled with candidates based in Washington, D.C. or Arlington, VA (or nearby) preferred. 

Work you'll do

As a Specialist Lead, Government Client Contracts Management on the Prime Contracts team, you will be responsible for...

  • Proactively provides support to the development, review, and negotiation of contracts, modifications, prime contractor NDA and teaming agreements and subcontracts consistent with company policies.
  • Ensure contract data is entered into appropriate forms and databases. Checks existence, accuracy, and completeness of electronic documents and contract systems related data.
  • Reviews Federal solicitations, requests for information and proposals, and identifies business risks, documents the findings, and provides recommendations.
  • Has a keen understanding and knowledge of key terms and conditions of assigned contracts that would affect performance or compliance with the ability to convey salient information to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Prepares standard contract language (e.g., technical/price assumptions, certifications & representations, proposal questions, organizational conflict of interest certificates, etc.) for inclusion into proposals.
  • Receives and interprets federal customers' post submission, proposal clarifications and/or deficiencies. Completes distribution of questions to the proposal team/awaits inputs, assists with the coordination of proposal changes. Remits revised proposal offer to the Contracting Officer.
  • Develops relationships with external client stakeholders and attend industry and government events.
  • Collaborate and coordinate across GPS teams to provide comprehensive solutions and insights to internal and external clients related to contracts portfolio.
  • Reviews for compliance with federal contract regulations and various reporting requirements.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

The Team

The Prime Contracts team is responsible for contract management and administration supporting accounts across Deloitte’s Government and Public Services practice. This role will work directly with Contracts professionals, Project Engagement Leadership, Enterprise Solutions points of contact, and other internal and external stakeholders to coordinate the information and decisions required to support compliant contract management and operational execution.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of experience in contract management, contract administration, or government contracting support
  • 2+ years of experience supporting the Veterans Affairs
  • 2+ years of experience with multiple contract types (e.g. FFP, LH, T&M, CPFF) and solicitation types (e.g. FAR Parts 8, 15, and 16)
  • Ability to travel 5-15%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that would require professionals to co-locate in person 2-3 days per week, whether at the a Deloitte office or client site, dependent on the team's needs 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting contracts within the Federal environment
  • Experience with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) requirements
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM) certification

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

Summary:

 

The Global Offering Portfolio Asset Business Leader (ABL) will work directly with Global OP Leader and broader global OP leadership team advising and shaping an OP specific Asset Strategy that reflects the Global Offering Portfolio Leader’s broader vision for that Offering Portfolio and that resonates across the global network. The ABL will advise the Global Offering Portfolio Leader on choices related to Industry plays, Alliance plays, GenAI/Agents and Delivery Transformation (i.e., the Global Ascend Program) – overall resulting into more asset-enabled sales across the global Offering Portfolio network. The ABL will take the lead in realizing the set OP specific Asset Strategy – capturing more market across the global network via asset-enabled sales for that Offering Portfolio.

Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Alignment:

Co-shape and deliver asset priorities in alignment with OP’s refreshed strategy to drive targeted portfolio and investment choices that align with MF market demands

  • Establish a global OP Asset Leadership community:

Establish a Leadership community to monitor the progress on assets, conduct due diligence on new assets and manage global support to the assets

  • Investments:

Assess and prepare investment requests and assist during investment committee pitches, showcasing alignment with OP objectives / proven market demand

  • Budget Utilization Tracking & ROI Monitoring:

Regularly monitor and report budget utilization for all approved investments.

Collaborate with MF asset teams to track ROI for an asset, ensuring alignment with strategic and financial objectives.

  • Scalability Planning 

Develop and execute plans for scaling successful assets across MF and the broader network.

  • Deal Integration:

Contribute to embedding assets in OP top deals, reinforcing the "build once, sell and use many" approach

  • Ascend Integration:

Lead the scaling of Ascend related Tech Components across the global network

  • Agentic AI:

Coordinate GenAI/Agents efforts specific to the set OP priorities

  • OP Asset Program management:

Lead the OP specific Asset Program including portfolio mgmt., investment mgmt., scaling & adoption efforts, Go-To-Market efforts, etc.


The team

Deloitte’s Global Consulting Services professionals support our global businesses to drive impact and create enduring value for clients in Strategy, Risk & Transactions (SR&T) and Technology & Transformation (T&T). We deliver purpose-driven services and solutions and provide a consistent, best-in-class "One Deloitte" experience around the world.



Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelor's degree required
  • Years of Experience: 5+ years of  Consulting, Project Management or Chief of Staff experience
  • High performing experience as an Experienced Deloitte Manager or Senior Manager level required
  • Proven experience building effective working relationships with high-level internal stakeholders across multiple businesses, geographies and cultures
  • High-level understanding of asset business models, asset lifecycle, asset commercial and monetization strategies, asset scaling approaches and asset Go-To-Market approaches  
  • Technology literacy
  • Superior communication and project management skills
  • Ability to work independently with competing priorities while consistently producing best-in-class deliverables
  • Experience in navigating a global, matrixed, and virtual work environment
  • Strategic and creative team player willing to do what it takes to get the job done
  • Outstanding analytical, research, and presentation skills (strong PowerPoint and MS Excel skills required)
  • Strong organizational and communications skills with outstanding attention to detail
  • Ability to interact with and influence all levels within the firm, particularly leadership
  • Ability to put his/her views across clearly and have the confidence to engage with senior people
  • Demonstrate a strong level of emotional intelligence, with experience managing complex situations successfully
  • Creativity and the ability to work collaboratively to reach innovative solutions
  • Ability to interpret and develop an understanding of technical subject matter
  • Strategic thinker who can identify strategic themes/issues
  • Ability to effectively manage a large number of projects and delivery across different teams
  • Ability to deal with a degree of ambiguity and use own initiative
  • Appreciation for and commitment to maintain Independence
  • Excellent communication skills are necessary - in particular a high level of written and spoken 
  • Previous market/client-facing experience and client pursuits/selling is a plus

Job ID 373614

Position Summary

Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Specialty Transplant Billing Operator, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as an Analyst without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long-term, onsite and/or remote client service delivery.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026

Work you'll do

As a Specialty Transplant Billing Operator / Billing and Claims Operator of Transplant Services you will be responsible for the accurate, timely billing, accounts receivable follow-up, and denial resolution of complex transplant accounts for a large health system. This role focuses on hands-on execution of hospital (facility) billing operations.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Prepare, review, and submit hospital (UB-04/837I) claims for transplant and related inpatient and outpatient services, ensuring coding, charges, and payer requirements are met before release.
  • Work assigned A/R inventory through timely follow-up with commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care payers via portals, phone, and written correspondence.
  • Research, analyze, and resolve denials and underpayments, including medical necessity, authorization, timely filing, and coding-related denials.
  • Prepare and submit appeals with supporting clinical documentation, contract language, and payer policy references; track appeal status through resolution.
  • Validate payer reimbursement against contract terms and flag variances, including transplant case rates, carve-outs, stop-loss, and outlier provisions.
  • Verify that authorizations, referrals, and transplant-specific approvals (evaluation, listing, transplant, and follow-up phases) are on file and linked to the correct accounts.
  • Coordinate with Patient Access, Coding, Health Information Management, Utilization Review, and the transplant clinical team to resolve documentation and account issues.
  • Document all account activity clearly and completely in the billing system to support audit and handoff.
  • Escalate payer trends, systemic denial root causes, and process gaps to leadership with supporting examples.

Transplant Specialty Responsibilities

  • Bill and reconcile organ acquisition costs by transplant program (kidney, liver, heart, lung, pancreas, and others as applicable), including accurate use of organ acquisition cost center revenue codes and charge capture.
  • Maintain organ acquisition cost center billing for Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers, including recovery of organ procurement organization (OPO) invoices and related acquisition charges.
  • Support Medicare cost report reconciliation by tying organ acquisition billing, usable and non-usable organ counts, and acquisition charges to the general ledger and cost report worksheets.
  • Partner with Reimbursement, Finance, and Decision Support to resolve variances between billed charges, payments received, and cost report data.
  • Manage billing across transplant phases, including pre-transplant evaluation, listing, the transplant admission, and post-transplant follow-up, and apply payer-specific global or case-rate periods correctly.
  • Identify and correct transplant-specific billing errors, including misapplied acquisition charges, duplicate billing of organ costs, and incorrect Medicare and Medicaid pass-through treatment.
  • Apply payer-specific transplant policies, Centers of Excellence requirements, and contract provisions when billing and when disputing payments.
  • Support payer and regulatory audits, cost report settlement activity, and data requests with accurate and timely account documentation.


A successful candidate would possess these skills:
* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Our Industry Solutions offering provides verticalized solutions that transform how clients sell products, deliver services, generate growth, and execute mission-critical operations. We deliver integrated business expertise with scalable, repeatable technology solutions specifically engineered for each sector.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of hospital (facility) billing, claims follow-up, or denials management experience in an acute care or health system setting.
  • 1 year of hands-on transplant billing, claims follow-up, or denials experience, including familiarity with transplant-specific payer requirements and global or case-rate billing periods.
  • Working knowledge of UB-04/837I claim requirements, revenue codes, ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT/HCPCS, and DRG-based and per diem reimbursement methodologies.
  • Working knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer rules, including timely filing, appeals, and authorization requirements.
  • Proficiency with an enterprise patient accounting system (such as Epic Resolute, Cerner, or Meditech), payer portals, and Microsoft Excel.  
  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, business, healthcare, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience billing organ acquisition costs and supporting Medicare cost report reconciliation (CMS-2552-10, Worksheet D-4 and related schedules).
  • Familiarity with OPO invoicing, organ acquisition cost center structures, and Medicare and Medicaid transplant reimbursement rules.
  • Experience with other complex or high-dollar specialty service lines, such as oncology, cardiology, orthopedics, or neurosciences.
  • Experience with payer contract interpretation and underpayment recovery.

Quick facts

  • Pay: $84,300 to $140,600 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 4+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Specialist Lead for user acceptance testing of finance applications including SAP S/4HANA, GEMS, SWIFT, Beacon, and CP3. You will plan and execute UAT cycles, translate business requirements into test scenarios, coordinate business testers, triage defects, and mentor team members.

Good fit if you have 4+ years testing finance or ERP systems, experience leading UAT, strong knowledge of SAP and finance processes, and can coordinate business users and cross-functional teams.

Full job description

Position Summary

Professionals in ES may apply and be considered for the role regardless of US office location.

We are seeking a Specialist Lead to join our Finance Systems team User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for finance-led platform enhancements and integrations. In this role, you will own UAT planning, readiness, and execution across GEMS, SWIFT, Beacon, CP3, and other finance applications, including those connected to SAP S/4HANA and related financial applications such as pricing and forecasting. You will act as the bridge between finance business users and technology teams: translating finance requirements into acceptance criteria and UAT scenarios, preparing and coordinating business testers, working with Information Technology Services (ITS), product engineering, and business teams, and giving stakeholders a clear, evidence-based view of release readiness to support go/no-go decisions. The Specialist Lead will also guide and mentor testers on the team and support the testing lead in day-to-day delivery.

Recruiting for this role ends on November 30th 2026.

Work You'll Do:

As a Specialist Lead, Firm Financial Systems, you will:

  • Define UAT scope, approach, and entry and exit criteria for finance application enhancements across GEMS, SWIFT, Beacon, CP3, and other finance platforms, including effort estimates and alignment to the release plan
  • Translate business requirements and acceptance criteria into UAT scenarios, test scripts, and test data that reflect real finance processes, ensuring shared understanding with product, engineering, and business teams
  • Partner with business process owners to identify, onboard, and brief UAT participants, setting clear expectations on roles, timelines, and sign-off, and scheduling around finance calendar constraints such as period-end close
  • Confirm UAT environment and test data readiness with ITS before each cycle, including SAP S/4HANA-connected interfaces and reporting outputs
  • Coordinate and run UAT cycles, guiding business testers, tracking execution progress against plan, and communicating daily status and blockers
  • Triage defects with business, product, and engineering teams by confirming severity and priority, distinguishing defects from change requests and training needs, and tracking fixes through retest and closure
  • Validate accounting and financial outcomes for finance-impacting changes, including reconciliations and data quality checks, and ensure test evidence is captured and audit-ready
  • Execute or oversee system integration, regression, and end-to-end testing to confirm releases are stable before and after UAT
  • Report UAT status, coverage, defect trends, and risks to the testing lead and stakeholders, and prepare go/no-go inputs and UAT sign-off documentation
  • Support production support and release hypercare validation, and apply lessons learned from UAT and production defects to future test planning
  • Mentor and guide testers by setting clear priorities, supporting performance and development, and fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture
  • Support the testing lead in coordinating day-to-day work across the team, tracking progress, and balancing workloads across releases, and run team stand-ups and release check-ins when the lead is unavailable
  • Review UAT scripts, test plans, and test cases prepared by team members, and onboard new joiners to finance applications and testing standards

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Finance Systems serves as the subject matter experts for the US finance application portfolio, testing and validating innovative solutions and changes through governance and change management to meet the technology needs of Finance and the US firm. The testing function sits at the center of that mission: designing and executing test strategies across functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing, safeguarding data quality and reporting accuracy, and catching defects before they reach production. UAT is where finance users confirm that a change works for the way they run the business, and the team makes sure those users are prepared, supported, and heard. Joining the team is an opportunity to help drive the future vision of the Finance organization by raising the bar on test coverage and release quality, so that every release ships with confidence.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Professional with 4+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on testing of finance or ERP systems and direct experience planning or leading UAT
  • Strong understanding of finance systems and processes; experience with SAP, client-to-cash (CTC), core finance, and pricing and forecasting
  • Hands-on experience designing and executing UAT scenarios, test plans, and test cases for enterprise applications
  • Experience coordinating business users through UAT, including onboarding testers, tracking execution, and obtaining sign-off
  • Experience supporting defect triage and release readiness for finance-related system changes, including providing go/no-go input
  • Experience gathering business requirements, translating them into acceptance criteria, and partnering with technical teams to validate finance or accounting system solutions
  • Experience researching system and process issues, performing root cause analysis, and driving cross-functional resolution
  • Experience coordinating testing activities and mentoring junior testers; able to communicate test status and risks clearly to stakeholders at all levels
  • Ability to explain technical issues in business terms and to influence business stakeholders to meet UAT timelines
  • Demonstrated commitment to integrity and confidentiality
  • Excellent proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams, etc.)
  • Introductory knowledge of AI tools and applications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Finance, Accounting, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred
  • Ability to travel 0–10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Certification in ISTQB, CSTE, Agile/SAFe, and/or Project Management Professional
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (for example, ALM, Jira, or Azure DevOps) for UAT execution tracking, traceability, and defect reporting
  • Experience planning UAT within Agile or SAFe release cycles, including Program Increments
  • Experience with test automation tools or frameworks for enterprise or ERP applications
  • Knowledge of audit support, SOX compliance documentation, and internal controls over financial reporting
  • Experience testing SAP-connected finance interfaces, subledgers, and reporting tools
