Job.JobTitle: Senior Tax Analyst - US Indirect Tax, Deloitte Global Finance
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

The Senior Analyst, Tax – US Indirect Tax supports the Deloitte Global's US indirect tax function, with a focus on sales and use tax, gross receipts taxes, business license taxes, and other state and local indirect taxes. The role is responsible for accurate and timely compliance, research, reporting and analysis of multistate tax matters, coordination of notices and audits, and continuous improvement of indirect tax processes. The Senior Analyst works closely with Tax leadership, Finance, Accounts Payable, Procurement, and external advisors, and interacts with stakeholders both within the United States and outside the United States.

  • Prepare and review multistate sales and use, commercial rent tax, OH CAT, gross receipts (e.g., Washington B&O), business license tax returns and etc.
  • Maintain the compliance calendar, tax registrations, and business license updates, including partner information changes.
  • Reconcile indirect tax accounts and support month-end and year-end accruals.
  • Review accounts payable data for use tax accruals and maintain exemption certificates.
  • Analyze taxability, nexus, and sourcing across jurisdictions.
  • Respond to tax notices and coordinate audits with external advisors.
  • Streamline and automate processes, including tax engine and ERP configuration, and maintain process documentation and controls.
  • Partner with Finance, Accounts Payable, Procurement, Payroll, and Legal on indirect tax matters.
  • Review loan staff work and provide concise updates to tax leadership.


The team

Global Finance provides the most cutting-edge and insightful research and analysis of the financial health of the entire Deloitte organization around the world. We advise, guide, and monitor global initiatives in five major areas: tax, member-firm reporting, finance and accounting, strategic projects, and financial analysis.



Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in US state and local or indirect tax, in public accounting, a professional services firm, or a corporate tax department, CPA or equivalent is preferred. 
  • Working knowledge of sales and use tax, gross receipts taxes, business license requirements, etc., across multiple states.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing multistate indirect tax returns and account reconciliations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., lookups, pivot tables, data analysis) and the Microsoft 365 suite.
  • Strong analytical, research, and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities with a high degree of accuracy.Technical expertise: Applies indirect tax knowledge to reach sound, well-documented conclusions.
  • Attention to detail: Delivers accurate, complete, and audit-ready work.
  • Communication: Explains tax matters clearly to tax and non-tax stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Builds effective working relationships across Finance, business teams, and external advisors.
  • Continuous improvement: Proactively identifies risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation.



Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Position Summary

Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.


Work You’ll Do 

As a Center Delivery Senior Consultant, Software Engineering Solutions on the Engineering as a Service team, you will:


  • Build agents against a layered SDK contract (shared types/tools, composable tools, thin agent shell, FastAPI + React surface)
  • Keep business logic in composable skills rather than shells or routers
  • Integrate LLMs through a multi-provider abstraction (Anthropic/Bedrock/OpenAI/Azure, extending to Vertex/OCI) behind a single sanitization + audit boundary so no raw client data leaves the worker
  • Implement durable service boundaries (async persistence, object-storage artifacts, and a tamper-evident hash-chain audit trail per run)
  • Enforce tenant isolation via Postgres RLS scoped sessions and author Alembic migrations (enum/DDL idempotency, RLS policies)
  • Wire agents into an event-driven orchestrator with human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval gates, exposing progress via async tasks (Celery/Redis) and WebSocket
  • Ship behind mechanical architecture linting and CI, contributing new invariant checks

A successful candidate would possess:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Engineering as a Service offering provides end-to-end design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We help transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering mindset. Our flexible delivery models – traditional teams, pools, or pods, are tailored for each client’s needs, offering engineering-led Advise, Implement, & Operate capabilities to accelerate innovation.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.


Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance
  • 3-6 years of backend Python with deep async/service-design expertise and practical LLM-application experience
  • 3-6 years of experience with Docker, SQL, Tailwind CSS 4, React.js

Preferred: 

  • Experience with GitHub Copilot
  • Multi-tenant SaaS, audit/compliance (HIPAA/FedRAMP/SOX), and data-domain exposure strongly preferred

Job ID 373534

Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 10+ years

About this job

Manager role leading SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) design and delivery on S/4HANA programs. Supports clients across the full solution lifecycle, from assessment through deployment, with focus on ASC 606 and IFRS 15 compliance and complex revenue scenarios.

Good fit if you have 8+ years of SAP consulting experience, 4+ years of RAR experience with ASC 606 or IFRS 15, and have led at least one full-lifecycle SAP RAR implementation.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join Deloitte’s SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You’ll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/15/2027.

Work you’ll do

As a Manager on the SAP team, you will support clients across the solution lifecycle, from business process assessment through design, build, testing, deployment, and post-go-live activities.

  • Lead SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) design and delivery on SAP S/4HANA programs, from fit-gap assessment through build, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
  • Own solution design for ASC 606 and IFRS 15, including performance obligation determination, standalone selling price (SSP) allocation, variable consideration, contract modifications, and contract combinations.
  • Assess and design solutions for complex revenue scenarios, including cross-company contracts, percentage-of-completion, multi-element arrangements, and in-flight contract migration; support OCM capabilities and migration from CCM to OCM; and support integration between SD-RAR and SOM-RAR.
  • Lead functional design and oversee configuration, data migration, testing, defect management, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and change adoption.
  • Design RAR integrations with BRIM, Sales and Distribution (SD) and billing, Project Systems, configure-price-quote (CPQ) platforms, Universal Journal, and reporting and analytics; apply SAP BRF+ and other SAP capabilities to support rules-based determination and address solution gaps through Clean Core-aligned options, including Business Technology Platform (BTP) extensions, hybrid approaches, and controlled custom development.
  • Advise client stakeholders on RAR design decisions and their business or compliance implications; contribute to proposals, client presentations, and key design-decision documentation; and mentor and review team members’ work while supporting quality, knowledge transfer, stakeholder communications, and training.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations across core business functions. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree, or Associate’s degree plus 10+ years of experience in SAP, ERP, or consulting
  • 8+ years of SAP consulting experience supporting solution design and end-to-end delivery in a consulting firm, industry environment, or both
  • 4+ years of SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) experience, including solution design and hands-on configuration supporting ASC 606 or IFRS 15 requirements
  • Experience delivering at least 2 full-lifecycle SAP RAR implementations or migrations, with a primary delivery or workstream leadership role on at least 1; at least 1 must be on SAP S/4HANA
  • Experience designing a solution for at least 1 of the following revenue scenarios: cross-company contract combinations, percentage-of-completion, or multi-element SSP allocation
  • Experience presenting SAP RAR design decisions to client stakeholders
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred

  • 2+ years of client service delivery experience in a consulting or professional services firm supporting transformation engagements
  • SAP certification in S/4HANA Finance, RAR, or Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM), or a CPA or CA credential.
  • Experience with BRF+ for rules-based determination (POB, SSP) and moving custom ECC logic to Clean Core-compliant designs.
  • Experience with in-flight contract migration, opening-balance reconciliation, and SOX / audit trail design.
  • Experience with pre-sales and orals, including proposal contributions.
  • Experience evaluating or applying SAP Business AI or Joule use cases involving contract and performance obligation interpretation, AI-assisted standalone selling price estimation, ABAP remediation, or continuous controls monitoring, including documentation of human-review considerations.

Job ID 373519

Quick facts

  • Pay: $116,200 to $229,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 4+ years

About this job

Senior Consultant role with Deloitte's Strategy, Growth, and Transformation team in Jacksonville, Florida. You will develop digital marketing strategies, build business cases for investments, and partner with product and analytics teams to help clients optimize their paid media programs and measurement capabilities.

Good fit if you have 4+ years in digital advertising, media measurement, and business case development, plus 3+ years in SEO/content audits and retail media or RMN platforms.

Full job description

Position Summary

Position Summary

Deloitte’s Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, transformative technologies, creative design, and modern marketing operations. Our team brings together strategists, operators, creatives, data specialists, and technologists to help clients drive sustained growth and measurable customer value.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 29, 2027

Work you’ll do

As a Senior Consultant in Strategy, Growth, and Transformation, you will lead client-facing workstreams and provide strategic and operational guidance as a Digital Strategist. This role requires strong analytical, strategic, and client-facing skills, with the ability to collaborate across business, product, engineering, data, analytics, and commercial teams.

In this role, you will…

  • Develop digital marketing growth strategies, including revenue targets, channel mix, pricing, packaging, and quarterly priorities.
  • Build business cases for roadmap investments, including revenue potential, margin impact, adoption, and operational readiness.
  • Assess market trends, competitive positioning, advertiser needs, and evolving digital media capabilities.
  • Support operating model design, governance, and performance management for businesses.
  • Develop problem statements, product requirements documents, prioritization frameworks, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with product, engineering, data, analytics, and AI/ML teams to assess feasibility, sequencing, dependencies, and delivery plans.
  • Facilitate decision-making across business and technology stakeholders.
  • Define measurement frameworks and reporting narratives using metrics such as ROAS, incrementality, customer acquisition, and new-to-brand performance.
  • Evaluate attribution, audience, identity, and closed-loop measurement capabilities.
  • Help clients strengthen first-party data segmentation and measurement partnerships.
  • Develop executive-ready insights and performance narratives for brands and internal stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting automation, and analytical maturity.
  • Segment offerings by advertiser tier, campaign objective, category, and level of measurement sophistication.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product.
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a team-based consulting environment.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor.
  • Ability to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to internal teams, clients, and vendor partners.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate campaign data into actionable recommendations.

The team

Deloitte’s Strategy, Growth, and Transformation practice helps clients reimagine how they grow by connecting customer strategy, marketing, sales, service, digital products, analytics, creativity, and technology. As part of this team, you will help clients modernize marketing operations and deliver paid media programs that are structured, measurable, and optimized for business impact.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
  • 4+ years of experience in digital advertising and marketing, retail or commerce media, Ad/MarTech, digital commerce, product strategy, or related fields
  • 4+ years of experience with media measurement, attribution, performance analytics, or closed-loop measurement
  • 4+ years experience developing business cases, assessing investment opportunities, and framing (e.g. translate analysis into recommendations)
  • 3+ years experience developing RMN and advertiser solutions, audience products, or measurement capabilities
  • 3+ years experience in SEO/AEO/GEO with hands-on technical and content audit experience with the ability read how a site is built and how its content performs, and spot what’s holding it back.
  • Ability to travel 30%+, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • 3+ years of experience with retail media business models, monetization strategies, or commerce advertising ecosystems
  • Knowledge of major RMN platforms
  • Industry experience in Retail / CPG / Travel & Hospitality sectors
  • Familiarity with sponsored products, display, programmatic, social, onsite, offsite, or in-store media.
  • Experience with media planning including creating pricing, packaging, rate cards, sales enablement materials, or go-to-market strategies.
  • Experience planning, structuring, and governing content strategy across channels and audiences to support goals beyond search visibility
  • Has started applying that thinking to AI search over the past year (testing prompts, seeing how brands show up in LLM answers)
  • Experience collaborating with product, engineering, data, analytics, or AI/ML teams.
  • Experience leading client workshops or executive-level presentations.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,200 - $229,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Requisition code: 373511
Job ID 373511

Position Summary

As a Consultant in Deloitte’s Digital Trust & Privacy practice, you will support the design and implementation of privacy technology solutions that help organizations address regulatory requirements, strengthen data governance, and enable trusted business outcomes. You will contribute across configuration, integration, testing, and deployment activities while working with client, vendor, and cross-functional teams. This role offers the opportunity to take on increased ownership in privacy-by-design initiatives, Consent & Preference Management, and AI governance efforts, and large-scale technology implementations.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you’ll do

  • Strategize with clients to identify privacy technology gaps that can be addressed with technology to enable future state privacy goals and navigate complex IT architectures to incorporate privacy technology solutions.
  • Lead working sessions with client stakeholders to gather technical, functional, and business requirements and establish use cases to inform future state architecture.
  • General awareness of global and domestic privacy regulations and concepts, and how they relate to the deployment of technology in line with applicable laws and regulations, and general knowledge of integrating technologies with third-party tools and APIs.
  • Configure, integrate, test, and deploy privacy tools and technologies to help clients automate their privacy capabilities and enhance customer experiences.
  • Coordinate with client stakeholders and technology vendor representatives to clarify queries, troubleshoot implementation issues, and test end-to-end deployment and system integrations, and manage and execute project activities across the IT Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including leading regular check-ins with team members and vendors
  • Develop and maintain technical configuration documentation, and manage and provide technical oversight to solution deployment and rollout.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or similar Engineering disciplines
  • 2+ years of experience in software design, architecture development, and technology implementation
  • 1+ years of experience with OneTrust and other technologies
  • 1+ years of implementation experience with OneTrust, Ketch, Transcend, Cassie, or Securiti’s Consent & Preference Management solution 
  • Ability to travel 25-75%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred Qualifications: 

Technical skills

  • Understand marketing technologies, including customer data platforms, consent, cookies, tag management solutions
  • Ability to understand, develop and enhance existing client architectures and solution designs to meet data privacy requirements
  • Prior experience in performing SaaS implementations for complex organizations and IT ecosystems.
  • Ability to comprehend and execute basic technology concepts such as Application Programming Interfaces (API’s), system requests methods (GET/POST), etc.
  • Demonstrated experience in performing integrations with Marketing Platforms (e.g., Sales Force Marketing Cloud), Master Data Management (e.g., Informatica MDM) and middleware (MuleSoft, Kafka)
  • Familiarity with privacy tools such as OneTrust, BigID, Securiti.ai, etc.
  • Hands-on experience and knowledge of software engineering concepts/technologies, such as:
    • JavaScript, RESTful APIs, HTTP Requests, JDBC, HTML CSS
    • SQL, NoSQL, database management concepts
    • API management tools such as Apigee, Postman
    • Agile/Scrum methodology to build and rollout complex software solutions
  • Understanding of privacy program requirements and capabilities such as data inventory, data subject rights, consent and preference management, privacy by design, privacy impact assessments, incident response, third-party risk, etc.
  • Knowledge of Data Privacy Laws and Regulations: Familiarity with data privacy legislation such as GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and other regional or industry-specific privacy regulations.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively articulate complex privacy concepts to business-facing audiences, such as clients and other team members.
  • Project Management Experience: Experience in managing projects, including planning, risk management, resource management, and meeting project timelines.
  • Teamwork and Collaboration: Proven experience in working effectively with diverse teams.
  • Change Management: Understanding of change management principles and approaches, to enable successful implementation and adoption of privacy solutions.
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or similar Engineering disciplines
  • 2+ years of experience implementing privacy solutions such as OneTrust, BigID, Securiti.ai
  • Certifications in one or more of the following: CIPT, CIPM, CISSP, CPDSE, CIPT, Agile/Scrum Master
  • Experience with application development and testing using one or more programming or scripting languages (e.g., .Net, C#, Python)
  • Understanding of Ad-Tech / Mar-Tech ecosystem, frameworks, tools, and solutions
  • Limited sponsorship may be available

Job ID 373468

Quick facts

  • Pay: $78,700 to $131,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Lake Mary, FL
  • Experience: 3 to 6 years

About this job

Build production React and FastAPI UIs for AI agents at Deloitte's Government & Public Services practice. Design streaming agent experiences and human-in-the-loop review flows, setting front-end standards for the pod while working with federal and public sector clients.

Good fit if you have 3-6 years React and Python experience, 3+ years building agent or streaming AI UIs, and REST and SSE/WebSocket integration skills.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work You’ll Do 

As a hands-on Center Delivery Senior Consultant, Data Engineering & Conversion Solutions on the AI & Data team, you will own the human-facing surface of these agents: the interfaces where users launch agent runs, watch them think in real time, review and approve their output, and ship the results.

  • Build production React (React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind) UIs backed by a FastAPI service
  • Design streaming agent experiences over Server-Sent Events (live run progress, connection status, incremental findings)
  • Craft human-in-the-loop review flows — checkpoint approvals, natural-language rule authoring, ER diagrams, data-quality dashboards, masking review, and semantic-view editors
  • Set the front-end standards for the pod (component architecture with TanStack Query + react-router, an accessible design system, screen-reader support, and performance under large data-profiling payloads)
  • Demo working software live in front of CIOs, CMOs, and client data teams

A successful candidate would possess:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.


Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance
  • 3-6 years of software engineering experience with deep React/TypeScript expertise
  • 3-6 years of experience with Python and React.js
  • 3+ years of experience building agent or conversational/streaming AI experiences (agent chat, token/event streaming, tool- and run-state visualization, long-running job UX)
  • 3+ years of experience with REST + SSE/WebSocket integration skills
  • Experience making complex, autonomous AI behavior legible, reviewable, and trustworthy

Preferred: 

  • Design system fluency
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot

Serve as first point of contact for Construction Management Platform users, handling support via phone, email, and ticketing app. Resolve user issues including login problems, password resets, and configuration questions while contributing to knowledge base improvements.

Good fit if you have 3+ years of help desk or service desk experience and a bachelor's degree or equivalent.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team delivers integrated, end-to-end support and advisory services covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, government operations modernization, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. Work alongside clients every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and provide practical solutions at every stage of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.

Work You’ll Do

As a Project Consultant, you will:

  • Serve as the primary first point of contact for Construction Management Platform users via phone, email and the in-platform ticketing app
  • Triage and document incoming issues and resolving simple and moderately complex issues directly where possible (including user login and credential problems, password resets, basic configuration and navigation questions, UI glitches and data corrections)
  • Work as part of a supportive delivery team, providing structured onboarding, coaching, and ongoing guidance 
  • Contribute to the service desk knowledge base, support content updates, and participate in continual-improvement activities tied to monthly service desk metrics (response time, resolution time, escalation rate, ticket volume)

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Sustainability, Infrastructure, Real Estate, & Resilience offering advises clients on climate and disaster-related risks through comprehensive strategy, planning, and crisis management, while also providing expertise in capital investments, infrastructure projects, and real estate portfolio optimization.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of help desk/service desk experience
  • Ability to travel up to 0-10% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
Preferred:
  • Experience with Kahua's construction management platform

Develop and configure Salesforce features for government workflows in a SAFe agile environment. Deliver production-ready code to an IL4 Salesforce system serving 28,000 end users across 8 feature teams.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of Salesforce development experience, a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, and hold or can obtain a Secret Clearance.

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You’ll Do

As a Project - Consultant, Technical Transformation on the project, you will:

  • Develop and configure Salesforce platform features supporting the enlisted mission and special mission set workflows within a SAFe agile delivery structure
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies and PI planning 
  • Deliver production-ready code in an IL4 Salesforce environment
  • Contribute to a shared codebase across 8 feature teams serving 28,000 end users.
The successful candidate would possess these skills:
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Job ID 373406

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber practice helps organizations address complex cybersecurity challenges across identity, access, and cloud transformation. As part of this team, you will help clients strengthen the security, resilience, and performance of their Microsoft identity environments, including Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID. This role offers the opportunity to lead large-scale identity initiatives, deliver practical risk-based solutions, and support clients as they modernize critical infrastructure.

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/01/2027.

Work you'll do

As an Engineering Manager II on the Deloitte Cyber team, you will be responsible for:

  • Assessing Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory environments and developing recommendations to improve security, configuration, and operational health
  • Leading the architecture, design, and implementation of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID deployments, migrations, upgrades, and consolidation efforts
  • Supporting identity modernization activities, including single sign-on, multifactor authentication, conditional access, identity provider migrations, and application integrations
  • Performing health checks, security assessments, recovery planning, and remediation activities across Active Directory services, domain environments, and supporting infrastructure
  • Delivering client-facing identity engagements across assessment, design, implementation, and post-implementation phases, while contributing technical insight to Deloitte eminence efforts

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Cyber helps organizations build trust in their digital environments by strengthening security across users, systems, and data. Within this space, our identity capabilities support clients in securing access, modernizing platforms, and reducing risk across enterprise environments. The team works with organizations to improve confidence in how access is managed and how critical information is protected.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, or Information Technology
  • 6+ years of experience in technical consulting, solution architecture, or client delivery involving Microsoft identity and access management solutions
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including conditional access, single sign-on, multifactor authentication, Privileged Identity Management, and application integrations
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with Active Directory, including Active Directory Federation Services, group policy, domain cleanup, domain and forest recovery, trusts, and federation
  • 5+ years of experience with identity protocols, including WS-Federation, Security Assertion Markup Language, OpenID Connect, and OAuth
  • Ability to travel 25-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience leading enterprise Active Directory or Microsoft Entra ID migration, upgrade, or consolidation programs
  • Experience implementing security solutions for Microsoft identity platforms, including Microsoft Defender for Identity
  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, or divestitures involving Active Directory domains and forests
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra B2B, Microsoft Entra B2C, or identity provider migration activities
  • Experience producing technical assessments, remediation plans, or compliance reporting for identity platforms
  • One or more certifications such as Microsoft SC-300, Certified Cloud Security Professional, Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge, Certified Information Systems Security Professional, Cisco Certified Network Professional, Cisco Certified Network Associate, Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert, or Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate

Don’t miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. The team

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

As a Manager you will work in a collaborative and diverse team environment providing many opportunities to have an active voice. You will support advising clients on their Supply Chain and Operations strategy and work with them to implement next generation solutions.

·       Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  • 7+ years warehousing experience in process design, operational improvements, layout, and / or management
  • 5+ years of experience implementing SCM solutions
  • 3+ years experience in leading WMS implementations
  • 2+ years experience in leading WMS implementations
  • Experience in Agile methodology
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Consulting experience
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Operations Research, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or related fields with a concentration in operations or analytics.
  • Advanced Degree in Operations Research, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or related fields with a concentration in operations or analytics.

Manager role with Deloitte's Government & Public Services practice based in Tallahassee, analyzing healthcare claims data and open-source information to identify fraud schemes and suspicious billing patterns for a federal healthcare program. Good fit if you have 6+ years of healthcare fraud and program integrity experience, a bachelor's degree, and can travel 5-25% and work independently.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organization. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

Work You’ll Do

As a Manager, Financial Crime Services, you will work with a cross disciplinary team to deploy a fraud detection accelerator for a large federal health care program.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze health insurance claims data, open source, and public information to identify new and emerging fraud schemes and identify suspicious billing patterns or other activities indicative of potentially fraudulent behavior.
  • Conduct analysis of open source and public information to identify sources of identity theft.
  • Perform proactive referral generation based on external data, such as government furnished reports and open source information, such as social media. 
  • Develop fraud referrals for presentation to the client, law enforcement, and other government agencies. 
  • Identify public health insurance program vulnerabilities through data analytics and open-source information.

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Enterprise Operations & Risk offering enables clients to achieve profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing “heart of the business” operations. Leverages deep domain expertise to extend enterprise resilience, agility and remediation. Addresses client needs which span the organization and impact strategy, operations, performance and reputation.

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 6+ years of experience in healthcare fraud and/or program integrity
  • 6+ years of experience supporting programs identifying and mitigating fraud, waste, or abuse. 
  • Ability to travel 5-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate Manager - IAM PBAC Architect/Engineer
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte’s Cyber Operate offering helps organizations operate and evolve critical cyber capabilities, including identity and access management. As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II, you will lead the design, implementation, and evolution of policy-based access control (PBAC) and broader identity and access management (IAM) solutions for large, highly regulated client environments. You will combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership to strengthen security, support regulatory compliance, and help clients manage access at scale.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

  • Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of PBAC and IAM solutions for complex, regulated client environments.
  • Translate business and security requirements into IAM architectures, controls, implementation plans, and technology roadmaps.
  • Build and maintain automated provisioning, de-provisioning, and access-control workflows.
  • Assess IAM controls and vulnerabilities, troubleshoot access issues, and lead root-cause remediation that minimizes business disruption.
  • Lead technical workstreams, maintain IAM documentation, deliver enablement on IAM policies and procedures, and mentor team members.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in “Computer Science” or Information Systems.
  • 6+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), including Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC), identity governance, automated provisioning and de-provisioning, enterprise access management, and IAM security audits.
  • Experience building IAM automation using Python or PowerShell and working with Active Directory or Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), Okta or Azure Active Directory, and Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Open Authorization (OAuth), or OpenID Connect.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree.
  • Current Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), or a vendor-specific identity and access management or cloud security certification.
  • Experience supporting financial services organizations, including banking, insurance, or capital markets environments.
  • Experience supporting security operations, threat intelligence, application security, or continuous compliance services.
  • Experience with PlainID or Axiomatics.
  • Experience leading IAM technical workstreams, technology roadmaps, or process-improvement initiatives.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 to $265,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate Manager - Identity Security Architect & Product Engineering
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Join Deloitte as a Lead Managed Services Engineer II and help design, engineer, and deploy identity security capabilities across enterprise environments. You will advance attack path analysis, identity threat protection, authentication modernization, policy-based access control (PBAC), and identity-driven attack containment. Working across cybersecurity, infrastructure, engineering, architecture, product, and vendor teams, you will deliver scalable solutions using Sgnl.ai, PlainID, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and CrowdStrike Identity Protection. This role combines identity and access management (IAM) architecture, Zero Trust, and product engineering to help clients reduce risk, strengthen resilience, and improve access experiences. This role may require work outside standard business hours based on business needs.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Define identity security roadmaps and architecture standards aligned with Zero Trust for authentication, authorization, access governance, and workforce, privileged, and machine identities.
  • Partner with product vendors and internal teams to translate business requirements into identity and access management solutions across enterprise applications and infrastructure.
  • Lead product engineering and deployment for Sgnl.ai, PlainID, CrowdStrike Identity Protection, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and authentication and authorization platforms.
  • Expand attack path analysis, identity threat detection, risk scoring, and identity-driven attack containment to address identity-based attack vectors, privilege escalation paths, lateral movement, and access risks.
  • Advance authentication services, including authenticator capabilities and access-experience improvements, alongside adaptive access, PBAC, identity-aware authorization, and risk-based access decisions using identity intelligence and continuous verification.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of Experience designing identity and access management (IAM) architecture for workforce, privileged, and machine identities, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), single sign-on (SSO), multifactor authentication (MFA), identity governance, privileged access management (PAM), federation, and authentication protocols.
  • Experience engineering, integrating, and operationalizing Sgnl.ai, PlainID, CrowdStrike Identity Protection, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) across enterprise applications and infrastructure.
  • Experience applying Zero Trust Architecture, identity threat detection and response (ITDR), attack path analysis, authorization frameworks, PBAC, and risk-based authentication; integrating platforms using application programming interfaces (APIs), identity protocols, automation, and cloud-native architectures.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, IAM, identity architecture, or security engineering.
  • Experience leading identity transformation programs for organizations subject to regulatory requirements.
  • Experience applying National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) and Zero Trust frameworks.
  • One or more of the following certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), Azure Security Engineer, or customer identity and access management (CIAM) or identity and access management (IAM) certification.
  • Master’s degree.

Job.JobTitle: Child Welfare Business Analyst - Human Service Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $71,300 to $118,900 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Lake Mary, FL
  • Experience: 2+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Business Analyst supporting technology and business transformation for child welfare systems at Deloitte's Government and Public Services practice. You will gather requirements, analyze business needs, document processes, and support system implementation for state government clients.

Good fit if you have 2+ years of business analysis experience, strong communication skills, and experience with SDLC activities and requirements documentation.

Full job description

Position Summary

We are seeking a Business Analyst to support the planning, analysis, testing, and implementation of technology and business transformation solutions for Deloitte’s Government and Public Services practice. In this role, you will work closely with clients, project teams, and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business needs, improve processes, and support successful project delivery. The ideal candidate brings foundational business analysis experience, strong analytical and communication skills, and the ability to support initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.

Work You'll Do

As a Project - Child Welfare Business Analyst (Delivery Engineer II) on the Government and Public Services team, you will be responsible for:

  • Supporting the elicitation, analysis, documentation, and validation of business, functional, and technical requirements
  • Collaborating with clients, stakeholders, and project teams to understand business objectives, operational challenges, and program needs
  • Documenting business processes, workflows, use cases, user stories, business rules, and functional specifications
  • Supporting system implementation activities, including requirements traceability, testing coordination, defect management, and deployment readiness
  • Assisting in facilitating stakeholder meetings, requirement workshops, and process improvement discussions
  • Analyzing data, identifying trends, and developing recommendations to support business and technology decisions
  • Contributing to project deliverables, status reporting, and client-facing communications
  • Supporting business process improvement, organizational change, and technology modernization initiatives
  • Staying apprised of developments across the broader child support market, including program, policy, and technology trends, and sharing relevant insights with the project team

A Successful Candidate Would Possess These Skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships with clients and team members
  • Ability to facilitate discussions and gather information from diverse stakeholder groups
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Ability to lead project tasks or workstreams with limited supervision
  • Ability to mentor and provide guidance to junior team members
  • Ability to meet deadlines while balancing competing priorities

The Team

Deloitte’s Government and Public Services practice brings together people, ideas, technology, and outcomes to help clients make an impact. Serving federal, state, and local government clients, as well as public higher education institutions, the team helps organizations anticipate disruption, rethink what is possible, and advance their mission.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Information Systems, Health & Human Services, Social Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field
  • 2+ years of professional experience supporting business analysis, system implementation, technology modernization, or business process improvement initiatives
  • 2+ years of experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements, user stories, business processes, workflows, and functional specifications
  • Experience supporting Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) activities including requirements management, design reviews, testing, defect triage, and implementation readiness
  • Experience using Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, or comparable business analysis tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements
  • Ability to travel 0-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • Experience with Child Support services from either a client or industry perspective 
  • Experience working on state government technology modernization or large-scale system implementation initiatives
  • Experience documenting current-state and future-state business processes, use cases, business rules, operational procedures, and process improvement recommendations
  • Experience working with Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or hybrid project delivery methodologies
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder workshops, requirements sessions, user acceptance testing (UAT), and process design discussions
  • Familiarity with requirements management and collaboration tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $71,300 to $118,900.

Position Summary

Lead the design and delivery of artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled customer experiences across marketing, commerce, sales, and service. As a Customer AI Solution Architect, you will help clients identify AI use cases, design solutions that align with front-office platforms and operating models, and guide delivery from prototypes to production. You will act as a senior individual contributor with client technology executives and architects while leading a Deloitte team of developers and engineers through delivery. You will also establish reusable architecture patterns and engineering standards that support delivery across programs.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 27, 2027

Work you'll do

As a Customer AI Solution Architect, you will be responsible for designing and delivering AI-enabled customer experiences from discovery through production. You will…

  • Architect agentic customer experiences for marketing, commerce, sales, and service, including customer assistants, conversational commerce, personalization, sales enablement, and support experiences.
  • Design agentic systems that address orchestration, planning, tool use, state management, retrieval, memory, model selection, routing, failure handling, and cost management; determine when agentic approaches add value over deterministic workflows.
  • Integrate AI solutions with front-office platforms and enterprise services using composable, headless, application programming interface (API)-led, and event-driven architectures; account for identity, consent, real-time data, security, and experience latency.
  • Embed oversight and safeguards through human approvals, escalation and override paths, scoped permissions, prompt-injection defenses, personally identifiable information (PII) handling, audit logging, and privacy and data-residency controls.
  • Lead architecture and security reviews with client stakeholders, resolve design issues, and coach technical teams on reference architectures, reusable patterns, and engineering standards.
  • Lead and manage a Deloitte team of developers and engineers: set technical direction, plan and assign work, run design and code reviews, manage delivery quality and risk, and develop team members through coaching and feedback.
  • Lead rapid prototypes and production delivery using AI-accelerated engineering practices; establish practices for AI evaluation, regression testing, observability, drift and latency monitoring, cost tracking, and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD); and partner with stakeholders to prioritize use cases, define AI-enabled and AI-native experiences, and connect delivery to business and customer outcomes.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead and manage technical teams, projects, or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing and Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience architecting and delivering high-performance enterprise technology solutions (for example, web, mobile, commerce, CRM, or integration platforms), including work that predates generative AI.
  • Hands-on experience designing and delivering two or more artificial intelligence (AI) solutions or agentic systems deployed in production and used by real customers or employees, in one or more of marketing, commerce, sales, or service.
  • Hands-on experience designing agentic systems deployed in production that include orchestration, tool integration, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), context assembly, agent memory, model selection, routing, and failure handling.
  • Hands-on production experience with at least one agent framework, such as LangGraph, Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), Claude Agent Software Development Kit (SDK), or Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and foundation-model application programming interfaces (APIs) for prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, tool use, prompt versioning, or model evaluation.
  • Hands-on experience integrating deployed AI solutions with enterprise platforms through APIs or event-driven architectures and addressing identity, consent, real-time data, security, privacy, and data-residency requirements.
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Good fit if you have 8+ years technology experience, 6+ years in cybersecurity or risk management, and can obtain US Government security clearance.

Full job description

Position Summary

Are you passionate about technology and interested in joining a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo? If so, read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity with Deloitte Technology US (DT - US). We are curious and life-long learners focused on technology and innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/14/2026.

Work you’ll do

The GPS BISO Consultant works with technical and non-technical stakeholders to support the Government and Public Services (GPS) Business Information Security Officer (BISO) function. The Consultant applies cybersecurity expertise to assess risks, recommend mitigation approaches, and help maintain the security posture of systems and applications that support business operations and client delivery.

The role supports the development of IT solutions by contributing to security reviews of solution architectures, particularly cloud-based solutions. Responsibilities include helping define security requirements, design specifications, and compliance controls, and assessing alignment with security policies, standards, and industry practices. Working across technical and business teams, the Consultant helps apply a consistent security approach while supporting evolving technology, innovation, and cloud migration needs.

. 

Responsibilities:

  • Review detailed application security architecture for GPS solutions.
  • Integrate security requirements into DevOps processes. Ensure application development follows Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to solution architects, developers, technical risk analysts, and others on information security principles, standards, and best practices.
  • Assist in the socialization and adoption of enterprise security and compliance requirements.
  • Create and validate application security requirements to meet business goals.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving application security threats and counsel development, business, and risk stakeholders.
  • Maintain awareness of AI tools and technologies; influence roadmaps to align with business needs.
  • Oversee and drive the design and implementation of application security controls in support of compliance requirements.

Deloitte Technology US (DT - US) helps power Deloitte’s success. DT - US drives Deloitte, which serves many of the world’s largest, most respected organizations. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Cyber Security

Cyber Security vigilantly protects Deloitte and client data. Using situational awareness, threat intelligence, and building a security culture across the organization, the team helps to protect the Deloitte brand.

Preferred:

Must be able to plan, drive and deliver on assigned projects and initiatives with minimal supervision
  • GCP or Azure Cloud training or experience

Job.JobTitle: Integrated Eligibility Business Analyst - Human Service Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary


We are seeking a Business Analyst to support the planning, analysis, testing, and implementation of technology and business transformation solutions for Deloitte’s Government and Public Services practice. In this role, you will work closely with clients, project teams, and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business needs, improve processes, and support successful project delivery. The ideal candidate brings foundational business analysis experience, strong analytical and communication skills, and the ability to support initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.

Work You'll Do

As a Project - Integrated Eligibility Business Analyst (Delivery Engineer II) on the Government and Public Services team, you will be responsible for:

  • Support analysis and documentation of eligibility policies, business rules, and operational processes for public sector health and human services programs, including Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, and related benefit programs. 
  • Collaborate with eligibility workers, policy staff, and program stakeholders to translate legislation, policy guidance, and operational requirements into system requirements and business processes. 
  • Support eligibility determination design, case management workflows, notices, enrollment processes, interfaces, and program operations within integrated eligibility environments. 
  • Assist with development and execution of user acceptance testing (UAT), scenario-based testing, and validation of eligibility outcomes against policy requirements. 
  • Analyze defects, operational issues, and enhancement requests to identify business impacts and support resolution planning.

A Successful Candidate Would Possess These Skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships with clients and team members
  • Ability to facilitate discussions and gather information from diverse stakeholder groups
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Ability to lead project tasks or workstreams with limited supervision
  • Ability to mentor and provide guidance to junior team members
  • Ability to meet deadlines while balancing competing priorities

The Team

Deloitte’s Government and Public Services practice brings together people, ideas, technology, and outcomes to help clients make an impact. Serving federal, state, and local government clients, as well as public higher education institutions, the team helps organizations anticipate disruption, rethink what is possible, and advance their mission.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Information Systems, Health & Human Services, Social Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field
  • 2+ years of professional experience supporting business analysis, system implementation, technology modernization, or business process improvement initiatives
  • 2+ years of experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements, user stories, business processes, workflows, and functional specifications
  • Experience supporting Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) activities including requirements management, design reviews, testing, defect triage, and implementation readiness
  • Experience using Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, or comparable business analysis tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements
  • Ability to travel 0-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred

  • Experience supporting Integrated Eligibility and Enrollment (IE&E) systems within Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, CHIP, Child Care, or other public assistance programs. 
  • Experience interpreting federal or state eligibility policy and translating policy requirements into business rules, workflows, and system requirements. 
  • Experience supporting eligibility determination, benefits issuance, case maintenance, renewals, notices, or enrollment functions. 
  • Experience developing test scenarios, expected results, and UAT materials for complex eligibility and enrollment programs. 
  • Experience working directly with eligibility workers, policy teams, and state agency stakeholders. 
  • Familiarity with CMS, HHS, Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, or other human services policy environments.
