About this job

Engineering Manager II leading Active Directory and identity infrastructure engagements for Deloitte Cyber, covering assessment, design, migration, and implementation. Requires 6+ years in Active Directory engineering and technical consulting with hands-on experience in enterprise infrastructure.

Good fit if you have 6+ years of Active Directory engineering experience and can lead identity infrastructure projects with strong technical and communication skills.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/01/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Engineering Manager II on the Deloitte Cyber team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading Active Directory and identity infrastructure engagements across assessment, design, migration, implementation, stabilization, and post-implementation phases.
  • Performing and overseeing Active Directory assessments covering domain and forest architecture, domain controllers, Sites and Services, Domain Name System (DNS), Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP), replication, trusts, Group Policy, privileged groups, service accounts, authentication protocols, and administrative processes.
  • Designing and implementing Active Directory security and hardening improvements, including administrative tiering, role-based access controls, service account management, Group Policy controls, and identity threat detection and recovery capabilities.
  • Architecting and supporting enterprise Active Directory environments, including hybrid identity integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, federation, synchronization services, and application dependencies.
  • Leading or supporting domain and forest migrations, separations, and consolidations, including discovery, dependency analysis, cutover planning, validation, rollback, and post-migration stabilization.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Cyber’s Digital Trust & Privacy practice helps organizations build and sustain confidence in their digital products, platforms, services, data practices, and customer experiences. Our work brings together digital trust, online protection, privacy, AI governance, identity, data protection, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance capabilities.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, another technical field.
  • 6+ years of experience in technical consulting, enterprise infrastructure, identity security, or Active Directory engineering.
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience designing, securing, assessing, migrating, or operating Microsoft Active Directory environments.
  • Experience with enterprise Active Directory services, including domain and forest architecture, domain controllers and replication, DNS, DHCP, Sites and Services, Group Policy, trusts, service accounts, Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), and domain or forest recovery.
  • Experience leading or supporting Active Directory domain or forest migrations, separations, or consolidations.
  • Experience with migration tooling such as Quest On Demand Migration (ODM) or Semperis migration capabilities.
  • Experience with identity threat detection, identity resilience, cyber recovery, or recovery validation tooling such as Semperis, Rubrik, or Microsoft Defender for Identity.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or another technical field.
  • Experience with Active Directory security assessments, attack-path analysis, domain hardening, and privileged access management.
  • Experience with enterprise identity security architectures, including Enhanced Security Administrative Environment (ESAE), tiered administration, administrative forests, or privileged access workstations.
  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, spin-offs, or enterprise reorganizations involving Active Directory environments.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, federation, synchronization, multifactor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), or hybrid identity architectures.
  • Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK), Microsoft SC-300, or Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA).

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $105,400 to $207,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Fort Lauderdale, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Forward Deployed Engineer working with strategic insurance clients to design and implement AI-powered claims solutions using Deloitte's ClaimBeacon platform. You'll embed with clients to understand technical challenges, build POCs, and guide architecture decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, and cloud platforms.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of software engineering experience, deep Java and Spring Boot expertise, knowledge of event-driven architecture and microservices, and comfort with client-facing technical roles.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Team

Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte’s Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented individual with an innovative mindset to join the Converge for FSI team in our mission to develop differentiated financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This role is focused on ClaimBeacon, Deloitte’s AI-powered claims solution. ClaimBeacon is a managed, agentic AI platform integrated with Guidewire that helps insurance carriers modernize the claims experience for both customers and Claims Adjusters. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte’s innovation and product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities.

Position Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled and client-facing Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer partnership. In this role, you will embed directly with our most strategic clients — particularly in the financial services sector — to understand their toughest technical challenges and help them design and implement world-class solutions using our platform. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with direct influence on product direction.

You are equally comfortable whiteboarding microservices architecture with a client's principal engineer, running a hands-on technical workshop for a team of developers, and standing up a compelling proof-of-concept in days. You thrive in fast-moving, high-stakes environments and know how to earn the trust of deeply technical stakeholders.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/3/2026. (if posted in Colorado)

Work you’ll do

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for strategic client accounts, building deep relationships with architects, engineers, and technical leaders
  • Lead discovery sessions to understand client architectures, pain points, and business objectives
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Collaborate with client architects and internal engineering teams to design scalable, production-ready solutions
  • Provide authoritative guidance on microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and cloud-native deployment patterns
  • Review and advise on client system designs, identifying risks and recommending best practices
  • Rapidly prototype and build POCs that demonstrate platform value in the context of a client's real-world use cases
  • Own and deliver polished, technically rigorous demos tailored to the client's specific technology stack and business domain
  • Maintain a library of reusable demo assets and reference implementations
  • Design and facilitate deep-dive technical workshops, hackathons, and onboarding bootcamps for client engineering teams
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides
  • Accelerate client time-to-value by enabling their teams to build confidently and independently
  • Act as the voice of the customer — surface product gaps, integration friction, and feature requests to internal product and engineering teams
  • Partner with Sales, Solutions Architecture, and Product to shape the technical go-to-market strategy

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot, including building production-grade microservices
  • Strong understanding of event-driven architecture — Kafka, event sourcing, CQRS, async messaging patterns
  • Hands-on experience with microservices design principles: service decomposition, API design, resiliency patterns, observability
  • Proficiency across multi-cloud environments, with AWS as a primary platform; working knowledge of Azure and GCP
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Exposure to Agentic AI frameworks and tooling — including LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration frameworks
  • Practical understanding of LLM integration patterns, prompt engineering, and AI-powered application design
  • Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client-relevant use cases
  • Exceptional communicator — able to lead technical conversations with senior engineers and C-suite stakeholders alike
  • Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions
  • Self-directed, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously
  • Natural curiosity and a bias for building — you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one

Qualifications 

Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing or equivalent field. MBA a plus.
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent in client-facing, solutions engineering, or field engineering roles
  • Ability to travel 20-30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Background in insurance strongly preferred, particularly with claims or policy administration systems
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices
  • Contributions to open-source projects or public technical content (talks, blogs, repos)
  • Prior experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment
  • Relevant cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional, etc.)

Job ID 373195

Quick facts

  • Pay: $86,700 to $170,900 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 3+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Design and build omnichannel customer journeys using Adobe Journey Optimizer and Target for B2B and B2C clients. You'll integrate customer data from CDPs and content from CMS platforms to deliver personalized experiences across email, SMS, push, in-app, and web channels.

Good fit if you have 3+ years in marketing technology and 2+ years hands-on with Adobe Journey Optimizer or comparable journey orchestration platform.

Full job description

Position Summary

As a consultant supporting personalization and journey orchestration, you will help clients design, build, test, and optimize real-time, omnichannel customer experiences across B2B and B2C. You will work hands-on in Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) and Adobe Target, connecting customer data from CDPs and content from CMS platforms to deliver relevant, timely engagement across email, SMS, push, in-app, and web. You will collaborate with business and technical teams to translate marketing strategy into practical, high-quality solutions that drive customer and commercial outcomes, and you will help clients stay ahead as the MarTech and AI landscape evolves.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 26, 2027

Work you'll do

As a Personalization and Journey Orchestration Consultant, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, configuring, and launching end-to-end B2C and B2B customer journeys in Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), including triggers, audiences, actions, messages, and orchestration logic
  • Building rules, conditional logic, and decisioning to orchestrate multi-step journeys and deliver 1:1 personalization based on customer attributes, behaviors, and real-time events
  • Configuring AJO channel surfaces for email, SMS, push notification, and in-app messaging, and supporting deliverability practices such as subdomain setup and IP warming
  • Planning, building, and executing personalization tests in Adobe Target, including A/B, multivariate, and experience targeting activities, and analyzing results to inform optimization recommendations
  • Integrating customer data from CDPs, such as Adobe Real-Time CDP, Segment, or Tealium, to support unified profiles, audience activation, and cross-channel measurement
  • Integrating content from CMS platforms, such as Adobe Experience Manager, to enable modular, reusable, and dynamic content across journeys and personalized experiences
  • Partnering with clients and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into journey designs, document solutions, and support technical design, implementation, and hand-off to client teams
  • Exploring, piloting, and recommending new platform capabilities, including emerging AI-driven features, and sharing what you learn with your team and clients

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • A pioneering mindset: curious, adaptable, and energized by learning new platforms, features, and ways of working as the tool landscape evolves
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to business stakeholders
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead small projects or workstreams with increasing independence
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others and share knowledge through training and enablement

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey — AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of experience in marketing technology, customer data, personalization, or digital campaign management
  • 2+ years of hands-on implementation experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) or a comparable journey orchestration platform, including journeys, triggers, actions, messages, and audiences
  • Experience designing and executing personalization and journey orchestration for both B2B and B2C use cases
  • Hands-on experience setting up and running tests in Adobe Target (or a comparable testing and personalization platform), including A/B testing, activities, audiences, and results analysis
  • Experience integrating data from CDPs (such as Adobe Real-Time CDP, Segment, or Tealium) to support audience activation, profile attributes, and journey triggers, with working knowledge of data models such as XDM
  • Experience integrating content from CMS platforms (such as Adobe Experience Manager) into personalized experiences and campaigns
  • Strong understanding of marketing campaign strategy and customer lifecycle, with the ability to translate functional requirements into technical journey designs
  • Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn new platforms and adapt to a changing MarTech landscape
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience with additional Adobe Experience Cloud products, such as Adobe Experience Platform, Customer Journey Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or Adobe Marketo Engage
  • Exposure to or experience with real-time decisioning and next-best-action or offer personalization (such as Adobe Journey Optimizer Decisioning, Salesforce, or Pega), including eligibility and prioritization rules.
  • Experience with other MarTech or CRM platforms, such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce, or Braze
  • Adobe Certified Expert or Adobe Certified Professional credential in Journey Optimizer, Target, Experience Platform, or a related Adobe Experience Cloud product
  • Understanding of or experience with AI in marketing, such as AJO decisioning and AI-driven personalization, AJO Experimentation, AEP AI Assistant, or generative AI for content and journey design
  • Experience with API-first configuration, event-driven integrations, and custom actions in AJO
  • Familiarity with SQL, JavaScript, or Python, and with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or major cloud providers
  • Experience training client teams or mentoring junior team members
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

  • Ensure user visible uptime and quality, providing operational and development expertise in making our systems fail rarely, and fast to fix when they do fail

In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

    • Experience in building, deploying and monitoring AWS services with strong IaaS and PaaS services (Redis Cache, Service Bus, Event Hub, Cloud Service etc.)

  • Strong experience with instrumentation, monitoring, alerting, and responding relative to performance and availability of application

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $93,000 to $155,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 8+ years

About this job

Manage complex, high-value Federal subcontracts and serve as a business advisor to account teams on contract administration. Role focuses on strategic negotiations, compliance, portfolio management, and supporting win strategies on Federal engagements.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in subcontracts administration, 5+ years with Federal Acquisition Regulations, and experience with multiple contract types.

Full job description

Position Summary

Possesses knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulations and commercial contracting principles. Demonstrates expert skill in managing a personal portfolio. Advises account teams on contract administration matters. Serves as a business advisor to account teams on all parts of Federal contract administration. Handles complex and high-value sub-contract matters that impact Firm revenue and retention. Uses independent judgment and analysis to resolve significant issues. Provides advisory subcontracts support to account leadership. Shapes and strengthens win strategies on Federal engagements. Performs strategic subcontract negotiations and completes various subcontract projects. Connects with strategic subcontract companies and maintains collaborative relationships with them.

Reviews and analyzes subcontracts to ensure understanding and inform the team's strategy. Compiles and analyzes subcontract data. Enters data in several internal databases and maintains historical information and documentation.

Proactively identifies and analyzes subcontracting issues. Solves standard and routine subcontract activities. Keeps teams fully informed on all subcontract standards, plans, and policies. Develops and maintains subcontract files according to government regulations and Deloitte’s procurement policies. Ensures timely filing and reporting of subcontract data entry into various systems. Monitors data updates.

Work you'll do

As a Specialist Manager, Procurement and Category Management on the Enterprise Contract Management & Operations team, you will:

  • Serve as a trusted business advisor to account teams on all aspects of Federal contract administration.
  • Handle complex and strategic high-value subcontract matters that directly impact the firm's revenue generation and retention.
  • Exercise independent judgment and analysis to identify and resolve significant issues.
  • Provide advisory-level subcontract support to account leadership, shaping and strengthening win strategies on Federal engagements.
  • Guides and coordinates proposals and award activities for assigned subcontracts. Provides guidance to internal teams for all phases of the subcontract lifecycle.
  • Independently reviews complex subcontract actions in all phases of the subcontract life cycle. Develops and implements tactical action plans to address risks and opportunities. Supports the development, review, and negotiation of subcontracts, modifications, subcontractor NDA, and teaming agreements consistent with company policies.
  • Responsible for compliance and accuracy of subcontracts administration for assigned portfolio. Reviews Federal solicitations and supports Subcontractor Requests for Proposals. Prepares documentation for Deloitte proposals in response to Subcontractor pricing, narratives, and consent requirements.
  • Manages individual workload to meet project deadlines on time and in compliance. Completes accurate deliverables for both internal and external clients.
  • Collaborates with other enabling areas to address complex subcontracts administration and proposal challenges.
  • Accurately and quickly enters subcontract data into different systems. Monitors data updates. Resolves contract document discrepancies and ensures data quality and accuracy.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

The team

The Enterprise Contract Management & Operations team is responsible for contract administration activities supporting strategic enterprise contract vehicles across Deloitte’s Government and Public Services practice. This role will work directly with Contracts professionals, Project Engagement Leadership, Enabling Solutions points of contact, and other internal stakeholders to coordinate the information and decisions required to support compliant contract management and operational execution

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 8+ years of experience in subcontracts administration
  • 5+ years of experience in Federal Acquisition Regulations and commercial contracting principles.
  • 3+ years of experience in managing personal portfolios and advising on contract administration.
  • Experience purchasing hardware and software or SaaS solutions, and other IT related products
  • 1+ years of experience with the Federal Acquisition Lifecycle
  • 1+ years of experience managing multiple contract types (e.g. T&M, FFP, FFP/LOE, CPFF, CPIF, CPAF,) and solicitation types
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • CPSR experience
  • Advanced degree and/or master's certificate NCMA: CFCM, CCCM, or CPCM.
  • Experience working with either Federal government procurements
  • Demonstrated experience in negotiating, and leveraging value added reseller agreements
  • Demonstrated proficiency with MS Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Strong consultative skills
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively and work collaboratively with teams

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.

Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking a results-oriented professional to join our AI & Data Energy, Resources & Industrials - Energy & Chemicals (ER&I-E&C) team, building data- and AI-enabled solutions for upstream oil and gas operations. The role may focus on subsurface and well data—including seismic interpretation, well logs, drilling and completions, reservoir models, production history, and well performance—as well as data engineering, integration, quality, governance, and analytics across exploration, appraisal, development, and production. You will combine knowledge of upstream workflows with hands-on skills in data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML to help clients make better-informed technical and operational decisions. This role will contribute to client engagements, develop scalable data products and analytics solutions, and grow alongside high-performing teams.

Work you’ll do

As a Data Engineer III on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for:

  • Supporting delivery of data and analytics engagements for upstream oil and gas clients across exploration, appraisal, development, and production
  • Integrating, profiling, and analyzing upstream data, including seismic interpretations, well logs, drilling and completions records, reservoir models, and production histories
  • Developing data pipelines and models that connect wells, wells bores, completions, formations, reservoirs, facilities, and production measurements
  • Applying data-quality, governance, metadata, and lineage practices to improve trust in upstream data products
  • Building analytics and AI/ML solutions for use cases such as well planning, production surveillance, reservoir management, and asset performance
  • Developing dashboards and visualizations that help technical and operational teams turn data into decisions
  • Collaborating with geoscientists, petrophysicists, reservoir and production engineers, drilling teams, data specialists, and client stakeholders to shape solutions and delivery plans
  • Documenting workflows, data definitions, assumptions, and analytical findings for technical and business audiences
  • Preparing client-ready deliverables, workshop materials, and presentations
  • Supporting pursuits and proposal content as needed
  • Contributing to practice assets and accelerators, and mentoring junior practitioners

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our AI & Data practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of consulting or industry technology experience delivering data, analytics, and artificial intelligence solutions for Energy & Chemicals domain
  • 2+ years hands-on experience with:
    • upstream workflows spanning exploration, drilling and completions, reservoir management, and production operations
    • upstream data standards or platforms, including WITSML, PRODML, RESQML, or OSDU
    • well, log, seismic, drilling, completion, reservoir, or production data formats and applications
  • 4+ years experience with SQL and Python (or R) for data analysis and modeling
  • 2+ years experience leading project workstreams and/or project teams, with resources in multiple locations
  • Bachelor’s degree in data engineering, computer science, petroleum engineering, geoscience, or a related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

  • Client-facing consulting experience, including working with teams across multiple locations
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Experience with emerging technologies (such as GenAI) and advanced data architectures (i.e., Data Mesh, Data Fabric, Data Products, etc.)
  • Experience with Business Intelligence and visualization tools (such as TIBCO Spotfire, Power BI or Tableau)
  • Experience translating business needs into data and analytical requirements and to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences

Job.JobTitle: Quantum Computing - Senior Quantum Research Scientist - Fault Tolerant Quantum Computing, Research & Delivery_Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

Innovation & Delivery Transformation is an organization within Deloitte Consulting that manages a portfolio of emerging technology investments spanning multiple time horizons. Our mission is to accelerate the next generation of technology-driven Consulting offerings. The Quantum Computing team will drive the ecosystem, capability and solution development to drive the impact of quantum technologies across all industries and clients we serve, with the aim of establishing Deloitte as a thought leader and Firm of choice for transformative and disruptive quantum technology.

Position Summary

Do you have a passion for innovation and emerging technologies, along with deep technical expertise in fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC), quantum error correction, and resource estimation? Would you like to be a part of the development of a new firm offering? We are currently seeking an experienced SeniorQuantum Research Scientist -- Fault Tolerant Quantum Computing to advance FTQC research within our quantum computing offering.

As a Senior Research Scientist within the Research & Delivery workstream, you will lead technically complex research at the intersection of fault-tolerant algorithms, quantum error correction, logical operations, and resource estimation. You will translate complex research questions into rigorous, reproducible analyses; assess what results do and do not support; and turn findings into technical roadmaps, prototypes, and recommendations for clients and offering leaders. As a senior technical contributor, you will provide subject-matter expertise, mentor colleagues, and help establish high standards for research rigor, reproducibility, and communication.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/26.

Work You’ll Do

You will own research workstreams focused on FTQC, working closely with quantum researchers, engineers, product teams, domain experts, and business stakeholders to assess technical feasibility and client relevance.

  • Define and prioritize FTQC research questions and workplans based on technical promise, computational feasibility, resource requirements, and relevance to client and offering needs.
  • Lead investigations in one or more areas of FTQC, including fault-tolerant algorithms (e.g., phase estimation, qubitization, QSVT), quantum error correction, decoding (e.g., surface codes, qLDPC), logical operations, and resource estimation.
  • Design, implement, and document reproducible experiments, simulations, benchmarks, and resource estimates using Python and relevant quantum software and research tools.
  • Evaluate quantum approaches against relevant classical baselines, alternative methods, and plausible hardware or architecture assumptions, including performance, scalability, error considerations, and potential business value.
  • Track developments in FTQC research, conferences, hardware architectures, and the broader technology landscape, and translate relevant developments into implications for clients and the Quantum Offering.
  • Synthesize research findings into clear recommendations, technical roadmaps, capability assessments, and analyses of limitations, uncertainty, open questions, and potential client preparation needs.
  • Partner with Product Engineering to translate validated research into prototypes, reusable assets, technical requirements, and engineering priorities.
  • Serve as a technical subject-matter expert in client discussions, proposals, demonstrations, and ecosystem collaborations.
  • Mentor researchers and engineers, providing constructive technical review to establish standards for rigor, reproducibility, and communication.

Required Skills:

  • Doctoral degree in Quantum Information Science, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant research or development experience, including independently leading technically complex work from problem framing through analysis and communication of conclusions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in fault-tolerant quantum computing, with substantial depth in fault-tolerant algorithms and resource estimation.
  • Strong understanding of quantum error correction, logical operations, decoding, and the relationship between algorithm design, architecture, and computational resources.
  • Hands-on ability to implement, reproduce, benchmark, or critically evaluate quantum algorithms using Python and relevant quantum software, simulation, or resource-estimation tools (e.g., Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, CUDA-Q).
  • Experience designing experiments, establishing appropriate classical baselines, interpreting results, and documenting methods, assumptions, limitations, and conclusions.
  • Ability to connect technical research to client needs, business outcomes, and Quantum Offering priorities.
  • Publications, preprints, conference presentations, open-source contributions, or other evidence of technical invention or contribution in quantum computing.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical findings, uncertainty, and tradeoffs to technical and business audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across research, engineering, product, consulting, and business teams and to provide technical guidance and mentorship to colleagues.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, based on business needs and the clients and industries served.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with quantum error correction codes, decoders, logical gates, and magic-state distillation.
  • Experience with high-performance computing and GPU-accelerated methods, including classical simulation for developing strong performance baselines.
  • Experience with resource-estimation tools, quantum simulation environments, or quantum cloud platforms (e.g., Azure Quantum Resource Estimator, AWS Braket, IBM Quantum).
  • Experience collaborating with quantum hardware teams, technology vendors, academic groups, or industry partners.
  • Experience translating research into prototypes, technical roadmaps, client materials, or emerging-technology offerings.
  • Domain experience in an FTQC application area, such as quantum chemistry and many-body simulation, financial modelling and risk, or optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of ambiguous technical problems and move them toward evidence-based, pragmatic conclusions in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 - $265,100.

Job.JobDescription:

Would you like to be a part of the development of a new firm offering? We are currently seeking an experienced Quantum Research Manager to lead the Research & Delivery workstream and help build and scale our quantum computing offering.

As a Manager, you will lead a portfolio of applied quantum research and client-facing delivery. You will set research priorities, guide teams in developing and evaluating quantum algorithms and quantum-inspired approaches, oversee prototypes and technical analyses, and translate rigorous findings into client insights, use cases, capability roadmaps, and recommendations. You will bring advanced technical judgment and research leadership to assess where quantum capabilities are technically credible, economically relevant, and applicable to business problems.

Work You’ll Do

You will lead a multidisciplinary research and delivery team spanning quantum computing, quantum-inspired methods, and quantum AI. You will work closely with Product Engineering, Operations & Client Delivery, Strategy and Growth, Alliances & Ecosystems, and external technology and research partners to advance Deloitte’s quantum capabilities, solutions, and ecosystem.

  • Translate Quantum Offering priorities and client needs into research questions, technical priorities, objectives, milestones, and measures of progress.

  • Coach and develop researchers and technical leads, fostering scientific rigor, collaboration, and clear communication.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and winning competitive proposals, including shaping the technical solution, estimating scope and effort, articulating differentiated value, and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders and clients.
  • Experience structuring and managing a research or technical portfolio, including prioritization, planning, progress tracking, risk management, and outcome reporting.

  • Experience mentoring or developing researchers, engineers, technical leads, or other technical professionals.
  • Experience collaborating across research, engineering, consulting, product, business, or other multidisciplinary teams.
  • Publications, patents, conference presentations, open-source contributions, or other evidence of technical invention or contribution.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical findings, recommendations, and tradeoffs to senior technical and business audiences.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, based on business needs and the clients and industries served.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with fault-tolerant quantum computing, quantum error correction, resource estimation, or benchmarking quantum approaches against classical baselines.
  • Significant experience with Python and one or more quantum software development kits or frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of systems engineering, technical architecture, and solution integration.
  • Experience applying machine learning, optimization, linear programming, or related quantitative methods to business problems.
  • Experience with client delivery, new product development, hybrid business models, or go-to-market activation.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships with senior internal and external stakeholders, including technology providers, startups, academic institutions, and other ecosystem partners.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and demonstrated ability to operate collaboratively in a rapidly evolving emerging-technology environment.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

Innovation & Delivery Transformation is an organization within Deloitte Consulting that manages a portfolio of emerging technology investments spanning multiple time horizons. Our mission is to accelerate the next generation of technology-driven Consulting offerings. The Quantum Computing team will drive the ecosystem, capability and solution development to drive the impact of quantum technologies across all industries and clients we serve, with the aim of establishing Deloitte as a thought leader and Firm of choice for transformative and disruptive quantum technology.

Position Summary

Do you have a passion for innovation and emerging technologies, along with a practical application of quantum computing? Would you like to be a part of the development of a new firm offering? We are currently seeking an experienced Quantum Product & Engineering Manager to help build and scale our quantum computing offering.

As a Manager, you will lead a team of Quantum Product Software Engineers while remaining hands-on in the technical work. You will manage engineering projects that transform quantum algorithms, research code, and experimental prototypes into production-ready software for Deloitte products and client solutions. Working across a matrixed organization, you will partner with quantum researchers, product and solution engineers, and business stakeholders to translate emerging research into scalable, supportable, and commercially relevant capabilities.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/26.

Work You’ll Do

This role combines leadership, technical delivery, product engineering, and client service. You will lead internal engineering initiatives, contribute to client-facing projects, and establish the structure, quality practices, and delivery discipline needed to operationalize quantum and quantum-inspired technologies.

  • Manage Quantum Product Software Engineers by providing technical direction, coaching, feedback, work review, and support for career development and performance.
  • Structure and manage projects that transform quantum research into production-ready capabilities, including scoping, work planning, delivery tracking, risk management, deployment readiness, and leadership reporting.
  • Remain hands-on in refactoring algorithms, research code, and prototypes into reusable, maintainable software through testing, interface design, performance evaluation, documentation, packaging, versioning, and release management.
  • Define and apply standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, dependency management, security, reliability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Develop reusable libraries, APIs, services, deployment patterns, and engineering playbooks.
  • Partner with quantum researchers, product and solution engineers, and business stakeholders to validate algorithms, define technical requirements, and integrate quantum and quantum-inspired capabilities into applications, data pipelines, machine learning workflows, APIs, and cloud environments.
  • Lead or contribute to client-facing projects, technical demonstrations, prototypes, proposals, product roadmaps, thought leadership, and eminence activities. Communicate technical approaches, tradeoffs, constraints, and recommendations to technical and business audiences.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of total professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, applied research engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience leading personnel and technical project delivery, including oversight of software development teams in quantum computing, AI/ML, or a related technical domain.
  • Experience delivering and deploying client-facing technical solutions in a consulting or professional services environment.
  • Experience converting experimental, research, or proof-of-concept code into reusable, maintainable software and integrating capabilities into applications, services, data pipelines, or enterprise platforms.
  • Proficiency in Python for production software development, application integration, automation, and data-intensive workflows.
  • Experience structuring, planning, and managing technical projects, including scoping, delivery tracking, risk management, quality practices, and leadership reporting.
  • Experience designing or consuming APIs, libraries, packages, or service interfaces, with a working understanding of data engineering concepts and patterns.
  • Proficiency with Git-based development and CI/CD practices, including automated testing, code quality, packaging, versioning, dependency management, and release processes.
  • Experience using cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure for application development, integration, deployment, or analysis.
  • Ability to evaluate tradeoffs involving performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, and integration complexity.
  • Familiarity with artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts and workflows.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences, including leadership.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, based on business needs and the clients and industries served.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred Skills:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent advanced technical experience.
  • Applied understanding of quantum computing and quantum-inspired methods, including quantum circuits, gates, measurement, noise, data encoding, feature maps, and hybrid quantum-classical workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more quantum or quantum-inspired frameworks, such as Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq, or Quimb.
  • Practical experience in at least one specialized area, such as tensor networks, quantum machine learning, optimization, simulation, data encoding and feature maps, or hybrid quantum-classical computation.
  • Experience working in an emerging-technology or new-offering environment, with the ability to translate ambiguous problems into structured technical and engineering plans.
  • Experience implementing tensor-network methods, including tensor representations, decomposition and contraction strategies, computational tradeoffs, and applications to quantum simulation, machine learning, or model compression.
  • Experience conducting applied research or structured experimentation involving quantum or quantum-inspired methods, including prototype development, classical benchmarking, evaluation, and documentation.
  • Experience with generative AI, large language models, natural language processing, or model compression.
  • Experience with operations research, optimization, Monte Carlo, or other simulation techniques.
  • Familiarity with quantum error mitigation, quantum error correction, and fault-tolerant quantum computing concepts.
  • Experience with graph databases or graph-based analytical methods.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Consultant - ASM Vulnerability Management - Patching
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Help organizations reduce cyber risk and improve resilience as part of Deloitte’s Cyber Defense & Resilience Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) team. In this role, you’ll support clients in identifying, prioritizing, and remediating security exposures across complex technology environments. You’ll work with cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen vulnerability management and patching processes, improve visibility into risk, and support cyber transformation initiatives.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Cyber Consultant ASM Vulnerability Management - Patching on the Cyber Defense & Resilience Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) team, you will be responsible for:

  • Supporting vulnerability remediation and patching activities aligned to CTEM priorities
  • Executing vulnerability and patch management tasks across infrastructure, middleware, and applications
  • Analyzing exposure data, asset criticality, exploitability, and attack paths to help prioritize remediation activities
  • Assisting with exception management, reporting, and process improvement efforts that reduce cyber risk
  • Preparing client-facing analyses, dashboards, and status updates to track remediation progress and exposure reduction
  • Assisting with identifying and documenting exposure and risk considerations introduced by AI and large language model deployments, including AI-specific attack surface and data exposure

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to support projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

Position Summary

Today’s chief financial officers (CFOs) and supply chain executives are being asked to improve business performance and shareholder value, along with operational effectiveness and efficiency. As an Oracle Manager at Deloitte, you will help clients define their cloud strategy, design and implement solutions aligned with business goals, and deliver measurable results. Recruiting for this role ends on 1/31/27

Work You’ll Do 

As an Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Manager, you will be responsible for leading implementation workstreams, advising client stakeholders, and driving business process transformation enabled by Oracle Cloud Supply Chain.

  • Manage day-to-day interactions with client executives, sponsors, and stakeholders.
  • Lead Oracle Cloud Supply Chain implementation workstreams, including requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, functional design, process design, prototyping, configuration support, testing, training, and post-go-live support planning.
  • Facilitate current-state and future-state process design, including scenario design, process flows, and identification of opportunities to improve efficiency, controls, and decision-making.
  • Manage team members across project activities and provide direction, oversight, and quality review for deliverables.
  • Support business development activities, including pursuit participation, proposal development, scope definition, and pricing discussions.
  • Coach junior practitioners and contribute to performance development, staffing, recruiting, and retention efforts.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently while leading collaboration across cross-functional teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with clients, stakeholders, and project teams
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, accurate work products
  • Proven ability to build, manage, and sustain strong professional and client relationships
  • Experience leading projects, workstreams, or teams to deliver results in alignment with business objectives
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and a professional executive presence

The Team 

Got your head in the cloud? With so much technology moving to the Cloud, our business requirements are taking us to new heights. By harnessing the power of Oracle ERP Cloud, you can streamline enterprise business processes with ERP Cloud's Financials, Procurement, or Portfolio Management. Do you have the ability to transform an organization through the latest social, mobile, and analytic technologies? We’re looking for someone that can increases the effectiveness of decision making and drive innovation. If your head is in the cloud, find out where we can take you with Oracle Enterprise Solutions.

Qualifications 

Required: 

  • Functional implementation experience with 4+ complex, full lifecycle Oracle Cloud Supply Chain implementations
  • 7+ years’ experience implementing any combination of Oracle Supply Chain modules
  • Experience defining systems strategy, documenting business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, designing current-state and future-state business processes, supporting conference room pilots, functional configuration, testing, and user training
  • Ability to travel 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, Information Systems, or another related field

Preferred: 

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, including presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint) 
  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills with the ability to exercise mature judgment. 
  • Experience leading an entire work stream of relevant Oracle applications. 
  • An advanced degree in the area of specialization

Job.JobTitle: SAP AI Transformation - Senior Consultant – SAP Data & Analytics
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Join Deloitte’s SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You’ll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

In this SAP AI Transformation role, you’ll contribute to Agentic ERP transformations that help clients advance toward the autonomous enterprise. Combining SAP expertise with AI-enabled delivery approaches, cross-functional collaboration, and industry insight, you’ll help address complex business challenges and create measurable client impact.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/15/2027.

Work you’ll do

As a Senior Consultant in Deloitte’s SAP practice, with a focus on SAP Data and Analytics, you will work side by side with functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact solutions that support Agentic ERP transformations. With Deloitte Ascend™, you’ll leverage AI accelerators and SAP capabilities to help clients modernize business processes and advance toward the autonomous enterprise.

This role requires a highly motivated professional who moves with speed and precision, builds practical solutions, and engages confidently with senior stakeholders and delivery teams to help generate measurable business impact.

  • Lead SAP Data & Analytics workstreams, coordinating milestones, dependencies, risks, team responsibilities, and quality across delivery teams.
  • Translate complex business questions into data models, semantic layers, reusable data products, and analytics solutions.
  • Facilitate client workshops that translate business needs into practical, scalable designs and validate insights with senior stakeholders.
  • Design and deliver solutions using SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BW/4HANA, S/4HANA embedded analytics, and SAP HANA Cloud.
  • Build repeatable patterns for data acquisition, integration, transformation, modeling, reporting, and performance management across SAP and non-SAP environments.
  • Analyze data to identify meaningful business insights, improve data quality and process performance, and support informed client decisions.
  • Coach team members, contribute to proposals and reusable assets, and help advance Deloitte’s SAP Data & Analytics capabilities.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations to enable an Autonomous Enterprise. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree; or an associate degree and 6+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), or consulting experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP consulting, enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation, or SAP/ERP technology transformation in a consulting or industry environment.
  • Experience supporting at least two full-lifecycle SAP implementations from project initiation through go-live and hypercare, including lead responsibility for an SAP Data & Analytics workstream or workstream area on at least one implementation, and experience supporting an SAP S/4HANA implementation.
  • 2+ years of hands-on functional or technical experience with SAP Data & Analytics toolsets, including one or more of the following: SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), or Joule copilot/SAC compass.
  • Experience implementing or configuring SAP data and analytics solutions—such as data integration, data or semantic modeling, dashboards, reporting, or planning—using SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BW/4HANA, or S/4HANA embedded analytics.
  • Experience working directly with client stakeholders to gather or validate data and analytics inputs.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Experience applying AI tools—including generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning, conversational AI, or AI agents—to enterprise transformation initiatives, such as solution design, implementation, or testing.
  • Experience with SAP BW/4HANA, S/4HANA embedded analytics, SAP HANA Cloud modeling, SAP Databricks, Business Data Cloud Connect, SAP Smart Data Integration, SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT), or Datasphere replication flows.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $82,600 to $162,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 2+ years

About this job

Consultant role in Deloitte's SAP practice focusing on data and analytics for Agentic ERP transformations. You'll work with clients to design and deliver SAP data solutions, translate business needs into analytics designs, and support modernization efforts across SAP toolsets including Datasphere, Analytics Cloud, and BW/4HANA.

Good fit if you have 2+ years of SAP consulting or ERP implementation experience, hands-on experience with SAP data and analytics tools, and can travel up to 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join Deloitte’s SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You’ll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

In this SAP AI Transformation role, you’ll contribute to Agentic ERP transformations that help clients advance toward the autonomous enterprise. Combining SAP expertise with AI-enabled delivery approaches, cross-functional collaboration, and industry insight, you’ll help address complex business challenges and create measurable client impact.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/15/2027.

Work you’ll do

As a Consultant in Deloitte’s SAP practice, with a focus on SAP Data and Analytics, you will work side by side with functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact solutions that support Agentic ERP transformations. With Deloitte Ascend™, you’ll leverage AI accelerators and SAP capabilities to help clients modernize business processes and advance toward the autonomous enterprise.

This role requires a highly motivated professional who moves with speed and precision, builds practical solutions, and engages confidently with senior stakeholders and delivery teams to help generate measurable business impact.

  • Support SAP Data & Analytics workstreams, coordinating milestones, dependencies, risks, team responsibilities, and quality across delivery teams.
  • Translate complex business questions into data models, semantic layers, reusable data products, and analytics solutions.
  • Support client workshops that translate business needs into practical, scalable designs and validate insights with client stakeholders.
  • Design and deliver solutions using SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BW/4HANA, S/4HANA embedded analytics, and SAP HANA Cloud.
  • Contribute to repeatable patterns for data acquisition, integration, transformation, modeling, reporting, and performance management across SAP and non-SAP environments.
  • Analyze data to identify meaningful business insights, improve data quality and process performance, and support informed client decisions.
  • Contribute to proposals and reusable assets, share knowledge with team members, and help advance Deloitte’s SAP Data & Analytics capabilities.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations to enable an Autonomous Enterprise. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree; or an associate degree and 4+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), or consulting experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • 2+ years of experience in SAP consulting, enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation, or SAP/ERP technology transformation in a consulting or industry environment.
  • Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle SAP implementation from project initiation through go-live and hypercare and experience supporting an SAP S/4HANA implementation.
  • 1+ year of hands-on functional or technical experience with SAP Data & Analytics toolsets, including one or more of the following: SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), or Joule copilot/SAC compass.
  • Experience implementing or configuring SAP data and analytics solutions—such as data integration, data or semantic modeling, dashboards, reporting, or planning—using SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BW/4HANA, or S/4HANA embedded analytics.
  • Experience working directly with client stakeholders to gather or validate data and analytics inputs.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Experience applying AI tools—including generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning, conversational AI, or AI agents—to enterprise transformation initiatives, such as solution design, implementation, or testing.
  • Experience with SAP BW/4HANA, S/4HANA embedded analytics, SAP HANA Cloud modeling, SAP Databricks, Business Data Cloud Connect, SAP Smart Data Integration, SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT), or Datasphere replication flows.
  • Experience supporting SAP cloud programs or SAP transformations deployed across multiple countries.
  • Experience applying SAP Activate, Agile, or Waterfall methodologies on SAP implementation programs.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, estimates, solution designs, or client presentations; or coaching and mentoring junior team members.
  • One or more SAP certifications, such as SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere/BW/4HANA, or SAP Analytics Cloud.

Job ID 372814

Quick facts

  • Pay: $102,500 to $210,600 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 8+ years

About this job

Senior Consultant role in Deloitte's Security Operations Center researching threat actors, attack vectors, and conducting threat hunting across member firm environments. Requires 8+ years cyber operations experience, 5+ years SIEM expertise, and ability to work 24x7x365 shifts with flexible scheduling.

Good fit if you have deep SIEM and threat hunting experience, can obtain US security clearance, and are comfortable working rotating shifts in a 24/7 operations center.

Full job description

Position Summary

Are you passionate about technology and interested in joining a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo? If so, read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity with Deloitte Technology US (DT - US). We are curious and life-long learners focused on technology and innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/14/2026.

Work you’ll do

The Security Operations Center (SOC) Tier 3 Analyst must be willing to work in a 24x7x365 Security Operations Center environment, as well as may be expected to work some holidays and allow for flexible scheduling. The Tier 3 analyst research relevant threat actors, attack vectors, and behaviors pertinent to Deloitte’s member firms. The candidate should possess extensive knowledge on network, endpoint, threat intelligence, as well as the functioning of specific applications or underlying IT infrastructure, and have experience with SIEM technologies, EDR solutions, forensics tools, and malware analysis. An understanding of network traffic, well known ports, network assets, web traffic, protocols, and basic requests such as HTTP/S is mandatory.

Responsibilities:

  • Research trending campaigns, attack vectors, and search for these in multiple environments.
  • Be tool agnostic – the Threat Hunting tools may differ from the access granted by the individual member firms, and we value concepts over tools. The ideal candidate must possess an acute ability to adapt to any tool.
  • Maintain awareness of the Deloitte Member Firms’ technology architecture, the architecture of the security solutions used for monitoring, imminent and pervasive threats as identified by the Threat Intelligence team, and recent security incidents.
  • As needed, work with L1-L3 SOC Analysts pertaining to security alerts to perform in depth analysis and triage threat activity based on host and network activity, traffic, and protocol analysis to identify infection vectors, the extent of the infection, and prepare high-quality reports based on findings.
  • Respond to requests from incident response teams for specific investigation requests around software/application vulnerabilities, zero days, and security incidents.
  • Understand chain of custody and be able to properly document all actions taken.
  • Present threat hunt findings to member firms on a regular interval, so proven presentation and communication skills are essential.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one security-related functional area (e.g. specific malware solution, AI, python programming, digital forensics, etc.)
  • Adhere to internal operational security and other Deloitte policies.
  • Hunt for new patterns, activities, and ever-changing tactics associated with advanced threat actors.
  • Perform ad hoc SIEM content development and testing.
  • Provide recommendations for remediation of assets identified during hunting to assist the Deloitte with threat mitigations. These include but are not limited to security upgrades, configuration changes, and SIEM content recommendations.
  • When necessary, devise and document new techniques, automation, and procedures along with the Threat Hunting Service Leadership and SIEM Engineers.
  • Mentor junior threat hunters and deliver technical training sessions.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration and build team members’ strengths.
  • Collaborate with the service leadership to help grow the service.

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Technology US (DT - US) helps power Deloitte’s success, which serves many of the world’s largest, most respected organizations. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The ~3,000 professionals in DT - US deliver services including:

  • Cyber Security
  • Technology Support
  • Technology & Infrastructure
  • Applications
  • Relationship Management
  • Strategy & Communications
  • Project Management
  • Financials

Cyber Security

Cyber Security vigilantly protects Deloitte and client data. The team leads a strategic cyber risk program that adapts to a rapidly changing threat landscape, changes in business strategies, risks, and vulnerabilities. Using situational awareness, threat intelligence, and building a security culture across the organization, the team helps to protect the Deloitte brand.

Areas of focus include:

  • Risk & Compliance
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Data Protection
  • Cyber Design
  • Incident Response
  • Security Architecture
  • Business Partnership

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Data Science or related fields.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience with Cyber Operations, Security Architecture, including AI Engineering
  • Minimum 5 years of in-depth experience in Security Operation environment and working on SPLUNK or other SIEM tools.
  • Must be able to obtain US Government security clearance.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Strong background in Security operations, Threat Hunting, Incident Response and threat intelligence
  • Responsible for proactively discovering new attacks, or attacks currently underway using advanced security monitoring techniques and advanced cyber systems/tools.
  • Experience with the following technologies: leading SIEM technologies, EDR solutions; Knowledge of IDS/IPS, Ant Virus Solutions, network- and host- based firewalls, data leakage protection (DLP), web proxies, DNS, windows/Unix system administration.
  • Understanding of possible attack activities such as network reconnaissance probing/ scanning, DDOS, malicious code activity, etc.
  • Strong knowledge of malware analysis
  • Understanding of common network elements devices such as routers and switches.
  • Understanding of basic networking protocols such as IP, DNS, HTTP, FTP, SMTP etc., and the OSI model.
  • Basic knowledge in system security architecture and security solutions.
  • Certifications include Certified Intrusion Analyst (GIAC), Continuous Monitoring (GMON), CISSP, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
  • Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Experience implementing cloud-based AI/ML workloads on any of AWS, Microsoft and Azure
  • A strong desire to understand the what as well as the why and the how of security incidents.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $102,500 to $210,600.  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
