Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.

Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking a visionary and results-oriented professional to lead our Life Sciences Commercial Operations practice, specializing in cutting-edge, AI-powered solutions for commercial operations (specializing in CRM (Veeva, Salesforce) data knowledge, Customer MDM data structures (Reltio, Informatica, etc.), IQVIA data structures (TRx, NRx, DDD, etc.), claims data, specialty pharma data, data governance, Dynamic targeting, Segmentation, Call Planning, Brand planning, Business Intelligence, etc.). This strategic role demands a deep understanding of the life sciences industry, combined with expertise in leveraging AI and advanced analytics to drive transformative changes in commercial operations. The Associate Vice President will be responsible for developing and executing our go-to-market strategy, leading client engagements, building high-performing teams, and fostering innovation within the practice.

Work you’ll do

As an Associate Vice President, AI and Data Solutions on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading AI & Data engagements for Life Sciences / Pharma clients, with emphasis on Commercial AI and data transformation, analytics, and digital enablement
  • Shaping and delivering use cases across account-based selling, HCP/HCO affiliations, dynamic targeting, segmentation, call planning, brand planning, sales and marketing optimization, next best action, and forecasting
  • Translating business problems into scalable AI, data, and digital solutions
  • Working across strategy, product, data, engineering, and client stakeholder groups to define solution approach and delivery plans
  • Advising clients on operating model implications, business value, roadmap sequencing, and adoption considerations for AI-enabled transformation
  • Supporting broader AI & Data pursuits and engagements across Life Sciences when needed
  • Leading engagement planning, budgeting, staffing, and team mobilization for data and AI initiatives
  • Defining deliverable structure and content; managing quality, timelines, economics, and engagement risk
  • Managing day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors and facilitating buy-in for proposed solutions
  • Leading business development activities, including client relationship development, pursuit leadership, proposal development, and pricing strategy input
  • Coaching and developing practitioners through counseling, staffing input, recruitment, retention, and delivery team leadership
  • Leading workshops, executive presentations, and stakeholder sessions
  • Mentoring junior practitioners and contributing to practice, offering, and go-to-market development

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our AI & Data practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise data architecture, data strategy, analytics, AI/ML, and digital transformation
  • 6+ years of experience in Life Sciences commercial transformation projects
  • 6+ years of experience with Life Sciences commercial data and platforms, such as CRM (Veeva, Salesforce), Customer MDM (Reltio, Informatica, etc.), IQVIA data (TRx, NRx, DDD, etc.), claims data, and specialty pharma data
  • 4+ years of experience leading, managing, and delivering complex technology engagements, with resources in multiple locations
  • 4+ years of experience shaping executive-level conversations and providing strategic advice, including selling and solutioning data analytics professional services deals
  • 4+ years of experience with the sales cycle by helping frame client opportunities and participating in pursuit teams, including creating proposal content for client discussions
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or Artificial Intelligence
  • Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • Experience with cloud computing platforms, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Experience leading executive presentations and client workshops for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience developing proposals or solution materials for data and analytics professional services engagements
  • Experience creating client-facing materials for workshops and interactive sessions
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or Artificial Intelligence

Job ID 372771

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Science, Biotech & Research, Sales / Business Development
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $116,200 to $229,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 4+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior role building AI-powered commercial operations solutions for pharma clients at Deloitte's AI & Data practice. Focus on analytics, data transformation, and machine learning applied to CRM, IQVIA, claims, and specialty pharma data.

Good fit if you have 4+ years analytics/AI/ML experience with 3+ years in life sciences commercial operations and strong skills in SQL, Python, and pharma data platforms.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.

Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking a results-oriented professional to join our Life Sciences Commercial Operations practice, building cutting-edge, AI-powered solutions for commercial operations (specializing in CRM (Veeva, Salesforce) data knowledge, Customer MDM data structures (Reltio, Informatica, etc.), IQVIA data structures (TRx, NRx, DDD, etc.), claims data, specialty pharma data, data governance, Dynamic targeting, Segmentation, Call Planning, Brand planning, Business Intelligence, etc.). This role combines curiosity about the life sciences industry with hands-on skills in analytics, AI/ML, and data to help pharma clients transform their commercial operations. The Senior Consultant will contribute to client engagements, develop AI and analytics solutions, and grow alongside high-performing teams.

Work you’ll do

As a Data Management Engineer III on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for:

  • Supporting delivery of AI & Data engagements for Life Sciences / Pharma clients, with emphasis on Commercial AI, analytics, and data transformation
  • Building and delivering commercial use cases across account-based selling, HCP/HCO affiliations, dynamic targeting, segmentation, call planning, brand planning, sales and marketing optimization, next best action, and forecasting
  • Acquiring, profiling, and analyzing CRM (Veeva, Salesforce), IQVIA (TRx, NRx, DDD, etc), claims, and specialty pharma data, and understanding how Customer MDM structures feed commercial analytics
  • Developing, testing, and documenting analytical and AI/ML models that translate commercial business problems into scalable solutions
  • Building dashboards and Business Intelligence reporting that turn insights into decisions for field and brand teams
  • Applying data governance and data quality practices to the commercial data used in analytics and AI solutions
  • Collaborating with strategy, product, data, engineering, and client stakeholder groups to shape solution approach and delivery plans
  • Preparing client-ready deliverables, workshop materials, and presentations
  • Supporting pursuits and proposal content as needed
  • Contributing to practice assets and accelerators, and mentoring junior practitioners

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our AI & Data practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of professional experience in analytics, AI/ML, or data solutions, including 3+ years in Life Sciences commercial operations (consulting, pharma, or commercial analytics)
  • 2+ years hands-on experience with Life Sciences commercial data, such as CRM (Veeva, Salesforce), IQVIA data structures (TRx, NRx, DDD, etc.), claims data, and specialty pharma data, with working knowledge of Customer MDM data structures (Reltio, Informatica, etc.)
  • 2+ years experience with analytics and/or AI/ML to commercial use cases such as segmentation, targeting, call planning, next best action, or forecasting
  • 2+ years experience with SQL and Python (or R) for data analysis and modeling
  • 2+ years experience leading project workstreams and/or project teams, with resources in multiple locations
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field
  • Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

  • Client-facing consulting experience, including working with teams across multiple locations
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Experience with emerging technologies (such as GenAI) and advanced data architectures (i.e., Data Mesh, Data Fabric, Data Products, etc.)
  • Experience with Business Intelligence and visualization tools (such as Power BI or Tableau)
  • Experience translating business needs into data and analytical requirements and to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience with data governance and with regulatory and compliance considerations in life sciences data privacy and security

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. Job ID 372770

Quick facts

  • Pay: $100,400 to $197,900 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 4+ years

About this job

Channel Sales professional role at Deloitte focused on expanding ServiceNow market presence and generating qualified pipeline. You will build strategic relationships across the ServiceNow ecosystem, coordinate joint go-to-market activities with sales and marketing teams, and track pipeline creation and conversion metrics.

Good fit if you have 4+ years in channel sales, alliance management, or business development, with experience managing partner relationships and CRM pipeline tracking, and can travel up to 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Are you a relationship-oriented sales professional with an entrepreneurial mindset, relevant industry and ServiceNow experience, and a demonstrated ability to activate partner ecosystems? Deloitte Consulting LLP is seeking a Channel Sales professional to expand market presence, strengthen ServiceNow relationships, and generate qualified pipeline across Cross Industry.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/02/2026.  

Work you’ll do

As a Channel Sales professional, you will activate the ServiceNow ecosystem to create market awareness, uncover new opportunities, and generate qualified pipeline for Deloitte. You will work closely with Sales Executives, account teams, ServiceNow stakeholders, and Marketing to turn relationships and market insight into actionable growth opportunities. You will:

  • Build and maintain a strategic relationship map across ServiceNow, including sales leaders, client executives, industry leaders, account teams, solution specialists, and other influential stakeholders.
  • Identify relationship gaps, priority connections, and engagement opportunities that increase Deloitte’s visibility and access across the ServiceNow ecosystem and internally.
  • Partner with Sales Executives and Deloitte account teams to identify target accounts, develop contact strategies, and activate joint go-to-market opportunities.
  • Help frame the purpose and desired outcomes of joint opportunity calls, recommend approaches that have worked in other accounts, and bring forward relevant examples from similar clients to spark opportunity creation.
  • Facilitate and support joint account planning, relationship-mapping sessions, pipeline reviews, and opportunity-creation calls with ServiceNow and Deloitte stakeholders.
  • Create repeatable engagement approaches that help account teams use ServiceNow relationships, industry insights, and solution capabilities to open doors and advance early-stage opportunities.
  • Work closely with marketing to plan and execute joint demand-generation initiatives, including events, workshops, webinars, campaigns, and targeted account-based marketing activities.
  • Convert marketing activity, partner interactions, and market intelligence into qualified opportunities by ensuring timely follow-up, clear ownership, and disciplined pipeline tracking.
  • Capture and share leading practices, client examples, market signals, and successful co-sell approaches to improve opportunity creation across the territory.
  • Track and report on key performance indicators, including relationship coverage, joint activities, marketing-sourced leads, pipeline created, pipeline influenced, and conversion to qualified opportunities.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations on where to focus relationship-building, marketing investment, and joint sales activity to maximize pipeline generation and growth.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • A proven track record in channel sales, alliance management, business development, partner marketing, or inside sales.
  • Experience developing relationships with partner sales organizations, technology providers, systems integrators, or other strategic ecosystem partners.
  • Strong relationship-mapping and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to navigate complex organizations and connect the right people at the right time.
  • The ability to translate client, partner, and market insights into practical opportunity-creation strategies.
  • Experience working with sales and marketing teams to develop and execute demand-generation and pipeline-creation initiatives.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and follow-up skills.
  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills, including the ability to manage activity, pipeline, and performance data in a CRM environment.
  • Knowledge of enterprise software solutions, consulting services, and the broader ServiceNow marketplace.

The Team

The Sales Center of Excellence supports Deloitte’s businesses in identifying, nurturing, and closing sales opportunities. Channel Sales professionals work alongside Sales Executives, Partners, Principals, Managing Directors, alliance leaders, marketing, and account teams to activate strategic relationships, generate demand, and create qualified opportunities that support Deloitte’s growth agenda.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of experience in channel sales, alliance management, business development, partner marketing, or related go-to-market roles.
  • Experience working within a complex, matrixed organization and coordinating cross-functional sales and marketing activity.
  • Demonstrated success developing partner relationships and generating pipeline through joint go-to-market activity.
  • Experience with pipeline management, CRM reporting, and measuring the effectiveness of demand-generation activity.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with ServiceNow, including its technology, sales organization, partner ecosystem, and go-to-market model.
  • Established relationships with ServiceNow sales representatives, client executives, industry leaders, or channel stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting account-based marketing, joint campaigns, industry events, or other co-marketing programs.
  • Experience selling or supporting the sale of complex, project-based professional services.
  • Undergraduate degree; advanced degree preferred.

Position Summary

Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer

Join Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions practice as a Microsoft Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant). You will help clients design, deploy, and support scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F&O) and Power Platform environments that advance finance and supply chain transformation. You will collaborate with client business and technology leaders to establish secure application lifecycle management, DevOps, integration, and operational practices across complex engagements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Microsoft D365/Power Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant) on the Emerging ERP Solutions team, you will be responsible for:

Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.

Architect and maintain Git-based application lifecycle management (ALM) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Power Platform Build Tools, solution packaging, automated solution checker gates, release controls, and rollback procedures.

Lead client workshops, architecture reviews, and stakeholder discussions; document environment and architecture decisions in decision logs and runbooks; present trade-offs involving cost, governance, and delivery speed.

Manage Azure integration services, including Service Bus, API Management (APIM), Storage Accounts, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and Application Insights; monitor batch jobs, workflows, integrations, and application performance; investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.

Manage technical delivery across concurrent client engagements, mentor team members, maintain reusable assets, and evaluate governance implications of emerging Power Platform capabilities, including Code Apps, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and Copilot Studio agents.

Participate in on-call and after-hours support as required.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

Effective written and verbal communication skills

Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

Ability to lead projects or workstreams

Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

Ability to meet deadlines

Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Qualifications Required:

6+ years of experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) or Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management (F&SCM), and Power Platform.

Experience using Azure DevOps or GitHub-based continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for Dataverse solutions and Git workflows, including branching, pull requests, and conflict resolution.

Experience using Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC), environment groups, managed environments, and Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS)-to-PPAC deployment transitions.

Experience designing Dataverse solution architecture, including managed and unmanaged solution layering and use of the Power Platform Center of Excellence Starter Kit or Application Lifecycle Management Accelerator.

Experience using Azure Portal and at least two of the following Azure services: API Management, Service Bus, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Key Vault, or Azure Functions.

Experience leading client workshops, architecture reviews, or steering committee presentations.

Experience managing technical delivery across two or more concurrent client engagements.

You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.

Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.


Preferred:

Microsoft certifications: PL-600 (Solution Architect), MB-700 (F&SCM Solution Architect), MB-800, or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer).

AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-204 (Azure Developer) certification.

Experience with Dataverse Git integration and Power Platform Build Tools.

Experience with Copilot Studio agent governance and AI Builder.

Experience with dual-write or integration architectures connecting Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management or Customer Engagement to external systems through Service Bus or API Management.

Experience creating environment and ALM decision records, operational support documentation, or runbooks.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $105,400 to $207,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Consultant role with Deloitte's Cyber Defense & Resilience team in Miami, leading vulnerability management, patch coordination, and remediation execution across enterprise environments. You'll prioritize vulnerabilities, coordinate patch execution, develop remediation metrics, and support automation and mentoring activities.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in IT/security, 4+ years leading remediation or patch coordination, and hands-on experience with patching tools and ITSM platforms like ServiceNow.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join Deloitte’s Cyber Defense & Resilience team focused on patching, remediation, and exposure reduction. In this role, you’ll work directly with client stakeholders to prioritize vulnerabilities, coordinate patch execution, and improve remediation outcomes across enterprise environments. You’ll help bridge security findings with operational action by translating exposure data into structured patching plans, reporting, and measurable risk reduction.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Cyber Defense and Resilience - ASM Vulnerability - Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for…

  • Leading day-to-day engineering execution for client patching and remediation activities across infrastructure, middleware, endpoints, and applications
  • Prioritizing remediation activities using vulnerability findings, asset criticality, exploitability, and threat context
  • Coordinating with client technology teams to drive patch planning, execution, validation, and exception tracking
  • Developing dashboards, status reporting, and remediation metrics that show progress against exposure reduction goals
  • Supporting automation and mentoring junior practitioners in patching, remediation, and operational delivery activities
  • Supporting identification of exposure and risk considerations introduced by AI and large language model deployments, including AI-specific attack surface and data exposure

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Cyber Specialists help organizations manage cyber risk through stronger security, greater visibility, and embedded privacy practices. The Cyber Defense & Resilience team works with clients to design, implement, and operate programs that help protect critical assets, support digital transformation, and respond to evolving threats. Within this practice, forward deployed engineers partner with client teams to accelerate patching, improve remediation governance, and reduce exposure across distributed enterprise environments.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in information technology, information security, vulnerability management, patch management, or a combination of these
  • 4+ years of experience leading remediation execution, patch coordination, or forward deployed engineering activities in enterprise environments
  • 4+ years of experience executing or overseeing patching across Windows, Linux, middleware, endpoints, or applications using tools such as BigFix, Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager, Red Hat Satellite, Windows Server Update Services, Tenable, Rapid7, or Qualys
  • 2+ years of experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or JavaScript Object Notation for scripting, automation, or configuration activities
  • 2+ years of experience using ServiceNow or another Information Technology Service Management platform to manage remediation workflows, exceptions, metrics, and status reporting
  • Familiarity with AI and Frontier AI risk considerations, including AI-related threat vectors (e.g., prompt injection, data poisoning, model supply chain risk) and their implications for exposure management programs
  • Experience using AI tools to triage, prioritize, create scripts, or integrations with other cybersecurity tools
  • Hold vendor-specific credential or proof of training completion (e.g., Qualys Certified Specialist, Tenable Vulnerability Management Expert, Rapid7 InsightIDR Certified Specialist, Wiz Defend Fundamentals)
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics, or Physics
  • Experience in a consulting environment
  • Experience creating or developing AI agents
  • Experience presenting remediation status, risk updates, or delivery progress to client stakeholders
  • Experience with vulnerability prioritization based on exploitability, asset criticality, or attack path data
  • Experience with the National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework, Center for Internet Security, International Organization for Standardization 27001, or Cloud Security Alliance Cloud Controls Matrix, or similar standards and frameworks
  • Relevant certification such as CompTIA Security+, CompTIA Network+, CISSP, etc.
  • Familiarity with how statements of work (SOWs) or requests for proposal (RFPs) are structured and used in a consulting or managed services engagement

Requisition code: 372734
Job ID 372734

Quick facts

  • Pay: $110,700 to $218,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Consultant role designing and optimizing enterprise identity resolution solutions that unify customer data across touchpoints. Responsibilities include managing identity graphs, designing data collection strategies, ensuring data quality, and collaborating with cross-functional teams at Deloitte's Customer practice in Jacksonville.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in data architecture or identity resolution platforms, 3+ years with identity graph technologies, and deep database and ETL experience.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 22, 2027

Work you'll do

An Identity Graph Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-level identity resolution solutions that enable a unified view of the customer across all data touchpoints. Key responsibilities include maintaining and evolving the identity graph, designing identity resolution inputs and data collection, collaborating with identity partners, and supporting traceability and data quality for identity outputs. The role requires deep expertise in identity resolution, data architecture, and cross-functional stakeholder engagement. You will:

  • Identity Graph Management: Help maintain and evolve the identity graph in collaboration with identity partners to optimize identity matching logic and resolution accuracy
  • Data Collection Architecture: Design data collection strategies using tagging solutions to feed high-quality data into the identity graph
  • Use Case Development: Gather and translate business use cases for the identity graph into scalable technical architectures and solutions
  • Traceability: Support linking identity resolution outputs back to source data so identities and attributes can be traced to their origin
  • Quality Monitoring: Help build reporting and monitoring into the identity graph to flag data anomalies, match mismatches, and oversized clusters
  • Privacy and Compliance: Partner with legal and compliance teams to ensure identity data handling meets applicable U.S. privacy requirements
  • Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders across product, marketing, analytics, and engineering teams to align on data strategy, solution design, and implementation priorities
  • Documentation and Specifications: Create technical specifications to drive development of solutions and deliver documentation for stakeholder review
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Interface with clients and internal teams to gather requirements, map solutions, and make recommendations
  • Innovation: Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer data capabilities and innovate on solutions to address evolving business needs

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing and Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, customer data platforms, or identity resolution solutions
  • 3+ years of experience working with identity graph technologies or identity resolution platforms (e.g., Acxiom, LiveRamp, or similar)
  • 5+ years of in-depth understanding of database platforms including relational and non-relational data engines (MS SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, and similar)
  • 5+ years of experience with data processing (ETL) tools and methodologies
  • 3+ years of experience designing customer-centric datasets (i.e., CRM, Call Center, Marketing, Offline, Point of Sale, etc.)
  • 3+ years of data modeling experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Ability to travel up to 50% on average based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred:

  • Experience and knowledge with digital marketing analytics and media operations
  • Experience with marketing cloud solutions and customer data platforms
  • Experience with data observability or anomaly detection tooling
  • Familiarity with U.S. privacy and data protection requirements as they apply to identity data, including federal requirements for government data
  • Experience in programming languages (Python, Java, or Bash scripting)
  • Experience with Big Data technologies (i.e., Hadoop, Spark, Redshift, Snowflake, Hive, etc.)
  • Experience with Martech/Adtech tools and how to integrate technologies into the data management solution (Adobe, Salesforce, Oracle, Google, and similar)
  • Experience in advanced analytics, machine learning concepts, and use cases applied to customer experience and marketing solutions
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to articulate complex technology concepts with technical and non-technical individuals
  • Ability to approach technical solutions to challenges from a business perspective
  • Understanding of the full SDLC process
  • Understanding of data integration methodologies and tools (Mulesoft, Dell Boomi, Custom API, Segment, Tealium, and similar)
  • Understanding of public cloud offerings and how to design solutions built around these technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and similar)
  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or related field
  • Experience working with public cloud offerings (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and similar)
    • GCP (Cloud Functions, Composer, SQL, Storage, Dataproc, Datastore, Kubernetes, BigQuery, Stackdriver, Pub/Sub)
    • AWS (Lambda, Glue, Data Pipeline, Redshift, Aurora, Athena/Spectrum, S3/Glacier, Fargate, Cloud Watch, Kinesis)
    • Azure (Functions, Batch, Blob Storage, Data Warehouse, Data Factory, Containers, Monitor, Service Bus)

As a Senior Consultant supporting Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), you will help clients design and implement real-time, omnichannel customer journeys that power personalized engagement across email, SMS, push, and in-app channels. In this role, you will bring together journey orchestration, campaign configuration, decisioning, and platform integration to support activation across digital touchpoints. You will work across business and technical teams to translate requirements into practical, high-quality solutions that drive customer and commercial outcomes.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 18, 2026

Work you'll do

As an Adobe Journey Optimize architect, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing and configuring end-to-end customer journeys in Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), including triggers, actions, messages, offers, and journey orchestration logic
  • Building rules and conditional logic to orchestrate complex, multi-step journeys based on customer attributes, behaviors, and real-time events
  • Configuring AJO channel surfaces, including email, SMS, push notification, and in-app messaging, along with email subdomains, IP pools, and IP warming strategies
  • Integrating AJO with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), including Real-Time Customer Data Platform (RT-CDP) and Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), to support unified profiles, audience activation, and cross-channel measurement
  • Implementing Journey Optimizer Decisioning (AJO-D) and Offer Decisioning capabilities, including offer collections, placements, decision scopes, and eligibility and prioritization rules, to enable contextual, real-time personalization
  • Leading integration and solution delivery across Adobe Experience Cloud, third-party systems, and client stakeholder groups during implementation, technical design, and pre-sales activities

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey — AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of hands-on implementation experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), including journey orchestration, triggers, automations, actions, messages, and offers
  • 2+ years configuring AJO channel surfaces (email, SMS, push, in-app), including email subdomain setup, IP pool creation, and IP warming/deliverability strategy
  • 2+ years working with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), including Experience Data Model (XDM) schemas, Real-Time Customer Data Platform (RT-CDP), and Web/Mobile SDK or Edge Network event forwarding to support AJO journey triggers
  • Experience configuring external data sources, custom events, and custom actions within AJO to support complex, attribute- and behavior-driven journeys
  • 5+ years in customer data, marketing technology, or digital campaign management with application programming interface (API)-first configuration, Git, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), environment promotion, automated validation, production monitoring, and runbooks
  • Strong understanding of business domains, data models, and marketing campaign strategy, with the ability to translate functional requirements into technical journey designs
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer Decisioning (AJO-D) and Offer Decisioning (OD), including offer collections, placements, decision scopes, and eligibility/prioritization rules
  • Adobe Certified Expert or Adobe Certified Professional credential in Journey Optimizer, Experience Platform, or a related Adobe Experience Cloud product
  • Experience with emerging AJO/AEP artificial intelligence capabilities, including AJO Experimentation, CX AI/Agent Orchestrator, and AEP AI Assistant
  • Experience with cloud data platforms, including Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience with digital marketing analytics and Customer Journey Analytics (CJA)
  • Programming or scripting experience in Python, Java, SQL, or Bash
  • Experience integrating marketing technology, advertising technology, and data integration tools, including Adobe, Salesforce, Oracle, Google, MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Segment, Tealium, or custom APIs
  • Experience training or leading offshore or nearshore delivery teams in a Global Delivery model
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a technical field

Quick facts

About this job

Lead AI and data transformation initiatives for life sciences commercial operations at Deloitte's Miami office. The role combines strategy, client engagement, and team leadership to deliver AI-powered solutions across CRM, customer data platforms, and analytics for pharma clients.

Good fit if you have 6+ years in life sciences consulting with 4+ years hands-on experience in commercial data systems, CRM platforms, and AI applications, plus ability to travel 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.

Position summary

Deloitte is seeking a visionary and results-oriented professional to help lead our Life Sciences Commercial Operations practice, specializing in cutting-edge, AI-powered solutions for commercial operations (specializing in CRM (Veeva, Salesforce) data knowledge, Customer MDM data structures (Reltio, Informatica, etc.), IQVIA data structures (TRx, NRx, DDD, etc.), claims data, specialty pharma data, data governance, Dynamic targeting, Segmentation, Call Planning, Brand planning, Business Intelligence, etc.). This strategic role demands a deep understanding of the life sciences industry, combined with expertise in leveraging AI and advanced analytics to drive transformative changes in commercial operations. The Manager will be responsible for contributing to our go-to-market strategy, leading client engagements, building high-performing teams, and fostering innovation within the practice.

Work you’ll do

On the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading delivery of AI & Data engagements for Life Sciences / Pharma clients, with emphasis on Commercial AI and data transformation, analytics, and digital enablement
  • Shaping and delivering commercial use cases across account-based selling, HCP/HCO affiliations, dynamic targeting, segmentation, call planning, brand planning, sales and marketing optimization, next best action, and forecasting
  • Translating commercial business problems into scalable AI, data, and digital solutions built on CRM, Customer MDM, IQVIA, claims, and specialty pharma data
  • Working across strategy, product, data, engineering, and client stakeholder groups to define solution approach and delivery plans
  • Advising clients on data governance, operating model implications, business value, roadmap sequencing, and adoption considerations for AI-enabled commercial transformation
  • Leading engagement planning, staffing, and team mobilization for data and AI initiatives; managing budgets, timelines, quality, and engagement risk
  • Defining deliverable structure and content for assigned workstreams
  • Managing day-to-day interactions with client leads and senior stakeholders and facilitating buy-in for proposed solutions
  • Supporting business development, including pursuit support, proposal development, solution materials, and pricing input
  • Coaching and developing practitioners through counseling, staffing input, recruitment, and delivery team leadership
  • Leading workshops, executive presentations, and stakeholder sessions
  • Contributing to practice, offering, and go-to-market development

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our AI & Data practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of relevant professional experience, including 4+ years in Life Sciences commercial operations with a proven track record of success delivering AI, analytics, and data solutions for pharma or biotech clients
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with Life Sciences commercial data, such as CRM (Veeva, Salesforce), Customer MDM data structures (Reltio, Informatica, etc.), IQVIA data structures (TRx, NRx, DDD, etc.), claims data, and specialty pharma data
  • 4+ years of professional Life Sciences consulting experience driving commercial transformation and innovation for clients, to include data and AI in areas such as customer engagement, field force excellence and operations, Customer 360, and Sales & Marketing
  • 2+ years hands-on experience of the commercial data landscape, CRM systems, sales force enablement technologies, and emerging technologies (such as GenAI) and advanced data architectures (i.e., Multimodal data management & model design, Data Mesh, Data Fabric, Data Products, etc.)
  • 2+ years experience with AI/ML techniques and their application to commercial use cases such as dynamic targeting, segmentation, next best action, and forecasting
  • 2+ years of experience prioritizing AI use cases, developing delivery roadmaps, and planning resources to ensure accelerated project delivery
  • 2+ years experience leading and managing complex projects, budgets, and teams, including delivery teams across multiple locations
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

  • Experience with cloud computing platforms, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Working knowledge of data governance practices for commercial data
  • Experience understanding and communicating client strategic business drivers and operational process requirements, then linking specific business requirements to AI & Data capabilities
  • Experience creating client workshop collateral and leading interactive working sessions
  • Experience presenting technical content to both large and small audiences

Job ID 372689

Position Summary

We are seeking an Associate Director to join our Finance Systems team to set strategy, lead end-to-end delivery of finance-led platform enhancements and integrations as well as develop a team of system delivery specialists. This role will work across Finance Process areas to resolve complex system enhancements and integrations to support scalable solutions across SAP S/4HANA and other related financial applications such as pricing and forecasting. You will serve as a senior business and process leader—translating finance strategy into prioritized epics/features, partnering with Information Technology Services (ITS) and product engineering teams to execute delivery, and ensuring releases are adoption-ready through User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training, and communications. The Associate Director will also support the Stakeholder reach-out, finalize and sign-off on strategic global requirements, and advise Change Management on functionality changes, while leading and developing a global team of Finance Systems Application Delivery Managers.

Professionals in ES may apply and be considered for the role regardless of US office location.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 15, 2026.

Work You'll Do

As the Firm Enterprise Solutions Associate Director, Finance Systems on the Finance Systems team, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead and develop a global team of Finance Systems Application Delivery Managers by setting priorities, managing performance, and fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture.
  • Direct finance application delivery from requirements refinement and prioritization through governance forums, release readiness, risk escalation, and decision-making for system enhancements and integrations.
  • Translate finance strategy into prioritized epics, features, and acceptance criteria; partner with ITS, product engineering, architecture, and testing teams to deliver SAP S/4HANA and related finance capabilities.
  • Review global feature sheets; assess U.S. impacts; approve effort and cost estimates; coordinate subject matter advisers and cross-business teams; and lead Program Increment (PI) planning, dependency management, solution-design decisions, and delivery milestones.
  • Lead user acceptance testing, production support, defect management, release hyper-care, and change-management activities, including training, communications, quick reference guides, and release notes.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Finance Systems serves as US finance application portfolio subject matter experts, to implement and manage innovative solutions and changes through governance and change management to meet the technology needs of finance and the US member firm. Joining the team provides an opportunity to drive the future vision of the Finance organization.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Information Technology and 8+ years of experience in finance systems, finance processes, accounting systems, or finance technology delivery.
  • Experience with Systems, Applications, and Products in Data Processing (SAP) S/4HANA and client-to-cash (CTC), core finance, pricing, or forecasting applications.
  • Experience leading teams across multiple countries and functions on finance-system delivery projects and presenting recommendations, tradeoffs, and cost estimates to executive stakeholders.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams or workstreams for finance or accounting system implementations and enhancements.
  • Experience gathering business requirements, creating acceptance criteria, conducting root cause analysis, and partnering with technical teams to implement finance or accounting system changes.
  • Experience supporting user acceptance testing for finance-related system changes, including test planning, test-script preparation, environment readiness, defect triage, and validation of accounting outcomes; and experience using Microsoft Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams, and artificial intelligence tools and applications.
  • Ability to travel 0–10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Agile certification and/or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Master’s degree.
  • Experience leading teams, workstreams, or cross-functional initiatives with accountability for delivery outcomes in a professional services organization.
  • Experience with finance transformation, process redesign, or automation initiatives in an enterprise organization.
  • Experience preparing audit support, compliance documentation, or internal-control documentation for financial reporting.
  • Experience with SAP-connected finance interfaces, subledgers, and reporting tools.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Senior Manager - Strategy, Growth, and Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Cyber Senior Manager - Cyber Alliances (Zscaler & Snyk) / Senior Manager, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation

Are you energized by building strategic alliances, designing go-to-market motions, and driving scaled revenue growth? Do you want to shape how Deloitte brings AI-powered cybersecurity capabilities to market — in partnership with leading technology companies like Zscaler and Snyk? Are you excited about operating at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and execution in a high-growth, high-visibility role?

If yes, then Deloitte’s Cyber team could be the place for you! Transparency, innovation, collaboration, sustainability: these are the hallmark issues shaping cyber initiatives today. Deloitte’s Cyber business is passionate about making an impact with lasting change. Delivering our industry leading services requires fresh thinking and a creative approach. We collaborate with teams from across our organization in order to bring the full breadth of Deloitte, its commercial and public sector expertise, to best support our clients. 

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you’ll do

As a Senior Manager, you will:

  • Own the GTM strategy and execution for Deloitte's strategic cyber alliances with Zscaler and Snyk within the specialized pod model
  • Operate within the pod model alongside the Lead Alliance Partner (LAP), Sales Relationship Executive (SRE), Sales Executive, CSM, and Pod Marketer to drive coordinated pipeline generation and activation
  • Build strong relationships with alliance counterparts and align joint objectives, offerings, enablement activities, and market opportunities.
  • Design, launch, and activate four strategic GTM motions: Data Protection, Cyber for AI, IoT/OT/5G Security, and Cyber Operate — driving pipeline generation and go-to-market execution for each.
  • Translate Zscaler and Snyk platform capabilities into differentiated Deloitte offerings, points of view, and joint go-to-market assets aligned to client business outcomes.
  • Facilitate regular pipeline reviews, investment planning, pursuit governance, and cross-functional decision-making across Offering Portfolio leaders, sector leaders, and alliance counterparts.
  • Partner with Offering Portfolio Leaders (Data Protection, Cyber for AI, Cyber Operate, Emerging Tech) and sector leaders to secure internal sponsorship, resources, and delivery capacity for scaled GTM execution.
  • Define, track, and report on pod-level KPIs including pipeline generated per GTM motion, alliance-attributed revenue, resell TCV, and activation campaign outcomes.

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Our Enterprise Security offering embeds security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client’s technical backbone while enabling secure digital transformation. Includes security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Cyber Security)
  • 8+ years of progressively responsible experience in cybersecurity go-to-market, alliance management, or portfolio growth roles, demonstrating increasing levels of strategy ownership, revenue accountability, and cross-functional leadership
  • 6+ years of experience developing and executing alliance or technology partnership GTM programs, including joint offering development, co-sell motions, field enablement, and pipeline activation with partners such as Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, or similar enterprise security vendors
  • 6+ years of experience designing and activating multi-motion GTM programs, including POV development, sales plays, demand generation campaigns, and field activation aligned to specific technology offerings.
  • 6+ years of experience managing revenue targets, pipeline governance, and P&L accountability in a consulting, alliance, or technology sales environment
  • 8+ years of experience leading cross-functional teams and executive-level stakeholders to define and execute growth strategies, including managing competing priorities across multiple business units, offering areas, and external partner organizations
  • 6+ years of experience with alliance governance, including joint business planning, co-investment models, pursuit tracking, and performance reporting against shared revenue targets
  • Minimum of 6+ years leading executive-level conversations, briefings, and go-to-market planning sessions with technology partners, clients, and internal stakeholders to shape investment decisions, offering priorities, and joint go-to-market programs
  • Minimum of 6+ years leading strategic alliance programs or portfolio growth functions at a Big 4 consulting firm, technology company, or enterprise security organization, with demonstrated success scaling revenue through partner ecosystems
  • Minimum of 6+ years managing teams in a technical leadership capacity
  • Ability to travel up to 40%, on average, based on the work you perform and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Snyk, Wiz, Zscaler and/or Palo Alto Networks platform of solutions
  • Strong understanding of the competitive landscape for enterprise cyber alliances, including Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, Snyk, and Wiz, and how Deloitte's go-to-market strategy can differentiate against other GSI partners
  • Ability to develop and communicate compelling GTM narratives, joint value propositions, and offering frameworks that align Deloitte and alliance partner capabilities to client business outcomes
  • Previous consulting or “Big 4” experience
  • Previous experience managing project budgets, resource models, P&L management
  • Experience building and operationalizing GTM motion playbooks, including offering definitions, target account strategies, pursuit governance models, and field activation plans in partnership with alliance vendors
  • Relevant cybersecurity or alliance certifications (e.g., Certified Zscaler Architect, CISSP, or equivalent Zscaler/Snyk partner certifications); prior experience as a Zscaler or Snyk sales or alliance leader is a strong differentiator

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. Position Summary

Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. You will:

  • Develop and format project materials, including presentations, briefing documents, and status updates

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $82,600 to $162,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 4+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Product Owner for ConvergeHEALTH, Deloitte's data and AI platform for healthcare analytics. You will translate business priorities into product requirements, coordinate with engineering and data teams, and manage backlog operations to deliver analytics capabilities that improve healthcare performance across clinical, financial, and operational domains.

Good fit if you have 4+ years in healthcare consulting, product management, or technology delivery; understand analytics platforms; and can work effectively across cross-functional teams in agile environments.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Team

This role sits within Converge for Health Care, Deloitte’s industry-focused asset studio for healthcare, and is part of Deloitte Consulting’s Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) practice. I&DT applies an engineering- and innovation-led mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology-enabled solutions.

Product Owners in Converge for Health Care work closely with Product Managers, engineering and data teams, Deloitte Consulting practitioners, and client stakeholders, including engineering leadership and cross-functional teams spanning analytics, data governance, and agent platform development. The team operates at the intersection of healthcare domain expertise, analytics platforms, and delivery execution—ensuring products are built with real-world use in mind and continuously refined based on delivery and market feedback.

Position Summary 

As a Senior Product Owner within Deloitte’s Converge for Health Care portfolio, you will play a key role in executing and advancing a ConvergeHEALTH data and AI platform for healthcare analytics. Built around a unified data foundation and an expanding set of agentic capabilities, this platform is designed to help healthcare organizations improve performance, enable better decision-making, and drive meaningful outcomes across clinical, financial, and operational domains.

In this role, you will work closely with a Product Manager to translate business priorities into executable product requirements, coordinate delivery with engineering and data teams, and ensure product capabilities align with real-world client and practitioner needs. You will operate with a high degree of ownership at the intersection of healthcare domain expertise, technology platforms, and product execution—bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to complex initiatives.

This position is well suited for practitioners who enjoy problem-solving in ambiguous environments, cross-functional collaboration, and building product capabilities that deliver tangible impact at scale.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026. 

Work you’ll do

As a Health Care Analytics and AI Senior Product Owner on a product management team within Converge for Health Care, you will be responsible for:

  • Driving execution of product roadmaps and delivery plans alongside the Product Manager, helping maintain alignment, momentum, and clarity as priorities move from concept through delivery.
  • Translating business objectives, practitioner input, and client needs into clear user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria, using a combination of healthcare domain knowledge and technical fluency to bridge business context with engineering and data teams.
  • Partnering closely with engineering, data, and analytics teams to coordinate development, testing, and release activities across platform capabilities, ensuring requirements are well understood and solutions align with intended use cases and outcomes.
  • Managing day-to-day backlog operations, including prioritization, grooming, and sprint planning, while balancing near-term delivery needs with longer-term product direction.
  • Participating in agile ceremonies and working sessions, helping ensure development progress aligns with roadmap priorities, delivery milestones, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Contributing meaningfully to research, documentation, and design of new features and enhancements by engaging with Deloitte leaders, practitioners, and clients to gather insights, validate assumptions, and inform product decisions grounded in real-world use.
  • Supporting pilot efforts and early deployments of new analytics capabilities, including GenAI-enabled features and emerging agentic workflows, and helping translate early learnings into scalable product improvements.
  • Developing product collateral, demonstrations, and internal enablement materials to support adoption across Deloitte Consulting teams and client-facing engagements.
  • Monitoring product usage, performance signals, and feedback, identifying opportunities for refinement, optimization, or future investment and surfacing these insights to the Product Manager and broader product team.

A Strong, Successful Candidate Will Possess These Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business and domain needs into structured product requirements and executable work items.
  • Experience applying analytics- or data-enabled solutions across healthcare operations and performance improvement contexts.
  • Technical fluency with analytics platforms and data-driven products, enabling effective collaboration with engineering, data, and analytics teams without requiring hands-on coding.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to synthesize inputs, evaluate tradeoffs, and articulate a clear “so what.”
  • Clear, effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage Product Managers, engineers, consultants, and senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence outcomes and drive progress across cross-functional teams operating in fast-moving, matrixed environments.
  • Comfort operating within agile delivery environments, including practical use of product and delivery management tools (e.g., backlog tracking, sprint planning, documentation, and collaboration tools) to organize work, communicate progress, and support effective execution.
  • Curiosity about emerging technologies such as advanced analytics, automation, GenAI, and agentic systems, and interest in how these capabilities can be responsibly applied within healthcare products.
  • Comfort operating in evolving product portfolios where priorities, capabilities, and investment focus continue to mature over time.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, information systems, computer science, or a related field
  • 4+ years of experience in healthcare consulting, product management, or technology delivery roles within the healthcare domain
  • Ability to travel 10-20%, on average, based on client and project needs
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, health informatics, or a related field

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

About this job

Senior Consultant supporting Deloitte's Rural Health Transformation Program, providing analytical and operational support to project teams. Role involves research on rural health policy and Medicaid regulations, preparing client materials, and coordinating day-to-day program delivery.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in public sector, healthcare, or consulting, with interest in health policy and strong organizational skills.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team delivers integrated, end-to-end support and advisory services covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, government operations modernization, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. Work alongside clients every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and provide practical solutions at every stage of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.

Work you'll do

As a Rural Health Program & Policy Delivery Senior Consultant on the Operations Transformation team, you will provide analytical and operational support to project teams working on projects under the Rural Health Transformation Program, coordinating research, documentation, and day-to-day delivery. This is a client-facing role supporting teams in the day-to-day execution of program deliverables. The ideal candidate has a foundational interest and some experience in health policy or public sector work, strong organizational skills, and an eagerness to grow within a fast-paced consulting environment.

Role responsibilities include:

  • Conduct research on rural health policy topics, Medicaid regulations, and state government program developments, summarizing findings for internal team use
  • Assist in the preparation of internal and client-ready materials including PowerPoint presentations, meeting agendas, status reports, and program trackers
  • Maintain team calendars, meeting schedules, and action item logs to support project coordination
  • Support tracking of program milestones, deliverables, and deadlines across multiple workstreams
  • Assist senior team members with data gathering, documentation, and quality review of project outputs
  • Help maintain shared team resources including SharePoint sites, distribution lists, and filing systems

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Operations Transformation offering provides NextGen core operational solutions and operating models, business-led technology support, and process optimization services, maximizing value to our government clients’ missions.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of professional experience in a public sector, healthcare, consulting, or related environment
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg) or Geo-Hub locations (Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, and Philadelphia)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to summarize research and draft clear, organized documents
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
  • Demonstrated ability to manage tasks, meet deadlines, and stay organized across multiple priorities
  • Collaborative working style with a willingness to support teammates
  • Academic or professional background in Public Health, Health Administration, Public Policy, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Exposure to Medicaid, state health agency programs, or human services policy (through coursework, internships, or early career experience)
  • Experience using SharePoint or similar project coordination and document management tools
  • Familiarity with rural health issues, health equity, or underserved population health topics
  • Experience supporting meeting coordination, note-taking, or reporting in a professional set
