Job.JobTitle: Rural Health Data Standardization Senior Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $91,100 to $163,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Lake Mary, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Convert hospital financial statements and source documents into standardized, analysis-ready data for Rural Health Transformation engagements. Extract, standardize, and perform quality control on financial and operational data from cost reports and audited statements at scale.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of analytics experience including data cleansing and Excel, and are authorized to work in the US without sponsorship.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team delivers integrated, end-to-end support and advisory services covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, government operations modernization, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. Work alongside clients every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and provide practical solutions at every stage of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.

Work you'll do

As a Rural Health Data Standardization Delivery Senior Consultant on the Operations Transformation team, you will:

  • Convert hospital financial statements and related source documents into standardized, analysis-ready data to support Rural Health Transformation engagement teams.
  • Extract financial and operational data from hospital cost reports, audited financial statements, and other source PDFs at scale
  • Standardize extracted data into consistent, analysis-ready formats aligned with engagement data models
  • Perform quality control checks to identify and resolve data discrepancies, gaps, or extraction errors
  • Maintain documentation of data sources, standardization rules, and assumptions for audit and reproducibility purposes
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure standardized data meets analytical needs
  • Support the development and refinement of extraction templates and standardization processes to improve efficiency over time

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Operations Transformation offering provides NextGen core operational solutions and operating models, business-led technology support, and process optimization services, maximizing value to our government clients’ missions.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • 5+ years of experience with analytics (data cleansing, business intelligence & health analytics, financial analytics, Microsoft Excel, data extraction)
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg) or Geo-Hub locations (Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, and Philadelphia)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Experience working with hospitals and health systems
  • Python experience (data manipulation & analysis, Medicare and Medicaid Services (MDS)
  • Experience working with regional or state governments, Federal Health

Requisition code: 372467
Job ID 372467

Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Fort Lauderdale, FL
  • Experience: 4+ years

About this job

Define and execute data strategy for Deloitte's AI-native product portfolio, manage third-party data and technology vendor relationships, and advise leadership on data monetization opportunities. Work at the portfolio level across Products+ with cross-functional stakeholders.

Good fit if you have 4+ years in data strategy or technology consulting, 2+ years managing third-party vendors, and experience with enterprise procurement processes.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future. This role sits within Products+ at the portfolio level, supporting the overall Product+ data strategy, usage tracking, and procurement.

Position Summary

Data is the foundation of every AI-native product we build, and Product+ needs someone to shape how we source, govern, and capitalize on it. In this role, you'll define the Product+ data strategy, build the third-party data and technology relationships that bring it to life, and advise leadership on how our data assets can drive new revenue. If you want to sit at the intersection of strategy, partnerships, and monetization, this is a rare chance to do it at portfolio level.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/06/2026.

Work you’ll do

In this role, you'll lead the effort to define and execute the data strategy for the Product+ portfolio, working with Product+ leadership and stakeholders across the organization. You'll also manage the third-party data and technology relationships that support it and keep our processes compliant. Key responsibilities include:

  • Drive the process to define, document, and refresh the Product+ data strategy, aligning priorities with Product+ leadership
  • Engage stakeholders across the firm (product, technology, legal, risk, and finance) to gather requirements and build consensus on data needs
  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard third-party data and technology providers that support the data strategy
  • Manage ongoing vendor and partner relationships, including contract renewals, usage, performance, and cost
  • Administer the firm processes required for data and technology acquisition, including procurement, risk, and compliance reviews, and keep documentation audit-ready
  • Track and report data usage and spend across the Product+ portfolio to inform investment decisions
  • Support financial metrics and associated Product+ P&L reporting including commercial performance across pipeline, adoption, margin, and annual growth targets.
  • Serve as a key advisor on data monetization efforts, helping assess opportunities, pricing considerations, and go-to-market approaches
  • Prepare recommendations and updates for Product+ leadership

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to translate ambiguous strategic goals into clear, actionable plans
  • Strong executive communication and the ability to influence without direct authority
  • Comfort navigating complex, cross-functional processes and balancing competing priorities
  • Sound judgment when handling sensitive, contractual, or regulated information
  • Collaborative, relationship-oriented approach with both internal stakeholders and external partners

Qualifications 

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 4+ years' experience in data strategy, data product management, vendor/partner management, or technology strategy consulting
  • 2+ years' experience managing third-party data or technology vendor relationships, including contract or renewal management
  • 2+ years' experience working directly with senior stakeholders or leadership teams
  • Experience working within an enterprise procurement, compliance, or risk review process
  • Ability to travel up to [10]%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • 2+ years' experience supporting or advising on data monetization, data licensing, or data product pricing
  • Experience in a professional services, consulting, or enterprise technology environment
  • Experience tracking and reporting on software or data usage and spend (e.g., using Excel, Power BI, or Tableau)
  • Experience working with AI/ML products or data used to power them
  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS) in a related field

We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don’t miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

The team

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making.   • Experience in Agile methodology to deliver large scale WMS solutions.

  • Advanced Degree in Operations Research, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or related fields with a concentration in operations or analytics.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber ServiceNow SecOps/SIR – Senior Business Process Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $105,400 to $207,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Business Process Consultant role leading ServiceNow Security Incident Response implementations for Deloitte's Cyber team. You will own process design, functional requirements, and workstream delivery for SOC and incident response transformations, mentoring junior consultants and guiding clients through migration from legacy tools.

Good fit if you have 4+ years ServiceNow implementation consulting, 3+ years designing ServiceNow SIR, SOC/incident response knowledge, ServiceNow CSA certification, and can travel 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

•       Lead requirements & design workshops and stakeholder interviews with SOC, incident response, threat intelligence, and IT operations leaders

•       Guide client stakeholders through migration considerations from current-state processes, tools, and data to ServiceNow-aligned architecture, including out-of-the-box adoption, customization trade-offs, and sequencing of capabilities

•       Own the process design & development workstream: current-state assessment, future-state design, response runbooks, severity and escalation models, major incident procedures, RACI, SLAs, and KPIs (e.g., MTTD, MTTR, escalation rate, automation coverage)

•       Develop epics and user stories, directly as output from workshops and process design sessions, working alongside other business process consultants and solution architects

•       Drive functional design decisions for SIR, including alert-to-incident logic, playbooks and flows, Threat Intelligence Security Center (TISC) enrichment, assignment, post-incident reviews, dashboards, and access models, and document via user stories and design documentation

•       Document requirements, RACI matrices, data flows, and integration needs with SIEM, EDR, Threat Intelligence Security Center (TISC) and other threat intelligence sources, as well as touchpoints the CMDB

•       Produce project artifacts: process flows, functional designs, test scenarios, training materials, and release notes

•       Identify where Now Assist and AI Specialists, including agentic incident response, can reduce manual triage and investigation work, and define the human-in-the-loop approval process around them

•       Define integration and data requirements for SIEM, EDR, SOAR, TISC and other threat feeds, and the CMDB in partnership with technical leads

•       Develop your workstream backlog, interacting directly with a team of technical consultants to configure ServiceNow to client specifics

•       Manage day-to-day agile activities, including user story assignment, backlog grooming, sprint preparation, and story refinement

•       Assist in project management reporting, understanding workstream and project wide dependencies and when to raise appropriate risks

•       Review and own quality-check deliverables from Consultants; mentor and coach team members.

•       Manage workstream scope, timeline, and risks; escalate early with a recommendation to engagement managers and senior leadership

•       Lead  show back demonstrations, UAT, defect triage training, cutover, and adoption planning

•       Contribute to proposals, estimates, and reusable practice assets

A successful candidate would possess these skills

•       Self-starter who takes ownership of a workstream and delivers without close supervision

•       Sharp analytical thinker who cuts through complexity to the core issue

•       Resourceful problem solver who builds workable solutions when there is no playbook

•       Advisory mindset: explains trade-offs in plain language and recommends the ServiceNow-aligned path

•       Collaborative leader who raises the performance of the people around them

•       Confident client-facing communicator, comfortable with technical and executive audiences

•       Meticulous attention to detail and quality

•       Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

•       Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Strategy & Transformation offering develops and transforms cyber programs in line with our client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. We support capabilities across a broad suite of ServiceNow products across SecOps, Integrated Risk Management, and IT Asset Management. We are a growing team and are looking for our next generation of leaders to steer the direction of practice.

Qualifications

Required

•        Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Technology, or Business Administration

•       4+ years supporting or leading ServiceNow implementation projects in a client-facing consulting role

•       4+ years gathering business requirements, leading workshops, and designing process flows and functional documentation

•       3+ years designing, configuring, or implementing ServiceNow Security Incident Response including at least one full implementation

•       Working knowledge of SOC and incident response operating processes

•       Experience leading a workstream and mentoring junior team members

•       Experience guiding clients from legacy tools and processes to ServiceNow out-of-the-box aligned design and best practices

•       ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

•       Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

•       Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

•       ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)

•       ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Security Incident Response (CIS- SIR)

•       Architecture Excellence (ArchX)

•       Experience with Threat Intelligence Security Center (TISC)

•       Experience applying NIST 800-61, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, or MITRE ATT&CK in process or platform design

•       Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM, EDR, or SOAR tools

•       Experience with Now Assist for Security Operations, AI Specialists, or Performance Analytics

•       Experience migrating from another case management or SOAR platform

Compensation and Additional Information

Position Summary

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team works to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Delivery Consultant, Data Engineering and Conversion Solutions on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for…

  • Design enterprise cloud data architectures that support transformation initiatives using modern cloud architecture principles.
  • Develop data pipelines, data models, and advanced analytics products using Databricks and/or Snowflake.
  • Apply DevOps practices and data and statistical programming tools to build, deploy, and improve cloud-based data solutions.
  • Conduct business-process assessments and prepare strategic deliverables, including strategic plans and visioning-session materials.
  • Facilitate client sessions and collaborate with executive-level stakeholders to translate business needs into technical delivery priorities.
  • Support State and Local Government client relationships and high-priority business-development activities.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

The team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or business-related field
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a secret level security clearance
  • 3+ years of professional experience
  • 2+ years of experience and engineering and developing cloud data architectures using technologies such as Databricks or Snowflake
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average up to two times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree (or higher) in Biomedical Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or business-related field
  • Experience supporting State and/or Local Government client engagements
  • Experience working on Agile delivery teams
  • Experience using continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices to support cloud data solutions
  • Experience preparing technical documentation for clients and delivering project updates to client stakeholders
  • Experience managing project plans, milestones, and deliverables across workstreams

Senior Consultant role with Deloitte's Reimagined Greenhouse team, Center for Customer Leadership. Develop programming and insights for customer-serving executives across industries, design client experiences, and serve as strategic advisor to account teams.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Reimagined Greenhouse (RG) team has been instrumental in helping thousands of executives and teams tackle business problems. From simple to the most complex, it takes specialized skills, proven best practices, and deft executive facilitation to deliver results that are anything but business-as-usual. Our teams design both physical and virtual environments that enable leaders and their teams to reach their desired outcomes together. 

We are looking for authentic, motivated, organized, and creative team members with a strong sense of self-awareness and emotional intelligence. You are excited to learn new things and are energized thinking about how to help businesses solve their toughest challenges, particularly in a team setting. Specific background, expectations, and experiences vary by role.

In Reimagined Greenhouse we drive 1) clients to advance their careers, the effectiveness of their teams, and their business performance, 2) account teams to deepen relationships with clients through their career arcs and in critical moments that matter, and 3) firm growth priorities by providing unique market-shaping experiences and programs. 

In this role you will interact extensively with senior Deloitte clients in all industries and functions.

Reimagined Greenhouse is searching for a Senior Consultant to join the Center for Customer Leadership (CCL) team. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a wide array of Customer serving executives (i.e., digital, marketing, sales, service). The ideal candidate is a high performer who is a creative, strategic thinker, and an exceptional project manager and communicator. Possession of strong facilitation/presentation skills, executive presence, and a genuine interest in creating and building relationships are a must. A proactive and hard-working attitude and excitement for operating in a fast-paced environment will help the person excel in this role. Above all else, the ideal candidate can generate ideas that help solve problems through imagination, innovation, and storytelling. The ideal candidate will:

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to account teams on how to leverage CCL offerings and customer-facing programming to build durable client relationships
  • Support delivery and execution of the CCL’s programming including, but not limited to: NextGen Executive Academies, Transition Labs, etc.
  • Contribute to strategy development for client programming across career journeys
  • Connect programming to additional RG and CCL workstreams to foster synergies with the aim of maximizing impact for our clients and the business
  • Support RG and CCL strategic projects and sprints 
  • Perform expansive project management support, coordinating across a range of internal and external stakeholders
  • Own executive update decks and impact reporting

The successful candidate will have the following qualifications:

  • 5+ years’ relevant professional work experience. Client service experience is a plus
  • Customer (i.e., Digital, Marketing, Sales, and/or Service) education and experience required
  • Mastery of Microsoft Office (e.g., PowerPoint, Excel, Word)
  • Robust experience with GenAI tools
  • Demonstrate exceptional creativity in designing and executing engaging client experiences 
  • Ability to strategically think at a 30,000 ft. level and then roll up the sleeves to drive tactical tasks forward with speed and agility
  • Ability to manage work across multiple streams, Ability to synthesize group discussions into concise / concrete insights and help steer abstract dialogue into actionable themes
  • Ability to manage risks, knowing what and when to escalate issues to the CCL leadership 
  • Experience working in Salesforce; Jupiter experience/knowledge strongly preferred
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

The successful candidate would also possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team primarily in a virtual environment
  • Excellent executive presence as well as effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Recognizing the differing needs of various stakeholder groups and understanding the importance of adjusting engagement approaches accordingly
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams, shifting across projects thoughtfully and seamlessly
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Operating effectively in ambiguity
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Applying knowledge of business terms and definitions, standard business or financial reports, and common business metrics
  • Taking personal ownership to ensure customers are satisfied and rendering extra services when necessary

Job ID 372268

Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

We're hiring a hands-on Principal Solution Architect who will design and evolve both the high-level and detailed architecture for new product features while supporting and improving existing capabilities. You'll lead with code and architecture pairing with engineers, producing reference implementations, and ensuring robust, scalable, cost-efficient solutions in Azure using .NET/C#, React/Node/TypeScript, and modern data-processing patterns.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Define HLD/LLD for new features and complex refactors (context & container diagrams, sequence diagrams, deployment views, data flows).
  • Author and steward Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), validate decisions via experiments and load tests.
  • Build reference implementations/PoCs in C#/.NET and React/Node to de-risk patterns, performance, and operability.
  • Review and merge PRs, provide actionable feedback, and pair with engineers on tricky problems.
  • Design event-driven and streaming architectures leveraging Azure Service Bus, Functions, App Services, AKS, and API Management.
  • Engineer for high throughput and low latency: concurrency, async I/O, caching (Redis), partitioning, idempotency, back-pressure, and circuit-breaking.
  • Model data across Azure SQL and Cosmos DB, including indexing, partitioning, consistency, and query optimization.
  • Guide modern React (TypeScript) architecture: component design, state management, performance profiling, accessibility, SSR/BFF patterns with Node.js. 
  • Ensure clean API contracts (REST/JSON, GraphQL where appropriate), schema governance, and sound error semantics.
  • Drive observability: distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), metrics and logs (App Insights), and actionable dashboards/alerts.
  • Bake in security: OIDC/OAuth2 (Entra ID), secrets management (Key Vault), OWASP ASVS, threat modeling.
  • Define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and ensure production readiness─on-call participation and RCA for major incidents.
  • Champion CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), IaC (Bicep/Terraform), repeatable environments, and golden paths/templates. 
  • Optimize for cost and performance (FinOps): right-sizing compute, data tiering, caching, and workload scheduling

Lead AI cybersecurity strategy assessments and governance programs for enterprise clients adopting generative AI and agentic systems. Translate business and regulatory objectives into security frameworks, manage client engagements, and coordinate across Deloitte's cyber capabilities.

Full job description

Position Summary

AI Security Manager

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

As a Manager, Strategy, Growth & Transformation specializing in Strategy in Deloitte’s Cyber for AI practice, you will lead client engagements that help enterprises understand the cybersecurity and enterprise risks of adopting AI and define how they will govern, manage and secure it. You will translate business, risk and regulatory objectives into cybersecurity controls, governance frameworks and risk operating models, remain directly involved in critical strategic decisions, and guide teams from assessment through implementation alongside the practice's Data, Infrastructure, Identity, Security Operations and Application Security capabilities. You will also shape solutions during pursuits and help build repeatable delivery assets.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Manager on the Cyber Strategy & Transformation team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading AI cybersecurity strategy assessments, governance workshops, and risk operating model design for clients adopting generative artificial intelligence and agentic systems.
  • Translating business objectives, regulatory obligations, and risk appetite into AI governance frameworks, risk taxonomies, and control operating models.
  • Advising clients on AI security strategy decisions while reviewing governance artifacts, policy documents, and risk assessments developed by engagement teams.
  • Managing engagement scope, teams, milestones, quality, and client expectations across strategy-led AI security programs.
  • Coordinating with Data, Infrastructure, Identity, Application Security, and Security Operations leaders to help translate strategic recommendations into implementable technical requirements, and technical considerations into strategic decisions.
  • Shaping solutions during pursuits through workshops, executive briefings, proposals, estimates, and delivery plans, while developing reusable cyber strategy assets including security controls, governance frameworks, maturity models, risk taxonomies, and playbooks, and coaching practitioners on advisory quality.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Strategy & Transformation offering develops and transforms cyber programs in line with a client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. It keeps the enterprise a step ahead of the evolving threat landscape and gives stakeholders confidence in the organization's cyber posture. Includes design of the cyber organization, governance, and risk assessments.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Risk Management or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • 6+ years of cybersecurity, risk management, or technology consulting experience
  • Experience designing AI governance frameworks, risk operating models, or security strategy programs for enterprise clients
  • Experience with AI/ML architectures and the risks of generative AI and agentic systems, plus familiarity with at least one of the following: NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, or the EU AI Act
  • Experience leading client-facing advisory or risk engagements and coordinating cross-functional workstreams across identity, data, infrastructure, security operations, and application security
  • Ability to travel 25%-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience building AI cybersecurity controls, control guidance, governance operating models, risk committees, or intake and approval processes for enterprise AI programs
  • Experience with governance, risk, and compliance platforms, AI governance tools, or model risk management systems
  • Experience with AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, or secure AI development practices
  • Experience building reusable strategy assets, delivery methods, or advisory frameworks used across multiple engagements
  • Experience with machine learning lifecycle tools or frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow
  • One or more of the following certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional, Certified Information Security Manager, Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer, Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional, or International Organization for Standardization/International Electrotechnical Commission 42001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor

Position Summary

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team works to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

As a Delivery Consultant, AI and Analytics Solutions, you will help design and deliver generative artificial intelligence (AI) and agentic AI solutions that address complex mission and business needs for government and public-sector organizations.

Work you'll do

As a Delivery Consultant, AI and Analytics Solutions on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for:

  • Design and build generative AI and agentic AI solutions using Claude, including agent orchestration, tool integration, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based integrations using the Claude Agent SDK and Claude Cowork.
  • Deliver components of client engagements spanning solution design, prototyping, testing, and production rollout.
  • Lead small teams through business requirements gathering, functional design, process mapping, and support-model definition, providing technical direction throughout.
  • Monitor progress against plan, identify variances, and drive corrective action before issues affect delivery.
  • Identify risks, assumptions, and constraints early, and implement approved mitigations to protect delivery.
  • Maintain clear, consistent communication with client stakeholders and internal engagement leadership.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or related field
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret level security clearance
  • 4+ years of experience delivering artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) solutions, including 1+ year focused on generative AI, agentic AI, or multi-agent systems.
  • 2+ years of experience building AI/ML solutions using Python.
  • 1+ years of experience developing agentic AI systems, including agent orchestration, tool integration, and autonomous decision-making workflows, using LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Strands, CrewAI, or LangGraph.
  • 1+ years of experience using one or more cloud platforms to build or deploy agentic AI applications: 
    • Microsoft Azure (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search or vector databases, Cognitive Services, Microsoft Entra ID, and Azure Key Vault); 
    • Amazon Web Services (AWS) (Amazon Bedrock, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Prompt Flows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, AWS Lambda, Amazon Elastic Container Registry, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud, Amazon Q Business, Amazon Q Developer, Amazon Cognito, AWS Identity and Access Management, AWS Secrets Manager, and AWS Key Management Service);
    • Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Vertex AI, Gemini application programming interface (API), Google AI Studio, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and Google Kubernetes Engine).
  • 1+ years of experience leading project workstreams or engagements for AI solution design and delivery.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 2 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience in consulting roles with client-facing delivery responsibilities.
  • Experience developing materials for client workshops and interactive client sessions, and delivering presentations to stakeholder audiences.
  • Experience building multi-agent systems with task delegation and coordination across agents.
  • Certification as an Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Amazon Web Services (AWS) Certified Machine Learning – Specialty, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect.
  • Experience with large language model (LLM) prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architecture.
  • Experience with machine learning operations (MLOps) or artificial intelligence operations (AIOps), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, cloud-native application development, application programming interface (API) design, microservices architecture, and event-driven systems.

About this job

Senior Manager role at Deloitte's Sourcing and Procurement practice in Jacksonville, Florida. Lead clients through procurement transformation, cost reduction initiatives, and digital technology implementations such as Coupa, Ariba, and Ivalua.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in sourcing or procurement, 4+ years leading client projects, and techno-functional digital procurement experience.

Full job description

Position Summary

Digital Procurement Senior Manager

Deloitte is defining the digital landscape. We are pioneering a new model for a new digital world. Do you like to challenge the status quo? Does curiosity feed your soul? Are you addicted to the thrill of creating? Do you want to be your authentic self at work? Then consider a career within our Supply Chain and Network Operations practice. Creative design, state-of-the-art technology, and your imagination merge here to create lasting impact for our clients. Not to mention make for a pretty fun and meaningful career!  

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/31/2027

 The team  

We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in their Supply Chains and enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions.

Deloitte’s Sourcing and Procurement practice helps clients transform their Strategic Sourcing & Procurement functions into strategic partners for their businesses. We are differentiated by our executable mindset, focus, and strategy capabilities. We excel at strategies that are delivered through a combination of strong category experience, Sourcing and Procurement operating model expertise, broad-based knowledge and management skills, and geographical reach around the world. We advise companies on potential areas of savings relating to both indirect SG&A costs as well as direct Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), and enable digital transformation goals of Strategic Sourcing & Procurement functions through technology (e.g., Coupa, Ariba, etc.) assessments, selection, implementation, and continuous operations.

Work you’ll do  

Industry-leading clients. An award-winning culture. Top notch connections. Big opportunities. At Deloitte, you’ll work with the best in the business to solve the toughest problems in business. From learning to leadership, this is your chance to take your career to the next level.  

We are seeking a Senior Manager to help clients improve sourcing, procurement, and broader value chain performance. In this role, you will lead organizations in driving efficiency, enabling digital transformation, and improving operating models across strategic sourcing and procurement. The ideal candidate brings experience delivering procurement transformation, category strategy, cost reduction, and technology-enabled solutions in complex business environments. 

  • Leading projects that support sourcing and procurement transformation initiatives for client organizations
  • Developing and executing strategic sourcing, category management, and procurement operating model solutions
  • Assessing current-state processes and identifying opportunities for cost reduction, efficiency gains, and value creation
  • Supporting selection, implementation, and optimization of procurement technologies such as Ivalua, Coupa, Ariba, Zip, Oro, Levelpath, and similar platforms
  • Surfacing, scoping, and selling procurement related projects and developing marketplace relationships
  • Managing client relationships, project teams, and deliverables across multiple phases of advisory and implementation work
  • Building eminence and a personal and Deloitte brand in sourcing and procurement

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead complex projects
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

Qualifications

Job ID 372180

Quick facts

  • Pay: $95,600 to $188,400 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time

About this job

Backend software engineer role on Deloitte's Government & Public Services team building secure AI-enabled platform for medical waiver review. Design and develop scalable services, APIs, and data pipelines handling document ingestion, OCR, and integration with AI/ML services in an IL4 environment.

Good fit if you have 4+ years Java programming, API design, database management, and memory management experience

Full job description

Position Summary

Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work You’ll Do

As a Project Software Engineer III on the Government & Public Services team, you will be responsible for backend development to design, build, test, and sustain the services supporting a secure AI-enabled platform that accelerates medical waiver review.

  • Design and develop scalable backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and integrations for document ingestion and AI processing.
  • Support processing of machine-generated and scanned PDFs, including OCR and extraction of structured medical information.
  • Implement workflows for case intake, role-based routing, physician and technician review, feedback capture, and secure export.
  • Integrate AI/ML services that identify relevant conditions, link findings to source documents, and support QUAL, WAVR, and DISQ recommendations.
  • Build audit trails, performance metrics, dashboards, and system logging to support transparency and traceability.
  • Implement secure authentication, authorization, encryption, and data handling for CUI, PII, and PHI in an IL4 environment.
  • Develop APIs and integration patterns that support future connectivity with AFRISS-TF and AFRISS 2.0.
  • Collaborate with AI/ML engineers, frontend developers, cybersecurity personnel, medical SMEs, and government stakeholders.
  • Participate in testing, UAT support, performance tuning, documentation, deployment, sustainment, and knowledge transfer.


A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others


The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Engineering as a Service offering provides end-to-end design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We help transform engineering teams, modernize technology, & deliver complex programs with a product engineering mindset. Our flexible delivery models— traditional teams, pools, or pods, are tailored for each client’s needs, offering engineering-led Advise, Implement, & Operate capabilities to accelerate innovation.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • 4+ years of experience in Java programming - the language and the JVM, not just a framework built on top of it
  • 4+ years of experience with design patterns and principles - Command, Strategy, Factory, etc., and applying one without overengineering
  • 4+ years of experience in API design - versioning, idempotency, error handling, and the tradeoffs between REST, RPC, and event-driven approaches
  • 4+ years of experience in database management - schema design, indexing, query optimization, and transaction/isolation semantics
  • 4+ years of experience in memory management - can explain heap vs. stack, garbage collection behavior, and how to diagnose a memory leak
  • 4+ years of experience in Cyber Analytics * 4+ years of experience in Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Manager within the Sourcing and Procurement team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading workstreams that support sourcing and procurement transformation initiatives for client organizations
  • Developing and executing strategic sourcing, category management, and procurement operating model solutions
  • Assessing current-state processes and identifying opportunities for cost reduction, efficiency gains, and value creation
  • Supporting selection, implementation, and optimization of procurement technologies such as Coupa, Ariba, and similar platforms

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Fort Lauderdale, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Forward Deployed Engineer for Deloitte's Retirement Agentic Ecosystem, an AI-enabled platform for financial services. You'll embed with strategic clients to design solutions, run technical workshops, and build proof-of-concepts that demonstrate platform value.

Good fit if you have 5+ years software engineering experience, deep Java and Spring Boot expertise, understand event-driven architecture, and can travel 20-40%.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Team

Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte’s Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented individual with an innovative mindset to join the Converge for FSI team in our mission to develop differentiated financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This role is focused on the Retirement Agentic Ecosystem (RAE), an AI-enabled platform that connects retirement systems and coordinates workflows across plan onboarding, ongoing operations and participant servicing—helping providers reduce manual work, improve accuracy and deliver more connected experiences. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte’s innovation & product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities.

Position Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled and client-facing Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer partnership. In this role, you will embed directly with our most strategic clients — particularly in the financial services sector — to understand their toughest technical challenges and help them design and implement world-class solutions using our platform. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with direct influence on product direction.

You are equally comfortable whiteboarding microservices architecture with a client's principal engineer, running a hands-on technical workshop for a team of developers, and standing up a compelling proof-of-concept in days. You thrive in fast-moving, high-stakes environments and know how to earn the trust of deeply technical stakeholders.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.

Work you’ll do

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for strategic client accounts, building deep relationships with architects, engineers, and technical leaders
  • Lead discovery sessions to understand client architectures, pain points, and business objectives
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Collaborate with client architects and internal engineering teams to design scalable, production-ready solutions
  • Provide authoritative guidance on microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and cloud-native deployment patterns
  • Review and advise on client system designs, identifying risks and recommending best practices
  • Rapidly prototype and build POCs that demonstrate platform value in the context of a client's real-world use cases
  • Own and deliver polished, technically rigorous demos tailored to the client's specific technology stack and business domain
  • Maintain a library of reusable demo assets and reference implementations
  • Design and facilitate deep-dive technical workshops, hackathons, and onboarding bootcamps for client engineering teams
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides
  • Accelerate client time-to-value by enabling their teams to build confidently and independently
  • Act as the voice of the customer — surface product gaps, integration friction, and feature requests to internal product and engineering teams
  • Partner with Sales, Solutions Architecture, and Product to shape the technical go-to-market strategy

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot, including building production-grade microservices
  • Strong understanding of event-driven architecture — Kafka, event sourcing, CQRS, async messaging patterns
  • Hands-on experience with microservices design principles: service decomposition, API design, resiliency patterns, observability
  • Proficiency across multi-cloud environments, with AWS as a primary platform; working knowledge of Azure and GCP
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Exposure to Agentic AI frameworks and tooling — including LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration frameworks
  • Practical understanding of LLM integration patterns, prompt engineering, and AI-powered application design
  • Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client-relevant use cases
  • Exceptional communicator — able to lead technical conversations with senior engineers and C-suite stakeholders alike
  • Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions
  • Self-directed, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously
  • Natural curiosity and a bias for building — you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one

Qualifications 

Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing or equivalent field. MBA a plus.
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent in client-facing, solutions engineering, or field engineering roles
  • Ability to travel 20-40%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Background in financial services, specifically retirement & wealth, strongly preferred
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices
  • Contributions to open-source projects or public technical content (talks, blogs, repos)
  • Prior experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment
  • Prior experience using AI and LLMs to rapid prototype in a sales, business development or product demonstrations 
  • Relevant cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional, etc.)

Requisition code: 372135
Job ID 372135

Position Summary

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

As a Delivery Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of an enterprise Azure managed services engagement for a US financial services client, lead cross-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will own the day-to-day service relationship, drive SLA and compliance performance, and support estimation, planning and change orders to ensure successful outcomes.

Work you'll do

We are looking for a Delivery Manager to own the delivery of a three-year Azure managed services engagement. You will be the accountable point of contact for the client, leading the teams that Migrate, transition, operate and secure a mix of Azure workloads, including compute and operating systems, containers, serverless services, backup and disaster recovery, patching, vulnerability and security monitoring, and cost optimization

As a Delivery Manager, you will be the onshore Service Delivery Manager for a multi-year Azure managed services contract covering a mix of IaaS (several hundred virtual machines across production, non-production and disaster recovery) and PaaS/serverless services. You will lead Level 2 and Level 3 operations teams across onshore and offshore Delivery centres, run service governance with the client, and ensure the Migrate, Transition and Operate phases are delivered against contractual SLAs, security standards and cost commitments.

Service Delivery & Contract Governance

  • Own end-to-end delivery across Plan & Define, Transition, and Operate (including the 90-day stabilization period), and maintain the Service Delivery Plan (SDP) as a living document.
  • Deliver against contractual SLAs — incident response/resolution, VM availability, and DR RTO/RPO — reporting monthly and running governance forums (service reviews, optimization reviews, steering committee).
  • Control scope and commercials: flag out-of-scope requests, raise change orders, and act as the escalation point for Priority 1 incidents.

Azure IaaS & PaaS Operations Oversight

  • Oversee Level 2/3 support for Azure IaaS (VMs, networking, storage, firewalls/WAF, load balancing) and PaaS/serverless services, including the shared-responsibility boundary with Microsoft.
  • Ensure golden, CIS-hardened images and IaC templates are maintained and used for all deployments, and oversee CI/CD, key/secrets management, and tagging standards.
  • Coordinate with Microsoft support and the client on CSP-side incidents and platform maintenance.

Incident, Problem & Change Management

  • Run ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management through ServiceNow — including the bidirectional eBonding integration — ensuring SLA-compliant prioritization (P1–P4) and root cause analysis for every P1.
  • Govern change requests (standard/normal/emergency) including CAB approvals, and maintain clear hand-offs across client Level 0/1, Deloitte Level 2/3, and third parties.

Security, Compliance & Risk

  • Ensure operational security controls are effective — IAM (SSO/MFA/PAM), credential rotation, and annual access reviews.
  • Oversee vulnerability management (daily scanning, risk prioritization, monthly reporting), SIEM/log monitoring, and security incident response.
  • Oversee cloud security posture management and compliance against NIST/CIS/CSA baselines, and support client audits and control requests.

Backup, Disaster Recovery & Patching

  • Oversee backup/restore policies across block, object, file, and PaaS data; plan and oversee the annual DR fail-over/fail-back test, reporting measured RPO/RTO.
  • Oversee the monthly OS patching cycle and CSP platform maintenance, communicating schedule and impacting the client.

Transition, Automation & Observability

  • Lead transition into managed services — design workshops, solution documentation, tool deployment, and knowledge transfer to steady-state operations.
  • Ensure monitoring/alerting/log management are configured to agreed thresholds, drive automation and continuous improvement (tracking MTTR and incident volume), and maintain client-facing reporting.

FinOps & Financial Management

  • Define budget thresholds and track alerts; oversee the quarterly cloud optimization analysis and reservation/savings-plan reviews.
  • Own delivery P&L inputs (utilization, productivity, revenue leakage) and partner with account leadership on renewals and extensions.

People & Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and coach technical leads and engineers across onshore and offshore Global Cloud Operations centers, including 24x7 on-call coverage for Priority 1 incidents.
  • Manage capacity planning, staffing, and on-call models, and support career development, certification paths, and promotion readiness.

The Team:

At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate advanced connectivity with AI infrastructure and enterprise networks to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in IT infrastructure services delivery, including 5+ years delivering Azure solutions.
  • 3+ years as a delivery manager, service delivery manager or technical lead on an SLA-driven managed services engagement.
  • Strong working knowledge of Azure IaaS: Windows and Linux VMs, VMSS, virtual networks, NSGs, Azure Firewall/WAF, load balancers, managed disks and storage, Entra ID and Key Vault.
  • Working knowledge of Azure PaaS and serverless services (such as App Service, Functions and managed databases), including how operational responsibilities differ from IaaS.
  • Understanding of backup and disaster recovery on Azure (Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery), RPO/RTO objectives and DR testing.
  • Strong command of ITIL and ServiceNow, including incident, problem and change management, SLA reporting and ticketing integrations.
  • Understanding of cloud security operations: vulnerability management, SIEM, endpoint protection, security posture management, IAM/PAM/MFA, and CIS and NIST controls.
  • Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD (Terraform or Bicep; Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) and Windows/Linux patch management.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and log management tools (such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or Datadog).
  • Experience with cloud cost management, including budget alerts, optimization reviews and reservations.
  • Commercial acumen across SOWs, SLAs, change orders and delivery financials.
  • Strong stakeholder and executive communication skills, including client governance and escalation handling.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred

  • Exposure to container platforms and Kubernetes operations (such as AKS).
  • Cloud certifications (Azure preferred) and ITIL 4 certification are an advantage.
  • Experience in banking or financial services is an advantage.

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. Position Summary

Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Test Architect, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Work you’ll do/Responsibilities  

  • Review Project Scope (PTS) and Project Feature (Confluence) documents to determine whether end-to-end (ETE) testing is needed; use the JIRA TA Dashboard and targeted queries to confirm all impacted Scrum Teams, including late joiners.
  • When ETE testing is required, align Business Analysts, the Business Sponsor, and testing teams on scenarios, impacted teams, and open questions; target full scenario sign-off at least one week before UAT/Unified Testing.
  • Coordinate Testbed (TBED) criteria-pull readiness for UAT1/UAT2 in line with the Release Calendar, and drive Test Data Management (TDM) preparation through the designated SharePoint site.
  • Initiate the Test Plan Input in the first impacted Sprint; help teams prepare stories and scripts in the correct Zephyr Release Fix Version aligned to JIRA, or use the required Excel-based process for non-Zephyr teams.
  • Lead Unified Testing communications and execution oversight: distribute status updates at a cadence suited to project risk, monitor progress for slippage, and intervene early to protect release milestones.
  • Oversee JIRA defect health and resolution accountability, validate Zephyr release readiness, and lead testing closure by preparing the TER Readiness Checklist and creating the Test Exit Report (TER).

The Team 

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Qualifications 

 Required 

  • 4+ years of experience in test management or test architecture roles supporting multi-team release programs.
  • Extensive experience coordinating testing across multiple teams and release milestones.
  • Experience with JIRA and Zephyr, or equivalent test management tools, including fix-version alignment and dashboarding.
  • Facilitation skills, with experience aligning business, testing, and delivery stakeholders.
  • Experience producing release-level testing artifacts, such as Test Plans, TER Readiness Checklists, and Test Exit Reports.
  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. This may include overnight travel.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Human Capital team helps organizations create value through people performance. We work with clients to reimagine work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise and to transform their HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today’s world, you will help clients answer questions like: How do I access, develop, and motivate my workforce? What should my AI strategy be for the HR function? Do I have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to make work better for humans and humans better at work.

Work You’ll Do

As a Delivery Consultant on the team, you will support Oracle Cloud HCM Core HR implementation and delivery activities by:

  • Supporting requirements-gathering and design workshops by documenting business needs and assisting with translating them into Oracle Cloud HCM Core HR configuration requirements
  • Assisting with configuration activities for Oracle Cloud HCM modules, including Employee Self-Service (ESS), Manager Self-Service (MSS), personnel action request (PAR) processing, position management, learning administration, time entry and approvals, absence plans, and related HR processes
  • Preparing and maintaining functional deliverables, including configuration workbooks, fit/gap documentation, security artifacts, integration touchpoints, process flows, and testing assets
  • Supporting fit-to-standard workshops by documenting process flows, business requirements, and design decisions for worker records, job and position management, assignments, person data, and HR transactions
  • Supporting data conversion and cutover activities, including worker and organizational-data mapping and validation, document checklists, and parallel-run activities
  • Collaborating with integration, payroll, reporting, and talent-management workstreams; supporting Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) and BI Publisher reporting activities; and maintaining action items and stakeholder communications
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our HR Strategy & Technology offering develops leading global HR strategies and implements HR technologies that drive transformation, maximize the workforce experience, and sustain HR effectiveness and value while navigating a world of disruption.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to serve businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte Center Model has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the center model provides high-quality services to our clients. Center professionals work out of one of our specific Deloitte locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • 1+ years Oracle Cloud HCM experience with configuration and support of Core HR module
  • 2+ years of experience supporting Oracle HCM implementations  
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance for this role
  • Bachelor's Degree
