Job.JobTitle: Technical Delivery Senior Consultant, Qualtrics (CX / XM)
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $110,700 to $218,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Lake Mary, FL
  • Experience: 2+ years

About this job

Design and configure Qualtrics Experience Management solutions for enterprise feedback programs, including survey architecture, integrations with CRM and data platforms, and dashboard reporting. Based at a Deloitte delivery center with hybrid work and up to 10% travel.

Good fit if you have 2+ years configuring Qualtrics surveys, designing cloud platform integrations, and analyzing customer feedback data.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You’ll Do

As a Delivery Senior Consultant, Customer Experience on the Customer Strategy & Design team, you will be responsible for:

  • Translating customer experience program objectives into Qualtrics Experience Management (XM) solution designs that define survey architecture, data models, workflows, and integration requirements.
  • Configuring and optimizing Qualtrics surveys, embedded data, dashboards, automations, and logic for enterprise feedback programs.
  • Building secure integrations between Qualtrics and customer relationship management, human resources information systems, and data warehouse platforms using application programming interfaces, web services, or single sign-on.
  • Deploying unmodified Qualtrics-provided Website/App Insights code in approved global headers or footers; avoiding multiple concurrent snippets; and testing data flow, intercepts, reporting, and workflow performance before production releases.
  • Analyzing customer feedback data, building role-based dashboards, and training stakeholders on reporting and workflow use to support experience management adoption.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Customer Strategy & Design team discovers, designs, and prototypes customer growth strategies and innovation portfolios.

This opportunity sits within our Center talent model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the center model provides high-quality services to our clients. Center professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor's degree preferably in computer science, information systems, data analytics, software engineering, or business analytics.
  • 2+ years of experience configuring Qualtrics Experience Management (XM) Platform surveys, workflows, embedded data, dashboards, and reporting.
  • 2+ years of experience designing integrations between cloud platforms and customer relationship management (CRM), human resources information systems (HRIS), or data warehouse platforms using application programming interfaces (APIs), web services, or single sign-on (SSO).
  • 2+ years of experience analyzing customer feedback data and creating dashboard-based reporting.
  • 2+ years of experience using JavaScript or Python to create survey logic, automate platform workflows, or deploy website feedback code.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance

Preferred: 

  • Qualtrics certification.
  • 1+ years of experience advising clients on best-practices of configuration for data collection.
  • 1+ years of experience delivering platform demos and technical walkthroughs to business stakeholders, translating data-driven findings into clear action.
  • 1+ years of experience integrating Qualtrics with Salesforce, SAP, or Slack.
  • 1+ years of experience supporting federal, state, or local government agencies or public higher education institutions.
  • 1+ years of experience configuring solutions in environments subject to Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) requirements.

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organizations. Our Regulatory & Financial Risk offering supports clients' regulatory and compliance needs, balancing risk and regulatory requirements with enhancing business value and optimizing outcomes. Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of experience in pricing and/or contracting within life sciences, consulting, payer, provider, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare organizations.
  • 2+ years of experience coordinating project activities, reviewing work products, or coaching junior practitioners in a client-facing environment.
  • Experience supporting pricing or contracting processes involving contract terms, governance, lifecycle activities, data analysis, or documentation.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting value-based contracting operations.
  • Experience improving pricing or contracting processes and controls, including documentation, governance, compliance testing, or operating-model activities.
  • Experience with revenue management software, such as Model N.
  • Consulting or advisory experience supporting pharmaceutical or biotechnology clients.

Job.JobTitle: SAP AI Transformation - Senior Consultant - SAP Supply Chain
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $110,700 to $218,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Senior Consultant role in Deloitte's SAP practice focused on SAP Supply Chain transformations. You'll lead supply chain work streams, design SAP S/4HANA solutions across modules like EWM and TM, and help clients advance toward autonomous enterprise using AI-enabled approaches.

Good fit if you have 5+ years SAP consulting experience, led an SAP Supply Chain workstream, and have hands-on configuration in EWM, TM, PP, EAM, or MM modules.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join Deloitte’s SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You’ll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

In this SAP AI Transformation role, you’ll contribute to Agentic ERP transformations that help clients advance toward the autonomous enterprise. Combining SAP expertise with AI-enabled delivery approaches, cross-functional collaboration, and industry insight, you’ll help address complex business challenges and create measurable client impact.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/15/2027

Work you’ll do

As a Senior Consultant in Deloitte’s SAP practice, with a focus on SAP Supply Chain, you will work side by side with functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact solutions that support Agentic ERP transformations. With Deloitte Ascend™, you’ll leverage AI accelerators and SAP capabilities to help clients modernize business processes and advance toward the autonomous enterprise.

This role requires a highly motivated professional who moves with speed and precision, builds practical solutions, and engages confidently with senior stakeholders and delivery teams to help generate measurable business impact.

  • Own assigned SAP Supply Chainwork streams, including work-plan execution, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, stakeholder coordination, and quality of deliverables.
  • Lead and facilitate opportunity-identification, fit-to-standard, autonomous solution-design, and playback workshops with client stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Translate supply chain requirements into SAP S/4HANA solutions and drive functional design and configuration across Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), third-party logistics (3PL) integrations, Production Planning (PP), Transportation Management (TM), Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), and Materials Management (MM).
  • Coordinate cross-functional integration requirements across procurement, sales, accounting, tax, treasury, reporting, and other relevant workstreams.
  • Lead or oversee data migration, testing, defect resolution, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization activities.
  • Assess supply chain processes and design AI-enabled and automated improvements for close, reporting, controls, analytics, and process performance; use Deloitte Ascend™ accelerators where applicable, with human review and validation of AI-generated outputs.
  • Serve as a day-to-day client advisor by communicating progress, decisions, risks, and recommendations to business and senior client stakeholders.
  • Coach junior team members, review work products, and contribute to proposals, estimates, reusable assets, and SAP practice development.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations to enable an Autonomous Enterprise. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree; or an associate degree and 6+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), or consulting experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP consulting, enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation, or SAP/ERP technology transformation in a consulting or industry environment.
  • Experience supporting at least two full-lifecycle SAP implementations from project initiation through go-live and hypercare, with demonstrated ownership or leadership of an SAP Supply Chain workstream or workstream area on at least one implementation, and experience supporting an SAP S/4HANA implementation.
  • 2+ years of hands-on functional configuration experience in at least one of the following SAP Supply Chain modules: SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), SAP Transportation Management (TM), SAP Production Planning (PP), SAP Production Planning for Process Industries (PP-PI), SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), SAP Materials Management (MM), or SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP).
  • Experience managing work plans, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, deliverables, and team coordination.
  • Experience collaborating directly with client supply chain stakeholders to gather and document business requirements and support SAP Supply Chain solution design, configuration, testing, or deployment on at least one SAP implementation, transformation, or support project.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Experience applying artificial intelligence (AI) tools—including generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning, conversational AI, or AI agents—to support enterprise transformation initiatives, including solution design, implementation, testing, or human-in-the-loop review and validation.
  • Experience supporting SAP cloud programs or SAP transformation programs deployed across multiple countries.
  • Experience applying SAP Activate, Agile, or Waterfall methodologies on SAP implementation programs.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, estimates, solution designs, or client presentations.
  • Experience coaching or mentoring junior team members.
  • One or more SAP certifications

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Join Deloitte’s SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You’ll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

In this SAP AI Transformation role, you’ll contribute to Agentic ERP transformations that help clients advance toward the autonomous enterprise. Combining SAP expertise with AI-enabled delivery approaches, cross-functional collaboration, and industry insight, you’ll help address complex business challenges and create measurable client impact.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/15/2027

Work you’ll do

As a Consultant in Deloitte’s SAP practice, with a focus on SAP Order to Cash, you will work side by side with functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact solutions that support Agentic ERP transformations. With Deloitte Ascend™, you’ll leverage AI accelerators and SAP capabilities to help clients modernize business processes and advance toward the autonomous enterprise.

This role requires a highly motivated professional who moves with speed and precision, builds practical solutions, and engages confidently with senior stakeholders and delivery teams to help generate measurable business impact.

  • Support SAP Order to Cash workstreams by identifying opportunities, tracking work-plan activities, identifying dependencies, risks, and issues, and preparing deliverables.
  • Participate in and facilitate opportunity-identification, fit-to-standard, and autonomous solution-design workshops.
  • Translate commercial and Order to Cash improvement opportunities into SAP solutions and support configuration across the end-to-end Order to Cash process.
  • Support coordination of commercial integration requirements with supply chain, finance and accounting, tax, and reporting teams.
  • Contribute to data migration, testing, defect resolution, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization activities.
  • Apply an AI-native approach to SAP delivery by using AI tools to accelerate analysis, solution design, prototyping, testing, and documentation, while maintaining human oversight to review, validate, and curate outputs.
  • Communicate project progress, decisions, risks, and action items with client and Deloitte team members; support training, change adoption, post-go-live activities, proposal development, and reusable SAP practice assets.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations that modernize operations, improve business performance, and create lasting value. Our teams bring together industry knowledge, functional expertise, technology capabilities, and emerging AI solutions to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to help advance the autonomous enterprise through Agentic ERP, cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. Depending on client needs, our work spans strategy, design, implementation, integration, data, testing, deployment, change, and post-go-live support.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree; or an associate degree and 4+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), or consulting experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • 2+ years of experience in SAP consulting, enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation, or SAP/ERP technology transformation in a consulting or industry environment.
  • Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle SAP implementation from project initiation through go-live and hypercare and experience supporting an SAP S/4HANA implementation.
  • 1+ year of hands-on functional configuration experience in at least one of the following: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD), or SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM).
  • Experience working directly with client or business stakeholders to support requirements gathering, testing, or deployment activities on at least one SAP implementation, transformation, or support project.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Experience applying artificial intelligence (AI) tools—including generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning, conversational AI, or AI agents—to support enterprise transformation initiatives, including solution design, implementation, testing, or human-in-the-loop review and validation.
  • Experience supporting or facilitating SAP design workshops, demonstrations, or testing activities.
  • Experience supporting SAP cloud programs or SAP transformation programs deployed across multiple countries.
  • Experience applying SAP Activate, Agile, or Waterfall methodologies on SAP implementation programs.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, estimates, solution designs, or client presentations.
  • One or more SAP certifications

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 6+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Lead vulnerability management and patching operations for Deloitte's Cyber Defense & Resilience team, prioritizing remediation across infrastructure and applications using threat intelligence and exposure data. You'll develop reporting metrics, mentor junior staff, and advise clients on AI-related security risks.

Good fit if you have 6+ years in IT security with hands-on vulnerability and patch management experience, automation scripting skills, and a relevant cybersecurity certification.

Full job description

Position Summary

Are you an experienced cybersecurity professional looking to help organizations reduce cyber risk and improve resilience? At Deloitte & Touche LLP, you’ll work with leading organizations to strengthen security, enable innovation, and reduce threat exposure. Join Deloitte’s Cyber Defense & Resilience Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) team to help clients identify, assess, and reduce their attack surface. In this role, you’ll lead remediation efforts, work with cross-functional stakeholders, and deliver solutions aligned to business and security priorities.

Recruiting for this role ends on 03/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Cyber Manager – ASM Vulnerability Management – Patching on the Cyber Defense & Resilience Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) team, you will be responsible for:

• Manage exposure-based remediation and patching activities aligned to CTEM priorities and lead vulnerability and patch management operations across infrastructure, middleware, and applications.

• Prioritize remediation activities using threat intelligence, exploitability, attack paths, asset criticality, and exposure data; support exception management, incident-driven response activities, and process improvements that reduce cyber risk.

• Develop vulnerability management reporting metrics and dashboards that track remediation progress and exposure reduction for client stakeholders; develop client deliverables and mentor junior practitioners.

• Support proposals and points of view, including contributing to proposal content, staffing and pricing models, and statements of work.

• Support client advisory efforts on exposure and risk considerations introduced by artificial intelligence (AI) and large language model deployments, including AI-specific attack surface, data exposure, and model and supply chain risk.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

• Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

• Effective written and verbal communication skills

• Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

• Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

• Ability to lead projects or workstreams

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

• Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

• Ability to meet deadlines

• Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Cyber Specialists help organizations manage cyber risk through stronger security, greater visibility, and embedded privacy practices. The Cyber Defense & Resilience team works with clients to design, implement, and operate programs that help protect critical assets, support digital transformation, and respond to evolving threats. Within this practice, the CTEM team helps clients identify exposures, prioritize remediation, and reduce risk across complex technology environments.

Qualifications

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field

• 6+ years of experience in information technology, information security, or both, including leading and executing vulnerability management, patch management, or continuous threat exposure management remediation programs; hands-on experience remediating vulnerabilities and executing patch management across Linux, Windows, middleware, and applications using one or more of the following tools: BigFix, Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager, Red Hat Satellite, Windows Server Update Services, Tenable, Rapid7, or Qualys.

• Experience automating remediation workflows using PowerShell, Bash, Python, JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), Ansible, Terraform, or a combination of these; hands-on experience using and configuring Information Technology Service Management or configuration management database platforms, such as ServiceNow, to coordinate remediation activities and report exposure reduction.

• Experience applying risk-based vulnerability prioritization approaches that weigh exploitability, asset criticality, and business risk in addition to severity scores; experience leading or supporting efforts to mature client attack surface management processes, tooling, and reporting.

• Experience assessing artificial intelligence (AI) and Frontier AI risk considerations, including AI-related threat vectors such as prompt injection, data poisoning, and model supply chain risk, and applying them to exposure management programs; possession of one of the following cybersecurity certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), a Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC), or Qualys Certified Specialist; experience supporting sales pursuits, Request for Proposal (RFP) responses, and solution development for cyber managed services engagements, translating technical security findings into client recommendations and status updates, mentoring and developing junior team members, and coordinating activities across a project team or workstream.

• Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

• Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field

• Experience working in a consulting environment or for a Big 4 firm

• Experience with ServiceNow workflows, automation, or orchestration

• Experience using one or more of the following frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework, Center for Internet Security, International Organization for Standardization 27001, or Cloud Security Alliance Cloud Controls Matrix

• Experience supporting proposals, statements of work, or work orders

• Experience with artificial intelligence (AI) security governance frameworks, including the National Institute of Standards and Technology AI Risk Management Framework or International Organization for Standardization/International Electrotechnical Commission 42001 (ISO/IEC 42001), or supporting clients on responsible AI adoption; experience assessing or advising on AI and machine learning (AI/ML)-specific attack surface as part of broader attack surface management (ASM) or continuous threat exposure management (CTEM) programs.

Compensation and Incentive Disclosure

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 to $265,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Lead architect role designing and implementing SAP Sales and Service Cloud solutions for enterprise clients. You will define end-to-end solution architecture, lead discovery workshops, and govern delivery from blueprint through operational handover.

Good fit if you have 7+ years of SAP CX implementation experience with Sales and Service Cloud, plus expertise in lead-to-cash processes and can travel up to 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. 

Recruiting for this role ends on January 13, 2027

Work you’ll do

As a Lead Architect at Deloitte Digital, get ready to tackle numerous mission-critical company directives. Our team takes on the challenge of designing, developing, and re-engineering highly complex application components and integrating software packages using various tools. You will use a mix of consultative skills, business knowledge, and technical expertise to effectively integrate packaged technology into our clients’ business environment and achieve business results. 

You will:

  • Lead discovery and explore workshops to assess current-state processes, pain points, business requirements, and transformation priorities.
  • Define the end-to-end solution and integration architecture for SAP Sales and Service Cloud V2, aligning functional, technical, and business needs.
  • Set the architecture direction for integrations with SAP and third-party systems, including S/4HANA, using SAP Integration Suite, APIs, OData, and event-based patterns.
  • Define the extensibility strategy across in-app and SAP BTP side-by-side options, including CAP/RAP services, custom objects, UI extensions, and reporting.
  • Design identity, authentication, authorization, and role-based access models using SAP Cloud Identity Services, including SSO, OAuth, and data-access controls.
  • Guide the solution design for core sales and service capabilities, including lead-to-quote processes, case management, agent experience, omnichannel routing, and service levels.
  • Lead architecture and functional design for C4C-to-Sales and Service Cloud V2 migration, considering data, integrations, extensions, and conversion supportability.
  • Advise on the broader SAP CX landscape—including Field Service Management and CPQ—and develop implementation roadmaps aligned to client objectives.
  • Govern delivery from blueprint and functional specifications through configuration, development, testing, training, and operational handover.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth. 

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of experience in SAP CX implementations in Sales & Service transformations using SAP Sales and Service Cloud V1 / V2 and SAP BTP Build;
  • 3+ years of experience in SAP Sales Cloud & Service Cloud functional and technical configuration & setup including CTI integration;
  • 7+ years of experience in ‘Lead to Cash’ and ‘Customer Service to Field Service’ processes;
  • 1+ years of experience in SAP FSM and SAP CPQ Cloud solutions
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • Experience in SAP Field Service Management (FSM) Cloud
  • Experience in SAP CPQ 2.0
  • Experience in SAP OTC – Sales and Distribution

Job ID 371701

Position Summary

Deloitte is defining the digital landscape. We are pioneering a new model for a new digital world. Do you like to challenge the status quo? Does curiosity feed your soul? Are you addicted to the thrill of creating? Do you want to be your authentic self at work? Then consider a career within our Software Defined Products practice. Creative design, state-of-the-art technology, and your imagination merge here to create lasting impact for our clients. Not to mention make for a pretty fun and meaningful career!  

  The team  

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy.  

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/5/2027.

Work You’ll Do

Industry-leading clients. An award-winning culture. Top notch connections. Big opportunities. At Deloitte, you’ll work with the best in the business to solve the toughest problems in business. From learning to leadership, this is your chance to take your career to the next level. 

This role is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of supply chain planning solutions, serving as the primary client interface, managing resource allocation, and directing cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives. The position oversees solution design, configuration, deployment, testing, data analysis, performance measurement, policy development, and knowledge management initiatives. Success in this role requires deep expertise in analytics, advanced planning systems such as Kinaxis, optimization methodologies, financial and statistical analysis, mathematical modeling, and data science technologies. The ideal candidate is a proven leader who consistently delivers results, exceeds client expectations, builds strong stakeholder relationships, applies strategic and critical thinking, and effectively manages complex projects and diverse teams.

·       Lead requirements gathering and process optimization for Supply Chain Planning, identifying opportunities for automation, cycle-time reduction, productivity improvements, and enhanced business outcomes.

·       Architect and design Kinaxis RapidResponse solutions, providing system architecture guidance and developing technical specifications across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) modules.

·       Configure and enhance supply chain planning capabilities, including worksheets, workbooks, dashboards, alerts, metrics, scorecards, control sets, and other system features to meet business requirements.

·       Partner with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, and vendor consultants to define user stories, prioritize enabler work, support implementation strategies, and drive roadmap alignment.

·       Support end-to-end solution delivery through data integration, performance optimization, system documentation, architecture modeling, knowledge transfer, and collaboration on technical integration requirements.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

·       Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
·       Effective written and verbal communication skills
·       Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
·       Ability to lead projects or workstreams
·       Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
·       Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
·       Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

Required Qualifications

·       10+ years of experience in supply chain implementation using Kinaxis RapidResponse

·       5+ full life cycle implementations of supply chain planning projects end to end

·       3+ years experience managing and mentoring teams in a consulting environment

·       Ability to travel up to 50%, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

·       Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field

·       Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred Qualifications

·       Certified as a Kinaxis Solution Architect or has completed all requirements for Kinaxis Solution Architect certification
·       Other leading Cloud based Supply Chain Planning solutions implementation experience (e.g. o9, Blue Yonder)
·       1+ year experience in Agile methodology to deliver large scale enterprise solutions
·       MBA or advanced degree
·       Experience engaging and managing senior-level client relationships.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber ServiceNow SecOps/ SIR – Business Process Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.


Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.


Work you'll do


•Facilitate workshops, stakeholder interviews, and requirements gathering with security operations center (SOC), incident response, and threat intelligence teams to document current-state and future-state processes based on ServiceNow out-of-the-box principles.

•Map incident lifecycles, supporting tools, and data to ServiceNow Security Incident Response (SIR) capabilities and data models; identify gaps and migration considerations.

•Develop epics, user stories, requirements, Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, and Informed (RACI) matrices, data flows, and integration needs for security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), Threat Intelligence Security Center (TISC), and configuration management database (CMDB) platforms.

•Support functional design and configuration of the SIR workspace, incident forms and states, assignment and escalation rules, response tasks, playbooks, flows, notifications, service-level agreements (SLAs), dashboards, roles, and access controls.

•Produce test scenarios, training materials, and release notes; manage user story assignment, backlog grooming, sprint preparation, story refinement, demonstrations, user acceptance testing, defect triage, cutover, and risk tracking with engagement managers.


A successful candidate would possess these skills:


•Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

• Effective written and verbal communication skills

• Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

• Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

• Ability to lead projects or workstreams

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

• Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

• Ability to meet deadlines

• Ability to provide clear guidance to others


The team

Our Cyber Strategy & Transformation offering develops and transforms cyber programs in line with our client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. We support capabilities across a broad suite of ServiceNow products across SecOps, Integrated Risk Management, and IT Asset Management. We are a growing team and are looking for our next generation of leaders to steer the direction of practice.


Qualifications


Required:

•Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Technology, or Business Administration

•ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and 2+ years supporting ServiceNow implementation projects in a client-facing consulting role

•2+ years gathering business requirements, facilitating workshops, and documenting process flows or user stories

•2+ years designing, configuring, or implementing ServiceNow Security Incident Response (SIR)

•Experience supporting security operations center (SOC) and incident response processes

•Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

•Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.


Preferred:


•One or more of the following credentials: ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD), ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Security Incident Response (CIS-SIR), or Architecture Excellence (ArchX)

•Experience with ServiceNow Major Security Incident Management, Data Loss Prevention, or Threat Intelligence Security Center (TISC) applications

• Experience applying National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Special Publication 800-61, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), or MITRE ATT&CK

• Experience integrating ServiceNow with security information and event management (SIEM) or endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools, including Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike, or Microsoft Defender

• Experience using Now Assist for Security Operations

• Experience as a SOC analyst or incident responder


The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $82,600 to $162,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: SAP Sales and Service Cloud Functional Senior Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $110,700 to $218,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Functional Senior Consultant role configuring SAP Sales and Service Cloud for enterprise clients. Involves designing sales and service processes, conducting discovery workshops, supporting integrations, and advising on digital transformation opportunities.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in SAP CX implementations with Sales and Service Cloud V1/V2 experience and knowledge of Lead to Cash processes.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. 

Recruiting for this role ends on January 13, 2027

Work you’ll do

As a Functional Senior Consultant at Deloitte Digital, get ready to tackle numerous mission-critical company directives. Our team takes on the challenge of designing, developing, and re-engineering highly complex application components and integrating software packages using various tools. You will use a mix of consultative skills, business knowledge, and technical expertise to effectively integrate packaged technology into our clients’ business environment and achieve business results. 

You will:

  • Facilitate discovery and explore workshops to understand current processes, pain points, and business requirements.
  • Translate requirements into business blueprints, process flows, functional designs, and configuration specifications.
  • Advise clients on SAP CX capabilities, digital transformation opportunities, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Configure sales processes, including leads, opportunities, pipeline management, quotations, and forecasting.
  • Configure service processes, including case management, agent experiences, queues, escalations, SLAs, and channel routing.
  • Set up sales and service organizational structures, roles, access controls, and user assignments.
  • Support integrations, data migration, and end-to-end solution design, including SAP C4C-to-Sales and Service Cloud V2 transitions.
  • Partner with development teams to design, build, and test required extensions and integration objects.
  • Plan and execute prototyping, testing, training coordination, and operational support documentation.
  • Apply working knowledge of SAP Field Service Management and SAP CPQ to support end-to-end CX requirements.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth. 

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in SAP CX implementations in Sales & Service transformations using SAP Sales and Service Cloud V1 / V2 and SAP BTP Build;
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP Sales Cloud & Service Cloud functional and technical configuration & setup including CTI integration;
  • 5+ years of experience in ‘Lead to Cash’ and ‘Customer Service to Field Service’ processes;
  • Some experience in SAP FSM and SAP CPQ Cloud solutions
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • Experience in SAP Field Service Management (FSM) Cloud
  • Experience in SAP CPQ 2.0
  • Experience in SAP OTC – Sales and Distribution

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 - $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Converge Signals, FSI - Engineering Lead_Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $141,200 to $278,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Fort Lauderdale, FL
  • Experience: 7+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Engineering Lead role building data platforms and AI-powered products for financial services at Deloitte's Innovation & Delivery Transformation team. You'll own architecture decisions to turn prototypes into a production platform serving the Signals for FSI product suite, leading engineers and partnering with product and data science teams.

Good fit if you have experience transitioning prototypes to production-scale platforms, expertise in geospatial data systems and ETL pipelines, and can lead technical conversations with both engineers and executives.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.

Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented Data Scientist to join the Converge for FSI team and help build differentiated, data-driven financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This is a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced analytics and financial services industry expertise, developing the models and insights that power Signals for FSI and future products in the Converge for FSI portfolio.

Position Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled and client-facing Engineering Lead to sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer partnership, supporting the Signals for FSI product. Signals is a proprietary set of data assets coupled with AI, data science, and statistical models that help our clients drive business growth and power decisions in a dynamic and changing market. You’ll own the architecture decisions that turn this from a collection of prototypes into a real platform: a shared data pipeline and warehouse that any app in the suite can draw from, a common geospatial/demographic data layer that scales nationally. In this role, you will partner with our product & data science team to integrate new data sources and harden prototypes into applications based on client feedback. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with direct influence on product direction. You will be part of the General Manager’s leadership team, responsible for proactively bringing ideas that push the business forward, weighing in on key decisions, and helping junior resources across the team overcome hurdles. This is a build-it-for-real role for someone who’s done this exact transition before — not scaling one app, but building the reusable foundation that lets a whole suite of client-facing products scale together.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.

Work you’ll do

As the Engineering Lead, you will work at the intersection of data science, engineering, and financial services domain expertise to build and refine the data platforms, models, and analytics that power Signals for FSI:

  • Rapidly prototype and build POCs using financial services datasets and data models that demonstrate value in the context of a client's real-world use cases
  • Lead teams of onshore and offshore data engineers and application engineers to harden prototypes into production grade applications that satisfy the highly secure and regulated environments of financial services.
  • Collaborate with internal Product & Data fabric teams to integrate new data sources and design and build scalable, production-ready data pipelines and applications.
  • Partner with the Product team and client architects to translate financial services use cases into requirements, features, and application specifications.
  • Recognize and promote opportunities for reuse when designing prototypes and applications.
  • Evaluate data, model and application performance against business and regulatory considerations relevant to financial services and iterate based on findings.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, business-relevant insights for Product, Sales, and client-facing teams to shape the technical go-to-market strategy.
  • Maintain a library of reusable demo assets, hardened applications, and reference implementations.
  • Stay current on emerging AI/ML techniques and financial services data trends, and evaluate their application to the Signals for FSI roadmap.
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Experience in building data and insights products and pipelines that power insights and signals for business users to drive growth decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to take a working prototype and re-architect it for production scale, cost, and reliability — not just incremental feature work
  • Exceptional written & verbal communicator — able to lead technical conversations with senior engineers and C-suite stakeholders alike; able to translate infrastructure tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders
  • Proven experience designing and scaling geospatial/location-based data systems (spatial indexing, PostGIS, H3, or equivalent) — ability to replace client-side point-in-radius rendering with server-side spatial queries at scale
  • Strong background in ETL/data pipeline engineering — designing scheduled ingestion from third-party data vendors into a warehouse or lake (BigQuery, Snowflake, or equivalent)
  • Experience with Python/FastAPI (or comparable) backend development and React/TypeScript frontend development, sufficient to review and refactor both sides of a full-stack codebase
  • Hands-on experience with data security and PII handling — masking, access controls, and retention policy for datasets containing personal identifiers
  • Experience standing up CI/CD pipelines and container/Helm-based deployment from scratch
  • Familiarity with authentication/authorization platforms (OAuth2, enterprise SSO/gateway integration) and migrating services onto a shared platform auth layer
  • Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry, with curiosity about how data translates into real client outcomes.
  • Exposure to Agentic AI frameworks, harnesses, and tooling — including LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration frameworks
  • Practical understanding of LLM integration patterns, prompt engineering, and AI-powered application design
  • Strong analytical rigor paired with sound judgment about when a model is ready to ship versus needing further refinement.
  • Comfortable moving between hands-on technical work and clear communication with product, engineering, and business stakeholders.
  • Self-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams at once.
  • Collaborative mindset and a willingness to partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring models into production.
  • Comfortable working through ambiguous, messy problems that require creativity and persistence.

Qualifications 

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in a technical lead or architecture role
  • Ability to travel 10-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree (Master’s) in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience working with financial services data (e.g., banking, capital markets, or insurance) or delivering analytics solutions to financial services clients.
  • Experience with cloud-based data and analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) in a financial services or other highly regulated industry context.
  • Familiarity with risk, fraud, credit, or customer analytics use cases within banking, capital markets, or insurance.
  • Experience with feature stores or ML feature engineering pipelines, particularly for on-demand/real-time scoring rather than static precomputed datasets
  • Background in financial services or another regulated industry, with working knowledge of data vendor licensing/compliance constraints (e.g., credit bureau or B2B data providers)
  • Experience with LLM/agent infrastructure (LangChain, LLM gateways) including cost monitoring and latency observability
  • Familiarity with FDIC, Census, or similar public geospatial/demographic datasets
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or paved-road tooling that other engineering teams consume
  • Prior experience taking a product from single-region/regional pilot to national or multi-region scale
  • Experience with observability stacks (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) for both application and ML/LLM monitoring
  • Background in a startup, management consulting, commercial transformation, or enterprise technology product leadership, ideally with a data focus (e.g. Epsilon, TransUnion, Equifax, Experian, Axciom)

Job.JobTitle: Converge Signals, FSI - Data Scientist_Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.

Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented Data Scientist to join the Converge for FSI team and help build differentiated, data-driven financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This is a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced analytics and financial services industry expertise, developing the models and insights that power Signals for FSI and future products in the Converge for FSI portfolio.

Position Summary

Financial services data holds enormous, often-underused potential — and turning it into decisions the business can act on takes both rigorous technical craft and real industry fluency. As a Data Scientist on the Signals for FSI team, you'll build the analytical engine behind one of Converge for FSI's flagship products, working hands-on with real financial services data to develop models clients can trust. You'll do it on a team that pairs start-up speed with the scale and credibility of Deloitte, giving you room to experiment while your work reaches some of the most influential institutions in financial services.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026. 

Work you’ll do

As the Data Scientist, you will work at the intersection of data science, product, and financial services domain expertise to build and refine the models and analytics that power Signals for FSI:

  • Develop, test, and refine statistical and machine learning models using financial services datasets (e.g., consumers, businesses, transactions, accounts, risk, or market data) to power Signals for FSI.
  • Partner with the Product team to translate financial services use cases into data requirements, features, data signals, and model specifications.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis and validate data quality across structured and semi-structured financial services data sources.
  • Evaluate model performance against business and regulatory considerations relevant to financial services and iterate based on findings.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, business-relevant insights for Product, Sales, and client-facing teams.
  • Stay current on emerging Statistical, AI/ML techniques and financial services data trends, and evaluate their application to the Signals for FSI roadmap.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry, with curiosity about how data translates into real client outcomes – early use cases are retail banking, investment and wealth management and insurance, but will expand over time.
  • Strong analytical rigor paired with sound judgment about when a signal or model is ready to ship versus needing further refinement.
  • Comfortable moving between hands-on technical work and clear communication with product, engineering, and business stakeholders.
  • Self-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams at once.
  • Collaborative mindset and a willingness to partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring models into production.
  • Comfortable working through ambiguous, messy problems that require creativity and persistence.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 4+ years of experience in applied data science, machine learning, or statistical modeling, including hands-on model development and validation – proficient at using Python, SQL and other data transformation and analytical tools
  • Ability to travel 10-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree (Master’s) in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience working with financial services data (e.g., banking, capital markets, investment management, or insurance) or delivering analytics solutions to financial services clients.
  • 2+ years of working with customer data to build audiences and segments for sales and marketing use cases.
  • Experience with cloud-based data and analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) in a financial services or other highly regulated industry context.
  • Experience with MCP servers and use of AI to analyze large data sets.

Job.JobTitle: SAP AI Transformation - Senior Consultant - SAP OTC
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $110,700 to $218,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Senior Consultant role at Deloitte's SAP practice focused on Order to Cash transformations. You'll lead SAP implementation workstreams, design AI-enabled process improvements, and work with clients to modernize core business processes.

Good fit if you have 5+ years SAP consulting experience, have led an Order to Cash workstream on at least one full-lifecycle SAP implementation, and can travel up to 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join Deloitte’s SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You’ll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

In this SAP AI Transformation role, you’ll contribute to Agentic ERP transformations that help clients advance toward the autonomous enterprise. Combining SAP expertise with AI-enabled delivery approaches, cross-functional collaboration, and industry insight, you’ll help address complex business challenges and create measurable client impact.

Recruiting for this role ends on 01/15/2027.

Work you’ll do

As a Senior Consultant in Deloitte’s SAP practice, with a focus on SAP Order to Cash, you will work side by side with functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact solutions that support Agentic ERP transformations. With Deloitte Ascend™, you’ll leverage AI accelerators and SAP capabilities to help clients modernize business processes and advance toward the autonomous enterprise.

This role requires a highly motivated professional who moves with speed and precision, builds practical solutions, and engages confidently with senior stakeholders and delivery teams to help generate measurable business impact.

  • Own assigned SAP Order to Cash workstreams, including work-plan execution, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, stakeholder coordination, and quality of deliverables.
  • Lead and facilitate opportunity-identification, fit-to-standard, autonomous solution-design, and playback workshops with client stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Translate commercial and Order to Cash improvement opportunities into SAP solutions and lead assigned functional design and configuration activities across the end-to-end Order to Cash process.
  • Lead and coordinate commercial integration requirements across procurement, supply chain, accounting, tax, treasury, and reporting teams.
  • Lead or oversee data migration, testing, defect resolution, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization activities.
  • Assess Order to Cash processes and design AI-enabled and automated improvements across order management, pricing, fulfillment, billing, cash application, dispute management, reporting, and process performance; use Deloitte Ascend™ accelerators where applicable, with human review and validation of AI-generated outputs.
  • Serve as a day-to-day client advisor by communicating progress, decisions, risks, and recommendations to business and senior client stakeholders.
  • Coach junior team members, review work products, and contribute to proposals, estimates, reusable assets, and SAP practice development.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations to enable an Autonomous Enterprise. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree; or an associate degree and 6+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), or consulting experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP consulting, enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation, or SAP/ERP technology transformation in a consulting or industry environment.
  • Experience supporting at least two full-lifecycle SAP implementations from project initiation through go-live and hypercare, with demonstrated ownership or leadership of an SAP Order to Cash workstream or workstream area on at least one implementation, and experience supporting an SAP S/4HANA implementation.
  • 2+ years of hands-on functional configuration experience in at least one of the following: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD), or SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM).
  • Experience managing work plans, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, deliverables, and team coordination.
  • Experience collaborating directly with client stakeholders to gather and document business requirements and support solution design, configuration, testing, or deployment on at least one SAP implementation, transformation, or support project.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Experience applying artificial intelligence (AI) tools—including generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning, conversational AI, or AI agents—to support enterprise transformation initiatives, including solution design, implementation, testing, or human-in-the-loop review and validation.
  • Experience supporting SAP cloud programs or SAP transformation programs deployed across multiple countries.
  • Experience applying SAP Activate, Agile, or Waterfall methodologies on SAP implementation programs.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, estimates, solution designs, or client presentations.
  • Experience coaching or mentoring junior team members.
  • One or more SAP certifications

The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Supply Chain Strategic Network Transformation Senior Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations! 
 
Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don’t miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce! 

Recruiting for this role ends on 2/14/2027 

The team 

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

The Work You’ll Do

This role draws on your deep understanding of supply chain network strategy, design, and optimization. The list below is a sample, and each project will give you the chance to grow your network transformation capabilities and your leadership of client teams.

  • Support the development of supply chain transformation strategies and roadmaps, helping sequence key components of the transformation from planning to execution
  • Execute key components of network design and optimization engagements, from problem framing and data collection through modeling, scenario analysis, and recommendations
  • Build, run, and validate models to answer key network questions around facility footprint and capacity, sourcing, inventory positioning, transportation flows, and cost-to-serve using supply chain design and simulation tools
  • Gather, cleanse, and structure client data, including cost, volume, lead time, and other network data to build reliable baseline models and support scenario development
  • Translate model outputs into clear, concise insights and executive-ready materials that support recommendations and business cases
  • Support assessment of client manufacturing, warehouse, and transportation operations, and contribute to defining the target-state operating model, processes, and enabling technologies
  • Prepare for, support, and lead discussions with client stakeholders across supply chain, operations, logistics, finance, and IT to understand business objectives and challenges, and present analyses and findings to client teams
  • Support the planning and execution of network transformation programs, including implementation roadmaps, change impacts, governance, and benefits tracking
  • Contribute to Deloitte’s go-to-market efforts, including supporting pursuits, thought leadership, offerings, and innovative solutions to bolster the future of the practice, and stay current on emerging network, decision intelligence, and AI-enabled optimization capabilities

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in supply chain consulting or industry roles focused on network design, logistics, distribution, or supply chain strategy
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with supply chain network design and optimization, including data gathering and cleansing, baseline model build, scenario development, and results interpretation
  • Experience using one or more network modeling and optimization tools (for example, Coupa Supply Chain Optimization, AIMMS, Optilogic, Lyric, or similar) 
  • Team lead experience
  • Bachelor’s Degree 
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.  
  • Must be authorized to work in the US without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience quantifying and communicating cost-to-serve, service, inventory, and transportation trade-offs through analytics and business cases, and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Prior consulting experience
  • Certification provided by software vendor 
  • Working knowledge of warehouse and transportation operations and the supporting technology landscape (WMS, TMS, OMS, planning, visibility platforms)
  • Experience leading a workstream or project team in a client environment
  • Proficiency with SQL, Python, or similar tools for data preparation and analysis, and with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau
  • Industry experience in consumer products, distribution, retail, life sciences, industrial products, or other asset-intensive supply chains
