Job.JobTitle: Supply Chain Strategic Network Transformation Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $141,200 to $278,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 7+ years

About this job

Lead supply chain network transformation projects at Deloitte, advising clients on strategy, design, and optimization. Use network modeling tools, advanced analytics, and operational expertise to deliver transformational solutions across facility footprint, sourcing, inventory, and transportation.

Good fit if you have 7+ years supply chain consulting experience, 5+ years hands-on network design and optimization work, and proficiency with network modeling tools like AIMMS or Optilogic.

Full job description

Position Summary

We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations! 
 
Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don’t miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

Recruiting for this role ends on 2/15/2027

The team

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

The Work You'll Do

This role draws on your deep understanding of supply chain network strategy, design, and optimization. The list below is a sample, and each project will give you the chance to grow your network transformation capabilities and your leadership of client teams.

  • Shape supply chain transformation strategies to sequence key components of the transformation from planning to execution
  • Lead network design and optimization engagements end-to-end, from problem framing and data collection through modeling, scenario analysis, recommendations, and implementation roadmap
  • Guide structuring of models to answer key network questions around facility footprint and capacity, sourcing, inventory positioning, transportation flows, and cost-to-serve using supply chain design and simulation tools, and translate the outputs into clear, executive, ready recommendations
  • Assess client manufacturing, warehouse, and transportation operations, and define the target-state operating model, processes, and enabling technologies
  • Lead discussions with senior client leaders, including supply chain, operations, logistics, finance, and IT executives to understand business objectives, challenges, and align on network transformation goals, strategy, and business case
  • Plan and lead execution of network transformation programs, including implementation roadmaps, change impacts, governance, and benefits tracking
  • Manage engagement delivery: scope, workplan, budget, risks, quality, and client relationships, while coaching and developing team members
  • Contribute to Deloitte’s go-to-market efforts, including supporting pursuits, thought leadership, offerings, and innovative solutions to bolster the future of the practice, and stay current on emerging network, decision intelligence, and AI-enabled optimization capabilities 

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in supply chain consulting or industry roles focused on network design, logistics, distribution, or supply chain strategy
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with supply chain network design and optimization, including data gathering and cleansing, baseline model build, scenario development, and results interpretation
  • Experience using one or more network modeling and optimization tools (for example, Coupa Supply Chain Optimization, AIMMS, Optilogic, Lyric, or similar) 
  • Bachelor’s Degree 
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.  
  • Must be authorized to work in the US without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Sales experience
  • Experience quantifying and communicating cost-to-serve, service, inventory, and transportation trade-offs through analytics and business cases, and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Prior consulting experience
  • Certification provided by software vendor
  • Working knowledge of warehouse and transportation operations and the supporting technology landscape (WMS, TMS, OMS, planning, visibility platforms)
  • Experience leading a project team in a project client environment
  • Proficiency with SQL, Python, or similar tools for data preparation and analysis, and with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau
  • Industry experience in consumer products, distribution, retail, life sciences, industrial products, or other asset-intensive supply chains

Job.JobTitle: Global Operate Business Development, Pricing Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

In this role, you will be a member of the Global Operate Pricing & Commercial Deal Strategy team, working with Global Operate pursuit teams around the world to structure winning commercial architectures for managed services engagements. As a Manager, Deal Pricing Coach, you will lead the financial and competitive research behind each deal coaching engagement, help design the recommended commercial architecture, and support pursuit teams as they build the client-facing materials that bring it to life. For lower-complexity or lower-TCV pursuits, you will independently lead the engagement end-to-end, including presenting the recommended architecture to the pursuit team. For more complex, higher-value pursuits, you will execute this work under the direction of a Senior Manager Deal Coach, to whom you will report. This work is primarily virtual, with occasional travel required for in-person pursuit team collaboration.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead deal coaching engagements end-to-end for lower-complexity or lower-TCV Global Operate pursuits, from pursuit team intake through final commercial architecture sign-off
  • Confirm each pursuit’s pricing status and required baseline commercial model (Time & Materials or Fixed Fee) before layering in any creative construct enhancements
  • Conduct the core research behind each engagement — five-year client financial trend analysis, peer benchmarking, and earnings call transcript review — and synthesize findings into a clear, evidence-backed set of client challenges
  • Help design recommended commercial architectures, combining baseline models with creative constructs tied to identified client challenges, under the direction of a Senior Manager for complex or high-value pursuits
  • Coach pursuit teams as they build client-facing commercial strategy presentations, and support pursuit team presentations to client teams for pursuits you lead end-to-end
  • Support the post-presentation feedback coaching loop by capturing client feedback and helping revise the commercial architecture into a refined proposal
  • Partner with the deal’s financial modeling team to help reflect the final, agreed-upon commercial structure in the engagement’s financial model
  • Escalate complex or high-stakes commercial structuring questions to the Senior Manager Deal Coach as needed
  • Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Deal Coaching methodology, tools, and creative construct catalog
  • Build relationships across Global Operate workstreams, alliances, and account teams to ground commercial recommendations in delivery reality
  • Collaborate with Global Solution Hub team(s) at various points of the end-to-end pursuit process to receive or provide various elements of support


The team

The Global Operate Team is comprised of professionals with various areas of focus that collectively provide mission critical services to support Global Operate’s overall success. Whether focused on sales excellence, delivery transformation, quality and risk management, contracts management, finance and operations, capability build, communications and change management, knowledge management, marketing and market intelligence, or other activities, these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people can effectively serve clients every day.



Qualifications
  • 5 years of experience in a professional/consulting services capacity, including some exposure to pricing, commercial deal structuring, or financial analysis
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or other advanced degree in finance, business, or a related field preferred
  • Experience supporting or designing commercial models (e.g., Time & Materials, Fixed Fee, gain share, outcome-based pricing, or other creative constructs) for managed services, outsourcing, or business process transformation engagements
  • Solid financial analysis skills, including the ability to interpret multi-year financial trends, support peer benchmarking, and extract insight from earnings call transcripts and investor materials
  • Advanced proficiency with MS PowerPoint and Excel-based financial modeling; familiarity with GenAI tools used to accelerate research and drafting is a plus
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate financial and commercial analysis into a clear, compelling narrative for technical and executive audiences
  • Ability to operate with moderate supervision, managing multiple work streams across competing priorities, time zones, and geographies



Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Job.JobTitle: MarTech Salesforce Tech Lead, SC- Functional Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You’ll Do

As a MarTech Salesforce Tech Lead on the MarTech Technology team, you will be responsible for:

  • Translate business objectives into customer journeys, business rules, data and consent requirements, integrations, reporting, and operational requirements.
  • Lead discovery and design activities; define solution designs, configuration approaches, development patterns, and acceptance criteria.
  • Own technology-domain estimates, technical work plans, dependencies, assumptions, risks, and technical decisions; partner with Solution Architects and Project Managers on scope, milestones, resource needs, and status.
  • Evaluate platform capabilities, constraints, alternatives, and implementation trade-offs; align solutions with enterprise architecture and reusable patterns.
  • Lead solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, testing strategy, user acceptance testing, defect triage, and go-live readiness; review configurations, code, integrations, and documentation against standards.
  • Support release management, production issue triage, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement; mentor Analysts, Consultants, and Developers and advise stakeholders on adoption, operating-model impacts, platform limitations, and value realization.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Advertising, Marketing, & Commerce offering designs and implements solutions that engage and activate customers through the customer journey.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future 
  • 5+ years of experience implementing and supporting Salesforce-based marketing technology platforms, including Salesforce Core and Marketing Cloud Next, for customer journeys, data, consent, integrations, and communication channels.
  • Experience using Salesforce Flow, Marketing Flows, Data 360, Agentforce, Salesforce objects and data models, security and sharing, platform events, and application programming interfaces (APIs).
  • Experience reviewing and troubleshooting Apex code; experience with Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE) coexistence, metadata management, development and operations (DevOps) practices, and Salesforce platform limits.
  • Experience leading technical workstreams, discovery workshops, estimates, testing, user acceptance testing, and production support.
  • Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred: 

  • Experience mentoring Analysts, Consultants, or Developers.
  • Experience presenting technical recommendations, platform constraints, and implementation trade-offs to business stakeholders.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Fort Lauderdale, FL

About this job

Cloud Architect role with Deloitte's Ascend Engineering Foundation, designing and operating enterprise cloud environments across Azure, GCP, and AWS. Responsibilities span architecture design, migration, disaster recovery implementation, and ongoing operations support for client solutions.

Good fit if you have 6+ years of consulting or technology experience, strong Kubernetes and cloud networking expertise, and proficiency with Terraform, Bash, Ansible, and CloudFormation.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Team 

Ascend Engineering Foundation (AEF) provides a common engineering foundation of reusable assets, common runtime services (CRS), platform capabilities and deployment frameworks that helps teams deliver client solutions consistently and efficiently. Supporting Zora’s Product Plus and Ascend’s Service+ strategies, AEF brings together cloud infrastructure, integration, AI and agentic capabilities, access controls and AppStore deployment patterns to simplify application modernization and client deployments. AEF’s common runtime services provide shared capabilities that applications can reuse, reducing duplication and enabling consistent deployment and operation across supported environments.

Position Summary

As a Cloud Architect, you will build and deploy cloud solutions to support enterprise clients. This requires all dimensions of cloud architecture.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026. 

Work you’ll do

As a Cloud Architect, you will architect, build, and operate enterprise cloud environments for our clients — from initial design through migration, onboarding, and day-to-day operations. Key responsibilities include:

Responsibilities

  • Architecting application designs using Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or any leading cloud-provider service.
  • Building, migrating, and testing Cloud Service Provider (CSP) environments.
  • Designing data security and end-to-end applications.
  • Leading application migration projects, including optimizing technical reliability and improving application performance.
  • Integrating with on-premises applications, cloud providers, or other platforms.
  • Implementing cost-optimized solutions based on usage, business requirements, and budget.

Onboarding

  • Develop client architecture, assuring it meets availability, disaster recovery (DR), and Well-Architected best practices.
  • Design, implement, and test Disaster Recovery.
  • Identify solution components via Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) review.
  • Lead technical onboarding and integration with the OpenCloud Platform, including the OC Portal.
  • Lead end-to-end implementation of design for new builds.
  • Own technical sign-off and verification of the go/no-go checklist.

Ongoing Operations

  • Lead incident and change request (CR) escalation for timely resolution, ensuring the RCA/problem management process is executed.
  • Lead all root cause analysis (RCA) and problem management efforts.
  • Lead client and project team interaction for technical decisions.
  • Conduct quarterly Well-Architected Reviews (WAR) and update architecture design documents in conjunction with cost optimization.
  • Work directly with Affinity Groups to ensure automation (pipeline) for deployment, release, and operational activities is repeatable and follows best practices.
  • Work with Shared Services team members, identifying repeatable efforts that can be automated.
  • Work with the Service Delivery Manager to implement areas of improvement.
  • Conduct monthly reviews of existing runbooks with the Pod/Architecture Team for alignment of automated processes.
  • Review and own verification of monitoring, performance, and budget alerting to align with SLA requirements as a baseline to support SOWs.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective communication skills.

Qualifications 

Required:

  • Bachelor-level degree in engineering, IT, data communications, telecommunications, computer science, or equivalent professional experience and/or qualifications.
  • 6+ years of relevant consulting, industry, or technology experience.
  • Ability to architect enterprise applications using Azure, GCP, or AWS.
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes architecture design and deployment.
  • Cloud networking architecture skills and configuration.
  • Working knowledge of cloud technologies such as computing, storage, network, managed SQL/NoSQL databases/data warehouses, and auto-scaling groups.
  • Understanding of cloud security for identity and access management (IAM) to security groups.
  • Deep knowledge of automation scripts and tools: Terraform, Bash, Ansible, Jenkins, and CloudFormation.
  • Understanding of how to deploy multitier applications across a custom-defined virtual private cloud.
  • Ability to set up multilevel network environments with any of the CSPs.
  • Ability to design scalable, secure, dependable, and efficient technical cloud ecosystems to support enterprise applications.
  • Experience with Application Programming Interface (API) and gateway functions: cloud function and API gateway (or equivalent).
  • Ability to travel X-X%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • AWS certification — Associate or Professional Solutions Architect.
  • Experience with Linux and/or Windows-based OS, including virtual machines: Red Hat, SUSE, or Windows Server.
  • Experience with cloud automation and container tools: Bash scripting and Ansible.
  • Working knowledge of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) and/or Agile methodologies.

Quick facts

  • Pay: $128,000 to $252,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Lead mobile engineering for personalized marketing and digital commerce at Deloitte's Miami office. Build iOS solutions and guide Android architecture while managing distributed teams across the US, India, and Mexico as a client-facing solution architect.

Good fit if you have 5+ years mobile engineering experience, 3+ years iOS development with Swift, and 2+ years leading technical teams.

Full job description

Position Summary

Build and lead mobile engineering efforts that support personalized marketing, customer engagement, and digital commerce experiences. This role is suited for a mobile engineer generalist with deep experience in iOS engineering and the ability to guide Android architecture discussions. The Lead Software Engineer II will serve as a client-facing solution architect, lead technical delivery, coordinate with engineering resources in the US, India, and Mexico, and translate business objectives into scalable mobile solutions. This role requires hands-on technical credibility and leadership across distributed teams and stakeholder groups.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 14, 2027

Work you'll do

As a Software Engineer on the Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team, you will be responsible for…

  • Leading the technical design, development, testing, and deployment of mobile applications, with primary focus on iOS solutions and cross-platform delivery considerations
  • Serving as a client-facing solution architect by defining technical approaches, presenting architecture recommendations, and aligning mobile solutions to business requirements
  • Providing technical leadership on mobile architecture, including iOS implementation patterns and Android architecture discussions with engineering teams

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Lake Mary, FL

About this job

AWS MarTech Developer role at Deloitte building serverless, event-driven solutions using AWS services and Salesforce Marketing Cloud. You will design messaging systems, integrations across platforms, and implement security and operational controls.

Good fit if you have a Bachelor's degree, AWS development experience with Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, and knowledge of serverless architecture and REST APIs.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You’ll Do

As a US Delivery Center Delivery Consultant on the team, you will:

  • Translate approved business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical designs into development tasks, application programming interface (API) specifications, configuration records, deployment materials, and operational runbooks
  • Design, build, test, deploy, and support serverless, event-driven, API-based, messaging, and data-processing solutions using AWS services
  • Develop email, SMS, transactional messaging, customer notification, message template, personalization payload, audience payload, event payload, and delivery workflow capabilities; implement customer preference, consent, subscription, suppression, and opt-out processing
  • Build integrations that ingest, route, transform, orchestrate, and process events and data across AWS, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Core, CRM systems, CDPs, websites, mobile applications, data platforms, and enterprise systems
  • Implement security, reliability, and operational controls, including encryption, access controls, retries, idempotency, throttling, dead-letter queues, logging, monitoring, alerting, audit trails, reconciliation, failure recovery, and deliverability monitoring
  • Collaborate with AWS Solution Architects, MarTech Technical Leads, Salesforce Developers, Integration Engineers, Analysts/Consultants, and business stakeholders to support user acceptance testing, release readiness, production issue resolution, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness
  A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Advertising, Marketing, & Commerce offering designs and implements solutions that engage and activate customers through the customer journey.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience developing applications or integrations on Amazon Web Services (AWS) using Python and JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Experience designing or building serverless, event-driven, API-based, messaging, or data-processing solutions using AWS Lambda, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS), Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS), Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES), and Amazon CloudWatch
  • Experience implementing Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs, JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), OAuth, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), webhooks, and event schemas for integrations with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Core, CRM systems, or CDPs
  • Experience with automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), infrastructure as code, logging, monitoring, and production support
  • Ability to travel 0–30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg) <<if approved by your Offering>> or Geo-Hub locations (Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, and Philadelphia)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance

Preferred: 

  • AWS certification
  • Experience integrating Salesforce Marketing Cloud with AWS-based customer engagement or notification platforms
  • Experience supporting production email, SMS, transactional messaging, or customer notification capabilities
  • Experience with one or more of the following AWS services: AWS Step Functions, AWS End User Messaging, API Gateway, Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3), Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Aurora, Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS), Amazon Kinesis, AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS), AWS Secrets Manager, AWS CloudTrail, or AWS Systems Manager
  • Experience using AWS CloudFormation, AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK), Terraform, Git, or CI/CD pipelines to automate infrastructure or deployments
  • Experience configuring message throughput, retry logic, idempotency, throttling, dead-letter queues, delivery-status events, bounce events, or reconciliation processes

Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced EUC & Digital Workspace Engineer, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Work you’ll do/Responsibilities  

As a Consultant at Deloitte, you will work within an engagement team and be responsible for supporting the overall project goals and objectives. In this role, you will interact with stakeholders and cross-functional teams. It is expected that you will be able to perform independent tasks as well as provide technical guidance to team members, as needed.

  • EUC Engineer (Digital Workspace & Onsite Desktop Support) for the End-User Computing (EUC) team.
  • Hands-on role to build, run, and support a 100% cloud-native digital workspace, combining engineering across virtual desktops (Omnissa Horizon Cloud on Azure), endpoint management (Intune, Workspace ONE UEM, PDQ Connect), application control and privilege management (BeyondTrust EPM, Airlock Digital), and monitoring (ControlUp, Wyse Management Suite), with onsite deskside/walk-up desktop support at office locations.
  • Serves as Tier 2/3 escalation point for the service desk and is the technical expert for the EUC stack, while remaining visible and approachable to end users on site.
  • Managed Services Project for Operations and Engineering across Infrastructure, Application, Data, Testing
  • Engage directly with business stakeholders and technology leadership to align delivery priorities and effort estimates

The Team 

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering delivers specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments. We modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge and develop new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advancements.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years in EUC, endpoint engineering, VDI, or desktop support/engineering
  • Hands-on production experience with Omnissa Horizon (Cloud/DaaS) and App Volumes (app stacks, writable volumes), plus DEM
  • Hands-on experience with at least three of: BeyondTrust EPM, Airlock Digital, Netskope, ControlUp, PDQ Connect
  • Ability to design solutions and write clear technical documentation
  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred

  • Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products

The Team

ConvergeCONSUMER™ is a product-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer-focused businesses improve decision-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world’s largest professional services firm.

We drive value for our clients by optimizing decisions and actions at a level of granularity only made possible with today’s data and technology. ConvergeCONSUMER’s suite of solutions helps consumer-facing businesses prosper in a world being re-shaped by convergence, where the lines between industries, competitors and collaborators, consumers and suppliers, and even human and artificial intelligence have blurred.

Position Summary 

Are you the person people call when a delivery-blocking issue needs to be found fast? As a Backend DevOps & UAT Engineer on ConvergeCONSUMER, you'll be the technical backstop for our product delivery teams — troubleshooting backend issues, owning UAT coordination, and making sure problems get tracked to resolution instead of falling through the cracks.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026. 

Work you’ll do

As the Backend DevOps & UAT Engineer, you will:

  • Troubleshoot backend issues surfacing during product delivery and client implementations, working across environments to isolate root cause
  • Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) coordination for product releases, catching and resolving issues before go-live
  • Escalate and track defects and delivery blockers across engineering, delivery, and product teams until resolved
  • Build and maintain test scripts and scenarios to validate backend functionality ahead of releases
  • Partner with delivery teams to validate environment configuration, data, and integration issues during implementations
  • Support CI/CD pipeline health and flag recurring failure patterns to engineering

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Methodical troubleshooter who can isolate root cause across multiple layers of a system under time pressure
  • Comfortable working across engineering, delivery, and product teams to track an issue through to resolution
  • Detail-oriented tester who thinks through edge cases and the downstream effects of changes
  • Clear written communicator, able to document issues and steps so others can follow them
  • Stays calm under pressure when a delivery-blocking issue needs fast triage and escalation
  • Continuous-improvement mindset toward reducing recurring issues over time

Qualifications 

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of backend development or DevOps experience supporting product delivery or implementation troubleshooting
  • Hands-on experience with UAT coordination, defect tracking, and escalation management across engineering and delivery teams
  • Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with CI/CD tooling and pipeline troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting client-facing product implementations or deployments

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $51,900 to $86,400 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 1+ year

About this job

Services Associate supporting Deloitte's GPS Contracts team by coordinating NDAs and Procurement Requisitions, managing project controls, and maintaining records and reporting across engagements. The role requires attention to detail, stakeholder coordination, and respect for legal and contracting processes.

Good fit if you have 1+ years in PMO support, project coordination, contracts, or procurement; strong organizational skills; and can handle confidential information.

Full job description

Position Summary

The PMO Analyst supports Deloitte’s GPS Contracts team by coordinating nondisclosure agreements (NDAs) and Procurement Requisitions while maintaining project controls across one or more engagements. The role focuses on the NDA and PR process, from intake through execution. The analyst works with engagement teams, external counterparties, contracts and procurement stakeholders, and Deloitte’s Office of General Counsel (OGC) to keep requests moving through the appropriate review and approval steps.

The analyst also helps teams maintain reliable plans, records, and reporting so leaders can see progress, address risks, and meet engagement commitments. This role calls for attention to detail, responsive stakeholder service, sound judgment, and respect for established legal and contracting processes.

Work You’ll Do

NDA Coordination

  • Receive and initiate NDA requests, confirming the business purpose, counterparty details, and supporting information before submission.
  • Coordinate the process from drafting and issuance through OGC review, proposed revisions, negotiation, approval, and execution. OGC retains responsibility for legal advice, substantive negotiation, and legal approval.
  • Track NDA versions, open questions, action owners, approvals, status, and execution dates; follow up with stakeholders to resolve outstanding items.
  • Communicate clear status updates and next steps to engagement teams, counterparties, OGC, and contracts or procurement stakeholders.
  • Escalate incomplete requests, delays, unusual terms, and potential compliance concerns to the appropriate decision-makers.
  • Maintain accurate, secure records of requests, correspondence, approvals, and executed agreements in accordance with applicable policies and retention requirements.

PR Coordination

  • Create and process Purchase Requisitions for goods and services.
  • Support subcontract awards for services.
  • Process funding and administrative modifications.
  • Coordinate with engagement teams and procurement stakeholders.
  • Ensure requisitions are complete, accurate, properly supported, and compliant with GPS requirements.
  • Track requisition status and help resolve processing issues.

PMO Delivery and Governance

  • Maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and deliverable trackers for assigned engagements.
  • Track risks, issues, actions, decisions, and required approvals, including owners, due dates, follow-up, and escalation.
  • Coordinate governance meetings, prepare agendas and materials, document decisions, and follow through on action items.
  • Collect and validate project updates; prepare concise status reports, dashboards, and leadership or client-facing materials.
  • Support document and version control, change requests, resource planning, and financial tracking as applicable to each engagement.

Stakeholder Coordination and Improvement

  • Work across engagement teams and support functions to turn requests into clear actions, owners, and deadlines.
  • Identify reporting gaps, recurring delays, and process bottlenecks; recommend practical improvements.
  • Develop and maintain useful templates, trackers, procedures, and knowledge materials that improve consistency across engagements.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

The Team

The GPS Contracts Sector Team comprises practitioners across the US and India, dedicated to supporting all prime contract management needs for our internal and external clients.

Operational Excellence provides essential business and operational support, enabling the GPS Consulting and Advisory practices to deliver exceptional client service. We play a critical role in driving meaningful operational change as the GPS business evolves. By collaborating with our leaders, we are reimagining the future of operations, fundamentally redesigning services, and incorporating new technologies to propel GPS into the future.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • 1+ years of experience in PMO support, project coordination, program operations, contracts or procurement support, or a related field.
  • 1+ years of experience maintaining trackers, status reports, approval workflows, project records, or similar operational materials.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing requests and deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide concise stakeholder updates.
  • 1+ years of experience handling confidential information and escalating matters that require specialist or leadership input.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience coordinating NDAs, contract documentation, procurement workflows, or legal review processes.
  • Experience supporting a PMO, consulting team, or government-related engagement.
  • Familiarity with federal contracting concepts such as task orders, statements of work, contract deliverables, or acquisition requirements.
  • A supply chain management certification or related training.

Position Summary

Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/01/2026

Work you'll do

As the largest Moveworks delivery partner, Deloitte is at the center of how Fortune 500 organizations are deploying and expanding agentic AI and generative AI-powered employee experiences at scale. As a Senior Manager, you will take on broader ownership across the Moveworks portfolio — leading engagement teams, shaping account strategy, and serving as a senior client advisor on how conversational AI, large language models (LLMs), and intelligent automation can transform HR and IT service delivery across new implementations, use case expansions, and platform optimization efforts.

As a Moveworks Senior Manager, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading multiple concurrent Moveworks engagements — including new implementations, use case expansions, and platform optimization efforts — across scope, budget, resourcing, timeline, and risk management, with accountability for overall account health and delivery quality.
  • Serving as the primary client relationship lead at the account and program level, building trusted advisor status with senior stakeholders across HR, IT, and Information Security, including Director and VP-level sponsors.
  • Managing and developing teams of Managers, Senior Consultants, and Consultants through day-to-day coaching, performance feedback, staffing decisions, and career development guidance.
  • Driving practice growth through business development, proposal leadership, scoping and pricing exercises, client presentations, methodology refinement, and knowledge sharing across the ServiceNow/Moveworks team.
  • Supporting go-to-market activities and thought leadership in ServiceNow/Moveworks/ServiceNow strategy, alliances, generative AI, and agentic AI-enabled employee experience transformation.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  •  Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills 
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment 
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines 
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our HR Strategy & Technology Offering is dedicated to developing leading global HR strategies and implementing cutting-edge HR technologies. We drive transformation and maximize the workforce experience, ensuring sustained HR effectiveness and value. In a world of disruption, our solutions empower organizations to navigate challenges seamlessly, enhancing their HR capabilities and fostering a resilient workforce.

Our Moveworks Team is dedicated to delivering AI-powered employee experience solutions that help clients transform their HR and IT service delivery practices. We drive significant cost savings, increased efficiency, a stronger competitive advantage, and improved employee experience through intelligent automation and agentic AI capabilities.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent years of experience)
  • 8+ years of enterprise platform implementation experience (for example, ServiceNow, Workday, or similar)
  • 4+ years of experience in client relationship management with experience engaging senior stakeholders (Director level and above)
  • 5+ years of program management experience overseeing multiple concurrent workstreams and collaborating cross-functionally with HR, IT, and Information Security
  • Ability to travel 0-30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Master's or MBA degree
  • 8+ years' experience managing staff and leading medium to large sized teams and leading projects, including 2+ end-to-end deliveries; managed schedule/budget/risks with weekly status reporting and stakeholder governance
  • 8+ years Big 4 consulting experience with demonstrated success developing business and exceeding sales targets
  • 5+ years of experience with solution architecture and system design for AI-driven employee experiences (for example, virtual assistants, automation, orchestration across HR and IT platforms)
  • 5+ years of experience with ServiceNow/Moveworks platform configuration, Agent Studio, or similar conversational AI or agentic AI platforms
  • 3+ years of experience working with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, or agentic AI solutions, including an understanding of prompt design, model behavior, and responsible AI considerations
  • Led 2+ ServiceNow/Moveworks or ServiceNow platform implementations end-to-end

Job.JobTitle: AWS MarTech Technical Lead (Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation)
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Lead AWS-based marketing technology solution design and implementation for Deloitte's Customer team. Design event-driven, serverless, and API-led solutions using AWS services, manage technical workstreams, and mentor delivery teams.

Good fit if you have 5+ years designing AWS solutions, 1+ year leading technical workstreams, and 1+ year implementing marketing technology platforms.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You’ll Do

As a Senior Consultant, AWS MarTech Lead on the Advertising, Marketing, & Commerce team, you will be responsible for…

  • Leading discovery, requirements definition, solution design, estimation, and technical planning for AWS-based marketing technology solutions.
  • Designing event-driven, serverless, and application programming interface (API)-led solutions using AWS services, including Lambda, EventBridge, Simple Notification Service (SNS), Simple Queue Service (SQS), Step Functions, API Gateway, Simple Email Service (SES), Identity and Access Management (IAM), CloudWatch, Amazon S3, and DynamoDB.
  • Defining integration, data, consent, security, observability, testing, deployment, and operational requirements; facilitating technical workshops, design reviews, demonstrations, user acceptance testing (UAT), defect triage, and go-live readiness.
  • Reviewing code, configurations, infrastructure as code, integrations, and technical documentation; collaborating with architects, project managers, business stakeholders, security teams, and delivery teams.
  • Supporting production issue resolution, root-cause analysis, release management, and continuous improvement; mentoring technical practitioners and contributing to knowledge transfer and capability development.
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Advertising, Marketing, & Commerce offering designs and implements solutions that engage and activate customers through the customer journey.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • 5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting AWS-based solutions, including cloud architecture, APIs, integrations, event-driven design, security, observability, and operational readiness.
  • 1+ years of experience leading technical workstreams, including requirements workshops, estimates, testing, releases, and production support.
  • 1+ years of experience implementing marketing technology solutions involving customer journeys, customer data, consent management, or digital communications.
  • Proven experience presenting technical solution designs, architecture trade-offs, and delivery recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future 
  • Ability to travel 0-30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred: 

  • AWS certification, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Developer, or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), automated testing, and AWS cloud cost or performance optimization.
  • Experience integrating AWS with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next, customer relationship management (CRM), customer data, consent-management, or customer-engagement platforms.
  • Experience implementing resilience patterns, including retries, idempotency, dead-letter queues, and failure handling.
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job ID 371306

Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Technical architect role at Deloitte designing marketing and advertising technology solutions across customer data platforms, journey orchestration, and AI-enabled tools. You will work across multiple vendor platforms and ecosystems, advising clients on architecture strategy and leading implementation delivery.

Good fit if you have 7+ years in MarTech/AdTech platforms, 5+ years with CDPs and identity resolution, and 3+ years leading technical pre-sales engagements.

Full job description

Position Summary

As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be the connective tissue across our clients’ marketing and advertising technology ecosystems, spanning customer data platforms, journey orchestration and decisioning, campaign and content platforms, and adjacent AdTech capabilities, all increasingly powered by AI and agentic technologies. You will move fluidly across platforms and vendors rather than anchoring to a single stack, advising clients on the art of the possible, designing composable, future-ready architectures, and leading implementation across MarTech, AdTech, and AI-enabled solutions.

This role suits a technologist who treats the pace of change in this space as the appealing part of the job: someone who stays current on emerging platforms and AI capabilities, pilots new tools ahead of the market, and brings that point of view to clients and internal teams alike.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 13, 2027

Work you'll do

As a MarTech Multi-Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:

  • Architecting end-to-end solutions across the marketing technology landscape (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform/AEP, Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics, Target; Salesforce Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce; and comparable platforms) to enable unified customer profiles, journey orchestration, and omnichannel personalization
  • Bridging MarTech and AdTech ecosystems by integrating CDPs with ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, identity resolution, and measurement/attribution platforms to enable addressable, privacy-safe advertising and cross-channel activation
  • Architecting and maintaining identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph solutions, including identity matching logic, resolution accuracy, and data collection strategies that feed a unified, enterprise-wide view of the customer
  • Embedding AI and agentic capabilities into client marketing and advertising ecosystems, including generative content and personalization, AI assistants/copilots, and next-best-action or agent orchestration, and continuously evaluating emerging tools as the landscape evolves
  • Advising clients on future-state architecture design, feasibility, level of effort, cost, and the art of the possible, across composable, API-first MarTech and AdTech stacks
  • Leading technical pre-sales and solutioning (hunter/farmer cycles), translating business and marketing goals into technical designs, estimates, and phased implementation roadmaps
  • Leading integration and solution delivery across multiple platforms, third-party systems, and client stakeholder groups during technical design and implementation
  • Building and leading high-performing, cross-functional, geographically distributed teams of architects, engineers, and analysts, and establishing reusable frameworks, accelerators, and playbooks
  • Evaluating and recommending composable architecture approaches that enable clients to assemble modular, best-of-breed MarTech/AdTech capabilities rather than defaulting to a single monolithic platform

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Genuine curiosity and a pioneer's mindset: energized, not unsettled, by a marketing and advertising technology landscape that is constantly introducing new platforms, tools, and AI capabilities
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience across marketing technology and/or advertising technology platforms, including implementation experience with at least two major MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud/Data Cloud, mParticle, Segment, Tealium, or comparable)
  • 5+ years of experience architecting Customer Data Platform (CDP) solutions, including data modeling, identity resolution, audience segmentation, and activation
  • 5+ years of experience with identity resolution (IDR) and identity graph technologies or platforms (e.g., Acxiom, LiveRamp, or similar), including identity matching logic and resolution accuracy
  • 3+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales or solution architecture engagements, including level-of-effort, cost estimation, and roadmap development
  • 3+ years of experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting MarTech/AdTech workloads
  • 1+ years of experience with AI/agentic capabilities embedded in MarTech or AdTech platforms (e.g., AI assistants/copilots, generative personalization, agent orchestration)
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience with composable architecture / MACH (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless) principles
  • Working knowledge of the AdTech ecosystem, including ad servers, DSPs/SSPs, programmatic buying, identity/addressability solutions, and measurement and attribution
  • Adobe Certified Expert/Professional and/or Salesforce certifications spanning CDP, Marketing Cloud, or Agentforce
  • Experience integrating MarTech platforms with AdTech data, identity, or clean-room solutions (e.g., LiveRamp, The Trade Desk, Google Marketing Platform)
  • Experience collaborating with identity partners to evolve identity graph coverage and improve enterprise-wide customer data mapping and digital tracking accuracy
  • A demonstrated track record as an early adopter, piloting new platforms, tools, or AI capabilities ahead of broad market adoption and driving their adoption within teams or client organizations
  • Experience training or leading offshore or nearshore delivery teams in a Global Delivery model
  • Programming or scripting experience in Python, SQL, or Java
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related technical field

About this job

Senior consultant role supporting SAP security design and implementation across ERP environments including SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and Fiori. Work involves assessing access controls, designing security solutions, and embedding security into enterprise transformation and migration programs.

Good fit if you have 4+ years SAP security experience, 3+ years with SAP ECC or S/4HANA, and 2+ years supporting SAP implementation or transformation programs.

Full job description

Position Summary

Cyber SAP Security and GRC Access & Process Control Senior Consultant / Senior Engineering Management Specialist

Join Deloitte’s Enterprise Security team and help clients strengthen SAP security across enterprise transformation, cloud modernization, and application change initiatives. The Senior Engineering Management Specialist will support SAP-focused security strategy, architecture, access design, control design, and implementation activities across ERP environments. This role works with client and Deloitte teams to address security requirements across SAP platforms, integrations, and transformation programs while helping organizations reduce risk and enable business operations.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Engineering Management Specialist on the Cyber Enterprise Security team, you will be responsible for…

  • Supporting the design and implementation of SAP security solutions across SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, and connected applications
  • Assessing SAP roles, profiles, and access models to identify segregation of duties, sensitive access, and control gaps
  • Translating business process and technical requirements into SAP security requirements, role design approaches, and remediation plans
  • Supporting SAP implementation, migration, and transformation efforts by embedding security requirements into project activities and deliverables
  • Collaborating with client stakeholders, functional teams, and technical teams on SAP security controls, governance, testing, and deployment readiness

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Enterprise Security Offering helps organizations embed security across digital transformation initiatives by securing the technical backbone of the business while enabling change. The team supports capabilities across security architecture, secure development and deployment, cyber cloud, application security, SAP security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 4+ years of experience in SAP security, SAP controls, or enterprise application security
  • 3+ years of experience with SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, or SAP Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • 3+ years of experience designing or supporting role-based access controls, segregation of duties analysis, or sensitive access controls in SAP environments
  • 2+ years of experience supporting SAP implementation, migration, upgrade, or transformation programs
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience with SAP Access Control, SAP Identity Access Governance, or SAP Cloud Identity Services
  • Experience supporting SAP security across SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, or SAP Business Technology Platform
  • Experience with SAP security control testing, audit support, or compliance programs
  • Experience defining SAP security standards, role design methods, or governance procedures
  • SAP certifications
  • Experience working in consulting or professional services environments

The team

Job.JobTitle: Converge for Life Sciences - Customer Success, Deal Desk, & Pricing and Packaging Lead, Sr. Consultant – Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte’s business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.

This role is aligned to the Converge for Life Sciences portfolio, Deloitte’s AI-enabled platform portfolio for the modern life sciences enterprise. Converge by Deloitte combines proprietary data assets, advanced analytics, and AI-driven decision intelligence to help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical product organizations accelerate the pace of discovery, development, and commercialization, while improving compliance and operational visibility across the enterprise.

Rather than being aligned to a single product, this role sits within the Converge for Life Sciences commercial operations function and supports deal structuring, contracting, and client success activities across the portfolio’s full suite of software and AI-enabled offerings.

Position Summary

As the Senior Consultant for Customer Success, Deal Desk, and Pricing and Packaging, you will serve as the commercial engine behind the Converge for Life Sciences go-to-market motion. You will own the full lifecycle of software license transactions, including all software license order renewals, partner with commercial strategy to design creative and innovative pricing and packaging models for software, technology, and IP offerings, and help ensure clients realize ongoing value from the platforms they adopt. Working across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Sales leadership, you will bring commercial structure and discipline to a growing, multi-product portfolio.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/01/2026.

Work you’ll do

Deal Desk, Contracting & License Renewals:

  • Own end-to-end management of all software license order renewals, ensuring accurate, on-time execution and continuity of client subscriptions across the portfolio.
  • Lead the full commercial contracting lifecycle: drafting offering summaries, securing internal approvals, engaging clients, drafting license agreements, routing risk and legal reviews, and executing signed agreements.
  • Build and maintain the commercial artifact(s) of record used to track deal status, payment milestones, and renewal timing across a staggered, multi-client portfolio.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for ad hoc contracting questions, coordinating with Legal/Risk on approvals so deals move cleanly from shaping through execution.

Pricing & Packaging Strategy:

  • Support the design of creative, innovative commercial models for new and existing software, technology, and IP offerings, including tiering structures, usage- and overage-based mechanics, margin targets, and contract exit terms.
  • Partner with Product Management to establish a consistent point in the product development lifecycle at which pricing and packaging work begins, so commercial readiness keeps pace with new product launches.
  • Build repeatable pricing frameworks and playbooks that scale as the software and AI-enabled product portfolio grows.
  • Evaluate and recommend licensing structures (e.g., subscription, consumption-based, transitional/migration licensing) that balance client adoption with long-term revenue durability.

Cross-Functional Commercial Alignment:

  • Act as the connective tissue across Finance, Legal/Risk, Product, and Leadership on commercial and contractual matters, ensuring the right stakeholders are engaged at the right time.
  • Partner with Finance on forecasting and cost modeling tied to commercial offerings, and support Legal/Risk in an advisory capacity on structural deal questions.
  • Identify and help resolve cross-functional commercial issues that don’t have a natural owner, bringing structure and follow-through to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations.

Customer Success & Adoption:

  • Partner with Account, Product, and Practice teams to support client adoption, stakeholder engagement, and client-facing messaging once a product is live, without duplicating relationship-management work already owned by those teams.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources, including practice expertise, product teams, and leadership, to resolve client-facing adoption issues and maintain a consistent client experience post-sale.
  • Monitor client health signals tied to commercial terms, such as renewal risk or usage against contracted tiers, and proactively flag concerns to the broader account team.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration:

  • Comfortable operating as both a leader and a connector across Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal/Risk, and Account teams.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage a staggered portfolio of concurrent deals, renewals, and client engagements at different stages simultaneously.
  • Clear, confident communicator, able to bring structure to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations without a predefined playbook.
  • Self-directed ownership mindset; comfortable being accountable for outcomes that span multiple functions with no single predefined owner.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree.
  • 4–6 years of combined experience in deal desk, commercial contracting, pricing and packaging, sales operations, or customer success roles, ideally within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
  • Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end commercial contract lifecycles, including drafting, approvals, execution, and renewal tracking.
  • Experience designing or supporting pricing and packaging models for software, technology, or IP-based offerings (e.g., tiered, usage-based, or subscription licensing structures).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using commercial or contract-tracking tools to manage a portfolio of active deals.
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally across Finance, Legal, Product, and Sales/Account teams to move commercial work forward.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience in life sciences technology environments (e.g., CRM, field engagement, patient services, R&D, supply chain, manufacturing, or market access).
  • Familiarity with software licensing and contracting norms in a SaaS or enterprise technology business, including subscription, consumption-based, and transitional licensing models.
  • Experience supporting or partnering with customer success functions on client adoption and stakeholder engagement for newly launched products.
  • Comfort engaging with Legal/Risk teams in an advisory capacity on structural deal questions (e.g., demo licensing, exit/refund terms).
  • Proficiency in commercial or product management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Salesforce, Aha!).

At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 - $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobDescription:
