  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Tallahassee, FL
  • Experience: 3+ years

About this job

Senior Consultant role supporting federal healthcare clients by researching regulations and policies to develop fraud detection strategies. You will translate policy requirements into detection criteria, identify vulnerabilities, and support referrals for investigation.

Good fit if you have 3+ years interpreting regulations and supporting fraud, waste, and abuse mitigation programs.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organization. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

Work You’ll Do

As a Senior Consultant, Financial Crime and Fraud, you will support the client by researching and interpreting relevant regulations, policies, and program rules that inform detection strategies and analytic products. You will reviews policy guidance, open-source resources, and public information to identify vulnerabilities, ensures analytic and rules-based detection logic reflects current policy requirements, and connects findings to broader program integrity concerns. You will also partners with Analytics / Rules Engineers and Data Scientists to translate policy and regulatory requirements into detection criteria, and supports the development of referrals and findings for further investigation by appropriate agencies or stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Research and interpret relevant regulations, policies, and program rules affecting detection strategies
  • Review open-source resources and public information to identify potential fraud, waste, and abuse vulnerabilities
  • Translate policy and regulatory requirements into detection criteria for Analytics / Rules Engineers
  • Support development of referrals and documented findings for further investigation
  • Connect specific findings to broader program integrity vulnerabilities and trends
  • Monitor policy and regulatory changes and assess their impact on existing detection logic
  • Document policy research, findings, and rationale per SOPs
  • Participate in stand-ups, sprint planning, and reviews within the SAFe Agile team

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others 

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Enterprise Operations & Risk offering enables clients to achieve profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing “heart of the business” operations. Leverages deep domain expertise to extend enterprise resilience, agility and remediation. Addresses client needs which span the organization and impact strategy, operations, performance and reputation.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years of experience utilizing research and analytical skills to interpret regulations or policy documents
  • 3+ years of experience supporting programs identifying and mitigating fraud, waste, or abuse. 
  • Ability to travel 5-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred: 

  • Strong research and analytical skills, with experience interpreting regulations or policy documents
  • Excellent written communication skills, including experience drafting findings or referral documentation
  • Ability to synthesize open-source and public information into actionable insights
  • Experience collaborating with technical teams to translate policy into detection criteria
  • Experience in healthcare policy, program integrity, or regulatory compliance domains
  • Familiarity with fraud, waste, and abuse detection methods

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $116,200 to $229,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 3+ years

About this job

Build optimization, simulation, and forecasting models for supply chain clients using Python, SQL, and cloud platforms. Work with Deloitte's supply chain transformation team to deliver analytical solutions from design through deployment.

Good fit if you have 3+ years delivering analytical solutions, experience building optimization models, proficiency in Python and SQL, and a cloud certification.

Full job description

Position Summary

We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don’t miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

Recruiting for this role ends on 02/28/2027

Work you'll do
· As a Supply Chain Optimization Data Scientist you will be responsible for
· Define decision objectives, constraints, business rules, and performance measures with client stakeholders.
· Design and validate optimization, simulation, forecasting, scheduling, inventory, and network-design models.
· Build and integrate analytical solutions using Python, SQL, data pipelines, and enterprise systems.
· Evaluate scenarios and trade-offs to quantify impacts on service, cost, capacity, working capital, lead time, and resilience.
· Support solution testing, deployment, user adoption, and communication of analytical findings.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
· The desire to build technology driven solutions
· Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
· Effective written and verbal communication skills
· Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
· Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
· Ability to lead projects or workstreams
· Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
· Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
· Ability to meet deadlines
· Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

Qualifications

Required:
· 3+ years of experience delivering analytical or technology solutions from concept through production deployment.
· Experience developing optimization, simulation, forecasting, scheduling, inventory, or network-design models.
· Experience using Python and SQL for data preparation, validation, and modeling.
· Experience translating supply chain planning or execution processes into functional or technical requirements.
· Experience integrating models or data through extract, transform, and load (ETL), extract, load, and transform (ELT), or application programming interfaces (APIs).
· At least 1 Cloud platform certification such as Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure or AWS.
· Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
· Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:
· Master’s degree in operations research, supply chain, computer science, or applied mathematics.
· 2+ years of experience with supply chain planning, decision intelligence, control towers, digital twins, or optimization platforms.
· Experience deploying analytical solutions in cloud or enterprise environments and integrating with planning, warehouse, transportation, manufacturing, or supplier-management systems.

Job.JobTitle: SAP AI Transformation - Consultant - SAP Finance
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $82,600 to $162,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 2+ years

About this job

Consultant role in Deloitte's SAP practice focused on SAP Finance and Agentic ERP transformations. You'll work with clients to design and implement SAP S/4HANA solutions across finance modules, using AI tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining human oversight throughout the transformation lifecycle.

Good fit if you have 2+ years of SAP consulting or ERP implementation experience, hands-on FICO configuration experience, and can travel up to 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Join Deloitte’s SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You’ll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

In this SAP AI Transformation role, you’ll contribute to Agentic ERP transformations that help clients advance toward the autonomous enterprise. Combining SAP expertise with AI-enabled delivery approaches, cross-functional collaboration, and industry insight, you’ll help address complex business challenges and create measurable client impact.

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/15/2027.

Work you’ll do

As a Consultant in Deloitte’s SAP practice, with a focus on SAP Finance, you will work side by side with functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact solutions that support Agentic ERP transformations. With Deloitte Ascend™, you’ll leverage AI accelerators and SAP capabilities to help clients modernize business processes and advance toward the autonomous enterprise.

This role requires a highly motivated professional who moves with speed and precision, builds practical solutions, and engages confidently with senior stakeholders and delivery teams to help generate measurable business impact.

  • Support SAP Finance and Controlling workstreams by tracking work-plan activities, identifying dependencies, risks, and issues, and preparing deliverables.
  • Participate in and facilitate portions of opportunity-identification, fit-to-standard, and Agentic ERP solution-design workshops.
  • Translate finance requirements into SAP S/4HANA solutions and support functional design and configuration for assigned FICO areas, including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, and Profitability Analysis.
  • Support coordination of finance integration requirements with procurement, sales, supply chain, tax, treasury, and reporting teams.
  • Contribute to data migration, testing, defect resolution, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization activities.
  • Apply an AI-native approach to SAP delivery by using AI tools to accelerate analysis, solution design, prototyping, testing, and documentation, while maintaining human oversight to review, validate, and curate outputs.
  • Communicate project progress, decisions, risks, and action items with client and Deloitte team members; support training, change adoption, post-go-live activities, proposal development, and reusable SAP practice assets. 

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations that modernize operations, improve business performance, and create lasting value. Our teams bring together industry knowledge, functional expertise, technology capabilities, and emerging AI solutions to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to help advance the autonomous enterprise through Agentic ERP, cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. Depending on client needs, our work spans strategy, design, implementation, integration, data, testing, deployment, change, and post-go-live support.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree; or an associate degree and 4+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), or consulting experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • 2+ years of experience in SAP consulting, enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation, or SAP/ERP technology transformation in a consulting or industry environment.
  • Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle SAP implementation from project initiation through go-live and hypercare.
  • Experience supporting at least one SAP S/4HANA implementation, transformation, or migration program.
  • 1+ year of hands-on functional configuration experience in SAP Financial Accounting and Controlling (FICO) in one or more of the following areas: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, or Profitability Analysis.
  • Experience working directly with client finance stakeholders to support requirements gathering, testing, or deployment activities on at least one SAP implementation, transformation, or support project.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Experience applying artificial intelligence (AI) tools—including generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning, conversational AI, or AI agents—to support enterprise transformation initiatives, including solution design, implementation, testing, or human-in-the-loop review and validation.
  • Experience supporting or facilitating SAP design workshops, demonstrations, or testing activities.
  • Experience supporting SAP cloud programs or SAP transformation programs deployed across multiple countries.
  • Experience applying SAP Activate, Agile, or Waterfall methodologies on SAP implementation programs.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, estimates, solution designs, or client presentations.
  • One or more SAP certifications

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $82,600 to $162,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Zora AI, Forward Deployed Engineer - Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

This role sits within Zora AI™ by Deloitte, Deloitte's product-focused asset business for back office capabilities, part of Deloitte Consulting's Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) practice. I&DT brings an engineering- and innovation-led mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology-enabled solutions.

Forward Deployed Engineers operate at the intersection of client delivery, applied engineering, and product strategy — partnering with account and product teams pre-sale to qualify and shape opportunities, and with client and delivery teams post-sale to prove and accelerate agentic value, feeding real-world learnings back into the platform roadmap.

Position Summary

As a Product Focused Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE) within Zora AI™ by Deloitte, you will work directly with clients, Deloitte Consulting's broader consulting practice, and Zora AI's product and engineering teams. Together, you'll advise, demonstrate and architect Zora AI's agentic use cases to meet client’s needs — starting from Deloitte's Zora AI Platform and its inventory of Product based SKUs — into production-scale capabilities in each client's environment, powering performance improvement across financial, sourcing & procurement, Human resource and IT services domains.

This is a techno-functional role: it requires both deep technical skill and deep functional domain knowledge, brought together to adapt agentic capabilities to the specific workflows, data, and nuances of each client. You'll operate at the intersection of client delivery, applied engineering, and product feedback: engaging with clients and core consulting teams both pre- and post-sale, and partnering with Zora AI’s product and engineering teams to translate field learnings into reusable capabilities. The role draws on functional breadth rather than a single specialty, spanning many functional domains.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/17/2026.

Work you’ll do

  • Presales & solution shaping. Partner with consulting teams and Zora AI's account and product teams during the sales cycle — running technical discovery, demonstrations, and use-case fit assessments that qualify client needs and shape a credible path to production value.
  • Agentic use case development. Work hand-in-hand with clients to build out agentic use cases on Digital Worker Workbench (DWW) — sometimes adapting and extending Deloitte's library of proven use cases, other times building greenfield to solve a client-specific problem for proofs of concepts.
  • Client enablement & value realization. Support client awareness, business case activities, and stay engaged post-launch to help identify expansion opportunities grounded in real usage.
  • Field-to-product feedback. Capture recurring client needs, patterns, and delivery learnings, and translate them into concrete agentic capability requests and reusable extensions for product and engineering teams.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Client-facing credibility to translate technical tradeoffs and constraints into clear business decisions, carrying both technical and executive conversations within the same engagement
  • Genuine techno-functional profile — deep technical capability paired with deep functional domain fluency, applying both together to adapt agentic solutions to real client workflows
  • Strong functional domain knowledge spanning back office domains — such as finance, sourcing & procurement, human resources and IT services — with the versatility to apply it across multiple areas rather than a single specialty
  • Strong hands-on configuration skills, including proficiency in agentic concepts and comfort working with APIs, data integration patterns, and cloud-based services (e.g., AWS) to solution production-grade capabilities in client environments
  • Hands-on experience designing, adapting, or hardening agentic workflows — multi-agent coordination, tool invocation, memory/state management — using modern agent frameworks, with the judgment to take a working use case to a production-grade client deployment
  • Intellectual curiosity and a strong pull toward what's next — actively following how agentic frameworks, tooling, and techniques are evolving, and quick to adopt new approaches in a field where today's stack may look very different in six months
  • Judgment to size each engagement — recognizing when an agentic use case can be reused with light configuration, when it needs substantial extension, and when a client problem calls for building greenfield

Job.JobTitle: Cyber - AI Cloud Security Engineer - Manager
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Cloud Engineer, IT / Technology, Cybersecurity Analyst
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 6+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Deloitte seeks a Manager to lead design and security of AI-enabled cloud platforms and products. The role combines hands-on software engineering, AI security architecture, cloud security, and team leadership across complex client programs.

Good fit if you have 6+ years in software engineering, AI engineering, or cloud security, with experience deploying APIs and cloud applications using Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, or Java.

Full job description

Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking an AI Cloud Security Engineer, Manager to lead the design, implementation, and security of artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled products, platforms, and cloud environments. This engineering-focused Manager role combines AI security architecture, AI Zero Trust, secure AI software development, cloud security engineering, and AI-enabled vulnerability discovery and remediation.

You will lead technical delivery for complex client programs, apply hands-on software engineering, cybersecurity, and cloud architecture expertise, and guide teams in building resilient AI platforms with security embedded throughout the technology lifecycle.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an AI Cloud Security Engineer, Manager on the Cyber and Cloud Security team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading the design of secure architectures for generative AI, agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model serving, and AI-enabled enterprise applications; defining security boundaries and AI Zero Trust controls across models, agents, tools, application programming interfaces (APIs), data, cloud workloads, development pipelines, and runtime environments
  • Establishing and implementing security practices across the AI software development lifecycle, including threat modeling, security gates, model and prompt versioning, evaluation datasets, approval workflows, release criteria, and testing for prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool use, model abuse, and policy violations
  • Leading the design and implementation of secure AI workloads across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and hybrid environments, including cloud landing zones, network isolation, private connectivity, logging, encryption, key management, data protection, containers, serverless workloads, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code controls
  • Directing AI-assisted vulnerability and threat management capabilities that identify, analyze, prioritize, test, and remediate issues across code, applications, APIs, cloud configurations, infrastructure, dependencies, containers, and AI workloads; establishing human approval and validation before high-impact remediation is deployed
  • Designing and building production AI security applications and platforms using full-stack engineering, including user experiences, APIs, backend services, microservices, event-driven workflows, RAG, model integrations, observability, and automated testing
  • Leading client discovery, architecture sessions, technical workshops, design reviews, program delivery, production deployment, and operational handoff; managing technical workstreams, mentoring engineers, and creating reusable reference architectures, standards, playbooks, and accelerators

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Cyber and Cloud Security teams help organizations adopt emerging technologies securely and at scale. Our professionals work across security architecture, cloud engineering, application security, AI, risk, and technology transformation to help clients design resilient platforms and embed security into how technology is built and operated.

This future-focused engineering capability operates at the intersection of AI, cybersecurity, cloud, and software delivery. The team builds reusable platforms, accelerators, reference architectures, and implementation patterns that help clients secure AI innovation from design through production.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering; equivalent professional work experience in software engineering, AI engineering, cybersecurity, cloud security, application security, or technology consulting may be considered in lieu of a degree
  • 6+ years of professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, cybersecurity, cloud security, application security, or technology consulting, including leadership of AI, software engineering, cloud security, cybersecurity, or technology transformation programs
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of the following AI platforms: Anthropic Claude, Claude Code, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Amazon Bedrock, or Vertex AI
  • Experience designing or implementing cloud security architecture, secure application development, development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), infrastructure security, or AI security controls
  • Experience developing and deploying APIs, database-backed services, distributed systems, or cloud applications using Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, or Java, including automated testing, deployment, and observability
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience securing Anthropic Claude, Claude Code, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Amazon Bedrock, or Vertex AI in production environments
  • Experience designing AI Zero Trust architectures or implementing security controls for models, agents, tools, data, and AI runtime environments
  • Experience conducting AI red teaming, adversarial testing, model evaluation, prompt security testing, RAG security testing, or responsible AI control testing
  • Experience developing applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, GraphQL, Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs, microservices, or event-driven systems
  • Experience implementing policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code security, or automated remediation using Terraform, Open Policy Agent, Checkov, tfsec, Kyverno, static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis, secrets scanning, or container security tools
  • Experience securing Kubernetes, containers, serverless platforms, cloud-native applications, or software supply chains; or delivering AI, cybersecurity, cloud, or application security solutions for financial services or healthcare organizations

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 to $265,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

  • Collaborating with client engineering, security, product, data, risk, architecture, and executive stakeholders to lead discovery, technical workshops, architecture sessions, design reviews, solution delivery, production deployment, and operational handoff; producing reference architectures, patterns, standards, playbooks, and accelerators

Full job description

Position Summary

Oracle Identity Senior Consultant / Senior Engineering Management Specialist

 As a Senior Engineering Management Specialist, you’ll work with client and Deloitte teams to design, implement, and enhance Oracle Identity solutions that strengthen access controls, improve user lifecycle management, and support business and regulatory requirements. You’ll drive Oracle Identity engagements that help clients modernize identity governance, access management, and security architecture across enterprise environments. This role offers the opportunity to contribute across strategy, design, deployment, and optimization efforts in complex environments.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Engineering Management Specialist on the Deloitte Cyber team, you will be responsible for…

  • Leading the design, configuration, and implementation of Oracle Identity solutions across identity governance, provisioning, access management, and authentication use cases
  • Supporting client programs to improve joiner-mover-leaver processes, access certification, role management, and privileged access controls
  • Collaborating with business, security, and technology stakeholders to define requirements, document solution designs, and align Oracle Identity capabilities to enterprise objectives
  • Integrating Oracle Identity platforms with enterprise applications, directories, and security tools using standard protocols and established implementation patterns
  • Contributing to testing, deployment, defect resolution, and production stabilization activities for Oracle Identity implementations

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Cyber helps organizations build trust in digital environments by strengthening identity, access, and security capabilities across critical platforms. The team works with clients to protect users, secure access to data and systems, and improve confidence in digital interactions through scalable cybersecurity solutions.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or Mathematics
  • 4+ years of experience in identity and access management
  • 3+ years of experience implementing Oracle Identity Governance, Oracle Access Management, Oracle Identity Manager, or comparable Oracle Identity technologies
  • Experience with provisioning, access certification, role-based access control, and user lifecycle management processes
  • Experience integrating identity platforms with enterprise applications and directories using Security Assertion Markup Language, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Lightweight Directory Access Protocol, or Active Directory
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience leading Oracle Identity workstreams in large-scale technology or cybersecurity transformation programs
  • Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure identity and access management capabilities

  • Experience with access controls supporting audit, compliance, or regulatory requirements
  • Oracle certifications in identity, security, or cloud technologies
  • Experience working in consulting or client-service delivery environments

Position Summary

Sales Ops Manager  

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

An evolving customer and regulatory landscape, mounting pipeline of next-gen assets and portfolio pressures, and intensifying competition are presenting new organizational and operational hurdles for Life Sciences companies. These complex market dynamics are requiring new levels of rigor and insight in business strategy development and problem-solving, both domestically and globally.

We are looking for practitioners who will work alongside Life Sciences organizations from bio-technology firms to global big pharma to medical devices, to drive business value through end-to-end delivery of solutions based on strategy development for heart of business issues.

As a Sales Ops Manager, you will drive the day-to-day operations and improve processes, and drive operational alignment on Life Sciences Cloud projects.  You will be instrumental in translating business objectives into actionable strategies, leading diverse projects, and ensuring operational excellence.

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and problem-
  • Knowledge of HCP/HCO master data, customer consent, field force effectiveness, promotional compliance, and commercial data governance.

  • Consulting, systems integration, and product management experience.
  • Practical knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, or AI orchestration.

Job.JobTitle: Firm Enterprise Solutions Associate Director, Government Client Contracts Management (OSD/OSW)
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking a top-performing professional services Firm Enterprise Solutions Associate Director, Government Client Contracts Management and Contracts Group Lead to support our Government and Public Services Practice (GPS). In this role, you will collaborate cross-functionally within the Operational Excellence team and across Deloitte's Enterprise Solutions.

This role is designed for a visionary leader who can manage day-to-day operations while inspiring and developing a team within Deloitte’s Government Contracts & Procurement Organization (GCPO). You will be aligned with a specific Account, leading a dedicated contracts team and serving as a trusted source of strategic contracting advice to give Deloitte a competitive advantage in winning Federal engagements.

You will mentor and develop a team of contracts professionals, ensuring they align with Deloitte’s strategic objectives and values. By fostering a collaborative, efficient, and highly effective environment, you will enhance team performance, drive professional growth, balance workloads, and facilitate cross-functional initiatives.

While all locations will be considered, this role offers a flexible hybrid scheduled with candidates based in Washington, D.C. or Arlington, VA (or nearby) preferred.

Work You’ll Do

As a Group Lead, you will direct a team of contracts professionals in all facets of Federal contract administration. You will manage complex, high-value, and strategic contractual matters that directly impact firm revenue generation and retention.

In this role, you will:

  • Practice independent judgment and sophisticated analysis to identify and resolve complex contractual issues
  • Provide strategic, advisory-level contracts support to account leadership, shaping and strengthening win strategies for Federal engagements
  • Execute strategic positioning and outreach activities aimed at Federal clients, interacting with client contracting personnel at all levels
  • Lead strategic contract negotiations and ensure the successful completion of diverse contract projects
  • Train and mentor account teams and assigned staff to ensure operational efficiency and strict compliance
  • Establish and implement team-level goals that align operations with broader GPS and account-level objectives
  • Communicate persuasively with team members, peers, internal leadership, and external clients
  • Design and execute a service-centric delivery model for Federal contracting, overseeing the end-to-end contracting lifecycle from pre-award strategy to post-award closeout to ensure rapid response times and mission alignment
  • Provide leadership and guidance to a high-performing group of direct reports, taking ownership of the team's overall performance in contract management
  • Serve as the primary contracts subject matter expert (SME) to your assigned account leadership
  • Participate as a core member of the account leadership team, assisting in the development and shaping of account-level contractual strategies
  • Guide and coordinate proposal and award activities for complex contracts, offering advisory-level guidance to internal teams across all phases of the contract lifecycle
  • Conduct thorough reviews of complex contract actions and develop tactical action plans to address risks and capitalize on opportunities
  • Ensure full compliance and accuracy of all contracts administration within your assigned area of responsibility
  • Monitor assigned contract portfolios (including pipeline and contract performance) to proactively identify risk areas and maximize revenue retention
  • Stay apprised of the latest trends in Federal contracting and advise leadership accordingly
  • Manage individual and team workloads to guarantee timely, compliant project delivery, guiding teams through issue resolution
  • Ensure accurate and timely data entry into contract management systems, monitoring updates and resolving discrepancies to maintain data quality
  • Negotiate complex, non-standard contracts and agreements
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with proposal and business teams to address complex contracting and proposal challenges

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 10+ years of relevant professional work experience
  • 5+ years of experience negotiating at the executive-to-executive level, driving collaboration, consensus, and strategic alignment across internal partners, practice leaders, and external Federal Sector clients
  • 5+ years of experience supporting multiple Federal acquisition approaches and diverse contract types
  • Command knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Lifecycle
  • 5+ years of experience in federal solicitation types, contract types, federal contracts vehicles, Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulations (DFARS)
  • 3+ years of direct supervisory/people management experience
  • Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that would require professionals to co-locate in person 2-3 days per week, whether at the a Deloitte office or client site, dependent on the team's needs
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred Experience

  • Advanced Degree (e.g., JD, MBA)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, influence, and mentor teams
  • Demonstrated capability to foster professional growth, manage high-performing teams, and drive cross-functional collaboration
  • Strong consultative and communication skills with the proven ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization
  • Department of Defense (DoD)/Department of War (DoW) or military branch acquisition experience
  • Experience supporting Federal clients aligned with the team of assignment (e.g., Office of the Secretary of Defense)
  • Direct supervisory experience leading a team of 3 or more professionals
  • Experience with non-traditional Federal acquisition authorities, including Commercial Solutions Openings (CSOs) and Other Transaction Authorities (OTAs)
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage emerging technology (including AI/ML) to drive business process improvement, operational effectiveness, and efficiency
  • NCMA Certifications: Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), or Certified Commercial Contracts Manager (CCCM)

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $113,100 to $232,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Position Summary

Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Manager  

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. An evolving customer and regulatory landscape, mounting pipeline of next-gen assets and portfolio pressures, and intensifying competition are presenting new organizational and operational hurdles for Life Sciences companies. These complex market dynamics are requiring new levels of rigor and insight in business strategy development and problem-solving, both domestically and globally.

We are looking for practitioners who will work alongside Life Sciences organizations from bio-technology firms to global big pharma to medical devices, to drive business value through end-to-end delivery of solutions based on strategy development for heart of business issues.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 16, 2026.  

Position Summary

Work you'll do

As a Manager, Functional Transformation on the Sales & Service team, you will be responsible for…

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart-of-the-business solutions.

Work You’ll Do

As a Project Delivery Consultant, Strategy, Growth and Transformation on the Supply Chain & Network Operations team on the project, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain automated workflows in Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Power Automate to support supply chain risk assessment intake, routing, notifications, and approval processes
  • Support the modernization of legacy analytical tools by maintaining and enhancing Microsoft Access (MS Access)-based databases, processes, and reporting workflows
  • Develop and sustain Microsoft Power BI dashboards that provide users and program stakeholders with exposure, contract, and operational analytics
  • Integrate, import, and validate data from multiple sources, including procurement, commercial, government, and intelligence-related data sets, into centralized repositories and reporting solutions

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others
 

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Supply Chain & Network Operations offering advises, implements, and operates transformational solutions that bring world class supply network capabilities.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

 Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, information systems, business, data analytics, engineering, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience developing and maintaining Microsoft Access (MS Access) databases, queries, forms, or reports
  • 3+ years of experience building automated workflows using Microsoft Power Automate and Microsoft SharePoint
  • 3+years of experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions in Microsoft Power BI
  • 3+ years of experience integrating, importing, or validating data from procurement, contract, logistics, or operational data sources, including Federal Procurement Data System (FPDS) or USAspending.gov
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred: 

  • 3+ years of experience supporting supply chain risk management, logistics operations, or defense supply chain analytics
  • 2+ years of experience using Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) tools in human-in-the-loop workflows
  • 3+ years of experience automating risk assessment outputs using structured data
  • 2+ years of experience supporting federal, defense, or government clients
  • 3+ years of experience working with cloud-based workflow modernization or enterprise data integration initiatives

Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

This role owns security architecture and design across the Enterprise Solutions portfolio. It defines how the portfolio's platforms — predominantly SAP (S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP HANA, Ariba, Fieldglass, Concur, and SuccessFactors), together with the Azure services and the AI and agentic platforms that increasingly surround and extend them — are designed, integrated, and operated securely. Working as a hands-on technical authority within the Enterprise Solutions Architecture team, the role establishes security patterns, identity and access designs, and control standards that every solution in the portfolio is expected to follow, and partners closely with the global cyber team to see those designs safely into production.

As the portfolio is modernized and “agentified” — embedding AI copilots and autonomous agents such as SAP Joule into core business platforms — the security expertise this role brings is central to success. Securing agentic AI (how agents authenticate, what data and actions they are authorized for, and how their behavior is governed) is the fastest-growing and highest-stakes area of the portfolio's risk surface. This role is expected to lead that agenda, not merely keep pace with it, and a genuine passion for agentic AI and its secure adoption is essential to the position.

The position is an individual-contributor architect role: it leads through technical expertise, influence, and the strength of its designs rather than through direct people management. Although the role has no direct reports, it provides dotted-line technical leadership — defining security architecture, standards, and security-related priorities for the DTECH Enterprise Solutions security team and the Basis team to implement. It does not guide these teams' day-to-day work. It is a trusted advisor to project teams, platform owners, and leadership on how to protect enterprise data and identities across a complex, multi-cloud, SAP-centric estate.

Key responsibilities

Security architecture & design

  • Own the end-to-end security architecture for the Enterprise Solutions portfolio — defining reference architectures, security design patterns, and control standards that apply across SAP and non-SAP platforms.
  • Produce fit-for-purpose security artifacts (security architecture overviews, high- and low-level designs, and architecture decision records) and review solution designs for security risk before build and deployment.
  • Embed security-by-design and zero-trust principles into solution and integration architectures, including data protection, encryption, network segmentation, and secure API/integration patterns (e.g., across SAP BTP Integration Suite and Azure).
  • Conduct security and risk assessments, threat modeling, and design reviews; define mitigations and track them to closure with delivery teams.

AI & agentic platform security (priority focus)

  • Lead security architecture for the AI and agentic platforms that are increasingly embedded across the portfolio — including SAP Joule and other agentic/GenAI capabilities — as SAP and adjacent platforms are modernized and agentified. This is a defining, high-priority dimension of the role.
  • Define how AI agents authenticate and are authorized: agent identity, scoped and least-privilege access, delegation and impersonation boundaries, data-access limits, and human-in-the-loop controls for autonomous actions.
  • Establish safeguards for prompts, tools, and outputs (e.g., prompt-injection and data-exfiltration defenses) and secure patterns for agent-to-system and agent-to-agent (A2A) interactions across the SAP and cloud estate.
  • Set the emerging security standards, guardrails, and reference patterns for agentic development — including tooli

    The team

    Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.



    Qualifications

    Required

    • 10+ years of experience in enterprise IT, with a substantial track record in solution or security architecture on large, complex programs.
    • Deep, hands-on security architecture experience across a SAP-centric landscape — demonstrable work securing S/4HANA and other SAP applications, and designing secure integrations between them.
    • Strong command of identity and access management, including practical experience with OAuth 2.0 / OIDC and SAML 2.0, single sign-on, federation, and identity lifecycle/provisioning.
    • Strong knowledge of identity management on SAP BTP (SAP Cloud Identity Services — IAS/IPS, trust, role collections, and federation), sufficient to define the architecture, standards, and guidelines for implementation teams.
    • Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure security services and cloud security patterns (identity, network, key/secrets management), including integration between Azure and SAP.
    • Proven ability to produce security architecture artifacts (HLD/LLD/ADRs), lead threat modeling and security/risk assessments, and drive designs into production.
    • Experience partnering with an enterprise or global cyber function — aligning designs to cyber and regulatory standards, and preparing for and successfully navigating cyber/security architecture reviews.
    • Demonstrated knowledge of AI and agentic AI concepts and associated security risks, with experience, training, certification, or project work involving LLMs, AI agents, SAP Joule, Claude, MCP-based integrations, or comparable technologies.
    • Experience influencing and advising senior stakeholders and delivery teams as a recognized technical authority, and leading technical teams through influence and dotted-line relationships rather than direct authority.

    Preferred

    • Familiarity with SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) and SAP HANA security, and with cloud procurement/HR SaaS platforms in the portfolio (Ariba, Fieldglass, Concur, SuccessFactors).
    • Hands-on experience securing production AI/agentic deployments — agent identity and authorization, prompt/output safeguards, and agent-to-agent (A2A) or MCP-based integration security.
    • Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF) and/or Azure security certifications (e.g., AZ-500) and SAP credentials.
    • Familiarity with zero-trust, OWASP, RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC authorization models, and regulatory/compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, data-privacy regulations).



    Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

About this job

Senior Manager role leading AI risk, validation, and implementation engagements for Deloitte's Regulatory & Financial Risk team. Advise client stakeholders on design, governance, and validation of AI and generative AI solutions while directing multidisciplinary teams.

Good fit if you have 10+ years developing or validating AI solutions, experience leading complex client engagements, and expertise with generative AI frameworks and cloud platforms.

Full job description

Position Summary

Senior Manager, AI Risk & Validation

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organizations. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 15, 2026

Work you’ll do

As a Senior Manager in Risk and Forensic on the Regulatory & Financial Risk team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading complex AI risk, validation, and implementation engagements aligned to client business, risk, regulatory, and operational objectives
  • Advising senior client stakeholders on the design, build, implementation, governance, and validation of artificial intelligence (AI), generative AI, and agentic AI solutions
  • Directing multidisciplinary teams that develop proofs of concept, experiments, and production-ready applications using machine learning, natural language processing, image analysis, time series analysis, graph-based methods, and retrieval-augmented generation techniques
  • Establishing and overseeing end-to-end validation approaches for AI-enabled solutions, including data review, design assessment, testing strategy, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, documentation, traceability, monitoring, and production-readiness evaluation
  • Evaluating trustworthiness and control considerations such as hallucination risk, grounding, bias, explainability, robustness, privacy, security, guardrails, escalation paths, and audit logging
  • Translating technical findings, validation outcomes, and control observations into executive-ready recommendations for client stakeholders and engagement leadership
  • Serving as a senior client contact and escalation point, managing stakeholder expectations, identifying delivery risks and dependencies, and driving timely resolution of issues
  • Leading managers, senior consultants, and consultants to strengthen technical quality, delivery discipline, documentation, and responsible AI practices
  • Collaborating with Deloitte specialists across risk, regulatory, technology, data science, and model validation disciplines to shape solution design, validation approaches, and delivery outcomes
  • Supporting engagement management and practice development activities, including work planning, quality review, proposal development, market offerings, thought leadership, and reusable methods or accelerators
  • Contributing to the growth of Deloitte’s AI risk and validation capabilities by identifying emerging trends, developing repeatable approaches, and helping teams apply responsible AI practices consistently

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Regulatory & Financial Risk offering supports clients' regulatory and compliance needs, balancing risk and regulatory requirements with enhancing business value and optimizing outcomes. We deliver enhanced value through strategic transformation, end-to-end implementation, and a focus on business-as-usual sustainability across processes, controls, and data & analytic infrastructures.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, or a similar quantitative field
  • 10+ years of experience developing, validating, or deploying AI, generative AI, or agentic AI solutions using Python and JavaScript
  • Experience leading complex AI solution delivery, validation, or implementation engagements in a client service or project-based environment
  • Experience advising senior stakeholders on AI risk, responsible AI, model or solution validation, governance, controls, and production-readiness considerations
  • Experience with generative AI tools and components such as Hugging Face, OpenAI application programming interfaces (APIs), Llama, Gemini, Claude, Granite, retrieval-augmented generation, or Stable Diffusion
  • Experience with agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or CrewAI, and at least one deep learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras
  • Experience overseeing deployment of AI solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including containerized environments using Docker or Kubernetes
  • Experience managing engagement delivery, workplans, deliverables, quality reviews, stakeholder communications, and project risks or dependencies
  • Experience translating model, AI, or system validation findings into clear documentation, reporting, and recommendations
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, or a similar quantitative field
  • Experience leading generative AI or agentic AI solutions in production environments
  • Experience training, fine-tuning, or evaluating deep learning models
  • Experience with model risk management, model validation, monitoring, documentation, or reporting for AI-enabled solutions
  • Experience serving Financial Services clients
  • Experience leading or contributing to responsible AI governance, controls, testing, or monitoring frameworks
  • Experience leading proposal development, thought leadership, reusable assets, or broader practice development efforts
  • Experience developing AI methods or adapting emerging techniques beyond baseline framework implementation
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across risk, regulatory, technology, data science, engineering, and model validation disciplines

Tax Manager role leading engagement teams on income tax provision services for non-attest clients at Deloitte's National Tax Accounting Group. Requires 5+ years ASC 740 experience, active CPA or equivalent credential, and management of tax accounting projects with a hybrid work model.

Good fit if you have 5+ years ASC 740 experience, an active CPA or equivalent credential, and proven management experience in professional services tax.

Full job description

Position Summary

Do you have a passion for income tax provisions and tax accounting? Do you enjoy assisting companies with their financial reporting of income taxes in a consultative environment? Are you interested in leveraging and expanding your ASC 740 experience and have an innovative mindset to assist tax departments with tax accounting complexities through technology-driven solutions? If you answered "yes" - then we have the career opportunity to keep you challenged and satisfied!

Recruiting for this role ends May 31, 2027.

Work you’ll do

As a NTAG Tax Manager, you will:

  • Lead engagement teams and work with Senior Managers, Partners, and Managing Directors to provide day-to-day management of tax accounting services to non-attest clients.
  • Manage tax accounting projects utilizing a standardized approach to review income tax provision calculations and manage the delivery of provision services.
  • Work closely with Senior Managers, Partners, and Managing Directors to expand the ASC 740 skills of our team, drive innovation, enhance cross-service line teaming, grow tax revenue, and build our Deloitte brand.
  • Mentor and develop engagement Staff and Seniors providing leadership, counseling,  and career guidance specifically assisting with their technical and other professional development.
  • Actively participate in marketplace activities, recruiting, and process and technology innovation.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others


The team

At Deloitte Tax LLP, our Business Tax Services (BTS) team is a dynamic team with professionals of varying backgrounds and provides expertise to clients to gain a competitive advantage by integrating tax strategy into their business operations while working within the confines of their individual risk profiles. Business Tax subject matter experts and industry specialists provide services and solutions relevant to our client’s business. Learn more about Deloitte Business Tax Services.

NTAG is a national practice that operates within Deloitte’s Business Tax Services offering. NTAG professionals offer a combination of tax accounting technical capabilities and an innovative mindset to help our clients mitigate risk and identify opportunities. NTAG assists companies with all aspects of their financial reporting of income taxes including tax provision assistance and tax accounting guidance and consulting related to planning initiatives and strategic transactions (e.g., acquisition accounting, discontinued operations and carve-out financial statements). In addition, we bring a fresh perspective with a strategic, innovated mindset, which allows us to increase the efficiency of the tax accounting process.

Qualifications
Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, business, finance or other business-related field
  • 5+ years of experience with income taxes in accordance to ASC 740 and/or IFRS

·       One of the following active accreditations obtained:

o    Licensed CPA in state of practice/primary office if eligible to sit for the CPA

o    If not CPA eligible:

§  Licensed Attorney

§  Enrolled Agent

§  Certifications:

·       Chartered Financial Advisor (CFA)

·       Certified Financial Planner (CFP)

  • Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that requires US Tax professionals to co-locate, in person, 2-3 days per week.
  • Background in tax compliance and accounting for income tax and a broad understanding of US income taxation
  • Experience with ONESOURCE Tax Provision (OTP) or other similar provision software
  • Professional services or comparable tax organization experience
  • Proven management experience indicating strong organizational skills and the ability to plan and manage budgets and workplans
  • Ability to travel up to 25% on average, based on the type of work you perform and the clients served

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree such as MST or MAcc
  • Experience in coaching and mentoring junior colleagues
  • Experience effectively prioritizing workload to meet deadlines and work objectives

·       Proven experience effectively prioritizing workload to meet deadlines and work objectives

·       Previous Big 4 or large CPA firm experience

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Project - Software Engineer III on the AI & Engineering team, you will be responsible for:

  • Support the implementation of Azure API Management in a hybrid multi-cloud environment
  • Lead client discussions on the design of technical environments and integration architecture
  • Stand up data integrations across cloud and enterprise platforms
  • Define and implement enterprise integration patterns using Microsoft Azure integration services
  • Mentor and support junior team members

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Engineering as a Service offering provides end-to-end design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We help transform engineering teams, modernize technology, & deliver complex programs with a product engineering mindset. Our flexible delivery models— traditional teams, pools, or pods, are tailored for each client’s needs, offering engineering-led Advise, Implement, & Operate capabilities to accelerate innovation.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and 8+ years of Information Technology experience, including 5+ years in enterprise integration architecture and 5+ years of experience with Azure Cloud
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft integration services, including Azure API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Logic Apps, and Functions
  • Experience designing and implementing hybrid and multi-cloud integration architectures
  • Ability to obtain Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) and Microsoft DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) certifications
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required clearance for this role
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Azure networking and security services supporting application programming interface (API) and integration architectures
  • Experience building continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines for cloud integration solutions
  • Experience supporting government or public sector technology environments

Job ID 369988

Job.JobTitle: Security Specialist, Risk and Compliance Services
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking an experienced Specialist, Risk and Compliance Services to administer the daily operations of the National Industrial Security Program (NISP) and implement procedures and controls to safeguard classified as well as special program information, as required. Be a part of a diverse team of security professionals in performing standard and specialized/multidisciplinary security duties supporting NISP-related classified, Controlled Unclassified Information/agency sensitive (CUI-Public Trust) contracts for a subset of Deloitte Government and Public Services (GPS) accounts.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/07/26.


Work You'll do:

  • Initiate, prepare, and submit required contractor personnel security applications for access to Public Trust, client sensitive data to include SF86, SF85P, SF85, Visit Authorization Letters (VAL) and other agency required paperwork
  • Manage and conduct NISP operations that includes both "access elsewhere" and “possessing facility” operational environments for Department of Defense and other government agencies
  • Ensure compliance with DOD/Federal/Intelligence Community regulations that govern the critical security disciplines of both NISP/NISPOM and SCI classified contract-related security operations
  • Analyze complex problems, develops, and articulates focused solutions, and takes independent action in an often-ambiguous work environment
  • Develop security procedures consistent with Deloitte policies, the National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM), including Intelligence Community Directive (ICD) 704 and ICD 705
  • Review, coordinate, publish (and amend, as needed) security program governance documentation (e.g.: policies, procedures, and Standard Practice Procedures (SPP) manuals)
  • Provide advisory and consultation to Federal leadership, senior management, project managers, and engagement team members
  • Conduct regular interactions (in-person meetings, briefings, phone calls, status emails) with Deloitte client account teams, government clients, and other Enterprise Service teams to understand their needs and requirements, develop efficient security support processes, report/provide relevant security-related information, engage clients as appropriate, and develop sound working relationships
  • Report all security violations and compromises/potential compromises of classified information to the Corporate Facility Security Officer
  • Conduct security-related liaison activities with external (client) customers/Government security officials, internal (Deloitte) Federal leadership, and Enterprise Solutions (Federal Contracts, Recruiting and Talent, as necessary)
  • Review personnel security clearance request packages for accuracy and completeness.
  • Coordinate security support for compartmented or special access programs, as required
  • Manage the Self-Assessment program between DCSA Security Reviews to monitor the overall security status of classified contracts/operations and provide recommendations for corrective actions, to include establishing continuous evaluation criteria
  • Perform other related duties as required, necessary or directed to assure a comprehensive and viable security program within the guidelines of the NISPOM
  • Assist with ad hoc proposal security volume reviews
  • Ensure both internal and external security information systems (e.g.: SharePoint, internal security databases, etc.) are updated with current data related to account
  • Escalate issues and concerns to appropriate managers and senior leadership
  • Collaborate across all GPS Security teams to ensure best practices are being consistently employed and information is adequately shared as appropriate

Required Qualifications:

  • Active Top Secret clearance. Be able to obtain/maintain Top Secret/SCI clearance, as required
  • 3+ years of professional experience
  • Experience working in a team environment that is rapid-response, customer-focused, and results-driven
  • Experience of people management supporting large, diverse, complex security organizations
  • Strong understanding of the security clearance process and ability to resolve personnel clearance problems effectively
  • Knowledge and experience of utilizing the Defense Information System for Security (DISS) database, National Industrial Security System (NISS) and ACCS
  • Experience in the Industrial Security field to include personnel security, operations security, insider threat management, FOCI mitigations, and incident management
  • Experience establishing facility clearances and getting classified areas certified by DCSA.
  • Familiarity with the drafting, coordinating and processing of prime/sub DD254s
  • Competence in delivery of business presentations, public speaking and training experience, and effective written communications skills to support interaction with all levels of personnel (employees and leadership)
  • Proficiency in the use of M.S. Office products, SharePoint, Personnel Security Management databases
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's (BS/BA) Degree or Advanced Degree with Security Specialization
  • FSO Program Management for Possessing Facilities Certification
