Job ID 369934

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Tampa, FL
  • Experience: 2+ years

About this job

Senior Consultant role at Deloitte in Tampa providing SAP software advisory and implementation services. Responsibilities include designing SAP S/4HANA solutions, analyzing supply chain systems, coordinating implementation phases, and training end users, with 50% national travel required.

Good fit if you have 2 years of experience with SAP Materials Management, S/4HANA implementation, supply chain analysis, and client stakeholder engagement.

Full job description

Position Summary

Deloitte Consulting LLP seeks a Senior Consultant in Tampa, Florida.

Work You’ll Do
Drive SAP software advisory and implementation services to help companies unlock the value of technology investments as discrete services or comprehensive solutions. Improve the ability to react in a digital world and enable scalability, remove performance barriers, enable innovation, and modernize core systems and reimagine their business with SAP digital solutions. Participate in setting SAP engagement objectives and scope, develop work plans for components of engagements, coordinate activities between workstreams and identify changes in scope. Perform assessments of existing information systems and identify gaps between business requirements and current system capabilities. Provide application analysis to meet SAP architecture and infrastructure goals. Provide industry insight and analytical support using data mining, pattern matching, data visualization, and predictive modelling tools to produce analysis and algorithms that help businesses make better decisions.

  • 50% Travel required nationally
  • Telecommuting permitted

Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Business Administration, any STEM field, or a related field. Must have 2 years of related work experience in the job offered or in a related occupation.

Position requires 2 years of related work experience in each of the following:

  • Working across the Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, and Run phases of SAP Activate methodology for the full lifecycle implementation of SAP Materials Management (MM) services;
  • Designing, configuring, and supporting SAP S/4HANA and SAP MM and Inventory Management (IM) modules to drive business requirements and provide user solutions;
  • Analyzing and documenting clients’ current-state supply chain systems, processes, and environments, and performing root cause analysis to support project design of future-state/to-be systems, processes, and environments, using Microsoft (MS) Office Suite;
  • Tracking and reporting on project and milestone deliverables status to ensure timely project delivery, and communicating updates to internal and external stakeholders, using Gantt and Burndown Charts, MS Excel, Rally, and Micro Focus ALM;
  • Driving requirements gathering and project planning, creating test cases, coordinating the testing and deployment in SAP S/4HANA, and training and assisting end users during Hypercare after Go-Live;
  • Interfacing directly with client stakeholders to provide the impact and risk analysis relating to RICEFW objects deployment in SAP MM; and
  • Designing and delivering user manuals and training for solutions to ensure successful implementation, adoption, and maintenance in client environments, utilizing SAP MM.

Job.JobTitle: Salesforce Commerce Cloud B2B Functional Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $86,700 to $170,900 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 3+ years

About this job

Salesforce Commerce Cloud B2B functional consultant role with Deloitte's Customer team in Jacksonville. You'll lead discovery workshops, design eCommerce solutions, and guide clients through SFCC implementations while working with technical architects and cross-functional teams.

Good fit if you have 2+ years configuring Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud, 1+ years facilitating discovery workshops, and can travel up to 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. 

Recruiting for this role ends on January 5, 2027

Work you’ll do 

Our eCommerce capabilities provide transactional solutions related to online marketing, sales and service; for both Direct-To-Consumer and Business-to-Business. Our Portal capabilities provide intranet and internet solutions focused on content presentment and transaction capabilities for both internal enterprise as well as customer facing purposes. 

You understand what it takes design and make complex Salesforce eCommerce solutions happen, and you'll have a firm hand on the controls every step of the way. 

You’ll help clients define their eCommerce requirements by leading and facilitating working sessions to gain an understanding of the client’s current state processes and technology in the eCommerce space as well as supporting the implementation that follows.

If you like to design leading-edge solutions, you will help clients unlock the business value of SFCC (Salesforce Commerce Cloud), specifically Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud. 

You will:

  • Lead project discovery workshops, both on-site and remotely
  • Assess client business requirements and work closely with the Technical Architect/Lead to provide long-term functional solutions based on the applicable Salesforce platform best practices
  • Communicate platform capabilities and limitations to clients effectively
  • Identify client process pain points and gaps in best practices
  • Create and socialize feature and technical roadmaps
  • Drive client functional requirements and eCommerce best practice adoption
  • Author & review functional specification documentation and user stories for implementations and other large projects

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth. 

Qualifications: 

Required 

  • 3+ years of IT experience
  • 2+ years of experience with Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud.
  • 1+ years of experience configuring Salesforce B2B Commerce (on Lightning Experience or B2B Commerce on Salesforce Core) including catalogs, price books, promotions, entitlements, and buyer groups
  • 1+ years of experience facilitating functional discovery workshops. Create functional design documents, user stories, process flows, and test scripts
  • 1+ years of experience with Agile delivery methodology and end-to-end implementation delivery
  • Exposure to AI-driven work within delivery — e.g., using GenAI tools for user story development, meeting notes/summarization, requirements documentation, or test case generation.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred  

  • Salesforce certifications: B2B Commerce Administrator, Salesforce Certified Administrator, or Business Analyst
  • Experience of working in a professional services firm or working in a client service environment
  • Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Systems

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $86,700 – $170,900.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Cloud Engineer, IT / Technology, Cybersecurity Analyst
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Tampa, FL

About this job

Design and manage cloud security telemetry, logging, and alerting infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP for Deloitte's global cloud platform. The role focuses on hands-on technical work building detection and response capabilities without on-call SOC responsibilities.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in software or cloud engineering, hands-on multi-cloud experience, and programming or Infrastructure as Code skills like Python or Terraform.

Full job description

Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

Are you energized by building at the intersection of cloud and security engineering? Our current cloud security tooling is a genuinely wide, still-evolving mix — cloud-native platforms, CNAPP tooling, and classic SIEM — with real room to bring more coherence to it, and a real appetite to bring AI into how we build, detect, and analyze. If designing the telemetry, data, and infrastructure that a global organization depends on to detect and respond to threats across a multi-cloud environment sounds like a good problem to work on, read on to learn about an opportunity on the Cloud Defensive Operations team within Deloitte's Global Cloud Security (GCS) organization.

As a Cloud Defense Security Engineer, you'll design, build, and directly manage the cloud security telemetry, monitoring, and alerting infrastructure that underpins how Deloitte's global cloud platform — used by Member Firms worldwide — is defended. GCS builds the platform-level capabilities that our Cyber Defense team relies on to see, understand, and respond to what's happening across the cloud — so your work has direct, foundational impact on Cyber, without the SOC or on-call rotation that usually comes with it.

This role is anchored in strong, hands-on technical execution across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. The ability to collaborate across teams and contribute to strategy matters too, but it's something we'll help you build over time rather than expect on day one.

This role reports to the Cloud Defensive Operations Manager.

Where you'll make an impact:

  • Cloud detection and response platform. Contribute to an internal platform GCS builds to support Cyber Defense's cloud investigation, triage, and response.
  • Unified threat visibility. Help bring cloud-native alerts, internal configuration guardrails, and our cloud-native application protection (CNAPP) service into a more unified view, in a landscape that's genuinely still evolving.
  • AI-infused security engineering. Explore how AI can change how we build, detect, and analyze — from AI-assisted engineering to AI-driven correlation across data sources.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and directly manage cloud security telemetry, logging, and alerting infrastructure — including log ingestion, storage, retention, and retrieval — across multiple cloud environments.
  • Apply modern software and cloud engineering practices — IaC, automation, CI/CD — to security-critical systems.
  • Spot and help close gaps in visibility or coverage, and contribute ideas on guardrails and improvements as you grow into the role.
  • Support post-incident reviews, document your work, and build working relationships across GCS, Cyber Defense, and cloud engineering teams.

What you'll bring:

This role is anchored in strong technical execution, with room to grow into the strategic and cross-team side of the work. The strongest candidates will demonstrate:

  • Modern engineering depth. A genuine software or cloud engineering background — not just security tooling configuration.
  • Cross-system thinking. Some real experience working across multiple systems, clouds, or tools, even if you're still building depth.
  • A collaborative mindset. Comfort working with people outside your immediate team, with room to keep growing that skill.
  • Curiosity and ownership. You treat gaps and incidents as chances to improve things, and you're comfortable with some ambiguity.


The team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.



Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, plus 5+ years in software engineering, cloud engineering, or data engineering
  • Hands-on, multi-cloud experience (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), including directly managing cloud security infrastructure such as logging and alerting
  • Programming and Infrastructure as Code experience (e.g., Python, Terraform, or similar)
  • Some experience with data modeling or correlating data across systems, and communicating with stakeholders outside your immediate team — depth isn't required, but this shouldn't be uncharted territory
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future

Desired Skills / Certifications:

  • Cloud-native telemetry & automation: Broader automation, scripting, or IaC experience (Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi); familiarity with unified data platforms, data modeling, data science, or reporting/BI tools such as Power BI
  • Detection & SIEM platforms: Hands-on experience with major SIEM or log-analytics platforms — Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or Google SecOps/Chronicle — and query authoring in KQL, SPL, or similar correlation languages
  • CNAPP & posture tooling: Experience with major cloud-native security platforms or CNAPP tooling such as Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, or Orca Security.
  • Container & workload security: Exposure to Kubernetes/Docker security, and awareness of frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud.
  • Applied AI: Hands-on use of AI tools for building, analyzing, or correlating security data
  • Relevant certifications: AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CCSP, GIAC GCSA/GCDA, or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS)
  • Adjacent exposure: Experience with Security Operations, Incident Response, or Cyber Defense as a partner team.



Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Job.JobTitle: Data and AI Policies & Enablement Senior Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.


The Data and AI Policies & Enablement Senior Manager role is a unique role that will drive immediate and global impact to help lead the formation and build the foundations of the new Data Strategy & Governance Office (DSGO) at Deloitte Global. 
The Senior Manager, Data Policies & Enablement is responsible for developing enterprise data and AI policies and monitoring organizational compliance by supporting the execution of data risk management practices, working closely with data and AI control owners, risk, and technology teams.


The role acts as a bridge between policy and execution, ensuring that data and AI governance frameworks are effectively embedded into day-to-day operations and risks related to lifecycle management including but not limited to identification, usage, quality, model selection, decisioning, privacy, retention, and compliance are identified, assessed, and mitigated.  

Key responsibilities include:

Policy Development & Interpretation

  • Identify requirements for policy definition to align with the requirements of internal cyber security standards, and external standards and frameworks like GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC2, NIST Standards, and the EU AI Act
  • Develop and maintain global data and AI policies, standards, and data and AI policy frameworks in alignment with data and AI maturity across the enterprise 
  • Cond

    The team

    The DSGO is responsible for building an integrated strategy and operating model to effectively and consistently manage global data and AI throughout its lifecycle to more effectively serve our clients, meet business objectives and foster innovation. The team is leading initiatives to develop a data and AI strategy and establish consistent data governance, data management, and AI product development and governance practices at Deloitte Global, enabled by technology. The team reports to the Global Chief Information Officer under the Technology Strategy and Architecture portfolio.



    Qualifications

    Do you possess the following?:

    • Six to Ten years of experience in data and AI governance, data policy development, and risk management and monitoring
    • Strong understanding of data and AI policies (privacy, security, governance), risk frameworks and control design, and regulatory environment impacting data and AI e.g. GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC2, NIST Standards, and the EU AI Act
    • Experience implementing risk and compliance processes at scale, ideally in a global or federated organization
    • Familiarity with data and AI governance tools (catalog, quality, lineage, model decisioning etc.), cloud data platforms, and AI/data governance considerations
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
    • Ability to interpret complex policies and translate into execution
    • Stakeholder management across business and technical teams
    • Process design and operationalization expertise
    • Communication skills to simplify complex governance concepts



    Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

This role leads the discovery, definition, delivery, governance, and adoption of data products for a strategic initiative to build Deloitte Global's Data Platform. It blends product ownership, business analysis, and data discovery expertise with a working understanding of how well-structured data underpins modern AI and agentic capabilities.


The Manager will own business use cases from intake through implementation, partnering with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to shape scalable, trusted, AI-ready data products. Success in this role means being equally comfortable running structured requirements sessions and navigating ambiguity — translating technical depth into recommendations that business and technology leaders can act on.

Product Ownership & Delivery Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of Global Data Platform (GDP) use cases and data products — from intake through implementation, business adoption, and ongoing enhancement
  • Partner with the Product Manager to intake, triage, and prioritize requests across business domains and the GDP roadmap
  • Lead cross-functional delivery teams of business stakeholders, data engineers, data modelers, and subject matter experts to deliver against commitments
  • Coordinate contributors across business and technology teams to drive alignment, accountability, and timely execution
  • Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and guidance to business analysts and project contributors supporting GDP initiatives
  • Ensure delivered solutions stay aligned with GDP strategy, enterprise architecture standards, and business priorities

Business & Data Requirements Analysis

    • Experience defining business and technical KPIs and success measures for enterprise data products and analytics solutions
    • Skilled at producing source-to-target mapping documentation, data lineage artifacts, and transformation logic
    • Working knowledge of data platforms, data warehousing, ETL/ELT processes, and analytics ecosystems such as Databricks or Snowflake

Job.JobTitle: Supply Chain Optimization Data Scientist Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $141,200 to $278,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 6+ years

About this job

Supply chain data scientist manager role at Deloitte in Jacksonville, Florida. You'll design optimization and forecasting models, build analytical solutions using Python and SQL, and support deployment and client adoption of transformational supply chain solutions.

Good fit if you have 6+ years delivering analytical solutions, experience building optimization or forecasting models, Python and SQL skills, and a cloud platform certification.

Full job description

Position Summary

Manager-Strategy, Growth & Transformation

We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!


Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don’t miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

Recruiting for this role ends on 02/28/2026

Work you'll do

· As a Supply Chain Optimization Data Scientist you will be responsible for

· Define decision objectives, constraints, business rules, and performance measures with client stakeholders.

· Design and validate optimization, simulation, forecasting, scheduling, inventory, and network-design models.

· Build and integrate analytical solutions using Python, SQL, data pipelines, and enterprise systems.

· Evaluate scenarios and trade-offs to quantify impacts on service, cost, capacity, working capital, lead time, and resilience.

· Support solution testing, deployment, user adoption, and communication of analytical findings.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
· The desire to build technology driven solutions
· Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
· Effective written and verbal communication skills
· Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
· Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
· Ability to lead projects or workstreams
· Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
· Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
· Ability to meet deadlines
· Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

Qualifications

Required:
· 6+ years of experience delivering analytical or technology solutions from concept through production deployment.
· Experience developing optimization, simulation, forecasting, scheduling, inventory, or network-design models.
· Experience using Python and SQL for data preparation, validation, and modeling.
· Experience translating supply chain planning or execution processes into functional or technical requirements.
· Experience integrating models or data through extract, transform, and load (ETL), extract, load, and transform (ELT), or application programming interfaces (APIs).
· At least 1 Cloud platform certification such as Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure or AWS.
· Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
· Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:
· Master’s degree in operations research, supply chain, computer science, or applied mathematics.
· 4+ years of experience with supply chain planning, decision intelligence, control towers, digital twins, or optimization platforms.
· Experience deploying analytical solutions in cloud or enterprise environments and integrating with planning, warehouse, transportation,manufacturing, or supplier-management systems.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the evolving cybersecurity challenges and opportunities organizations face. Join our Cyber practice to help clients navigate a dynamic threat landscape through solutions and managed services that simplify complexity and strengthen resilience. In this role, you will support Next-Generation Security Operations Center (SOC) capabilities built on the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including Falcon Next-Gen SIEM (NG SIEM), Falcon Insight Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Falcon Fusion SOAR, Falcon Identity Protection, Falcon Intelligence, and Charlotte AI. You will help clients operate with confidence and proactively manage cyber risk.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a CrowdStrike SecOps, Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading the design and implementation of Falcon Next-Gen SIEM architectures, including log source onboarding, data normalization, enrichment, and correlation rule development to support enterprise threat detection and analytics.
  • Leading the deployment of log-ingestion pipelines using data fabric technologies and application programming interface (API) integrations, including Cribl, Tines, or similar technologies.
  • Administering and optimizing the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including sensor deployment, policy configuration, host grouping, exclusions, and response actions across Windows, macOS, and Linux/server environments.
  • Collaborating with SOC analysts and threat detection engineers to prioritize, develop, and tune threat-detection content and use cases in CrowdStrike Falcon, including custom indicators of attack (IOAs) and correlation rules to detect malicious behavior and adversary activity in enterprise environments.
  • Building and maintaining Falcon Fusion SOAR playbooks and API-based integrations to automate alert enrichment, triage, and response, while advising clients on SOC maturity and platform capabilities.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Cyber Defense & Resilience offering helps clients defend against advanced threats by transforming security operations, monitoring technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence capabilities. The team works with organizations to manage dynamic attack surfaces and strengthen readiness, response, and recovery across cyber incidents and broader business disruptions.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in security operations, threat detection engineering, or enterprise information technology security.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with CrowdStrike Falcon platform architecture, modules, and administration, including Falcon Next-Gen SIEM; Falcon Insight Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and extended detection and response (XDR); Falcon Fusion SOAR; Falcon Identity Protection; Falcon Intelligence; Charlotte AI; sensor deployment; policy configuration; host grouping; exclusions; and response actions.
  • Experience conducting detection and response activities, including investigations, triage, host isolation, indicator blocking, and quarantine support; and applying the MITRE ATT&CK framework and Cyber Kill Chain.
  • Experience using Python or another scripting language for automation and integration development.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA), CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Responder (CCFR), or Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) certification.
  • Experience using Python or PowerShell to develop Falcon Fusion SOAR playbooks and API integrations.
  • Experience conducting threat hunting or producing cyber threat intelligence.
  • Experience with data fabric technologies, including Bindplane or Cribl, and cloud infrastructure platforms, including Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) or security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) tools, including Splunk, Cortex XSOAR, or XSIAM.
  • Consulting experience or one or more of the following certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 8+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Manage federal contract administration for complex, high-value government engagements at Deloitte, advising leadership on contract strategy and resolving contractual issues. Requires 8+ years managing multiple federal contract types and DHS agency experience, with hybrid work and 25% travel.

Good fit if you have 8+ years managing federal contracts including cost-plus and firm-fixed-price types, experience with DHS agencies, and can work hybrid with 25% travel.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Specialist Manager, Government Client Contracts Management supports strategic federal contract administration activities across complex, high-value engagements that directly affect revenue generation and retention. This role advises account leadership on contract strategy, supports compliant execution across the contract lifecycle, and leads analysis and resolution of complex contractual matters. The role also drives negotiation, portfolio oversight, and operational coordination across internal stakeholders.

While all locations will be considered, this role offers a flexible hybrid scheduled with candidates based in Washington, D.C. or Arlington, VA (or nearby) preferred. 

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/01/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Specialist Manager, Government Client Contracts Management on the Enterprise Contract Management & Operations team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading proposal, award, and contract administration activities for complex federal contracts across the contract lifecycle
  • Reviewing contract actions, identifying contractual risks and opportunities, and implementing action plans to support compliant execution
  • Advising project and account leadership on contract strategy, negotiations, and issue resolution for strategic government engagements
  • Monitoring contract portfolios, pipeline activity, and contract performance to support revenue retention and operational execution
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders to maintain contract data, resolve discrepancies, and support accurate documentation and reporting

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

The team

The Enterprise Contract Management & Operations team is responsible for contract administration activities supporting strategic enterprise contract vehicles across Deloitte’s Government and Public Services practice. This role will work directly with Contracts professionals, Project Engagement Leadership, Enabling Solutions points of contact, and other internal stakeholders to coordinate the information and decisions required to support compliant contract management and operational execution

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Legal Studies, or another business discipline
  • 8+ years of experience managing multiple federal contract types, including cost-plus-fixed-fee, cost-plus-incentive-fee, cost-plus-award-fee, firm-fixed-price level-of-effort, time-and-materials, and firm-fixed-price contracts or commensurate experience.
  • Experience supporting federal clients, including DHS Agencies
  • Experience leading projects with organizational impact
  • Experience developing, submitting, and negotiating governmentwide contract vehicles
  • Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that would require professionals to co-locate in person 2-3 days per week, whether at the a Deloitte office or client site, dependent on the team's needs 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Advanced Degree such as Master of Business Administration, Master of Science degree, or Juris Doctor
  • National Contract Management Association certification, including Certified Federal Contracts Manager, Certified Commercial Contracts Manager, or Certified Professional Contracts Manager
  • Experience in a professional services organization
  • Demonstrated experience managing both prime federal contracts and downstream federal subcontracts or vendor procurement operations governed under federal regulations and procedures
  • Experience managing junior team members

Job.JobTitle: Life Sciences Research Manager – Deloitte Center for Health Solutions
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Position Summary

Are you passionate about shaping the future of life sciences and health care?

Deloitte’s Center for Health Solutions (DCHS) is seeking an established professional who accelerates the Center’s ability to sense sector and industry trends, develop business relevant research, and activate market-shaping insights—ensuring the right content reaches the right business leader at the right time to drive client and market conversations. The focus will be on market and business issues that impact the life sciences sector, particularly biopharma and medical technology organizations.

The individual in this role will have accountability for turning research strategy into scalable, high-impact insights that influence executive decision-making, inform client strategy, and accelerate Deloitte’s growth in the business. The role combines thought leadership excellence, operational rigor, and commercial acumen to ensure the Center’s work is relevant, differentiated, and impactful. This role is designed for a leader who can bridge research and business, inspire teams, and influence senior stakeholders across Deloitte and the broader life sciences and health care ecosystem.

As a Research Manager at Deloitte, you will:

  • Shape market-moving insights that guide and inspire curiosity among life science executives
  • Engage with top decision makers in industry and the market
  • Lead, manage and mentor the next generation of research leaders
  • Identify and lead the implementation of innovation, collaboration, and activities that create value for our business and help our practitioners scale insight driven client conversations.

This is a rare opportunity to lead with purpose, collaborating with incredible professionals across our firm, thinking boldly, growing the impact of our business, and delivering insights that inspire action and improve health for millions across our nation and the world.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.

About Deloitte’s Center for Health Solutions

Deloitte Center for Health Solutions (DCHS) is Deloitte’s trusted source for actionable insights on the most pressing issues in life sciences and health care. Our mission is to turn evidence into influence—delivering research that challenges conventional wisdom, sparks dialogue and drives transformation across the health ecosystem.

The Center brings together researchers, policy experts, and strategists to generate differentiated, data-driven thought leadership. As part of Deloitte’s Research & Insights organization within the Growth and Purpose function, DCHS works at the intersection of commercial, public sector, academic, and business to help our clients — and the world — make smarter, more sustainable decisions about health.

What You will Do: As a Research Manager of the Center for Health Solutions, you will:

Lead Market-Making Research

  • Engage with senior Deloitte leaders from across the firm to define and lead the research agenda for the Life Sciences Sector (prioritizing issues facing biopharma and medtech organizations) ensuring alignment with Deloitte’s strategic priorities and emerging industry challenges. Relevant topics include, but are not limited to, strategic choices, Research & development, innovation, artificial intelligence, finance, workforce, supply chain, commercial launch and market issues, cyber risk, governance, transformation, financing, operations, digital health, models of care, M&A, and the future of the life sciences sector. At times, the issues will integrate and interface with the health care sector, so we need to also consider times when the business benefits from industry level insight development.
  • Design and oversee large-scale, multi-method research studies (e.g., surveys, public data analysis, proprietary data analysis, econometric modeling, AI-enabled analytics, structured interviews, among others).
  • Advance innovative methodologies, integrating innovative tools, rigor, and diverse data sources to generate unique insights. Develop and promote new research methodologies via generative AI tools to increase quality, variety, and quantity.
  • Cultivate collaborations with business leaders, academic institutions, industry partners, and global thought leaders to expand the Center’s research reach and impact.
  • Maintain Deloitte’s reputation for intellectual integrity, quality, and independence.

Shape Thought Leadership

  • Serve as a visible thought leader within Deloitte and the broader LSHC community.
  • Publish research, deliver client, account team and market presentations and engage with media and other key stakeholders to elevate Deloitte’s brand.
  • Translate complex findings into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with executive audiences and drive market impact.
  • Position research as a catalyst for client conversations, policy dialogue, and strategic decision-making.
  • Identify and communicate key industry trends and their implications to our clients and our business.

Inspire Teams & Drive Excellence

  • Lead and mentor a team of researchers, analysts, and strategists — cultivating excellence, innovation, and professional growth.
  • Build an environment that values intellectual rigor, collaboration, curiosity, and inclusion oriented in using data, AI, and technology.
  • Serve as a mentor and role model, helping emerging researchers grow into visible thought leaders.
  • Manage project delivery and quality, ensuring research meets Deloitte’s high standards and deadlines.
  • Set clear expectations, provide feedback, and model leadership behaviors aligned with Deloitte’s purpose and values.
  • Own sector workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, and performance management to scale reliable development, delivery, operations, and execution.
  • Help implement the principles of our business unit thought leadership transformation

Engage with Clients & the Market

  • Partner with Deloitte industry and sector leaders to translate insights into solutions that can solve real-world client problems.
  • Engage with C-suite executives, policymakers, and global leaders to present findings, test hypotheses, and influence decisions.
  • Identify emerging issues and white-space opportunities to guide new research and strengthen Deloitte’s position in key markets.
  • Support clients and account teams by identifying and supporting sector and related account needs as appropriate.

Drive Activation, Distribution, and Commercial Enablement

  • Partner with Industry, Sector, and Account leaders to position research as a growth catalyst, enabling differentiated client value propositions.
  • Help support and enhance an always-on distribution system (segmented audiences, executive moments that matter, enablement packaging, and digital/multimedia assets) so business leaders receive relevant and timely insights when they can act.

  • Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, Communications, and PR teams to amplify reach, relevance, and impact.
  • Deliver on impact metrics (reach, engagement, influence on pipeline, client adoption) to demonstrate return on insight investment.
  • Modernize research workflows using emerging approaches (including analytics, automation, and responsible artificial intelligence (AI) where appropriate).
  • Improve speed-to-insight through rapid-cycle research and publishing models—without sacrificing quality or independence.

Basic Qualifications

  • Master’s degree required in health administration, public health, economics, epidemiology, health policy, business, or related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of professional experience with increasing leadership responsibility in research, thought leadership, or strategy roles.
  • Expertise in the LSHC industry, with proven ability to connect research to business and policy real world implications.
  • Strong analytical, research, and project management skills; expertise in large, complex data sets, industry data, public data and use of statistical methods (R, Python, Stata).
  • Experience using LLMs and similar AI tools to facilitate deeper research and develop new analytic approaches.
  • Demonstrated excellence in writing and communicating for executive audiences.

  • Proven record of leading, developing and inspiring high-performing teams.

  • Experience in the professional services environment and comfort in operating in a matrixed organization

  • Doctorate in business administration, AI, public health, medicine, economics, sciences, health policy, sociology, or related field
  • Record of creativity, resilience, and adaptability in ambiguous situations.

Position Summary

Associate Vice President, CCaaS & AI Transformation

Our Deloitte Sales & Service team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work you'll do

As an Associate Vice President, you will help grow and deliver Deloitte’s Contact Center and Customer Service transformation business. You will serve as a trusted client advisor, lead complex engagements, shape pursuits, and bring together business, technology, alliance, and delivery teams to create measurable client value.

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

The team

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.

Required:

  • 10+ years delivering digital, cloud, contact center, or customer service solutions, including 5+ years focused on CCaaS or customer service transformation.
  • 5+ years spanning sales/pre-sales and delivery, including at least 3 pursuits and 2 implementation, migration, or optimization programs.
  • 5+ years with NICE CXone and/or Amazon Connect, including experience designing or overseeing enterprise solutions integrated with CRM, IVR, workforce management, quality management, analytics, or digital channels.
  • Experience applying AI to at least one customer service or contact center use case, such as virtual agents, conversational IVR, agent assist, summarization, quality automation, or workforce optimization.
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent work experience.

Preferred:

  • Integrations with Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, SAP, or Microsoft Dynamics.
  • Experience with omnichannel routing, self-service, IVR, workforce management, quality management, analytics, and digital channels.
  • Working knowledge of AWS services such as Amazon Connect, Lex, Bedrock, Lambda, and API Gateway.
  • Experience with AI platforms such as Agentforce, Google CCAI, Cognigy, Kore.ai, or similar.
  • Agile, Scrum, hybrid delivery, or relevant cloud/CCaaS certifications.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate SOC L3 Analyst / Shift Lead - Senior Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Managed Services Engineer III on the Cyber Operate Offering team, you will be responsible for…

  • Act as main interface point between Service Delivery Managers (SDMs), Cyber Managed Services Engineering, Threat Hunting teams and SOC analysts
  • Act as escalation point for all advanced security escalations from L2 analysts
  • Perform in-depth analysis and triage of threat activity across host and network layers traffic and protocol analysis to identify infection vectors, scope of compromise, and impact.
  • Review threat intelligence and open-source information to maintain awareness of new patterns, activity, and tactics associated with advanced threat actors, and incorporate this into ongoing hunt activity.
  • Analyze network and endpoint data in both structured and unstructured methods using the SIEM and specialized tooling; remain tool-agnostic concepts and methods are key, the tool is only a means.
  • Interface with Threat Intelligence to raise questions, share escalations, and mine reporting for actionable threat behaviors.
  • Analyze malware (executables, scripts, documents) to determine indicators of compromise, and create signatures for future detection of similar samples
  • Provide guidance on process and procedures specific to client’s environment
  • Responsible for meeting SLA requirements
  • Ensure quality standards are being met by doing ticket audits and reviewing and completing shift turnover logs
  • Conduct continuous improvement and on the job training (OJT)
  • Coordinates with Service Delivery Managers to enforce specific client requests and provide monitoring updates
  • Coordinate with clients to process and complete continuous improvement activities
  • Monitor and provide feedback/guidance on incident tickets on trends, patterns and anomalies
  • Act as the Point of escalation for operations/security issues
  • Attend client meetings, as and when needed, to assist SDMs with dissemination of security and event information
  • Ensure SOC metrics are met
  • Review reports and deliverables before they leave the SOC
  • Manage security event investigations, partnering with other departments as needed
  • Maintain individual certifications and learning requirements

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Proven ability to lead and coordinate a team of analysts across shifts
  • Strong client-facing communication skills, including delivering findings and updates to SDMs and clients
  • Ability to make sound, timely decisions during high-severity or ambiguous incidents
  • Ability to manage competing priorities across ticket queues, escalations, and personnel needs
  • Strong coaching and mentoring skills to develop L1 and L2 Analysts
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships across client and internal stakeholder groups
  • Meticulous attention to quality, demonstrated through ticket audits and QA reviews
  • Ability to lead process-improvement initiatives and own runbook/playbook governance
  • Ability to remain composed and provide clear direction during critical incidents

The team

Our Cyber Operate Offering operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
  • 4+ years of experience in cybersecurity or security operations
  • Able to work shifts on a rotating basis for 24/7 support of clients
  • Experience in security technologies such as: Security information and event management (SIEM), IDS/IPS, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Proxy, Web Application Firewall (WAF), Endpoint detection and response (EDR), Anti-Virus, Sandboxing, network- and host- based firewalls, Threat Intelligence, Penetration Testing, etc.
  • Extensive knowledge of Advanced Persistent Threats (APT) tactics, technics and procedures
  • Understanding of possible attack activities such as network probing/ scanning, DDOS, malicious code activity, etc.
  • A deep understanding of the Cyber Kill Chain and MITRE tactics and technically detailed knowledge of basic attack techniques such as buffer overflows, SQL injections, XSS, common vulnerabilities, and memory allocation basics
  • Possess technically detailed knowledge of important threat campaigns and perform hunt activities as directed by Hunt Lead, or Service Lead
  • Understanding of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP
  • Extensive knowledge in system security architecture and security solutions
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certification in Certified Intrusion Analyst (GIAC), Continuous Monitoring (GMON), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) or equivalent
  • Programming experience in one or more languages
  • Ability to work 50% of their time from a Deloitte office
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience in a client-facing delivery role
  • Experience in Detection Engineering or Vulnerability Management

Requisition code: 369556
Job ID 369556

Quick facts

  • Pay: $151,500 to $252,200 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Fort Lauderdale, FL
  • Experience: 8+ years

About this job

Lead technical ownership of a Deloitte cybersecurity product line spanning spacecraft hardware, embedded software, AI/ML, ground systems, and cyber operations. You make final release decisions, define system architecture across multiple spacecraft platforms, and lead multidisciplinary teams through integration, testing, and compliance.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in space systems or embedded engineering, proven leadership on complex multidisciplinary programs, and deep experience integrating payloads across satellite bus architectures.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

The Lead Product Engineer is the senior technical owner for one of Deloitte’s product lines as a hands-on lead spanning across spacecraft hardware, embedded software, AI/ML, ground systems, and cyber operations. This role holds final technical authority over what ships and release readiness, while defining and evolving the system architecture, including how the Deloitte product integrates into new spacecraft buses and mission profiles, so it remains scalable, coherent, and strategically aligned across a growing set of host platforms and customer programs.

Recruiting for this role will end on December 30, 2026.

Work You’ll Do

As a Lead Product Engineer on the Enterprise Security team, you will be responsible for…

  • Serving as the senior technical owner for a Deloitte product line across spacecraft hardware, embedded software, AI/ML, ground systems, and cyber operations.
  • Defining and evolving system architecture, integration patterns, and technical standards to support deployment across new spacecraft buses, mission profiles, and host platforms
  • Making release readiness decisions and owning final technical authority over product quality, system integrity, and what is approved for shipment
  • Leading technical tradeoff decisions for adaptation to unfamiliar bus architectures, interfaces, and orbital environments while maintaining schedule, performance, and mission outcomes.
  • Partnering with product, engineering, manufacturers, bus partners, and government and commercial customers to drive technical vision, delivery, and interoperability of Deloitte’s products.
  • Lead integration engineering for each new host platform: define interface control documents (ICDs), adapt Silent Shield to mission-specific bus protocols (e.g., CAN, MIL-STD-1553, SpaceWire) and message structures, and manage the non-recurring engineering required to onboard a new bus, satellite manufacturer, or mission profile.
  • Lead multidisciplinary delivery across cyber, software, hardware, AI, and systems: unblock teams, ensure implementation consistency across bus types and mission profiles, and bridge research to production.
  • Translate compliance frameworks (NIST, CNSSP-12, ATO, STIGs as applicable) into executable delivery controls and compliance-ready designs, consistent across Deloitte-owned and customer-owned deployments. 
  • Own system-level test strategy and execution, including FlatSat and hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL) integration testing, security validation, mission-readiness, and operational acceptance across host platforms; own system failures and root-cause resolution.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective technical written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Strong leadership skillset.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Strong technical acumen
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong grasp of security architecture.
  • Ability to lead and influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to meet deadlines

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Enterprise Security offering embeds security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client’s technical backbone while enabling secure digital transformation. Includes security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Active TS/SCI or SCI eligibility is required.
  • 8+ years of experience in product engineering, systems engineering, software engineering, or embedded systems engineering.
  • 8+ years of experience working in the space industry with a strong understanding of systems architecture.
  • 5+ years of experience with spacecraft systems, embedded software, cyber operations, ground systems, or artificial intelligence/machine learning-enabled products.
  • Proven leadership capabilities delivering complex, multidisciplinary cyber and/or space systems through production and operations.
  • Deep experience designing secure architecture across cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and space/embedded constraints, with strong systems-thinking and integration background (interfaces, bus protocols, constraints, failure modes).
  • Demonstrated experience integrating a payload, subsystem, or capability across multiple satellite bus architectures or host platforms, including interface definition (ICDs), non-recurring engineering, and acceptance testing with external manufacturers or bus partners.
  • Experience defining system architecture and technical requirements for integrated hardware and software products.
  • Experience supporting technical integration with external partners, manufacturers, or customers
  • Experience operating under compliance constraints (NIST, ATO, STIGs, as applicable) and translating them into executable delivery controls and compliance-ready designs.
  • Expertise in Cyber Governance and Policies and Product Management.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred: 

  • Master’s degree or PHD in engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related technical field.
  • Cyber technical skillset.
  • Experience with satellite mission operations, telemetry/tracking/command (TT&C), or aerospace delivery environments.
  • Background in embedded systems integration across multiple bus protocols (CAN bus, MIL-STD-1553, SpaceWire, real-time protocols).
  • Experience working with satellite manufacturers or bus partners on payload integration, radiation qualification, or SWaP-constrained design.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML model deployment pipelines in constrained environments (e.g., ONNX).
  • Background in SPARTA (Space Attack Research and Tactic Analysis) threat frameworks.
  • Working fluency across the platform tech stack, enough to guide design decisions in each domain: embedded/space (C, POSIX, CAN bus, real-time OS); AI/ML (Python, ONNX, PyTorch, Isolation Forest, autoencoders); ground segment (Docker, Grafana, MQTT, Node.js); CI/CD and DevOps (GitHub Actions, automated security scanning, containerized deployments, Prometheus, Fluent Bit).

Job ID 369508

Job.JobTitle: Senior Consultant, Salesforce Data 360 & Marketing AI
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte's AM&C practice is looking for a Senior Consultant who can operate at the intersection of front-office strategy, Salesforce Data 360 architecture, and hands-on AI/engineering delivery. This is not a traditional "oversee and present" consulting role. You will lead client relationships and workstreams, and you'll stay close enough to the technology to configure, build, and troubleshoot alongside your team. You should be equally comfortable running a steering committee conversation with a CMO and sitting in Data Cloud configuring identity resolution rules or tuning an Agentforce workflow.

You'll work on engagements where clients are consolidating fragmented customer data, standing up real-time segmentation and personalization, and introducing agentic AI into marketing, sales, and service operations. They need someone who can translate what the business wants into what actually gets built.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 1, 2027

Work you’ll do

As a Senior Consultant, you’ll lead the design and delivery of data-driven customer experiences that help clients turn customer data into measurable business outcomes. You’ll combine client leadership, hands-on technical delivery, and team development across Salesforce Data 360 and connected marketing technology engagements.

You will:

  • Lead discovery, solution design, and delivery for Salesforce Data 360 and connected marketing technology engagements.
  • Partner with CMOs, marketing leaders, and sales and service operations teams to translate business priorities into scalable data and technology solutions.
  • Architect and configure Data 360 capabilities, including data models, harmonization, identity resolution, calculated insights, segmentation, and activation.
  • Build integrations across Data 360, Marketing Cloud Engagement, Agentforce, and other front-office platforms—and stay hands-on enough to solve issues as they arise.
  • Work directly in the technology, including SQL, APIs/integration patterns, and configuration tooling
  • Bring AI and agentic use cases to life, including next-best action, predictive segmentation, and conversational experiences grounded in trusted customer data.
  • Lead and develop consultants and engineers while contributing to proposals, reusable accelerators, delivery methods, and growth of the Data 360 practice.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth. 

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of relevant experience, including consulting or client-facing delivery experience in marketing technology, CDP, or customer data platforms
  • 3+ years of experience with hands-on implementation experience with Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360): data modeling, identity resolution, calculated insights, activation
  • 2+ years of experience with at least one Salesforce marketing application (Marketing Cloud/Engagement or Agentforce) at a configuration/build level, not just functional familiarity
  • 2+ years of demonstrated front-office domain knowledge: marketing operations, campaign management, customer experience, or sales/service data use cases
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications relevant to Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, or Agentforce
  • Experience with AI/agentic workflow design (prompt design, agent orchestration, model evaluation) in a customer-data context
  • Prior experience in a "forward deployed" or embedded delivery model (for example, rapid prototyping alongside client teams, iterative build-and-feedback cycles)
  • Exposure to adjacent CDP or marketing technology platforms (Adobe Experience Platform, Segment, Tealium) useful for competitive/migration conversations
  • Experience managing or mentoring technical teams in a consulting environment

About this job

Develop, test, and maintain cybersecurity detection rules and queries for client security operations as part of Deloitte's managed services team. Work with threat intelligence and security platforms to identify detection requirements and investigate gaps in threat coverage.

Good fit if you have 2+ years in cybersecurity or security operations, experience with security logs and alerts, and know Python, PowerShell, SQL, KQL, or SPL.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate Offering team, you will be responsible for helping develop, test, tune, and maintain cybersecurity detections that support client security operations.

  • Review threat intelligence, emerging threats, attack techniques, vulnerabilities, and historical incident information to identify detection requirements.
  • Develop, maintain, and update detection rules, queries, signatures, and indicators of compromise for security monitoring platforms.
  • Configure and tune detections; identify false positives; and recommend improvements that maintain effective threat coverage.
  • Test and validate detection rules against known threats and attack scenarios; document test results, configuration changes, and detection logic.
  • Monitor detection performance; investigate gaps or unexpected results; support incident-response research; and collaborate with security operations center analysts, threat hunters, incident responders, Platform Operations Engineers, and client cybersecurity teams.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Computer Engineering.
  • 2+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, threat intelligence, networking, or systems administration.
  • Experience reviewing or analyzing authentication events, network traffic, operating system activity, vulnerability data, security logs, or alerts.
  • Experience using at least one scripting or query language: Python, PowerShell, Structured Query Language (SQL), Kusto Query Language (KQL), or Splunk Processing Language (SPL).
  • Experience documenting technical findings, test results, configuration changes, or detection logic.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience in a security operations center, with security information and event management or endpoint detection and response platforms, or in threat hunting, incident response, or detection engineering.
  • Experience using Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Google Security Operations, Elastic, CrowdStrike, or Microsoft Defender.
  • Experience creating or modifying Sigma rules, YARA rules, Suricata signatures, Kusto Query Language queries, or Splunk Processing Language queries.
  • Experience using Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience using Git, version control systems, detection-as-code practices, or continuous integration/continuous delivery processes.
  • CompTIA Security+, CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+), or Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Foundational Cybersecurity Technologies certification.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $110,700 to $218,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Senior consultant role implementing AI-driven SAP CPQ solutions for Deloitte's customer transformation practice. Lead client projects in automating quote-to-cash processes through intelligent configuration, pricing, and commerce capabilities.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of consulting experience, 2+ years with SAP CPQ, a bachelor's degree, and can travel up to 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI and intelligent automation, transformative technologies, and creative design. We help clients reimagine commerce and configuration for an AI-driven world, automating complex quote-to-cash journeys and replacing manual, rules-heavy processes with intelligent, self-optimizing systems. We enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, AI-powered commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. 

Recruiting for this role ends on December 16, 2026

Work you’ll do

Deloitte Digital offers services that enable client solutions using digital technologies, including the Web, Mobile, Social Networking, Digital Strategy, Digital Content and Digital ERP, with a growing focus on AI-powered commerce and automation.  The Digital Web team works with clients to advise, design, implement and deploy AI-enabled CPQ solutions.  Our CPQ capabilities combine deep configuration expertise with Generative AI and intelligent automation to give clients self-service, no-touch Configure, Price, Quote capabilities that remove friction from the Quote-To-Order and Lead-To-Cash processes and replace manual exception-handling with automated, rules- and AI-driven decisioning.

You are the soothsayer. You have gazed into the future of our clients' businesses, and you see a clear path to success built on intelligent, AI-driven configuration and commerce. You understand what it takes to make complex SAP CPQ solutions happen, how to automate the manual steps out of quote-to-cash, and you'll have a firm hand on the controls every step of the way.

  • Act as a lead on client projects and for junior staff, championing AI-driven and automation-first approaches to CPQ delivery.
  • Help define business requirements and process design (including scenario design and flow mapping), identifying opportunities to automate manual configuration, pricing, and approval workflows with AI and intelligent automation.
  • Create functional designs, prototyping test planning and execution, training coordination, and documentation of operational support procedures for AI-enabled configuration and commerce capabilities.
  • Help clients define forward-looking business strategies related to digital transformation, including the adoption of Generative AI, agentic automation, and intelligent commerce platforms.

The Team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement AI-powered technology platforms for personalized marketing and intelligent commerce across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, intelligent configuration and pricing, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth through automation and AI. 

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience
  • 2+ years of experience working with a major CPQ technology vendor solution, preferably SAP CPQ (Callidus/CallidusCloud) or SAP Commerce Cloud CPQ, including exposure to AI-assisted configuration or automation features
  • Bachelor's Degree, advanced degree preferred
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Interest in or exposure to applying Generative AI and intelligent automation to configuration, pricing, and quote-to-cash processes
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • Proven experience building CPQ and lead-to-cash solutions, ideally incorporating AI-driven guided selling or automated deal desk capabilities
  • Good understanding of Quote-To-Order and Lead-To-Cash processes
  • Good understanding of product structures (made to stock, made to order), configurations, product pricing and quote management
  • Hands-on experience with CPQ configuration including organization, market, currency, simple and configurable products, attributes, compatibility rules, pricing, quote design, proposal documents, and scripting extensions, with exposure to AI-assisted or rules-based automation of configuration logic
  • Experience with software development, scripting, and automation technologies, e.g., Python, .NET, UI5 framework, SQL, and low-code/no-code or RPA tooling
  • An understanding of information architecture related to sales, dealer or customer experience and usability design techniques, and an interest in applying Generative AI and intelligent automation to streamline configuration and commerce workflows
  • Familiarity with AI-powered commerce and CPQ capabilities (e.g., SAP Business AI, generative product recommendations, intelligent guided selling) and automation platforms such as RPA or workflow orchestration tools

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 – $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
