Job.JobTitle: Techno-Functional PLM Consulting Manager - Chemicals/Advanced Materials
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Join Deloitte’s Supply Chain & Network Operations practice and help clients modernize product lifecycle processes through digital transformation. In this role, you’ll work with leading organizations to address complex business and technology challenges, deliver PLM-focused solutions, and create measurable impact across the value chain. If you are energized by solving complex problems, working across teams, and shaping innovative solutions, this role offers the opportunity to grow your career while helping clients build more connected, responsive operations.

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/16/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Techno-functional PLM Consulting Manager on the Supply Chain & Network Operations team, you will be responsible for:

  • Delivering end to end complex Product Lifecycle Management transformations in a fast-paced, team environment
  • Conducting business assessments to identify gaps, build roadmaps, and develop the business case for PLM transformation.
  • Manage workstream leads across functional areas including engineering, quality, regulatory, manufacturing, and IT
  • Drive milestone achievement, status reporting, and steering committee communications
  • Ensure deliverable quality across design, configuration, integration, data migration, and validation workstreams
  • Leading and supporting Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) pursuits and development of practitioners in the product development practice
  • Contributing to knowledge-sharing forums that strengthen Deloitte’s capabilities and support client problem-solving
  • Building experience across current and emerging PLM solutions

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Deep understanding of product development and engineering processes related to the process industries in advanced chemicals, lubricants or advanced materials — BOM management, engineering change control, document management, LIMS/ELN integration, MES integration, CAD/PDM integration, , technical publications, product costing, requirements management,  regulatory management, and product data governance
  • Ability to manage products in complex manufacturing settings—spanning process, hybrid and discrete manufacturing situations
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

You will work closely with operations leaders, plant managers, and IT teams to design and implement solutions that enhance production efficiency, quality, visibility, and traceability across the manufacturing value chain.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 8+ years of experience using, implementing, supporting, or advising on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions
  • Experience in the formulated and process industries in chemicals and/or advanced materials
  • Delivery experience on one or more major industry relevant PLM platforms (Siemens Teamcenter, Dassault Enovia, SAP PLM, Aras, or equivalent)
  • Experience with software development lifecycle activities, including requirements gathering and solution design
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

·    Bachelor’s degree specifically in chemical engineering, mechanical engineering or business

  • Familiarity in product creation and management in regulated industries.
  • 8+ years experience in assisting clients to manage a complex portfolio of products from ideation to commercialization and retirement of products.
  • Experience in consulting or as an internal consultant within a Fortune 500 organization
  • Experience supporting Product Lifecycle Management pursuits or practice development initiatives
  • Experience managing programs in at least one regulated or complex industry: chemicals or advanced materials
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to PLM implementations, such as, ISO 9001:2015, EU REACH, etc.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate SOC L2 Analyst - Senior Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Managed Services Engineer III on the Cyber Operate Offering team, you will be responsible for…

  • Conduct advanced analysis of the results of monitoring solutions, assess escalated outputs and alerts from Level 1 Analysts, and ensure that all identified events are promptly validated and thoroughly investigated.
  • Perform root cause analysis and ad hoc searches related to relevant threat intelligence or emerging threats; assist the Threat Hunting team with advanced investigations as needed; and perform continuous monitoring of new threat sources and intel.
  • Analyze network data (e.g., packets and logs) and endpoint data (e.g., logs and malicious artifacts) using SIEM and various tools; analyze malware (executables, scripts, and documents) to determine indicators of compromise; and create signatures for future detection of similar samples.
  • Advise on development of detection engineering content and testing; provide guidance on response action plans for information risk events and incidents based on incident type and severity; and provide end-to-end event analysis, incident detection, and escalations to Shift Lead/Engineering/SDMs and SOC Manager using documented procedures.
  • When necessary, and with the SOC Manager’s approval, devise and document new procedures and runbooks/playbooks; comply with and update processes, runbooks, templates, and procedures based on experience and best practice; track and report SOC SLAs; maintain individual certifications and learning requirements; and assist Shift Leads and fulfill Shift Lead responsibilities in their absence.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients’ critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
  • 2+ years of experience in cybersecurity or security operations
  • Experience in security technologies such as: Security information and event management (SIEM), IDS/IPS, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Proxy, Web Application Firewall (WAF), Endpoint detection and response (EDR), Anti-Virus, Sandboxing, network- and host-based firewalls, Threat Intelligence, Penetration Testing, etc.
  • Knowledge of Advanced Persistent Threats (APT) tactics, techniques, and procedures; understanding of possible attack activities such as network probing/scanning, DDOS, malicious code activity, etc.
  • Understanding of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, and HTTP; knowledge in system security architecture and security solutions
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Work shifts on a rotating basis for 24/7 support of clients and work 50% of time from a Deloitte office.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience with threat hunting, detection engineering and vulnerability management
  • Programming experience in one or more languages
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certification in Certified Intrusion Analyst (GIAC), Continuous Monitoring (GMON), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) or equivalent

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our AI & Engineering team helps transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and deliver meaningful impact for clients. In this role, you will work with professionals who are reimagining and reengineering business-critical operations and processes. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, launch new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Delivery Consultant, Software Engineering Solutions on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for:

  • Assist development teams in delivering technical solutions using software development life cycle methodologies, including Scrum and Agile
  • Design, develop, and enhance software systems and custom components using modern development tools and frameworks
  • Analyze user requirements, system flows, data usage, and performance standards to define technical designs and identify problem areas
  • Integrate existing software into new or modified systems and develop and execute test procedures for software components
  • Plan, track, and manage deliverables across short-term sprints and long-term software deployments

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines

The team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Engineering as a Service offering provides end-to-end design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We help transform engineering teams, modernize technology, & deliver complex programs with a product engineering mindset. Our flexible delivery models— traditional teams, pools, or pods, are tailored for each client’s needs, offering engineering-led Advise, Implement, & Operate capabilities to accelerate innovation.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or Management Information Systems
  • 3+ years of full-stack software development experience 
  • 3+ years of experience with Modern Full Stack languages (Java, Python, React, Angular, etc.)
  • Experience orchestrating in cloud and/or serverless environments
  • Experience with Relational and Non-relational DBs (Postgres, SQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.)
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Active Top Secret security clearance

Preferred:

  • Experience with Gen AI, Agentic AI, ML/NLP environments and tools
  • Major Cloud provider certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI)
  • AI related certifications (Anthropic, Github, etc.)

Job.JobTitle: AWS Cloud Engineer - Software Engineering Solutions - Top Secret Clearance
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

 

Work You’ll Do

As a Center Delivery Consultant, Software Engineering Solutions on the HCI team, you will join the infrastructure team supporting a new unified importer identity and onboarding platform — providing full visibility across every importer entity and individual applying on its behalf, all running on AWS.

You'll design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure for identity verification, biometric matching, and ACE Portal integration, working alongside developers, identity/policy specialists, and stakeholders through Release 1, Release 2, and ongoing O&M. You will work on core AWS infrastructure supporting a mobile identity-verification app, Salesforce orchestration, and ACE Portal integration, as well as biometric/identity services, including hosting and scaling Iprove (facial recognition/liveness) within AWS environment. In addition, integration infrastructure connecting to ATS/NVC (vetting), Salesforce, and ACE. Environments supporting Release 1 (Year 1 launch) and Release 2 running in parallel with steady-state O&M. Security infrastructure supporting the ATO process — access controls, audit logging, encryption for a system handling PII and biometric data. Scheduling/appointment infrastructure for background check and fingerprinting workflows, if in scope.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and maintain AWS infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across two concurrent release tracks. Configure networking, IAM, and security groups per federal requirements
  • Stand up and scale compute for biometric/ML workloads under real onboarding volume
  • Implement monitoring/logging/alerting (CloudWatch) to support O&M
  • Support integration between AWS-hosted services, Salesforce, ATS/NVC, and ACE
  • Support ATO documentation and audits (access control evidence, data flow diagrams, encryption, vulnerability scanning)
  • Collaborate with identity/policy stakeholders on credentialing infrastructure. Support patching, tuning, and capacity planning as the platform scales

A successful candidate would possess:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

 

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Active Top Secret clearance
  • 3+ years of experience building/operating production AWS infrastructure. 
  • 3+ years of experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar). 
  • 3+ years of experience working with AWS core services: VPC, IAM, EC2/ECS/Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch. 
  • 3+ years of experience integrating with third-party or legacy government systems, such as federal security/compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, NIST 800-53, ATO). 
  • 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tooling and automated deployment. 
  • Reside a commutable distance to Deloitte office in Gilbert, AZ, Mechanicsburg, PA, or Lake Mary, FL
  • Able to travel up to 10%

Preferred:

  • 2+ years of experience with CBP, DHS, or other federal law-enforcement systems
  • 2+ years of experience supporting systems through an ATO process

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Manager, Functional Transformation on the Moveworks team, you will be responsible for leading AI-powered employee experience engagements across implementation, expansion, and optimization efforts for Fortune 500 clients.

  • Lead multiple Moveworks engagements across implementation, use case expansion, and platform optimization, including scope, budget, resource, timeline, and risk management
  • Manage and develop consultants and senior consultants through day-to-day coaching, feedback, and performance oversight
  • Serve as a primary project-level client contact for stakeholders across Human Resources, Information Technology, and Information Security
  • Lead workshops, design sessions, and stakeholder reviews to define user journeys, sprint priorities, and configuration decisions for knowledge management, conversational flows, enterprise search, and agentic AI capabilities
  • Oversee integration planning and solution delivery for Moveworks with platforms such as ServiceNow, Workday, and other enterprise systems that support employee service workflows
  • Contribute to business development and practice development activities, including proposals, scoping, client presentations, methodology refinement, and knowledge sharing

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

The team

Our HR Strategy & Technology Offering is dedicated to developing leading global HR strategies and implementing cutting-edge HR technologies. We drive transformation and maximize the workforce experience, ensuring sustained HR effectiveness and value. In a world of disruption, our solutions empower organizations to navigate challenges seamlessly, enhancing their HR capabilities and fostering a resilient workforce.

Our Moveworks Team is dedicated to delivering AI-powered employee experience solutions that help clients transform their HR and IT service delivery practices. We drive significant cost savings, increased efficiency, a stronger competitive advantage, and improved employee experience through intelligent automation and agentic AI capabilities.

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience implementing enterprise platforms, such as Workday, ServiceNow, or similar systems, including configuration, application programming interface (API) integrations, testing, and deployment

  • 3+ years of experience with Moveworks platform configuration, Agent Studio, or similar conversational artificial intelligence platforms

Job ID 369406

Job.JobTitle: Tax Manager, Global Employer Services - M&A
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Looking for a role where your expertise in executive compensation and benefits can influence high-stakes business decisions? Join Deloitte Tax LLP’s Global Employer Services (GES) Rewards – M&A team, advising clients through complex transactions and helping them navigate the compensation, benefits, equity, and tax considerations that can shape deal outcomes. You’ll lead impactful M&A work, partner with senior stakeholders and deal teams, and translate complex tax requirements into practical solutions—while expanding your technical expertise, leadership skills, and career within a collaborative, nationally connected practice.

Recruiting for this role will end on May 31, 2027.

Work you'll do

As a Deloitte Tax Manager on the Global Employer Services, Rewards - M&A team, you will be responsible for:

Due Diligence – Compensation & Benefits

  • Conduct comprehensive tax due diligence on all compensation, benefits, retirement, and equity programs of target companies.
  • Review plan documents, employment agreements, and incentive arrangements for compliance with relevant tax laws (e.g., Section 409A, Section 162(m)), plan qualification, and reporting requirements.
  • Assess risks and opportunities related to deferred compensation, stock options, health and welfare benefits, retirement plans, and global mobility arrangements.
  • Prepare findings and recommendations for deal teams and senior leadership, highlighting areas of tax exposure, compliance gaps, and integration challenges.

IRC Section 280G (“Golden Parachute”) Analysis

  • Identify and analyze executive employment agreements, change-in-control provisions, and severance arrangements for Section 280G implications.
  • Quantify potential excise tax liabilities and prepare 280G calculations, including safe harbor analyses and mitigation strategies.
  • Advise deal teams on structuring and negotiating executive compensation to minimize 280G-related risks and costs.
  • Support shareholder approval processes and documentation for 280G mitigation.

Compliance & Regulatory Oversight

  • Ensure all rewards programs comply with relevant tax laws and regulations, including IRC Section 280G, Section 409A, Section 162(m), FICA, and global tax requirements.
  • Monitor and mitigate risks related to tax reporting, withholding, and plan qualification.
  • Maintain documentation for all tax-related M&A rewards activities.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

At Deloitte Tax LLP, our Global Employer Services Rewards professionals help clients design and manage compensation and rewards programs for their global workforce. The practice advises on rewards strategy, compensation structures, benchmarking, and related tax and regulatory considerations to support effective business and talent outcomes. Learn more about Deloitte Tax Global Employer Services.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that requires US Tax professionals to co-locate in person 2 – 3 days per week
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, accounting, human resources, information systems, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in executive compensation, including relevant consulting and in-house corporate experience with demonstrated knowledge of tax rules related to compensation and benefits programs (162(m), 280G, 409A, 401(k), etc)
  • Ability to travel up to 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
  • One of the following active accreditations: 
    • Licensed Certified Public Accountant (CPA) in state of practice/primary office
    • If not CPA eligible:
      • Licensed Attorney
      • Enrolled Agent (EA)
      • Certified Executive Compensation Professional (CECP)
      • Certified Equity Professional (CEP)
      • Global Professional in Human Resources (GPHR)
      • Certified Employee Benefits Specialist (CEBS)
      • Certified Pension Consultant (CPC)
      • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP)
      • Project Management Professional (PMP)

Preferred:

  • Strong analytical, consultative, quantitative, and project management skills
  • Attention to detail with a focus on quality, consistently meeting deadlines and achieving results
  • Proficiency in Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, Word. Qualtrics is a plus
  • Strong communication (verbal & written) and presentation skills 
  • Capable of working within large, complex engagements and able to work efficiently and with a sense of urgency
  • An aptitude for working as part of a global team with diverse members
  • Leadership skills in managing client relationships and the ability to develop customized solutions to meet client needs with the ability to prioritize tasks, work on multiple assignments, and manage assignments in a team environment

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $226,125.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

About this job

Senior Consultant role designing and implementing real-time, omnichannel customer journeys in Adobe Journey Optimizer. You will configure journey orchestration, channel surfaces, decisioning, and integrations with Adobe Experience Platform to support personalized engagement across email, SMS, push, and in-app channels.

Good fit if you have 3+ years hands-on Adobe Journey Optimizer implementation experience and 5+ years in marketing technology with API-first configuration and CI/CD practices.

Full job description

Position Summary

As a Senior Consultant supporting Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), you will help clients design and implement real-time, omnichannel customer journeys that power personalized engagement across email, SMS, push, and in-app channels. In this role, you will bring together journey orchestration, campaign configuration, decisioning, and platform integration to support activation across digital touchpoints. You will work across business and technical teams to translate requirements into practical, high-quality solutions that drive customer and commercial outcomes.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 18, 2026

Work you'll do

As an Adobe Journey Optimize architect, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing and configuring end-to-end customer journeys in Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), including triggers, actions, messages, offers, and journey orchestration logic
  • Building rules and conditional logic to orchestrate complex, multi-step journeys based on customer attributes, behaviors, and real-time events
  • Configuring AJO channel surfaces, including email, SMS, push notification, and in-app messaging, along with email subdomains, IP pools, and IP warming strategies
  • Integrating AJO with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), including Real-Time Customer Data Platform (RT-CDP) and Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), to support unified profiles, audience activation, and cross-channel measurement
  • Implementing Journey Optimizer Decisioning (AJO-D) and Offer Decisioning capabilities, including offer collections, placements, decision scopes, and eligibility and prioritization rules, to enable contextual, real-time personalization
  • Leading integration and solution delivery across Adobe Experience Cloud, third-party systems, and client stakeholder groups during implementation, technical design, and pre-sales activities

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey — AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of hands-on implementation experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), including journey orchestration, triggers, automations, actions, messages, and offers
  • 2+ years configuring AJO channel surfaces (email, SMS, push, in-app), including email subdomain setup, IP pool creation, and IP warming/deliverability strategy
  • 2+ years working with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), including Experience Data Model (XDM) schemas, Real-Time Customer Data Platform (RT-CDP), and Web/Mobile SDK or Edge Network event forwarding to support AJO journey triggers
  • Experience configuring external data sources, custom events, and custom actions within AJO to support complex, attribute- and behavior-driven journeys
  • 5+ years in customer data, marketing technology, or digital campaign management with application programming interface (API)-first configuration, Git, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), environment promotion, automated validation, production monitoring, and runbooks
  • Strong understanding of business domains, data models, and marketing campaign strategy, with the ability to translate functional requirements into technical journey designs
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer Decisioning (AJO-D) and Offer Decisioning (OD), including offer collections, placements, decision scopes, and eligibility/prioritization rules
  • Adobe Certified Expert or Adobe Certified Professional credential in Journey Optimizer, Experience Platform, or a related Adobe Experience Cloud product
  • Experience with emerging AJO/AEP artificial intelligence capabilities, including AJO Experimentation, CX AI/Agent Orchestrator, and AEP AI Assistant
  • Experience with cloud data platforms, including Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience with digital marketing analytics and Customer Journey Analytics (CJA)
  • Programming or scripting experience in Python, Java, SQL, or Bash
  • Experience integrating marketing technology, advertising technology, and data integration tools, including Adobe, Salesforce, Oracle, Google, MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Segment, Tealium, or custom APIs
  • Experience training or leading offshore or nearshore delivery teams in a Global Delivery model
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a technical field

Full job description

Position Summary

As a Capital Markets Transactions (CMT) – Manager within our Accounting & Reporting Assurance offering, you will oversee day-to-day operations of IPO, SPAC, and other CMT advisory engagements. You'll closely work with the team to tackle accounting, reporting and other issues, while using our cutting-edge tools and technology. The work you’ll do

We are seeking professionals who want to build off their IPO and transactions experience to oversee complex engagements related to IPO/SPAC readiness and execution as well as other transactions and technical accounting projects. This individual will manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, providing technical guidance, project oversight, and cross-functional coordination to ensure high-quality delivery to our clients.   • Services implementing corporate governance structures, streamlined close, consolidate report
  • Ability to oversee multiple workstreams concurrently, ensuring alignment, timely execution, and adherence to project objectives.

  • Ability to develop, maintain and leverage internal contacts across Deloitte businesses.
  • Be an advisor to newly public and private clients to assist with accounting and financial reporting, among other areas.
  • Stay connected to market trends to think through future innovative solutionprocesses, consideration of investor relations, human capital, and operational improvements

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

Job.JobTitle: Vice President, Sales Executive – Products/ Zora AI – C_MAT
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte’s business through new AI native platforms and products The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.

A core focus of this role is Zora AI by Deloitte, Deloitte’s Agentic Platform for the modern business. Zora AI by Deloitte enables enterprise organizations across all industries to make faster, more precise, and more customer-obsessed decisions aided by AI. The platform combines enterprise grade concepts with leading edge AI capabilities in a subscription-based AI platform to support repeatable, scalable decisions across Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, Information Technology and other enterprise activities.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.

Work you’ll do

Deloitte Consulting is seeking a high-performing VP Sales Executive to drive new client adoption and growth of product revenue for Zora AI by Deloitte as a product suite. This leader will be responsible for originating, shaping, and closing product-led engagements across the portfolio.

This role is also critical for feedback to shape and improve the products in the portfolio. The VP Sales Executive role requires a commercially driven executive with a strong background in enterprise data sales, competitive data environments, consultative solution selling, and executive-level relationship development.

Sales Leadership

  • Shape and sell annual recurring revenue deals across the Zora AI product suite.
  • Serve as a leader for feedback to shape product development, product marketing, and pricing the Zora AI portfolio.
  • Develop and execute account-based sales strategies aligned to priority Zora AI by Deloitte accounts.
  • Expand sales opportunities for Zora AI products.
  • Lead end-to-end sales cycles: origination, qualification, shaping, pricing, negotiation, and close.

Market Expansion

  • Identify whitespace opportunities within existing Deloitte accounts.
  • Open new logo opportunities.
  • Position Zora AI as a strategic transformation platform, not just a point solution.

Executive Engagement

  • Build C-suite and SVP-level relationships.
  • Collaborate with Partners, Market Makers, Product Leads, and Pursuit Teams to align offerings with priority client opportunities and growth agendas.
  • Articulate ROI, value realization, and measurable business outcomes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Zora AI by Deloitte leaders, industry account teams, and product teams.
  • Provide structured pipeline visibility and forecast accuracy.
  • Find, secure and direct talent internally or externally to produce compelling content like product demos, PowerPoint overviews, and other sales collateral.
  • Coach and support team members on effective client engagement and market maker interactions.
  • Increase Offering Portfolio, Industry, and field awareness of Zora AI by Deloitte product capabilities and differentiation through targeted enablement efforts.
  • Capture field insights, client feedback, and market learnings and feed them into ongoing product improvement cycles.

The successful candidate will possess:

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across both business and technical audiences, including senior executives, Partners, product leaders, and engineers.
  • Proven communication and storytelling skills, including experience presenting to executive audiences and structuring complex ideas into clear, actionable narratives.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with experience managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated interest in developing deep expertise in Zora AI by Deloitte products or prior experience working with Zora AI or similar Enterprise grade platforms.
  • Demonstrated willingness and ability to contribute to both strategic planning and hands-on execution.
  • Demonstrated track record of client leadership, selling, and deal shaping

The Team

The I&DT team collaborates closely with Industries, Offering Portfolios, Growth, and Delivery Transformation to curate and scale the Zora AI by Deloitte portfolio, drive Strategic Growth Offerings, and translate differentiated product capabilities into compelling client outcomes. The team also plays a central role in incubating next-generation technologies through Deloitte’s Technology Offices and leading the firm’s Tech Talent Transformation. Innovation & Delivery Transformation is part of Deloitte Consulting Services and brings an engineering-, product-, and platform-oriented mindset to everything it does. The team helps Deloitte organize for rapid innovation, expand how technology is built and commercialized, and support clients as they navigate disruption in an increasingly data- and AI-driven consumer economy.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 10+ years of professional experience in data or product selling, solution development, product commercialization, or related roles within enterprise software, analytics platforms, data provider, or management consulting.
  • Ability to travel 0-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Demonstrated commercial experience with technology products or platforms, including product marketing, go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, pricing and packaging, or commercialization of analytics, data, or AI-driven products.
  • Familiarity with enterprise systems and platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, and supply chain, merchandising, or marketing technology platforms

The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $171,600.00 to $338,300.00.

Job.JobTitle: Oracle OCI Delivery Senior Consultant, Configuration and Integration Solutions
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Lake Mary, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Deliver Oracle Database administration and cloud infrastructure solutions for government clients as part of Deloitte's Enterprise Performance team. Manage Oracle Database 19c/23c environments on OCI, implement high-availability and disaster-recovery systems, and automate operations using Terraform, Ansible, and Python.

Good fit if you have 5+ years Oracle Database administration experience, 2+ years OCI hands-on experience, active Secret Clearance, and CompTIA Security+ certification.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart-of-the-business solutions.


Work you'll do

As a Delivery Senior Consultant, Configuration and Integration Solutions on the Cloud Database Operations team, you will be responsible for:

  • Administering and optimizing Oracle Database 19c/23c environments across OCI DB Systems, Exadata Cloud Service, and Autonomous Database platforms
  • Managing OCI-based container database and pluggable database environments, including provisioning, cloning, patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and resource management
  • Implementing and supporting high-availability and disaster-recovery capabilities using Recovery Manager (RMAN), Oracle Data Guard, and cross-region OCI architectures
  • Troubleshooting database, compute, storage, networking, connectivity, and OCI resource issues, including Automatic Workload Repository (AWR), Active Session History (ASH), and SQL performance tuning
  • Automating OCI database administration using Terraform, Ansible, OCI Command Line Interface (CLI), Bash, and Python, while maintaining runbooks and operational documentation

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Oracle offering drives business transformation services to improve performance and value delivered by the full suite of Oracle solutions.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

  
Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Have an Active Secret Clearance
  • Active CompTIA Security+ certification
  • 5+ years of Oracle Database administration experience, including Oracle Database 19c/23c and multitenant container database and pluggable database architecture
  • 2+ years of hands-on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure experience, including virtual cloud networks, subnets, Identity and Access Management, compartments, storage, and security services
  • Experience administering Oracle Database environments on OCI DB Systems, Exadata Cloud Service, and Autonomous Database
  • Experience implementing or supporting Recovery Manager, Oracle Data Guard, and disaster recovery architectures
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting production, mission-critical workloads
  • Cloud IAM Strategy and Assurance: Foundation certification
  • Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW): Foundation certification
  • Oracle Cloud GoldenGate: Foundation certification
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect: Foundation certification
  • Terraform: Foundation certification

Salesforce Life Sciences Lead Technical Architect

Our Deloitte Sales & Service team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.

  • Perform proactive referral generation based on external data, such as government furnished reports and open source information, such as social media. 
  • Develop fraud referrals for presentation to the client, law enforcement, and other government agencies.

Leverages deep domain expertise to extend enterprise resilience, agility and remediation. Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate Senior Manager- Detect and Respond
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Are you passionate about leading the frontline defense against today's most sophisticated cyber threats – both known and unknown? Do you want to own and evolve an advanced operational threat defense capability, grounded in evidence-based knowledge of the threat landscape, that safeguards client data and is delivered to some of the world's leading organizations – not just as a project, but as an ongoing, mission-critical service? Are you energized by building high-performing teams, driving strategy for a growing service line, and being accountable for the outcomes that keep our clients secure?

If yes, then Deloitte's Cyber Detect and Respond team could be the place for you! Deloitte's Cyber Detect and Respond business is focused on enabling change to expand the scope of threat monitoring and managed Security Operations Center (SOC) services, helping organizations adapt to emerging infrastructural change and deliver lasting impact. Running our industry-leading managed services requires significant expertise, sound business judgment, and strong leadership of diverse, distributed teams.

We collaborate with teams from across our organization to bring the full breadth of Deloitte – its commercial and public sector expertise – to best support our clients. Our aspiration is to be the premier integrated services provider in helping to transform the cyber security services marketplace. Our team is client focused and mission driven. As an Associate Vice President (AVP) in Cyber Detect and Respond, you will own the delivery, strategy, and financial performance of managed SOC engagements, leading teams of managers and analysts – onshore and offshore – to solve some of today's toughest cybersecurity and organizational challenges.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an AVP, Engineering Managed Services on the Cyber Detect and Respond team, you will be responsible for…

    - Lead end-to-end managed Security Operations Center (SOC) delivery for assigned clients, including service-level agreement performance, service quality, protection of sensitive client data, and continuous improvement of detection and response capabilities

    - Translate current threat intelligence into detection logic, use cases, response playbooks, and client reporting; expand coverage for known and novel threats through User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) and anomaly-based detection

    - Set and execute roadmaps for Cyber Detect and Respond services, including delivery-model evolution, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) modernization, cloud migrations, automation, and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) capabilities

    - Lead managers and analysts across onshore and offshore teams; oversee performance, development, escalation management, and complex incident investigation, mitigation, and remediation

    - Own engagement financial performance and governance, including margin, utilization, staffing, forecasting, executive reporting, account planning, client relationships, growth opportunities, and Deloitte engagement-management requirements

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

    - Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

    - Effective written and verbal communication skills

    - Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

    - Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

    - Ability to lead projects or workstreams

    - Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

    - Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

    - Ability to meet deadlines

    - Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

    - Deloitte’s Cyber Operate team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive Secure.Vigilant.Resilient.™ cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions.

Qualifications

Required:

    - 10+ years of experience in security monitoring, security engineering, or security analytics, including experience leading managed Security Operations Center (SOC) or detection and response services

    - 10+ years of experience leading cybersecurity managed-services delivery, Security Operations Center operations, or cybersecurity transformation programs with responsibility for client delivery, staffing, financial management, executive reporting, account planning, solution design, proposal development, pricing, or contracting

    - Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, information security, mathematics, decision sciences, risk management, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or industrial engineering

    - Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

    - Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

    - Experience building or scaling a cybersecurity service-delivery model, including workforce planning across onshore and offshore teams

    - Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Continuous Monitoring Certification (GMON), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) certification

    - Experience with one or more of the following technologies: Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Intrusion Detection Systems/Intrusion Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), proxy platforms, Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), anti-virus tools, sandboxing, network- and host-based firewalls, penetration-testing tools, or technologies used to identify Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs)

    - Experience operationalizing threat intelligence by converting evidence-based research on existing and emerging threats into detection content, use cases, and client advisories

    - Experience operating on-premises and cloud-based SIEM environments and Security Operations Center processes, including User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) capabilities

    - Experience applying data-protection practices throughout security detection and investigation activities, and experience investigating network probing/scanning, Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks, and malicious-code activity across network infrastructure devices and protocols

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Tampa, FL

About this job

Director role leading enterprise data management strategy and capabilities across the global Deloitte network. Responsible for master data management, metadata management, data quality, and taxonomy programs, working across business executives, architects, and technology teams to establish scalable data governance and trusted data assets.

Good fit if you have 12+ years in enterprise data management, 7+ years leading global teams, and experience with data governance tools and federated organizations.

Full job description

Position Summary

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

The Director, Data Management Capabilities & AI Readiness is responsible for defining and leading the strategy, operating model, and delivery of enterprise data management capabilities.  The role is the business owner for cross-domain data management capabilities that serve the Deloitte network, including Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, Data Quality, Taxonomy Management, Reference Data, and Data Modeling.

Working across global applications, business functions, architecture teams, product organizations, and operational teams, the Director will establish scalable data management capabilities, drive adoption of enterprise standards and procedures, and develop trusted data assets for business operations, analytics, AI, regulatory compliance, and decision-making.

This leader serves as a key connector between business executives, application owners, enterprise architects, operations leaders, and technology teams, aligning diverse stakeholder perspectives and driving consensus on complex data management decisions across a global organization. This role is expected to establish measurable outcomes, monitor performance, and continuously evolve enterprise data management capabilities to an aligned target state and maturity model that the role will also define and govern.

The DSGO is responsible for building an integrated strategy and operating model to manage global data and AI products across their lifecycle, enabling better business outcomes, innovation, and client service.

Key responsibilities

1. Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute the data management strategy for:
    • Master Data Management
    • Metadata Management
    • Ontology and Context Management
    • Data Quality
    • Taxonomy and Reference Data
    • Enterprise Data Models
  • Develop multi-year roadmaps that align to business priorities, digital transformation objectives, and AI enablement goals.
  • Establish and evolve enterprise operating models, governance forums, stewardship structures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Champion the importance of trusted, governed data as a strategic enterprise asset.
  • Lead a global team of data management professionals and subject matter experts.

2. Data Management Operating Model Development

  • Design and implement sustainable operating models supporting global and regional data domains.
  • Define roles, responsibilities, decision rights, escalation paths, and governance forums.
  • Build effective collaboration models between:
    • Business teams
    • Application owners
    • Product teams
    • Enterprise Architecture
    • Operations teams
    • Data and analytics functions
  • Establish service delivery models that enable consistent execution across multiple geographies and applications.
  • Drive adoption of standardized data management processes for, metadata, data quality, data architecture, taxonomy, and data quality remediation.

3. Master Data & Reference Data Management

  • Lead enterprise master data governance programs across key domains such as Customer, Vendor, Products, and People.
  • Define authoritative sources, golden record strategies, hierarchy management approaches, and lifecycle management approaches.
  • Establish data management practices for reference data and shared enterprise dimensions.
  • Partner with business and technology leade

    The team

    Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.



    Qualifications

    Key Qualifications:

    • Bachelor's degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Data Management, Business, or related discipline.  Master's degree preferred.
    • 12+ years of experience in enterprise data management, data governance, data architecture, or related disciplines.
    • 7+ years leading global teams and enterprise-scale transformation initiatives.
    • Proven leadership of master data, metadata, data quality, taxonomy, or data governance programs as the voice of the business with technical teams, particularly for cross-domain data assets.  Experience with data governance tools such as Informatica, SAP MDG, Collibra, Databricks Unity Catalog, etc.
    • Experience establishing operating models and governance frameworks across multiple business units and geographies. Experience working closely with application and operations teams in large, federated organizations.
    • Confident communicator with the ability to engage effectively with executive leadership teams.  Able to translate complex data concepts into business outcomes.
    • Ability to build strong relationships across organizational boundaries, acting as a trusted advisor to executives, business leaders, architects, product teams, and internal customers represented across multiple geographies.
    • Demonstrated experience navigating politically complex environments and skilled at facilitating alignment where competing objectives exist, to successfully balance enterprise objectives with individual stakeholder requirements.
    • Connects enterprise data capabilities to business strategy, operational effectiveness, and AI enablement by establishing measurable outcomes and accountability structures.
    • Drives execution through governance, influence, and disciplined delivery management leading direct reports and dotted line teams.



    Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Position Summary

We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don’t miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026

The team

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

Roles and Responsibilities

This role works with clients to transform their product portfolios and value chains across industries where physical products are increasingly software-defined. 

•Strategy & Blueprint Design: Architect end-to-end AI and agentic solutions for product portfolio strategy, demand forecasting, and product lifecycle management. Products across every industry — automotive, industrial equipment, electronics, consumer goods, and even formulation-based products are becoming software-defined, as embedded sensing, digital twins, and AI-driven formulation turn physical goods into data-generating, continuously optimized platforms. This role designs the agentic enablement that spans hardware, software, and formulation-based product development from concept through production.

•Portfolio & Complexity Strategy: Lead data harmonization, platform clustering, and product rationalization efforts that quantify the cost and reward of complexity across sprawling product portfolios, and translate those decisions into agentic architectures — coordinated networks of specialized agents that execute the resulting strategy at scale.

•Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with business leaders (CTO, COO, CPO, VP of Supply Chain or Operations) and technical teams to translate strategic goals into system requirements.

•Data Integration: Oversee how data flows across enterprise platforms, including ERP, SAP, PLM, ALM and cloud data lakes.

•Governance & Visibility: Design governance frameworks that give executives real-time visibility into AI and agentic systems, ensuring they remain secure, compliant, cost-effective, and scalable from pilot through production.

•Network & Complexity Reduction: Apply agentic optimization to development, distribution, manufacturing operations, and supporting product networks, and drive end-to-end transformation of configure-to-order and engineer-to-order processes to reduce complexity and accelerate cycle times.

Required Qualifications

•10+ years consulting experience

•3+ years Agentic AI experience

•Platform engineering experience

•Software defined product experience

•Data integration experience 

•Bachelor’s Degree

•Ability to travel up to 50%, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. 

•Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred Qualifications

•Digital twin experience

•Bachelor’s Degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Software Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Analytics, or Computer Science

•Prior Consulting experience

•Pre-sales experience

•Experience leading a project team in a project client environment. 

•Experience with  product portfolio strategy, supply chain planning, procurement, strategic sourcing, or product development workflows — including configure-to-order and engineer-to-order processes — across industrial, chemicals, consumer products, automotive, or discrete manufacturing settings.

•Experience  with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), data pipelines, Python, and machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI tools.

About this job

Consultant supporting healthcare supply chain transformation and data analytics for Deloitte's Supply Chain & Network Operations team. Responsibilities include spend analysis, supplier research, requirements development, and process improvement to strengthen healthcare procurement operations.

Good fit if you have 2+ years in healthcare supply chain or procurement, plus 2+ years with data analysis tools like Power BI, SQL, or Excel.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart-of-the-business solutions.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/01/2026.

Work You’ll Do

As a Consultant, Healthcare Supply Chain & Data Analytics on the Supply Chain & Network Operations team, you will be responsible for…

  • Supporting requirements development activities that accelerate Medical/Surgical Prime Vendor product list coverage and improve sourcing outcomes
  • Performing spend, supplier, inventory, and procurement performance analysis to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for operational improvement
  • Conducting supplier research, market research, and data validation activities to support acquisition-ready requirements packages and sourcing strategies
  • Assisting with process improvement and governance efforts that strengthen data quality, workflow execution, and supply chain decision-making
  • Collaborating with client stakeholders and cross-functional teams to support transformation initiatives within healthcare supply chain and procurement operations

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

 The Team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Supply Chain & Network Operations offering advises, implements, and operates transformational solutions that bring world class supply network capabilities.

 Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 2+ years of experience in healthcare supply chain, sourcing, procurement, contracting, category management, or medical/surgical purchasing
  • 2+ years of experience supporting data analysis, business intelligence, or reporting using tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, Microsoft Excel, or Visual Basic for Applications (VBA)
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Ability to be onsite 2 days a week at the nearest Deloitte office.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred: 

  • 2+ years of experience in healthcare supply chain, sourcing, procurement, contracting, category management, or medical/surgical purchasing
  • 2+ years of experience supporting data analysis, business intelligence, or reporting using tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, Microsoft Excel, or Visual Basic for Applications (VBA)
  • 2+ years of experience supporting business requirements development, process improvement, operational transformation, or data governance activities
  • 2+ years of experience conducting spend analysis, supplier analysis, inventory analysis, market research, or procurement performance analysis
  • Experience applying the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) in acquisition, sourcing, or contracting support activities
  • 2+ years of experience in federal health

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Life Sciences CRM Global Delivery Lead

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers. This includes supporting their marketing, sales, and service organizations. Post sales activities including service, customer success and professional services is growing in importance because of the role it plays in customer retention and expansion. Across a number of industries including High-Tech, Media, and Energy, Professional Services and Customer Success is becoming a pressing need.

Recruiting for this role ends on November 30, 2026.

Work you'll do

As a Life Sciences CRM Global Delivery Lead Senior Manager, you will lead global delivery management with CRM platform expertise, ensuring end‑to‑end execution of CRM solutions across multiple and complex Salesforce transformations for biopharma and medtech clients across commercial, patient services, and field excellence. You will shape business strategy, lead requirements and process design, and guide cross-functional teams through delivery and adoption. You will drive business development activities, craft proposals, and develop practitioners while promoting leading practices in compliance, data privacy, and regulated industry controls.

The Team

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 10+ years in consulting or industry delivering CRM/engagement platforms for life sciences (biopharma or medtech).
  • 7+ years delivering go to market strategy operations in the Life Sciences Industry.
  • 5+ years in Global delivery governance managing clients, stakeholders and vendors across multiple time zones.
  • Bachelor’s degree (BA or BS) or 4 additional years of professional experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • 2+ years implementing Health Cloud or patient services solutions (e.g., case management, benefits/eligibility, prior authorization, care management).
  • 2+ years in commercial pharma functional domains (e.g., call planning, territory alignment, consent management, sampling/compliance).
  • 2+ years integrating Salesforce with MDM, data, or analytics platforms (e.g., OpenData or Reltio for HCP/HCO, Snowflake, Tableau/CRM Analytics) from a functional perspective (requirements, testing, adoption).
  • 2+ years applying Agile delivery practices (Scrum/SAFe), including backlog grooming, sprint ceremonies, and release planning using tools such as Jira.
  • 1+ years experience implementing privacy/security controls for HCP/patient data (e.g., HIPAA, state privacy laws) in Salesforce.
