Full job description

Position Summary

M&A Human Capital Due Diligence Senior Consultant  

Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. We offer comprehensive end-to-end support and advisory services, covering areas such as valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. The team works closely with clients at every stage of their journey, helping them navigate challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and implement practical solutions before, during, and after major transformational projects or transactions creating lasting impact.

Join our M&A Human Capital Due Diligence team to help clients navigate the people, organization, and workforce implications of complex transactions—where strategic insight can shape deal value from day one. As a Senior Consultant, you’ll work alongside experienced deal professionals and senior stakeholders to turn human capital risks and opportunities into actionable recommendations that enable confident decisions.

Recruitment will end on 12/30/2026

Work You’ll Do

As a Senior Consultant on the M&A Human Capital (HC) Due Diligence (DD) team, you will be responsible for:  

•Deliver Human Capital due diligence engagements that support the development and testing of M&A strategies and deal theses for corporate and private equity clients.

•Assess workforce, organizational, compensation, benefits, human resources (HR) compliance, labor relations, HR operations and technology, talent, and culture considerations in mergers, acquisitions, and other transactions.

•Analyze workforce and HR data, financial information, and transaction documents to identify and quantify transaction risks and opportunities.

•Evaluate HR operating models, workforce structures, and stand-alone costs for integration, separation, and carve-out scenarios.

•Collaborate with Deloitte workstreams, legal counsel, investment banks, and client HR leaders to develop and communicate diligence findings and recommendations.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

•Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

•Effective written and verbal communication skills

•Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

•Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

•Ability to lead projects or workstreams

•Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

•Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

•Ability to meet deadlines

•Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

M&A advises corporate and PE clients across inorganic growth/divestiture scenarios through M&A strategy, diligence, integration/separation planning and execution, financial and modeling services, and transaction financing.

Within M&A Consulting, the Transaction Strategy & Diligence (TS&D) team advises corporate and investor clients on strategic choices before, during, and after transactions. The team helps clients evaluate acquisition and divestiture opportunities, assess market and competitive dynamics, test investment theses, and identify value creation opportunities that support informed deal decisions. By combining strategic insight with transaction experience, the team helps clients move from deal ambition to execution with greater confidence. Within TS&D, our M&A Human Capital Due Diligence team helps clients assess the workforce, organization, leadership, culture, and people-related risks and opportunities that can influence transaction value. 

Qualifications:

Required: 

•Experience supporting or delivering at least 5 Human Capital M&A projects involving restructuring, enterprise cost reduction, due diligence, transaction-risk assessment, target screening, or integration planning and execution.

•4+ years of experience performing Human Capital due diligence and post-deal integration or separation activities, including identifying and quantifying transaction risks and opportunities across compensation, benefits, HR compliance, labor relations, HR communications, HR operations and technology, talent, or culture.

•Experience reviewing financial statements, trial balance details, government filings, employee census data, employment agreements, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), and employee benefit and compensation documentation; preparing data request lists and call agendas; and facilitating interviews with target management.

•Experience conducting compensation benchmarking; individual equity-proceeds analysis, including waterfall analysis or fully diluted share count; benefits comparison and migration-cost analysis; executive compensation reviews; turnover and open-position analysis; HR function stand-alone structure and cost reviews for carve-outs; and employee-related Quality of Earnings and debt-like analyses.

•Bachelor’s degree and 4+ years of consulting or industry experience in financial due diligence, compensation and benefits program design, retirement or health care consulting, HR strategy or operations, or talent solutions; or a Master of Business Administration (MBA) and 2+ years of experience in change management initiatives, communications development, organizational design and development, HR strategy or operations, or talent solutions.

•Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

*You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.

*You can expect to co-locate on average 1-2 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.

*Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred: 

•Master of Business Administration (MBA) or graduate degree in Human Resources or Organizational Behavior.

•Experience supporting workshops, meetings, or presentations for senior leaders.

•Experience managing project plans and delivering work products by deadlines.

•Experience using Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Excel, Tableau, or Structured Query Language (SQL) to prepare analyses and reports.

US-E – Consulting – Lead Integration Engineer II – AI & Engineering/EaaS

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026. 

Work You'll Do:

You will bring considerable technical, functional and leadership experience as part of our Integration Engineering team. You’ll be responsible for leading teams who support the design, development and deployment of large-scale complex software solutions at an enterprise level using your Integration Engineering expertise. Your team will support various applications and the complex programs surrounding these applications including internal consultants, near-shore and off-shore technologists and multiple vendor relationships. You’ll work across geographies, with accountability for the success, effectiveness and delivery of multiple work streams managing a large technology team. You’ll lead planning and budgeting; mobilizing and managing engagement teams; defining deliverable structure and content; facilitating buy-in of proposed solutions from management levels; direct on-time, quality delivery of work; manage technology economics; and risk.

• Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

• Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

Integration Design & Architecture: Design complex integration solutions following industry best practices and leveraging various integration design patterns (e.g., publish/subscribe, request/reply, aggregator). API Management: Design, build, and manage APIs using API Management capabilities, ensuring secure and efficient communication between systems (REST/SOAP).

 Experience with Azure, AWS, and/or GCP

Experience implementing EDI solutions using ANSI X12 and EDIFACT, including transactions such as 810, 850, 855, 856, and 997.

Strong SQL and relational database skills.

Experience with Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, SDLC, automated testing, and production support.

One certification in a cloud technology platform such as AWS, GCP or Azure.

Proficiency in at least one programming language – Spring Boot, JavaScript or Python.

Experience with API governance, event-driven architecture, microservices, integration observability, and cloud modernization.

Experience managing multiple workstreams, vendors, and geographically distributed teams.

Strong client relationship, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.

As a Deloitte Tax Delivery Manager supporting our Global Employer - Japanese services group, you will:

  • Build strong client relationships through clear, thoughtful communication and responsive service.

  • Lead and develop tax professionals by providing coaching, reviewing work, and coordinating assignments across multiple deadlines.
  • Manage engagement timelines, priorities, resources, and budgets to support high-quality client outcomes.
  • Collaborate with engagement leaders and other tax professionals to resolve issues, manage risks, and deliver a consistent client experience.

At Deloitte Tax LLP, our Japanese Services professionals advise high-net-worth individuals and families on complex tax compliance and planning matters. Learn more about Deloitte Tax Global Employer Services.

Required

  • Fluent in both English and Japanese (i.e. bilingual)
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or other relevant discipline
  • 5+ years of experience individual tax compliance and planning, with exposure to high-net-worth individuals
  • Strong technical knowledge of high-net-worth taxation, including experience reviewing complex individual and gift tax returns
  • Demonstrated technical skills including Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, QlikView, and Tableau
  • Ability to travel up to 5% on average based on the work that you do and the clients you support
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • One of the following accreditations obtained:
    • Licensed CPA in state of practice/primary office if eligible to sit for the CPA
    • If not CPA eligible:
      • Licensed Attorney
      • Enrolled Agent

Preferred

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in a related field.
  • Experience serving high-net-worth individuals or private clients.
  • Strong client communication and relationship-management skills.
  • Experience leading, coaching, and developing tax professionals.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint; experience with CCH tax technology or workflow tools is a plus.

Job.JobDescription:

About this job

Senior Consultant supporting public sector health and human services programs, primarily Medicaid, SNAP, and TANF. You will analyze eligibility policies, design case management workflows, and conduct testing to validate system requirements against policy.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of consulting or industry experience in public assistance eligibility and benefits determination systems.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

  • Support analysis and documentation of eligibility policies, business rules, and operational processes for public sector health and human services programs, including Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, and related benefit programs. 
  • Collaborate with eligibility workers, policy staff, and program stakeholders to translate legislation, policy guidance, and operational requirements into system requirements and business processes. 
  • Support eligibility determination design, case management workflows, notices, enrollment processes, interfaces, and program operations within integrated eligibility environments. 
  • Assist with development and execution of user acceptance testing (UAT), scenario-based testing, and validation of eligibility outcomes against policy requirements. 
  • Analyze defects, operational issues, and enhancement requests to identify business impacts and support resolution planning.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

Serving federal, state, and local government clients, as well as public higher education institutions, the team brings experience in strategy, technology, and operations to help clients address complex mission challenges. Within this environment, GPS HST Technology professionals support programs that improve service delivery, operational effectiveness, and constituent outcomes.

Qualifications

  • 5 + years of consulting and/or industry experience
  • Current state public assistance system experience that supports eligibility and benefits determination and case management
  • Experience supporting State client(s) in one or more of the following areas: eligibility determination, benefits calculation, benefits issuance, and/or information management
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Ability to travel 0 - 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Preferred: 
  • Experience supporting Integrated Eligibility and Enrollment (IE&E) systems within Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, CHIP, Child Care, or other public assistance programs. 
  • Experience interpreting federal or state eligibility policy and translating policy requirements into business rules, workflows, and system requirements. 
  • Experience supporting eligibility determination, benefits issuance, case maintenance, renewals, notices, or enrollment functions. 
  • Experience developing test scenarios, expected results, and UAT materials for complex eligibility and enrollment programs. 
  • Experience working directly with eligibility workers, policy teams, and state agency stakeholders. 
  • Familiarity with CMS, HHS, Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, or other human services policy environments.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Engineering Transformation-Strategy Growth and Transformation Technology Senior Manager - AI & Engineering/EaaS

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/15/2026.

Work You'll Do

As a Strategy Growth and Transformation Senior Manager, you are an accomplished Digital Transformation Lead who drives strategic change and delivers exceptional value for commercial sector clients. This role will serve as a trusted advisor to Technology, Operations and Strategy executives, working on complex transformation initiatives. The successful candidate will have deep engineering transformation experience, which includes a strong program delivery foundation and a passion for developing innovative solutions. You will lead globally dispersed teams (primarily across the US, India, and Mexico) to successfully deliver strategy and downstream transformation engagements. You will be part of engagement planning which includes defining deliverables and milestone structure, as well as overseeing engagement delivery which includes managing the team that will build deliverables – it will be your job to ensure the team delivers on time and with high quality. In addition, you will assist in managing engagement risk and on-going engagement economics and managing client expectations proactively. You will serve as a coach for junior practitioners, serving in the role as a “coach” and providing input and guidance into the future staffing needs.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years’ experience in the commercial professional services IT consulting sector working on large scale IT engineering/transformation projects with hands-on depth in technology around application development and custom built applications.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or a related field
  • 5+ years’ experience selling, running and leading large scale transformation programs in a commercial environment with a focus on technology.
  • 10+ years’ experience in technology and operational transformation efforts
  • Experience in operating model transformation, agile delivery, leading global teams across borders
  • A strong understanding of the fundamentals of engineering transformation with the ability to successfully articulate technology concepts to both a business and a technology audience with depth and accuracy.
  • Experience working in a multi-vendor environment and with third parties
  • Extensive team leadership experience which should include managing people, projects, clients and financials.
  • Experience using AI to streamline business processes and create efficiencies.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or at any time in the future.

Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, based on the work you perform and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree, preferably in computer science, information technology, engineering or business
  • Ability to quickly learn and deliver on analogous technologies not previously worked on;
  • Industry recognized technology certifications - AWS, Cloud, Google, Claude and others.

About this job

Vice President leading business development for Deloitte's Health Care Consulting Practice in the Southeast region. Focuses on generating opportunities with health care providers and health plans through direct client engagement and account penetration.

Good fit if you have 10+ years selling complex health care services, strong relationships in the market, and can travel up to 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Are you a top-performing client relationship and solution sales executive looking for your next career move? If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, relevant professional services experience and demonstrate selling attributes, strategies, and techniques you may be interested in an opportunity with our Health Care Consulting Sales team.

Deloitte Consulting’s Health Care Practice serves Health Care Providers and Health Plans across the US with a wide range of strategic, implementation, optimization, and operations solutions and services.

Health Care is a high-growth practice area within Deloitte Consulting, and is the nation’s largest and leading Health Care Consulting Practice. The Health Care Sales Executive role will focus on generating and cultivating opportunities while working closely with our Principals, Managing Director’s, and account team leadership. The position requires extensive Health Care consulting, strategic selling and account development experience. It also requires an understanding in various Health Care services including revenue cycle, core business operations, strategy & analytics, M&A, human capital, ERP, customer and marketing and technology.

Work you’ll do

The Health Care Sales Executive is responsible for calling directly on clients as well as working with our regional, account and service offering leaders. As a Sales Executive you will:

  • Lead business development efforts for the Southeast region
  • Work with our sector PPMD leadership to identify potential clients for targeting
  • Develop an understanding of Deloitte Consulting’s Health Care portfolios and offerings, as well as cross-firm integrated market offerings, to be knowledgeable in our capabilities
  • Understand market segmentation of target clients and potential fit with relevant business processes, technology platforms, market offerings and alliances and ecosystems
  • Develop understanding of target client’s buying patterns based on industry knowledge, relationships, prior experience, etc.
  • Identify and qualify opportunities and stay involved with the sales process to win business in collaboration with appropriate PMD’s. This requires both net new skills as well as growth and penetration skills to grow the client
  • Have executive presence and the ability to develop CXO relationships

Sales Support

  • Run a disciplined sales pipeline including lead management, qualification, bringing established sales methods to the sales process
  • Identify and align appropriate firm resources to pursue, win, and manage opportunities
  • Contribute to pursuit processes by leveraging relationships for insights and influence, including determining “win” themes, aligning messaging with client needs, supporting proposal/orals materials preparation, and participating in the oral’s session as appropriate
  • Provide support to accounts without Client Relationship Executives (CREs) as needed for critical opportunities

Industry Expansion and Relationship Building

  • Collaborate with our Principals, Managing Directors and our technology alliances on messaging, events and eminence - both internal and external
  • Identify ways the Health Care Practice can expand/enhance visibility at key regional and national events and in the market
  • Represent the Health Care Practice at selected events as necessary
  • Utilize Deloitte eminence including thought-ware, events, trainings, conferences, and memberships to build and enhance relationships
  • Utilize available offerings to develop and participate in activities and events focused on shared values and mission, e.g., Deloitte Greenhouse events, Client Experience labs etc.
  • Participate in key industry events to build relationships and develop business opportunities

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team

  • The Client & Market Acceleration Team (CMAT) supports Deloitte’s businesses in uncovering, nurturing, and closing sales opportunities. Working together with Partners, Principals and Managing Directors, our Sales Executives focus their highly skilled efforts in securing relationships with qualified targets, executives and decision makers to uncover opportunities, develop effective sales strategies, manage the pursuit process and act as a key advisor to the pursuit team throughout the sales process.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 10+ years’ experience managing complex clients characterized by long sales cycles and significant dollar transactions
  • Strong sales management knowledge and/or experience selling to Health Care clients
  • Experience in relationship building that increases account penetration and leads to increased revenue opportunities with new and existing clients
  • Ability to develop and utilize pre-existing network of clients or contacts in the marketplace
  • Experience managing internal sales activities to ensure consistent approach to marketplace across geographies and industry groups
  • Experienced with a complex pursuit process, proposal development and oral presentations that win new business
  • Ability to travel 0-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Rewards delivery and wellness experience
  • Undergraduate degree

About this job

Delivery Consultant role on Deloitte's AI & Data team designing and supporting data pipelines, conversion processes, and integration workflows for client systems. Work includes data mapping, transformation, validation, and collaboration with cross-functional teams on the data lifecycle.

Good fit if you have 4+ years with Python and data testing, 3+ years designing data pipelines and SQL, and can obtain a Public Trust clearance

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team works to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Delivery Consultant, Data Engineering and Conversion Solutions on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for…

  • Designing, developing, and supporting data pipelines, conversion processes, and integration workflows across client systems
  • Performing data mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities to support conversion and migration requirements
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to analyze source and target data structures, document technical requirements, and resolve data issues
  • Developing and executing unit tests, supporting defect triage, and maintaining documentation for data engineering and conversion deliverables
  • Contributing to project delivery by supporting sprint activities, status reporting, and implementation tasks across the data lifecycle

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte’s scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Mathematics, or Statistics
  • 4+ years of experience with Python, machine learning, artificial intelligence (AI) testing, data testing, and AI agent development or implementation
  • 3+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting data pipelines, data integration workflows, data conversion solutions, SQL, data analysis, and data mapping
  • Experience with data validation, reconciliation, defect resolution, and implementation support for migration or conversion activities
  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1-2 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting government, public sector, or higher education clients
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience with ETL tools, data warehousing platforms, or lakehouse technologies
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments
  • Experience creating technical documentation, source-to-target mappings, and test evidence for project deliverables
  • Experience with risk modeling and predictive modeling

Job.JobTitle: Converge for FSI - Lead UI Engineer - Products & Platforms
Job.CustomJobTypeName: UX / UI Designer, Creative / Design / Architecture
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte’s business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.

Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte’s Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented individual with an innovative mindset to join the Converge for FSI team in our mission to develop differentiated financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte’s innovation & product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities. 

Position Summary

Converge is investing in its BankingSuite product line to compete in the exciting FinTech ecosystem, which will focus on delivering a world-class customer experience for consumer and small businesses of smaller banks and non-banks. The BankingSuite platform is a cloud-native stack at every layer and aims to help BankingSuite clients compete with large bank and FinTech incumbents with the flexibility to deliver innovative marketing, product, and experiences, while enjoying dramatically lower digital bank operating costs. 

The BankingSuite team is looking is looking for a Lead UI Engineer with a passion for innovation and the experience to launch a high-quality digital banking product as part of a FinTech startup team. You’ll work closely with our CPO/CTO, Head of Product, Tech Leads, and UI engineering team to build apps that end users engage with, while improving consumer financial health and/or B2B banking client profitability.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you’ll do

  • Hands-on technical design and build of our applications for iOS, Android and Web
  • Create innovative and industry-leading applications for existing or new financial service offerings, collaborating with team members to define the technical design and POC new concepts 
  • Drive the creation of experiences that calls the industry to recognize BankingSuite as a leader in fintech and as the “go-to” platform for digital banking transformation
  • Lead and mentor the global BankingSuite UI team
  • Create high-quality and error-free apps with technical consistency
  • Produce coherent technical design deliverables that solve BankingSuite’s most challenging application architecture problems, such as and flexibility and accuracy in supporting multiple tenants on a complex fin-tech platform
  • Adhere to software quality and efficiency measurement standards
  • Take designs and wireframes and produce high quality responsive UI Code 

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • In depth knowledge of web technologies such as HTML/CSS/JS and how to take wireframes to high fidelity UIs
  • Strong experience in VCS technologies such as Git as well as peer review tools such as Bitbucket
  • Experience leading Agile teams specifically scrum and comfortable working in distributed teams
  • Ability to use Jira and Confluence for product development tracking and management 
  • Knowledge of integration patterns with Rest APIs and MCP servers including mocking approaches, failure handling and caching strategies
  • Strong knowledge of testing approaches for mobile applications 
  • Familiar with CI/CD approaches for the publishing of both web and mobile applications to beta user groups as well as the Android and iOS app stores
  • Experience building or integrating generative UI patterns and rendering interfaces from declarative schemas (JSON/DSL)
  • Experience in producing secure applications

Preferred:

  • Existing experience with the Dart programming language or Flutter SDK.
  • Familiarity with the Fastlane deployment tool
  • Experience with schema-driven or server-driven UI frameworks, including versioning and backward compatibility, in systems where an LLM or agent selects the component or flow to render at runtime 
  • Strong verbal and written communications, adept at explaining complex technical concepts and sharing your knowledge with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Interest in all digital consumer interaction models, from web to mobile to push notifications to emerging HCI channels 
  • Passionate about test-driven development, clean code, test automation, and continuous deployment
  • Passion and experience for identifying and providing feasible solutions for reducing technical debt and can directly execute improvements across the stack

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in development of mobile app and/or web applications in either Swift, Kotlin, React Native, Angular or Xamarin. Flutter experience preferred however training can be provided.
  • Ability to travel <10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience in the development of banking experience or financial services applications.

Quick facts

  • Pay: $141,200 to $278,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 7+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Lead the design, build, implementation, and validation of AI and generative AI solutions for Deloitte clients. Manage project teams developing proofs of concept and production-ready applications while overseeing end-to-end validation including testing, benchmarking, and trustworthiness assessment.

Good fit if you have 7+ years developing and validating AI solutions with Python, experience with generative AI tools and agentic frameworks, and can lead project workstreams in client service environments.

Full job description

Position Summary

Manager, AI Risk & Validation

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organizations. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 15, 2026

Work you’ll do

As a Manager Risk and Forensic on the Regulatory & Financial Risk team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading the design, build, implementation, and validation of artificial intelligence (AI), generative AI, and agentic AI solutions aligned to client business, risk, and regulatory objectives
  • Managing project teams and workstreams that develop proofs of concept, experiments, and production-ready applications using machine learning, natural language processing, image analysis, time series analysis, graph-based methods, and retrieval-augmented generation techniques
  • Overseeing end-to-end validation of AI solutions, including data review, design assessment, testing strategy, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, documentation, traceability, monitoring, and production-readiness evaluation
  • Assessing trustworthiness and control considerations such as hallucination risk, grounding, bias, explainability, robustness, privacy, security, guardrails, escalation paths, and audit logging
  • Translating technical findings and validation results into decision-ready recommendations for client stakeholders and engagement leadership
  • Serving as a day-to-day client contact, managing stakeholder communications, identifying delivery risks and dependencies, and escalating issues as appropriate
  • Reviewing and coaching the work of consultants and senior consultants to strengthen technical quality, delivery discipline, documentation, and responsible AI practices
  • Collaborating with Deloitte specialists across risk, regulatory, technology, data science, and model validation disciplines to shape solution design, validation approaches, and delivery outcomes
  • Supporting engagement management and practice development activities, including work planning, status reporting, quality review, proposal support, and development of reusable methods or accelerators

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Regulatory & Financial Risk offering supports clients' regulatory and compliance needs, balancing risk and regulatory requirements with enhancing business value and optimizing outcomes. We deliver enhanced value through strategic transformation, end-to-end implementation, and a focus on business-as-usual sustainability across processes, controls, and data & analytic infrastructures.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, or a similar quantitative field
  • 7+ years of experience developing, validating, or deploying AI, generative AI, or agentic AI solutions using Python and JavaScript
  • Experience leading AI solution delivery, validation, or implementation workstreams in a client service or project-based environment
  • Experience with generative AI tools and components such as Hugging Face, OpenAI application programming interfaces (APIs), Llama, Gemini, Claude, Granite, retrieval-augmented generation, or Stable Diffusion
  • Experience with agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or CrewAI, and at least one deep learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras
  • Experience deploying or overseeing deployment of AI solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including containerized environments using Docker or Kubernetes
  • Experience managing workplans, deliverables, quality reviews, stakeholder communications, and project risks or dependencies
  • Experience translating model, AI, or system validation findings into clear documentation, reporting, and recommendations
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
  • Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, or a similar quantitative field
  • Experience supporting generative AI or agentic AI solutions in production environments
  • Experience training, fine-tuning, or evaluating deep learning models
  • Experience with model risk management, model validation, monitoring, documentation, or reporting for AI-enabled solutions
  • Experience serving Financial Services clients
  • Experience leading or contributing to responsible AI governance, controls, testing, or monitoring frameworks
  • Experience contributing to proposals, thought leadership, reusable assets, or broader practice development efforts

Position Summary

Senior Consultant, AI Risk & Validation

Our Deloitte Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team helps client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform their organizations. Join our team and use advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with industry insights to help clients bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 15, 2026.

Work you’ll do

As a Senior Consultant Risk and Forensic on the Regulatory & Financial Risk team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building, and implementing artificial intelligence, generative artificial intelligence, and agentic artificial intelligence solutions aligned to client business, risk, and regulatory objectives
  • Developing proofs of concept, experiments, and production-ready applications using machine learning, natural language processing, image analysis, time series analysis, graph-based methods, and retrieval-augmented generation techniques
  • Performing end-to-end validation of AI solutions, including data review, design assessment, testing strategy, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, documentation, traceability, monitoring, and production-readiness evaluation
  • Evaluating trustworthiness and control considerations such as hallucination risk, grounding, bias, explainability, robustness, privacy, security, guardrails, escalation paths, and audit logging
  • Translating technical findings into decision-ready recommendations, supporting project delivery, and collaborating with Deloitte specialists to strengthen solution design, validation approaches, and responsible AI practices

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Regulatory & Financial Risk offering supports clients' regulatory and compliance needs, balancing risk and regulatory requirements with enhancing business value and optimizing outcomes. We deliver enhanced value through strategic transformation, end-to-end implementation, and a focus on business-as-usual sustainability across processes, controls, and data & analytic infrastructures.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, or a similar quantitative field
  • 4+ years experience developing and deploying artificial intelligence, generative artificial intelligence, or agentic artificial intelligence solutions using Python and JavaScript
  • Experience with generative artificial intelligence tools and components such as Hugging Face, OpenAI application programming interfaces, Llama, Gemini, Claude, Granite, retrieval-augmented generation, or Stable Diffusion
  • Experience with agentic artificial intelligence frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or CrewAI, and at least one deep learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras
  • Experience deploying AI solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including containerized environments using Docker or Kubernetes
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
  • Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, or a similar quantitative field
  • Experience supporting generative artificial intelligence or agentic artificial intelligence solutions in production environments
  • Experience training, fine-tuning, or evaluating deep learning models
  • Experience with model risk management, model validation, monitoring, documentation, or reporting for AI-enabled solutions
  • Experience serving Financial Services clients
  • Experience developing AI methods or adapting emerging techniques beyond baseline framework implementation

Job.JobTitle: MES Solution Architect Manager (Siemens Opcenter Core/Camstar)
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don’t miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Manufacturing Executions Systems Solution Architect Manager on the Supply Chain & Network Operations team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading discussions with senior leaders and business stakeholders to define Manufacturing Execution System (MES) needs and translate requirements into solution functionality
  • Collaborating with technical architects to design scalable, technically feasible Siemens Opcenter Core/Camstar solutions
  • Performing functional and technical architecture, analysis, research, and design activities for MES implementations
  • Leading delivery of complex MES projects across requirements gathering, configuration, testing, deployment, and support in a fast-paced team environment
  • Contributing to practice growth by sharing knowledge, helping solve client challenges, and supporting innovation in current and emerging MES solutions

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 7+ years of Manufacturing Execution System (MES) experience
  • 5+ years of experience implementing Siemens Opcenter Core/Camstar, including solution design, installation, configuration, setup, integration, and upgrades
  • 5+ years of experience with business requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, functional process design, data mapping, functional and technical specification documentation, system configuration, system testing, solution delivery, customer support, process documentation, and onsite/offshore delivery models
  • Experience leading 2+ MES implementations and defining system architecture
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or Engineering
  • 3+ years of experience working with Siemens Opcenter Core/Camstar
  • Consulting experience
  • Siemens Opcenter certification
  • Experience leading project teams in a client service environment

Quick facts

  • Pay: $128,000 to $252,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL

About this job

Senior Consultant role with Deloitte's Performance & Cost Improvement team in Miami, focusing on operations improvement, enterprise transformation, and cost reduction across client engagements. Lead workstreams, analyze financial and operational data, and develop business cases and financial models to drive structural change.

Good fit if you have 4+ years of management consulting experience in operations improvement, enterprise transformation, or cost reduction with strong financial analysis and Microsoft Office skills.

Full job description

Position Summary

Deloitte’s Strategy and Transactions – Performance Improvement and Restructuring (PI&R) practice helps clients navigate critical business moments and transformational initiatives. We provide end-to-end support and advisory services across performance improvement, cost transformation, turnaround, restructuring, and financial and operational transformation.

PI&R works with boards and C-suite executives to develop execution-ready strategies and customized financial and operational solutions that drive structural, enterprise-wide change. We work closely with clients throughout their transformation journey to help them navigate financial and operational challenges, improve performance, and implement practical solutions that create lasting impact.

Within PI&R, the Performance & Cost Improvement (P&CI) team helps clients identify, evaluate, and implement enterprise-wide cost reduction and margin improvement opportunities. We support initiatives including cost reduction, margin improvement, operating and business model transformation, and analytics-enabled performance improvement. Our work focuses on structural, enterprise-wide changes designed to support immediate performance objectives and long-term profitable growth.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation on the Performance & Cost Improvement team, you will help clients evaluate and execute initiatives that improve cost structure, cash flow, and enterprise value. You will be responsible for:

  • Lead small engagements or key workstreams within larger, complex engagements focused on operations improvement; enterprise transformation involving operating models or service delivery models (e.g., shared services or centers of excellence); non-labor optimization; or business process reengineering focused on cost reduction.
  • Analyze operational, financial, and market data to identify value creation, cost optimization, and performance improvement opportunities across the enterprise.
  • Support development of business cases, pricing analyses, and financial models tailored to client objectives.
  • Plan and support transformation engagements across industries, including coordinating workstreams, managing scope changes, and tracking progress against engagement objectives.
  • Work with client stakeholders to assess issues, develop strategic recommendations, and prepare deliverables aligned with engagement requirements; serve as a liaison between business needs and technology-enabled solutions to support implementation and execution.
  • Contribute to proposal development and other practice-building activities, as requested.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

PI&R defines and leads enterprise Board and C-suite agendas for non-distressed, underperforming, and distressed clients to improve margins and operational and financial performance, navigate financial difficulties, and improve cash flow to fund critical transformations.

The P&CI team helps clients identify, evaluate, and implement enterprise-wide cost reduction and margin improvement opportunities. The global practice includes more than 9,000 cost transformation practitioners, with experience across industries, deep sector knowledge, and industry-leading assets and accelerators.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • 4+ years of management consulting experience in operations improvement; enterprise transformation involving operating models or service delivery models (e.g., shared services or centers of excellence); non-labor optimization; margin improvement; or business process reengineering focused on cost reduction.
  • 4+ years of experience using financial analysis and data from multiple sources to assess value creation opportunities.
  • 4+ years of experience developing models using Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Access, Visual Basic, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1-2 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree.
  • Experience serving corporate and private equity clients.
  • Experience developing business cases, pricing analyses, or complex financial analyses.
  • Experience creating executive-level presentations and client deliverables using Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Visio.
  • Experience supporting proposal development or mentoring junior team members.
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel, analytics, and data visualization tools to support analysis and recommendations.

Job.JobTitle: Converge Signals for FSI - Product Forward Deployed Engineer - Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $105,400 to $207,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 2+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Product Forward Deployed Engineer for Signals, a financial services AI product at Deloitte. Split time between pre-sale pitches to executives and post-sale delivery of proofs of concept, managing client outcomes and feeding product feedback to engineering teams.

Good fit if you have financial services industry knowledge, can communicate technical concepts to executives, and work effectively with engineering teams on delivery.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte’s business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.

Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte’s Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented individual with an innovative mindset to join the Converge for FSI team in our mission to develop differentiated financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte’s innovation & product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities. 

Position Summary

Are you energized by both winning the deal and delivering on it? As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE), you'll be the GTM & Delivery engine for Signals, a priority product in the Converge for FSI portfolio. Signals is a proprietary set of data assets coupled with AI, data science, and statistical models that help our clients drive business growth and power decisions in a dynamic and chaning market. You'll bring core consulting skills, financial services industry knowledge, and the ability to work with key stakeholders (product managers, technical / engineering teams, and Market Makers) to qualify product fit, pitch / demo products to clients, shape & commercialize opportunities, and deliver work by managing scope, timeline, and client outcomes. You’ll be expected to be equally comfortable pitching and demoing to a C-suite leader as you are working with product / engineering teams to deliver on a proof of concept.

As the pFDE, you will be responsible for developing the strategy, vision, and operations of the FDE function for the Signals product. You will drive commercial success by defining commercialization models, working with internal teams to enable licensing, and making it easier for Market Makers to sell products to clients. You will be part of the General Manager’s leadership team, responsible for proactively bringing ideas that push the business forward, weighing in on key decisions, and helping junior resources across the team overcome hurdles.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.

Work you’ll do

As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer, you will split your time between winning new product business and delivering on it once sold. You will:

Pre-Sale:

  • Build and maintain relationships with market makers, buyer decision-makers, and Deloitte account teams to identify and shape product opportunities
  • Prepare and deliver pitches and product demos to client executives (including C-suite), translating Signals for FSI product value into a clear business case
  • Develop go-to-market materials — pitch decks, demo scripts, one-pagers, case studies — that Sales and Product teams can reuse across engagements
  • Partner with Market Makers and Product Managers to scope, price, and staff delivery engagements (incl. building scoping documents, pricing models, and commercial agreements)
  • Enable commercialization of products, create standardized license agreements, and be an advisor to Market Makers less familiar with taking Products to market

Post-Sale:

  • Lead delivery of scoped proofs of concept (POCs) and in-market testing, working hands-in-hand with engineering and data science teams to deliver the product to the client to drive outcomes for their business
  • Serve as the client's primary point of contact post-sale, managing scope, timeline, and outcomes, and escalating/resolving issues that put delivery at risk
  • Translate client requirements and product gaps back to Product Managers to inform the product feature backlog, distinguishing custom delivery needs from core product enhancements
  • Build, maintain, and scale reusable delivery assets, demo patterns, and implementation playbooks that accelerate the sales and deployment cycle for future engagements
  • Provide a continuous feedback loop between clients and the product team, and support knowledge transfer to delivery teams
  • Operate within defined engagement guardrails — scoped, time-boxed, and outcome-oriented — to protect capacity and ensure clean handoffs at the end of each deployment/delivery

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Comfortable moving fluidly between client-facing selling conversations and hands-on delivery oversight, without needing to write the underlying code
  • Strong executive presence and communicator, able to translate technical product capability into a business case for client executives and internal stakeholders alike
  • Able to work effectively alongside engineering and technical delivery teams — understanding enough of the technical picture to scope, sequence, and troubleshoot delivery without being the hands-on engineer or data scientist
  • Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry sufficient to speak credibly to industry-specific client problems across banking, insurance, and investment management
  • Ability to deliver work within scope / timelines and take an “outcomes” mindset to ensure client receives maximum value
  • Comfortable working through hard, ambiguous problems that require critical thinking, resourcefulness, and grit
  • Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client-relevant use cases
  • Deep understanding of customer data science, segmentation, and behavioral insights that can be leveraged for sales and marketing across consumer and business customers
  • Knowledge and experience across the marketing, sales and distribution of financial services products and services
  • Deep understanding of customer data platforms, use of market research survey data and data science modeling to project insights and findings to larger populations
  • Understanding of data transfer protocols – SFTP, Cloud Bucket to Bucket transfers, Clean Rooms and CRMs, and Martech Customer Data Platforms
  • Awareness and depth of knowledge of 1st and 3rd party data uses to drive marketing and sales.
  • Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions
  • Self-directed, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously
  • Natural curiosity and a bias for building — you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Data Science or equivalent field. MBA a plus.
  • 3+ years of client-facing management or technology consulting / professional services experience, including leading delivery of technology-enabled engagements
  • 2+ years of experience within, or delivering consulting/technology engagements to, the financial services industry
  • Demonstrated experience working alongside engineering, data science, or technical delivery teams to scope, sequence, and troubleshoot data / technology implementations, without requiring hands-on coding
  • Demonstrated experience contributing to sales and business development activities (e.g., client pitches, proposals, demos) in addition to delivery
  • Ability to travel 20-40%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience selling and/or delivering licensable software/data products or productized services, as distinct from custom SOW-based or traditional consulting delivery
  • Prior experience in a startup, high-growth SaaS or data/insights environment
  • Prior experience using AI and LLMs to rapid prototype in a sales, business development or product demonstrations

Job.JobTitle: Banking Product Forward Deployed Engineer - Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $105,400 to $207,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Forward Deployed Engineer role embedded with strategic financial services clients to design and implement solutions on BankingSuite, a composable banking platform. You'll combine technical leadership in microservices and cloud architecture with client-facing problem-solving, building POCs and leading technical workshops.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of software engineering with client-facing experience, deep Java and Spring Boot expertise, and knowledge of event-driven architecture and AWS.

Full job description

Position Summary

The Team

Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte’s Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented individual with an innovative mindset to join the Converge for FSI team in our mission to develop differentiated financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This role is focused on BankingSuite, a managed composable banking platform that helps regional, universal, and community banks launch new digital product propositions & services and transform the digital customer experience. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte’s innovation & product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities. 

Position Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled and client-facing Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer partnership. In this role, you will embed directly with our most strategic clients — particularly in the financial services sector — to understand their toughest technical challenges and help them design and implement world-class solutions using our platform. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with direct influence on product direction.

 You are equally comfortable whiteboarding microservices architecture with a client's principal engineer, running a hands-on technical workshop for a team of developers, and standing up a compelling proof-of-concept in days. You thrive in fast-moving, high-stakes environments and know how to earn the trust of deeply technical stakeholders.

 Recruiting for this role ends on 12/01/2026.

Work you’ll do

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for strategic client accounts, building deep relationships with architects, engineers, and technical leaders
  • Lead discovery sessions to understand client architectures, pain points, and business objectives
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Collaborate with client architects and internal engineering teams to design scalable, production-ready solutions
  • Provide authoritative guidance on microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and cloud-native deployment patterns
  • Review and advise on client system designs, identifying risks and recommending best practices
  • Rapidly prototype and build POCs that demonstrate platform value in the context of a client's real-world use cases
  • Own and deliver polished, technically rigorous demos tailored to the client's specific technology stack and business domain
  • Maintain a library of reusable demo assets and reference implementations
  • Design and facilitate deep-dive technical workshops, hackathons, and onboarding bootcamps for client engineering teams
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides
  • Accelerate client time-to-value by enabling their teams to build confidently and independently
  • Act as the voice of the customer — surface product gaps, integration friction, and feature requests to internal product and engineering teams
  • Partner with Sales, Solutions Architecture, and Product to shape the technical go-to-market strategy

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot, including building production-grade microservices
  • Strong understanding of event-driven architecture — Kafka, event sourcing, CQRS, async messaging patterns
  • Hands-on experience with microservices design principles: service decomposition, API design, resiliency patterns, observability
  • Proficiency across multi-cloud environments, with AWS as a primary platform; working knowledge of Azure and GCP
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Exposure to Agentic AI frameworks and tooling — including LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration frameworks
  • Practical understanding of LLM integration patterns, prompt engineering, and AI-powered application design
  • Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client-relevant use cases
  • Exceptional communicator — able to lead technical conversations with senior engineers and C-suite stakeholders alike
  • Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions
  • Self-directed, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously
  • Natural curiosity and a bias for building — you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one

Qualifications 

Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing or equivalent field. MBA a plus.
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent in client-facing, solutions engineering, or field engineering roles
  • Ability to travel 20-30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Background in financial services, specifically banking, payments, or fintechs strongly preferred
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices
  • Contributions to open-source projects or public technical content (talks, blogs, repos)
  • Prior experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment
  • Relevant cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional, etc.)

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $110,700 to $218,300 a year
