  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Senior consultant designing and implementing Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud solutions for clients. You'll lead discovery workshops, assess business requirements, and guide clients through eCommerce implementations based on platform best practices.

Good fit if you have 3+ years with Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud, 2+ years facilitating discovery workshops, and can travel up to 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. 

Recruiting for this role ends on December 18, 2026

Work you’ll do 

Our eCommerce capabilities provide transactional solutions related to online marketing, sales and service; for both Direct-To-Consumer and Business-to-Business. Our Portal capabilities provide intranet and internet solutions focused on content presentment and transaction capabilities for both internal enterprise as well as customer facing purposes. 

You understand what it takes design and make complex Salesforce eCommerce solutions happen, and you'll have a firm hand on the controls every step of the way. 

You’ll help clients define their eCommerce requirements by leading and facilitating working sessions to gain an understanding of the client’s current state processes and technology in the eCommerce space as well as supporting the implementation that follows. If you like to design leading-edge solutions, you will help clients unlock the business value of SFCC (Salesforce Commerce Cloud), specifically Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud. 

You will:

  • Lead project discovery workshops, both on-site and remotely
  • Assess client business requirements and work closely with the Technical Architect/Lead to provide long-term functional solutions based on the applicable Salesforce platform best practices
  • Communicate platform capabilities and limitations to clients effectively
  • Identify client process pain points and gaps in best practices
  • Create and socialize feature and technical roadmaps
  • Drive client functional requirements and eCommerce best practice adoption
  • Author & review functional specification documentation and user stories for implementations and other large projects

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth. 

Qualifications: 

Required 

  • 5+ years of IT experience
  • 3+ years of experience with Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud.
  • 2+ years of experience configuring Salesforce B2B Commerce (on Lightning Experience or B2B Commerce on Salesforce Core) including catalogs, price books, promotions, entitlements, and buyer groups
  • 2+ years of experience facilitating functional discovery workshops. Create functional design documents, user stories, process flows, and test scripts
  • 2+ years of experience with Agile delivery methodology and end-to-end implementation delivery
  • Exposure to AI-driven work within delivery — e.g., using GenAI tools for user story development, meeting notes/summarization, requirements documentation, or test case generation.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred  

  • Salesforce certifications: B2B Commerce Administrator, Salesforce Certified Administrator, or Business Analyst
  • Experience of working in a professional services firm or working in a client service environment
  • Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Systems

Job ID 367422

Position Summary

As a Delivery Manager, you hold program-level execution accountable on a day-to-day basis within Deloitte's Product Engineering organization, one or more product teams operating against a shared set of intents.

Delivery in this organization operates inside an intent-driven development model with three concurrent layers — governance, execution, and learning — that run simultaneously. Execution advances in evidence-gated dashes, not sprints.

The activities that used to define this role — status compilation, schedule maintenance, risk-log upkeep, and ceremony documentation — are increasingly AI-assisted. What remains, and grows, is the judgment work: cross-team coordination on initiatives larger than a single product team can self-coordinate, stakeholder alignment, dependency management, and the operational discipline that keeps evidence-gated delivery.

Recruiting for this role ends on September 22nd 2026.

Work you'll do:

  • Program-level coordination for one significant initiative or a set of related programs. Ensure dashes start when slices are ready and end when deployed evidence confirms the intended behavior shifted.
  • Day-to-day stakeholder orchestration with internal Deloitte stakeholders at the program level, including reconciliation of AI-drafted artifacts when stakeholders arrive with their own briefs.
  • Drive cost-efficient adoption of LLM, agentic AI, and cloud platforms through effective governance, FinOps practices, and consumption optimization.
  • Operational integrity of the evidence-gated cycle in your scope: proof signals being read, harm watches honored and exit gates respected before slices expand.

Core Responsibilities

  • Outcome-Driven Leadership: Deliver the right customer and business outcomes by engaging product teams on structure, skills, leverage models, and measurement. Scope dashes against ready slices and observable evidence, so work advances when deployed evidence confirms the behavior shifted — not at a sprint boundary.
  • Delivery Leadership and Advocacy: Champion fit-for-context delivery methodologies and work with Product Managers to drive priorities and execution. Form skilled teams, remove roadblocks, and set cadence to the rhythm the program needs. Surface coordination friction before it becomes a blocker, escalating to the Delivery Leader when it exceeds your authority.
  • Craft Mastery: Foster delivery excellence through quality processes, program value delivery, and team growth — coaching junior professionals via pairing, observation, and feedback. Experiment with new tools like GenAI and support the AI Workflow Orchestrator on your program, knowing which workflows are AI-driven and how exceptions route. Spread knowledge through community sessions.
  • Communication: Inspire and influence stakeholders, serving as the contact for value achievement across product engineering teams. Communicate status accurately on the cadence the program needs. Hold the room when stakeholders disagree: surface trade-offs, recommend a path, drive to decision. Facilitate co-creation workshops.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as a connected member of the program alongside the triad ensemble (Product, Engineering and Experience) and cross functional groups. Maintain a live picture of dependencies across the product teams and platform services you touch. Manage conflict, foster collaboration, and enable cross-skilling.
  • Discovery & Delivery Proficiency: Apply deep SDLC expertise with continuous planning and refinement. Watch for drift between intent and execution and raise it early. Hold evidence-gate discipline — proof signals read, harm watches honored, exits and expansions respected. Identify risks, adapt scope, and embed continuous improvement.
  • Customer-Centric Delivery: Drive lean solutions through rapid experimentation, engaging customers before, during, and after delivery to land the right solution effectively.
  • Operational Excellence: Build inclusive, engaged teams; remove obstacles and coach; improve satisfaction and reduce attrition. Govern the intake of AI-drafted artifacts so they become productive inputs, not noise. Report on financials, innovation, and engagement, and drive efficiency and productivity.
  • Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage stakeholders at all levels and foster a culture of co-creation. Hold the relationship with program sponsors and affected stakeholders, informing them in proportion to their stake, and reconcile conflicting AI-generated artifacts on the same initiative. Align diverse perspectives to deliver quality solutions.
  • Domain Expertise: Rapidly acquire domain-specific knowledge and navigate enterprise functions to drive product value and organizational alignment.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team

US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value and outcomes. It leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure across a four-capability matrix: Product, Experience, Engineering, and Delivery. As Deloitte's primary product development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results. We develop and deploy cutting-edge go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 10+ years of delivery management with direct experience leading a cross-functional program or set of programs with meaningful dependencies and multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience operating inside an Agile or Lean model and demonstrated readiness to operate inside intent-driven, evidence-gated delivery patterns.
  • Experience working in a product-staffed model where durable product teams stay with their products across build, deploy, operate, and evolve.
  • Strong expertise in AI/Cloud FinOps, budget management, financial forecasting, vendor management, cost optimization, and data-driven delivery governance.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
  • Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to one of the select locations available for this role 
  • Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week

Preferred:

  • Coordination at scale: Track record of managing dependencies, surfacing risks, and driving alignment across teams that do not naturally talk to each other.
  • Engineering fluency: Able to follow technical conversations, ask useful questions, and challenge feasibility claims constructively. More than passive listening.
  • Evidence orientation: Comfortable measuring delivery by outcome validation rather than velocity proxies. Able to hold the line on evidence gates.
  • AI-augmented working practice: Fluent with current GenAI assistants and agentic delivery tooling. Able to direct AI output for status, risk, and coordination tasks rather than only consume or produce it manually.
  • Specification literacy: Able to read and reason about charter, persona, intent, constitution, and blueprint artifacts and understand how a program is governed through them.
  • Communication: Writes clearly. Presents to senior stakeholders without over formatting. Tells the truth about status, including bad news, without varnish.

Position Summary

As Salesforce Life Sciences Senior Consultant specializing in Life Sciences, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients achieve their transformation goals.  

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Sales & Service team, you will be responsible for…

  • Supporting the design and delivery of sales and service transformation initiatives across strategy, process, technology, and operating model workstreams
  • Analyzing current-state business processes, customer journeys, and organizational structures to identify gaps and improvement opportunities
  • Gathering and documenting business requirements and translating client needs into functional recommendations and deliverables
  • Facilitating client workshops, stakeholder interviews, and working sessions while tracking decisions, risks, issues, and action items
  • Creating presentations, status reports, process maps, and implementation materials to support program execution and stakeholder alignment

The Team

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in consulting or the Life Sciences industry (pharma, medtech, or biotech)
  • 3+ years leading Salesforce programs, including 3+ full lifecycle implementations as program/delivery lead.

Full job description

Position Summary

Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud Consultant 

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

An evolving customer and regulatory landscape, mounting pipeline of next-gen assets and portfolio pressures, and intensifying competition are presenting new organizational and operational hurdles for Life Sciences companies. These complex market dynamics are requiring new levels of rigor and insight in business strategy development and problem-solving, both domestically and globally.

We are looking for practitioners who will work alongside Life Sciences organizations from bio-technology firms to global big pharma to medical devices, to drive business value through end-to-end delivery of solutions based on strategy development for heart of business issues.

Recruiting for this role ends on February 11th 2027. 

Work You’ll Do

As a Consultant on the Sales & Service team supporting Salesforce programs, you will partner with business and clinical/operations stakeholders to translate patient and provider support needs into scalable Salesforce solutions. You will be responsible for eliciting and documenting business requirements, managing requirements through delivery, and driving functional design across patient support workflows.

The Team

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of consulting and/or industry experience
  • 2+ full life-cycle Salesforce implementations
  • Expertise in at least two Salesforce clouds: Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a technology field; or equivalent years of experience.
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Salesforce certifications
  • Experience in one or more industries such as Financial Services, Life Sciences, Health Care, Manufacturing, Technology, Retail, or Media
  • Experience presenting to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience implementing CRM platforms (SAP CRM, Oracle Sales Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics) or CPQ technologies (BigMachines, Apttus, Cameleon)
  • Advanced degree in a relevant field

Position Summary

AI Security Senior Consultant

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth & Transformation in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own and deliver work that helps clients understand and mitigate/monitor the risks of adopting AI across the enterprise and define the cybersecurity controls, governance, policy and risk management approaches needed to deploy AI securely and safely. You will combine client advisory with structured cyber risk and governance work, turning business and regulatory requirements into frameworks, roadmaps and recommendations, and you will work closely with the practice's Data, Infrastructure, Identity, Security Operations and Application Security teams to make sure strategy translates into implementable requirements. You will guide junior practitioners, lead project activities and client interactions and help identify, win and deliver new work.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth & Transformation on the Cyber Strategy & Transformation team, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead discovery and current-state assessments of client AI cybersecurity controls governance, risk management and security practices across business units and AI use cases.
  • Facilitate stakeholder workshops with security, risk, data science, legal and business leaders to surface AI risk concerns and gather requirements.
  • Develop AI risk registers, control frameworks and maturity assessments aligned to standards such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, the OWASP LLM Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS.
  • Translate strategic recommendations into workstream-level roadmaps, coordinating with Data, Infrastructure, Identity and Application Security practitioners on technical implementation details.
  • Draft governance artifacts, including AI use-case intake processes, policy templates, model risk tiering approaches and AI security awareness materials.
  • Own a workstream within a broader engagement, manage dependencies and milestones, provide day-to-day guidance to consultants, and support client demonstrations, executive readouts, and research, benchmarking, and estimation inputs to pursuits.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Strategy & Transformation offering develops and transforms cyber programs in line with a client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. It keeps the enterprise a step ahead of the evolving threat landscape and gives stakeholders confidence in the organization's cyber posture. Includes design of the cyber organization, governance, and risk assessments.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or Risk Management
  • 4+ years of experience in cybersecurity, risk, or technology consulting, including experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning systems, data governance, or emerging technology risk.
  • Experience working with artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts, including model development, training, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic architectures.
  • Experience applying artificial intelligence risk and security frameworks or regulations, including the National Institute of Standards and Technology Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (NIST AI RMF), International Organization for Standardization/International Electrotechnical Commission 42001 (ISO/IEC 42001), Open Worldwide Application Security Project Large Language Model Top 10 (OWASP LLM Top 10), MITRE Adversarial Threat Landscape for Artificial-Intelligence Systems (MITRE ATLAS), or the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act.
  • Experience conducting risk assessments, gap analyses, or maturity assessments in cybersecurity, privacy, or governance and developing strategy documents, governance frameworks, and executive presentation materials.
  • Ability to travel 25-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience in consulting, client delivery, or client-facing advisory roles and experience building or customizing prompts, templates, or lightweight artificial intelligence workflows to standardize recurring deliverables, including risk registers, maturity assessments, or policy drafts.
  • Experience with artificial intelligence governance platforms, governance, risk, and compliance tools, or model risk management systems.
  • Experience with the machine learning lifecycle and technologies such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow.
  • Experience developing reusable strategy assets, reviewing work products of junior consultants, or contributing to methodologies and frameworks.
  • Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, life sciences, or the public sector.
  • Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE), Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP), or ISO/IEC 42001 Foundation or Lead Implementer.

Tax Manager role at Deloitte serving high-net-worth individuals and families on complex tax compliance and planning matters. You will lead engagements, review tax returns, serve as trusted advisor to clients, and mentor tax professionals.

Full job description

Position Summary

Are you a tax professional who enjoys building trusted relationships with high-net-worth individuals, families, and their advisors? Do you bring strong experience in individual tax compliance and planning, including complex matters involving gifts, trusts, or wealth transfer? If so, this Tax Manager opportunity within Deloitte Tax may be a strong fit.

Recruiting for this role will end on May 31, 2027.

Work you’ll do

As a Deloitte Tax Manager supporting our Individual Tax Services - High Net Worth group, you will:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for high-net-worth individuals and their advisors.
  • Lead tax compliance and advisory engagements involving complex individual income tax matters.
  • Review individual tax returns and related deliverables, identify issues, and coordinate with specialists when needed.
  • Build strong client relationships through clear, thoughtful communication and responsive service.
  • Translate complex tax matters into practical recommendations for clients and their advisors.
  • Lead and develop tax professionals by providing coaching, reviewing work, and coordinating assignments across multiple deadlines.
  • Manage engagement timelines, priorities, resources, and budgets to support high-quality client outcomes.
  • Collaborate with engagement leaders and other tax professionals to resolve issues, manage risks, and deliver a consistent client experience.

A successful candidate will possess the following skills:

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team

At Deloitte Tax LLP, our Individual Tax Services professionals advise high-net-worth individuals and families on complex tax compliance and planning matters. The practice supports clients with individual income tax considerations while building long-term relationships with clients and their trusted advisors. Learn more about Deloitte Tax Global Employer Services.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or other relevant degree
  • 5+ years of experience in individual tax compliance and planning, with exposure to high-net-worth individuals and gifts
  • Strong technical knowledge of high-net-worth taxation, including experience reviewing complex individual and gift tax returns
  • Demonstrated ability to serve as a trusted client advisor, communicate complex tax matters clearly, and build relationships with high-net-worth clients and their advisors
  • Experience leading the delivery of complex tax engagements, including coordinating teams, managing competing deadlines, reviewing work, and maintaining high-quality client outcomes
  • Ability to travel up to 5%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • One of the following active accreditations obtained:
    • Licensed CPA in state of practice/primary office if eligible to sit for the CPA
    • If not CPA eligible:
      • Licensed Attorney
      • Enrolled Agent

Preferred

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in a related field.
  • Experience serving high-net-worth individuals or private clients.
  • Strong client communication and relationship-management skills.
  • Experience leading, coaching, and developing tax professionals.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint; experience with CCH tax technology or workflow tools is a plus.

About this job

Lead delivery of Identity and Access Management managed services for Deloitte's Cyber Operate team, overseeing full IAM stack implementation across large client accounts. Responsible for service outcomes, team management, account growth, and driving automation and modernization across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.

Good fit if you have 10+ years in Identity and Access Management with 5+ years leading managed services, experience with platforms like SailPoint or CyberArk, and can travel 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Deloitte helps organizations protect and grow their business by delivering risk management solutions across critical domains, including cyber. Within that environment, this role leads the delivery, growth, and continuous improvement of large-scale Identity and Access Management (IAM) managed services engagements. The Associate Vice President (AVP), IAM Managed Services will own delivery outcomes across the full IAM stack, including Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Access Management (SSO/MFA), and Directory Services, while also driving innovation, automation, account growth, and renewals for a large, complex client portfolio.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Associate Vice President, Engineering Managed Services on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

    - Lead end-to-end delivery of Identity and Access Management managed services across Identity Governance and Administration, Privileged Access Management, Access Management, and Directory Services.

    - Own service outcomes for blended onshore and offshore delivery teams, including service-level agreement and key performance indicator performance, service quality, staffing, and client satisfaction.

    - Serve as the primary delivery relationship owner for assigned accounts; lead executive governance, status reporting, incident response, risk mitigation, and financial performance management.

    - Drive service improvement through automation, tooling modernization, root-cause remediation, and adoption of identity-management practices across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.

    - Lead account expansion, contract renewals, and Requests for Proposal and Requests for Information activities, including solution scoping, staffing models, delivery approaches, and pricing.

    - Mentor managers, leads, and engineers through career guidance, coaching, and performance management.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

    - Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

    - Effective written and verbal communication skills

    - Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

    - Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

    - Ability to lead projects or workstreams

    - Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

    - Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

    - Ability to meet deadlines

    - Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Cyber Operate team manages clients' critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or in partnership with client teams, delivering skilled talent, market-tested technologies, and proven processes across the identity lifecycle. Our Digital Identity managed services combine Identity Governance and Administration, Access Management, and Privileged Access Management into a single, turnkey offering that helps clients reduce risk, accelerate maturity, and operate with confidence at scale. This work helps clients strengthen service performance while operating more efficiently at scale.

Qualifications

Required:

    - 10+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management, including 5+ years in a managed services or information technology operations leadership role.

    - Experience implementing or operating one or more identity platforms, including SailPoint, Saviynt, One Identity, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Okta, Ping Identity, or Microsoft Entra ID.

    - Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, information security, mathematics, decision sciences, risk management, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or industrial engineering

    - Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

    - Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

    - One or more certifications, including Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), SailPoint, CyberArk, or Okta certifications.

    - Experience deploying or managing Identity and Access Management solutions in Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform environments.

    - Experience defining or refining service-level agreements and operational-level agreements, and using information technology service management tools such as ServiceNow or Remedy.

    - Experience using development and operations (DevOps) practices, automation or orchestration tools, identity analytics, or Privileged Access Management disaster-recovery processes.

    - Experience delivering consulting or professional services to clients in life sciences, manufacturing, energy, or engineering and construction, including account expansion, renewals, or proposal-response activities.

    - Experience leading Identity and Access Management managed services across at least two domains—Identity Governance and Administration, Privileged Access Management, Access Management/Single Sign-On/Multifactor Authentication, or Directory Services—and leading teams of 30+ team members.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in stock plan administration or equity compensation operations and hold a CPA, attorney license, EA, CECP, CEP, GPHR, CEBS, CPC, CPP, or PMP credential.

Position Summary

Join Deloitte Tax LLP’s Global Employer Services practice as a Tax Manager, Equity Operations, where you will advise clients on how to optimize, redesign, build, and stand up effective stock administration functions, including operating models, governance, processes, controls, technology, data, integrations, service delivery, and readiness for major corporate events.

Work you'll do

As a Deloitte Tax Manager on the Equity & Incentives team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing and improving end-to-end administration processes for grants, vesting, releases, exercises, purchases, cancellations, settlements, mobility, tax withholding, payroll reporting, reconciliations, and participant support.
  • Leading or supporting function stand-up, transition, and stabilization activities, including implementation planning, data conversion, knowledge transfer, cutover, post-go-live support, and readiness for major corporate events.
  • Advising on equity administration platforms, vendor strategy, integrations, data flows, operational risk, controls, and scalable delivery approaches for client environments.

  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

  • Ability to meet deadlines

The team

At Deloitte Tax LLP, our Global Employer Services Rewards professionals help clients design and manage compensation and rewards programs for their global workforce. The practice advises on rewards strategy, compensation structures, benchmarking, and related tax and regulatory considerations to support effective business and talent outcomes. Learn more about Deloitte Tax Global Employer Services.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, accounting, human resources, information systems, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in stock plan administration, equity compensation operations, or stock administration advisory services
  • Experience in a corporate stock administration function, broker, recordkeeper, administrator, consulting organization, or professional services firm
  • Experience administering equity award lifecycles, including grants, vesting, releases, exercises, purchases, cancellations, settlements, withholding, and participant transactions
  • Experience designing or improving stock administration processes, controls, reconciliations, reporting, procedures, service delivery, or cross-functional issue resolution
  • Ability to travel up to 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
  • One of the following active accreditations: 
    • Licensed Certified Public Accountant (CPA) in state of practice/primary office
    • If not CPA eligible:
      • Licensed Attorney
      • Enrolled Agent (EA)
      • Certified Executive Compensation Professional (CECP)
      • Certified Equity Professional (CEP)
      • Global Professional in Human Resources (GPHR)
      • Certified Employee Benefits Specialist (CEBS)
      • Certified Pension Consultant (CPC)
      • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP)
      • Project Management Professional (PMP)

Preferred:

  • Experience designing, building, transforming, or standing up a stock administration function or major component of one
  • Experience with Equity Edge Online, Morgan Stanley at Work Shareworks, Fidelity Stock Plan Services, or a comparable equity administration platform
  • Certified Equity Professional (CEP) credential or comparable equity compensation expertise
  • Experience supporting global equity plans, globally mobile employees, and coordination across multiple payrolls and jurisdictions
  • Experience in public company environments, initial public offering readiness, executive or insider processes, financial reporting support, or corporate transactions
  • Experience with operating model design, vendor selection, platform implementation, data conversion, testing, cutover, transition, or post-go-live stabilization

Full job description

Position Summary

In an increasingly challenging environment marked by disruptive tech like AI, market uncertainty, and regulatory change, finance and global business services leaders recognize the opportunity to better serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Deloitte helps navigate this complexity by bringing deep industry insights and integrated solutions to achieve business objectives. From strategy to technology to operations, and across workforce, risk, assurance, and tax, Deloitte helps drive value along the Finance Transformation journey.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/01/2026

Work you'll do

As a Finance Analytics & AI Manager on the Finance Transformation team, you’ll work with the best in the business to solve the toughest client problems. From learning to leadership, this is your chance to take your career to the next level. Our Managers are expected to contribute to the firm's growth and development in a variety of ways.

§  Lead AI solution development and deployment, managing day-to-day client relationships, and ensuring quality, performance, and technical outcomes meet client expectations

§  Serve as a techno-functional bridge between client stakeholders and technical delivery teams — clarifying requirements, resolving design ambiguities, and providing solution guidance

§  Lead small engagements or workstreams within larger programs that identify, design, and implement AI-enabled business and technology solutions for large enterprises

§  Partner with developers and technical teams to translate design requirements into build specifications, providing functional guidance throughout development, testing, and deployment

§  Translate client business needs and finance process requirements into clear AI-related functional and technical design requirements, ensuring solutions are both technically sound and aligned to business outcomes

§  Engage clients to identify business issues and high-impact AI use cases, shaping hypotheses, value cases, and solution design requirements

§  Perform assessments using quantitative and qualitative techniques, including AI-enabled diagnostics and discovery methods, to inform solution architecture and design decisions

§  Define scope, objectives, requirements, and delivery plans; managing solution architecture planning through execution, delivery, and post-implementation review

§  Contributing to business development by supporting proposals, RFP responses, and orals, and by mentoring and developing team members

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

§  Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

§  Effective written and verbal communication skills

§  Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

§  Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

§  Ability to lead projects or workstreams

§  Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

§  Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

§  Ability to meet deadlines

§  Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Finance Transformation offering helps finance and global business services leaders navigate an increasingly challenging environment marked by disruptive tech like AI, market uncertainty, and regulatory change, and recognize the opportunity to better serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Within the Finance Transformation offering, our Business Finance team helps drive strategic value through financial planning, forecasting, and analytics capabilities. By leveraging next-gen processes, scalable data platforms, and AI, our team delivers accurate, timely, and actionable insights.

Qualifications

Required:

·         Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

·         6+ years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.

·         Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP).

·         Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch for customers.

·         Experience leading technical discovery sessions with customers.

·         Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.

·         Experience using Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) to develop analytics, machine learning, data engineering, or automation solutions in Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure environments

·         Experience architecting generative and agentic AI solutions across infrastructure, model, and application layers, including one or more of the following infrastructure platforms: NVIDIA, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure; one or more of the following model platforms: GPT-4o, Claude, or Llama; and one or more of the following application platforms: ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini

·         Experience working with finance data and use cases related to planning, budgeting, forecasting, close, profitability, or cost allocations

·         Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

·         Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

·         Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Analytics, Finance, Mathematics, or Statistics

  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Knowledge of LLM-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

·         Experience with finance platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, OneStream, or Workday

·         One or more certifications in artificial intelligence, machine learning, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, Snowflake, Databricks

·         2+ years of experience supporting pre-sales, proposals, RFP responses, and mentoring data and AI delivery teams

Position Summary

In an increasingly challenging environment marked by disruptive tech like AI, market uncertainty, and regulatory change, finance and global business services leaders recognize the opportunity to better serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Deloitte helps navigate this complexity by bringing deep industry insights and integrated solutions to achieve business objectives. From strategy to technology to operations, and across workforce, risk, assurance, and tax, Deloitte helps drive value along the Finance Transformation journey.

Recruiting for this role ends on 09/30/2026

Work you'll do

As a Finance Data & AI Manager specializing in Microsoft Azure and Fabric, you’ll lead teams that design end-to-end solutions from source integration and OneLake through trusted data products, AI, and Power BI. You will guide architecture from strategy through production.

•Lead engagements or workstreams that define end-to-end Azure and Fabric architectures across integration, OneLake, lakehouse/warehouse, security, AI, and finance consumption

•Guide batch, streaming, mirroring, and orchestration design with Fabric Data Factory, Data Engineering, Spark, Data Warehouse, and Real-Time Intelligence

•Establish governance, lineage, Entra-based access, data quality, observability, service-level objectives, and remediation with Microsoft Purview

•Define reusable finance data products, canonical models, OneLake sharing, APIs, and governed semantic models for planning, close, profitability, treasury, and reporting

•Architect production ML and generative and agentic AI with Fabric Data Science and Azure AI services, MLOps and LLMOps, evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI

•Manage client relationships, estimates, design reviews, deployment, capacity and cost outcomes; mentor teams and support demonstrations, proposals, and RFP responses

•Agentic Redesign of Finance data and processes such as planning, forecasting, close, profitability, treasury, or reporting

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

?Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

?Ability to translate finance outcomes into clear architecture decisions

?Effective written, verbal, and executive communication skills

?Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

?Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

?Ability to lead projects or workstreams

?Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

?Ability to meet deadlines

?Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Finance Transformation offering helps finance and global business services leaders navigate an increasingly challenging environment marked by disruptive tech like AI, market uncertainty, and regulatory change, and recognize the opportunity to better serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Within the Finance Transformation offering, our Business Finance team drives strategic value through planning, forecasting, and analytics. We design trusted finance data products, modern platforms, and AI-enabled solutions that deliver timely, actionable insights.

Qualifications

Required:

•6+ years of experience architecting enterprise data, analytics, or AI solutions in a corporate or consulting environment

•4+ years of experience designing Azure or Fabric solutions across data engineering, lakehouse/warehouse, security, performance, and multi-environment deployment

•4+ years of experience with finance data and processes such as planning, forecasting, close, profitability, treasury, or reporting

•Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

•Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

•Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

•Experience with OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory, Data Engineering, Real-Time Intelligence, Direct Lake, Power BI, and Purview

•Experience with data quality, observability, lineage, testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and capacity/cost optimization

•Experience deploying ML, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic AI with Azure AI or Fabric Data Science and responsible AI controls

•Experience integrating SAP, Oracle, Workday, Anaplan, or OneStream and building governed Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, and reports

•Microsoft certification in Azure architecture, Fabric, or Power BI; or a master’s degree in a related field

•2+ years of experience supporting pre-sales, proposals, RFP responses, and mentoring data and AI delivery teams

Quick facts

About this job

Lead teams designing end-to-end Snowflake data and AI solutions for finance transformation at Deloitte. Role spans architecture, pipeline design, governance, ML/AI implementation, and client management across planning, forecasting, close, and reporting processes.

Good fit if you have 6+ years architecting enterprise data solutions, 4+ years with Snowflake (SQL, Python), and 4+ years in finance data and processes.

Full job description

Position Summary

In an increasingly challenging environment marked by disruptive tech like AI, market uncertainty, and regulatory change, finance and global business services leaders recognize the opportunity to better serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Deloitte helps navigate this complexity by bringing deep industry insights and integrated solutions to achieve business objectives. From strategy to technology to operations, and across workforce, risk, assurance, and tax, Deloitte helps drive value along the Finance Transformation journey.

Work you'll do

As a Finance Data & AI Manager specializing in Snowflake, you’ll lead teams that design end-to-end solutions from ingestion through trusted data products, AI, and reporting. You will connect finance outcomes to target architecture and guide delivery from strategy through production.

·         Lead engagements or workstreams that define end-to-end Snowflake architectures across integration, engineering, storage, security, semantic modeling, AI, and finance consumption

·         Guide batch and streaming pipeline design using SQL, Python, Snowpark, Snowpipe, dynamic tables, streams, tasks, and orchestration tools

·         Agentic Redesign of Finance data and processes such as planning, forecasting, close, profitability, treasury, or reporting

§  Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

§  Ability to translate finance outcomes into clear architecture decisions

§  Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

§  Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

Within the Finance Transformation offering, our Business Finance team drives strategic value through planning, forecasting, and analytics. We design trusted finance data products, modern platforms, and AI-enabled solutions that deliver timely, actionable insights.

Required:

·         6+ years of experience architecting enterprise data, analytics, or AI solutions in a corporate or consulting environment

·         4+ years of experience designing Snowflake solutions with SQL and Python across data engineering, security, performance, and multi-environment deployment

·         4+ years of experience with finance data and processes such as planning, forecasting, close, profitability, treasury, or reporting

·         Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

·         Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

·         Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

·         Experience with Snowpark, Snowpipe, dynamic tables, streams and tasks, Cortex AI, semantic views, secure sharing, governance, and data quality

·         Experience with data observability, lineage, testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and Snowflake cost/performance management

·         Experience deploying ML, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic AI with evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI controls

·         Experience integrating SAP, Oracle, Workday, Anaplan, or OneStream and delivering Power BI or Tableau semantic models and reporting

·         SnowPro certification or a master’s degree in a related business or technical field

·         2+ years of experience supporting pre-sales, proposals, RFP responses, and mentoring data and AI delivery teams

Quick facts

  • Pay: $163,400 to $322,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 7+ years

About this job

Lead strategy consulting engagements for healthcare marketing clients at Deloitte's Jacksonville office, covering CMO agenda areas like operating models, go-to-market strategy, and AI-enabled transformation. Requires 7+ years consulting delivery for marketing stakeholders and 4+ years healthcare ecosystem experience.

Good fit if you have 7+ years marketing consulting experience, 4+ years working directly with healthcare clients, and comfort with MarTech platforms and AI tools.

Full job description

Position Summary

Position Summary

Throughout the health ecosystem, you’ll find courageous and inspiring people who are committed to driving transformation, advancing access to healthcare, and leading a well-being revolution. Where you find innovators committed to sustainable progress, you’ll find Deloitte’s Life Sciences & Health Care practice. Our leaders work side-by-side to orchestrate and deliver on the business of science and health. We bring trusted, flexible approaches that help foster innovation, harness new technologies, and formulate consumer-driven strategies to engineer a digitally enabled, equitable future of health.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 15, 2026

Work you’ll do

The Health Care Marketing Strategy Manager is a client-facing consulting leader responsible for leading the day-to-day delivery of strategy consulting engagements for Health Care clients and their marketing functions. This role combines marketing strategy expertise, consulting execution, and Health Care commercial acumen to help clients address the full breadth of the Chief Marketing Officer’s agenda. This person will lead teams that deliver on complex challenges for marketing functions to generate measurable outcomes.

As a Health Care Marketing Strategy Manager, you will be responsible for:

·       Leading the day-to-day delivery of strategy engagements for Health Care marketing clients, spanning the breadth of the CMO agenda including:

o   Marketing operating model and organizational design

o   Customer, patient, member, provider or stakeholder segmentation

o   Go-to-market and channel strategy

o   Growth and margin improvement opportunities

o   Marketing investment and resource allocation

o   Customer experience and engagement transformation

o   Marketing performance measurement and KPI design

o   AI enabled marketing transformation

·       Partnering with client marketing, commercial, and digital leaders to define strategic choices and recommendations tied to clear business outcomes

·       Translating business and customer challenges into structured analyses, insights, and high-quality, executive-ready deliverables grounded in research and data

·       Bringing comfort with the more technical aspects of marketing, including MarTech stacks, platforms, tools, and the implications of AI, to help shape and support broader marketing transformation engagements

·       Managing day-to-day client relationships, facilitating working sessions, and overseeing scope, timelines, risks, and dependencies across workstreams

·       Using advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, insight generation, and work quality

·       Supporting practice growth through proposals, solution shaping, workplans, and follow-on opportunities

·       Coaching teams, modeling Deloitte leadership behaviors, and contributing to an inclusive, high-performing culture

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

·       Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

·       Effective written and verbal communication skills

·       Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

·       Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

·       Ability to lead projects or workstreams

·       Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

·       Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and manage complex, multi-stakeholder engagements

·       Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

·       Ability to meet deadlines

·       Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

·      

The team

An evolving customer and regulatory landscape, cost and operational pressures, and intensifying competition are presenting new organizational and operational hurdles for Health Care organizations. These complex market dynamics require new levels of rigor and insight in marketing strategy, operating model design, and the application of new technology capabilities by marketing leaders.

We are looking for practitioners who will work alongside Health Care organization leadership teams to drive business value through the design and delivery of strategies that connect customer insight to business impact.

Qualifications

Required:

·       7+ years of experience with a demonstrated history of consulting delivery for marketing stakeholders and related areas of the CMO agenda

·       4+ years of experience working directly with marketing client teams

·       4+ years of experience in the US Health Care and Life Sciences ecosystem, including customer and stakeholder dynamics, commercial operating environments, engagement models and market pressures

·       1+ years of experience incorporating AI into daily workflow and leveraging AI tools to enable and optimize the client experience

·       Ability to travel up to 30%+ on average, based on the work you do and the clients you serve

·       Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

·      

Preferred:

·       2+ years of experience leading workstreams or projects, including managing scope, timelines, and deliverables

·       Comfort with and exposure to the technical aspects of marketing, including MarTech platforms, tools, and the implications of AI (no requirement to design or build technology)

  • Ability to connect customer and market insights to measurable business outcomes, including growth, margin improvement, productivity, adoption, experience, or organizational effectiveness
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret research, customer data, market data, financial information, and performance metrics

·       Experience presenting recommendations and deliverables to executive stakeholders

·       Experience collaborating with technical teams and translating business needs into analytical or technology-enabled solutions

·       Experience growing and developing teams, especially practitioners with 0-2 years of experience

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $163,400 – $322,100

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Requisition code: 366844
Job ID 366844

Quick facts

  • Pay: $198,700 to $391,600 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 12+ years

About this job

Senior Manager role at Deloitte leading commerce strategy engagements for clients across industries. Combines strategic guidance on commerce as a growth channel with client-facing consulting leadership and business development responsibilities.

Good fit if you have 12+ years of commerce or digital transformation consulting experience, with demonstrated client leadership and experience selling and delivering multiple concurrent engagements.

Full job description

Position Summary

  1. Position Summary

Across industries, commerce has become one of the most important channels for growth, customer engagement, and margin performance – not simply a transactional endpoint, but a strategic lever that shapes how customers experience a brand and how a business competes. Where organizations are rethinking the role commerce should play in their broader channel mix and how they acquire, convert, and retain customers as a result, they look to Deloitte’s Commerce practice.

Our team helps clients define the role of commerce as a channel within their broader growth strategy, build the value narrative and business case for where to invest, and shape the experiences, capabilities, and operating model needed to deliver on that strategy. We bring together strategic rigor, design depth, commercial judgment, and implementation expertise to help clients translate ambition into measurable business outcomes.

The Commerce Strategy Senior Manager is a client-facing consulting leader responsible for balancing oversight and expert guidance across multiple high-impact commerce strategy engagements while driving pipeline and business development activities for clients across industries. This role combines deep commerce strategy expertise with consulting leadership and the credibility to serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, connecting commerce decisions to the broader commercial strategy – including customer experience, pricing, and growth strategy – and shaping the value narrative that guides how organizations prioritize and invest in commerce as a channel.

Recruiting for this role ends on November 30, 2026

Work You’ll Do

Commerce organizations are operating in a fast-changing environment shaped by shifting consumer behavior, channel fragmentation, rising customer expectations, and pressure to deliver profitable growth. Many companies are investing in commerce, but too few have a clear strategy for the role commerce should play as a channel – where to play, how to win, how commerce decisions should shape pricing, customer experience, and growth strategy, and how to prioritize the use cases that matter most.

We are looking for practitioners who can work alongside client leadership teams to define the strategic role of commerce as a channel, build the value narrative and business case for where to invest, prioritize commerce use cases, and drive the implications of that positioning across pricing, customer experience, and growth strategy – creating measurable impact that carries through into how commerce gets implemented.

As a Commerce Strategy Senior Manager, you will:

  • Provide oversight and expert guidance across multiple concurrent commerce strategy engagements across industries, including channel strategy and role definition, commerce operating model design, experience optimization, and the value narrative and business case behind where to invest
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, leading executive readouts and decision-ready recommendations on commerce’s role as a growth channel with credibility and authority
  • Drive the implications of commerce strategy and channel positioning into other parts of the commercial strategy agenda – including customer experience, pricing, and growth strategy – guiding how clients prioritize commerce use cases based on business value and strategic fit
  • Drive pipeline and business development activities, including leading proposal responses, shaping client solutions, and supporting business development across the practice
  • Contribute to and lead thought leadership efforts that build the practice’s reputation and market presence in commerce strategy
  • Confidently lead teams to strong outcomes while managing scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, and client needs across engagements
  • Maintain a strategic, value-oriented perspective on commerce technology and platform capabilities sufficient to guide broader commerce transformation engagements, without owning day-to-day technical delivery
  • Use advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, insight generation, and work quality
  • Lead, coach, and develop teams while fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture and modeling Deloitte leadership behaviors

A Successful Candidate Would Possess These Skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively as part of a team
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and lead complex, multi-stakeholder engagements
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and translate business needs into analytical or technology-enabled solutions
  • Ability to lead multiple projects or workstreams concurrently
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to proactively identify and address potential challenges to effective delivery of work products before they happen
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others
  • Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, and written and oral communication skills, with the credibility to engage senior client leaders

Qualifications

Required

  • 12+ years of experience with a demonstrated history of consulting delivery in commerce strategy, digital commerce, customer experience, technology-enabled transformation, or related areas
  • 8+ years of experience working directly with business, digital, technology, or commerce client teams
  • 5+ years of experience selling and delivering, including supporting pursuits, leading proposal responses, shaping client solutions, and owning delivery outcomes
  • 4+ years of experience leading and overseeing multiple engagements or teams concurrently
  • 5+ years of experience shaping commerce strategies and translating them into actionable roadmaps, operating models, or implementation plans
  • 1+ years of experience incorporating AI into daily workflow and leveraging AI tools to enable and optimize the client experience
  • Ability to travel up to 30%+ on average, based on the work you do and the clients you serve

·       Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • Working knowledge of digital commerce platforms and capabilities sufficient to guide strategy and prioritization decisions across engagements, without owning hands-on implementation
  • Experience connecting commerce strategy to adjacent areas of commercial strategy, such as customer experience, pricing, or growth strategy, and guiding clients toward prioritized recommendations at the executive level
  • Demonstrated track record of generating pipeline and converting opportunities into sold work
  • Experience leading thought leadership, eminence building, and proposal development
  • Experience growing and developing teams in a highly collaborative and dynamic environment, especially practitioners with 2-4 years of experience

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $198,700 - $391,600.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Position Summary

Across industries, commerce has become one of the most important channels for growth, customer engagement, and margin performance – not simply a transactional endpoint, but a strategic lever that shapes how customers experience a brand and how a business competes. Where organizations are rethinking the role commerce should play in their broader channel mix and how they acquire, convert, and retain customers as a result, they look to Deloitte’s Commerce practice.

Our team helps clients define the role of commerce as a channel within their broader growth strategy, build the value narrative and business case for where to invest, and shape the experiences, capabilities, and operating model needed to deliver on that strategy. We bring together strategic rigor, design depth, commercial judgment, and implementation expertise to help clients translate ambition into measurable business outcomes.

The Commerce Strategy Manager is a client-facing consulting leader responsible for shaping commerce strategy engagements across industries, bringing a strategic, value-oriented lens to how clients position commerce as a critical growth channel. This role combines commerce strategy expertise and consulting execution with the judgment to connect commerce decisions to the broader commercial strategy – including customer experience, pricing, and growth strategy – helping clients prioritize the highest-value commerce use cases and carry a clear value narrative through to implementation.

Recruiting for this role ends on November 30, 2026

Work You’ll Do

Commerce organizations are operating in a fast-changing environment shaped by shifting consumer behavior, channel fragmentation, rising customer expectations, and pressure to deliver profitable growth. Many companies are investing in commerce, but too few have a clear strategy for the role commerce should play as a channel – where to play, how to win, how commerce decisions should shape pricing, customer experience, and growth strategy, and how to prioritize the use cases that matter most.

We are looking for practitioners who can work alongside client leadership teams to define the strategic role of commerce as a channel, build the value narrative and business case for where to invest, prioritize commerce use cases, and drive the implications of that positioning across pricing, customer experience, and growth strategy – creating measurable impact that carries through into how commerce gets implemented.

As a Commerce Strategy Manager, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading the day-to-day delivery of commerce strategy engagements across industries, including defining commerce’s role as a growth channel, channel strategy and role definition, commerce operating model design, and experience optimization – bringing a strategic, value-oriented lens into how these strategies carry through implementation
  • Partnering with client business, digital, technology, and operations leaders to define commerce strategies tied to clear business outcomes
  • Translating business challenges into structured analyses, recommendations, and executive-ready deliverables grounded in data, customer insight, and commercial logic
  • Shaping commerce strategy roadmaps that span channel positioning, experience design, capability priorities, and organizational change, grounded in a clear value narrative and business case for where to invest
  • Driving the implications of commerce strategy and channel positioning into other parts of the commercial strategy agenda – including customer experience, pricing, and growth strategy – and helping clients prioritize commerce use cases based on business value and strategic fit
  • Partnering with global technical and implementation delivery teams to ensure the strategic intent and value case behind commerce decisions carry through into execution, without owning day-to-day technical delivery
  • Managing day-to-day client relationships, facilitating working sessions, and overseeing scope, timelines, risks, and dependencies across workstreams
  • Using advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, insight generation, and work quality
  • Supporting practice growth through proposals, solution shaping, workplans, and follow-on opportunities
  • Coaching teams, modeling Deloitte leadership behaviors, and contributing to an inclusive, high-performing culture

A successful candidate should possess these skills:

  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments; managing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements; and leading projects or workstreams.
  • Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, and written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and translate business needs into analytical or technology-enabled solutions.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team while building and sustaining professional relationships.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work products, while managing and prioritizing multiple tasks and meeting deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor, with the ability to mentor others and provide clear guidance.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of experience with a demonstrated history of consulting delivery in commerce strategy, digital commerce, customer experience, technology-enabled transformation, or related areas
  • 5+ years of experience working directly with business, digital, technology, or commerce client teams
  • 5+ years of experience shaping commerce strategies and translating them into actionable roadmaps, operating models, or implementation plans
  • 1+ years of experience incorporating AI into daily workflow and leveraging AI tools to enable and optimize the client experience
  • Ability to travel up to 30%+ on average, based on the work you do and the clients you serve

·       Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • 4+ years working knowledge of digital commerce platforms and capabilities sufficient to inform strategy and prioritization decisions, without owning hands-on implementation
  • 4+ years of experience leading workstreams or projects, including managing scope, timelines, deliverables, and client communication
  • Experience connecting commerce strategy to adjacent areas of commercial strategy, such as customer experience, pricing, or growth strategy, and translating that connection into prioritized recommendations
  • Experience presenting recommendations and deliverables to executive stakeholders
  • Experience supporting proposals, solution shaping, or workplan development
  • Experience growing and developing teams, especially practitioners with 0-2 years of experience

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $163,400 - $322,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

This position is aligned with the Core Talent Model. To view the associated benefit package, please reference this document.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients’ success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Project - Software Engineer III on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing and developing APIs, including specifications, endpoints, data models, and protocols
  • Contributing production-grade code for core services in a hands-on development environment
  • Performing code reviews with team leads to support code quality, maintainability, and security
  • Collaborating closely with the Engineering Crew Lead and API Architect on solution delivery
  • Mentoring junior engineers and supporting day-to-day technical execution

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
