The team

Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Engineering as a Service offering provides end-to-end design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We help transform engineering teams, modernize technology, & deliver complex programs with a product engineering mindset. Our flexible delivery models— traditional teams, pools, or pods, are tailored for each client’s needs, offering engineering-led Advise, Implement, & Operate capabilities to accelerate innovation.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree  
  • 6+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL
  • Experience with the RSpec testing framework
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining application programming interfaces (APIs)
  • Experience leading engineering teams while contributing hands-on to software development
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required clearance for this role
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm
  • Experience with application security principles and secure development practices
  • Experience with Git version control
  • Experience with OAuth
  • Experience with asynchronous job processing tools such as Sidekiq
  • Experience with Spring Boot and Java

Job.CustomJobTypeName: IT / Technology, Real Estate / Property Management
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 10+ years

About this job

Manager role on Deloitte's Real Estate Technology team leading Maximo implementations for clients. You will manage business requirements translation, oversee Maximo configuration teams, and serve as technical lead across full lifecycle implementations involving asset and work management systems.

Good fit if you have 8+ years Maximo design and configuration experience, 10+ years consulting background, completed 4+ full implementations, and hold IBM Maximo 7.6.x certification.

Full job description

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. We offer comprehensive end-to-end support and advisory services, covering areas such as valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. The team works closely with clients at every stage of their journey, helping them navigate challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and implement practical solutions before, during, and after major transformational projects or transactions creating lasting impact.

Are you passionate about helping clients design, build and deploy solutions which transform their organization and their asset management function? As trusted advisors to CFOs, COOs, CIOs, and other key executives, we advise, implement, and deliver as-a-service solutions that enhance asset management capabilities.  Join our team of Maximo and asset management technology professionals, where industry expertise, innovation, technical skills and specialized knowledge come together to empower clients to amplify the value of their technology investments.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/18/2026.

Work you’ll do

As a Manager on the Real Estate Technology team you will:

  • Lead discussions regarding understanding of asset and work management business processes and prepare business requirements
  • Convert business requirements into technical requirements and act as an interface between end users and Maximo technical team
  • Act as a Maximo technical lead to develop technical design documents in collaboration with Maximo technical architect
  • Lead a team of Maximo consultants to develop/configure the design in Maximo
  • As needed, perform hands on configuration in Maximo, configure Maximo applications, Maximo Integration Framework (MIF), manage security and develop reports (including BIRT reports)
  • Create relevant artifacts related to development and testing, and ensure process compliance on Maximo development and testing processes
  • Perform data loads using MIF or MXLoader to Maximo
  • Troubleshoot issues in production environment and provide technical support
  • Help customer end users in testing and validation
  • Serve as a liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring clear communication and accurate translation of requirements into delivered solutions
  • Leading or supporting proposal development, client relationship development, and business development activities

A successful candidate would possesses these skills: 

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Infrastructure and Real Estate team are trusted advisors to clients in managing physical assets throughout their lifecycle. We help them unlock value from their asset and real estate portfolios and functions by developing strategies, optimizing operating models and organizational design, and leveraging technology enablement.

Qualifications required

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university
  • 10+ years of relevant consulting experience in a professional services environment, with a large or boutique consulting firm, or as an internal consultant within industry
  • 8+ years of experience designing, configuring, and supporting business processes in Maximo
  • A minimum of 4 full life cycle implementations
  • Deep understanding and configuration of Maximo applications – Organization/Site, Asset Management, Inventory, Work Management, Procurement, Service Management and others
  • Understanding of Maximo Technical Architecture including code migration, environment management, performance, and code management
  • Hands-on experience with Maximo Integration Framework (MIF), Maximo Enterprise Adapters with experience for integration using APIs, batch, and SOAP
  • Hands on experience of Maximo Security Framework
  • Hands-on experience of report development using BIRT
  • Experience with at least one Maximo add-on (Maximo Spatial, Maximo Transportation, Maximo Utilities, and others)
  • IBM Maximo certification with Maximo 7.6.x
  • Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodation
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1-2 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

  • Experience in implementing Maximo Anywhere or any of the mobile partner solutions
  • Understanding of Maximo APM modules
  • Knowledge of MAS 8 upgrade
  • Experience with more than one Maximo add-on (Maximo Spatial, Maximo Transportation, Maximo Utilities and others)
  • Developing Digital solutions (e.g., predictive planning, scenario-based models, ERP, process automation, analytics, and visualizations)

Position Summary

CCaaS Technical Lead, Senior Consultant

Our Deloitte Sales & Service team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce

Recruiting for this role ends on December 31, 2026.

Work you'll do

As a CCaaS Technical Lead, you will help design, configure, integrate, and deliver cloud-based contact center and Generative AI solutions. You will work closely with client stakeholders, solution architects, engineers, and delivery teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable technical solutions across NICE CXone, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Genesys Cloud.

This is a hands-on delivery role. You will own technical workstreams, contribute to architecture decisions, guide engineering activities, and support solutions from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead technical workstreams for CCaaS and Contact Center AI implementations.
  • Develop solution designs, integration patterns, technical specifications, and implementation plans.
  • Configure and integrate platforms such as NICE CXone, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Genesys Cloud.
  • Design AWS-based solutions using services such as Amazon Connect, Lex, Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, and CloudWatch.
  • Implement Generative AI capabilities, including RAG, knowledge grounding, tool calling, conversational AI, automation, and guardrails.
  • Integrate CCaaS platforms with CRM, workforce management, analytics, knowledge management, and enterprise applications.
  • Support architecture decisions related to APIs, event-driven integrations, data flows, security, monitoring, and scalability.
  • Contribute to technical estimates, delivery plans, testing strategies, deployment activities, and production support.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate resolution across client and delivery teams.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Provide day-to-day technical guidance to team members and mentor junior practitioners.
  • Support proposals, demonstrations, platform assessments, and solution trade-off discussions.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  •   Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  •   Effective written and verbal communication skills
  •   Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  •   Ability to build and sustain professional relationship
  •   Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  •   Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  •   Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  •   Ability to meet deadlines
  •   Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in technology consulting, software engineering, cloud architecture, or enterprise solution delivery.
  • 3+ years of experience designing or implementing AWS-based solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more major CCaaS platforms, with working knowledge of others, including:
    • NICE CXone
    • Five9
    • Amazon Connect
    • Genesys Cloud
  • Experience with CCaaS configuration, integrations, APIs, routing, workflows, reporting, or administration.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures, APIs, event-driven solutions, CI/CD, automated testing, source control, and Agile delivery.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience
  • Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

  • Production experience with Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, and/or Amazon Bedrock.
  • Experience with NICE CXone, Five9, and Genesys Cloud implementations or platform evaluations.
  • Experience with IAM, VPCs, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch, and other AWS security and observability capabilities.
  • Experience integrating CCaaS platforms with Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics, or other enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with Google Gemini, Vertex AI, and/or Dialogflow.
  • Experience supporting Contact Center AI use cases from design through adoption.
  • Experience preparing architecture diagrams, interface specifications, technical runbooks, test plans, and deployment documentation.
  • Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and SDLC methodologies.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $130,00 to $200,000.

Position Summary

Today’s chief financial officers (CFOs) and supply chain executives are being asked to improve business performance and shareholder value, along with operational effectiveness and efficiency. Deloitte Oracle Generative AI Architect Managers help clients delineate strategy and vision, design and implement process and systems which align with business objectives and have a measurable impact on growth. Do you want to be a part of a team that transforms the business landscape for its clients? Do you want to be on the winning team that drives transformation, improves productivity, and streamlines business operations with AI? Do you feel your skills surpass those of your peers and colleagues? If your answer is yes to all these questions, it’s very nice to meet you and we want to hear from you immediately!

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Oracle Gen AI Architect Manager on the Oracle team, you will translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions using Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services and modern AI frameworks. You will help organizations improve automation, insight, and operational efficiency while applying emerging technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, Google Cloud Agent Space, LangGraph, Glean, and other enterprise AI platforms to drive business value.

Full job description

Position Summary

Step into a role where you will help shape the future of finance. As part of Deloitte’s Finance Operate team, you will work with CFOs, controllers, and finance leaders to address complex finance and accounting challenges through scalable managed services solutions. Leveraging Deloitte’s industry experience, technology ecosystem, and delivery capabilities, you will help clients modernize finance operations, strengthen controls and reporting, and drive better business outcomes.

Recruiting for this role ends 12/31/2026.

As a Senior Manager, Solution Delivery in our Finance Operate practice, you will lead the growth of our Controllership / Record-to-Report managed services offering in the Technology, Media & Telecom Industry. You’ll lead client solutions and sales pursuits, advise senior leaders, oversee mobilization and delivery excellence, and contribute to account growth and market development.

This role combines accounting domain expertise, managed services solutioning, Technology, Media & Telecom Industry experience, commercial acumen, executive presence, and strong client and team leadership.

Work You’ll Do

As a Senior Manager, Solution Delivery, you will:

  • Lead and shape managed services solutions for Controllership / Record-to-Report opportunities within the Technology, Media & Telecom Industry.
  • Lead business development activities, sales pursuits, proposal development, client presentations, pre-request for proposal materials, and request for proposal responses for Finance Operate opportunities.
  • Provide senior leadership for Finance Operate deal flow for the Technology, Media & Telecom sector, including pipeline visibility, opportunity qualification, pursuit prioritization, solution governance, and handoff to mobilization and delivery teams.
  • Partner with senior Deloitte leaders to develop differentiated client solutions, operating models, delivery approaches, commercial strategies, and value propositions.
  • Provide senior oversight for engagement mobilization and ongoing delivery, including governance setup, transition planning, service management, issue resolution, operational reporting, and quality management.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to CFOs, controllers, and finance leaders on controllership modernization, Record-to-Report transformation, finance operating models, and managed services.
  • Drive continuous improvement, standardization, automation, and technology enablement across finance operations engagements.
  • Lead, coach, and develop teams while building capabilities across the Finance Operate practice.
  • Contribute to account development, market development, internal knowledge sharing, and the continued growth of Deloitte’s Finance Operate offering.

  • Ability to lead complex pursuits, client engagements, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong executive presence and effective written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to build and sustain trusted relationships with clients, senior stakeholders, and internal leaders.
  • Demonstrated commercial judgment and ability to connect client needs to scalable managed services solutions.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Ability to lead teams, workstreams, and stakeholders toward shared outcomes.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor.
  • Ability to identify risks, resolve issues, and make sound decisions.
  • Ability to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to mentor, coach, and provide clear guidance to others.

The team

Our Finance Operate offering provides ongoing operation of the finance function as an extension of Deloitte’s broader Finance Transformation portfolio. We help organizations improve finance performance through managed services across key domains such as Controllership / Record-to-Report, FP&A, Treasury, and Finance Technology. Our professionals combine finance domain expertise, operational discipline, technology-enabled delivery, and deep industry experiences to help clients achieve sustainable outcomes at scale.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in accounting, financial reporting, controllership, Record-to-Report operations, or finance transformation.
  • 6+ years of experience in managed services, shared services, outsourced delivery, or finance operations.
  • 6+ years of experience working within the Technology, Media & Telecom Industry or serving Technology, Media & Telecom clients.
  • Experience leading or significantly contributing to solutioning, sales pursuits, transition, mobilization, or delivery for finance managed services.
  • Experience leading client-facing workstreams, complex projects, or cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with and influence senior client and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Active Certified Public Accountant license.
  • 12+ years of experience in finance, controllership, managed services, or solution delivery.
  • Experience leading RFP responses, proposal development, pricing inputs, business cases, or commercial solutioning.
  • Experience in audit, controllership, or finance transformation.
  • Experience with enterprise resource planning platforms or finance technologies, including SAP, Oracle, Workday, BlackLine, or OneStream.
  • Experience leading process improvement, automation, standardization, or service delivery transformation initiatives.
  • Experience establishing governance models, performance metrics, service-level reporting, and operating procedures.
  • Experience hiring, developing, mentoring, and leading high-performing teams.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Manager, Finance Managed Services - Controllership & Record-to-Report | Consumer Industry
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $148,200 to $292,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Experience: 12+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Manager role leading Controllership and Record-to-Report managed services for Life Sciences and Health Care clients at Deloitte. Responsibilities include client solutioning, sales pursuits, delivery oversight, and team leadership for finance transformation engagements.

Good fit if you have 12+ years finance/accounting experience, 8+ years managed services background, 6+ years Life Sciences or Health Care industry experience, and can travel 50%.

Full job description

Position Summary

Step into a role where you will help shape the future of finance. As part of Deloitte’s Finance Operate team, you will work with CFOs, controllers, and finance leaders to address complex finance and accounting challenges through scalable managed services solutions. Leveraging Deloitte’s industry experience, technology ecosystem, and delivery capabilities, you will help clients modernize finance operations, strengthen controls and reporting, and drive better business outcomes.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

As a Senior Manager, Solution Delivery in our Finance Operate practice, you will lead the growth of our Controllership / Record-to-Report managed services offering in the Life Sciences & Health Care Industry. You’ll lead client solutioning and sales pursuits, advise senior leaders, oversee mobilization and delivery excellence, and contribute to account growth and market development.

This role combines accounting domain expertise, managed services solutioning, Life Sciences & Health Care Industry experience, commercial acumen, executive presence, and strong client and team leadership.

Work You’ll Do

As a Senior Manager, Solution Delivery, you will:

  • Lead and shape managed services solutions for Controllership / Record-to-Report opportunities within the Life Sciences & Health Care Industry.
  • Lead business development activities, sales pursuits, proposal development, client presentations, pre-RFP materials, and RFP responses for Finance Operate opportunities.
  • Provide senior leadership for Finance Operate deal flow for the Life Sciences & Health Care sector, including pipeline visibility, opportunity qualification, pursuit prioritization, solution governance, and handoff to mobilization and delivery teams.
  • Partner with senior Deloitte leaders to develop differentiated client solutions, operating models, delivery approaches, commercial strategies, and value propositions.
  • Provide senior oversight for engagement mobilization and ongoing delivery, including governance setup, transition planning, service management, issue resolution, operational reporting, and quality management.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to CFOs, controllers, and finance leaders on controllership modernization, Record-to-Report transformation, finance operating models, and managed services.
  • Drive continuous improvement, standardization, automation, and technology enablement across finance operations engagements.
  • Lead, coach, and develop teams while building capabilities across the Finance Operate practice.
  • Contribute to account development, market development, internal knowledge sharing, and the continued growth of Deloitte’s Finance Operate offering.

A successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to lead complex pursuits, client engagements, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong executive presence and effective written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to build and sustain trusted relationships with clients, senior stakeholders, and internal leaders.
  • Demonstrated commercial judgment and ability to connect client needs to scalable managed services solutions.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Ability to lead teams, workstreams, and stakeholders toward shared outcomes.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor.
  • Ability to identify risks, resolve issues, and make sound decisions.
  • Ability to mentor, coach, and provide clear guidance to others.

The team

Our Finance Operate offering provides ongoing operation of the finance function as an extension of Deloitte’s broader Finance Transformation portfolio. We help organizations improve finance performance through managed services across key domains such as Controllership / Record-to-Report, FP&A, Treasury, and Finance Technology. Our professionals combine finance domain expertise, operational discipline, technology-enabled delivery, and deep industry experiences to help clients achieve sustainable outcomes at scale.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of experience in accounting, financial reporting, controllership, Record-to-Report operations, finance transformation, or related finance leadership.
  • 8+ years of experience in managed services, shared services, outsourced delivery, finance operations, consulting, or related operating-model environments.
  • 6+ years of experience working within the Life Sciences & Health Care Industry or serving Life Sciences & Health Care clients.
  • Experience leading or significantly contributing to solutioning, sales pursuits, transition, mobilization, or delivery for finance managed services.
  • Experience leading client-facing workstreams, complex projects, or cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with and influence senior client and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Active Certified Public Accountant license.
  • 15+ years of experience in finance, controllership, managed services, finance transformation, or solution delivery.
  • Experience in audit, controllership, or finance transformation.
  • Experience leading RFP responses, proposal development, pricing inputs, business cases, or commercial solutioning.
  • Experience with enterprise resource planning platforms or finance technologies, including SAP, Oracle, Workday, BlackLine, or OneStream.
  • Experience leading process improvement, automation, standardization, or service delivery transformation initiatives.
  • Experience establishing governance models, performance metrics, service-level reporting, and operating procedures.
  • Experience hiring, developing, mentoring, and leading high-performing teams.

Position Summary

Data Privacy Manager

As a Manager in Deloitte’s Digital Trust & Privacy practice, you will lead the discovery, design, and implementation of privacy technology solutions that help organizations address regulatory requirements, strengthen data governance, and enable trusted business outcomes. You will contribute configuration, integration, testing, and deployment activities while working with client, vendor, and cross-functional teams. This role offers the opportunity to take on increased ownership in privacy-by-design initiatives, Consent & Preference Management, and AI governance efforts, and large-scale technology implementations.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you’ll do

Design:

  • Strategize with clients to identify privacy technology gaps that can be addressed with technology to enable future state privacy goals.
  • Lead working sessions with client stakeholders to gather technical, functional, and business requirements and establish use cases to inform future state architecture.

Architect:

  • Navigate complex IT architectures to incorporate privacy technology solutions.
  • General awareness of global and domestic privacy regulations and concepts, and how they relate to the deployment of technology in line with applicable laws and regulations.
  • General knowledge of integrating technologies with third-party tools and APIs.

Implement:

  • Configure, integrate, test, and deploy privacy tools and technologies to help clients automate their privacy capabilities and enhance customer experiences.
  • Familiar with change management, test plan design and backout plans.
  • Coordinate with client stakeholders and technology vendor representatives to clarify queries, troubleshoot implementation issues, and test end-to-end deployment and system integrations.

Manage:

  • Manage and execute project activities across the IT Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including leading regular check-ins with team members and vendors
  • Lead a cross-functional group of client stakeholders to meet their unique needs in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work alongside practice leaders and experienced privacy technology professionals gaining industry-leading insights into data privacy.
  • Develop and maintain technical configuration documentation.
  • Manage and provide technical oversight to solution deployment and rollout.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or similar Engineering disciplines
  • 7+ years of experience in software design, architecture development, and technology implementation
  • 4+ years of experience with Data Privacy principles such as Privacy Impact Assessment, Data Inventory, Privacy Breach Management, Data Subject Rights, Notice & Policy Management, Consent & Preference Management, Cookie Management, etc.
  • Ability to travel 25-75%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Experience leading collaborative efforts across organizational silos, including multifunctional teams of IT professionals, legal/compliance teams, and business executives
  • Familiarity with change management, deployment and operational processes in large IT organizations
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred Qualifications: 

Technical skills

  • Understand marketing technologies, including customer data platforms, consent, cookies, tag management solutions
  • Ability to understand, develop and enhance existing client architectures and solution designs to meet data privacy requirements
  • Prior experience in performing SaaS implementations for complex organizations and IT ecosystems.
  • Ability to comprehend and execute basic technology concepts such as Application Programming Interfaces (API’s), system requests methods (GET/POST), etc.
  • Demonstrated experience in performing integrations with Marketing Platforms (e.g., Sales Force Marketing Cloud), Master Data Management (e.g., Informatica MDM), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), and middleware (MuleSoft, Kafka)
  • 4+ years of experience implementing privacy solutions such as OneTrust, BigID, Securiti.ai
  • Hands-on experience and knowledge of software engineering concepts/technologies, such as:
    • JavaScript, RESTful APIs, HTTP Requests, JDBC, HTML CSS
    • SQL, NoSQL, database management concepts
    • API management tools such as Apigee, Postman
    • Agile/Scrum methodology to build and rollout complex software solutions
  • Understanding of privacy program requirements and capabilities such as data inventory, data subject rights, consent and preference management, privacy by design, privacy impact assessments, incident response, third-party risk, etc.
  • Knowledge of Data Privacy Laws and Regulations: Familiarity with data privacy legislation such as GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and other regional or industry-specific privacy regulations.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively articulate complex privacy concepts to business-facing audiences, such as clients and other team members.
  • Project Management Experience: Experience in managing projects, including planning, risk management, resource management, and meeting project timelines.
  • Teamwork and Collaboration: Proven experience in working effectively with diverse teams.
  • Change Management: Understanding of change management principles and approaches, to enable successful implementation and adoption of privacy solutions.
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or similar Engineering disciplines
  • Certifications in one or more of the following: CIPT, CIPM, CISSP, CPDSE, CIPT, Agile/Scrum Master
  • Experience with application development and testing using one or more programming or scripting languages (e.g., .Net, C#, Python)
  • Understanding of Ad-Tech / Mar-Tech ecosystem, frameworks, tools, and solutions

About this job

Lead client engagements on profitability and financial analytics challenges, designing and implementing costing methodologies and SAP PaPM solutions. Work with industry leaders to strengthen analytical skills while developing data-driven solutions for finance transformation.

Good fit if you have 6+ years in profitability reporting or management consulting, 4+ years with SAP PaPM and cost modeling, and can lead projects and teams.

Full job description

Position Summary


In an increasingly challenging environment marked by disruptive tech like AI, market uncertainty, and regulatory change, finance and global business services leaders recognize the opportunity to better serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Deloitte helps navigate this complexity by bringing deep industry insights and integrated solutions to achieve business objectives. From strategy to technology to operations, and across workforce, risk, assurance, and tax, Deloitte helps drive value along the Finance Transformation journey.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Manager, Strategy, Growth on the Business Finance team, you will work with industry leaders to strengthen your analytical and industry skills while developing and implementing innovative solutions that help clients address complex profitability and financial analytics challenges.

  • Lead client engagements to solve complex business challenges related to finance transformation, profitability, and financial analytics
  • Manage and analyze structured and unstructured data and translate findings into insights that support business decision-making
  • Drive SAP Profitability and Performance Management (PaPM) and analytics solutions to deliver strategic business insights
  • Lead the design and implementation of profitability and costing methodologies aligned to business and finance objectives
  • Steer the development and deployment of technology-driven solutions while managing project execution, client deliverables, and stakeholder coordination

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Finance Transformation offering helps finance and global business services leaders respond to disruption driven by artificial intelligence, market uncertainty, and regulatory change while improving how they serve the enterprise, shareholders, customers, and regulators.

Within that offering, the Business Finance team helps organizations create strategic value through financial planning, forecasting, and analytics capabilities. By combining next-generation processes, scalable data platforms, and artificial intelligence, the team delivers accurate, timely, and actionable insights.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of experience in profitability reporting, costing, allocations, finance transformation, financial planning and analysis, or management consulting
  • 4+ years of experience extracting, transforming, and analyzing data sets from multiple sources
  • 4+ years of experience building cost and profitability models and using SAP Profitability and Performance Management (PaPM) or other profitability analytics solutions
  • 4+ years of experience working with SAP S/4HANA and/or Oracle
  • 3+ years of experience leading project workstreams, client deliverables, and junior team members
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Master of Business Administration, Master of Finance, Master of Accounting, or master's degree in Data Analytics or Information Systems
  • Experience implementing SAP Profitability and Performance Management (PaPM)
  • Experience with profitability reporting, cost allocations, and costing frameworks
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance, Oracle, or enterprise performance management platforms

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Specialist Manager, Government Client Contracts Management supports strategic federal contract administration activities across complex, high-value engagements that directly affect revenue generation and retention. This role advises account leadership on contract strategy, supports compliant execution across the contract lifecycle, and leads analysis and resolution of complex contractual matters. The role also drives negotiation, portfolio oversight, and operational coordination across internal stakeholders.

While all locations will be considered, this role offers a flexible hybrid scheduled with candidates based in Washington, D.C. or Arlington, VA (or nearby) preferred. 

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/01/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Specialist Manager, Government Client Contracts Management on the Enterprise Contract Management & Operations team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading proposal, award, and contract administration activities for complex federal contracts across the contract lifecycle
  • Reviewing contract actions, identifying contractual risks and opportunities, and implementing action plans to support compliant execution
  • Advising project and account leadership on contract strategy, negotiations, and issue resolution for strategic government engagements
  • Monitoring contract portfolios, pipeline activity, and contract performance to support revenue retention and operational execution
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders to maintain contract data, resolve discrepancies, and support accurate documentation and reporting

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

The team

The Enterprise Contract Management & Operations team is responsible for contract administration activities supporting strategic enterprise contract vehicles across Deloitte’s Government and Public Services practice. This role will work directly with Contracts professionals, Project Engagement Leadership, Enabling Solutions points of contact, and other internal stakeholders to coordinate the information and decisions required to support compliant contract management and operational execution

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Legal Studies, or another business discipline
  • 8+ years of experience managing multiple federal contract types, including cost-plus-fixed-fee, cost-plus-incentive-fee, cost-plus-award-fee, firm-fixed-price level-of-effort, time-and-materials, and firm-fixed-price contracts or commensurate experience.
  • Experience supporting federal clients, including Department of War (DoW)/Department of Defense (DoD) Agencies
  • Experience leading projects with organizational impact
  • Experience developing, submitting, and negotiating governmentwide contract vehicles
  • Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Advanced Degree such as Master of Business Administration, Master of Science degree, or Juris Doctor
  • National Contract Management Association certification, including Certified Federal Contracts Manager, Certified Commercial Contracts Manager, or Certified Professional Contracts Manager
  • Experience in a professional services organization
  • Demonstrated experience managing both prime federal contracts and downstream federal subcontracts or vendor procurement operations governed under federal regulations and procedures
  • Experience managing junior team members

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. Job.JobTitle: Manufacturing Technology and Industrial Data Delivery Leader
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Delivery Leader – Senior Manager

Overview

Industrial Data Operations turns decades of disconnected, uncontextualized plant data into the foundation clients need for AI, automation, and modernization. That foundation work only holds up if the person leading it has lived on both sides of the OT/IT line. This role is for that person: a client-facing, team-building, sell-and-deliver leader with real operations and industrial data experience who can shape a practice that's still being built while running live client work.

This is succession leverage for the practice's current bridge leader. You inherit engagements already in motion, not a blank page — and the room to build the team and offer as the practice scales.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 5th , 2027.

Responsibilities

  • Own client relationships end-to-end: trusted advisor to plant, operations, IT, and data leadership, not just a delivery contact
  • Sell and shape new work: lead pursuits, build the business case, close engagements
  • Lead delivery across multiple concurrent engagements, accountable for outcomes, quality, and client satisfaction
  • Build and grow the practitioner team: recruit, coach, develop, and retain
  • Move fluidly between strategy and execution — set the direction on an engagement and roll up sleeves when the team needs it
  • Advise on governance, stewardship, and organizational design across the IT/OT boundary
  • Bring real OT and industrial data grounding to every conversation: credible with a plant engineer, credible with a CIO
  • Shape the IDO offer and point of view as the practice matures, informed by what's actually working in the field
  • Represent IDO externally: alliances, industry forums, eminence content

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of real experience in industrial operations, OT/process control, industrial data, or IT/OT convergence — not adjacent, not academic, actually done the work
  • 5+ years in a client-facing leadership role: sold work, ran client relationships, led delivery teams
  • 5+ years demonstrating ability to operate across strategy and implementation — has set direction and has also delivered
  • Track record building or growing a team or practice, not just staffing one
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Ability to travel an average of 50% of working time based on client and industry needs
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or at any time in the future

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background spanning more than one of: plant/operations leadership, industrial automation vendor (sales engineering, solution architecture), OT-focused systems integrator, or consulting delivery — breadth matters more than any single path
  • Direct experience with plant floor systems and standards (ISA-95, OPC UA, historians) — enough to be dangerous, not necessarily the expert in the room
  • Direct experience with industrial data platforms, cloud, data and tools (representative: Cognite, HighByte, AVEVA, Databricks, Snowflake, Palantir, AWS, GCP)
  • Experience navigating or advising on data governance and org structure questions across IT and OT
  • Comfortable partnering with platform-specific architects and alliance teams without needing to own that depth personally
  • Prior experience building or scaling a practice, offering, or new capability inside a larger organization
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity: this practice is still being built, and the role requires shaping it while delivering

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $189,200 - $372,900.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Manufacturing Technology and Industrial Data Delivery Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $155,600 to $306,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 8+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Lead delivery execution for industrial data and analytics engagements at Deloitte's Industrial Data Operations practice in Jacksonville. Own design oversight of data integration between operational technology sources and cloud platforms, coordinating onshore and offshore teams while managing client communications.

Good fit if you have 8+ years as a data platform architect or senior data engineer, 5+ years leading industrial data or manufacturing analytics delivery, and experience with cloud platforms and Databricks/AWS.

Full job description

Position Summary

IDO Delivery Manager

Deloitte’s Industrial Data Operations (IDO) practice helps clients turn plant-floor data into a trusted, reusable enterprise asset that powers operational excellence, connected enterprises, and digital transformation. We bring together people, processes, and technology to connect industrial assets and systems, contextualize data across IT and OT environments, govern data quality and access, and deliver reliable information for analytics and decision-making. Our work enables capabilities such as production performance, factory synchronization, predictive maintenance, supply chain visibility, digital twins, and AI-enabled manufacturing applications—creating the scalable data foundation organizations need to move beyond brittle point-to-point solutions and realize value from their digital investments.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 5th , 2027

Work you'll do

In this role, you will lead core delivery execution for industrial data and analytics engagements, coordinating onshore and offshore teams while managing clear, client-facing delivery communications. You will help translate technical work into practical delivery plans, keep execution moving across teams, and support alignment between client stakeholders, delivery teams, and platform partners.

You will own the design oversight of the data integration layer between operational technology (OT) sources and cloud analytics platforms, including lakehouse schemas, time-series mapping, cloud landing zone architecture, and pipeline patterns. This role requires enough hands-on data platform depth to review offshore data engineering output, identify architectural risks, and guide corrections. Early in engagements, you may coordinate with Databricks and AWS alliance solution architects for platform-specific design input. The ideal background is a data platform architect or senior data engineer who has led delivery on industrial data or manufacturing analytics programs and moved into delivery leadership from a technical foundation.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!

Qualifications

Required:

  • 8+ years of experience as a data platform architect, senior data engineer, or similar technical delivery leader.
  • 5+ years leading delivery on industrial data, manufacturing analytics, operational technology (OT), or related data platform programs.
  • 5+ years managing execution across multiple workstreams while maintaining focus on architecture quality and delivery outcomes.
  • 5+ years working with cloud data platforms and hyperscaler ecosystems, with 2+ years of exposure to Databricks and AWS preferred.
  • 8+ years of total experience in consulting and/or industry, including 3+ years of technical delivery leadership following a data architecture or engineering background.
  • 3+ years coordinating or leading work across onshore and offshore delivery teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related field, or at least 8 years of equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to travel an average of 50% of working time based on client and industry needs.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or at any time in the future.

 Preferred:

  • Comfortable coordinating with platform solution architects or alliance teams for platform-specific design support.
  • Strong client communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Data integration patterns between OT source systems and cloud analytics platforms.
  • Experience designing or overseeing lakehouse schemas, time-series data mapping, cloud landing zone architecture, and data pipeline patterns.
  • Ability to review data engineering deliverables in enough technical depth to identify architectural issues, integration risks, and design gaps.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $155,600 to $306,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Position Summary

Manager/Solution Architect

Deloitte’s Industrial Data Operations (IDO) practice helps clients turn plant-floor data into a trusted, reusable enterprise asset that powers operational excellence, connected enterprises, and digital transformation. We bring together people, processes, and technology to connect industrial assets and systems, contextualize data across IT and OT environments, govern data quality and access, and deliver reliable information for analytics and decision-making. Our work enables capabilities such as production performance, factory synchronization, predictive maintenance, supply chain visibility, digital twins, and AI-enabled manufacturing applications—creating the scalable data foundation organizations need to move beyond brittle point-to-point solutions and realize value from their digital investments.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 5th , 2027.

Work you'll do

You will serve as the platform-agnostic industrial data architecture authority, leading foundation advisory and implementation workstreams across operational technology (OT), edge, and enterprise environments. You will define the OT-up architecture, including Unified Namespace (UNS) design, ISA-95 asset modeling, contextualization strategy, and integration topology across historian systems, edge platforms, and enterprise systems. You will also act as the technical voice in vice president- and director-level client conversations, translating plant-floor realities into practical architecture decisions.

In this role, you will partner closely with delivery leadership, handing off the cloud data platform layer to the Delivery Manager while continuing to guide the industrial data architecture. On Cognite Data Fusion (CDF) engagements, you will work with the Cognite Platform Architect to align architecture decisions with platform capabilities. This role is designed for someone with a controls or automation background who has moved into data architecture, or an OT integration lead from a vendor or systems integrator environment. You should be comfortable walking a plant floor, reading a piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID), and translating between operations and IT, with deep familiarity in at least two of the following: ISA-95/ISA-88 standards, OPC UA/UNS, historian systems, or edge platforms.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in controls/automation engineering, OT integration, or industrial data architecture, including 5+ years leading architecture work across OT, edge, and enterprise environments and experience with a vendor or systems integrator.
  • 5+ years defining OT-up architecture, including 2+ years designing UNS architecture and ISA-95 asset models from scratch.
  • 5+ years designing connections among historian systems, edge platforms, and enterprise systems within industrial data architectures.
  • 5+ years leading foundation advisory and implementation workstreams for industrial data or OT integration programs.
  • Ability to serve as the technical voice in vice president- and director-level client conversations.
  • 5+ years translating between operations/OT and IT/enterprise stakeholders.
  • 3+ years of firsthand plant-floor experience, including reading and working from P&IDs.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with two or more of the following: ISA-95/ISA-88, OPC UA/UNS, historian systems, or edge platforms.
  • 5+ years maintaining a platform-agnostic architecture perspective while aligning designs to implementation needs.
  • 3+ years coordinating architecture handoffs to cloud data platform delivery leaders.
  • 3+ years partnering with platform architects, including Cognite Platform Architects on Cognite Data Fusion engagements where applicable.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Industrial/Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field, or at least 8 years of equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to travel an average of 50% of working time based on client and industry needs.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Comfortable coordinating with platform solution architects or alliance teams for platform-specific design support.
  • Strong client communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Data integration patterns between OT source systems and cloud analytics platforms.
  • Experience designing or overseeing lakehouse schemas, time-series data mapping, cloud landing zone architecture, and data pipeline patterns.
  • Ability to review data engineering deliverables in enough technical depth to identify architectural issues, integration risks, and design gaps.

Job ID 366430

Quick facts

About this job

Creative Operations Lead manages end-to-end creative workflow for a high-volume CRM account covering email and direct mail. The role handles project timelines, resource planning, quality assurance, and coordination using Workfront, with a Project Delivery Model designed for long-term onsite work with limited travel.

Good fit if you have 5+ years managing creative resources and workflows in agencies, with experience in project management platforms and hybrid teams.

Full job description

Position Summary

Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Sr. Creative Operations Consultant, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long-term, onsite client service delivery.

Work you’ll do/Responsibilities  

  • The Creative Operations Lead owns the end-to-end creative workflow for a high-volume CRM account spanning email and direct mail, driving projects from brief through creative approval with precision and accountability.
  • Day-to-day, this role manages creative timelines, tracks review cycles, and monitors task progress in Workfront — running daily standups and following up proactively to keep campaigns on track.
  • On the people side, the Creative Operations Lead handles pod capacity planning and resource assignments, identifying constraints, surfacing blockers, and building contingency coverage for competing priorities or PTO.
  • From a production standpoint, this role owns creative QA/readiness for handoff to campaign operations to start build process — maintaining version control, troubleshooting file issues, managing image licensing, and applying knowledge of email and direct mail specs and best practices.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Recruiting for this role ends on December 31st 2026.

The Team 

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Our Digital Foundry & Operations works with the Customer group to bring a flexible capability and fluid capacity model to the delivery of small technology projects and enhancements.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of experience managing creative resources, workflows, and output in high-volume settings
  • 5+ years of experience with email and direct mail creative development and deployment
  • 5+ years of experience with project management platforms (e.g. Workfront, Jira, etc.)
  • 5+ years of experience in an agency environment
  • 5+ years of experience working with hybrid onshore/offshore teams
  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred

  • Analytical/ Decision Making Responsibilities
  • Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products
  • Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
  • Excellent Written and Communication Skills
  • Ability to deliver technical demonstrations

Requisition code: 366333
Job ID 366333

Quick facts

  • Pay: $134,500 to $265,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Experience: 6+ years

About this job

Lead Microsoft 365 security projects for Deloitte's enterprise clients, managing cloud risk across platforms like Entra ID, Defender, Sentinel, and Purview. Oversee engineers and architects while serving as primary client contact for security analysis, deployment, and technical support.

Good fit if you have 6+ years in Microsoft 365 enterprise services, systems management, or endpoint security with consulting and project leadership experience.

Full job description

Position Summary

M365 Security - Manager / Manager, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Work you’ll do

As a Microsoft 365 Security Manager, you will be at the front lines with our clients supporting them with their Cloud Cyber Risk needs specifically helping them navigate the journey on securing their Microsoft 365 (M365) platform. This will include:

  • Lead projects and/or also function as project lead architect with the following Microsoft technologies: Purview, Intune, Sentinel, Entra ID, Defender for Office, Defender for Endpoints and Servers, Defender for Vulnerabilities, Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender XDR and SCCM
  • Assist in business development activities such as defining scope of services, building resource estimates and related pricing, packaging proposals and supporting the delivery of the proposal to the client for M355 security services.
  • Lead the delivery of cloud security analysis, recommendations and configurations of prospective clients’ Microsoft Entra ID, Office 365 (O365), Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive for Business, M365 Copilot and SharePoint Online environments based on Deloitte’s Microsoft 365 Cyber Risk Framework. This can include leveraging Microsoft’s security solutions such as Entra, Purview, Defender, Intune, and Sentinel.
  • Oversee day-to-day activities of both onsite and offshore engineers and architects.
  • Function as the primary client day-to-day interface building rapport and trust with the client.
  • Perform technical health checks for these M365 platforms/environments prior to broader deployments.
  • Assist clients with transitions to the Microsoft 365 security services such as solution setup and service configuration, focused on risk mitigation. Additional technologies include MFA, Conditional Access, Purview Compliance Manager, M365 Defender, Defender for O365, Defender for Cloud Apps (MDCA), Purview Information Protection (MPIP), Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP).
  • Provide technical support for M365 E5 security services and resolve service-related issues through research and troubleshooting and working with Microsoft.
  • Implement industry leading practices around M365 E5 cyber risks and cloud security for clients.
  • Design and develop cloud-specific security policies, standards and procedures e.g., O365 tenant management and configuration, identify management and access control, auditing and monitoring, security incident and event management, data protection (classification/labeling, DLP, encryption), user and administrator account management, SSO, conditional access controls and password/key management.
  • Troubleshoot system level problems in a multi-vendor, multi-protocol network environment.
  • Document platform technical issues, analysis, client communication, and resolution as part of cyber risk mitigation steps.
  • Execute on M365 security engagements during different phases of the lifecycle – Discover, Assess, Design, Deploy/Test, Hypercare/Handover.
  • Provide internal technical training to Advisory personnel as needed.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on cloud cyber risk for Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Sentinel capabilities.
  • Manage to Point-of-Views (PoVs) on providing leading practices to our clients on the M365 security challenges they face.
  • Contribute to eminence activities, such as whitepapers pertaining to Microsoft 365 security capabilities.
  • Support talent process in the manager role such as for recruiting and coaching.

The team

Our Enterprise Security offering embeds security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client’s technical backbone while enabling secure digital transformation. Includes security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Required Qualifications:

Working experience in at least two of the areas listed below.

  • 6+ years of experience in technical consulting, client problem solving, architecting and designing solutions in a consulting role with project leadership and/or architect experience.
  • 6+ years of hands-on technical experience with Microsoft 365 enterprise-level messaging and collaboration services (Teams, OneDrive for Business, Exchange Online, Entra ID, SharePoint Online, O365 administration and setup) in implementation and operations.
  • 6+ years of hands-on technical experience with enterprise-level systems management systems such as SCCM and Intune and endpoint engineering (MEM) and mobile device management (MAM & MDM)) implementation or operations.
  • 6+ years of hands-on technical and project / professional experience enterprise-with at least two of the following technologies: Microsoft Endpoint Security Platforms (e.g. Defender for Endpoints and Defender for Servers), Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft’s email security platform (Defender for Office), Microsoft Purview & Entra ID

Ideally the following technical experience is a plus in any of the technologies below:

  • Microsoft Security Copilot
  • Defender for Vulnerabilities
  • Defender for Cloud Apps
  • Defender XDR
  • SCCM

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be willing to travel up to 50% within North America.
  • Limited Sponsorship may be available.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • BA/BS Degree preferred. Ideally in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology.
  • Microsoft Certifications such as: (SC-900, SC-100, SC-200, SC-300, SC-400),
  • Cyber Certifications such as: CCSP, CCSK, CISSP, CCNP, and CCNA.

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Technology, Finance, or Business
  • 2+ years of experience supporting ServiceNow implementation projects in a client-facing consulting role
  • 2+ years of experience gathering business requirements, facilitating workshops, documenting process flows or user stories, and producing functional documentation
  • 2+ years of experience designing, configuring, or implementing ServiceNow solutions in one or more of the following modules: IT Operations Management, IT Asset Management, Integrated Risk Management, Security Operations, or Third-Party Risk Management
  • 2+ years of experience configuring ServiceNow forms, workflows, notifications, service level agreements, reports, dashboards, roles, or access controls
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  • Architecture Excellence (ArchX)
  • One or more ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications, including Risk and Compliance (CIS-RC), Security Incident Response (CIS-SIR), Vulnerability Response (CIS-VR), Third-Party Risk Management (CIS-TPRM), Hardware Asset Management (CIS-HAM), Software Asset Management (CIS-SAM), Service Mapping (CIS-SM), Discovery (CIS-DISCO), Event Management (CIS-EM), Data Foundations (CIS-DF), or Strategic Portfolio Management (CIS-SPM)
  • Experience supporting implementation and configuration of ServiceNow AI Control Tower capabilities, including inventory management, intake and approval workflows, lifecycle oversight, issue management, dashboards, and reporting

Possesses a strong working knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulations, and commercial contracting principles. Supports the execution of all facets of the contract life cycle. Performs contract administration duties for federal contracts and ensures the accuracy of the contracts and financial systems. Exercises increased independence and judgment in reviewing and analyzing moderately complex contracts actions. Maintains a keen awareness of requirements and status associated with assigned contracts. Effectively, manages personal portfolio and advises account teams on contracts administration matters. Compiles and analyzes contract related data; and maintains historical information and documentation.

  • Support contract administration activities for strategic enterprise contract vehicles across Deloitte’s Government and Public Services practice.

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in contract management, contract administration, or government contracting support
  • 2+ years of experience supporting enterprise contract vehicles, task orders, contract modifications, or contract administration workflows

Lead Architect role designing and building enterprise-grade agentic AI systems using Anthropic's Claude models for large organizations. You'll integrate LLMs into production applications, deploy on cloud platforms, and ensure security and scalability across multi-agent systems.

Good fit if you have 8+ years as an architect, 6+ years delivering production AI/ML solutions, 1+ year with Claude and agentic AI systems, and hyperscaler certifications.

Full job description

Position Summary

Lead Architect with Agentic AI Experience, AI & Engineering/Engineering as a Service

Agentic AI is moving from experimentation to production, and organizations everywhere are racing to figure out how to build it responsibly and at scale. We're growing a team of engineers who want to work at the center of that shift: designing and building autonomous, multi-agent systems powered by Anthropic's Claude models for some of the world's largest organizations.

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/1/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Architect with Anthropic experience, AI & Engineering on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and developing enterprise-grade Anthropic applications and platforms,  selecting technologies and ensuring solutions are robust, scalable and secure.  You will:

  • Integrate and fine-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) and other AI/ML models into enterprise applications. Develop and implement strategies for model deployment, inference and monitoring, with an emphasis on production level performance and reliability
  • Collaborate with enterprise architects to ensure AI solutions align with the broader company’s technical strategy, governance and standards
  • Design and deploy applications using Cloud Native principles on a hyperscaler platform (AWS, Azure, GCP). Leverage a wide range of hyperscaler tools and services including containers (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless functions, and managed databases.
  • Ensure the security of all AI/ML systems by addressing potential vulnerabilities such as data privacy concerns, model poisoning, and adversarial attacks
  • Apply and enforce application design patterns and agentic design patterns to build resilient and maintainable software systems
  • workflows, and automation solutions.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 8 or more years experience as a Solution or Application Architect with a strong focus on application development
  • 8+ years of hand-on experience in Java, .NET or Python
  • Hyperscaler architect certifications – AWS Certified Solution Architect, Azure Solution Architect, or GCP Professional Cloud Architect
