Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Louisville, KY
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!


As a Large Loss Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.  

Preferred Qualifications:


  • 4-5 years’ previous experience as an outside property adjuster is highly desired.
  • Experience handling claims with multiple trades and over $100,000 in losses
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • Reside within 40 miles of Louisville, KY
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

·         

Required Qualifications:


  • Must be able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access roofs with up to a 6/12 pitch.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

You’re provided with comprehensive training:


  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

** Please note, you will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:


  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:


  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:


Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

#LI-DL1

Skills

Active Listening, Communication, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Insurance Claims, Multitasking, Organizing, Time Management, Working Independently, Xactimate

Base compensation offered for this role is $72,000-$115,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job.JobTitle: SIU Field Investigator - Oakland, CA - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

Put your investigative skills to work uncovering the facts behind complex insurance claims. As an SIU Field Investigator, you’ll conduct detailed investigations, analyze claim information, identify potential fraud indicators, and gather the information needed to reach well-supported conclusions. You’ll use critical thinking, effective interviewing, research, and analytical skills to connect details and resolve questions that may not have an obvious answer. Whether analyzing information or conducting investigative work in the field, you’ll play an important role in helping ensure claims are handled appropriately while protecting customers and the business from potential fraud.

We're looking for a SIU Field Investigator to join our team in Northern California. This is a field-based role within the SIU (Special Investigations Unit) Fraud Investigation Department, responsible for conducting in-depth fraud investigations related to insurance claims. The preferred candidate should be based in or around San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose, Sacramento, or the surrounding commuting areas, as they will be expected to service the broader region. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both investigations and insurance.


Key Responsibilities

  • Enters SIU claim data information into multiple SIU systems
  • Reviews investigations with fraud outcomes to validate whether denial is appropriate
  • Updates files with investigation outcome, and when no fraud or insufficient evidence is found, returns file to market claim office for further handling and settlement
  • Conducts complex online data application searches, research, and evaluation
  • Conducts complex site inspections, including body shops, medical clinics, loss locations etc.
  • Conducts thorough investigations of complex that are potentially fraudulent to determine if payment is warranted, including scene investigations and surveillance as needed
  • Validates that the information provided and obtained through investigation is true and accurate and follows up on all possible leads
  • Summarizes documents and enters into claim system notes, documenting a claim file with notes, evaluations and decision-making process
  • Utilizes analytic tools or SIU field intelligence to identify complex claims for investigation and/or for support in the evidence of the fraud and damages
  • Researches and responds to complex customer communications, concerns, conflicts or issues

Skills

Analytical Thinking, Critical Thinking, Decision Making, Documentations, Evidence Gathering, Fraud Investigations, Insurance Claims Investigations, Interviewing, Investigative Skills, Problem Analysis, Special Investigations, Time Management

Compensation

Base compensation offered for this role is:

SIU Consultant I: $60,000 - $87,400
SIU Consultant II: $62,100 - $92,700 

And is based on experience and qualifications. Total compensation for this role is comprised of several factors, including the base compensation outlined above, plus incentive pay (i.e. commission, bonus, etc.) if applicable for the role.

Put your analytical skills and claims expertise to work as an Auto Field Adjuster with National General, an Allstate Company. In this role, you’ll evaluate first- and third-party material damage claims, develop comprehensive damage estimates, and guide claims toward appropriate resolution. You’ll apply your knowledge of regulatory requirements, fair claims practices, policy coverage, and estimating fundamentals while building trusted relationships with internal and external customers. From negotiating settlements to documenting claim activity and making payments within your authority, you’ll take meaningful ownership of the claims process and help deliver thoughtful, well-supported outcomes.

Where You’ll Work:

This is a field-based position supporting customers throughout Little Rock and surrounding areas in Arkansas. Candidates must live within reasonable proximity to the assigned territory and be comfortable with regular local travel to support customers and complete in-person claim inspections.


We are seeking an Auto Field Adjuster to join our team in the Little Rock, AR region. In this field-based role, you will assess vehicle damage, prepare estimates, and guide customers through the claims process.


If you have strong auto estimating experience, enjoy working independently in the field, and take pride in delivering fair and timely claim outcomes, this is a great opportunity to grow your career with National General, an Allstate company.

Key Responsibilities

• Applies thorough understanding of regulatory compliance and fair claims practices

• Builds established relationships with both internal and external customers

• Exhibits proficient estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on 1st and 3rd party material damage losses

• Processes a deep understanding of the content of all policy types written by the company

Job Description

About Law & Regulations
The Law & Regulations organization provides strategic legal and compliance services that protect the company and its customers while ensuring adherence to evolving legal, regulatory, privacy, and ethical standards. The team supports critical business functions including Claims Litigation, Legal Operations, Matter Management, Document Management, Regulatory Compliance, and Legal Technology Solutions.
________________________________________
Position Summary
We are seeking an accomplished and highly motivated Software Engineer (Java/Full Stack) to join the Law & Regulations Technology team. This position is responsible for the design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support of enterprise applications that enable legal operations, matter and document management, compliance initiatives, and business process automation.
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong full stack development expertise and hands-on proficiency in React, Java, Spring Boot, microservices, cloud technologies, APIs, and event-driven architectures. This individual will collaborate with cross-functional partners across Legal, Compliance, Product Management, Architecture, Data Engineering, and other business functions to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative technology solutions.
This role provides an opportunity to contribute to the modernization of enterprise legal technology while working with contemporary cloud-native platforms and engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise-grade applications across the technology stack.
  • Build modern, responsive, and scalable web applications using React and modern UI frameworks.
  • Develop secure, high-performing backend services and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code following software engineering best practices.
  • Participate in application modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

Legal Technology and Matter Management Solutions

  • Develop and support Matter Management, Legal Operations, and Document Management solutions.
  • Build integrations between legal platforms, claims systems, document repositories, and enterprise applications.
  • Implement workflow-driven solutions supporting legal intake, matter lifecycle management, document processing, and regulatory compliance.
  • Support litigation, claims management, legal reporting, and operational processes through technology solutions.

Backend and API Development

  • Design and develop cloud-native microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful architectures.
  • Build scalable APIs and enterprise integrations supporting business-critical applications.
  • Develop event-driven solutions utilizing technologies such as Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent messaging platforms.
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security controls aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Optimize application performance, reliability, scalability, and availability.

Frontend Development

  • Develop responsive user interfaces using React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and microservices.
  • Create reusable UI components and implement modern design patterns.
  • Improve usability, accessibility, and overall user experience.

Database and Data Management

  • Design and support solutions utilizing MongoDB, SQL Server, Oracle, and document-based databases.
  • Develop and maintain relational and NoSQL data models.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, performance, and scalability across applications.

Cloud and DevOps

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development and deployment automation.
  • Support cloud-native application deployment and operations.
  • Work with containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Participate in Azure and AWS cloud environments.
  • Support monitoring, alerting, logging, observability, and incident management activities.
  • Perform production support, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.

Agile Delivery and Collaboration

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, and Engineering teams.
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support testing, releases, upgrades, and post-production activities.
  • Contribute to peer code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 3-5 years of professional experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer.
  • Experience designing and developing enterprise applications and integrations.
  • Experience with distributed messaging platforms such as Kafka or Azure Service Bus.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native application development principles.
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DocumentDB).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices, authentication, authorization, and application security.

Cloud and Platform Experience

  • Experience developing and deploying applications in Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
  • Experience building and supporting cloud-native, containerized applications.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jenkins, and similar automation platforms.
  • Experience supporting production environments through monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational excellence practices.

Preferred Domain Experience

  • Experience with Matter Management, Legal Operations, Case Management, Claims Systems, or Document Management platforms.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job.

As a Represented Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury on complex/severe claims. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

Qualifications:


  • 3+ years of Casualty Represented complex/severe claim handling experience.
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.
  • The individual selected for this role will join a team who primarily handles claims in the following states: Ohio, Michigan, Indiana.
  • Candidates in the Central and Eastern time zones preferred.

Training:


The first approximately [six-nine weeks] of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.


You’ll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

 

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  


  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply. 

Sign-On Bonus Information:


  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus. 
  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 
  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus. 

Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii, Washington, or Puerto Rico residents.

Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Outside Property Consultant investigates and confirms the facts of loss for advanced homeowner claims. The role determines coverage, damages and otherwise adjusts and negotiates claims within limit of authority. The position creates or audits a comprehensive estimate of damages for first party homeowner claims leading to the proper disposition.

We are seeking an experienced Property Field Adjuster to support the Illinois suburbs, primarily covering Kane and Cook Counties, with coverage extending into DuPage County as needed. This team supports our premier clients and is looking for a seasoned professional who brings strong communication, customer service, and property claims expertise. In this role, you will handle a variety of property claims, including water-related losses, roof claims, and interior losses, many of which may be high-value and complex in nature.

Key Responsibilities

  • Possesses a deep understanding of the content of all policy types written by the company
  • Possesses strong estimating fundamentals in order to create or audit estimates of damages on first party homeowner losses with complexity
  • Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers across multiple lines
  • Evaluates settlement alternatives by reviewing regulatory compliance and fair claims practices and makes decisions on best option
  • Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files across multiple lines

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.


Sign On Bonus:  

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 


  *Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.*

By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

You’ll manage claims from initial investigation through resolution, conducting field inspections, evaluating damages, reviewing applicable coverage, developing repair estimates, and working with customers and other involved parties to reach timely and accurate claim outcomes. This role combines independent field work, critical thinking, technical expertise, and strong customer service. You’ll manage an assigned territory and workload while documenting claim activity, communicating throughout the claims process, and making sound decisions in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

We're hiring a Field Property Adjuster based near Worcester, Northborough or Natick, Massachusetts. You'll manage property claims from inspection through resolution, including estimating damage, reviewing supplements, handling contents losses, and supporting customers throughout the claims process.

The ideal candidate has property claims experience, strong customer service and organizational skills, proficiency in Xactimate, and an active adjuster license (or the ability to obtain one). Experience handling claims both in the field and virtually is preferred.


Key Responsibilities

  • Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on the most complex first party homeowner losses of all severities
  • Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers
  • Interprets regulatory compliance and fair claims practices
  • Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files
  • Applies mastered content in interpretations of all policy types written by the company and assists leadership in formal and ad hoc training

Job.JobTitle: Senior Homeowner Liability Adjuster - Complex Bodily Injury Litigation - Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

As an Adjuster, you will be responsible for investigating and managing complex homeowner liability claims, including dog bites, slip-and-fall incidents, and other claims involving third-party property damage and/or bodily injury. Working remotely from your home office, you will independently handle a litigation-focused caseload while delivering exceptional customer service throughout the claim lifecycle. In this role, you will evaluate coverage, liability, and damages, conduct thorough investigations, and work closely with customers, attorneys, and other claim stakeholders. Communication will occur through multiple channels, including phone, email, and text. Leveraging innovative claims platforms and tools, you will negotiate settlements, manage litigation exposures, and help drive fair and timely claim resolutions.  This position is designed for an experienced litigation/complex claims adjuster who is comfortable handling higher-severity bodily injury claims and navigating the litigation process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Negotiates and settles claims in accordance with business unit best practices.
  • Review policy language and analysis determine coverage.
  • Reviews of medical reports in preparation for claims settlement evaluation.
  • Coordinate the appraisal process for highly complex, disputed claims, ensuring adherence to policy provisions.
  • Determines and explains coverage limits in moderately complex and complex claims involving single or multiple claimants, also determines claim value.
  • Sets initial reserve, updates reserve, documents rationale and claim summary notes.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for policyholder attorneys, leading direct negotiations to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Draft and respond to attorney correspondence, requests for information, and demands to maintain compliance and mitigate legal exposure.
  • Researches and responds to moderately complex and occasionally complex customer communications, concerns, conflicts or issues.
  • Summarizes documents and enters into claim system notes, documenting a claim file with notes, evaluations and decision-making process.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of bodily injury claims handling experience, including litigation and/or complex casualty claims.
  • Experience handling homeowner liability claims (dog bites, premises liability, etc.) preferred but not required.
  • Strong investigation, negotiation, and claim resolution skills.
  • Ability to effectively manage attorney-represented claims and complex liability exposures.
  • Candidates based on the West Coast are strongly preferred. Applicants in other locations may be considered if they can reliably work Pacific Time zone hours.

Training:

  • The first approximately 6-9 weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Remote Home-Based Work:

  • This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States. This position is not available to Alaska, California, Hawaii or Washington residents.

When you work from home full time, you’ll need:

  • A home office – a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.  

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign-on Bonus:  

  • You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 
  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus. 

Allstate Benefits: 

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes: 
  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement. 
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance. 
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role. 
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobTitle: Territory Sales Manager (Salt Lake City/Provo, UT) - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Territory Sales Manager is responsible for consistently exceeding agreed upon new business production, direct written premium, and loss ratio goals, and other KPIs on an annual basis by effectively managing the agents of an assigned market to increase company market share by driving profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Position is responsible for product/user integration with industry technology and comparative rating platforms within market and assigned agencies

• Positions and promotes full suite of National General Insurance products into Independent Agency Partners to include, multiple personal auto products, homeowners, commercial vehicle, flood, and recreational vehicle & key focus on Household package coverages (based on state availability)

• Develops and maintains the assigned market’s new agency appointment pipeline, supports National Accounts & Alternative Distribution Initiatives to implement corporate agreements at the local market level with large Independent Agents driving package product growth & coach new Territory Sales Managers

• Consults with IA’s by having a strong knowledge of the independent agency channel, including industry competitors, major brokers and national industry associations to gather market intel to help promote and position National General products and/or make market enhancement to align with industry opportunity

• Delivers on the business unit’s annual execution plan (growth, profitability, agency engagement, new appointments) for their market with focus on Household package coverages under the guidance of a Regional Sales Manager and/or Director.

• Role uses full suite of production data and reporting to identify trends, capitalize on opportunity and regularly address agency level performance including training / skill gap to execute on business plan, educating on package products to drive agency growth

• Collaborates with IAs to assist with creation of agency-specific short term and long-term strategic business plans, periodically reviews and suggests adjustments as necessary to achieve results

• Collaborates with Product, Pricing, Operations to perform stakeholder (agency) and risk analysis on market related issues

• Territory Sales Manager handles increasing the quote and issuance flow of assigned market beyond the rate and Underwriting trends filed and implemented in the market

• Key company liaison within assigned market to both independent agencies and industry associations and must be field facing 4 days per week, driving key business initiatives, maintaining accurate records of these sales activities, client interactions, and follow-ups in CRM software


Candidates must reside in the greater Salt Lake City/Provo, UT area.


Experience

• 5 or more years of experience (Preferred)


Supervisory Responsibilities

• This job does not have supervisory duties.


Skills

Client Relationship Building, Insurance Products, Relationship Building, Strategic Collaboration, Territory Sales Management

Compensation

Base Salary: $95,000 - $104,000 plus incentives based on performance

This is a remote role

Candidate residing in Pacific & Mountain time zone preferred

A day in the life of an inside Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Moderate Inside Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Working remotely your primary responsibility will involve virtually inspecting damages, investigating coverage, preparing estimates, and settling claims promptly and accurately. You will be interacting with customers, contractors, and vendors through various software platforms such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. This communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. This role places a particular focus on water losses, ensuring that our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

· The Customer Service Expert – you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always. This role involves taking care of customers in their times of need

· The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

· The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

· The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

· The Problem Solver – you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

· The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Schedule - 8:00 - 4:30 EST Monday-Friday and rotational Saturday Remote

· Candidate residing in Central & Eastern time zone preferred

· 1+ years of previous customer service experience required.

· Previous industry experience is highly desired.

· Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for virtual assessments is preferred.

· Ability to assess property damages and accurately determine claim coverage.

· Excellent negotiation and communication skills to interact with customers and stakeholders remotely.

· Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently in a virtual work environment.

· Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality and efficient claim resolutions.

You’re provided with comprehensive training:

· The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

· Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

Job Description

Team and overall scope:


  • The Allstate's Data & Analytics Technology organization is seeking a Machine Learning Platform Lead to architect, build, and scale the core platforms that power enterprise-wide machine learning solutions.
  • In this role, you will provide deep technical leadership across ML infrastructure, MLOps automation, model deployment systems, and cloud-native engineering.
  • You will influence platform strategy, guide architectural decisions, and collaborate closely with data science, engineering, security, and product teams to enable reliable, scalable, and responsible ML adoption across the enterprise.

This role is ideal for a senior technologist who thrives in hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and building high-impact ML platform capabilities.


Key Responsibilities


  • Serve as the technical lead for ML platform architecture, guiding system design, scalability, performance, and reliability across platform components.
  • Architect and build core ML platform services, including training and compute infrastructure, feature stores, model registries, inference runtimes, and data pipelines.
  • Drive architectural decisions for distributed systems, cloud‑native frameworks, and automated MLOps workflows that support enterprise-scale machine learning.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging ML platform technologies, tools, and best practices to continuously strengthen platform capabilities.
  • Design and implement robust MLOps pipelines for experiment tracking, data and model versioning, CI/CD for ML, automated retraining, and model governance.
  • Develop automated workflows that ensure reproducible model training, validation, deployment, and lifecycle management across multiple environments.
  • Implement monitoring and observability systems for model performance, data quality, drift detection, and inference reliability.
  • Build and optimize cloud-based ML infrastructure on Azure, AWS, or GCP using Kubernetes, containerization, and infrastructure‑as‑code.
  • Develop scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using modern data engineering tools and frameworks.
  • Embed security, compliance, responsible AI principles, and cost optimization best practices within ML platform architecture and operations.
  • Collaborate with data scientists to translate modeling needs into scalable, reusable, and self-service platform capabilities.
  • Work closely with security, compliance, and governance teams to ensure safe and compliant deployment of AI/ML solutions.
  • Partner with application engineering teams to accelerate adoption of ML services and enable consistent, high-quality production deployments.
  • Provide technical mentorship, set engineering standards, and contribute to documentation, best practices, and ongoing platform improvements.

Required Qualifications


  • Extensive experience in ML engineering, platform engineering, or large-scale distributed systems.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with MLOps tools, ML frameworks, model deployment techniques, and ML lifecycle automation.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and backend development for machine learning systems.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and ML services, including Azure ML Studio, AWS SageMaker, and/or Google Vertex AI.
  • Exposure to cloud storage/data such as Azure Fabric/OneLake, AWS S3, and Google Cloud Storage (GCS).
  • Experience with cloud-native scanning and security tools such as Azure Defender, Microsoft Purview, AWS Security Hub, Amazon Inspector, GCP Security Command Center, or equivalent services.
  • Strong understanding of technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Terraform/Infrastructure-as-Code, etc.
  • Solid knowledge of system design, APIs, data pipelines, and scalable ML infrastructure patterns.
  • Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and influence cross‑team engineering decisions.
  • 6+ years of progressive related experience

Skills

CI/CD, Machine Learning (ML), Machine Learning Model Development, Machine Learning Operations, Microsoft Azure, Python Automation, Python Frameworks

Job.JobTitle: Bodily Injury Adjuster - Moderate Represented - Remote PST/MST/CST
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster your focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

In this role, candidates must demonstrate a high level of adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced and continuously evolving environment. Success requires the ability to manage multiple, diverse venues simultaneously, each with its own unique operational demands and stakeholder expectations.

As the claim owner, you are the primary point of contact for the customer for their claim. While others—such as field adjusters or repair shops—may assist with the claim, the insured will look to you for guidance throughout the process.

Excellent customer service is essential. For many customers, this may be their first experience filing a claim. It's your responsibility to support them through what can be a stressful situation by providing clear communication and empathetic guidance.

Additionally, the role involves close collaboration with internal partners to assess and drive value across initiatives. This cross-functional engagement is key to aligning strategic goals and delivering impactful outcomes.

Candidates for this role must reside in the Pacific, Mountain or Central time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.

The work schedule varies depending on your local time zone:

  • Pacific Time Zone: Monday-Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm PST
  • Mountain Time Zones: Monday–Friday, 8:00am –5:00pm MST
  • Central Time Zones: Monday–Friday, 8:00am –5:00pm CST

The first approximately 6-9 weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior represented third-party casualty claim handling experience.
  • 3+  years of bodily injury claim handling experience.
  • Moderate bodily injury claim handling experience.
  • Experience handling claims in Tennessee, Mississippi, Kentucky , Arizona, Illinois, and/or Iowa.
  • Experience using NextGen, Mitchell Decision Point, and Casualty Center preferred.
  • Strong phone communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Work Location

  • This position is a remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States.

Licensing Requirements

  • You may be required to obtain an adjuster and/or appraiser license as a condition of employment.
  • If required, licensing may include an additional Department of Insurance background check and must be completed within 60 days of hire.
  • If you currently hold an active insurance license, you must terminate all existing appointments before onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments during employment.
  • If you are seeking an adjuster role and hold a resident producer license, you must formally surrender that license when instructed by the licensing team.
  • The Hiring Manager and Centralized Licensing team will provide support if licensing is required. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and agree to comply with these licensing requirements.

Sign-On Bonus Information

  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus.
  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits

  • Day 1 benefits, including time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.
  • Competitive pay, plus support for ongoing development and career advancement.
  • Time off programs and resources that support work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to help you succeed in the role.
  • Additional benefits may include 401(k)/pension, education reimbursement, and programs that support life outside of work. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobDescription:

As a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair and timely injury settlements with all parties involved.


***The ideal candidate will be able to handle a high-volume of pending cases and have experience with not only third-party casualty adjusting, but also first-party collision and third-party property damage claims.***


Candidates for this role must reside in the Eastern or Central Time Zones.

Claims experience in South Carolina, North Carolina, or Alabama highly preferred


Qualifications

  • Prior represented third-party casualty claim handling experience is required
  • Florida, Georgia, Nevada, Texas, California claims experience preferred
  • 2-5 years of moderate/complex Bodily Injury claim handling experience is preferred
  • Prior litigation claims experience a plus
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Proficient knowledge of insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination and state regulations.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite a plus


You’ll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder –you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Why This Role?

This is a meaningful leadership role within the enterprise P&C actuarial reserving organization, designed for a senior actuarial manager who wants to sit close to complex reserve analysis, business decision-making, and the continued modernization of reserving practices.

You will lead actuarial reserving work for Homeowners, catastrophe and runoff exposures across the Allstate brand and National General, partnering with reserving senior leadership and key business partners to develop, evaluate, and communicate reserve indications, methodologies, and insights. The role requires a strong blend of technical actuarial judgment, analytical discipline, people leadership, and the ability to translate complex results into clear recommendations that support business decisions.

As a Senior Actuarial Manager, you will not only execute core reserving responsibilities, you will help strengthen the craft of reserving through improved methodology, data quality, documentation, tool utilization, and team development. This is a role for someone who can operate independently on complex analyses, guide analysts through high-quality execution, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of a modern reserving function.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead complex reserving analyses. Own reserving analyses for Homeowners, catastrophe and runoff exposures, using accepted actuarial and statistical standards, with a focus on high-quality analysis, sound judgment, and clear business implications.
  • Strengthen reserve decision support. Partner with senior reserving leaders and business stakeholders to develop and execute reserving strategies that support high-complexity reserve analyses and informed decision-making.
  • Ensure data quality and analytical rigor. Select, review, and challenge the data, assumptions, methods, and tools used in highly complex actuarial analyses, ensuring outputs are reliable, well-supported, and fit for purpose.
  • Translate technical work into clear insights. Review, evaluate, and communicate actuarial results, modeling techniques, and reserve indications in a way that is understandable, actionable, and relevant for leadership and external groups.
  • Guide work across projects and priorities. Plan, manage, and contribute to high-complexity projects that may span multiple disciplines, balancing technical quality, timelines, stakeholder needs, and execution discipline.
  • Develop analysts and build team capability. Lead a team by setting expectations, coaching technical development, reviewing work, and providing input on talent management, development, and team effectiveness.
  • Advance the reserving craft. Contribute technical and thought leadership through improvements to reserving methods, processes, tools, documentation, and analytical approaches, often serving as a subject-matter expert within the team.
  • Apply business and regulatory context. Use knowledge of insurance products, market dynamics, claims trends, and the regulatory environment to inform reserving conclusions and influence appropriate business decisions.

Impact & Exposure

This role sits at an important intersection of actuarial analysis, business partnership, and team leadership. Your work will support reserve estimates and explanations used by senior reserving leadership and key business partners, and your ability to communicate clearly will help shape how complex reserve movements, methods, and assumptions are understood.

It is a highly visible senior manager role that requires independent judgment, strong execution, and the ability to influence through technical credibility, clarity, and partnership.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS).
  • Ten or more years of actuarial experience.
  • Experience leading complex actuarial analyses and applying actuarial judgment to support business decisions.
  • Experience partnering with leaders and cross-functional business stakeholders.
  • Experience managing and developing actuarial talent.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred

  • Property and casualty reserving experience.

 

Supervisory Responsibilities

This role has supervisory responsibility for a team that includes actuarial managers or team leads and analysts, and includes coaching, work direction, review, and input into talent management.

Job Description

Are you someone who enjoys being on the move, solving problems, and making a real impact for customers? As a Field Auto Adjuster, you'll be at the forefront of our claims process—meeting customers where they are, whether it's at their home, a repair shop, or a tow yard.

You'll take the lead in writing estimates and guiding customers through the repair or total loss process, using a mix of in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication. No two days are the same—whether you're evaluating damage on-site or collaborating with body shops and service providers, you'll enjoy a fast-paced, hands-on role that keeps you engaged and on your toes.

If you're looking for a career that blends technical know-how, customer service, and the freedom of field work, this is your chance to thrive in a role where your expertise truly matters.


Preferred Qualifications

  • 18+ months’ experience in auto collision estimating using CCC One
  • You have a High School Diploma or a GED
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates
  • Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements

A day in the life of the Field Auto Damage Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

  • The Customer Service Expert – you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver – you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 
  • The Recorder – Your Eye for Detail Keeps Everything on Track - In this role, you’ll ensure claims are documented accurately and in line with policy agreements. As you handle each case, you’ll maintain clear, timely records in our claims system (which we’ll train you on). Your attention to detail helps keep the process smooth, organized, and transparent from start to finish.

Work Location

  • This position is a field-based role. To be eligible for this role, you must be located in the following locations: Philadelphia, PA

Company Car
Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.


Please note, you may be required to attend 2 weeks of training held in person at our Dallas, TX office.

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjuster’s license in multiple markets (Appraiser's license required in RI as well)
  • All required licenses will need to be obtained within 60 days of hire

  • This role offers a sign on bonus of $1,000 if you have an active appraiser license or active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state (current employees and candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus)

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan
  • Ayco financial coaching 
  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Adoption reimbursement 
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition reimbursement 
  • Wellness incentives

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Senior Consultant II is responsible for granting settlement authority on highly complex claims valued in excess of Market Claim Office (MCO) and Regional Claim Office (RCO) limits, providing recommendations on requests to go to trial on cases where the gross exposure is in excess of MCO authority, and general oversight of all large losses for a specific CSA or CSAs. The individual may also provide discretionary referrals on coverage issues, opinions and research. In addition, the Sr Cons II may provide approval on Closed Without Payment (CWP) requests where liability is disputed, and the value is in excess of Field authority.

We are seeking Large Loss Adjusters to join our growing team! This team manages complex, high exposure claims and may include rejected tenders and extra-contractual exposures claims. Claims often involve severe injuries, such as catastrophic impairments, amputations, comas, and fatalities. The ideal candidate will have prior experience handling large loss claims, navigating complex liability issues, and managing litigation through resolution. Strong investigative, negotiation, and risk assessment skills are essential for success in this role.





Key Responsibilities

• Performs file reviews for various complex projects or for cases in litigation, analyzes data, and reports findings

• May review cases to determine if CWP is appropriate given gross tort value exposure

• Supports the Field with discretionary referrals on complex coverage issues and engages Home Office Claim litigation for involvement and direction as needed

• Reviews coverage, liability, and/or damages on highly complex cases referred for authorization and collaborates with Field leadership on addition steps to be taken and other feedback and direction

• Collaborates with Frontline Performance Experts (FPEs), Frontline Performance Leaders (FPLS), and Claim Process Specialists (CPSs) to share experience and trends identified in referred cases

• Works with Product, Protection, Law, and Claims on new products introduced to the Field and the sales force, and develops Claim Bulletins to provide new forms and/or endorsements that impact claim handling practices



Supervisory Responsibilities

• This job does not have supervisory duties.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. Job Description

The Software Engineer, Sr Consultant II to Lead Consultant, implement applications following 12-factor principles to build out the product and iterative enhancements. They own the full stack of software products; developing and implementing frontends (web or mobile), and backend services. They leverage test driven development and continuous integration to ensure agility and quality of products. They actively participate in the decision-making process of the team ensuring that the simplest appropriate technology and design is chosen to meet user needs.

Key Responsibilities 

Backend Engineering (Primary Focus) 

  • Design, develop, and maintain Java backend services using Spring Boot or similar frameworks. 
  • Build APIs and services OAuth backed by SQL-based relational data stores. 
  • Apply modern engineering practices to ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 
  • Write clean, testable, and production-ready code using automated testing practices. 
  • Make thoughtful design decisions with a focus on simplicity and long-term supportability. 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across applications, containers, and basic networking layers. 

Platform & Delivery 

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines supporting continuous integration and deployment. 
  • Deploy and operate services in containerized environments, including Kubernetes. 
  • Support applications in lower and production environments. 
  • Participate in improving observability, resiliency, and operational practices. 

Frontend (Supporting Contribution) 

  • Contribute to frontend code when needed, primarily using React. 
  • Read, debug, and make small enhancements to frontend components. 
  • Frontend expertise is considered a supporting skill and is not required. 

Collaboration & Communication 

  • Participate in standups, planning sessions, retrospectives, and design discussions. 
  • Communicate technical concepts, design decisions, and tradeoffs clearly. 
  • Ask clarifying questions when requirements or expectations are unclear. 
  • Collaborate through code reviews, pairing, and technical discussions. 

AI & Emerging Technologies 

  • Demonstrate interest in modern AI system design and emerging technologies. 
  • Exposure to model orchestration, agent-based workflows, or multi-agent patterns is a plus. 
  • Participate in exploration or prototyping of AI-assisted tools where appropriate. 
  • Stay informed about how AI can enhance developer productivity and product capabilities. 

 

Essential Skills


Levels Considered: Senior Consultant II: 3+ years | Lead Consultant: 5+ years


  • 3+ years (Senior Consultant II) or 5+ years (Lead Consultant) of professional experience building backend systems using Java.
  • Proven ability to develop backend services using Spring Boot or similar Java frameworks.
  • Demonstrated proficiency building and integrating APIs, including services using OAuth.
  • Hands-on knowledge of SQL and relational databases supporting backend applications and services.
  • Strong knowledge of automated testing practices and development of clean, testable, production-ready code.
  • Practical understanding of CI/CD pipelines, continuous integration and deployment practices, and version control.
  • Working knowledge of containerized application deployment and support, including Kubernetes.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot issues across applications, containers, and basic networking layers.
  • Applied knowledge of scalability, reliability, resiliency, maintainability, and observability practices for backend services.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively through code reviews, pairing, technical discussions, planning, and design sessions.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, design decisions, and tradeoffs clearly in meetings, documentation, and code reviews.
  • Solid familiarity with modern AI systems and AI-assisted development tools, including exposure to model orchestration, agent-based workflows, or multi-agent patterns.
  • Foundational knowledge of cloud platforms, including AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 

Desirable Qualifications


  • Solid development expertise with frontend technologies such as React or Angular, including the ability to read, debug, and enhance frontend components.
  • Broad exposure across multiple cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Demonstrated capability supporting applications in production environments.
  • Familiarity working within product-driven or consulting-style teams.

Job Description

This position is for a Project and Program Management Expert on the Claims Strategy team.

The Claims Strategy team drives clarity, alignment and execution throughout Claims. We serve as the connective tissue across the organization, translating strategy into action, aligning leaders around priorities and orchestrating complex work to enable stronger decisions and business results. We operate with clarity, discipline, accountability and a commitment to outcomes. Success is measured not only by the value we create for the business, but also by how we foster a positive team culture that develops talent through meaningful experiences, broad exposure, and enterprise-level work, preparing team members for future leadership opportunities across Claims and Allstate.

As an Expert, you will partner across Claims and the enterprise to navigate complex priorities, influence decisions, connect teams, and ensure strategic initiatives deliver measurable value.

Key Responsibilities

• Demonstrates mastery of best practices in project management and communication processes and contributes to the improvement of these processes at Allstate 

  • Drives agenda and facilitates projects/program steering committee meetings; delivers project communication and issues in an easily understood simplified style to any audience 
  • Drives achievement of enterprise level projects/program success factors 
  • Trains project management techniques and leads by example in raising the level of performance 
  • Takes the lead role in highly pressurized situations when there is a need to communicate critical project information while remaining 
  • sensitive to organizational politics 
  • Leverages organizational dynamics to influence outcomes through leadership and communication skills 
  • Demonstrates thought leadership and strong business acumen in solving complex problems, leveraging data and insights to develop recommendations and effectively influence senior leadership. 
  • Drives project execution. Provides direction and oversight throughout project lifecycle to project team to meet applicable business 
  • requirements 
  • Represents the projects/program and its objectives in all governance and gating forums 
  • Customizes solutions for complex issues typically involving enterprise-level considerations 
  • Works autonomously to lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from problem identification through execution, using sound judgment to determine priorities, next steps, and appropriate stakeholder engagement. 
  • Leverages data and analytics to identify trends, develop actionable insights, measure outcomes, and translate complex information into clear recommendations that support business and strategic decisions. 
  • Builds and maintains strong relationships across a broad network of business partners and key stakeholders, effectively navigating competing priorities and driving alignment toward shared outcomes.
