As a Director, you won’t just deliver results – you drive our culture and shared purpose. You can work remotely and will commute to a nearby office and/or travel for meaningful connection opportunities.

Imagine this.

  • 7:02 a.m. A new intelligence report describes an MFA-bypass technique being used against financial services firms. Within two minutes it is scored against Allstate’s priority intelligence requirements and flagged as relevant, and an automated hunt launches across identity and email telemetry.
  • 7:09 a.m. The hunt gets a hit: one account shows the technique’s pattern. An AI agent opens the investigation immediately, pulls identity and device context, runs the pivots a senior analyst would run, and reaches a high-confidence verdict with a full evidence trail.
  • 7:11 a.m. Contained. The verdict meets the bar for a pre-approved, reversible response, so the system acts on its own: active sessions revoked, credentials reset, account temporarily locked. Nine minutes from first intelligence to containment.
  • 7:16 a.m. An analyst reviews the evidence and the actions taken, confirms the call, and reaches out to the employee. Humans stay accountable for every automated action, without being the bottleneck for it.
  • 8:02 a.m. An AI-drafted detection for the technique is waiting in an engineer’s review queue. It uses the real attack telemetry from the hunt as its test case, and has been backtested against 30 days of history for false positives. It arrives linked to the intelligence that prompted it, the attack path it closes, and its expected alert volume. The engineer approves it and the pipeline promotes it. Next time, nobody has to go hunting. It fires on its own.

Now imagine you lead the teams that made that possible. Your intelligence team set the priority. Your hunters tested it against our environment. Your engineers built the automation that contained it in minutes and the pipeline that turned it into durable coverage within the hour. And you know it worked because you inspected the data, not because someone said so.

That’s the job, and it’s what we’re building at Allstate.

What we’re building

Allstate is building a Cyber Response organization designed for the speed of AI-enabled threats. The work underway is the kind most security teams are still only talking about:

  • An AI-assisted detection-as-code pipeline. Every detection version-controlled, peer-reviewed, tested, tied to the attack paths that matter most to Allstate, and promoted through CI/CD, with AI agents accelerating how detections are created and validated.
  • Agentic investigation and governed response. AI-driven triage and investigation paired with orchestrated response, with human decision gates where the business impact is real.
  • Automated threat intelligence. Pipelines that turn global threat reporting into fast, relevant action for exposure management, incident response, hunting, and leadership.
  • Intelligence-led threat hunting. Hypothesis-driven hunts, AI-assisted scoping, and findings that flow straight into durable detections.
  • Continuous adversarial validation. Breach-and-attack simulation and purple teaming that prove coverage against real attacker behavior.

We need a leader who can bring these together into one system and take it to enterprise scale.

Why this matters

Allstate exists to protect people from life’s uncertainties. In security, that promise now runs into a math problem: adversaries are using automation and AI to scale, and human hours do not. If analyst capacity decides what we detect, risk ends up in the alerts no one had time to look at. Our goal is to predict, detect, and disrupt threats before they reach our customers and our data, with coverage we can prove, detections we can trust, response at machine speed, and automation we can govern.

What Allstate can do for you

  • A charter, not a backlog. You’ll lead three teams, D&R Engineering & Automation, Threat Intelligence, and Threat Hunting, and define how they work as one system. You report to the leader of Cyber Defense & Response and sit on that leadership team.
  • Scale and stakes. A Fortune 100 insurer, a global team across the US, Ireland, and India operating follow-the-sun, and an enterprise attack surface spanning identity, cloud, email, endpoint, and applications.
  • Real backing for the AI-era SOC. Executive sponsorship and active investment in agentic investigation, orchestration, and AI-assisted engineering, with a mandate to scale through intelligence and automation.
  • Room to build the culture. A mandate to build teams where candor is normal, “I don’t know” is a respected answer, quality is inspected rather than assumed, and people improve the system instead of heroically working around it.

What you can do for Allstate

  • Build one loop, not three teams. Create the strategy and operating processes that connect intelligence, hunting, and D&R engineering. Priority intelligence requirements set the agenda, hunts test the hypotheses, and every finding ends in a detection, a control change, a telemetry requirement, or a documented decision.
  • Decouple coverage from analyst capacity. With AI handling first-pass investigation, stop tuning coverage to what humans can staff. Expand behavioral coverage across the attack paths that matter most to Allstate, with identity first in line, and measure coverage of those paths rather than rule counts.
  • Run detections like code, end to end. Git-backed content, unit tests, linting, peer review, staged CI/CD promotion, and a clear definition of done, applied to every detection in the library.
  • Make the queue work for the SOC. Partner with Security Operations so detections land in AI-assisted investigation at creation time. Look past medians to tail wait time and cycle time across every severity, because the risk sits in the tail, not the average.
  • Put humans where judgment changes the outcome. Let machines investigate and take pre-approved, reversible containment actions at machine speed, with every action reviewed by a human. Keep a human decision gate for business-impacting remediation. Earn trust in AI the statistical way, with parallel runs and measured agreement, and expand its autonomy as the data proves it out.
  • Inspect quality, then build it in. Stand up quality control across detections, hunts, and intelligence products: defined rubrics, meaningful sampling, and a feedback loop where every defect becomes training, automation, or a process fix.
  • Scale intelligence for speed and relevance. Lead automated intelligence pipelines that tell exposure management, incident response, hunting, and leadership, in minutes, when a threat actually matters to Allstate.
  • Show your work. Build capacity models, coverage baselines, and a quarterly scorecard that ties detection and response to outcomes and cost lines leaders already track. Ask the right questions and answer them with data.
  • Lead leaders and grow people. Develop the leaders of all three teams, hire for traits like curiosity, empathy, and candor, and teach the skills. Protect the team from burnout by fixing the system that causes it.

What you should bring with you

  • 12+ years across threat detection, incident response, threat intelligence, or security operations, in large enterprise, managed detection and response, incident response consulting, or security product teams.
  • Experience leading leaders, including teams distributed across time zones.
  • A track record of applying software engineering discipline to detection: you have run detections as code and know what it takes to keep a library healthy.
  • Experience taking AI or agentic capabilities in detection and response from pilot into production, and clear opinions about where humans must stay in the loop.
  • A data-driven management style: capacity modeling, queueing, quality control, and the habit of answering hard questions with data.
  • Deep understanding of attack surfaces and attacker behavior, especially identity, cloud, and email, and how to turn that into measurable coverage of the attack paths that matter rather than a color-coded matrix.
  • The ability to explain the math to a CFO and the TTP to an engineer, in the same afternoon.
  • Empathy and candor. You own the problem before you solve it, and you build teams where people can say “I was wrong.”

Skills

Cyber Defense, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, People Leadership, Production Automation

Job.JobTitle: Travel Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Remote (Eastern Time Zone)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Travel Estimating Property Adjuster:  

 As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.    

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:  

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.   

  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.   

  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.   

  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.  

  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.   

  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.    

Schedule: 

  • During training, work Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM. 

  • After training, work 10 days on 4 days off working 8 - 12 hours/day (up to $175/day for working over 8 hours, $200 weekends and/or holidays). 

  • This field position requires up to 90% travel out of town. 

  • Required to attend 2-week training program in Dallas, TX 

Qualifications:  

  • 2+ years of experience writing water damage estimates preferred. 

  • Previous experience as a property adjuster preferred.  

  • Proficiency in estimating software like Xactimate preferred.  

  • Strong focus on providing exceptional customer service.  

  • Ability to work independently, starting from home, and travel to different locations.  

  • Proactive problem-solving skills and a positive attitude toward challenges. 

  • Excellent organization and multitasking abilities in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.  

Required Qualifications: 

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on either a one to two-story roof. 

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements. 

  • Must reside within 50 miles of an airport.  

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply. 

  

You’re provided with comprehensive training:  

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work. 

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.  

  

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.  

Sign On Bonus:   

  • You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.  

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.  

  

Company Car: 

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.  

  

Allstate Benefits:  

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:  

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.  

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.  

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.  

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Senior Detection Content Engineer (Identity) is the technical authority for identity detection content in Detection and Response Engineering. You own coverage of credential abuse, account takeover, privilege escalation and directory attacks across industry leading Identity Detection and Response Platforms. Identity sits at the center of most attack chains, so you also lead cross-domain correlation that links identity signals to endpoint, cloud and communications activity. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Detection Engineering Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own identity coverage strategy against Allstate's threat profile, with emphasis on password spray, MFA fatigue and bypass, token theft and replay, impossible travel and privilege escalation.
  • Design detections for on-premises Active Directory attacks seen through MDI (Kerberoasting, DCSync, pass-the-hash, reconnaissance) and for cloud identity abuse in Entra ID and Okta.
  • Lead cross-domain correlation that ties identity to other domains (for example risky sign-in to endpoint execution, or OAuth consent to mailbox access).
  • Maintain identity Knowledge Objects: privileged account and service account watchlists, break-glass account lists, sign-in baselines and identity investigation context files.
  • Work with Automation Engineers on session revoke, account disable and MFA reset workflows with safe guardrails for privileged and VIP accounts.
  • Track and report MFA enforcement gaps and conditional access weaknesses that affect detection coverage.
  • Assist in driving the Detection Standard for the Identity domain: reusable detection patterns, templates and the Definition of Done, consistent with the team-wide standard.
  • Set tuning standards, fidelity thresholds and suppression governance for domain content. Approve tuning and redesign recommendations.
  • Run the lifecycle review for domain content and present retirement recommendations, confirming no coverage gap is created.
  • Own and develop the Identity domain's agentic content development workflow (context files, skills and agents), with human review before anything reaches production.
  • Final technical reviewer for high and critical severity Cloud domain content. Coach and develop junior and mid-level engineers, and act as secondary Subject Matter Expert (SME) cover for at least one other domain.


Key Requirements

  • 7+ years in security engineering, detection engineering, SOC, or incident response with at least 2 years at a senior or lead level.
  • Significant experience using industry standard querying languages, such as Kusto Query Language (KQL) and CrowdStrike Query Language (CQL).
  • Experience using Microsoft Security Suite, Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, and E5 Logging Sources.
  • Proven delivery of detection-as-code in Git (branching, pull requests, CI/CD).
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of Entra ID SigninLogs and AuditLogs, MDI tables, and at least one third-party IdP (Okta, PingFederate or DUO).
  • Strong understanding of Active Directory and Kerberos attacks, OAuth and token-based attacks, and conditional access.
  • Track record of building identity detections that hold up in a large, complex user population spanning multiple Tenants and directory forests.


Desired Qualifications

  • Entra ID Protection and risk-based conditional access design.
  • Identity security certifications (e.g.; GIAC GCIH, Microsoft SC-100, SC-200, SC-300, Okta Certified Professional) or cloud engineering background.
  • UEBA and anomaly detection approaches for sign-in data.
  • Identity threat hunting across hybrid AD and cloud environments.
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Codex or similar), including writing custom context, skills or prompts.
  • Built agentic workflows with human-in-the-loop controls for security content.
  • Experience writing investigation context for AI SOC agents.
  • Experience in a large, regulated enterprise (financial services or insurance).

Job.JobTitle: SIU Field Investigator - St. Louis, MO - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Special Investigative Unit Consultant II is responsible for investigating and analyzing complex, multi-discipline coverage and claims that have been referred to the Special Investigative Unit (SIU) for potential fraud. The role typically handles a combination of complex attorney represented and unrepresented claims and moderate to complex losses, in which suspicious activity has been identified. The individual performs a thorough investigation including (1) conducting background searches, scene investigations, and clinic inspections; (2) taking recorded statements; (3) reviewing and analyzing medical notes, bills, and property damage; and (4) conducting witness interviews and social media searches. The individual conducts surveillance on property and/or creates scene reconstructions on some investigations and reviews whether fraud can be substantiated and supports a lawsuit.

We are seeking an experienced SIU Investigator to join our growing team! This role is responsible for conducting complex fraud investigations across multiple lines of business, including Auto, Homeowners, and Specialty Lines. This is a field-based position supporting a territory within approximately a three-hour radius of St Louis, MO. Prior investigative experience is required, with a strong preference for candidates who have a Special Investigations Unit (SIU) background and a proven track record of identifying, investigating, and resolving suspicious claims.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enters SIU claim data information into multiple SIU systems
  • Reviews investigations with fraud outcomes to validate whether denial is appropriate
  • Updates files with investigation outcome, and when no fraud or insufficient evidence is found, returns file to MCO for further handling and settlement
  • Conducts complex online data application searches, research, and evaluation
  • Conducts complex site inspections, including body shops, medical clinics, loss locations etc.
  • Conducts thorough investigations of complex that are potentially fraudulent to determine if payment is warranted, including scene investigations and surveillance as needed
  • Validates that the information provided and obtained through investigation is true and accurate and follows up on all possible leads
  • Summarizes documents and enters into claim system notes, documenting a claim file with notes, evaluations and decision-making process
  • Utilizes analytic tools or SIU field intelligence to identify complex claims for investigation and/or for support in the evidence of the fraud and damages
  • Researches and responds to complex customer communications, concerns, conflicts or issues


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

#LI-KR1

Skills

Analytical Thinking, Claims Processing, Critical Thinking, Decision Making, Evidence Gathering, Fraud Investigations, Information Collection, Insurance Claims Investigations, Insurance Investigation, Researching, Special Investigations, Surveillance, Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR), Time Management, Witness Interviewing

Special Investigative Unit Consultant II: $62,100 - $105,300

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Senior Claim Manager leads a Direct Claims team responsible for handling complex claims and latent injury exposures, including asbestos, pollution, PFAS, talc, and other long-tail matters. This role is responsible for strategic leadership, operational excellence, financial oversight, and team development to ensure high-quality claim outcomes, regulatory compliance, and alignment with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities 


Lead and develop a high-performing team of claim professionals handling complex environmental, mass tort, asbestos, PFAS, and other long-tail liability claims. 

  • Provide strategic direction on claim resolution, including coverage analysis, liability assessment, litigation management, reserving, reinsurance reporting, and settlement strategies for high-severity exposures. 
  • Drive superior claim outcomes through sound financial stewardship, innovative disposition strategies, and a focus on timely, effective claim resolution. 
  • Oversee litigation and dispute resolution activities, including management of outside counsel, experts, consultants, and vendor partners. 
  • Monitor claim performance, reserving accuracy, operational metrics, and emerging trends to identify opportunities for improved results and organizational effectiveness. 
  • Partner with Legal, Actuarial, Reinsurance, Finance, and senior leadership to address complex claims and business issues. 
  • Prepare and present claim strategies, exposure assessments, and operational updates to senior leadership. 
  • Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, continuous learning, and employee engagement through coaching, performance management, and talent development. 
  • Build technical capability and succession strength within the team through coaching, knowledge transfer, and development planning. 
  • Ensure compliance with claim handling standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational policies. 
  • Leverage data analytics, technology, and AI-enabled tools to enhance decision-making, operational efficiency, and claim outcomes. 
  • Identify emerging claim trends and communicate potential financial, operational, and reputational impacts to key stakeholders. 
  • Oversee third-party administrators and vendors to ensure contract compliance, service quality, and cost control. 
  • Occasional business travel may be required. 
  • Other responsibilities as assigned.  

Qualifications: 

Experience 

  • 10+ years of relevant claims, insurance coverage, or reinsurance experience. 
  • Proven leadership experience managing teams and direct reports. 

Technical & Functional Skills 

  • Advanced expertise in environmental and mass tort claims, investigation, evaluation, negotiation, and settlement. 
  • Strong knowledge of insurance, coverage interpretation, and case law. 
  • Deep understanding of claims processes, systems, and regulatory requirements. 
  • Ability to analyze complex data, financial forecasts, and operational performance metrics. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, as well as Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled technologies, with demonstrated adaptability to new systems and tools. 

Leadership Competencies 

  • Strong leadership and people management skills, including coaching, mentoring, and team development. 
  • Ability to influence and communicate effectively with senior leaders and diverse stakeholders. 
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate complex issues into actionable solutions. 
  • Proven ability to drive results, improve processes, and manage competing priorities. 

Work Environment & Technology 

  • Company-provided technology includes laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, and mouse. 
  • Remote employees receive monthly connectivity reimbursement. 
  • A dedicated, distraction-free workspace and reliable internet, with minimum speeds of 50 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload, are required for remote work. 

Skills

Claims Review, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Operational Performance, Performance Metrics, Process Improvements, Vendor Management

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 134,000.00 - 209,750.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job Description

The Senior Counsel, Incident Management plays a critical role in providing real-time, business-focused legal guidance on incident response and cybersecurity matters.

Recognized internally as a subject matter expert, this individual brings advanced business acumen and specialized legal expertise to support complex cybersecurity and incident response matters across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead investigations and effectively collaborate with stakeholders in Law & Regulation, risk, security, technology, and more, ensuring an effective incident response across jurisdictions in compliance with applicable privacy, information security and cybersecurity laws and regulations
  • Maintain knowledge of privacy, information security and cybersecurity laws and regulations, with focus on data breach laws
  • Proactively monitor and assess applicability of privacy, information security and cybersecurity laws and regulations, and other legal authority
  • Conduct risk analyses on key issues, from a holistic perspective, recognizing overall impact to the enterprise; make strategic recommendations based on legal requirements and risk analyses
  • Advise business partners on legal subjects (including cybersecurity and incident response) and risk management
  • Drive strategy determination, action planning, and communication with business partners, business units, and other areas of Law & Regulation
  • Anticipate legal concerns and provide creative problem solving in a dynamic business environment
  • Escalate matters, as appropriate, to support legal and compliance risk identification and mitigation and company requirements
  • Exceptional ability to communicate verbally and in writing with a variety of audiences about complex technologies and legal requirements
  • This role may require minimal travel to Allstate locations in Arizona, Illinois, North Carolina, and Texas, based on business needs.

Education:

  • Juris Doctor (Required)

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

  • Must be admitted, licensed to practice law, and in good standing with the bar of at least one U.S. state.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 7 years of legal experience in a law firm or an in-house legal department of a mid- to large-sized company (Required)
  • Experience advising technology teams on legal and regulatory matters. (Required)
  • Extensive and demonstrated experience advising on data breach response (Required)
  • Working knowledge of technology standards and technical investigations related to data security and privacy (Preferred)

  • This job may have supervisory duties over individual contributors, contractors, consultants, and temps (as required)

Job.JobTitle: Personal Injury Protection Adjuster - PST/MST/CST- Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Are you a strong communicator who enjoys solving problems, helping others, and making a meaningful impact every day? We're seeking a Personal Injury Protection Adjuster to join our team and support customers through the medical claims process following an auto accident.

This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for individuals with strong critical thinking, time management, and customer service skills who are looking to build a rewarding career in claims. Insurance experience is helpful but not required. We provide training and support to help you succeed.

In this role, you'll work directly with customers, healthcare providers, and other stakeholders to review medical claims, determine coverage, evaluate bills, and ensure claims are handled fairly, accurately, and compassionately.

What You'll Do


As a Personal Injury Protection Adjuster, you will:


  • Guide customers through the medical claims process with empathy, professionalism, and care.
  • Investigate and evaluate Personal Injury Protection (PIP) and Medical Payments (Med Pay) claims.
  • Review medical bills, treatment records, wage loss documentation, mileage reimbursements, attendant care requests, and other related expenses.
  • Determine claim eligibility, coverage, and reasonableness of medical expenses.
  • Communicate claim decisions clearly and professionally to customers and other parties involved.
  • Maintain accurate claim documentation and detailed file notes.
  • Establish and manage claim reserves based on claim facts and treatment patterns.
  • Identify potential medical management opportunities and refer suspicious activity when appropriate.
  • Manage multiple claims simultaneously while meeting quality, service, and productivity expectations.
  • Utilize digital tools and technology to provide efficient and seamless customer experiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Personal Injury Protection (PIP)/MedPay claim handling experience.
  • 2 years of insurance claim handling/adjusting.
  • Complex liability claim handling.
  • Experience using Mitchell DecisionPoint.
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Remote Home-Based Work:

This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States.


Location: Candidates located in the Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones are preferred. This position is not available to candidates in California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico.


Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8-hour shift scheduled between 7:00 a.m. and 6:30 p.m. Central Time.


When you work from home full time, you’ll need:

  • A home office – a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Training:

  • The first approximately 6-9 weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.  

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign-on Bonus:  

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 
  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus. 

Allstate Benefits: 

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes: 
  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement. 
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance. 
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role. 
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job Description

We are seeking a Platform Consultant DBaaS Senior Expert to help design, evolve, and drive adoption of enterprise database platform capabilities. This role combines database architecture, cloud engineering, platform automation, and consulting expertise to deliver secure, scalable, and self-service database services for application teams. The ideal candidate will be passionate about simplifying database consumption through automation, reusable patterns, and platform engineering best practices.

Allstate is modernising its database ecosystem to provide secure, reliable, automated, and self-service database capabilities that accelerate delivery for Digital Product Teams. As application teams increasingly consume infrastructure through platform services, and Database as a Service (DBaaS) plays a critical role in simplifying database operations while improving reliability, security, and developer experience.

Key responsibilities:


Help Shape Database Platform Capabilities 

  • Contribute to the evolution of Allstate's Database as a Service strategy and service catalog. 
  • Collaborate on database platform standards, reference architectures, and engineering patterns. 
  • Support the development of common database consumption models across cloud and on-premises platforms improving cross venue portabilities. 
  • Identify opportunities to increase platform adoption and reduce operational complexity. 

Build Reusable Platform Solutions 

  • Design and implement reusable automation, templates, and platform abstractions. 
  • Develop Infrastructure as Code patterns and reference implementations for database services. 
  • Implement standardized onboarding and provisioning capabilities. 
  • Improve consistency across database deployment and operational practices. 

Enable Self-Service Experiences 

  • Help develop self-service workflows for database provisioning and lifecycle management. 
  • Improve developer experience through automation and platform integrations. 
  • Partner with application teams to identify friction points and recommend solutions. 
  • Support API-driven and GitOps-based service delivery models. 

Influence and Knowledge Sharing 

  • Share best practices, reusable patterns, and lessons learned. 
  • Contribute to technical roadmaps and platform adoption strategies. 
  • Present recommendations to engineering and technology leadership. 
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for database platform capabilities and automation. 

Essential Skills:

  • All applicants must demonstrate they have a legal right to work in the USA for employment at Allstate. Allstate is not providing sponsorship for this vacancy.
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in database engineering, platform engineering, cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or related technical disciplines. 
  • A minimum of 3 years of acting as a strategic advisor in database engineering, platform engineering, cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or related technical disciplines to senior stakeholders within a technology enterprise.
  • Demonstrable experience contributing to at least one enterprise database platform, Database as a Service (DBaaS), or cloud database capability, including standardisation, provisioning, platform engineering, or service adoption.
  • Hands-on experience using Infrastructure as Code and/or automation tooling such as Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent to automate database infrastructure, provisioning, configuration, or lifecycle management.
  • Experience delivering at least one reusable self-service, API-driven, or GitOps-based capability that enabled engineering teams to provision or manage database or infrastructure services with reduced manual intervention.

What Success Looks Like:

Increased DBaaS adoption

Drive adoption by delivering secure, scalable and intuitive database services, removing friction and making approved platform capabilities the easiest choice for engineering teams.


Faster provisioning through automation

Reduce database provisioning and delivery times through Infrastructure as Code, APIs, GitOps and automated workflows that replace manual processes.


Improved reliability and resiliency

Embed reliability, resiliency, portability, observability and operational readiness into reusable database platform patterns across cloud and on-premises environments.


Consistent database architectures

Establish reference architectures, engineering standards and common consumption models that improve consistency while supporting different application and workload requirements.


Reduced manual lifecycle management

Automate database provisioning, configuration, scaling, upgrades, recovery and decommissioning to reduce operational effort and maintain appropriate controls.


Improved developer experience

Deliver intuitive self-service workflows, APIs, documentation and integrations that reduce developer friction and continuously improve platform usability.


Greater reuse of platform capabilities

Build reusable automation, Infrastructure as Code modules and service offerings that reduce duplicated effort and expand the DBaaS service catalog.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This role does not have any supervisory responsibilities.

Job.JobTitle: Lead Consultant, Penetration Testing - Adversarial Validation
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description


The team:


  • Our Adversarial Validation team is part of Allstate’s broader Exposure Management organization, focused on identifying, testing, and validating security vulnerabilities across enterprise applications and technology environments.
  • Our team is evolving beyond traditional penetration testing to take a more proactive approach to security. In addition to supporting critical application and compliance testing, we investigate newly disclosed vulnerabilities to understand their exploitability and potential business impact.
  • The team brings together penetration testing professionals with complementary technical expertise who collaborate closely with Exposure Intelligence, Exposure Response, and Threat Intelligence teams.

Overall Work Scope: Lead Consultant, Penetration Testing - Adversarial Validation


  • As a Lead Consultant within our Adversarial Validation team, you'll combine advanced penetration testing with real-time security exposure validation.
  • You'll work closely with security engineers, exposure management teams, and technology stakeholders, providing both hands-on technical expertise and clear guidance to leadership.
  • This is an opportunity to influence how we approach offensive security while continuing to develop your skills across emerging technologies.

What You'll Do


  • Lead complex, hands-on penetration testing across web applications, APIs, networks, and enterprise technologies.
  • Investigate emerging vulnerabilities, analyze publicly available exploit code, and validate whether identified exposures can be exploited in our environment.
  • Assess attack paths, security controls, and potential business impact to help prioritize remediation.
  • Translate technical findings into clear, actionable risk insights for engineers, business stakeholders, and executive leadership.
  • Collaborate with exposure intelligence, exposure response, threat intelligence, and technology teams to investigate and address security risks.
  • Leverage penetration testing tools and automation capabilities to improve testing efficiency and validate security exposures.
  • Support security assessments of critical applications and environments, including those subject to regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Contribute to testing methodologies, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across the team.

What You Bring


  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing, offensive security, red teaming, or related adversarial security testing.
  • Strong practical experience conducting penetration tests, particularly across web applications, APIs, and network environments.
  • Experience investigating vulnerabilities, analyzing proof-of-concept exploit code, and validating real-world exploitability.
  • Ability to assess attack paths, evaluate security controls, and determine the technical and business impact of security exposures.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical findings and security risks to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Working knowledge of penetration testing methodologies, common vulnerabilities, and security frameworks such as OWASP and PTES.
  • Working knowledge of security tools such as Burp Suite Professional, Postman, or comparable testing technologies.
  • Familiarity with PCI DSS or similar security compliance requirements and their implications for risk prioritization.

Nice to Have


  • Experience assessing cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Exposure to penetration testing of AI-enabled applications, generative AI, or large language model technologies.
  • Experience with mobile applications, SaaS platforms, or PaaS environments.
  • Experience leveraging automated security testing or adversarial validation tools.
  • Scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Experience with Active Directory, identity security, advanced network testing, or adversary simulation.
  • Offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GPEN, or equivalent demonstrated capabilities.

Skills

Adversary Simulation, Automation, Network Penetration Testing, Offensive Cyber Operations, Offensive Security (Inactive), Penetration Testing, Red Teaming, Security Testing, Threat Detection, Threat Management, Web Application Penetration Testing

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 100,000.00 - 170,500.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job Profile Summary
The Senior Manager, Dealer Insurance Solutions leads the strategy, execution, optimization, and growth of insurance solutions delivered through Allstate Dealer Services. Job Description
This role translates Allstate Dealer Distribution priorities into clear operating plans for dealer insurance solutions, often while the strategy, capabilities, and path forward are still evolving. The Senior Manager builds the dealer insurance value proposition, leads cross-functional execution, monitors performance, and removes barriers that affect growth, profitability, and the dealer experience. The role reports to the Director, Dealer Channel Strategy & Implementation.

  • Develops and executes dealer insurance solution strategies aligned with business growth and profitability objectives.
  • Leads initiatives that support dealer acquisition, engagement, retention, and growth of existing dealer relationships.

  • Designs and improves dealer insurance programs, services, and value propositions based on dealer and business needs.
  • Partners with Sales, Product, Technology, and other teams to deliver integrated dealer solutions.

  • Leads complex cross-functional initiatives that expand insurance distribution and improve operational effectiveness.
  • Communicates recommendations, decisions, progress, risks, and results clearly and proactively to leaders and key stakeholders, creating alignment and shared understanding as strategies and operating plans evolve.
  • Manages staffing, expense priorities, and team performance within the assigned area of responsibility.
  • Builds team capability through clear expectations, coaching, feedback, and development.

  • Demonstrated experience shaping new strategies, programs, or operating models in ambiguous environments where the roadmap, roles, or solutions were not fully defined (preferred).

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Provides direction and guidance to direct reports and may lead managers or teams of professionals.
  • Sets performance expectations, develops talent, establishes staffing priorities, and manages significant assignments within the area of responsibility.

Job.JobTitle: Specialty Operations Claims (Property & Casualty Reinsurance) Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Specialty Operations Claims Consultant handles and analyzes assumed reinsurance claims under excess of loss and facultative reinsurance contracts, including workers’ compensation and automobile claims and developing responsibility for mass tort, latent injury, and other long-tail casualty matters. The role evaluates claim facts, coverage, contract obligations, liability, damages, reserves, payments, and supporting documentation to help control exposure and support appropriate claim outcomes.

In this role, you will manage an assigned caseload with increasing independence, develop claim action plans, maintain well-documented files, and communicate with internal and external business partners. You will join a collaborative and knowledgeable Specialty Operations team where sound judgment, technical curiosity, ownership, and clear communication are valued.

Key Responsibilities

·    Handle and adjust assigned excess of loss and facultative assumed reinsurance claims with appropriate guidance, with the goal of evaluating and controlling exposure.

·    Analyze claim facts and financial information, including liability, damages, coverage positions, reserves, payments, allocation information, and supporting documentation.

·    Interpret and apply relevant provisions of reinsurance contracts, facultative certificates, underlying insurance policies, and available legal or industry guidance.

·    Establish and maintain appropriate reserves and process payments within assigned authority; prepare clear recommendations and obtain approval when matters exceed authority.

·    Develop and carry out claim action plans, including identification of coverage, exposure, documentation, financial, and timing issues requiring follow-up or escalation.

·    Maintain accurate and well-reasoned claim files, including timely diary activity, claim analyses, required reporting, and adherence to applicable procedures and service expectations.

·    Communicate professionally with management, cedents, brokers, internal business partners, and other external contacts; request additional information and explain claim positions as appropriate.

·    Support complex claim reviews and special projects through research, financial analysis, reporting, data validation, and collaboration with senior claim professionals.

·    Continue building technical expertise through training, feedback, review of claim outcomes, and awareness of relevant insurance, reinsurance, legal, and industry developments.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience

·    3+ years of relevant experience preferred.


Functional Skills

·    Working knowledge of reinsurance contracts, insurance policies, coverage principles, claim processes, procedures, and system applications.

·    Ability to evaluate claim information and identify relevant facts, exposure considerations, financial impacts, documentation needs, and issues requiring escalation.

·    Ability to manage an assigned caseload, prioritize competing deadlines, and maintain accurate, timely, and well-supported claim records.

·    Effective written and verbal communication skills, including clear claim analyses, recommendations, and correspondence.

·    Ability to collaborate effectively in virtual and in-person settings with team members, management, internal partners, cedents, brokers, and other external contacts.

·    Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and Copilot; aptitude for learning new technology and claims systems.

·    Analytical thinking, sound judgment, and appropriate independence, with willingness to seek guidance on complex matters or issues outside assigned authority.


Limited travel may be expected (approximately twice per year) to support team connection, training, or business needs.

Analytical Thinking, Casualty Insurance, Claims Review, Reinsurance, Written Communication

•·    Administer assigned cedent books with bordereau cessions under quota share reinsurance treaties, including review and analysis of claim listings, loss and expense information, supporting documentation, and contract participation.

·    Complete internal claim-processing system transactions for the team accurately and timely, including notices, reserve changes and payment transactions.

·    Review and validate financial information, identify discrepancies or missing support, and escalate material documentation, contract, authority, or processing issues.

·    Apply established reinsurance contract provisions, procedures, and controls with guidance to support accurate cession calculations and claim administration.

·    Maintain complete and well-organized claim records, including clear file documentation, timely diary activity, required reporting, and adherence to service and compliance expectations.

·    Support periodic account reviews, reconciliations, data validation, audit activities, and special projects assigned by claim professionals or management.

·    Communicate professionally and collaboratively with team members, management, internal business partners, cedents, brokers, and other external contacts as appropriate for assigned work.

·    Build reinsurance, claims, processing, and technology knowledge through training, feedback, and review of claim outcomes.

·    Developing knowledge of reinsurance contracts, quota share concepts, claim-processing workflows, procedures, controls, and system applications.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster Field Estimating - Phoenix, AZ
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!


As a Field Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.  

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Reside in Phoenix, AZ.
  • 2-3 years prior experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.   
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required qualification:


  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one-to-two-story roof.

You’re provided with comprehensive training:


  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job

** Please note, you will be required to attend 2-weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:


  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed. 
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

 

Sign On Bonus:


  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:


Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

#LI-DL1

Skills

Active Listening, Communication, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Empathy, Insurance Claims, Multitasking, Organizing, Working Independently, Xactimate

Job Description

The Team & What They Do:


  • The Measurement Science team sits at the center of high-impact decision support across the enterprise. This group is the go-to partner when the business needs to understand what truly drives outcomes.
  • Working within a specialized analytics pod and closely aligned with a broader “core” measurement team, you’ll collaborate with peers who combine deep statistical rigor with a consulting mindset. Together, the team evaluates campaigns, product changes, and strategic initiatives to ensure leaders can make decisions grounded in well-reasoned statistical evidence.
  • This is a high-visibility team that frequently engages with senior leadership to assess the effectiveness of major initiatives and quantify real business impact.
  • Unlike traditional data science roles focused on prediction, this role is about decision science—producing defensible, evidence-based insights that shape strategy.

Overall Work Scope:


  • As a Lead Data Scientist on the Measurement Science team you will have the opportunity to work on high value, high visibility projects across the entire enterprise. This role is tasked with providing clarity to problems with high degrees of uncertainty.
  • Your role will be responsible for the following: applying advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to evaluate business metrics, designing and analyzing business experiments, applying quasi-causal techniques, validating and evaluating key metrics, and engineering repeatable measurement methodologies and systems. This role will contribute to and manage projects of high complexity

Key Responsibilities:


  • Works collaboratively to improve the effectiveness of business decisions and business results through designing, building, and advising on appropriate measurement, experimental, or quasi-causal designs.
  • Provides leadership clear insights into the strengths and limitations of measurement approaches
  • Identifies and evaluates key performance metrics, including validation of proxies and leading indicators.
  • Contributes to the design, review and engineering of repeatable measurement methodologies and systems.
  • Identifies languages, tools, and methodologies that can bring efficiencies and rigor to the team.
  • Uses best practices to develop statistical and machine learning/AI techniques to enable rigorous data-driven decisions
  • Mentors and upskills junior data scientists

Required Qualifications:


  • A minimum of 3 years demonstrated experience applying causal inference methodologies (experimental design, propensity score matching/weighting, double ML, cluster randomization, doubly robust estimation)
  • Comfortable consulting with and educating non-technical business partners on a variety of measurement methods
  • Strong foundation in statistical inference including hypothesis testing, generalized linear modeling, variance reduction techniques (CUPED) and Bayesian inference
  • Experience in statistical and machine learning fundamentals, including model evaluation, feature engineering, and supervised/unsupervised learning principles
  • Proficiency in Python and/or R for data analysis, data manipulation, and model development.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience with dashboards or visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.).
  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices (version control, code review, testing frameworks).
  • Experience using CI/CD pipelines or modern development workflows for deploying data products, experiments, or analytics automation.
  • Experience with agentic coding tools and methodologies (i.e. Github copilot, Claude code, spec-kit, etc.)
  • Experience evaluating LLM and agentic systems
  • Proficiency in distributed compute systems (i.e. PySpark)

Artificial Intelligence Markup Language, Business Model Development, Causal Inference, Data Analytics, Predictive Modeling, Python (Programming Language), R Programming, Statistical Analysis, Statistical Models, Statistical Tools, Statistics

Working across product, engineering, architecture, data, analytics, finance, and business teams, we build scalable solutions that improve how portfolio decisions are made and executed. This includes leveraging AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), cloud technologies, and modern software engineering practices to create intelligent capabilities that improve visibility, identify risks and opportunities, support prioritization, and enable better business and customer outcomes.

Our team enables a high-performing, user-centric culture that empowers employees to deliver valuable customer outcomes. We leverage modern engineering practices including Agile development, test-driven development, continuous integration, and continuous delivery.

This role is open for consideration of Senior Consultant to Lead Consultant levels.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job! 

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims. 


You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience: 

·        The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.  

·        The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.  

·        The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.  

·        The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations. 

·        The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.  

·        The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.   


Qualifications: 

·        2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired. 

·        Previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired. 

·        Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating. 

·        Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements. 

·        Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service. 

·        Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively. 

·        Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work. 

·       This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents. 


Required Qualifications: 

·        Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.  

·        Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.

·        Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements. 


You’re provided with comprehensive training: 

·        The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

·        Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

·        You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX. 


Notice of Licensing Requirement: 

·        As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire. 

·        If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed. 


Sign On Bonus:  

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 


*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.


Company Car: 

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work. 


Allstate Benefits: 

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes: 

·        Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement. 

·        Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance. 

·        Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role. 

·        Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

The Senior Incident Handler leads the investigation and response to complex cybersecurity incidents across the enterprise; directs technical investigations, containment, eradication, and recovery activities; coordinates cross-functional response teams; and advises technical, business, and executive leadership on incident impact, risk, and actions required to contain threats and restore operations.

About the Role

We're rebuilding incident response from the ground up—and we want a proven responder to help lead the way. This is a chance to bring your hard-won expertise into a next-generation Security Operations program at Fortune 100 scale, where rapid response, automation, and AI-driven investigation are core to how we operate.

As our Senior Incident Handler, you'll be the technical anchor for our most significant security events—driving the response, raising the bar on how we work, and helping mature the team toward a formal, scalable incident command model we're building for the future.


If you've handled the incidents that make headlines (or quietly prevented them from becoming headlines), bring the instincts of a seasoned incident commander, and can move seamlessly from the server room to the boardroom, this is where your experience turns into real influence.

What You'll Own

  • Incident Handling & Response Leadership: Serve as the lead responder during critical incidents—owning the full lifecycle from detection through containment, eradication, and recovery. You'll help run the war room, coordinate responders, and make confident calls with incomplete information.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Unify analysts, infrastructure, application owners, legal, comms, and third-party partners into a single, fast-moving response. Relentless focus on reducing dwell time and mean-time-to-respond.
  • Executive Communication: Be a trusted voice during high-severity events—translating fast-moving technical realities into clear business impact for stakeholders up to the C-suite. You build calm and confidence when it matters most.
  • Deep Threat Investigation: Lead advanced investigations into malware, identity compromise, ransomware, and targeted attacks. Analyze logs, network, and forensic data to expose attacker tradecraft (lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration) and hunt down what others miss—leveraging EDR/XDR, SIEM, and cloud telemetry.
  • AI & Automation Leadership: Help modernize our SOC by putting cutting-edge automation and AI-assisted tooling to work—accelerating triage and enrichment without sacrificing human judgment.
  • Team Uplevel & Continuous Improvement: Raise the standard of how the team responds—sharpening detections, playbooks, and controls through meaningful after-action reviews, and helping shape the practices that will underpin our future incident command function.
  • Mentorship & Readiness: Coach L1/L2 analysts, share command-level tradecraft, and lead the tabletop exercises that keep the whole team sharp.

What You Bring 

  • Battle-tested IR experience: 5+ years in cybersecurity operations or incident response, with a track record of leading complex, enterprise-scale incidents end-to-end. Financial services or insurance experience is a plus—but great responders come from everywhere.
  • Command-level instincts: Demonstrated ability to act as an incident commander or technical lead in high-stakes moments—running major bridge calls and making decisive calls fast. You bring the judgment that helps a team operate like a mature command function.
  • Technical depth: Strong command of network security, EDR/XDR, log and forensic analysis, and threat hunting across on-prem and cloud. Comfortable with SIEM, forensics tooling, and scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell).
  • Communication range: Exceptional written and verbal skills; equally credible with engineers and executives.
  • Automation mindset: Enthusiasm for SOAR, ML-based tooling, and LLMs to elevate response workflows. 
  • Credentials: CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, OSCP or other certifications preferred.


Why This Role

You'll join at a pivotal moment—bringing your expertise to a team that's actively maturing, with the opportunity to help shape the incident command function we're building next. This is a role for someone who wants their fingerprints on how a Fortune 100 responds to the threats ahead. If you're ready to lead through crisis, outthink sophisticated adversaries, and elevate a team around you—let's talk.

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cross-Functional Collaboration, Cyber Incident Response, Cybersecurity Operations, Cyber Threat Hunting, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Executive Briefing, Forensic Analysis, Incident Handling, Network Security, Scripting, Security Automation, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR), Technical Leadership
