Job.JobTitle: Senior Trial Attorney - Hampton Roads, VA (Remote)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Join the legal frontline and champion the defense for both the insured and the Company! As a Senior Trial Attorney, you’ll handle bodily injury, property damage lawsuits, and more, with mediations, arbitrations, and trials. Beyond the courtroom, you’ll provide vital counsel to business clients and coordinate between legal teams. Stay ahead of the game by monitoring new laws and regulations, ensuring our strategies remain sharp. Embrace the excitement of constant challenges and victories in this dynamic role!

Key Responsibilities

  • Represents insured individuals and the Company in the defense of bodily injury and property damage lawsuits, subrogation, and Allstate Financial cases.
  • Prepares thoroughly for and conducts hearings, trials, mediations, and depositions.
  • Prepares and presents pre- and post-trial motions effectively.
  • Assists colleagues in resolving calendar conflicts in a collaborative manner.
  • Offers counsel to business clients on day-to-day legal matters.
  • Manages projects efficiently, fostering coordination and collaboration among legal teams.
  • Keeps abreast of and evaluates new laws, regulations, and case law; identifies and summarizes relevant issues; collaborates with other areas of the Law and Regulation (L&R) department; provides proactive advice and counsel to business units on the impact of new laws; monitors legal representation

Education

  • Juris Doctorate and active membership in good standing with the Virginia State Bar.
     

Minimum Requirements

  • 3+ years of proven litigation experience or strong litigation-type skills, such as case strategy development, legal research, and advocacy, with the ability to manage complex disputes and work effectively under pressure.
  • First or second chair jury trial experience.
  • Proven experience with insurance defense is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, LexisNexis (preferred), and internet research.
  • Strong teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with attorneys, paralegals, and administrative assistants under the guidance of Lead Counsel.
  • Capacity to manage a substantial case load.
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment and willing to travel throughout the greater Hampton Roads, VA area.
  • Allstate provides a comprehensive technology setup, including a laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, and mouse. Employees eligible to work from home also receive a monthly connectivity reimbursement to help offset internet costs.
  • When working from home, you must have a dedicated, private workspace free from distractions, along with appropriate desk and seating. Reliable internet is required, with minimum speeds of 50 MB download and 5 MB upload.
  • Explore the Benefits of Joining Allstate's Client Legal Services:
  • Exceptional Work-Life Balance: At Allstate, we understand the importance of achieving harmony between work and personal life. Our in-house litigation roles provide more predictable schedules, allowing you to excel professionally while enjoying a fulfilling personal life.
  • Professional Growth Opportunities: With ample opportunities for advancement and professional development, you'll have the support and resources you need to reach new heights in your legal career.
  • Holistic Understanding of the Business: As part of the Allstate legal team, you'll gain invaluable insight into our diverse business operations, objectives, and culture. This comprehensive understanding enables you to align legal strategies closely with the company's goals, fostering impactful contributions and strategic partnerships across departments.
  • Direct Client Collaboration: Working in-house at Allstate means collaborating directly with internal stakeholders and business units. This close partnership cultivates deeper client relationships, facilitating a nuanced understanding of their needs and priorities. By providing proactive legal guidance and support, you'll play a pivotal role in driving the company's success.
  • Strategic Influence and Impact: As an integral member of our legal team, you'll have the opportunity to shape strategic decisions and risk management initiatives. Your insights and expertise will inform key business decisions, empowering you to mitigate risks effectively and drive positive outcomes that directly impact Allstate's bottom line.
  • Diverse Legal Challenges: In-house litigation roles at Allstate encompass a broad spectrum of legal work beyond traditional litigation, including regulatory compliance, risk assessment, and dispute resolution. This diversity of challenges ensures continuous professional growth and development, expanding your skill set and enhancing your career trajectory.

Job Description

Allstate Insurance Company has an opportunity for an experienced licensed Sales Leader to support the market in Michigan. The Sales Market Leader (SML) supports Allstate Exclusive Agents to consult about their business success. There may be an opportunity that the market may shift with district lines into a border state. The selected incumbent will have approximately 20% of travel requirements to be in the field meeting Agents. While this is a home-based opportunity, it is preferred that the selected incumbent would live in or near the market but not required. The SML supports the growth and success of the distribution channel and its new agency owners and/or existing exclusive agents. This is achieved through effective consultations, acquisition and retention process adoption, business planning and deployment/staffing strategies.  Influence’s behavior changes with the ability to coach/engage agency owners. 

Mobility preferred but not required.

 

Key Responsibilities:


The SML supporting Growth agencies is responsible for “owning” the market to which they are assigned and achieving Allstate business objectives - which include but are not limited to - ensuring strategic, long-term profitable growth and increased market share.  This will be achieved through:

  • Creating and tracking performance to a strategic business plan for the market
  • As the Allstate Representative, consulting with Exclusive Agencies (EAs) to develop strategic business plans, provide advice on agency operations, identify issues and recommend plans for resolution, and facilitate access to Allstate resources as requested
  • Communicating Allstate messages to EAs, apply the message to the agency-specific business model, and assisting EAs and EFSs, as requested, to create an action plan to adjust operations accordingly
  • Prospecting for, assessing and recruiting agency candidates in accordance with the market deployment strategy

The SML travels to agencies and consults and provides advice on-site to achieve goals.

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Territory Sales Manager is responsible for consistently exceeding agreed upon new business production, direct written premium, and loss ratio goals, and other KPIs on an annual basis by effectively managing the agents of an assigned market to increase company market share by driving profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Position is responsible for product/user integration with industry technology and comparative rating platforms within market and assigned agencies

• Positions and promotes full suite of National General Insurance products into Independent Agency Partners to include, multiple personal auto products, homeowners, commercial vehicle, flood, and recreational vehicle & key focus on Household package coverages (based on state availability)

• Develops and maintains the assigned market’s new agency appointment pipeline, supports National Accounts & Alternative Distribution Initiatives to implement corporate agreements at the local market level with large Independent Agents driving package product growth & coach new TSM’s

• Consults with IA’s by having a strong knowledge of the independent agency channel, including industry competitors, major brokers and national industry associations to gather market intel to help promote and position National General products and/or make market enhancement to align with industry opportunity

• Delivers on the business unit’s annual execution plan (growth, profitability, agency engagement, new appointments) for their market with focus on Household package coverages under the guidance of a Regional Sales Manager and/or Director.

• Role uses full suite of production data and reporting to identify trends, capitalize on opportunity and regularly address agency level performance including training / skill gap to execute on business plan, educating on package products to drive agency growth

• Collaborates with IAs to assist with creation of agency-specific short term and long-term strategic business plans, periodically reviews and suggests adjustments as necessary to achieve results

• Collaborates with Product, Pricing, Operations to perform stakeholder (agency) and risk analysis on market related issues

• Territory Sales Manager handles increasing the quote and issuance flow of assigned market beyond the rate and Underwriting trends filed and implemented in the market

• Key company liaison within assigned market to both independent agencies and industry associations and must be field facing 4 days per week, driving key business initiatives, maintaining accurate records of these sales activities, client interactions, and follow-ups in CRM software


Candidates must reside in the greater Columbus, OH area.


Experience

• 5 or more years of experience (Preferred)

From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

About Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms
Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms (ACO&P) is a net-new digital product organization within Cyber Operations, building the shared technology foundation for how modern cyber defense operates.

Our north star is an adaptive, engineering-led, AI-powered cyber operations platform that brings together high-fidelity security data, integrated tooling, AI, and automation to help defenders detect threats earlier, turn security telemetry into actionable intelligence, accelerate decision-making, and respond at machine speed.

Our mission is to connect the cyber operations lifecycle end to end, turning signals into trusted intelligence, intelligence into decisions, and decisions into protection. By reducing fragmentation and intelligently applying AI and automation, ACO&P enables cyber defenders to focus their expertise where human judgment matters most while building a cyber operations ecosystem that continuously adapts to an evolving threat landscape.

About the Role
As a Digital Product Manager in ACO&P, you will be a hands-on product owner for a defined area of the cyber operations portfolio. You will translate the needs of defenders, investigators, engineers, end users, and business partners into a clear roadmap and prioritized backlog, lead discovery, set iteration goals, and make the trade-offs that keep your team focused on the outcomes that matter most.

You will partner closely with engineering teams and with detection and response, threat intelligence, threat hunting, and platform teams to build on shared security data and integrations, connecting your product area to the broader ACO&P ecosystem rather than delivering isolated point solutions.

Open Roles
We are hiring Digital Product Managers for two distinct product areas. Each role shares the responsibilities and required qualifications below; the role profiles that follow describe the specific focus, capabilities, and preferred qualifications for each area.

Open Roles

We are hiring Digital Product Managers for three distinct product areas. Each role shares the responsibilities and required qualifications below; the role profiles that follow describe the specific focus, capabilities, and preferred qualifications for each area.


Key Responsibilities (All Roles)

  • Define and maintain the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for your product area, aligned to the ACO&P north star and the priorities of your partner teams.
  • Lead problem-first discovery and framing, translating defender, investigator, engineering, end-user, and business partner needs into validated problem statements, testable hypotheses, epics, and user stories.
  • Establish and track outcome-based KPIs that show measurable progress for your product area.
  • Partner with engineering and adjacent Cyber Operations teams to build on shared security data and integrations rather than isolated point solutions.
  • Support vendor evaluations, proofs of value, and build, buy, or retire decisions with clear acceptance criteria, usage models, and success measures.
  • Drive adoption and change management through documentation, communication, enablement, and feedback loops with users and stakeholders.
  • Design products with appropriate guardrails, including auditability and human oversight of AI-enabled and automated actions.

Required Qualifications (All Roles)

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in digital product management, platform product delivery, data product ownership, or enterprise tooling ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated success translating complex stakeholder needs into outcome-based roadmaps and prioritized backlogs.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner closely with engineering and architecture teams.
  • Proven track record of defining strategy and using metrics to drive prioritization, decision-making, and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience operating in agile, product-centric delivery models.

Role Profiles and Preferred Qualifications


Preferred Qualifications (All Roles)

  • Familiarity with security operations and investigation workflows, including detection, threat hunting, incident response, digital forensics, and case management.
  • Experience with AI/ML-enabled products, workflow automation, or governance-by-design concepts such as auditability, access boundaries, policy enforcement, and safe automated actions.

Role 1: Digital Product Manager – Endpoint Security

Own the products that protect Allstate's endpoints, including endpoint detection and response, privilege management, and application control, moving from reactive, incident-driven changes to proactive, measurable risk reduction. You will work with a dedicated team of endpoint security engineers and report to the Lead Digital Product Manager – Endpoint & Data Defense.


Focus Areas

  • Endpoint coverage: ensure every endpoint is protected, with a clear, current view of where gaps remain and how they are being closed.
  • Prevention and controls: deploy protections and policy changes based on risk reduction, operational impact, and user experience, and scale block-by-default application control and least privilege with sustainable exception processes.
  • Alerting and containment: reduce alert noise, improve alert context, and enable fast, consistent device isolation.
  • Proactive defense: partner with threat intelligence, threat hunting, and purple teams to deploy protections ahead of emerging threats and vendor advisories.
  • AI-enabled operations: apply AI and automation to policy tuning, change deployment, and repetitive operational work.

Success is measured by endpoint coverage, prevention effectiveness, time to detect and contain, alert quality, deployment speed, and user experience.


Preferred Qualifications – Endpoint Security

  • Familiarity with endpoint security capabilities such as EDR, next-generation antivirus, endpoint privilege management, application control, or device control, using technologies like CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BeyondTrust, or similar.
  • Experience with large, heterogeneous endpoint environments, including Windows, macOS, Linux, virtual desktops, and cloud workloads.
  • Familiarity with threat-informed defense concepts such as MITRE ATT&CK and control validation.
  • Experience bringing product practices to infrastructure or operations teams, including iterative delivery and outcome-based change management.

Role 2: Digital Product Manager – Mission Control

Build Mission Control, a new product that gives Allstate's cyber defenders one unified operating experience, bringing intelligence, investigation context, and workflows from many separate security tools together in one place, with AI agents working alongside analysts. As an inaugural product role, you will partner with a dedicated engineering team to connect existing tools rather than replace them, and deliver early wins that move defenders faster from signal to decision to action.


Focus Areas

  • Unified operating view: give responders one central view of active incidents and investigations, relevant telemetry, and who is working on what, so context is not lost across tools and handoffs. 
  • Connected tools: integrate the SIEM, SOAR, case management, threat intelligence, endpoint, and ticketing tools defenders already use, along with the connections AI agents rely on, through a common, reusable integration layer.
  • Investigation and case workflows: streamline how alerts become cases and how investigations are coordinated across teams, cutting manual lookups and tool switching.
  • Decision support and AI agents: assemble evidence and recommend next steps with clear confidence information, laying the groundwork for governed, agent-assisted operations with humans accountable for high-impact decisions.
  • Adoption and trust: observe analysts' real workflows, earn their trust through transparency and audit trails, and retire old paths as the product proves its value.

Success is measured by fewer tool switches and manual lookups, less time spent assembling context, faster time to decide and act, clear visibility into investigation status, and analyst adoption and satisfaction.


Preferred Qualifications – Mission Control

  • Familiarity with security operations platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, XDR, and case management tools, using technologies like Microsoft Sentinel or similar.
  • Experience building analyst- or operator-facing workflow products, such as case management, incident management, or operations consoles, used by multiple teams.
  • Experience with integration and orchestration capabilities, such as APIs, event-driven workflows, or agent connectivity standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop AI or automation, including explainability, confidence signals, permissions, and audit trails.
  • Experience launching a new product from the ground up, including user research, prototyping, and early wins that drive adoption and build user trust.

Role 3: Digital Product Manager – WAF & Web Edge Protection

Own the products that protect Allstate's internet-facing web applications and APIs, including web application firewall (WAF), bot and API protection, and rapid virtual patching, across multiple providers, hosting platforms, and acquired businesses. Working with a dedicated team of WAF engineers, you will front the most exposed applications and APIs first, then build a reliable, measurable protection capability backed by deep in-house expertise. 


Focus Areas 

  • Exposure-led coverage: find the most exposed internet-facing applications and APIs and front them first, covering back-end services as well as front ends, with a clear, current view of protection status and remaining gaps. 
  • Protection and availability: partner with Digital Protection and application teams to balance aggressive tuning with legitimate traffic, move applications from alert-only to blocking mode with fast rollback, and track the availability and security indicators both sides rely on. 
  • Provider strategy and policy as code: lead use-case-based evaluations and proofs of value to select the right enterprise providers, consolidating where it improves outcomes while preserving resilience, and manage policy as code so one protection can be applied across every provider. 
  • Operations and rapid protection: shape a 24/7 support model with cyber operations, with clear runbooks and the ability to deploy emergency rules and virtual patches within hours of a newly exploited vulnerability. 
  • Reliability and AI-enabled operations: learn from outages and root cause analyses, feed WAF telemetry into shared security data, and apply AI and automation to tuning, onboarding, and repetitive operational work. 

Success is measured by coverage of the most exposed applications and APIs, blocking-mode adoption, time to deploy an emergency protection, availability impact from WAF changes, logging completeness, and the share of operations run by the in-house team.


Preferred Qualifications – WAF & Web Edge Protection

  • Familiarity with web application and API threats and protections, such as the OWASP Top 10, WAF, bot management, API security, and DDoS mitigation, using technologies like Akamai, Cloudflare, Fastly, F5, or similar.
  • Familiarity with web delivery fundamentals, including DNS, TLS certificates, load balancers, reverse proxies, Kubernetes ingress, and content delivery networks.
  • Experience leading vendor evaluations, RFPs, or proofs of value for a security or infrastructure platform, using use-case-based criteria that weigh outcomes, resilience, and cost.
  • Experience with policy as code, infrastructure as code, or CI/CD pipelines for managing security controls at scale.
  • Experience standing up 24/7 operational support for a critical control, including on-call models, runbooks, service-level objectives, and building in-house expertise.

Supervisory Responsibilities

These roles do not have supervisory duties.

Skills

Backlogs, Business Case Analyses, Product Delivery, Product Management, Product Organization, Product Ownership, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Product Vision, Systems Thinking

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 120,000.00 - 193,725.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.

Job Description

About Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms
Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms (ACO&P) is a net-new digital product organization within Cyber Operations, building the shared technology foundation for how modern cyber defense operates.
Our north star is an adaptive, engineering-led, AI-powered cyber operations platform that brings together high-fidelity security data, integrated tooling, AI, and automation to help defenders detect threats earlier, turn security telemetry into actionable intelligence, accelerate decision-making, and respond at machine speed.

By reducing fragmentation and intelligently applying AI and automation, ACO&P enables cyber defenders to focus their expertise where human judgment matters most while building a cyber operations ecosystem that continuously adapts to an evolving threat landscape.

About the Role
As a Lead Digital Product Manager in ACO&P, you will lead a portfolio of capabilities within the cyber operations ecosystem, shaping the product strategy for how those capabilities are delivered, measured, and continuously improved. As the portfolio evolves, you will identify, shape, and scale the capabilities that deliver the greatest value across Cyber Operations, balancing near-term needs with the long-term integrity, adoption, and outcomes of the platform.

You will lead and develop Digital Product Managers and partner closely with engineering leaders and Cyber Operations stakeholders to translate strategy into measurable outcomes, product roadmaps, and durable capabilities.

Open Roles
We are hiring Lead Digital Product Managers for three distinct portfolios. Each role shares the responsibilities and required qualifications below; the role profiles that follow describe the specific focus, capabilities, and preferred qualifications for each portfolio.

Key Responsibilities (All Roles)

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, outcomes, and roadmap for your portfolio, aligned to the ACO&P north star.
  • Lead, coach, and grow Digital Product Managers, building strong product practices in discovery, outcome definition, roadmapping, prioritization, and measurement.
  • Define measurable product outcomes and KPIs that connect your portfolio's performance, adoption, and user experience to Cyber Operations outcomes.
  • Translate complex Cyber Operations needs into a coherent product strategy, balancing immediate priorities with the foundational capabilities needed to unlock future value.
  • Drive connected capabilities that build on shared data, integrations, platform, workflow, and orchestration capabilities rather than isolated point solutions.
  • Define clear product boundaries, decision rights, and partnership models with adjacent teams across Cyber Operations, enterprise platforms, and engineering.
  • Advance AI and automation responsibly, establishing the product principles and guardrails needed for safe, auditable, and increasingly agentic cyber operations.
  • Guide build, buy, integrate, and retire decisions based on long-term value, user needs, resilience, interoperability, and portfolio integrity.
  • Stay close to defenders and the work, using continuous discovery, observation, product data, and feedback to understand friction, validate assumptions, and measure adoption and outcomes.
  • Communicate strategy, progress, evidence, and trade-offs to Cyber Operations leadership and stakeholders, resolving tensions between local needs and ecosystem-wide outcomes.

Required Qualifications (All Roles)

  • 8+ years of experience in digital product management, platform product leadership, or enterprise product delivery, with demonstrated experience leading, coaching, or influencing product teams.
  • Demonstrated success leading outcome-driven products, platforms, or portfolios in complex enterprise environments.
  • Track record of outcome-driven product management, including defining measurable outcomes, establishing baselines, using data to inform decisions, and prioritizing roadmaps against those outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder leadership with the ability to align engineering, platform, security, risk, and business partners around shared outcomes, priorities, and clear ownership boundaries.
  • Excellent strategic communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and operational topics clear and actionable for both executives and practitioners.

Role Profiles and Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications (All Roles)

  • Background in cybersecurity operations, such as SOC operations, incident response, threat intelligence, threat hunting, or detection engineering.
  • Experience enabling AI and automation at scale, including agentic AI governance concepts such as guardrails, auditability, human oversight, and safe actions.

Role 1: Lead Digital Product Manager – Cyber Intelligence Platform

Lead the foundational platform that turns security telemetry into trusted, decision-ready intelligence and connects it to the tools and workflows defenders use every day, reducing fragmentation and accelerating the path from signal to decision to action.


Focus Areas

  • Trusted security data: make telemetry reliable, timely, observable, and enriched, with shared data standards that improve quality and interoperability across the ecosystem.
  • Connected operating experience: bring intelligence, tools, workflows, and AI together so defenders can investigate, decide, and respond with less friction.
  • Decision intelligence and trusted AI: turn security context into prioritized insights and safe automated actions, and enable AI agents to interact safely with security data and tools.
  • Extensible platform: drive reusable integrations, APIs, orchestration, and platform patterns that serve multiple Cyber Operations teams.
  • Success is measured by platform health, adoption, user experience, and operational effectiveness across Cyber Operations.

Preferred Qualifications – Cyber Intelligence Platform

  • Demonstrated success owning platform or data products used by multiple internal teams.
  • Experience with security data, observability, telemetry pipelines, or SIEM and analytics ecosystems, such as Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Data Explorer, Cribl, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with KQL-style analytics, data normalization and schemas, and data quality and health concepts.
  • Experience building or leading internal developer or operator platforms, golden paths, APIs, orchestration, or workflow capabilities.
  • Experience with context enrichment, knowledge graphs, or decision-support products.

Role 2: Lead Digital Product Manager – Security Operations Missions

Lead the mission-focused capabilities that turn intelligence into protection, helping Cyber Operations discover threats earlier, investigate and respond faster, reduce exposure, and automate repetitive operational work.


Focus Areas

  • Threat discovery and intelligence: connect threat intelligence, hunting, detection, and security context to improve coverage, reduce noise, and focus on the highest-value threats.
  • Investigation and response: enable faster, more consistent investigation, containment, and response through connected workflows, decision support, and automation.
  • Exposure intelligence: combine vulnerability, threat, and business context to prioritize the exposures that matter most and measure risk reduction through remediation.
  • Scalable mission capabilities: work with frontline teams to turn workflows, decision logic, and response patterns into reusable, increasingly automated capabilities.
  • Success is measured by detection effectiveness, time to investigate and contain, exposure reduction, analyst effort, and automation effectiveness.


Preferred Qualifications – Security Operations Missions

  • Experience partnering closely with operational teams to translate frontline workflows and pain points into products that achieve measurable outcomes.
  • Familiarity with security operations technologies and workflows, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence, security analytics, and case management.
  • Familiarity with threat and exposure frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, threat-informed defense, and risk-based vulnerability prioritization.
  • Experience with insider threat or vulnerability and exposure management.
  • Experience building products that connect intelligence, operational workflows, and decision-making across multiple teams or systems.

Role 3: Lead Digital Product Manager – Endpoint & Data Defense

Lead the products that protect Allstate's endpoints and data across the enterprise and acquired businesses, moving from reactive, incident-driven control changes to proactive, threat-informed risk reduction while keeping friction low for end users.


Focus Areas

  • Endpoint coverage: protect every workstation, server, Mac, Linux, virtual desktop, and cloud workload, with clear visibility into gaps and compensating controls.
  • Prevention and hardening: advance EDR, privilege management, and application control that block malicious activity by default, deployed ahead of emerging threats with threat intelligence, hunting, and purple teams.
  • Data protection: evolve capabilities such as data loss prevention, encryption, removable media and data movement controls, and malware scanning of stored data.
  • Detection quality and containment: deliver high-fidelity telemetry, well-tuned policies, and reliable device isolation for detection, response, and threat hunting teams.
  • Portfolio rationalization: define clear scope with adjacent teams, retire overlapping tools, and break large policy and deployment changes into smaller, lower-risk increments.
  • Success is measured by coverage, prevention, detection, containment, risk reduction, and user experience.


Preferred Qualifications – Endpoint & Data Defense

  • Experience with endpoint security and data protection capabilities, such as EDR, endpoint privilege management, application control, DLP, encryption, or device control, using technologies like CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview, BeyondTrust, or similar.
  • Familiarity with large, heterogeneous endpoint environments and the trade-offs between protection and user experience.
  • Familiarity with threat-informed defense, MITRE ATT&CK, control validation, and purple team practices.
  • Experience with control governance and risk management, including coverage measurement, exception and risk-acceptance processes, and audit readiness.
  • Experience bringing multiple environments or acquired businesses onto common platforms, standards, and controls.

Supervisory Responsibilities

These roles lead, coach, and develop Digital Product Managers within their portfolio.

Skills

Cyber Defense, Cyber Operations, Cybersecurity Operations, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Influencing Others, Product Management, Product Organization, Product Ownership, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Product Vision, Security Analytics, Strategic Management, Systems Thinking

As a full-time Inside Sales Representative, you will:

  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy — no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Specialty Operations-Direct Claims manages and resolves the Company’s legacy commercial casualty exposures, including bodily injury and property damage claims involving asbestos, environmental pollution, products liability, abuse, workers’ compensation, and other long-tail and latent liabilities. The department evaluates claims and coverage, sets resolution strategies, manages complex policyholder accounts, and supports reinsurance recoveries.

Job Summary

The Director leads the Specialty Operations-Direct Claims department and is accountable for resolving the Company’s legacy insurance exposures. The Director develops and implements claims strategies, policies, procedures, and controls that manage financial and operational risk and resolve complex exposures in accordance with contractual and legal requirements.
The Director also leads strategies to reduce and exit legacy exposures, oversees management of complex claim and account resolutions, and partners with senior management, policyholders, insurers, reinsurers, mediators, and internal and external counsel on significant coverage, litigation, and settlement matters.

Key Responsibilities


  • Provides strategic leadership and oversight of complex claims, coverage matters, policyholder accounts, and legacy portfolios, developing innovative resolution strategies and ensuring sound claim handling practices.
  • Leads complex disputes and negotiations involving significant financial, legal, and reputational risk.
  • Monitors legal, regulatory, litigation, and industry trends, assesses their impact on claims strategy, legacy exposures, and financial results, and advises senior management on emerging risks.
  • Delivers clear, concise written and verbal reports to senior management on significant claims, portfolio trends, financial exposures, and strategic initiatives.
  • Oversees case reserves, financial analysis, projections, controls and governance, and partners with Finance, Actuarial, and other stakeholders on financial planning and reporting, including SOX and state and federal regulatory requirements.
  • Builds organizational capability by developing talent, strengthening succession pipelines, and connecting team contributions to Company objectives.
  • Builds effective relationships across Finance, Law & Regulation, Actuarial, and Property-Liability, and with brokers, insureds, reinsurers, consultants, intermediaries, and outside counsel.

Supervisory Responsibilities


Leads managers and claims professionals who handle complex legacy liabilities. Sets priorities and performance expectations, develops talent and succession capabilities, and ensures the team has the expertise and resources to execute strategy and meet Company objectives.


Qualifications


Education and Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree required; Juris Doctor (JD), MBA, or other advanced degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of progressively responsible experience in commercial casualty claims, complex coverage, legacy liabilities, litigation management, reinsurance, or related areas.
  • Experience leading complex claims, projects, and multidisciplinary teams.

Functional Skills


  • In-depth knowledge of commercial insurance policies, complex coverage issues, case law, and claims practices.
  • Extensive experience managing complex commercial casualty claims and long tail or latent exposures, including coverage analysis, litigation, and dispute resolution.
  • Strong financial acumen, including evaluating exposures, reserves, trends, and the financial impact of claim strategies.
  • Advanced negotiation skills with a record of resolving complex, high-severity disputes and developing innovative solutions.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategies for complex problems involving competing legal, financial, operational, and business considerations, and to translate emerging legal, regulatory, and industry developments into actionable strategies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex legal, financial, and insurance matters into clear recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple complex initiatives.
  • Sound independent judgment and the ability to build effective relationships with senior leaders, peers, cross-functional partners, and external insurance and reinsurance stakeholders.
  • Ability to lead through change and sustain a high-performing team.
  • Proficiency with claim management systems and Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, CoPilot and Teams.

The preceding description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities. The employee may be required to perform other related duties as assigned. Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this job.

Job.JobTitle: Lead Software Engineer- Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Software Developer / Engineer, IT / Technology, Cybersecurity Analyst
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Lead Software Engineer -Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms  

Help us build the next generation of AI-powered cybersecurity. 

What if you could use your software engineering skills to help transform how one of the world's leading insurance companies detects, investigates, and responds to cyber threats? 

At Allstate, we're building something new, and we're looking for engineers who want to be part of it. 

Our newly established Agentic Cyber Operations & Platforms (ACO&P) organization is bringing together software engineering, cloud technologies, security data, AI, and automation to create smarter, faster, and more connected cyber defense capabilities. 

We're looking for hands-on software engineers who enjoy building solutions, solving complex problems, and working with emerging technologies. 

What You'll Be Working On: We're growing two closely connected engineering teams. While both share a strong software development foundation, each focuses on a different part of our cybersecurity transformation. 

(1) Cyber Data & Intelligence: Build the Foundation 

Help us connect the dots across our cybersecurity ecosystem. This team is building the data intelligence and integration capabilities that bring together security information from different applications, cloud environments, and enterprise platforms.  
 
The team is also building scalable observability and telemetry capabilities that collect, process, enrich, and deliver data across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, and security platforms. 

You'll have opportunities to: 

  • Design and develop software integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect multiple security and technology platforms. 
  • Design and evolve observability and telemetry pipelines that ingest data from multiple enterprise sources and enable monitoring, analytics, security intelligence, and automation use cases. 
  • Build solutions to collect, process, and deliver security telemetry and operational data. 
  • Develop automation that makes security information more accessible, reliable, and actionable. 
  • Apply software engineering and DevOps practices to build scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. 
  • Help establish the foundation for future AI-powered security analytics and intelligent automation. 
  • Help build a unified data intelligence layer that makes security and operational telemetry accessible for advanced analytics, automation, and AI-enabled workflows. 

You might be a great fit if: You're a software engineer who enjoys backend development, APIs, systems integration, and working with data, with an interest in observability and modern cloud and platform engineering. Experience with cybersecurity, DevOps, or observability platforms is a plus. 

 

(2) Mission Control: Build the Experience 

Help us reimagine how cybersecurity teams manage and respond to incidents. This team is focused on bringing together incident management tools and capabilities into a more connected, streamlined experience for cyber defenders. 

You'll have opportunities to: 

  • Engineer and enhance applications that support cybersecurity incident management and response. 
  • Build integrations between enterprise applications and security platforms. 
  • Support and improve existing cloud-based applications while helping develop new in-house solutions. 
  • Take software solutions through the complete development lifecycle, from concept and proof of concept to production. 
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automation, and cloud-based application infrastructure. 
  • Help create a unified platform that makes it easier for security teams to investigate, collaborate, and respond to threats. 

You might be a great fit if: You're a hands-on backend or full-stack software engineer with experience building applications, working with cloud technologies, and delivering production-ready solutions. Cybersecurity experience is a welcome bonus, not a prerequisite. 

Both teams offer opportunities to contribute to a growing engineering organization and help shape how we build and deliver modern cyber operations capabilities. 

What We're Looking For 

At the heart of this role is strong software engineering capability. We're interested in engineers who can build, integrate, automate, and deliver reliable technology solutions. 

The Essentials 

  • Software Engineering: Hands-on experience developing applications, backend services, integrations, or automation solutions using languages such as Python, Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar. 
  • Application Development & Integration: Experience building or supporting APIs, software integrations, data pipelines, or production applications. 
  • Cloud Technologies: Working knowledge of Azure, AWS, or GCP, along with an understanding of modern infrastructure and application environments. 
  • DevOps & CI/CD: Familiarity with source control, automated testing, deployment pipelines, and software delivery practices using tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. 
  • AI-Assisted Development: Experience using AI coding assistants, such as GitHub Copilot, to support software development, with an understanding of code review, testing, and validation. 
  • Security Awareness: An understanding of secure software development principles, including application security, access controls, and protecting sensitive information. 
  • Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional teams to translate technical requirements into practical engineering solutions. 

Experience That Would Be a Plus 

Depending on your background and interests, experience in any of the following areas could be valuable: 

  • Cybersecurity & Observability: Experience with observability, telemetry, log processing, security monitoring, or SIEM technologies such as Datadog, Cribl, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, or similar platforms. 
  • Data Engineering & Integration: Working with telemetry and data pipelines, streaming technologies, Azure Data Explorer (ADX), Kusto Query Language (KQL), SQL/NoSQL databases, data lakes, Kafka, Databricks or similar technologies. 
  • Cloud & Platform Engineering: Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application development. 
  • Infrastructure & Observability: Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, networking, distributed systems, observability, telemetry, and modern application architectures. 
  • Full-Stack Development: Building REST APIs, microservices, or web applications using frameworks such as React or Angular. 
  • AI & Intelligent Automation: Exposure to AI/ML technologies, AI agents, agentic workflows, or automation solutions. 
  • Cybersecurity Concepts: Familiarity with vulnerability management, incident response, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, or zero-trust principles. 

These are preferred skills, not a checklist. We recognize that great engineers bring different technical strengths and experiences. You don't need to have worked with every technology listed to be considered. 

Why Join Us? 

  • Build something new:  Join a growing organization where you'll help develop foundational platforms and capabilities rather than simply maintain existing systems. 
  • Engineering with real-world impact:  Your work will help cybersecurity professionals access better information, make faster decisions, and respond more effectively to emerging threats. 
  • Explore AI and automation :  Work in an environment where AI-assisted development and intelligent automation are part of our technology direction, with opportunities to expand your skills as these capabilities evolve. 
  • Bring your strengths and keep growing :  Whether your background is in backend development, full-stack engineering, cloud platforms, or data integration, you'll have opportunities to apply your expertise while developing new capabilities. 
  • Collaborate across disciplines:  Work alongside software engineers, cloud specialists, data professionals, and cybersecurity teams to solve meaningful technology challenges. 

Ready to Build What's Next? 

If you're a software engineer who loves solving problems, enjoys building technology from the ground up, and is curious about the intersection of software engineering, cybersecurity, and AI, this could be an exciting next step. 

You don't have to come from a traditional cybersecurity background. What matters most is your ability to engineer solutions, learn new technologies, and contribute to building something meaningful. 

Bring your engineering expertise. We'll bring the challenges, opportunities, and room to grow. 

Skills

Application Development, CI/CD, DevOps, Full Stack Development, Identity Access Management (IAM)

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 100,000.00 - 170,500.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment  while making a difference, then apply to join our team today! 

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

Job Description

The Event Planning Lead Consultant is responsible for leading the strategy, planning and execution of complex, high-profile enterprise events, with a strong emphasis on domestic and international incentive and recognition programs. This role requires demonstrated expertise in delivering luxury incentive travel experiences, managing global vendor partnerships, and overseeing sophisticated event logistics.

This role requires occasional international travel.  A valid passport is required for such travel.  If a candidate does not already possess a passport, they must be able to obtain one upon hire.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

·         Strategic Event Leadership: Independently lead end to end planning and execution of complex enterprise events and large-scale domestic and international incentive programs. 

·         International Program Management: Manage international destination sourcing, luxury hotel selection, destination management companies (DMCs), cultural considerations, and complex travel logistics. 

·         Experience Design: Develop distinctive recognition experience, including executive engagements, award celebration, gala events, exclusive excursions, and elevated hospitality programs. 

·         Vendor & Contract management: Source, negotiate, and manage domestic and international suppliers, ensuring contractual compliance, service excellence, and financial accountability. 

·         Budget Management: Develop and manage significant program budgets, including international financial considerations, cost forecasting, and expense reconciliation. 

·         Risk Management: Partner with internal experts and external providers to address international travel requirements, attendee safety, duty of care, contingency planning, and operational risks. 

·         Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, business partners, and cross-functional teams while providing proactive communication and strategic recommendations. 

·         Onsite Leadership: Direct complex onsite operations, manage supplier performance, resolve issues, and ensure seamless execution of all program elements.

·         Continuous Improvement: Evaluate program outcomes, attendee feedback, and operational effectiveness to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement. 


Required Qualifications

·         Extensive professional experience planning and executing complex corporate events, including large-scale incentive and recognition programs.

·         Demonstrated hands-on experience independently leading international incentive travel programs from destination sourcing through onsite execution.

·         Proven experience working with luxury hotels, international DMCs, global suppliers, and complex attendee travel arrangements.

·         Strong financial acumen, including management of significant event budgets, contract negotiations, and vendor relationships.

·         Experience supporting senior executives and managing high-visibility, business-critical programs.

·         Excellent project management, communication, problem solving, and stakeholder relationship skills. 

·         Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and make sound decisions in fast-paced environments. 

·         Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including extended onsite assignments. 


Preferred Qualifications

·         Experience managing international incentive programs for large groups of top-performing sales professionals.

·         Experience delivering luxury recognition programs involving several hundred attendees.

·         Established relationships with global hospitality partners and international destination management companies. 

·         CMP, CIS, CSEP, or equivalent industry certification.

·         Experience leveraging event technology, data analytics, and AI-enabled tools to improve planning efficiency and attendee experiences. 


Education

  10 years or more years of experience (Preferred)


#LI-SP2

Skills

Budget Management, Contract Management, Contract Negotiations, Corporate Event Planning, Domestic Travel Arrangements, Event Management, Event Planning, International Travels, Stakeholder Management, Vendor Management

Base compensation offered for this role is $70,100 -$110,400 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Leads an Operational Resilience capability and its team, setting operational objectives and driving execution in alignment with broader Operational Resilience strategy. Shapes the capability’s roadmap, standards, and priorities and monitors and improves its effectiveness. Serves as the capability’s lead partner to OR³ and AoR leaders, providing second-line oversight and influence on complex resilience matters.

Critical Capability: This role supports one of the Company’s critical capabilities, areas of expertise that are increasingly essential to the Company’s strategy, transformation and long-term success. Work within these capabilities requires specialized expertise and operates in a highly competitive and rapidly evolving talent market that extends beyond traditional insurance and financial services organizations. Roles in these areas apply specialized knowledge and capabilities to address complex, evolving business needs and enable the Company to remain competitive, resilient and positioned for future growth.

Operational Resilience: Applies specialized expertise to strengthen the reliability and resilience of critical business operations, technology and processes. Work within this capability helps the Company anticipate and prepare for disruption, maintain business continuity and rapidly recover when disruptive events occur, protecting critical operations and supporting consistent service to customers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead execution of the operational resilience framework within the capability, applying critical business services, impact tolerances, and scenario testing to the capability’s resilience discipline; influence framework enhancements and alignment with evolving regulatory expectations.
  • Lead the capability's transition to an integrated, service-based operational resilience model, including its content and requirements in Fusion.
  • Establish and execute the capability's roadmap, milestones, budget, resource priorities, and performance objectives, including role-based training and awareness.
  • Evaluate capability effectiveness and recommend and implement changes to methods, tools, standards, and practices to address emerging risks and improve outcomes.
  • Engage members of the Operational Risk, Return and Resilience (OR³) organization to identify and understand risks facing AoR operations; provide independent challenge, escalate material gaps, and agree on corrective actions.
  • Set requirements and oversee capability exercises and testing, ensuring significant findings are addressed to closure. Lead or support enterprise response, recovery, and crisis-management activities during significant disruptions.
  • Provide capability metrics, key risk indicators, emerging risk insights, and reporting for enterprise dashboards and risk committees; recommend priorities for remediation and investment.
  • Own capability standards and requirements and ensure they are represented in Fusion. Build cross-functional partnerships that strengthen integrated planning, response, and recovery.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team that may include Managers, Experts, and Consultants; establish staffing, workforce planning, performance expectations, development priorities and succession plans that sustain capability performance.
  • Represent the capability in regulatory examinations and Internal Audit reviews and provide second-line guidance to first-line partners in preparing for audits.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

·       This job has supervisory duties.


EXPERIENCE

·       10 or more years of experience (Preferred) in operational resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, operational or technology risk, information security, or related fields.


CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • No certification, license or registration is required for the job. Preferred: MBCP, CBCP, MBCI, CRISC, or CISM.
  • ;">No certification, license or registration is required for the job. Preferred: MBCP, CBCP, MBCI, CRISC, or CISM.;">No certification, license or registration is required for the job. Preferred: MBCP, CBCP, MBCI, CRISC, or CISM.


FUNCTIONAL SKILLS

  • Capability strategy and road mapping
  • People leadership and coaching
  • Second-line risk governance and oversight
  • Resilience standards across business continuity, disaster recovery, and crisis management
  • Senior leader influence and strategic partnership
  • Executive reporting
  • Budget and resource management
  • Insurance industry knowledge and ability to contextualize resilience risks within core business operations
  • Experience with Fusion Risk Management or similar resilience tools
  • Understanding of business unit and industry systems, processes, and requirements

Skills

Business, Business Continuity Management (BCM), Crisis Management, Employee Supervision, Leadership, Operational Resilience, Planning, Strategic Collaborations, Strategic Objectives, Technical Consulting

Compensation offered for this role is 120,000.00 - 193,725.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. Job Description

The Operational Resilience Expert provides authoritative, second-line expertise to strengthen preparedness, response, recovery, and operational resilience across the enterprise. As a trusted advisor to OR³ and AoR leaders, the role directs highly complex resilience initiatives, provides oversight and expert guidance on significant operational risks, and influences decisions that advance the enterprise’s resilience capabilities. The position evaluates emerging risks and regulatory developments, identifies resilience gaps, and drives solutions that keep critical business services within established impact tolerances during disruptive events.

Critical Capability: This role supports one of the Company’s critical capabilities, areas of expertise that are increasingly essential to the Company’s strategy, transformation and long-term success. Work within these capabilities requires specialized expertise and operates in a highly competitive and rapidly evolving talent market that extends beyond traditional insurance and financial services organizations. Roles in these areas apply specialized knowledge and capabilities to address complex, evolving business needs and enable the Company to remain competitive, resilient and positioned for future growth.

Operational Resilience: Applies specialized expertise to strengthen the reliability and resilience of critical business operations, technology and processes. Work within this capability helps the Company anticipate and prepare for disruption, maintain business continuity and rapidly recover when disruptive events occur, protecting critical operations and supporting consistent service to customers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Direct highly complex execution of the operational resilience framework, integrating requirements across business and technology areas and providing authoritative guidance on matters with significant enterprise impact.
  • Contribute to the capability’s transition to an integrated, service-based operational resilience model, including design of current content and requirements in Fusion.
  • Evaluate emerging industry practices, regulatory developments, and operational risks, translating findings into recommendations that improve outcomes.
  • Author and maintain operational resilience standards, methods, and assessment criteria, including critical-service identification, impact tolerances, dependency mapping, business impact analysis, risk scoring, and scenario testing.
  • Advise areas of responsibility during disruptions by evaluating impacts, guiding response and recovery, coordinating stakeholders, and leading post-event reviews; participate in crisis management and on-call rotations as assigned.
  • Engage members of OR³ and AoR business leaders to identify risks, evaluate resilience gaps, provide independent challenge, escalate significant issues, and drive corrective actions to closure.
  • Build strategic partnerships across Information Security, Physical Security, Emergency Response Teams, Technology, Third-Party Risk Management, and Supplier Management to improve integrated planning, response, and recovery.
  • Direct complex resilience exercises and training and awareness programs, and coach less experienced professionals.
  • Direct resilience capability, third-party, and technology assessments to identify vulnerabilities, evaluate recovery capabilities, and recommend risk mitigation strategies.
  • Develop resilience metrics, key risk indicators, and executive reporting that help leaders evaluate effectiveness and prioritize improvements.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

·       This job does not have supervisory duties.

EXPERIENCE

·       7 or more years of experience (Preferred) in operational resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, operational or technology risk, information security, or related fields.


CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • No certification, license or registration is required for the job. Preferred: MBCP, CBCP, MBCI, CRISC, or CISM.
  • ;">No certification, license or registration is required for the job. Preferred: MBCP, CBCP, MBCI, CRISC, or CISM.;">No certification, license or registration is required for the job. Preferred: MBCP, CBCP, MBCI, CRISC, or CISM.

FUNCTIONAL SKILLS

  • Deep knowledge of at least one resilience discipline
  • Standards and policy writing
  • Program leadership
  • Senior leader influence and consensus building
  • Risk analysis
  • Executive communication
  • Industry and regulatory awareness
  • Experience with Fusion Risk Management or similar resilience tools
  • Independent challenge and risk-based decision making
  • Resilience framework and methodology design

Skills

Business Continuity, Business Impact Analysis (BIA), Emerging Risks, Operational Resilience, Operational Risks, Risk Mitigation, Risk Mitigation Strategies, Training

Compensation offered for this role is 100,000.00 - 170,500.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job Description

The Product Engineer architects and designs digital products using modern tools, technologies, frameworks and systems, applying a systematic approach to the design, implementation, testing and documentation of software. Working within the Auto Team, the role focuses on product engineering and Java development, with emphasis on observability and application monitoring, AI-assisted development practices and test automation using Rest Assured. The role owns and manages running its application in production and is ultimately accountable for the success of its digital products through achieving KPIs.

Key responsibilities 

 

 

  • Participates in iteration planning meetings, ensuring the team has a common understanding of each story and chore in the team backlog

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment  while making a difference, then apply to join our team today! 

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?

  • 20 PTO Days per year & 6 Paid Holidays
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program
  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive

  • 0 – 2 years of experience

Job Description

Allstate’s sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from life’s uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy — no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $20/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $ $55,000–$82,510/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstate’s discretion.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customer’s needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstate’s support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance 
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.
  • Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employee’s first 90 days of employment.
  • Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

Job Description

Join the legal frontline and champion the defense for both the insured and Allstate! As a Senior Trial Attorney, you'll independently manage a complex litigation caseload involving bodily injury, property damage and PIP/No-Fault lawsuits, subrogation matters, and uninsured/underinsured motorist claims.

You'll lead trials, arbitrations, mediations, and high-exposure negotiations while providing strategic counsel to business partners and collaborating across legal teams. Stay ahead of the game by monitoring new laws and regulations, ensuring our litigation strategies remain sharp and effective. Embrace the excitement of challenging cases, courtroom advocacy, and meaningful victories in this dynamic role!

This opportunity is also a bonus eligible role!

Key Responsibilities

  • Represents insured individuals and Allstate in the defense of bodily injury and property damage lawsuits, subrogation litigation, PIP/no-fault matters, and uninsured/underinsured motorist cases.
  • Independently manages all aspects of litigation from case inception through resolution, including case evaluation, discovery, motion practice, arbitrations, mediations, settlement negotiations, and trial.
  • Reviews new file assignments, analyzes documentary evidence, develops litigation strategy, and directs discovery efforts.
  • Prepares for and conducts hearings, depositions, examinations under oath, arbitrations, mediations, settlement conferences, and trials.
  • Drafts and argues substantive motions and prepares complex pleadings, trial documents, and motions in limine.
  • Prepares witnesses, clients, and expert witnesses for depositions, arbitrations, mediations, and trial testimony.
  • Investigates and pursues subrogation opportunities and recovery efforts, as appropriate.
  • Provides legal counsel and strategic litigation guidance to claims business partners and other internal clients.
  • Keeps claim business partners informed regarding case developments, litigation strategy, exposure assessments, settlement recommendations, and trial preparation.
  • Keeps abreast of and evaluates new laws, regulations, and case law developments; identifies emerging legal trends and proactively advises business partners regarding potential impacts.
  • The Senior Trial Attorney is required to travel to court as needed throughout the Metro Boston area, Worcester, the South Shore, Greater Boston, and other locations across Massachusetts in support of litigation responsibilities, including court appearances, depositions, mediations, arbitrations, and trials.

Education

  • Juris Doctorate and active membership in good standing with the Massachusetts State Bar.

Experience

  • 4+ years of litigation experience within insurance defense, bodily injury, personal injury, PIP/no-fault litigation, subrogation, or related civil litigation fields.
  • First or second chair jury trial experience preferred.
  • Experience conducting depositions, mediations, arbitrations, hearings, and settlement negotiations.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage an active litigation caseload through resolution.
  • Strong legal research, writing, analytical, and advocacy skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, legal research platforms, and internet-based legal research tools.
  • Strong teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with attorneys, paralegals, and administrative assistants.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote/hybrid environment and travel throughout Massachusetts, including the Metro Boston area, Worcester, the South Shore, Greater Boston, and other court venues as needed.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Explore the Benefits of Joining Allstate's Client Legal Services:

  • Exceptional Work-Life Balance: At Allstate, we understand the importance of achieving harmony between work and personal life. Our in-house litigation roles provide more predictable schedules and flexibility, allowing you to excel professionally while enjoying a fulfilling personal life.
  • Holistic Understanding of the Business: As part of the Allstate legal team, you'll gain invaluable insight into our diverse business operations, objectives, and culture. This comprehensive understanding enables you to align legal strategies closely with the company's goals, fostering impactful contributions and strategic partnerships across departments.
  • Direct Client Collaboration: Working in-house at Allstate means collaborating directly with internal stakeholders and business units. This close partnership cultivates deeper client relationships, facilitating a nuanced understanding of their needs and priorities. By providing proactive legal guidance and support, you'll play a pivotal role in driving the company's success.
  • Strategic Influence and Impact: As an integral member of our legal team, you'll have the opportunity to shape strategic decisions and risk management initiatives. Your insights and expertise will inform key business decisions, empowering you to mitigate risks effectively and drive positive outcomes that directly impact Allstate's bottom line.
  • Diverse Legal Challenges: In-house litigation roles at Allstate encompass a broad spectrum of legal work beyond traditional litigation, including regulatory compliance, risk assessment, and dispute resolution. This diversity of challenges ensures continuous professional growth and development, expanding your skill set and enhancing your career trajectory.
  • Professional Growth Opportunities: With opportunities for advancement and professional development, you'll have the support and resources you need to reach new heights in your legal career.
