Job Description

Put your analytical skills and claims expertise to work as an Auto Field Adjuster with National General, an Allstate Company. In this role, you’ll evaluate first- and third-party material damage claims, develop comprehensive damage estimates, and guide claims toward appropriate resolution. You’ll apply your knowledge of regulatory requirements, fair claims practices, policy coverage, and estimating fundamentals while building trusted relationships with internal and external customers. From negotiating settlements to documenting claim activity and making payments within your authority, you’ll take meaningful ownership of the claims process and help deliver thoughtful, well-supported outcomes.

National General is seeking a Material Damage Specialist to evaluate and resolve 1st and 3rd party auto physical damage claims. In this role, you will inspect damages, prepare comprehensive repair estimates, negotiate settlements, and ensure compliance with fair claims practices and company policies.


Depending on experience level, candidates may also serve as a technical resource and mentor to peers, leveraging advanced estimating expertise to support complex material damage losses.


Where You’ll Work: This is a field-based position supporting customers throughout North Dakota, South Dakota, or Minnesota. Candidates must live within reasonable proximity to the assigned territory and be comfortable with regular local travel to support customers and complete in-person claim inspections.


Preferred Experience:

  • Auto physical damage claims handling
  • Writing and reviewing vehicle repair estimates
  • 1st and 3rd party material damage claims
  • Negotiating claim settlements and managing complex files
  • Knowledge of estimating platforms (CCC, Mitchell, Audatex, etc.)
  • Strong customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Prior field estimating or material damage appraisal experience preferred


Key Responsibilities

• Interprets regulatory compliance and fair claims practices

• Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files

• Applies mastered content in interpretations of all policy types written by the company and assists leadership in formal and ad hoc training

• Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on 1st and 3rd party material damage losses of all severities

• Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers


Supervisory Responsibilities

• This job does not have supervisory duties.


As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.


Training: Please note: You may be required to attend 2 weeks of training held in person at our Dallas, TX office.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Arity is a part of the Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We collect and analyze enormous amounts of data in order to provide cutting-edge solutions to companies invested in transportation.

The Team
The Arity Sales team plants the seeds of our company’s success. We’re looking for candidates who bring a unique concoction of consulting, business development, technology, and—of course—sales experience to help our business take off. Innovation, transparency and a desire to do the right thing are essential for this position, because we’re not selling one specific product—we’re selling ideas and solutions we truly believe in. Team members are passionate about their job and excited about the opportunity to drive change not just for customers, but for an entire industry. Our ideal candidate has deep knowledge of transportation across multiple industries and thinks outside the box to help our partners solve their toughest transportation problems. Sound like you? Let’s chat!

The Role
The Sales Engineering Senior Manager is an expert-level individual contributor who helps prospective customers evaluate, integrate, and realize business value from Arity’s mobile experiences and performance marketing solutions. The role requires a business-savvy technical leader with hands-on experience in mobile application development and API-based data integration. This individual leads customer discovery, translates business objectives into solution architecture, and demonstrates how Arity products can create measurable value through our mobile SDK, API, and data-driven platform integrations. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders, the Expert Sales Engineer influences product direction, technical strategy, and go-to-market execution through technical expertise, customer insight, and quantified value assessments.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the technical subject matter expert for Arity’s mobile SDK product and UI kits, integration of processes like real time bidding (RTB) models, consumer data pre-fill, and integration into Arity’s and other performance marketing platforms; evaluate customer business goals, operating processes, technical architecture and integration needs to qualify product fit.
  • Be an inquisitive listener eager to challenge organizations to think differently and adopt new ideas.
  • Lead complex technical discovery engagements to understand customer objectives, business processes, technology ecosystems, implementation requirements, and success measures.
  • Design solution architectures that use Arity products, APIs and data assets to address customer business challenges, and clearly communicate technical trade-offs, dependencies and recommended approaches.
  • Assess gaps and opportunities in product features, API capabilities and integration patterns based on market demand; partner with product and engineering to prioritize the work with the greatest customer and business value.
  • Assess gaps and opportunities in product marketing, including business-value messaging, technical enablement and API integration guidance, and help prioritize the work needed to support market adoption.
  • Partner with business development representatives on strategic opportunities, leading technical discovery, solution design, feasibility assessment and value articulation from qualification through customer decision.
  • Act as a technical thought leader through customer workshops, industry conferences, webinars and market-facing presentations based on the individual’s industry expertise.

Required Qualifications

  • Author request for information (RFI) and request for proposal (RFP) responses for prospective customers; assist with proposals and statements of work (SOWs), including solution architecture, API integration scope, assumptions, dependencies and value expectations.
  • Design, manage and execute evaluations and pilot projects for potential customers, including API-based prototypes, mobile or web application experiences, and REST API data integrations that retrieve or post data between systems.
  • Develop solution-level business cases by establishing a baseline, identifying measurable benefits and costs, defining assumptions, and estimating value such as revenue growth, cost reduction, risk reduction, productivity improvement or customer experience impact.
  • Partner with customer technology and business teams to map current-state and future-state processes, identify where API-enabled data or capabilities improve the workflow, and define success measures for implementation and adoption.
  • Build long-term business relationships and become a trusted advisor by connecting technology decisions to customer business processes, operating metrics and strategic objectives.
  • Create presentation assets, API-enabled prototypes and interactive product demonstrations; clearly explain both the technical approach and the expected business impact to technical and non-technical audiences; participate in conferences and events, including speaking and technical demonstrations, to generate leads.
  • Understand customer needs and business processes to advise product development teams on roadmap capabilities that are not currently available; provide leadership visibility into future-state requirements, integration needs, implementation effort, adoption considerations and potential value based on customer interaction and competitive research.
  • Experience or knowledge working with development teams building mobile applications on iOS and Android platforms.
  • Familiarity with Swift, Kotlin, Xcode, Android Studio, and modern mobile development frameworks.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs, SDKs, cloud services, and backend data platforms.
  • Understanding mobile application deployment, observability, security, and performance best practices.
  • Strategic sales and consultative discovery skills to evaluate customer requirements, business processes, technical constraints and value drivers to determine Arity product fit.
  • Strong technical fluency in API consumption and integration, including the ability to interpret API documentation, understand request and response structures, work with REST endpoints, and explain GET, POST and related patterns. Experience with API testing tools, mobile or web development, SQL, Python or Scala is valuable.
  • Ability to lead through expertise and influence, navigate organizational dynamics, and align business, product and engineering stakeholders around a practical solution and measurable outcomes.
  • Ability to design, estimate, manage and execute large projects and engagements, both internally and externally, including integration scope, implementation effort, dependencies, risks and expected business value.
  • Expert ability to map current-state and future-state business processes, establish measurable baselines, develop ROI and value models, and quantify expected outcomes such as revenue growth, cost reduction, productivity improvement, risk reduction or customer experience impact.
  • Strong oral and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate between executive business needs and detailed technical requirements.
  • Ability to build long-term business relationships with customers

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4-year Bachelor's Degree (Minimum)
  • 8 or more years of experience (Preferred)
  • Functional experience in insurance technology, mobility, advertising technology, or another data-intensive industry is strongly preferred.
  • Experience applying technology to business processes, identifying measurable outcomes, and building business cases is a critical component of this role.
  • Experience with API-based data consumption and integration is required, including REST APIs, HTTP methods, authentication, JSON payloads, error handling, API testing, and system-to-system data exchange. Experience with mobile or web application development that consumes APIs to power a user interface is highly valuable. Experience with big data analytics and leading cloud platforms is strongly preferred.

You’ll do all this in a flexible environment that embraces connection and belonging. And with the recognition of several inclusivity and diversity awards, we’ve proven that Allstate empowers everyone to lead, drive change and give back where they work and live.

Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Contents Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Columbus, OH
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Coordinated Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Coordinated Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will be handling escalated claims files involving complex contents damage to ensure our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these claims.

  • Handle escalated claims files involving complex contents damage.

  • Conduct a thorough coverage investigation of the loss and ensure the policy was applied correctly.  

  • Use advanced video technology to collaborate with onsite vendors to identify damages and write a contents damage estimate.  

  • Communicate empathetically with customers and help them through their claim process in a fast, fair, and easy manner.  

  • Negotiate claim settlements with customers in accordance with business unit standard methodologies.  

  • Coordinate with structure and ALE adjusters to ensure holistic handling of the claim file. 

  • Use data and analytics to tell a story and influence decision making.  

  • If offered the role, you will go through virtual training.  You will receive ongoing support, mentoring and coaching as you develop your career.    

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:  

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.  

  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.  

  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.  

  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.  

  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.  

  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.   

Schedule:  

  • Monday – Friday; 8 am - 5 pm with rotational weekend duty, Saturday or Sunday.  

  • This role involves taking care of customers in their times of need. As a result, you must be willing to work some weekend and extended hours if necessary.  

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Reside in Columbus, OH area.

  • 3+ years of previous experience handling property insurance claims preferred.

  • Have prior experience using estimating software like Xactimate for complex contents estimating.  

  • Value providing an effortless customer service experience.  

  • You enjoy the ability to work independently in the field or from your home office.   

  • View problems and setbacks as opportunities for improvement and look forward to coming up with creative solutions.   

  • Are organized and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Are known for clear and professional communication – both written and verbal. 

Required Qualifications:

  • Required to have a valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role. 

You’re provided with comprehensive training:  

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.  

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job. 

  

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.

  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

  

  

Sign On Bonus:   

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.  

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.  

Company Car:  

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.  

   

Allstate Benefits:  

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:  

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.  

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.  

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.  

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit: www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!  


As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.  

  

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:  


  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.   
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.   
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.  
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.   
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.    

Preferred Qualifications:  


  • Reside in Birmingham, AL.
  • 2-3 years prior experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.   
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

  

Required Qualifications:


  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one-to-two-story roof.

You’re provided with comprehensive training:


  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job

** Please note, you will be required to attend 2-weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

 

Sign On Bonus:


  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Job.JobTitle: Bodily Injury Adjuster - Represented/Litigation, Complex/Severe - CST/MST/PST (Remote)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented/Litigation Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job:

The individual selected for this role will join a team who primarily handles claims in the following states: CA, other western states and/or IL

As a Represented/Litigation adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

* Candidates in the Pacific, Mountain and Central Time Zones preferred*

**This position is not available for California (Unless you have litigation background and 3 years experience in litigation), Alaska, Hawaii, Washington, or Puerto Rico residents.**

The first approximately 6-9 weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - North Augusta, SC
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!  

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.  

  

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:  

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.   
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.   
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.   
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.  
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.   
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.    

Qualifications:  

  • 2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.  
  • Previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.  
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.  
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.  
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.  
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.  
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.  
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.  

  

Required Qualifications:  

  • Residency within the North Augusta, SC area is mandatory for this role.   
  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof. 
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.  

  

You’re provided with comprehensive training:  

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work. 
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job. 
  • You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.  

  

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.  

  

Sign On Bonus:   

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.  

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus. 

  

Company Car:  

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.  

  

Allstate Benefits:  

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:  

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.  
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.  
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.  
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.  #LI-TW1

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to support and enhance enterprise access management platforms that secure critical applications and digital services across the organization. This role will serve as a lead responsible for designing, configuring, implementing, and supporting commercial IAM solutions while partnering with business and technology teams to deliver secure, scalable access management capabilities.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with web access management and identity platforms such as IBM Verify Identity Access, IBM Verify Access, IBM Security Access Manager (ISAM), PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (PAIC), Ping Access, PingFederate, PingAM, or similar enterprise IAM technologies. This individual will play a key role in product strategy, solution design, vendor management, application integrations, troubleshooting, testing, issue resolution, and mentoring team members.

The Allstate job title for this is role is Vended Application Lead Consultant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support and guide the design, configuration, enhancement, and support of enterprise Identity and Access Management solutions, with a focus on vended access management platforms.

  • Develop technical and functional designs that address complex business requirements, application access needs, and security objectives.

  • Configure, develop within, and maintain IAM platforms that support authentication, authorization, single sign-on (SSO), federation, and access control capabilities.

  • Partner with business stakeholders, security teams, infrastructure teams, application owners, and vendor support teams to deliver secure access management solutions.

  • Contribute to product planning by creating, refining, and guiding user stories for complex features, including coaching team members who may be learning the platform or process.

  • Facilitate feature review sessions for complex business issues and requirements, document key decisions, and ensure alignment across business and technical teams.

  • Create functional designs using moderate technical skills to address complex business processes, product features, and application integration needs.

  • Support the planning, execution, and review of module, integration, and system testing for assigned features and product stories.

  • Manage issues, blockers, defects, and implementation risks through resolution for assigned features and product stories.

  • Review and validate new vendor release features, assess impact, and identify opportunities to improve platform capability and reliability.

  • Use vendor defect resolution processes, support tools, product documentation, and developer groups to troubleshoot issues and influence future product direction.

  • Evaluate proposed vendor software products and enhancements in alignment with strategic corporate direction, platform standards, and vendor roadmaps.

  • Provide knowledge and support for resolving technology issues across multiple business areas and application processes.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for access management processes, vended IAM platforms, and related application integrations.

  • Provide training, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to strengthen team capability and bench strength.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, process documentation, support procedures, and implementation guidance.

Essential Qualifications

  • 5 years or more of experience implementing, configuring, administering, or supporting enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions. (Or Equivalent)

  • Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise web access management or IAM platforms, such as IBM Verify Identity Access (IVIA), IBM Verify Access, IBM Security Access Manager (ISAM), IBM Verify Access Appliance or related earlier versions, Okta, ForgeRock, PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (PAIC), Ping Access, PingFederate, PingAM, or similar vended access management tools. (Or Equivalent)

  • Experience configuring or developing within vendor software to support access management, application authentication, authorization, and secure application access.

  • Experience implementing and supporting single sign-on (SSO), federation, and access management solutions for enterprise applications.

  • Experience writing automation scripts to complete the integration mapping automation using scripting languages, such as JavaScript, Python, Groovy, YAML or PowerShell. (Or Equivalent) 

  • Knowledge of common identity and access standards and protocols, including SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and federation concepts.

  • Experience gathering complex business requirements and translating them into functional and technical designs.

  • Experience supporting module testing, integration testing, issue resolution, and production troubleshooting for enterprise applications or platforms.

  • Ability to lead technical discussions, organize requirements or feature review sessions, and document resulting decisions.

  • Experience working with vendor support processes, product documentation, defect resolution procedures, or developer support groups.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, identify blockers, drive issue resolution, and support delivery of assigned product features.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder partnership skills.

  • Ability to mentor, coach, or train team members and share knowledge across technical and business teams.

  • Equivalent combinations of technical training, certifications, and relevant work experience will be considered.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large enterprise IAM or access management environments.

  • Experience with cloud-based identity platforms, SaaS application integrations, or hybrid identity environments.

  • Knowledge of directory services such as Active Directory, LDAP, or related identity stores.

  • Experience with API security, access gateways, reverse proxies, policy configuration, or application onboarding for access management platforms.

  • Familiarity with Identity Governance Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), adaptive authentication, multi-factor authentication (MFA), or related security technologies.

  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Product Engineering, or similar delivery environments.

  • Experience evaluating vendor roadmaps, testing new release features, and recommending platform enhancements.

  • Relevant identity, security, cloud, or vendor certifications.

  • Experience in creating technical documentation, operational procedures, training materials, or platform standards.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Are you someone who enjoys being on the move, solving problems, and making a real impact for customers? As a Field Auto Appraiser, you'll be at the forefront of our claims process—meeting customers where they are, whether it's at their home, a repair shop, or a tow yard.

You'll take the lead in writing estimates and guiding customers through the repair or total loss process, using a mix of in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication. No two days are the same—whether you're evaluating damage on-site or collaborating with body shops and service providers, you'll enjoy a fast-paced, hands-on role that keeps you engaged and on your toes.

If you're looking for a career that blends technical know-how, customer service, and the freedom of field work, this is your chance to thrive in a role where your expertise truly matters.


Sign-On Bonus: A $5,000 sign-on bonus may be offered to qualified candidates who receive and accept an employment offer. Eligibility, payment timing, and conditions will be outlined in the official offer letter.

  • You have a High School Diploma or a GED
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates
  • Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements

  • The Problem Solver – you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

In this role, you will help design, build, and deliver the next generation of operational claims systems supporting Allstate Dealer Services. This platform is a strategic investment in the future of the business, enabling more efficient operations, faster service delivery, improved customer experiences, and long-term cost optimization.

As a technical leader on the team, you will contribute to the architecture, development, and delivery of modern backend services and applications that support key business capabilities. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate complex operational needs into scalable, reliable, and maintainable technology solutions.

This role includes ownership of applications in production, driving engineering best practices, and helping shape the technical direction of a platform that will modernize how Dealer Services manages claims operations. Your work will directly contribute to reducing operational complexity, accelerating delivery of new capabilities, and improving outcomes for customers and the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and APIs supporting enterprise payment solutions.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including iteration planning, standups, and retrospectives, helping drive continuous improvement across the team.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver customer-focused solutions.
  • Contribute to the architecture, development, and operation of scalable microservices and distributed systems.
  • Apply engineering best practices including clean code principles, test-driven development, code reviews, and automated testing.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes that support reliable software delivery.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and support applications in production environments.
  • Contribute to the codebase while ensuring adherence to coding standards, security requirements, and engineering best practices.

Essential Skills

  • 4+ years of software development experience using Java and J2EE technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring IoC, Spring Security, Spring AOP, and related Spring frameworks.
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, including API documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI), versioning, service discovery, testing, and microservice architectures.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented design principles, software design patterns, and modern software development practices.
  • Experience with relational databases, including schema design, indexing strategies, query optimization, and SQL development.
  • Experience with automated testing and Test Driven Development (TDD) using frameworks such as JUnit, Selenium, JBehave, or similar tools.
  • Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices using tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, SonarQube, Gradle, Maven, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience deploying and operating containerized applications using Kubernetes, Docker, or similar platforms.
  • Experience developing and supporting production services with observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog or equivalent.
  • Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or XP environments.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience building and operating high-volume, distributed systems with a focus on reliability, performance, and scalability.
  • Experience with messaging and event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar technologies.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, PCF, Azure, or equivalent cloud environments.
  • Experience with application security and quality tooling such as SonarQube, Fortify, Contrast, or similar products.
  • Exposure to modern front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, or Angular. While this role is primarily focused on backend engineering, the ability to collaborate across the full stack is a plus.

Experience

  • 5 or more years of experience (preferred)

Job.JobTitle: Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster - CST - Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job:

As a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

Candidates for this role must reside in the Central or Eastern time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:  

The Customer Service Expert – you will live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.   

The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.   

The Effective Communicator – you will use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.   

The Negotiator – you will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.  

The Problem Solver – you will utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.   

The Recorder – you will protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.  

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years ' Represented 3rd party Bodily Injury claim handling experience.

  • Texas casualty claim handling experience.

  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.

  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.

  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.

  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Remote Home-Based Work:

This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States.

  • Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm CST.

When you work from home full time, you’ll need:

  • A home office – a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.

  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.

  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).

  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.  

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.  

Notice of Licensing Requirement:  

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.

  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign-on Bonus:  

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License. 

  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus. 

Allstate Benefits: 

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes: 

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement. 

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance. 

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role. 

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Skills

Bodily Injury Claims, Casualty Insurance, Claims Resolution, Insurance Adjusting, Negotiation

Compensation offered for this role is 53,500.00 - 84,625.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job.JobDescription:

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always. 

  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 

  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 

  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 

  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.  

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Reside within the greater metropolitan Columbia, SC area.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for policyholder attorneys, leading direct negotiations to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Draft and respond to attorney correspondence, requests for information, and demands to maintain compliance and mitigate legal exposure.
  • Researches and responds to moderately complex and occasionally complex customer communications, concerns, conflicts or issues.

Job Description

Join Our Team as a Commercial Counsel – Arity Advertising and Marketing.

We’re looking for a creative, collaborative, and high-energy attorney who thrives at the intersection of law, business, technology, and data. This role sits within the Business Law division of Allstate’s Law and Regulation department and offers the opportunity to counsel Allstate’s mobility data and telematics business unit (Arity), advising its marketing solutions business on a wide range of commercial agreements, product counseling and related matters.

Key Responsibilities:

This position is ideal for someone with expertise advising in the advertising industry and who brings strong business acumen, embraces complexity, and enjoys partnering with cross-functional teams to navigate legal and regulatory challenges in innovative and evolving areas.

You will:

  • Provide real-time, strategic legal counsel on a wide array of business matters, including product development, marketing, sales, and emerging technologies.
  • Structure, draft, and negotiate commercial agreements—especially those involving advertising, marketing, and data service arrangements.
  • Advise on legal risk management and evolving regulatory landscapes in areas such as technology, commercial contracts, privacy, and consumer protection.
  • Contribute to enterprise-wide strategies by collaborating across business units, policy, compliance, and legal teams.
  • Anticipate legal issues and offer practical, innovative solutions in fast-paced and dynamic business environments.
  • Conduct in-depth legal research and help assess the impact of emerging laws or regulations on business activities.
  • Help foster alignment between business goals and legal frameworks in regulated industries.
  • Navigate ambiguity with confidence and help shape emerging business models and opportunities.
  • Contribute to a culture of open dialogue and collaborative problem solving across a distributed, virtual team.
  • This is a remote role with travel required. While the position is open to remote candidates across the U.S., preferred home office locations include Chicago, IL; New York, NY; or San Francisco, CA due to team collaboration and business travel considerations.

What a Typical Day Might Look Like:

  • Partnering with product teams on a new technology within mobile applications, drive technologies etc, rollout or exploring a novel corporate structure.
  • Synthesizing insights from multiple legal experts to offer business-focused guidance in plain language.
  • Drafting complex data licensing agreements or leading the negotiation of commercial deals.
  • Leading the implementation of a compliance or risk mitigation plan in collaboration with other departments.

What We’re Looking For:

  • We’re proud to work alongside a team of talented, mission-driven professionals. We’re looking for someone who:
    • Thrives in areas of law that are emerging, complex, and continually evolving.
    • Brings process-building skills and a desire to drive efficiency.
    • Contributes creative solutions and innovative thinking.

Education and Experience:

  • Juris Doctorate and active bar membership in good standing
  • A minimum of 7 years of legal experience, ideally within a law firm or the in-house legal department of a mid- to large-sized organization.
  • Proven expertise in one or more of the following areas: commercial law, privacy, advertising/marketing law, technology, artificial intelligence, intellectual property.
  • Experience working within a corporate parent company and across a family of affiliated entities.

Desired:

  • Experience supporting a commercial business unit and/or professional experience beyond traditional legal roles.

Key Competencies & Functional Skills:

  • Strong leadership capabilities with a focus on collaboration, team development, mentoring, and strategic guidance.
  • Executive presence with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience managing departmental or legal budgets.
  • Solid project management skills, including the ability to prioritize and deliver across multiple workstreams.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and other relevant legal or business technology tools.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.
  • Demonstrated discretion and professionalism in handling sensitive and confidential information.
  • High business acumen, including the ability to assess and communicate legal risk in a commercial context and contribute to the development of business cases and return-on-investment evaluations.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Milwaukee, WI
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!


As a Field Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always. 
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage. 
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress. 
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills. 
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.     

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Reside within Milwaukee, WI.
  • 2-3 years prior experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.   
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents. 

Required qualification:


  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one-to-two-story roof.

You’re provided with comprehensive training:


  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job

** Please note, you will be required to attend 2-weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:


  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

 

Sign On Bonus:


  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:


Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

#LI-DL1

Active Listening, Communication, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Insurance Claims, Multitasking, Organizing, Working Independently, Xactimate

Compensation offered for this role is $69,250 - $93,250 and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job.JobTitle: Inside Property Adjuster- Remote - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Property Large Loss Adjuster to join our Homeowners Claims team supporting the Western region. This role is responsible for managing complex, high-severity residential property claims, typically exceeding $100,000 in loss value, from initial investigation through final resolution.

The ideal candidate brings extensive large loss property experience and can independently handle complex claims involving fire, wind, hail, catastrophe, and other major property damage events. This is a fully remote position with no field inspections required. Physical inspections are completed through independent adjusters, contractors, and other third-party partners, while you manage the overall claim strategy, coverage analysis, estimate review, negotiation, and resolution.
  • This role will support claims primarily across the Western region.

  • Investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve complex homeowners property claims involving significant damages and exposures.

  • Manage large loss claims resulting from fire, weather events, catastrophes, and other major property losses.

  • Determine coverage, evaluate damages, and issue claim decisions within established authority levels.

  • Review contractor and independent adjuster estimates for accuracy, scope, and appropriateness of repair recommendations.

  • Utilize Xactimate estimates and supporting documentation to assess damages and identify discrepancies or opportunities for clarification.

  • Manage claim authority requests and effectively document claim rationale for elevated approvals.

  • Handle additional living expense (ALE) and personal property exposures as part of complex homeowner claims.

  • Collaborate with contractors, mitigation vendors, independent adjusters, legal partners, and internal stakeholders to drive claims toward resolution.

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to less experienced claims professionals.

  • Maintain strong customer communication while managing claims that may remain open for extended periods due to the complexity of repairs and reconstruction efforts.

Desired Qualifications

  • Extensive experience handling large loss residential property claims, typically exceeding $100,000.

  • Strong understanding of residential construction, repair processes, and property damage assessment.

  • Experience reviewing and interpreting Xactimate estimates.

  • Ability to independently manage complex claims with minimal oversight.

  • Strong analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex files simultaneously.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience handling catastrophe-related property claims.

  • Background managing fire, wind, hail, wildfire, or severe weather-related losses.

  • Previous experience working with contractors, independent adjusters, and restoration vendors.

  • Prior leadership, mentoring, or peer coaching experience.

    • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Job Description

Product Security Engineering designs, builds, and operates enterprise security controls as software products that integrate directly into cloud platforms, the software development lifecycle, and core enterprise services. The organization applies modern software and cloud engineering practices to deliver scalable, reliable, and developer-friendly security capabilities that enable secure-by-default behaviors across the enterprise.

The Managing Engineer, Data Security Engineering leads a team responsible for designing, building, and operating capabilities across DLP Policy, Data Intelligence, and Data Access. This role combines people leadership, technical direction, and delivery ownership, ensuring the team delivers automated, scalable, and measurable solutions that protect sensitive data while enabling appropriate business use.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a high-performing team accountable for engineering data security products and controls.

  • Set technical direction and drive execution across architecture, design, implementation, deployment, and production support.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through code and, solution design, key technical decisions, and critical implementation work.

  • Guide the engineering of capabilities across DLP Policy, Data Intelligence, or Data Access, including policy automation, data discovery and classification, and access controls.

  • Develop and advance policy-as-code workflows, reusable control patterns, detection logic, platform integrations, and automated testing and deployment.

  • Automate control lifecycle activities, including validation, configuration drift detection, reporting, alert enrichment, and operational health checks.

  • Own the reliability, effectiveness, adoption, and continuous improvement of the team’s products and controls.

  • Translate complex data security requirements into scalable technical solutions and measurable outcomes.

Essential Skills

  • 5+ years of professional software, data, or security engineering experience, including ownership of production systems and technical products.

  • 2+ years of experience leading engineers while remaining actively engaged in technical design, code reviews, and complex engineering work.

  • Deep technical knowledge of data protection, including DLP, data discovery and classification, information protection, data access controls, and data governance.

  • Comprehensive understanding of cloud, SaaS, CASB, and enterprise data protection architectures.

  • Strong scripting and automation proficiency using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, Terraform, YAML, JSON, or comparable technologies.

  • Proven ability to build version-controlled security solutions using policy as code, automated delivery pipelines, APIs, and reusable components.

  • Demonstrated success transforming manual, console-based administration into scalable, automated operating models.

Desirable Skills

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Purview and other enterprise platforms supporting DLP, data discovery and classification, information protection, or data access governance.

  • Knowledge of integrating data security capabilities with identity, cloud, SIEM, SOAR, workflow, and enterprise data platforms through APIs and event-driven architectures.

  • Proven ability to influence technical decisions and drive adoption of secure patterns and engineering standards across product areas.

  • Demonstrated success mentoring senior engineers and developing emerging technical leaders.

  • Understanding of security and operational measures, such as control adoption, detection quality, reliability, and risk reduction, used to evaluate engineering outcomes and guide priorities.


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This role has supervisory responsibilities and serves as the first level manager for a team of engineers.

This platform is a strategic investment in the future of the business, enabling more efficient operations, faster service delivery, improved customer experiences, and long-term cost optimization.

As an engineering leader, you will provide technical and people leadership to multiple agile teams responsible for the development, implementation, and support of modern backend services and applications. You will partner closely with product management, architecture, engineering leaders, and business stakeholders to establish technical direction, deliver business outcomes, and cultivate a high-performing engineering culture.

This role is accountable for building and developing engineering talent, ensuring operational excellence, driving delivery commitments, and fostering engineering best practices. You will help shape the long-term technology strategy while creating an environment where teams can innovate, collaborate, and consistently deliver secure, scalable, and reliable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leads and participates in knowledge sharing activities and contributes to the overall growth of the engineering organization through mentoring, coaching, and the promotion of engineering best practices.

  • Drives operational excellence by ensuring applications are secure, reliable, scalable, and effectively supported in production environments.

  • Collaborates with product, engineering, architecture, security, and business leaders to align technology investments with strategic business objectives.

  • Leads cross-functional and cross-product collaboration efforts to ensure consistency, reusability, and alignment across engineering teams and technology portfolios.

  • Supports workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, and talent management activities to build and maintain high-performing engineering teams.

  • Establishes and monitors key engineering metrics related to delivery, quality, reliability, and team health to drive continuous improvement.

  • Acts as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders, providing thought leadership on modern software engineering practices, cloud platforms, distributed systems, and organizational effectiveness.
