Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$79,600.00 - $131,400.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Reports to Boiler and Machinery Field Manager. Conduct boiler and pressure vessel inspections in accordance with jurisdictional rules by performing thorough examinations, identifying hazardous conditions, applying appropriate codes and standards, and recommending corrective actions. Work cooperatively with Boiler and Machinery underwriting and claim groups, in support of helping them make informed decisions to maximize profit and growth. Primarily performs boiler and pressure vessel inspections on all accounts. Under close supervision, performs risk evaluations and claims investigations on less complex accounts as assigned. Participates in individual training opportunities to enhance/develop risk control and product/service knowledge.

What Will You Do?

  • Maintain a consistent field presence, spending approximately 20% - 50% of the time onsite with customers. Traveling to customers may entail long-distance, overnight travel, and/or multi-night trips depending on the needs of the business and alignment with territory and/or geography.
  • In this role, works with limited guidance and direction to manage jurisdictional inspection workload within an assigned territory. Take ownership of the territory and effectively prioritize, plan, and schedule work. Utilize provided technology resources for maximum efficiency. Respond to customer requests and helps customers understand and mitigate risks associated with equipment breakdowns.
  • Conduct boiler and pressure vessel inspections in accordance with jurisdictional rules by performing thorough examinations, identifying hazardous conditions, applying appropriate codes and standards, recommending corrective action and submitting required reports.
  • Under moderate supervision performs less complex risk evaluations, evaluate exposures and controls, develops meaningful loss estimates, and communicate findings to business partners.
  • Apply critical thinking to determine adequacy of controls preventing equipment breakdown, and overall insurability. Investigate less complex Equipment Breakdown claims as requested by the claim department. Evaluate elements of the breakdown, extent of damage, invoice review, and cause of loss.
  • Effectively document, communicate, and report findings.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in related field.
  • Technical Skills.
  • Demonstrates a basic level of understanding of mechanical and electrical principles.
  • Possesses a basic knowledge of predictive and preventive maintenance practices.
  • Demonstrates specific engineering/technical skills necessary to achieve established business goals.
  • Utilizes Risk Control workstation computer system applications to efficiently manage territorial workload, schedule and complete all job assignments.
  • Customer Service.
  • Identifies customer needs and takes appropriate action to meet those needs.
  • Acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to delivering an appropriate level of customer service.
  • Problem Solving.
  • Develops new methods or approaches to getting the work done.
  • Evaluates information and makes the right choice (decision).
  • Is resourceful in gaining information/resources to solve business problems.
  • Interpersonal Skills.
  • Results driven and takes responsibility for own decisions and actions.
  • Manages own work and seeks help as necessary.
  • Works independently and in a team environment.
  • Establishes and maintains effective work relationships.
  • Communication.
  • Clearly expresses ideas.
  • Listens to and understands what others are saying.
  • Shares information and maintains confidentiality.
  • National Board of Boiler and Pressure Vessel Inspector's Inservice commission.
  • Military Boiler or Nuclear Power operator certification.
  • Civilian Power Boiler Operation Certificate.
  • ANSI NDE Level II Examiner Certification.

What is a Must Have?

  • Two years of experience in the boiler and machinery industry or a related field, such as plant engineering, power generation, manufacturing operations or maintenance, or relevant military experience.
  • Valid driver's license.
  • Must obtain an Inservice Commission (IS) from the National Board of Boiler and Pressure Vessel Inspectors within six months of employment.
  • Must have or be able to attain appropriate certification to meet state-specific requirements, where applicable.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$68,700.00 - $113,400.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As a Claim Rep, Outside Property, you will be responsible for managing, inspecting, evaluating, negotiating, and settling 1st party property claims in a timely and accurate manner which includes performing in-person inspections at customers' residences and properties to accurately assess damages. In this detail-oriented and customer-focused role, you will work closely with insureds and representatives to ensure claims are resolved efficiently while maintaining a high level of professionalism, empathy, and service throughout the claims handling process. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office. This position services a territory in <add location> areas of <add state(s)>. You must either reside in or be willing to relocate at your own expense to assigned territory.

What Will You Do?

  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under limited supervision. Typically, will handle personal insurance claims with limited supervision and higher authority and begin to handle business insurance claims with direct supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, and third-party vendors.
  • Investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for property damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilize as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates, with guidance from management.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, representatives, third-party vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Negotiate with multiple constituents, i.e., contractors or insured's representatives with guidance.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Assess and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, including roofs, attics, crawl spaces, and other confined areas. Ability to carry, set up, and climb ladders weighing approximately 38-49 pounds.
  • May require extensive travel, including overnight stays, to support customers across multiple locations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Two years of property claim experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year of property or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Salary Range

$53,800.00 - $88,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Associate Claim Rep, Outside Property, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage 1st party property claims. This program is typically 9-12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility. This position is based remotely with work at residential and commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under direct supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Learn to investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for building damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilizes as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, claimants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Assess and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, including roofs, attics, crawl spaces, and other confined areas. Ability to carry, set up, and climb ladders weighing approximately 38-49 pounds.
  • May require extensive travel, including overnight stays, to support customers across multiple locations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); willingness to learn claims management and estimating software.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

What Is the Opportunity?

The Sales Executive Team is dedicated to navigating and managing a high performing sales culture in person and/or virtually which contributes to the overall success of the Select business. The team executes on industry-leading sales strategies aligned with business objectives, builds effective relationships with customers, distribution partners and fellow employees, and creates tactical sales plans for profitable growth through extensive product knowledge and state of the art sales and influencing tactics. The team also uses digitally advanced strategies to move the business forward, leads the relationships with our aggregator/networking groups, and partners with the agent to imbed into higher producing revenue streams. As a Sales Executive, Select, you will manage and develop a moderately complex group of Travelers agency assignments/territories, optimize growth within defined new business, retention and profitability goals and deliver success within Travelers' framework of Corporate values. You will act as a brand ambassador to sell the Travelers value proposition to distribution partners. This position is an outside sales position where assigned distribution relationships within the geographic territory tend to be best served through an in-person sales strategy.

As of the date of this posting, Travelers anticipates that this posting will remain open until December 31, 2026.

What Will You Do?

  • Develop and implement comprehensive sales strategies to expand and manage a portfolio of business, with the objective of driving profitable growth.
  • Own assigned territory, including business development, leveraging performance metrics to create annual plans and manage territorial performance.
  • Conduct in-depth agency diagnostics to assess performance and identify growth opportunities.
  • Facilitate agency appointments and build long-term relationships through office visits (both in person and virtual).
  • Prospect, onboard and set performance goals for new agencies, while providing training and support.
  • May pre-qualify accounts as needed.

As an Outside Auto Appraiser, you are responsible for physically inspecting damaged vehicles, estimating repair costs, working closely with repair facilities, and determining and settling the actual cash value of total loss vehicles to ensure accurate and timely claim settlements. What Is the Opportunity?

As an Outside Auto Appraiser, you are responsible for physically inspecting damaged vehicles, estimating repair costs, working closely with repair facilities, and determining and settling the actual cash value of total loss vehicles to ensure accurate and timely claim settlements. In this customer-facing role, you will need to have a high level of technical expertise in vehicle damage assessment, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. This position will serve as a technical resource for auto claim staff and will provide advice and direction to claim professionals on claim damages to achieve optimal outcomes. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

This position services Insureds/Agents in East Metro Atlanta, GA . The selected candidate must reside in or be willing to relocate at their own expense to the assigned territory.

What Will You Do?

  • Inspect and assess vehicle damage resulting from accidents, weather events, or other covered losses by conducting thorough virtual or on-site inspections at body shops or customer locations.
  • Perform estimate review work, conduct virtual inspections, and collaborate with repair facilities to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality across claims.
  • Prepare accurate repair estimates using industry-standard estimating software to determine the cost of parts, labor, and materials required to restore vehicles to pre-loss condition.
  • Evaluate and settle vehicle total losses by determining actual cash value (ACV) through market research, comparable vehicle analysis, and application of appropriate valuation tools and methodologies.
  • Negotiate repair costs and settlements with body shops, customers, and third-party claimants to reach fair and timely resolutions while maintaining quality repair standards.
  • Identify and document pre-existing damage, prior repairs, and potential fraud indicators to ensure accurate claim evaluation and protect company interests.
  • Collaborate with claim representatives, body shops, and vendors to coordinate repairs, authorize supplements, and resolve coverage or repair-related issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by explaining the appraisal process, answering questions, assisting in moving claims towards timely resolution, and keeping vehicle owners informed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Two years of auto physical damage appraisal experience.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year of auto physical damage appraisal or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.
  • Valid driver's license.

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.

Why Join Assurant as a Regional Account Manager?


At Assurant, the Regional Account Manager plays a pivotal role in driving growth, innovation, and client success. This position goes beyond traditional account management, serving as a strategic advisor who strengthens client partnerships, and delivers solutions that help clients stay competitive in a rapidly evolving marketplace.


By analyzing industry trends, assessing client needs, and implementing tailored program enhancements, you'll directly influence business performance and customer outcomes. You'll collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to optimize program execution, uncover new opportunities, and integrate impactful solutions across sales channels.


Success in this role comes from leveraging data-driven insights and frontline feedback to continuously improve programs, enhance the customer experience, and drive measurable results. As a trusted voice to both clients and Assurant leadership, you'll help shape product and service strategies that maintain Assurant's competitive advantage.


If you're energized by building relationships, solving complex business challenges, and making a visible impact on growth and innovation, you'll find a rewarding career at Assurant where your expertise helps clients succeed and fuels the company's continued evolution.


This is a remote position; the ideal candidate will be based in Chicago, IL. The territory will be Illinois, Indiana, Michigan and Minnesota.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Responsible for driving performance for assigned programs for the assigned client through fostering and maintaining relationships with various levels of leadership.  
  • Conduct program training at corporate, division, region, district level or site location.  Conduct train-the-trainer programs for client staff.  
  • Circulate performance and compliance reports to ensure all related goals are being achieved.  
  • Consult with client management to establish and ultimately execute plans for achieving or exceeding program goals.  
  • Develop and enhance Assurant’s relationship with our client at management at various levels in the field to include, regional, district, and store level.
  • Communicate program results and plans for marketing efforts to client and Assurant management.  
  • Summarize activities for ROI purposes and be able to track the performance related to those activities.  
  • Serve as the primary contact between Assurant and client, as it relates to the assigned areas.
  • Assist in the execution of promotions and contests for associated programs.
  • Ensure travel budget adherence and control expenses.
  • Conduct competitive analysis regularly and prepare reports on the competitive environment, occasionally mystery shopping across related business segments.
  • Identify and assist in resolution of customer and client service quality process issues with the assigned Assurant Account Executive to ensure a positive root cause resolution.  

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in retail, wireless, customer-facing environments, with a strong understanding of sales, client service, and account development.
  • Proven presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and effectively engage leaders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with experience developing and executing strategies to improve business results.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and multimedia presentation tools.
  • Experience in managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, meet deadlines, and work independently with minimal supervision.

How much travel will be required?

  • Up to 75% travel.

Job Description

The Division Vice President (DVP) of Assurant Dealer Services leads the strategic and operational direction of a defined geographic business. This executive is responsible for achieving and exceeding revenue targets, growing market share, budget management, and ensuring exceptional client satisfaction across a portfolio of automotive accounts. The DVP oversees performance of the regional sales team, drives new business development, and builds strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job? 

  • Develop and execute sales strategies aligned with Assurant Dealer Services (ADS) goals based on expertise within the channel, participants, markets, products and competitive landscape (traditional and disruptive).
  • Drive revenue growth, margin performance, and cost management across the division, creating a roadmap for increased profitability and commercial excellence within their division.
  • Research and proposes innovative strategies for ADS sales strategic accounts growth for their division; monitor sales effectiveness in delivering points of difference to increase our position in value creation for AIZ and our partners.
  • Provides leadership in developing best practices for measuring and optimizing strategic activities to drive data-driven decision making and excellence in their division.
  • Proactively analyze segments of customer data to uncover insights and key takeaways that inform strategic planning, increase revenue and drives business value in their division.
  • Synthesize and present data on account performance, identify areas of potential income improvement, and implement strategies to cross-sell products in their division.
  • Ensures any service gaps are addressed quickly and effectively and in situations of conflict with the client, leads the management team(s) to resolution looking to accomplish a win-win situation.  Measures client satisfaction and uses findings to identify and address areas of opportunities as well as build upon success stories in their division.
  • Collaborates with risk management team related to current clients to mitigate regulatory risk and manage client compliance and oversight requirements in their division.
  • Lead, mentor, develop and performance manage regional sales managers and support staff. Build a high-performance, results-driven culture.
  • Monitor division sales performance/pipeline metrics and provide coaching.
  • Creating a roadmap for increased profitability and excellence within their division.

Team Leadership:


Direct reports

  • 8 Regional Managers

Number of direct and indirect reports

  • Approx. 20-35

 
What are the requirements needed for this position? 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Marketing or related field.
  • A minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience in retail automotive space with concentration in the F&I arena, with demonstrated experience showing progression and increasing scope of responsibility.
  • 15 or more years in the Automotive Insurance experience and/or training industry.
  • Proven track record of strategic goal setting and personnel oversight, development and managing large, complex accounts.
  • Strong knowledge of the automotive ecosystem—OEMs, tiered suppliers, dealers, or fleet/aftermarket services.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and client relationship management skills.
  • Change Management - Develops workable implementation plans; Communicates changes effectively; Builds commitment and overcomes resistance; Prepares and supports those affected by change; Monitors transition and evaluates results.
  • Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions; Displays orientation to profitability; Demonstrates knowledge of market and competition; Aligns work with strategic goals.
  • Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values.
  • Strategic Thinking - Develops strategies to achieve business goals that support the overall organization’s goals; Understands business strengths & weaknesses; Analyzes market and competition; Identifies external threats and opportunities; Adapts strategy to changing conditions.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have? 

  • Master's degree in Business Administration preferred.​

How much should I expect to travel? 

  • Up to 70% travel

Strong preference to candidates that reside or are open to relocation to the Dallas, Houston, Phoenix, Los Angeles, or Chicago markets.


#LI-Remote

Job.JobDescription:
We are Farmers – where ambition meets opportunity.

At Farmers, we’re not just known for unforgettable jingle – we’re a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people’s lives. We deliver peace of mind when it matters most. Our results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Here, growth isn’t just a goal – it’s a way of life for both the organization and every individual on our team. We tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure our impact on the customers who trust us.

Join an award-winning,  equal opportunity employer, where you’ll find more than a job – you’ll find a supportive community. Enjoy competitive benefits, take part in meaningful volunteer projects, and help shape the future alongside talented colleagues across all backgrounds. At Farmers, helping others is at the heart of what we do.

Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let’s build something incredible together!

Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote )  - This is a field role requiring travel to and from policyholder homes.

Candidates must reside in the Greater Springfield, MO area to be considered for this role.


The starting wage for this position is $26.01 per hour or higher. Additional compensation may be offered basedon relevant experience and transferable skills.

If you are looking for the following in your next career ...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education,mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.


… then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders’ residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days. 

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.  Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Final candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated level of this role.

Candidates Must be Willing & Able to:

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day, 
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

Physical Actions & Environment:

  • Bending, Kneeling, Pulling, Pushing, Sorting, Carrying up to 50 lbs., Climbing, Reaching, Standing, Walking, Seeing
  • Speaking (English), Reading (English), Writing (English), & Key Entering

Required job duties are performed in the field and an in-home office environment. Exposure to some or all of the following environments when in the field: Uncontrolled outside environmental conditions, Excessive noise levels, Chemicals Chemical/Biological conditions, Moving mechanical parts, Areas considered dangerous, Conditions which could affect the respiratory system or skin such as fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, oils, smoke, soot, or poor ventilation.

Benefits

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.
  • Bonus Opportunity (based on Company and Individual Performance)
  • 401(k)
  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Tuition Assistance
  • For more information, review “What we offer” on https://www.farmers.com/careers/corporate/#offer

Job Location(s): US - MO - Springfield

Anticipated application deadline: At Farmers, the recruitment process is designed to ensure that we find the best talent to join our team. As part of this process, we typically close open positions within 8 to 21 days after posting. If you are interested in any of our open positions, we encourage you to submit your application promptly.

Farmers will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance or other applicable law.  Pursuant to 18 U.S.C. Section 1033, Farmers is prohibited from employing any individual who has been convicted of any criminal felony involving dishonesty or a breach of trust without prior written consent from the state Department of Insurance.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Farmers is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in any employer/employee relations based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender expression, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military and veteran's status, or any other basis protected by applicable discrimination laws. 

Want to learn more about our culture & opportunities? Check out www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate and be sure to follow us on Instagram, LinkedIn, and TikTok.

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered and would be considered remote.

Our Internal Audit team is adding multiple Senior Business Auditors! We are open to more senior candidates as well. 

Job Summary

Are you an inquisitive individual with a passion for uncovering insights and driving improvements to positively impact an organization? Farmers Insurance is for Senior Business Internal Auditors to strengthen our assurance practices through the performance of quality audit work as part of our transformation to become a leading practice audit function. What You'll Do:

  • Lead: Lead audit engagements in accordance with Farmers Internal Audit Standards with minimal oversight.
  • Deliver: High quality audits that help Farmers deliver on its value proposition to its customers.
  • Contribute: Participate in the development of the Internal Audit Strategy and Plan, as well as the Audit Universe, by demonstrating a thorough understanding of the risks facing the company or business unit. Analyze controls and information gathered through audits, meetings, and other sources, and escalate relevant findings to Audit Management.
  • Collaborate: Establish strong working relationships with, and knowledge of, the business while partnering with IT Internal Audit in the performance of integrated audits
  • Communicate: Prepare executive ready reports and other written correspondence that effectively and efficiently communicate findings and recommendations.
  • Transform: Bring, and drive, transformational ideas that drive the Internal Audit function forward.
  • Facilitate Knowledge Sharing: Mentor peers and colleagues to support their professional development and enhance the overall capability of the team.
  • Cultivate Professional Development: Grow as a professional through various stretch and growth opportunities that will develop and hone skillsets needed for advancement.

Join our team to lead impactful audit engagements and contribute to the continuous improvement of our internal audit processes.

Essential Job Functions

Leads audit engagements with minimal supervision - on time and in a quality manner. Preparation of reports and communication with the business. Administrative duties supporting departmental activities, individual development plan, training, performance management, and general administration. Participates in departmental special projects.

Physical Actions

This role, whether performed virtually or in an office setting, will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions. Sits or stands for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Occasionally reaches overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Occasionally moves, lifts, carries, and places objects and supplies weighing 0-10 pounds without assistance. Listens to, interprets, and differentiates auditory information (example others speaking) at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Visually verifies and reads information. Visually locates material, resources and other objects. Ability to continuously operate a computer for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate keyboard and other office equipment up to a full work shift.

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), or other comparable designation preferred.

Experience Requirements

Five or more years experience in Auditing at an external firm or financial services firm, or seven years experience with Farmers Insurance and/or one year as a Farmers Insurance Auditor. Detailed subject matter expertise of at least one area of the business or industry.

The preferred candidate will possess:

  • Prior experience in insurance or financial services.
  • Demonstrated ability in advanced audit techniques including data analysis, data visualization, data mining, process mining, provide audit insights and critically think through complex problems.
  • Proficient in data analytics tools such as PowerBI, Excel, and SQL.
  • Experience using artificial intelligence methods within the audit process.
  • Skilled in tracing transactions to the general ledger.
  • Experience leading complex audit engagements.

Job Summary

This position collaborates with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver technical solutions that support complex to highly complex business initiatives. The role acts as a subject matter expert to provide systems-level views of technology and devise technical solutions aligned with business objectives. It focuses on enhancing solution design, optimizing development processes, and effectively implementing CI/CD pipelines to deliver impactful solutions that meet business needs. The position ensures technology delivery is successful within lines of business and across the enterprise. It performs work independently while receiving guidance or direction for only the most complex scenarios. Mentors, trains, and coaches team members at all levels.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Partners with cross-functional business stakeholders and technical teams to understand and address complex to highly complex initiatives within a business unit or at the enterprise level. Leads discussions to gather requirements, develop solutions, validate technology assumptions, and evaluate implementation alternatives. Influences solution strategies by leveraging comprehensive business knowledge and depth of expertise in solution engineering.
  • Acts as a servant leader for the solution by ensuring Agile Release Trains operate effectively. Anticipates and removes constraints across the development and delivery process while collaborating with Release Train Engineers to coordinate delivery. Provides a systems view of the development lifecycle to lead technology delivery and align architecture with business objectives. Serves solutions with multiple Agile Release Trains or business units. Primarily serves solutions at the enterprise level but may support solutions at all levels as needed.
  • Leads multiple technical projects simultaneously by prioritizing and coordinating solution engineering efforts across teams and initiatives. Establishes performance metrics to measure effectiveness and continuously optimize performance. Manages non-functional requirements and ensures compliance with industry standards throughout the solution development and delivery process.
  • Develops and refines robust technical designs to meet business requirements for complex to highly complex solutions while ensuring scalability and performance. Collaborates with developers and Agile Release Trains to align solutions with enterprise architecture. Works with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that streamline deployment and integrate new features. Engages with quality assurance teams to validate that technical solutions meet performance and reliability standards.
  • Leads development and delivery of complex to highly complex solutions by ensuring technical implementation s align with product roadmaps and overarching business strategies. Monitors progress, resolves issues affecting delivery timelines, and leads technical problem-solving efforts during development and deployment phases. Partners with business stakeholders and technical teams to address challenges and optimize solutions.
  • Oversees the maintenance of technical documentation for solutions to ensure effective knowledge sharing. Engages in continuous learning to stay current with trends and technologies in solution engineering. Applies learning to enhance own skills and impact the achievement of team and project objectives. Acts as a subject matter expert to consult and advise on solution engineering across business units and the enterprise. Leads pioneering of design and development practices to promote innovation and improvements across solutions. Performs other duties as assigned.

First Year Success Factors

  • Establish credibility as a trusted AI partner and primary AI contact for both IT and Business organizations.
  • Translate business opportunities into a sequenced portfolio of AI initiatives, clearly defining target outcomes, required capabilities, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Partner across business, architecture, engineering, data, security, and governance teams to identify and remove barriers to execution, accelerate delivery from concept through production, and ensure solutions are scalable, supportable, and reusable across the enterprise.
  • Drive adoption of the enterprise Spec-Driven Development (SDD) framework and AI-assisted engineering practices, achieving 90% adoption across targeted teams.
  • Drive measurable business and technology outcomes through faster delivery cycles, improved software quality, increased automation adoption, and successful deployment of AI capabilities that deliver enterprise value.
  • Lead multiple AI initiatives from concept through production readiness, partnering with engineering ensuring successful delivery while proactively removing obstacles and managing risks.
  • Establish reusable AI delivery assets, including implementation playbooks, patterns, templates, evaluation frameworks, governance controls, CI/CD standards, and production-readiness checklists.
  • Build a portfolio of AI success stories and reusable solutions that accelerate adoption across the enterprise.
  • Champion AI adoption across IT through hackathons, innovation challenges, monthly technology summits, workshops, and enablement programs.
  • Coach and enable engineers, architects, product owners, and technical teams on AI technologies, SDD, and modern engineering practices.
  • Ensure all AI solutions adhere to enterprise architecture, security, privacy, governance, and Responsible AI standards.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and AI-driven transformation across the IT organization.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • Bachelors degree required in computer science, engineering, or similar field.
  • Minimum 9 years of experience required in solution engineering, software development, systems architecture, or related.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and working in Agile teams required.
  • Experience in the insurance industry preferred.
  • Lead Solution Engineer is in support of AI COE / Forward Deployed Engineer in the AI and Automation Team.  
  • This role is targeting the IT / Systems AI FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer) in support of Farmers IT Core SDLC Functions.

Additional Qualification

  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Able to clearly communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated written communication skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and team building skills.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills. Able to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues of varying complexity.
  • Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ability to drive multiple projects to successful completion.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. Deep knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns. Strong proficiency in one or more phases of the software development lifecycle. In-depth knowledge of multiple systems and their key components. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, etc.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Frequently sits for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including, navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and/or places objects or materials weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Rarely performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

We’re looking for sales-driven, enthusiastic experienced sales professionals to join our next classes of Sales Consultants beginning in February 2027.

In this role, you will respond to calls coming into our call center by positively promoting Farmers insurance products to prospective customers, consulting with customers to understand their needs, and selling those products which best fit the customer’s needs.  You may also make outbound calls to optimize sales potential. You will earn a competitive base salary in addition to monthly incentive earnings based upon your performance.

We provide a comprehensive paid training program, combining virtual classroom and hands-on learning with mentoring to ensure that you have the skills you need to succeed at Farmers.  Ongoing coaching and training will remain a focus throughout your career to help you grow in your role and advance to new opportunities. 

Join a team where your performance drives your paycheck! Our compensation package is designed to reward your success. 

  • Our model includes guaranteed annual base pay of $40,000+ based on your experience. 
  • A competitive benefits package PLUS an uncapped performance-based incentive, giving you the opportunity to increase your earnings on average up to an additional $27,300+ on top of the guaranteed base pay annually. 
  • Many of our top performers who consistently meet and exceed their goals earn up to an additional $75,000+ on top of their annual base pay. 
  • Experienced and licensed insurance sales professionals with 3+ years working in a competitive call center environment will be considered for higher salary grades - Senior or Lead sales roles, with starting annual base pay of $50,000+.

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders’ residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days. 

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.  Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Job Summary

This position is responsible for leading a data analytics team. Partners with leaders to identify the need for business specific data analysis in order to provide insight and guide decision making. This is accomplished through building reports, analyzing data, and use of advanced statistical models.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Define KPIs, benchmarks, and key performance drivers.
  • Build dashboards that translate data into actionable insights.
  • Analyze the digital conversion funnel and identify friction and fallout.
  • Recommend changes to improve conversion and customer experience.
  • Monitor bounce rate, conversion, ROI, ROAS, and other digital metrics.
  • Leverage A/B testing to measure impact and guide optimization.
  • Turn digital analytics into prescriptive business recommendations.
  • Leads a team of business and data analysts.
  • Manages the flow of ad-hoc and project analysis requests through the team, triage new requests, assign requests to team members, ensures effective communication with internal customers, and delivers expedited processing for escalated requests/issues.
  • Recommends, delivers, or facilitates training to increase skills of team.
  • Coordinates successful delivery of analysis projects through critical phases including but not limited to conception, data gathering, analysis, presentation, and deployment.
  • Demonstrates best practices in project management, including proactive and appropriate communication with project stakeholders; management of scope, timeline, and actual vs. budgeted hours, and measurement and communication of project value.
  • Executes key change initiatives or process improvements on the Analytics team.
  • Engages in continuous process improvement.
  • Identifies and recommends areas for improvement in internal or external business processes.
  • Maps process steps and identifies their impact on key outcomes.
  • Forms actionable change initiatives or project proposals.
  • Identifies and involves stakeholders and other participants in change initiatives.
  • Measures and communicates the value from process improvement efforts and critically analyzes team output and eliminate non-value-added work.
  • Proactively escalates issues or concerns requiring the organizations attention.
  • Sets the standard in effective written and verbal communication with leadership including the ability to explain analysis results, statistics concepts, or statistical approaches, and impact on business performance.
  • Develops employees on presentations to project sponsors or business leads.
  • Effectively delivers presentations to executive audiences.
  • Is accountable to business leaders for hours worked by the team.
  • Ensures quality products are delivered to internal customers through analysis techniques and quantitative skills.
  • This is accomplished through data extraction using SQL, business query interfaces, and analysis cubes as well as using descriptive statistics and their application to business problems.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred.
  • Possesses or currently pursuing insurance designation.
  • Minimum 5 years experience in data analytics, qualitative analysis, process improvement, and project management required.
  • Three- Five years people leading experience required.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, data extraction, relational database concepts and query tools preferred.
  • Preferred technical stack includes: Power BI, Excel, SQL, Tableau, Snowflake.

First Year Success Factors

  • Establishes strong partnerships with business leaders and positions the analytics team as a trusted source of insights that support business decision-making.
  • Builds an effective intake, prioritization, and delivery approach for analytics requests, balancing business priorities, team capacity, quality, and timeliness.Develops the team’s analytical, technical, and communication capabilities through coaching, targeted development, and knowledge sharing.
  • Delivers high-quality analytics and reporting that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business and executive audiences.Identifies and implements opportunities to improve analytics processes, reduce non-value-added work, and demonstrate measurable business value.
  • Builds trust and credibility with the team by providing clear direction, ongoing coaching, and support that enables employees to grow and succeed.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with eCommerce and Web Analytics.
  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills including strong written communication skills.
  • Develops and delivers effective presentations and is comfortable presenting to all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent interpretation of complex statistical data with the ability to relay the information in a manner easily understood.
  • Demonstrates a high level of accuracy, even under pressure is able to manage multiple projects while meeting strict deadlines.
  • Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills while using critical thinking skills.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude; expert proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Proficient in all other Microsoft Office tools.
  • Adaptable and flexible to new technology.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills with the ability to identify and apply business rules to analysis projects. 

Physical Actions

Sits or stands for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Occasionally reaches overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Visually locates material, resources and other objects. Ability to continuously operate a computer for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate keyboard and other office equipment up to a full work shift.

Physical Environment

This position operates in an open office working environment which will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions.

We are seeking an Attorney with jury trial experience to join our Northern California staff counsel team! Our attorneys work from home and handle in-person appearances and trials as required. We offer developmental opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package including annual bonus potential up to 20% of the salary, generous 401k, auto allowance, PTO, medical/dental/vision, paid parental leave, and much more all without the stress of billable hours!   

Job Summary

This position is responsible for representing clients in all areas of insurance defense practice, handling cases that are primarily low to moderate in complexity and exposure. Manages all phases of cases from intake to resolution.

Essential Job Functions

  • Litigates low to moderate complexity and exposure cases and performs duties necessary from intake to trial and/or settlement. This includes but is not limited to preparation of pleadings, motions, discovery, and briefs.
  • Attends hearings, conferences, interviews, mediations, arbitrations, and/or trials.
  • Proactively informs leadership of case handling opportunities and challenges encountered.
  • Consults with the Claims Department on the legal aspects of files and jurisdictional issues.
  • Performs other tasks or duties to ensure efficient case management.
  • May handle second chair trials and handle trials in cases with moderate complexity and/or exposure.
  • Provides support to senior attorneys in cases of greater complexity and/or exposure and receives developmental assignments of matters that are of high complexity and/or exposure.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Physical Environment

Required job duties are normally performed in a climate- controlled office environment, with some exposure to uncontrollable outside environmental conditions and travel via automobile and/or commercial transportation.

Education Requirements

Bachelors degree preferred. Licensed to practice law in applicable states required upon hire.

Experience Requirements

Three years of insurance defense litigation and/or personal/bodily injury experience preferred. Second chair trial experience strongly preferred. Multistate jurisdictional practice preferred.

Special Skill Requirement

Public speaking, ability to function and handle high case loads in adversarial or confrontational situations, driving.

Additional Qualification

Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Excellent written communication skills. Effective negotiation skills. Demonstrated conflict management skills. Ability to represent the company with external constituents. Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills. Demonstrated time management and priority setting skills. Ability to work within tight timeframes and meet strict deadlines. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Adept and proficient at using technology to maximize efficiency in virtual, paperless environment.

Job Summary

Ready to change how a Life Insurance business uses data to grow? As Director, Business Intelligence & Analytics, you will lead a team of two analysts and serve as the go-to data and analytics partner across our Life Insurance organization. You will transform how the business accesses and uses data, turning insights from distribution and sales, new business, and customer and agent experience into decisions that drive profitable growth.  

Your team will own a portfolio of field-facing and operational reports and dashboards, build statistical models, and provide the analytical horsepower behind high-visibility, cross-functional initiatives. You will influence data and analytics strategy, review and approve analytics initiatives, oversee the support and evolution of existing data products, and bring innovative ideas to business leadership, then lead them through to implementation. This is a highly visible role for a builder who wants to see their work move the needle. 

Essential Job Functions

In this role, you will lead the analytics engine behind our Life Insurance business. You will develop advanced, value-driven analytics solutions, from statistical models that sharpen our understanding of the application funnel, policy placement, and persistency to Power BI dashboards that give agents, field leaders, and operations teams the insights they need to act. You will own and continuously evolve a portfolio of field-facing and operational reports and dashboards so they keep pace with changing business needs.   
 
As a trusted partner to leaders across distribution and sales, customer and agent experience, and operations, you will identify the biggest opportunities to unlock business value, translate them into clear analytics requirements and business plans, and drive them to resolution.  You will apply a deep understanding of the data elements, structures, and standards common in financial services and Life Insurance, including cloud-based data storage and sharing, to balance regulatory and compliance requirements with business needs. You will consult on UAT, technical specifications, strategic planning, contract design, testing, and training, and independently lead highly complex projects with little to no guidance.   
 
As a people leader, you will supervise, coach, and manage the performance of two analysts, deliver regular feedback, and support their professional development, fostering a high-performance culture where excellence is standard and innovation is actively encouraged. You will craft strategic plans and turn them into action for your team and for partners across three or more business domains, communicating strategy in a way that resonates with audiences new to data and analytics and helping enable enterprise priorities. 

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree or equivalent required, preferably in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Actuarial Science, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.  Master's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or an MBA with a quantitative focus preferred. Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate or insurance industry designations (e.g., LOMA FLMI), are a plus.

Experience Requirements

7-10 years of related work experience in business intelligence, analytics, or data science required, including: 
  • Building and maintaining enterprise reporting and dashboards in Power BI (or a comparable BI tool) for business and front-line audiences, including data modeling and DAX 
  • Applying statistical and predictive modeling techniques (e.g., regression, segmentation, propensity or retention modeling) to solve business problems and influence decisions 
  • Hands-on proficiency with SQL and experience working with data warehouses, data marts, and cloud-based data platforms across multiple source systems 
  • Partnering with senior business leaders to translate ambiguous questions into analytics requirements, prioritized roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes 
  • Leading complex, cross-functional analytics initiatives with IT, data science, product, and vendor partners from concept through implementation 
  • Establishing data quality, governance, and reporting standards, and resolving data issues across systems 
  • Communicating insights and recommendations clearly to executive and non-technical audiences 
 
Preferred experience: 
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience, ideally in Life Insurance, with familiarity with new business, underwriting, policy administration, and distribution data 
  • Experience analyzing sales and distribution performance, application funnel and throughput, placement, persistency, or agent and customer experience metrics 
  • Experience in a people leader or management role, including coaching and developing analysts 
  • Experience supporting field-facing or agent-facing reporting in a distribution-driven organization 
  • Working knowledge of Python or R and of data privacy and regulatory considerations in insurance

Job Summary

Provides onsite and remote technical support for employees, resolving hardware, software, access, connectivity, mobile device, and workplace technology issues while minimizing business disruption. Supports employee onboarding, device deployments, workplace and site readiness, conference rooms and events, asset management, and technology initiatives. Identifies recurring issues, performs root cause analysis, and contributes to service improvements that improve technology reliability and employee experience. Creates and maintains technical documentation and collaborates across teams to ensure effective resolution and consistent, customer-focused support

Essential Tasks

  • Provide onsite deskside support for end-user devices, including desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals.
  • Perform hardware diagnostics, repairs, and replacements as needed.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot operating systems, applications, and drivers.
  • Troubleshoot wired and wireless connectivity and support conference room and AV technology.

  • Support new hire onboarding and offboarding, including device setup, equipment deployment, recovery, and technology readiness.
  • Support technology requirements for office moves, expansions, remodels, seating changes, and new workspace deployments.
  • Assist with local incidents and outages by providing onsite validation, communicating findings, and coordinating with responsible teams.
  • Participate in testing, deployments, remediation, and other minor projects, and develop customer training, process, and technical documentation.
  • Maintain accurate asset tracking and inventory for end-user hardware.
  •
