Workplace:  Remote ( #LI-Remote )

We are seeking an experienced Trial Attorney with experience handling complex matters to join our Northern California staff counsel team! Our attorneys work from home and handle in-person appearances and trials as required. We offer developmental opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package including annual bonus potential up to 20% of the salary, generous 401k, auto allowance, PTO, medical/dental/vision, paid parental leave, and much more all without the stress of billable hours!   

Job Summary

This position is responsible for representing clients in all areas of insurance defense practice, handling cases that are primarily moderate to high complexity and exposure and/or involve unique insurance defense issues. Manages all phases of cases from intake to resolution.

Essential Job Functions

  • Litigates moderate to high complexity and exposure cases and/or cases involving unique legal or procedural issues and performs duties necessary from intake to trial and/or settlement. This includes but is not limited to preparation of pleadings, motions, discovery, and briefs. 
  • Acts as the lead attorney at hearings, conferences, interviews, mediations, arbitrations, and/or trials.
  • Develops strategies and arguments to thoroughly prepare for trial.
  • Utilizes knowledge of legal precedents to analyze the probable outcomes of a case.
  • Identifies the strengths and weaknesses of approaches to a case.
  • Performs or ensures completion of any other tasks or duties necessary for the proper representation of clients.
  • Consults with Claims Executive team and renders legal strategy recommendations regarding the legal aspects of the handling of personal injury claims.
  • Provides guidance to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
  • Interprets applicable industry laws, rulings and regulations.
  • Functionally supervises attorneys who are assisting in the handling of cases as development opportunities.
  • Provides guidance and mentorship with the autonomy to learn.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Physical Environment

Required job duties are normally performed in a climate- controlled office environment, with some exposure to uncontrollable outside environmental conditions and travel via automobile and/or commercial transportation.

Education Requirements

Bachelors degree preferred. Licensed to practice Law in applicable states required upon hire.

Experience Requirements

Seven years of litigation experience required. Insurance defense, personal injury, and/or jury trial experience required. First and second chair trial experience in bodily injury litigation strongly preferred. Multistate jurisdictional practice preferred.

Special Skill Requirement

Public speaking, ability to function and handle high case loads in adversarial or confrontational situations, driving.

Additional Qualification

Effective leadership skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to command the attention of an audience. Demonstrated problem solving skills. Possesses a genuine interest in the defense of Insurance regulations. Ability to represent the company with external constituents. Handles conflict effectively with the ability to quickly interpret and respond to new information. Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills. Ability to work within tight timeframes and meet strict deadlines. Excellent time management and priority setting skills. Articulate and responsive to colleagues. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Adept and proficient at using technology to maximize efficiency in virtual, paperless environment.

Our attorneys work from home and handle in-person appearances and trials as required. Job Summary

This position is responsible for representing clients in all areas of insurance defense practice, handling cases that are primarily moderate to high complexity and exposure and/or involve unique insurance defense issues. Manages all phases of cases from intake to resolution.

Essential Job Functions

  • Litigates moderate to high complexity and exposure cases and/or cases involving unique legal or procedural issues and performs duties necessary from intake to trial and/or settlement. This includes but is not limited to preparation of pleadings, motions, discovery, and briefs.
  • Acts as the lead attorney at hearings, conferences, interviews, mediations, arbitrations, and/or trials.
  • Develops strategies and arguments to thoroughly prepare for trial.
  • Utilizes knowledge of legal precedents to analyze the probable outcomes of a case. 
  • Identifies the strengths and weaknesses of approaches to a case.
  • Performs or ensures completion of any other tasks or duties necessary for the proper representation of clients.
  • Consults with Claims Executive team and renders legal strategy recommendations regarding the legal aspects of the handling of personal injury claims.
  • Provides guidance to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
  • Interprets applicable industry laws, rulings and regulations.
  • Functionally supervises attorneys who are assisting in the handling of cases as development opportunities.
  • Provides guidance and mentorship with the autonomy to learn.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Physical Environment

Required job duties are normally performed in a climate- controlled office environment, with some exposure to uncontrollable outside environmental conditions and travel via automobile and/or commercial transportation.

Education Requirements

Bachelors degree preferred. Licensed to practice Law in applicable states required upon hire.

Experience Requirements

Seven years of litigation experience required. Insurance defense, personal injury, and/or jury trial experience required. First and second chair trial experience in bodily injury litigation strongly preferred. Multistate jurisdictional practice preferred.

Special Skill Requirement

Public speaking, ability to function and handle high case loads in adversarial or confrontational situations, driving.

Additional Qualification

Effective leadership skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to command the attention of an audience. Demonstrated problem solving skills. Possesses a genuine interest in the defense of Insurance regulations. Ability to represent the company with external constituents. Handles conflict effectively with the ability to quickly interpret and respond to new information. Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills. Ability to work within tight timeframes and meet strict deadlines. Excellent time management and priority setting skills. Articulate and responsive to colleagues. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Adept and proficient at using technology to maximize efficiency in virtual, paperless environment.

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders’ residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days. 

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.  Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor’s degree preferred. Outside insurance education (CPCU, GCA) preferred.

Job Summary

The Lead Pricing Actuary is a senior actuarial and business leader responsible for shaping pricing strategies that drive profitable growth, rate adequacy, and competitive performance across Personal and Commercial products and markets. This role leads the development of rate indications, pricing recommendations, and portfolio insights by integrating actuarial analysis, claims trends, reserving considerations, and market dynamics.

As a strategic partner to Product, Claims, Finance, Underwriting, and Reserving leaders, the Lead Pricing Actuary translates complex actuarial findings into actionable business recommendations that influence key enterprise decisions. The role provides leadership to a high-performing actuarial organization, develops talent, and serves as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on matters impacting growth, profitability, and long-term business performance.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Lead pricing strategy for assigned Personal and Commercial Lines products and markets, ensuring alignment with profitability, growth, retention, and competitive objectives.
  • Establish rate level and rating plan recommendations using actuarial analysis, predictive modeling, business performance insights, and market intelligence.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and emerging trends to identify opportunities and recommend pricing actions that drive business results.
  • Provide actuarial leadership for financial planning, including rate activity, premium growth, loss trends, profitability targets, and other key business metrics.
  • Partner with Product, Underwriting, Finance, Claims, and Distribution leaders to influence strategic decisions and deliver actionable business insights.
  • Champion innovation through advanced analytics, predictive modeling, process improvement, and pricing automation.
  • Ensure the integrity of pricing data, models, tools, and governance processes while maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements and actuarial standards.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing actuarial organization, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and technical excellence.
  • Represent actuarial perspectives in business performance reviews and executive presentations, including exposure to senior leadership.

First Year Success Factors

Within the first 12 months, a successful candidate can expect to have achieved the following:

  • Quickly develop a deep understanding of Bristol West's pricing processes, portfolio dynamics, and business objectives.
  • Build credibility with an already strong actuarial team and effectively leverage existing leadership talent.
  • Establish themselves as a trusted member of the Bristol West leadership team.
  • Strengthen collaboration across Product, Claims, Finance, and Reserving functions.
  • Demonstrate strong business acumen and executive presence by connecting actuarial insights to business outcomes.
  • Drive informed pricing decisions that balance profitability, growth, retention, and market competitiveness.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

Candidates would ideally reflect the following professional qualifications and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS) designation required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of actuarial experience, including progressive responsibility in pricing, product management, or portfolio management.
  • Deep expertise in Personal Lines pricing, preferably within Personal Auto and broader Property & Casualty insurance.
  • Proven experience developing rate indications, pricing strategies, and profitability improvement initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of loss trends, claims performance, reserving impacts, and rate adequacy analysis.
  • Experience leading actuarial teams and developing talent through coaching, mentorship, and performance management.
  • Ability to communicate complex actuarial concepts and analytical findings to executive and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven track record influencing business strategy and driving decisions through data-driven insights.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Claims, Finance, Underwriting, and senior business leaders.
  • Strong knowledge of state rate filings, regulatory requirements, and actuarial standards of practice.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Non-standard Personal Auto pricing experience.
  • Experience working within a large, multi-state insurance carrier.
  • Previous leadership responsibility for actuarial managers or other people leaders.
  • Experience presenting pricing recommendations and business performance results to executive leadership.
  • Familiarity with predictive modeling, pricing optimization, and advanced analytical techniques.
  • Experience balancing growth, retention, and profitability objectives within competitive insurance markets.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in SAS and SAS Macros.
  • Strong Excel modeling and analytical capabilities.
  • Experience utilizing Power BI or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Ability to leverage large datasets, predictive analytics, and visualization tools to support pricing decisions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

Benefits

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.

Job Summary

  • This role is for a person that has expertise in complex projects. This role supports the rate filing process which is the most important driver of our business results.
  • The role helps drive large scale process improvement. You will be assigned to a team working on specific markets or countrywide efforts that is responsible for supporting profitable growth of the business; assignments are generally less complex than those assigned to Product Directors. This position requires strong organizational and time management skills, working in a cross-collaborative environment and solving structured and unstructured business problems.
  • Performs work independently with limited direction and guidance. May manage one or more Product Analysts.

Essential Job Functions

  • Demonstrates an expertise in the principles of product management, filing process, quoting platforms and systems, knowledge management, underwriting guidelines and defining data requirements in support of the profit and growth of the business.
  • Demonstrates expertise in ability to navigate the organization's processes (filing, IT programming/delivery/testing, compliance, underwriting, regulatory) to influence the timeline and sequencing of both rate and non-rate initiatives that drive and influence business results. Demonstrates ability to proactively manage complex rate and non-rate initiatives. 
  • Strategic Owner for scheduling and deployment of rate revisions, multi-state product initiatives, and non-rate initiatives, ensuring alignment across impacted states.
  • Provides support and guidance for all stages of the rate execution, filing process, compliance and regulatory projects. 
  • Business owner for all compliance and regulatory requests and initiatives.
  • Building deep regulatory expertise for assigned market or product.
  • Influences and drives more complex rate and non-rate initiatives timeline and sequencing.
  • Responsible for maintaining product and underwriting rules manuals, and other documentation.

Job Summary

  • This is for a person with expertise in product execution.  This role supports the rate setting process which is the most important driver of our business results.
  • The role leads large scale processes and drives process improvement.
  • You will be leading a team working on specific markets or countrywide efforts that is responsible for supporting profitable growth of the business; assignments are generally larger and more complex than Product Managers.
  • This position requires strong organizational and time management skills, working in a cross-collaborative environment and solving structured and unstructured business problems.
  • Performs work independently with limited guidance. May manage a team of Product Managers and Analysts.

Essential Job Functions

  • Demonstrates an expertise in the principles of product management, filing process, quoting platforms and systems, knowledge management, underwriting guidelines and defining data requirements in support of the profit and growth of the business.

  • Demonstrates expertise of competitor product structure, underwriting rules, systems and quoting platforms. Provides direction and guidance on competitor research into compliance and regulatory changes.

  • Escalation owner for complex or high-impact product issues.

  • Business owner of complex interactions and negotiation for proposed product or underwriting rule changes with departments of insurance and other regulatory entities.

Physical Actions

Job Summary

This position supports the growth of life insurance sales by leveraging data to make recommendations to agents that drive premium and profit objectives for an assigned territory. The role takes ownership of sales outcomes through proactive engagement and solution-driven approaches. The position develops and implements business plans to enhance agency productivity and profitability, deepen relationships, and promote life insurance products and the companys value proposition. The position collaborates with internal teams, field leadership, and agency stakeholders to address complex or high-value challenges, implement life insurance sales initiatives, and achieve sales objectives. This position is an individual contributor and performs work independently while receiving minimal guidance and direction.

Essential Job Functions

  • Drives life insurance sales by consulting with agency owners to meet sales objectives across multiple product lines and on high-value and complex cases.
  • Takes ownership of sales outcomes by managing both assisted and unassisted sales activities.
  • Focuses on point-of-sale interactions to drive successful transactions and meet sales targets.
  • Promotes life insurance products and company value proposition.
  • Achieves activity targets and production goals by proactively engaging with district managers and agency owners to identify needs or opportunities and deliver tailored solutions, and continuously monitor outcomes.
  • Follows up on implemented strategies to assess effectiveness and pivots as needed when results do not meet expectations.
  • Develops and implements customized sales plans for assigned agency to drive sales growth and meet sales objectives, including quarterly and annual sales targets.
  • Aligns agency-specific sales plans with broader business objectives and leverages adjacent revenue stream opportunities to drive life sales.
  • Demonstrates strong knowledge of life insurance products and services to effectively compete in the marketplace.
  • Independently provides recommendations on product illustrations, case designs, and sales focus.
  • Acts as a liaison between internal teams, field leadership, and agency stakeholders on complex underwriting, commissions, customer service, licensing, and other issues.
  • Builds and maintains relationships with elite agents through targeted consultation, training, and education on products, services, marketing campaigns, technology, and advanced sales strategies.
  • Supports agency growth by assisting with producer recruitment and development, optimizing performance and profitability, and delivering guidance virtually or in-person.
  • Monitors agency performance through CRM systems and other tools.
  • Tracks sales activities, analyzes data and identifies trends or patterns, and provides actionable insights to help agencies address performance gaps and improve sales results.
  • Measures changes in agency performance resulting from the deployment of various tailored solutions.
  • Mentors, trains, and coaches less experienced team members or lower level life sales consultants to develop their skills and improve performance.
  • Provides ongoing support and feedback to support professional development and enhance team capabilities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Bachelors degree preferred.
  • Valid life insurance and FINRA 6, 63 licenses required.
  • Other preferred designations include Financial Services Certified Professional (FSCP), Chartered Life Underwriter (CLU), Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC).

Experience Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in sales, account management, or agency operations, preferably within the insurance industry.
  • Experience required in direct point of sale, life insurance wholesale, and sales leadership.

Additional Qualification

Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Demonstrated written communication skills. Ability to influence internal and/or external constituents. Demonstrated analytical skills. Possesses strong product knowledge. In-depth knowledge of life insurance products and services and in-depth understanding of company product offerings. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficient in Microsoft Office suite. Strong proficiency in CRM and similar systems. Able to adapt quickly to new technology. Develops and delivers effective presentations. Possesses a high degree of initiative. Instills commitment to organizational goals. Effectively coaches and delivers constructive feedback.

Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. The starting wage for this position is $27.67hr. or higher. Additional compensation may be offered based on relevant experience and transferable skills. 

If you are looking for the following in your next career ...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education,mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.


… then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders’ residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days. 

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.  Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Job Summary

  • Develops assigned agent portfolio to full sales potential as described in the production plan, prioritized by agent segment and readiness. Achieves top and bottom-line results for assigned territory through effective Agency and District Performance Management, using segment-based playbooks, KPI scorecards, and defined operating cadence.
  • Works in conjunction with the Sales Director, and members of the product and underwriting team to develop an effective business plan that incorporates sufficient marketing, sales, retention and pricing initiatives to accomplish the assigned territory’s financial plan, with actions and support tailored by agent segment. 
  • Engages with specific segments of agents to meet sales goals, which may include using one-on-one appointments, sales builder meetings, and effective training, leveraging segment Journey to Success playbooks and KPI gates to progress agents (step-up/step-down support based on results. Coordinate with agents, Sales Director, Territory Office and to set goals, define marketing/sales objectives, achieve profitability, influence business processes, and follow through to defined goals, including clear handoffs to virtual execution/referral support where applicable.
  • Support levels and engagement cadence are adjusted based on agent activity and results, with resources prioritized to agents demonstrating sustained commitment and measurable outcomes. Work with assigned agents to influence sales and marketing behaviors and drive top-line business results.

Essential Job Functions

  • Achievement of top line and bottom-line sales results within assigned segment. Accomplishes rotating territory field travel schedule as outlined in the plan for meeting one-on-one with agents or in groups to present methods, ideas and support aligned to segment playbooks and operating cadence for the specific purpose of increasing sales in the assigned segment.
  • Develop business plans for defined segment agents to focus activity on achieving all sales goals, including specific marketing and sales activities, as well as presentations and sales training tailored by agent segment and readiness, that will be used within the assigned segment to drive sales results to the specified goals.
  • Reviews segment performance and prepares estimated run rates and reports of operations that include corrective actions where necessary. Assist agencies in the identification of prospective customers through recommendations of effective lead developing methods, including segment-appropriate activation (example, referral-first for lower engagement segments and pipeline discipline for growth segments).
  • Follows through on identified quotes with underwriting to assure achievement of desired hit ratios, yield, and conversion, evaluating results monthly, recommending actions to either correct deficiencies or to exploit a developing market opportunity. Workplace:Remote ( #LI-Remote ) - This is a field role requiring travel to and from policyholder homes. 

Candidates must reside in the greater Canton, OH area to be considered for this role. 

The starting wage for this position is $27.67/hr. or higher. Additional compensation may be offered based on relevant experience and transferable skills.  

If you are looking for the following in your next career ...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education,mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.


… then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders’ residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days. 

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.  Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Final candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated level of this role.

Candidates Must be Willing & Able to:

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day, 
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

Physical Actions & Environment:

  • Bending, Kneeling, Pulling, Pushing, Sorting, Carrying up to 50 lbs., Climbing, Reaching, Standing, Walking, Seeing
  • Speaking (English), Reading (English), Writing (English), & Key Entering

Required job duties are performed in the field and an in-home office environment. Exposure to some or all of the following environments when in the field: Uncontrolled outside environmental conditions, Excessive noise levels, Chemicals Chemical/Biological conditions, Moving mechanical parts, Areas considered dangerous, Conditions which could affect the respiratory system or skin such as fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, oils, smoke, soot, or poor ventilation.

Job Summary

This position collaborates with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver technical solutions that support more complex business initiatives. The role acts as a subject matter specialist to provide systems-level views of technology and devise technical solutions aligned with business objectives. It focuses on enhancing solution design, optimizing development processes, and effectively implementing CI/CD pipelines to deliver impactful solutions that meet business needs. The position ensures technology delivery is successful within lines of business and across the enterprise. It performs work independently while receiving minimal guidance or direction. May mentor or train less experienced team members.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Solution Engineer / Solution Architect with strong Java/Spring Boot, Angular, microservices, and enterprise integration experience. More importantly, the individual should be capable of independently driving Wcomplex initiatives end-to-end, from solution design and architecture through technical execution, cross-team coordination, and delivery. AI experience is valuable, but it should complement the core solution engineering capabilities rather than replace them.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Collaborating with business stakeholders to gather and understand requirements.
  • Translating business requirements into technical solutions for development teams.
  • Designing solution architecture and creating detailed architecture diagrams.
  • Working closely with cross-functional and external teams to resolve dependencies and provide technical clarifications.
  • Guiding development teams by providing technical direction and ensuring alignment with architectural standards.

First Year Success Factors

  • Identify, prioritize, and implement AI opportunities across departmental operations, business processes, and projects to improve efficiency, productivity, and deliver measurable cost savings.
  • Lead cross-functional programs and strategic initiatives, ensuring effective planning, stakeholder alignment, milestone tracking, and successful delivery through closure.
  • Establish clear success metrics, track AI-driven efficiencies and cost savings, and regularly communicate progress, outcomes, and business impact to leadership.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • Bachelors degree required in computer science, engineering, or similar field.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience required in solution engineering, systems architecture, or related.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and working in Agile teams required.
  • Experience in the insurance industry preferred.
  • Senior/principal-level software development experience with strong expertise in Angular and Java/Node.js technologies.
  • Strong understanding of solution architecture and system design principles.
  • Familiarity with native mobile application development, including iOS and Android.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, and integration best practices.
  • Strong expertise in cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience with AI/GenAI technologies, including practical use of AI-assisted tools, agentic AI frameworks, or platforms such as GitHub Copilot.
  •

The position ensures technology delivery is successful within lines of business and across the enterprise. It performs work independently while receiving limited guidance or direction.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Engages with cross-functional business stakeholders and technical teams to understand and address complex initiatives within a business unit or at the enterprise level. Participates in discussions to gather requirements, develop solutions, validate technology assumptions, and evaluate implementation alternatives. Influences solution strategies by leveraging in-depth business knowledge and practical experience in solution engineering.
  • Leads multiple technical projects simultaneously by prioritizing and coordinating solution engineering efforts across teams and initiatives. Uses established performance metrics to measure effectiveness and make necessary adjustments. Manages non-functional requirements and ensures compliance with industry standards throughout the solution development and delivery process.
  • Acts as a servant leader for the solution by ensuring Agile Release Trains operate effectively. Identifies and resolves constraints across the development and delivery process while collaborating with Release Train Engineers to coordinate delivery. Provides a systems view of the development lifecycle to guide technology delivery and align architecture with business objectives. Serves solutions with one or more Agile Release Trains or business units.
  • Develops and refines technical designs to meet business requirements for complex solutions while ensuring scalability and performance. Collaborates with developers and Agile Release Trains to align solutions with enterprise architecture. Works with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that streamline deployment and integrate new features. Engages with quality assurance teams to validate that technical solutions meet performance and reliability standards.
  • Supports development and delivery of complex solutions by ensuring technical implementations align with product roadmaps and overarching business strategies. Monitors progress, resolves issues affecting delivery timelines, and contributes to technical problem-solving efforts during development and deployment phases. Collaborates with business stakeholders and technical teams to address challenges and optimize solutions.
  • Maintains technical documentation for solutions to facilitate knowledge sharing and makes updates as architecture or functionality changes. Engages in continuous learning to stay current with trends and technologies in solution engineering. Applies learning to enhance own skills and impact the quality of work produced. Shares best practices in solution engineering across business units and the enterprise to promote peer learning. Supports pioneering of design and development practices to promote innovation and improvement across solutions.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred in computer science, engineering, or similar field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience required in solution engineering, software development, systems architecture, or related.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and working in Agile teams preferred.
  • Experience in the insurance industry preferred.

First Year Success Factors

  • Establish credibility as the trusted advisor and primary point of accountability for AI strategy and business value realization across IT and business organizations.
  • Develop and maintain a prioritized portfolio of AI opportunities aligned to enterprise objectives, ensuring clear business outcomes, investment rationale, value realization targets, and executive sponsorship.
  • Partner with senior business and technology leaders to identify strategic opportunities where AI can improve customer experience, operational efficiency, employee productivity, risk management, and revenue growth.
  • Drive enterprise alignment across business units, technology teams, governance bodies, and executive stakeholders to accelerate AI adoption and remove organizational barriers to execution.
  • Define and track meaningful business KPIs for AI investments, ensuring measurable outcomes through productivity gains, cost reduction, process optimization, improved decision-making, and customer impact.
  • Lead the governance and prioritization process for AI initiatives, ensuring investments are aligned with enterprise strategy, regulatory requirements, risk appetite, and organizational capacity.
  • Build and institutionalize repeatable frameworks for AI opportunity assessment, business case development, prioritization, value tracking, and executive reporting.
  • Create a portfolio of enterprise AI success stories that demonstrate business impact and serve as catalysts for broader adoption across the organization.
  • Champion a culture of innovation and responsible AI by leading executive engagement, business workshops, innovation forums, strategic planning sessions, and change management initiatives.
  • Influence and enable leaders, product owners, and business teams to identify, evaluate, and adopt AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Partner with architecture, data, security, legal, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet enterprise standards while balancing speed, innovation, and risk management.
  • Establish executive-level visibility into AI strategy, investments, risks, adoption metrics, and business outcomes through regular reporting, scorecards, and portfolio reviews.
  • Build strategic partnerships across internal teams and external vendors to accelerate innovation, leverage emerging capabilities, and maximize enterprise value.
  • Foster an organization-wide mindset focused on continuous improvement, experimentation, business transformation, and value-driven adoption of AI technologies.

Additional Qualification

  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Able to clearly communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated written communication skills.
  • Effective interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills. Able to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ability to simultaneously handle multiple priorities.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. In-depth knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns. Strong proficiency in one or more phases of the software development lifecycle. In-depth knowledge of multiple systems and their key components. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, etc.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Frequently sits for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including, navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and/or places objects or materials weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Rarely performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote ) - This is a field role requiring travel to and from policyholder homes.

Candidates must reside in the Greater Knoxville, TN area to be considered for this role.


The starting wage for this position is $26.01 per hour or higher. Additional compensation may be offered basedon relevant experience and transferable skills.

If you are looking for the following in your next career ...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education,mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.


… then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders’ residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days. 

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.  Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Final candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated level of this role.

Candidates Must be Willing & Able to:

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day, 
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

Physical Actions & Environment:

  • Bending, Kneeling, Pulling, Pushing, Sorting, Carrying up to 50 lbs., Climbing, Reaching, Standing, Walking, Seeing
  • Speaking (English), Reading (English), Writing (English), & Key Entering

Required job duties are performed in the field and an in-home office environment. Exposure to some or all of the following environments when in the field: Uncontrolled outside environmental conditions, Excessive noise levels, Chemicals Chemical/Biological conditions, Moving mechanical parts, Areas considered dangerous, Conditions which could affect the respiratory system or skin such as fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, oils, smoke, soot, or poor ventilation.

Job Summary

As Director, Technical Underwriting - Casualty, you will serve as Farmers' senior technical authority for commercial casualty underwriting. You will lead the development of underwriting strategy, governance, referral frameworks, and portfolio management practices while providing expertise on complex casualty exposures. This newly created role offers the opportunity to shape the future of casualty underwriting within a transforming Business Insurance organization.

This role combines deep underwriting expertise, strategic leadership, and organizational influence. The Director will help shape underwriting appetite, governance frameworks, authority structures, quality programs, and portfolio performance while building technical capabilities across the broader underwriting organization. We are particularly interested in experienced external underwriting leaders who can bring specialized expertise and innovative thinking to help advance Farmers' underwriting capabilities.

The Director will play a pivotal role in building technical excellence, enhancing underwriting quality, improving profitability, and developing the next generation of underwriting talent.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead authority management strategy and underwriting governance framework, including corporate authority templates, referral triggers, and decision rules.
  • Define and enforce how underwriting decisions are made to ensure consistency with underwriting strategy and risk appetite.
  • Exercise elevated underwriting authority and provide guidance on complex or high-exposure risks.
  • Own underwriting performance and profitability for assigned lines of business, including accountability for loss ratio, combined ratio, growth, and retention.
  • Monitor performance and take action to achieve financial and business objectives.
  • Own underwriting quality program and control environment, including quality standards, leakage monitoring, audits, and compliance frameworks.
  • Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions to ensure adherence to underwriting guidelines, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
  • Translate underwriting strategy and risk appetite into technical frameworks, including guidelines, authority structures, and operational rules.
  • Ensure consistent execution across lines of business through clear standards and governance mechanisms.
  • Partner with actuarial and data and analytics to develop and deploy portfolio analytics, underwriting models, and decision-support tools.
  • Establish and lead emerging risk identification and governance processes. 
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to assess impacts and drive updates to underwriting guidelines, authority frameworks, and control structures.
  • Provide direct technical guidance and support to underwriting centers, ensuring responsiveness, effective decision-making, and alignment with underwriting standards.
  • Lead, develop, and retain talent in either quality or loss control functions.
  • Build deep technical expertise and governance discipline within the organization.
  • Implement feedback loops to continuously improve underwriting decision quality, pricing discipline, and overall performance, including coordination and portfolio management of individual account reinsurance placements and collaboration with the reinsurance team on annual facility placements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Experience Requirements

  • Commercial casualty underwriting expertise including complex casualty exposures, liability trends, and technical referral authority.
  • Minimum ten years of experience in insurance underwriting or insurance compliance required.
  • Minimum five years experience leading people required.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelors degree required. Preferably in mathematics, business, or finance.
  • CPCU or CIC designation preferred.

Additional Qualifications

  • Ability to drive multiple projects to successful completion.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional work, drive decisions, and build alignment across underwriting, product, pricing/actuarial, IT, data/analytics, and operations.
  • Demonstrated change leadership, including adoption planning, training enablement, measurement, and continuous improvement. Instills commitment to organizational goals.
  • Ability to understand the vision and direction of the business to develop and execute a plan to achieve business results.

Job Summary

This role oversees technology audit portfolios, ensuring risk-aligned coverage, technical rigor, and consistent quality. It provides independent insight and challenge on technology and risk matters to senior leaders, translating audit results into meaningful risk insights and shaping risk-based coverage within assigned portfolios. The role develops technical audit leaders while contributing to innovation and methodology advancement

Essential Job Functions

  • Act as senior point of contact for technology audit matters within assigned portfolios.
  • Present results, risk themes, and insights to leadership.
  • Translate audit outcomes into meaningful business and risk narratives.
  • Manage and develop staff through coaching, performance management, and assignment alignment, while leading change management efforts by translating strategic priorities and direction from leadership into actionable guidance.
  • Provide oversight across engagements to ensure quality, consistency, and methodological adherence.
  • Review technology audit deliverables and challenge issue calibration, evidence sufficiency, and recommendations, including ensuring risks, root causes, and impacts are clearly supported and conclusions are sound.
  • Own technology audit portfolios and identify emerging risks, applying data-informed and risk-based approaches to shape audit scope and ensure appropriate technology risk coverage within integrated audits.
  • Oversee engagements, approve scope changes, and synthesize portfolio-level insights.
  • Mentor audit leaders.
  • Lead or support methodology improvements, analytics adoption, and other initiatives that enhance technology audit effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Perform targeted hands on audit work on complex or high#priority engagements while overseeing routine execution.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred.
  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), or equivalent preferred.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum seven years experience in IT audit, cybersecurity, or technology risk or equivalent required, preferably within financial services or P&C insurance or external audit industry.
  • Minimum three years of leadership experience preferred.

Additional Qualification

  • Effective leadership skills.
  • Ability to effectively lead through change while operating in an agile and adaptable manner.
  • Possesses strong product knowledge.
  • Strong knowledge of ITGCs, cloud security, IAM, networking, emerging technology risks.
  • Experience with technical control testing.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills.
  • Ability to think critically and work through ambiguity.
  • Demonstrated written communication skills.
  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Effective interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to drive multiple projects to successful completion.
  • Ability to work within tight timeframes and meet strict deadlines

Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote )

We are seeking an experienced Trial Attorney with experience handling complex matters to join our Massachusetts staff counsel team and handle cases venued primarily in the Boston area and surrounding counties. Our attorneys work from home and handle in-person appearances and trials as required. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including annual bonus potential up to 20% of the salary, generous 401k, auto allowance, PTO, medical/dental/vision, paid parental leave, and much more all without the stress of billable hours!   

Job Summary

This position is responsible for representing clients in all areas of insurance defense practice, handling cases that are primarily moderate to high complexity and exposure and/or involve unique insurance defense issues. Manages all phases of cases from intake to resolution.

Essential Job Functions

  • Litigates moderate to high complexity and exposure cases and/or cases involving unique legal or procedural issues and performs duties necessary from intake to trial and/or settlement.
  • This includes but is not limited to preparation of pleadings, motions, discovery, and briefs.
  • Acts as the lead attorney at hearings, conferences, interviews, mediations, arbitrations, and/or trials.
  • Develops strategies and arguments to thoroughly prepare for trial. 
  • Utilizes knowledge of legal precedents to analyze the probable outcomes of a case.
  • Identifies the strengths and weaknesses of approaches to a case.
  • Performs or ensures completion of any other tasks or duties necessary for the proper representation of clients.
  • Consults with Claims Executive team and renders legal strategy recommendations regarding the legal aspects of the handling of personal injury claims.
  • Provides guidance to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
  • Interprets applicable industry laws, rulings and regulations.
  • Functionally supervises attorneys who are assisting in the handling of cases as development opportunities.
  • Provides guidance and mentorship with the autonomy to learn.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Physical Environment

Required job duties are normally performed in a climate- controlled office environment, with some exposure to uncontrollable outside environmental conditions and travel via automobile and/or commercial transportation.

Education Requirements

Bachelors degree preferred. Licensed to practice Law in applicable states required upon hire.

Experience Requirements

Seven years of litigation experience required. Insurance defense, personal injury, and/or jury trial experience required. First and second chair trial experience in bodily injury litigation strongly preferred. Multistate jurisdictional practice preferred.

Special Skill Requirement

Public speaking, ability to function and handle high case loads in adversarial or confrontational situations, driving.

Additional Qualification

Effective leadership skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to command the attention of an audience. Demonstrated problem solving skills. Possesses a genuine interest in the defense of Insurance regulations. Ability to represent the company with external constituents. Handles conflict effectively with the ability to quickly interpret and respond to new information. Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills. Ability to work within tight timeframes and meet strict deadlines. Excellent time management and priority setting skills. Articulate and responsive to colleagues. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Adept and proficient at using technology to maximize efficiency in virtual, paperless environment.

Benefits

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.

Job Summary

  • This position manages an assigned portfolio of core Foremost Independent Agencies, including responsibilities to prospect and appoint new agencies with guidance, drive profitable premium growth, and achieve financial and operational goals. This role develops and manages agency partnerships and serves as the primary relationship between the agency and the company. The position develops and successfully promotes and supports the available suite of Foremost products and services within an assigned portfolio. The assigned portfolio includes management of moderately complex accounts and could span multiple states and several hundred storefronts. This position is an individual contributor who receives moderate guidance and direction from management and field distribution partners while performing work with business unit and enterprise impacts. The position may be virtual or hybrid with limited field travel.

Essential Job Functions

  • Owns and manages assigned portfolio driving profitable growth to achieve financial and operational targets. With moderate guidance from management and field distribution partners, assists in developing and executing territory tactical plan and agency management processes (example business planning, training, compensation) to support financial and operational targets, measure results, and pivot as necessary. With coaching, builds and cultivates mutually beneficial agency partnerships with agency ownership, management, and frontline staff using a consultative sales framework. Establishes position as a trusted advisor while delivering product, underwriting philosophy, appetite, and system training to support retention and new business development to increase depth and maximize agency revenue. With moderate guidance creates, maintains, and executes high quality agency strategies and plans, including holding agents accountable, to achieve written premium, profit, and new business goals. Coordinates plans with field distribution partners, including strategic and tactical components, to align with key business strategies such as carrier consolidation (agency book consolidation), agency storefront expansion, and new product or program rollout support. With coaching, drives and ensures quality of new business flow, appropriate mix of business, and overall risk management of both ind ividual agency books and overall assigned portfolio. Provides appetite and target market clarity, identifies and addresses profit or quality of business concerns to ensure profitability across portfolio. With moderate guidance, strategically utilizes internal reporting and tools designed to support the Independent Agent channel including all Marketing and Development programs, business development tools and internal production/profitability data and analysis. Performs other duties as assigned.

Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. State insurance license preferred upon hire.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum three years of experience required in insurance distribution.
  • Experience achieving profitable premium growth and sales success.
  • Territory management experience

Job Summary

The Director, Decision Science leads a team of analytics and decision science professionals responsible for transforming data into actionable business insights that drive strategic decision-making across the enterprise. This role partners closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex business challenges, identify growth opportunities, improve operational performance, and enhance profitability.
 
The Director oversees the development and application of advanced analytics, statistical modeling, experimentation, forecasting, and machine learning techniques to inform critical business decisions. This leader establishes the vision and strategy for decision science initiatives, ensures the delivery of high-impact analytical solutions, and fosters a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The position leads other people leaders, acts as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, and serves as a subject matter expert in analytics and data-driven decision making.

Essential Job Functions

  • Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to identify strategic business opportunities and develop data-driven solutions that improve business outcomes.
  • Lead the development and execution of the Decision Science strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives and business priorities.
  • Provide consultative leadership on complex business questions by leveraging advanced analytics, statistical methodologies, predictive modeling, forecasting, and machine learning techniques. 
  • Translate business objectives into analytical frameworks and actionable recommendations that influence strategic decisions.
  • Guide large-scale exploratory analyses to uncover trends, risks, opportunities, and drivers of performance across the organization.
  • Oversee the design, execution, and interpretation of experiments, hypothesis testing, and causal inference analyses to evaluate business initiatives and optimize outcomes.
  • Direct the development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of predictive and prescriptive analytics solutions.
  • Leverage modern analytics, visualization, and decision-support tools to communicate insights effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior and executive leadership, influencing decisions through compelling data storytelling and business-focused communication.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, Technology, Product, Finance, and Business Operations teams to ensure data integrity, governance, and scalable analytical solutions.
  • Establish best practices for analytical rigor, model governance, data quality, and performance measurement.
  • Drive the adoption of emerging analytical technologies, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and industry best practices to enhance business capabilities.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor leaders and teams within the Decision Science organization, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, inclusion, and high performance.
  • Manage workforce planning, performance management, employee engagement, talent development, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.
  • Serve as a thought leader and trusted advisor, promoting data literacy and analytical decision-making throughout the enterprise.
  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in decision science methodologies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Experience Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in analytics, decision science, data science, business intelligence, statistics, actuarial analytics, operations research, or related quantitative disciplines.
  • 5+ years of progressive people leadership experience, including leading managers and developing high-performing analytics organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience influencing senior leaders and driving enterprise-level business decisions through analytics and insights.
  • Experience applying advanced statistical techniques, predictive modeling, experimentation, forecasting, machine learning, and optimization methodologies to solve business problems.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and collaborating with business, technology, and data teams.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline preferred.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Frequently sits for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including, navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and/or places objects or materials weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Rarely performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

This leader partners closely with business stakeholders, the data and analytics organization, and IT leadership to transform insight into actionable recommendations, scalable products, and strategic capabilities that influence decision-making across the organization. This role requires a consultative mindset that can connect with executives on creating well developed and value-added insight solutions.

As a strategic partner to our stakeholders this role provides a clear vision to leadership on design, development, implementation, and governance of enterprise data and analytics solutions, while fostering a culture of innovation, data-driven decision making, and continuous improvement. The position will lead a high-performing team responsible for aligning capabilities to the requirement of the organization in meeting its key performance indicators and goals. Focusing on data engineering, analytics, reporting, governance, and advanced analytical capabilities to deliver measurable business value.

Essential Job Functions

  • Identifies and drives opportunities to leverage advanced analytics, predictive modeling, machine learning, and emerging technologies to create competitive advantages and business value.
  • Develops and communicates strategic roadmaps, priorities, and investment recommendations while ensuring successful execution of large-scale initiatives.
  • Partners with business leaders to establish meaningful performance metrics, measurement strategies, and actionable insights that improve operational and financial outcomes.

  • Serves as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating complex business challenges into scalable data-driven strategies and solutions.
  • Establishes and advances enterprise data governance practices, ensuring data quality, integrity, security, compliance, and effective stewardship.
  • Leads the design and implementation of highly complex data and analytics products, platforms, and capabilities that support strategic decision-making and business transformation initiatives.
  • Champions data literacy and a culture of data-driven decision making across the organization through thought leadership, coaching, and organizational influence.
  • Drives continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging data to optimize processes, enhance customer and agent experiences, and improve organizational performance.
  • Ensures adherence to data management standards, architectural principles, governance policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Leads multiple concurrent enterprise initiatives, balancing strategic priorities, resources, risks, and timelines to achieve business outcomes.

Experience Requirements
