Job.JobTitle: Account Manager II, Commercial Risk - Florida
Job.JobDescription:
Aon is Looking for an Account Manager II! Do you have experience in Commercial Risk? Are you an inquisitive, organized, meticulous individual who would like to apply their experience to our dynamic and engaging industry? If so, this may be the next step in your career! This is a hybrid role based out of our Tampa, Miami, or Jacksonville, FL office. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like:   Partner with Account Executives on assigned book of business, manage day-to-day service processes and outputs, support a variety of strategic, client-facing initiatives, and run point on each client’s renewal cycle, ensuring a positive and productive client experience.   How this opportunity is different What makes this opportunity different is the combination of meaningful client impact and Aon’s collaborative culture. In this role, you’ll work closely with colleagues across geographies and solution lines, leveraging Aon’s tools and deep expertise to deliver great outcomes for clients—while benefiting from a supportive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, career development, and personal wellbeing.   Skills that will lead to success: Maintains effective and positive relationships with clients. Serves independently in a client-facing capacity on matters of moderate importance and complexity. Facilitates the timely and accurate flow of information between clients, and account team members, keeping all parties informed. Handles client open items lists and respond to client ad-hoc requests. Gathers and analyzes data and drafts assigned elements of stewardship reports and other convincing presentations tailored to the needs of the audience and the circumstances of the presentation. Actively supports and monitors the renewal process, engaging with account team members as necessary. May draft quote comparisons and is responsible for saving down binders, policies, and endorsements. Where applicable, serves as the primary point of contact with Aon Client Services (ACS), coordinating activities of the client service team and ACS to ensure that key processes assigned are performed efficiently and quality of client deliverables. Primary collaborator with Premium Accounting on client billing matters. Receives and handles routine and sophisticated coverage inquiries and endorsement requests. Serves as key client liaison for items such as certificates, auto IDs, location additions, invoices, Worker’s Compensation posting notices, allocations, premium finance agreements, summaries of insurance, and policy transmittals. Monitors and follows-up on invoice generation, fee agreements, receivables, and collections. Addresses and resolves problems. May provide guidance and mentoring to a less senior account specialist. Delegates work to support staff and ACS where applicable. Ensures tools are understood and used. Performs related duties as assigned. Education and Experience: 3+ years of insurance experience required (preferably in an Account Management role) Property & Casualty broker’s license strongly preferred, or to be obtained within 120 days of start date Strong verbal and written communication skills and analytical abilities Ability to work well under pressure with attention to detail Team oriented self-starter, with ability to organize, prioritize, monitor and control workflow deadlines and be flexible Proficient in Outlook, Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint (intermediate to expert user level preferred) High school diploma or equivalent required Associates degree preferred Experience supporting complex clients is preferred Pay Transparency Laws The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $70,000 - $84,000. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-HYBRID #LI-MM2 2590058

Job.JobTitle: Regional Manager, Email Marketing and Automation - North America
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Digital Marketing Specialist, Marketing / Communications / PR
Job.JobDescription:
The Regional Manager, Email Activation & Marketing Automation, North America, sits within the Global Digital Marketing team and is the strategic marketing automation partner and primary contact for email marketing and digital communications across the North America region. The role combines deep Eloqua expertise with stakeholder management, campaign consulting, governance and measurement, translating regional business needs into effective email, nurture and engagement strategies while applying global standards. It is not solely a coordination role: the manager provides expert recommendations, challenges briefs and directly supports advanced activation where complexity requires it. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Regional Stakeholder Partnership and Campaign Consulting Act as the primary email and automation contact for regional and solution line marketing teams, building trusted relationships with marketing leaders and campaign owners. Translate business objectives and briefs into clear email, nurture and engagement strategies, constructively challenging briefs unlikely to deliver the intended outcome. Advanced Email Activation and Campaign Leadership Lead the design and activation of complex, high-priority, multi-wave programs, including nurture, re-engagement and lifecycle journeys, with advanced segmentation, personalization and lead-scoring logic in Eloqua. Provide hands-on Eloqua activation where complexity or regional importance goes beyond standard delivery, ensuring campaigns are viable before build and escalating material risks. Campaign Governance, Quality and Standards Drive adoption of global email and marketing automation standards, templates, naming conventions, tracking and QA processes across the region. Apply governance across segmentation, consent, preference management, suppression, data use, accessibility and brand, with robust pre-launch validation for complex campaigns. Performance, Testing and Optimization Act as the regional subject matter expert on email and automated campaign performance, defining KPIs and championing systematic A/B and multivariate testing. Turn performance data into evidence-based recommendations, apply learnings to future campaigns, and connect email engagement to lead progression where data allows. Regional-to-GCC Operating Model Coordination Maintain a structured connection between regional stakeholders and the Global Capability Center (GCC) Digital Engagement and Email Marketing team, translating requirements into actionable briefs and coordinating intake, readiness and issue resolution. Surface capacity, timing and scope conflicts to regional and Global Digital leaders, and recommend improvements to roles, handoffs and processes that reduce duplication. Marketing Technology and Capability Building Contribute regional requirements to Eloqua and martech development, support user acceptance testing, and identify automation and AI-enabled efficiencies in line with privacy, risk and brand requirements. Champion email and automation excellence through guidance, workshops, playbooks and coaching of GCC colleagues on complex campaigns. Key Partnerships Global Head of Digital Marketing; North America Go-To-Market, marketing and solution line leaders; Global Capability Center Digital Marketing and Email Marketing teams; Lead CoE; Marketing Technology; Global Digital Performance and Insights; Data, Privacy, Risk and Compliance; Brand and Content. Skills and experience that will lead to success Advanced Oracle Eloqua experience in an enterprise environment, including Campaign Canvas, Program Builder, segmentation, forms, landing pages, custom data objects, lead scoring and dynamic content. Comparable platform experience may be considered alongside a strong grasp of Eloqua concepts. Demonstrated experience designing and delivering complex, multi-stage or multi-market email campaigns and nurture journeys. Strong understanding of audience data, tracking, consent, preference management, suppression and deliverability, with working knowledge of CRM integration, lead management and attribution. Strong stakeholder management, consulting and communication skills: translating business objectives into practical solutions, constructively challenging briefs, explaining technical concepts simply, and influencing senior stakeholders and matrixed teams without direct authority. Collaborative, proactive, pragmatic and accountable, comfortable in an evolving global operating model and in combining strategic consulting with hands-on expert activation. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, digital, technology or a related discipline, or equivalent experience; Oracle Eloqua or marketing automation certification. Significant experience in email marketing, digital communications, marketing automation or campaign operations within a global, regional or matrixed enterprise. Experience leading complex campaign workstreams or mentoring specialists; regulated, data-sensitive or professional-services experience is advantageous. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $100,000 - $115,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. The salary range reflected is based on a primary work location of Chicago, Illinois. The actual salary may vary for applicants in a different geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-SP1 #LI-REMOTE 2590697

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Account Executive, Sales / Business Development, Farm Worker
Job.JobDescription:
Aon is looking for a Equine Farm and Ranch-Account Executive/Broker Specialist for our Private Risk Management Group. This is a virtual position, that can be located anywhere in the United States. As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions. Aon is in the business of better decisions: At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like: An emerging team member who is responsible for assisting a team of Account Executives with day-to-day account management and broking of personal insurance programs. Supports the Account Executive by working to build, expand, and solidify relationships with existing clients and prospective clients. Promotes the value that Aon delivers to clients through superior service, pricing, consultation, and reporting. Assist with new business and remarketing of equine, farm, and ranch insurance programs for current clients. Updating applications within our agency management system, quoting online with insurers, and completing coverage comparisons or proposals for the Account Executives in Microsoft Word or Excel. Prepare and input summary of coverages for Account Executives. Prepare and maintain summary of values for Account Executives. Assist with conducting annual reviews for clients. Process changes and endorsements within 48 hours of receipt. The time service standard: returning a phone call within 24 hours and responding to emails by the end of the day. Assist the Account Executive with complex claim activity. Including contacting claims adjusters when necessary. Assisting the Account Executive with client billing issues- including contacting the carrier and/or internal accounting team to coordinate, track, resolve billing/payment issues. Access carrier websites/systems to process changes, retrieve documents and information as required. Skills and experience that will lead to success: Minimum of 3 years experience with high-net-worth personal lines insurance. Experience with complex equine or farm and ranch accounts a plus. Experience with Applied Epic is preferred. Proficiency in applying carrier management platforms (American Reliable, Chubb Agribusiness, Travelers Agribusiness, etc.). Intermediate experience with Microsoft Word and Excel. Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of industry experience is preferred. Must have a valid P&C license. AFIS, CPRIA, CPCU, CIC, or ARM completed or in process is preferred. How we support our colleagues In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well. Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. People with criminal histories are encouraged to apply. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. You can request accommodations by emailing us at ReasonableAccommodations@Aon.com or your recruiter. We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $65,000 to $75,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Aon is looking for a Risk Consultant for our Property Consulting Group We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Property Risk Control Consultant. This position will support Aon’s Property Risk Consulting Group. To strengthen Aon’s construction risk engineering capability across the US, with a particular focus on digital infrastructure and data center projects, while also supporting broader construction-related opportunities across the region. This person should have HPR property engineering experience with knowledge of both NFPA and Factory Mutual standards as well as an understanding of property insurance policy terms and conditions. Applicant must be proficient in managing client, carrier, and insurance brokerage relationships. Excellent communication skills a must and should be able to effectively explain general property risk management concepts to prospective clients and internal business groups. The prospect will be expected to travel anywhere between 30-40% of the time primarily in the U.S. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Deliver construction risk engineering support across the project lifecycle, including early design / pre-construction, construction phase, energisation / commissioning and transition into operations. Conduct and lead project risk reviews, design reviews, construction site surveys, underwriting surveys, construction-phase risk assessments and loss estimate assignments. Identify critical construction-phase exposures, including fire, structural, delay-in-start-up, resilience and interface risks, and translate these into practical improvement recommendations. Support data centers and digital infrastructure projects by contributing to a consistent US delivery approach, common methodology and high-quality technical deliverables. Work closely with local country teams, broking colleagues, underwriters, clients and the wider US / global risk consulting community to support both local and cross-border assignments. Provide technical input into underwriting narratives, risk reports, loss estimates, risk improvement plans and client-facing recommendations. Help build and share construction risk engineering knowledge across US by supporting training initiatives, mentoring colleagues and contributing to standardized tools, templates and best-practice guidance. Support growth activity by helping country and regional leaders assess pipeline opportunities, resource needs and the technical feasibility of construction / digital infrastructure assignments. Skills and experience that will lead to success Strong background in construction risk engineering, project risk engineering, construction insurance engineering or a closely related technical engineering discipline. Experience with construction-phase risk reviews, design advisory / review work, site surveys, underwriting reports and technical risk recommendations. Ability to review and interpret engineering reports, drawings and interfaces between design disciplines, particularly where assignments require short turnaround times. Good understanding of data center / digital infrastructure risk drivers would be highly beneficial, including power supply, redundancy, cooling, commissioning, integrated systems testing and handover risks. Program Consultant, Worker's Compensation The Workers’ Compensation Program Consultant is responsible for the comprehensive management, oversight, and optimization of complex workers’ compensation programs. This role requires deep expertise in program design, implementation, continuous monitoring, and process improvement. The Consultant acts as a key liaison between internal stakeholders, third-party administrators (TPAs), insurance carriers, and external vendors to ensure effective claim management, compliance, and cost containment. This is a remote opportunity. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like Workers’ Compensation Program Management Design, implement, and oversee workers’ compensation programs, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and compliance with regulatory requirements. Coordinate and lead regular claim reviews (multiple times per year) and manage follow-up action items per agreed plans of action. Monitor and review new claims, subrogation opportunities, claim delays, denials, and reserve changes, and recommend corrective action as necessary. Liaise with local operations and TPA to facilitate information exchange, address program issues, and ensure service quality. Oversee state-specific programs, including monopolistic state oversight and premium payment coordination (e.g., Ohio BWC). Claims Oversight and Litigation Management Provide continuous oversight and monitoring of claim activity, including significant loss cases and legal calendar management. Manage litigation processes, including defense attorney panel management, performance monitoring, and implementation of changes as needed. Stay current on technical, legislative, and legal changes affecting workers’ compensation programs and communicate relevant updates to local operations. Coordinate and monitor all legal plans of action (POAs) related to workers’ compensation claims. Program Advocacy and Stewardship Act as a program advocate, coordinating stewardship programs and benchmarking exercises to measure and enhance program performance. Develop and provide educational materials and training sessions to local operations on program-specific topics, technical changes, and best practices. Vendor and Provider Management Manage relationships with medical provider networks, including quality monitoring, provider changes, and conducting provider interviews. Field and resolve vendor inquiries, research issues, and coordinate resolution of unpaid invoices. Modify service level agreements and special account handling instructions as necessary to optimize service delivery. Data Analytics and Program Improvement Review and analyze loss data and claims analytics to identify cost-saving opportunities and areas for program improvement. Coordinate claims audits and support continuous improvement initiatives. Gather and report relevant data to support program objectives and drive decision-making. Additional Program Support Support manufacturing and owner-controlled insurance program (OCIP) claim oversight, including business unit claim reviews and annual stewardship. Develop and update service instructions and program documentation as needed. Coordinate efforts with the Safety and Human Resources departments to align claims management with organizational safety initiatives as well as remain compliant within each jurisdiction. Skills and experience that will lead to success 7+ years in workers’ compensation program management, consulting, or claims administration. In-depth knowledge of state and federal workers’ compensation laws, regulations, and program requirements. Proven ability to manage complex claims, litigation, and vendor/provider relationships. Strong analytical skills and experience with claims data analytics and program benchmarking. Excellent communication, training, and stakeholder management skills. Experience with monopolistic state programs (e.g., Ohio BWC) and multi-state program oversight preferred. Education: Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Insurance, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., ARM, CPCU) are a plus A Property & Casualty license is required or must be obtained within 90 days of hire if not already active Professional insurance or risk management designations such as, CPCU, ARM, ACII or equivalent is preferred. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $115,000 to $135,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Are you ready to lead insurance solutions for Fortune 500 clients? Do you want to collaborate with industry experts and drive innovation in captive insurance management? Aon is actively seeking an experienced Insurance Officer to join our expanding team! This is a hybrid OR remote role. Strong preference for candidates who can work from our Burlington, VT office. This role will require Eastern Standard Time work hours. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. How this opportunity is different You will work with Risk Managers from multinational companies and collaborate with Brokers, Actuaries, Account Executives, Regulators, Investment Managers, Auditors, and C-Suite executives. Aon provides the opportunity to drive your career development and be part of a leading captive management firm. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, depth of experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary range reflected is based on a primary work location of Burlington, VT. The actual salary may vary for applicants in a different geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Job.JobTitle: Senior Casualty Claims Consultant - Virtual anywhere in US
Job.JobDescription:
Aon is looking for a Senior Casualty Claims Consultant! We currently have a great career opportunity for a Casualty Claims Risk Consultant. It is the responsibility of the Casualty Claims Risk Consultant to deliver tactical, client specific, casualty claims services on assigned accounts in support of Aon’s core brokerage services. This position is for a workers’ compensation professional; however, experience with auto and general liability, is a plus. Work Style: Virtual work from Home. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. How this role is different The general role of our Casualty Claims Risk Consultant is to: Identify client exposures and provide customized casualty consulting services for clients to help them reduce their Total Cost of Risk. Ensuring the highest level of service from claims administrator(s) and carrier partners. Improve client claim outcomes by examining and analyzing key elements and related costs of their claims programs and build best practice-oriented approaches to claims cost containment. Introduce appropriate Aon resources and provide project management to ensure commitments are met and results are achieved. Establish project plans and budgets. May require limited involvement in business development opportunities as dictated by geographic needs. Skills and experience that will lead to success Demonstrated expertise in workers’ compensation claims management, with knowledge of casualty lines including auto and general liability, and a commitment to delivering exceptional client outcomes. Strong relationship management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust, advocate for clients, and collaborate effectively with clients, carriers, TPAs, Account Executives, and internal partners. Experience developing and executing strategic service plans, managing budgets, and delivering high-quality consulting services on time and in alignment with client objectives. Analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate claims data, identify trends, conduct claim reviews, and recommend strategies that improve claim outcomes and reduce total cost of risk. Proven project management and process improvement capabilities, including managing multiple priorities, documenting action plans, applying best practices, and driving consistent service delivery. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, along with strong written and verbal communication skills and a commitment to continuous professional development. Minimum qualifications and requirements Proven performer with strong technical knowledge and work experience adjusting or managing workers compensation claims or possess multi-line claims experience with emphasis on casualty lines of coverage. Retain proficiency as an insurance professional while maintaining clear and effective communication, both in writing and verbally. Fluent in Microsoft office suite, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Minimum education Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience Producer/Broker licensing may be required after hiring Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $126,735 to $140,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-RW1 #LI-REMOTE 2583908

Aon is looking for an Office Operations & Administrative Specialist! Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the Day Will Look Like The Office Operations & Administrative Specialist is a full-time, office-based role within Aon United Administrative Operations organization responsible for delivering exceptional workplace experience for colleagues, clients, and visitors. This position combines administrative support, office operations, workplace services, and concierge-level assistance to ensure a seamless and productive environment. Serving as a visible and trusted on-site resource, the Office Operations & Administrative Specialist plays a critical role in supporting day-to-day business operations, enhancing workplace efficiency, and providing high-touch service to executives, colleagues, and guests. Working Model Full-time, five days per week in the office in our Miami, FL office. Position requires consistent on-site presence to support workplace operations and employee experience Role involves regular interaction with colleagues, leaders, clients, visitors, vendors, and workplace partners How this opportunity is different This role is ideal for a highly organized, service-oriented professional who enjoys working in a dynamic office environment, excels at creating positive experiences for others, and thrives in a role that blends administrative support, workplace operations, and concierge-level service. Administrative Support Provide proactive administrative support to assigned colleagues and business leaders, managing calendars, scheduling meetings, coordinating priorities, and responding to ad hoc requests with accuracy and professionalism. Coordinate domestic and international travel and manage expense reporting, reconciliation, and tracking to ensure timely and accurate processing. Organize virtual, in-person, and off-site meetings, including invitations, conference rooms, technology, materials, catering, agendas, meeting notes, decisions, and follow-up action items. Prepare, format, print, and distribute business documents, presentations, correspondence, reports, and other materials while maintaining a high level of quality, confidentiality, and attention to detail. What the day will look like Workplace & Location Services Operations: Coordinate meeting rooms, room setup, audiovisual technology, meeting materials, catering, and other office logistics to support seamless meetings and workplace activities. Support reception and visitor services, including registration, badging, greeting, escorting guests, and creating a professional and welcoming experience. Maintain workplace readiness by monitoring meeting rooms, common areas, amenities, office supplies, mail, packages, and occupancy needs. Partner with Facilities, IT, Security, and external vendors to resolve workplace issues promptly and support consistent, high-quality office experience. Skills and Experiences that Will Lead to Success Executive & On-Site Support Coordinate executive meetings, schedules, visits, and special requests, ensuring seamless logistics and a professional experience. Anticipate executive needs, prioritize urgent requests, and prepare meeting materials, presentations, and other support resources with discretion and accuracy. Support on-site meetings, office events, and employee or client-facing activities, including room setup, registration, signage, technology, materials, and catering. Provide a hospitality-focused experience by welcoming executives, clients, and visitors and supporting smooth day-of event execution. Partner with Marketing & Events and other stakeholders on larger events, including coordination, teardown, follow-up activities, and restoring workplace readiness. Organization & Execution Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, and requests in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and follow-through, with the ability to work independently while maintaining high service standards. Customer Service & Communication Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a professional, client-focused, and hospitality-oriented approach. Ability to build positive relationships and confidently interact with senior executives, clients, colleagues, and external stakeholders. Problem Solving & Ownership Proactive problem solver with strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to anticipate needs and identify effective solutions. Demonstrates accountability, ownership, adaptability, and flexibility when responding to changing business needs and priorities. Technology Proficiency Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. Experience with expense management, travel booking, visitor management, scheduling platforms, and other workplace technology, with the ability to quickly learn new tools. Success Measures Deliver timely, accurate, and high-quality administrative and workplace support with strong responsiveness to requests, issues, and escalations. Ensure seamless coordination of meetings, executive/VIP visits, on-site events, and workplace logistics while maintaining a positive colleague, client, and visitor experience. Collaborate effectively across administrative support, Facilities, IT, Security, vendors, and Marketing & Events to ensure clear handoffs and consistent service delivery. This position combines administrative support, office operations, workplace services, and concierge-level assistance to ensure a seamless and productive environment. Serving as a visible and trusted on-site resource, the Office Operations & Administrative Specialist plays a critical role in supporting day-to-day business operations, enhancing workplace efficiency, and providing high-touch service to executives, colleagues, and guests. Working Model Full-time, five days per week in the office in our Miami, FL office. Position requires consistent on-site presence to support workplace operations and employee experience Role involves regular interaction with colleagues, leaders, clients, visitors, vendors, and workplace partners How this opportunity is different This role is ideal for a highly organized, service-oriented professional who enjoys working in a dynamic office environment, excels at creating positive experiences for others, and thrives in a role that blends administrative support, workplace operations, and concierge-level service. Administrative Support Provide proactive administrative support to assigned colleagues and business leaders, managing calendars, scheduling meetings, coordinating priorities, and responding to ad hoc requests with accuracy and professionalism. Coordinate domestic and international travel and manage expense reporting, reconciliation, and tracking to ensure timely and accurate processing. Organize virtual, in-person, and off-site meetings, including invitations, conference rooms, technology, materials, catering, agendas, meeting notes, decisions, and follow-up action items. Prepare, format, print, and distribute business documents, presentations, correspondence, reports, and other materials while maintaining a high level of quality, confidentiality, and attention to detail. What the day will look like Workplace & Location Services Operations: Coordinate meeting rooms, room setup, audiovisual technology, meeting materials, catering, and other office logistics to support seamless meetings and workplace activities. Support reception and visitor services, including registration, badging, greeting, escorting guests, and creating a professional and welcoming experience. Maintain workplace readiness by monitoring meeting rooms, common areas, amenities, office supplies, mail, packages, and occupancy needs. Partner with Facilities, IT, Security, and external vendors to resolve workplace issues promptly and support consistent, high-quality office experience. Skills and Experiences that Will Lead to Success Executive & On-Site Support Coordinate executive meetings, schedules, visits, and special requests, ensuring seamless logistics and a professional experience. Anticipate executive needs, prioritize urgent requests, and prepare meeting materials, presentations, and other support resources with discretion and accuracy. Support on-site meetings, office events, and employee or client-facing activities, including room setup, registration, signage, technology, materials, and catering. Provide a hospitality-focused experience by welcoming executives, clients, and visitors and supporting smooth day-of event execution. Partner with Marketing & Events and other stakeholders on larger events, including coordination, teardown, follow-up activities, and restoring workplace readiness. Organization & Execution Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, and requests in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and follow-through, with the ability to work independently while maintaining high service standards. Customer Service & Communication Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a professional, client-focused, and hospitality-oriented approach. Ability to build positive relationships and confidently interact with senior executives, clients, colleagues, and external stakeholders. Problem Solving & Ownership Proactive problem solver with strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to anticipate needs and identify effective solutions. Demonstrates accountability, ownership, adaptability, and flexibility when responding to changing business needs and priorities. Technology Proficiency Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. Experience with expense management, travel booking, visitor management, scheduling platforms, and other workplace technology, with the ability to quickly learn new tools. Success Measures Deliver timely, accurate, and high-quality administrative and workplace support with strong responsiveness to requests, issues, and escalations. Ensure seamless coordination of meetings, executive/VIP visits, on-site events, and workplace logistics while maintaining a positive colleague, client, and visitor experience. Collaborate effectively across administrative support, Facilities, IT, Security, vendors, and Marketing & Events to ensure clear handoffs and consistent service delivery. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-RW1 #LI-Office

Aon is looking for a Private Client Account Executive. As part of an industry-leading team, responsible for the day-to-day account management and broking of complex personal insurance programs for affluent clients and families, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions supporting our APRM group. This position is virtual role, based in California. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like: Manages an assigned book of high-net-worth personal insurance clients with personal insurance portfolios of varying size and complexity. May also include Group Excess Liability programs. Work to build, expand, and solidify relationships with existing clients and prospective clients. Leads appropriate resources to address the client/prospective client's risk needs, thereby retaining and growth a profitable book of business. Promotes the value that Aon delivers to clients through superior service, pricing, consultation, and reporting. Brokers and maintains required insurance policies and risk management solutions on behalf of clients. Conducts annual reviews for clients ahead of key renewal dates. Coordinates all client-related billing matters and maintains aged receivables reports. Works with Client Services team and assigned Coordinator to process changes and other client requests in a timely manner. Maintains awareness of all large and potentially complicated claim-related matters and assists in the negotiation of equitable claim settlements on behalf of clients. Engages internal and external resources as required in order to Empower Results on behalf of our clients. Achieves assigned annual revenue growth and retention metrics. Supports growth of book of business through rounding of accounts and through new business production. The time service standard: returning a phone call within 24 hours and responding to email by end of the day. Develops and maintains meaningful working relationships with insurers, clients, referral sources, and colleagues through regular contact and interaction. Maintains awareness of all insurance carrier partner products, services, and systems. Fully utilizes internal client management system to maintain policies, client correspondence, coordinate billing activities, and management client related tasks. Achieves assigned transparency, disclosure, and compliance goals and fosters innovative solutions to drive success for our clients. Skills and experience that will lead to success: Property and Casualty Broker's License required. 5-10 years of high net-worth personal insurance experience required. Appropriate insurance designations such as: CPCU, CIC,CPRM, CPRIA,AFIS or ARM completed or in process is preferred. Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of industry experience. How we support our colleagues: In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well. Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. People with criminal histories are encouraged to apply. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. You can request accommodations by emailing us at ReasonableAccommodations@Aon.com or your recruiter. We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience. Job.JobTitle: Health Benefit Solutions Assistant Vice President
Job.JobDescription:
Are you intellectually curious with a passion to solve problems? Do you enjoy a flexible and collaborative, team-based environment where you are always learning and growing? If yes, Aon is the company for you! As part of a leading global professional services firm, you will empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective solutions supporting health and welfare benefits strategies. We are building our Health Solutions team with the best talent and will consider great candidates in Tampa or Miami, FL. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from a local office. What the day will look like As an Assistant Vice President, you are the Lead Consultant on the Health Solutions client team supporting the Account Executive and responsible for timely, accurate, and quality service of all client deliverables. In this position you will act as the primary day-to-day contact for clients and oversee the client team and project management. The Health Solutions Assistant Vice President will collaborate with the client Account Executive to facilitate execution of overall strategy plus special projects as needed. This position includes delegation of assignments to team members and peer review of their work, but also involves being actively involved in performing analysis, drafting client presentations, participating in client meetings, and identifying client needs for other services. Additionally, the Assistant Vice President will: Lead integrated efforts of internal Aon teams such as actuarial, audit, legal, and specialized broking teams Foster the overall relationship with the client’s vendor partners Maintain an understanding of healthcare market trends and innovation Leverage the right resources to resolve client issues Mentor, coach, and guide junior staff How this opportunity is different What makes Aon different are the people and the culture. Aon colleagues support each other across geographies and solution lines. Aon has the tools plus depth and breadth of experience to drive great outcomes for our clients, while providing the optimal environment for the career and personal growth of our colleagues. Skills and experience that will lead to success Ten plus years of experience in the group health and benefits industry with a strong working knowledge of benefits Excellent organizational and project management skills with strong attention to detail Ability to handle multiple projects at one time Strong analytical and presentation skills Advanced level of proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint and Excel) Project Management, Consulting, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Data Analysis, Health Care Education Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of industry experience Must have appropriate insurance license/life and health (can be fulfilled post-hire) Project management certification is a plus Pay Transparency The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $107,000 to $143,000.00 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary range reflected is based on a primary work location of Tampa, FL. The actual salary may vary for applicants in a different geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. How we support our colleagues Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. #LI-HL2 #LI-HYBRID #USA_IND 2581273

Maintain workplace readiness by monitoring meeting rooms, common areas, amenities, office supplies, mail, packages, and occupancy needs. Partner with Facilities, IT, Security, and external vendors to resolve workplace issues promptly and support consistent, high-quality office experience. Skills and Experiences that Will Lead to Success Executive & On-Site Support Coordinate executive meetings, schedules, visits, and special requests, ensuring seamless logistics and a professional experience. Anticipate executive needs, prioritize urgent requests, and prepare meeting materials, presentations, and other support resources with discretion and accuracy. Support on-site meetings, office events, and employee or client-facing activities, including room setup, registration, signage, technology, materials, and catering. Provide a hospitality-focused experience by welcoming executives, clients, and visitors and supporting smooth day-of event execution. Partner with Marketing & Events and other stakeholders on larger events, including coordination, teardown, follow-up activities, and restoring workplace readiness. Organization & Execution Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, and requests in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and follow-through, with the ability to work independently while maintaining high service standards. Customer Service & Communication Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a professional, client-focused, and hospitality-oriented approach. Ability to build positive relationships and confidently interact with senior executives, clients, colleagues, and external stakeholders. Problem Solving & Ownership Proactive problem solver with strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to anticipate needs and identify effective solutions. Demonstrates accountability, ownership, adaptability, and flexibility when responding to changing business needs and priorities. Technology Proficiency Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. Experience with expense management, travel booking, visitor management, scheduling platforms, and other workplace technology, with the ability to quickly learn new tools. Success Measures Deliver timely, accurate, and high-quality administrative and workplace support with strong responsiveness to requests, issues, and escalations. Ensure seamless coordination of meetings, executive/VIP visits, on-site events, and workplace logistics while maintaining a positive colleague, client, and visitor experience. Collaborate effectively across administrative support, Facilities, IT, Security, vendors, and Marketing & Events to ensure clear handoffs and consistent service delivery. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. AON is looking for a Global Benefits Analyst/Consultant - (Hybrid Chicago / NY / CA) Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Coordinate with colleagues around the world to understand project progress and to ensure that deliverables are met. Support and/or participate in regular ongoing client briefing calls to describe project progress and discuss critical issues. Prepare reporting and materials for global benefits projects. Review information provided by global colleagues for consistency and reasonability. Make edits, ensure proper use of English and summarize results in high quality deliverables for presentation to clients. Join meetings and take notes, monitor and execute deliverables and accountabilities based on project scope and statement of work. Partner as appropriate with other team members to finalize projects and monitor time spend and project budget. Make analytical conclusions/recommendations for work conducted. Identify additional potential work and any out of scope services requested by clients. Support senior members of the group in developing business opportunities through the introduction of additional services for existing clients. Resolve client issues at appropriate levels and inform relationship manager and other team members of pertinent issues. Manage projects and drive timely delivery of work products within a highly decentralized global structure. Work with Bangalore (India) and Krakow (Poland) - based support team to ensure efficient delivery of client materials and other deliverables. Support client projects with limited direction through completion and within established time frames and financial parameters to attain overall client deliverables. Support and/or attend client meetings and present results as an integral part of a collaborative client service team. Review less experienced staff members’ work product for reasonableness and accuracy to validate data and results. Assist with development and informal supervision of more junior staff by ensuring that client deliverables are met. Assist in development and maintenance of tools and templates required for efficient work delivery. Assist in preparation of thought leadership materials to bring new concepts and ideas to clients. Participate in training opportunities to remain current with the regulatory environment. Develop necessary skill set to discuss technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences alike. Additional opportunities to participate on special project teams may also be identified as part of a more personalized career development plan. Skills and experience that will lead to success Bachelor’s degree (mathematics, finance, economics or other degrees where quantitative skills are required is preferred). Project management certification is an advantage. Foreign language skills and work experience in a foreign country are an advantage Knowledge & Experience: 1-3 years or more of direct experience in an HR consulting firm or professional services firm preferred. In addition, international or non-US benefits consulting experience is strongly desired. We also value demonstrated consultative skills to effectively work in a cohesive team environment as well as the ability to communicate with a variety of internal and external parties. Strong project management and strong analytical ability. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong presentation skills Strong interpersonal skills, ability to prioritize multiple projects in as fast-paced and time-sensitive environment. Working knowledge of employee benefits. Demonstrated interest in the global environment, other cultures and languages For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is looking for a Strategic Communication Partner – Hybrid/In Person (Chicago, New York, Philadelphia, Atlanta, Denver, Phoenix, Los Angeles), or Virtual As part of our Strategic Communication team within Aon’s Human Capital business, the Partner in this role will be accountable for driving business growth, expanding client relationships, managing people, and enhancing market differentiation for our team and Aon. This role works with clients to develop communication and change strategies and high-impact creative communication in the areas of total rewards (compensation, benefits, and more), talent programs, and organizational change. In this role, you will have an opportunity to make an impact on our clients and their people right now, while also growing our team and shaping the future of employee communication. Job.JobTitle: Account Executive - Assistant Vice President - Private Equity
Job.JobDescription:
Are you looking to be a member of an industry-leading team? Do you want to deliver innovative and effective solutions to clients? If yes, then our Private Equity Account Executive role is the one for you. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from any of our Florida offices (Jacksonville, Miami or Tampa). Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What The Day Will Look Like Responsible for overall total rewards strategy, benefits consulting, vendor management, client service, and growth-related activities for designated clients and prospects. This position will have frequent interactions with clients’ HR, Benefits and Finance executives regarding the delivery of benefits consulting services. Leads client service teams to identify and meet client needs and thereby retain and grow a profitable book of business. Through service, pricing, consultation and reporting, promotes the value Aon delivers to clients. Handles predominantly (i.e., 70%+) small and mid-market clients. Additionally, the Account Executive - Assistant Vice President will: Develop employee benefits strategies, lead sophisticated benefits consulting projects, manage vendors, develop client reports, lead external meetings and internal resource coordination. Maintain and grow long-term client relationships through excellent service Display an in-depth understanding of the Health and Benefits marketplace, as well as Aon’s Health Solutions capabilities Possess experience and expertise in benefit plan design, rate analysis, strategy, RFP development and response review, insurance carrier negotiations, stewardship report preparation, benchmark analysis, client financial analysis and reporting and carrier contract reviews Demonstrate excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal collaboration skills Form effective teams, share client background and goals, measure results, share ideas, identify process improvements, provide timely and regular coaching and feedback to team members Exhibit thought leadership—understand and be able to articulate ideas to clients Marshal appropriate Aon resources to support client needs Assist with client acquisitions and benefit integrations Arrange Aon compensation for services, whether fee or commission-based, and ensure overall account profitability Skills to be successful in the role 7+ years of Health and Benefits background and 5+ plus years of benefits consulting/brokerage experience Client facing experience at a consulting company, insurance company, or brokerage focused on benefits and health services Business development experience Broad business knowledge/perspective Team building skills Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools Working understanding of the Private Equity industry is preferred Data Management, Meeting Facilitation, Project Management, Risk Management, Solutions Design, Benefits Administration, Workforce Strategy, Consulting, Customer Engagement, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Data Analysis Education Bachelor’s degree or applicable experience or equivalent years of industry experience Life/Accident/Health insurance license (or ability to learn license after hire) Pay Transparency Laws: The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $107,000 to $143,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. The salary range reflected is based on a primary work location of Miami, FL. The actual salary may vary for applicants in a different geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance. This role does not accrue vacation. Rather, this role is eligible to take paid time off at the discretion of the employee and management in accordance with company policy and practices. Various other types of leaves of absence; paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. #LI-HL2 #LI-HYBRID #USA_IND 2581237

Job.JobTitle: Time Away & Life Solutions Senior Consultant - Underwriter
Job.JobDescription:
Aon is looking for an experienced Underwriter to join our growing Time Away & Life Solutions (TALS) Consulting Practice. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from one of our offices in the United States. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As a underwriter within the Time Away & Life Solutions (TALS) Consulting Practice, you will be leading large complex clients and presenting your analysis in a client-facing role. You will be responsible for training and development of the offshore COE team, and follow a formal peer review process, to drive the financial strategy for our clients. How this opportunity is different Our team focuses on National Account clients. With the evolving need for leave industry there is constant need for strategy development and cost modeling to ensure that clients remain compliant and competitive in the marketplace. This team is comprised of colleagues with different backgrounds and skillsets that collaborate with each other to deliver for our clients. Skills and experience that will lead to success The candidate should have financial technical skills with regards to disability, life insurance, FMLA and municipal/state regulated leaves, and voluntary benefits. Strong technical underwriting and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate risk and interpret complex benefit programs Ability to support project execution through effective planning, coordination, and timely delivery of assigned workstream components Solid organizational and project management skills to manage multiple priorities and deadlines Applies professional principles and sound business judgment to support the development and refinement of processes, procedures, and solutions Contributes to the adoption of best practices by consistently applying established processes, tools, and methodologies to support quality and efficiency Understanding of industry trends, data analysis, and evolving market dynamics impacting underwriting and benefit programs Project Management, Benefits Administration, Consulting, Data Analysis, Data Management, Meeting Facilitation Education 10+ years in underwriting Absence, Life & Disability Pay Transparency Laws: Salary range for the position The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $125,000 - $145,000.00 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. #LI-LR1 #LI-HYBRID #LI-REMOTE 2581718
