  • On site newly renovated fitness center - free to use for employees.  Yoga and other classes available for a nominal fee.

Responsibilities

The Litigation Specialist’s job function includes efficiently and effectively handling advanced-level, primarily litigated, commercial third-party general liability losses in a “paperless” environment. An ability to communicate both verbally and in written form in a prompt, courteous and professional manner is essential.

This role can be located in our Scottsdale AZ office, or remotely for a highly qualified candidate.

  • Reviews and sets up new loss assignments in a timely manner in compliance with Department guidelines and best practices.
  • Establishes appropriate initial loss and expense reserves and continues to regularly evaluate the file for adequacy, accuracy and adherence to reserving guidelines.
  • Analyzes and interprets policy language in conjunction with specific loss facts to reach appropriate coverage decisions.
  • Drafts frequent and complex coverage correspondence, including reservation of rights and coverage disclaimers in compliance with various state statutes and regulations.
  • Composes a variety of other detailed correspondence to insureds, claimants, attorneys, agents and Regulatory agencies.
  • Proactively manages primarily litigated claim files from inception to closure, including identification and investigation of coverage, liability and damage issues, determination and efficient execution of an appropriate plan of action, and prompt, economical file resolution, in compliance with Department guidelines and best practices.
  • Appropriately and clearly documents all claim file activity, including current strategy, plan of action and exit plan in file notes.
  • Consistently demonstrates comprehensive coverage analysis, investigation, evaluation and negotiation skills at an advanced level.
  • Directs and controls the activities and costs of numerous outside vendors including defense counsel and coverage counsel, experts and independent adjusters.
  • Effectively presents and discusses loss facts and issues in roundtable discussions to peers and members of management at all levels.
  • Composes and transmits on a regular and timely basis frequent Large Loss Reports and other detailed reporting documents as appropriate.
  • Manages and monitors file caseload through the use of various resources.
  • Obtains all required state adjuster licenses and maintains them as required via compliance with mandatory continuing education requirements.
  • Other duties may be assigned.
  • Serves as a technical resource within the Department through mentoring and knowledge-sharing, whether one-on-one, in small groups, or presentations to larger groups.
  • Meets with intern personnel and others as needed to provide job function overview and/or specific subject-matter training.
  • Occasional participation in projects and initiatives led by other departments and/or W. R. Berkley companies, including audits, workshops, focus groups, task forces, etc.
  • Initiates appropriate communication with members of management and other Departments.
  • Attends internal and external seminars and other training events and provides feedback to peers and/or members of management.

  • Must have at 12+ years of insurance experience, with a strong background in commercial general liability claims examination and coverage analysis.
  • Must have intermediate knowledge of computer programs in a Windows environment, including Word, Excel and E-mail.

Company Details

W. R. Berkley Corporation is establishing a new operating unit, Berkley Edge.

Berkley Edge offers solutions for hard-to-place and distressed risks for both professional and casualty lines of business.  Edge will focus on small to mid-sized risks through a wholesale only distribution model.

Founded in 1967, W. R. Berkley Corporation has grown from a small investment management firm into one of the largest commercial lines property and casualty insurers in the United States.  Along the way, we have been listed on the New York Stock Exchange, seen our revenue soar well past $10 billion, and become a well-respected Fortune 500 Company.

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

The AVP, Manufacturers and Contractors Division Manager will lead the underwriting unit writing products liability and contractors liability.  The manager will set the vision, drive underwriting strategy, manage the portfolio and lead the team.  The manager will also be responsible for training of staff.

  • Develop and execute underwriting strategy for Manufacturers and Contractors division.
  • Build, train, and lead a high-performing team of underwriters.
  • Monitor emerging risks, market trends, and regulatory developments to change product as needed.
  • Work with Product and Forms Specialist to create coverage forms.
  • Work with actuarial to create pricing models.
  • Establish risk appetite guidelines.
  • Handle underwriting referrals.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and implement corrective actions as needed to maintain profitability.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key distribution partners.
  • Lead initiatives to grow market share in target segments.
  • Ensure compliance with underwriting guidelines, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.
  • Partner with actuarial, claims, legal, and data teams to ensure a holistic view of risk and make an underwriting profit.
  • Report on key metrics and provide insights to executive leadership.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree highly desired; advanced degree or CPCU designation a plus.
  • 7+ years of relevant E&S experience including in-depth knowledge of casualty risks.
  • Strong technical underwriting background with experience in leadership roles.
  • Proven success in building and managing profitable portfolios.
  • In-depth knowledge of insurance markets and trends.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.

Additional Company Details

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting agencies or firms. • Depending on job level, the base salary range is listed below: Team Lead - $135K-$165K AVP, Division Manager - $170K-$200K • Eligible to participate in annual discretionary bonus • Benefits include: Health, dental, vision, dental, life, disability, wellness, paid time off, 401(k) and profit-sharing plans The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment.

Company Details

Berkley Aspire is passionate about making excess and surplus lines business easy to transact.  We differentiate ourselves by continually innovating to bring market-leading technology and services to our agents and their clients. 

From direct bill with installments, to not requiring renewal applications for 80% of our small business policies, we focus on making it easy, expeditious, and efficient for agents and consumers.

Berkley Aspire writes from small, minimum premium, policies to accounts over six figures.  We offer General Liability, Property, Inland Marine and Excess policies through Berkley appointed agencies in 49 states.

Benefit Highlights• Aspire offers Medical, Dental and Vision coverage. Our onsite Scottsdale, AZ Wellness Center and companywide Employee Assistance Program are free to employees and are here to support your overall well-being. Our flexible work schedule with a work-from-home day means you can balance work and life like a pro.• Our Health Savings Accounts have automatic company contributions if you sign up, and we offer Flexible Spending Accounts, STD, LTD, life insurance policies, and more. Plus, we offer a 401(k) program, profit-sharing program, and stock purchase plan – investing in your future has never been so rewarding.• We've got you covered with competitive paid time off, paid sick time, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. Plus, you get paid holidays, a floating holiday, and paid volunteer time – because giving back to the community is important to us at Aspire!• Come grow with us! Level up with company sponsored conferences, tuition assistance, and industry-related education and exams. We have many internal promotional growth opportunities – because we believe in growing together.• We believe in working hard and playing hard. We embrace team building and are enthusiastic about sponsoring fun activities inside and outside of the office. Our Plum Benefits program gives you cost-free access to thousands of exclusive travel and entertainment discounts – it's like a VIP pass to fun.

We’re seeking an E&S Territory Underwriter covering the state of Illinois

This role can be located from remote in Illinois, and drives profitable growth across the state by underwriting new business, managing agency relationships, and identifying new opportunities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Agency Engagement: Build and strengthen agency relationships through education, outreach, and strategic collaboration.
  • Underwriting Excellence: Evaluate risks, set terms, and price policies within authority to meet profitability goals.
  • Performance Goals: Achieve targets for new business, rate changes, and underwriting quality.
  • Service Standards: Deliver timely quotes, endorsements, audits, and policy issuance with precision and consistency.
  • Risk Management: Review inspections, audits, and endorsements to ensure accurate coverage and premium adequacy.
  • Mentorship: Support and coach junior underwriters to build team capability.
  • Reinsurance Coordination: Assess facultative reinsurance needs and manage cession processes.

Qualifications

  • Proven success in commercial P&C underwriting with 5+ years of experience; E&S and surplus lines expertise strongly preferred.
  • Skilled in working with independent agents and managing agency relationships.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficient in Windows-based tools (Word, Excel, Email); experienced in paperless environments and online underwriting platforms (e.g., SAGE, Silver Plume, Reference Connect).
  • This role requires regular travel within the assigned territory—up to 50%—to support business needs, client engagement, and operational effectiveness. Candidates must demonstrate flexibility and readiness to travel approximately 1-2 weeks per month. Travel requirements support making approximately 120 in-person agency visits annually, averaging around 10 visits per month.

Company Details

Berkley Fire & Marine Underwriters (BFM) was launched in 2013 and is a W.R. Berkley operating unit offering specialized underwriting expertise and products and claims management for Inland Marine lines of business. Headquartered in Chicago with offices in Atlanta, Charlotte, Richmond, Cincinnati and Dallas, BFM serves customers on a national basis with regions in the Mid Atlantic, Midwest, South and Western states.

Our culture is one that empowers employees to question the status quo and seek innovative ways to continue to exceed the expectations of our customers. We practice collaboration, ownership, critical thinking, and a professional growth mindset, along with being part of a larger team daily.

Now more than ever, financial strength is critical to a successful, long term insurance relationship. Berkley Fire & Marine Underwriters is a member company of W. R. Berkley Corporation, a Fortune 500 company, whose insurance company subsidiaries are rated A+ (Superior) by A.M. Best.

This role would ideally be based in one of our offices where we offer a hybrid work schedule with 4 days in the office; and 1 day remote where it makes sense to do so. 

  • Atlanta, GA 
  • Denver
  • Chicago
  • Dallas

Alternatively, this position can be fully remote, but only for a colleague outside of a commutable distance to the office. 

#LI-AV1  #LI-Remote

The company is an equal opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

As our VP, Chief Underwriting Officer, you will report directly to the BFM President and be a key member of the senior leadership team.  You will oversee the product to align with our strategy, have oversight of our operating unit portfolio from a macro view and develop standards and acumen to support our underwriters’ efforts to grow profitably while maintaining underwriting compliance and excellence requirements.  This role will liaise with the holding company as it relates to underwriting requirements.  You will partner on strategic planning and overall management of the underwriting discipline to ensure profitable growth. In collaboration with other departments, this role will be responsible for development and successful alignment of BFM’s underwriting strategy, with the goal of maximizing shareholder value and risk-adjusted returns. 

What you can expect:

  • Culture of innovation, teamwork, supportive colleagues and leaders willing to invest in talent
  • Internal mobility opportunities 
  • Visibility to senior leaders and partnership with cross functional teams
  • Opportunity to impact change
  • Benefits – competitive compensation, paid time off, comprehensive wellness benefits and programs, employer funded health savings account, profit sharing, 401k, paid parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, tuition assistance and professional continuing education

We'll count on you to:

  • Oversee the development and management of underwriting strategy, aligning with the overall BFM strategic plan, and translating the strategy into clear underwriting guidelines and limits of authority.
  • Develop Inland Marine products to meet the needs of our underwriting strategy and the attributes of risk that allow us to price and cover exposures properly.
  • Lead market research and stays abreast of emerging trends and identifies innovative products for evaluation and development.
  • Work with Actuarial team to develop pricing and underwriting strategies to attain and improve profitable growth.
  • Evaluate our CAT accumulation and aggregation and develop risk strategies that keep our AAL’s in line with our net loss approaches
  • Collaborate with Regional teams to develop an efficient set of processes that deliver creative, customized underwriting and risk management solutions while meeting the expectations of our partners.
  • Develop and manage both internal and external relationships in a way that strengthens trust in the business partnership.
  • Evaluate the Operating Unit portfolio to reflect an appropriate balance between segments and diversification of line of business.
  • Lead Product Line Reviews
  • Oversee Authority and work with UW Quality Director and Field organization on implementation and maintenance of authority statements and UW Quality standards.
  • Meet as needed with the Senior Leadership Team and President to analyze, recommend, and report on the progress of objectives and projects.
  • Partner with Head of Field Underwriting and Sales on technical development needs and resources for our underwriting community
  • Partner with Underwriting Directors in providing leadership support, mentoring and guidance necessary
  • Anticipate and plan, with the capacity to collaborate with other senior management team members, in a way that fosters innovation.

Qualifications

What you need to have:

  • 10+ years’ experience including products, Property, and Inland Marine underwriting experience
  • History strategic and tactical leadership through influence leadership to a team of talented professionals
  • Demonstrated organizational skills, working with integrity and great strategic foresight
  • Strong interpersonal relationship and communication skills, as well as a desire to collaborate, build rapport, add value, and effectively problem solve
  • Agile and decisive; can work in an ambiguous, dynamic environment while also leading to clarity and solutions; adapts quickly and effectively to change
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of time if necessary

What makes you stand out:

  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Proven track record for finding innovative ways to bring teams together
  • Challenges norms while working collaboratively with colleagues at all levels of the organization

Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. The Sr. Account Manager supports the delivery of employee benefits solutions by partnering with clients, carriers, and internal teams. This role is responsible for managing renewals, analyzing benefit plans, preparing client presentations, coordinating compliance activities, and providing ongoing client support. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong relationship management, analytical, and communication skills while serving as a key contributor to client satisfaction and strategic benefits planning. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Works proactively to build rapport with carrier and client contacts; may take active role in meetings. Communicates directly with clients, carriers, and internal team members through phone, email, virtual meetings, and other remote collaboration tools, in collaboration with senior team members. Prepare and send the request for proposals to applicable insurance carriers and spreadsheets results as they come in. First draft of renewal presentation. Takes the lead on reviewing contracts, benefit plan summaries, and carrier source documents for accuracy in collaboration with the Account Executive or Advisor. May serve as a mentor to more junior team members; assists with training more junior team members Develops and maintains ongoing relationships with clients through regular remote communication. Takes more of an active role in client meetings and calls, including virtual meetings as appropriate. May have direct contact with clients and relies on a growing knowledge of the details of various insurance coverages Continues relationships with carrier representatives to better understand available products and services in the marketplace and recommend them to clients Work with advisors or more senior team members to identify the strategies to meet client needs Review & analyze request for proposals and insurance plan designs, negotiate with carriers and recommend renewal actions in drafts of presentations to be reviewed by Account Executives Assist with client renewals and marketing and client meeting presentations; responsible for first draft of presentations Update benefit guides, ensure client resources and communications are up to date following open enrollment or coverage change Prepare document and data for annual client compliance audits to be presented by Account Executive Attend to client requests including product or vendor service or performance challenges Ensure 5500 form is filed and completed in a timely manner Assembles updates for clients regarding appropriate industry trends and events, including all state and federal regulatory issues in conjunction with Account Executives or Advisors Learns about alternative funding strategies. General client service support in conjunction with the account management team Maintains consistent availability and responsiveness during business hours while working remotely, including timely participation in scheduled calls, virtual meetings, and team communications. Participate in client projects such as implementation of new business, open enrollment process, non-discrimination testing, etc. May provide informal leadership to more junior team members, based on experience, without official supervisory responsibility. Performs other duties as assigned and consistently makes independent judgments subject to general supervisor support. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Knowledge of benefits administration, HealthCare Reform, industry trends, carrier products and services Ability to work independently and anticipate client and team needs Effective time management and decision making skills Diligent follow up skills Ability to express ideas clearly in both written and oral communications Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills Commanding presentation and public speaking abilities Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, including strong self-management, proactive communication, and proficiency with virtual meeting and collaboration tools. Education and/or Experience: Associates degree (or equivalent), and BA/BS preferred More than 3 years’ client service and/or industry and product line experience Certificates, Licenses, Registration: Life, Accident and Health Insurance License required within six months. Physical Demand: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to handle or feel and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand and walk. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distance vision. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $52,700 – $65,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! Job.JobTitle: Benefits Operations Data & EDI Analyst (Remote ET)
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. PPI Benefit Solutions (part of NFP, an Aon Company) provides benefits administration services and technology designed to simplify the employee benefits experience for employers and their employees. With more than 50 years of insurance and benefits administration experience, PPI supports organizations through benefits enrollment, eligibility management, carrier integrations, billing, and ongoing administration. PPI combines technology with hands-on service to help streamline benefits processes, maintain accurate eligibility information, and support connections between employers, carriers, brokers, and other benefits partners. Summary The Benefit Operations Data Analyst is responsible for reviewing, manipulating, validating, testing, and reconciling benefits eligibility data, with a strong focus on Microsoft Excel and 834 EDI eligibility files. This role requires the ability to work efficiently with large Excel data sets, transform and format data to meet specific requirements, compare information across multiple sources, identify discrepancies, and ensure accuracy before data is imported into internal or external systems. The Analyst also supports the testing, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of incoming 834 EDI eligibility files from clients and trading partners. Working closely with internal teams, clients, carriers, brokers, and vendors, this role helps identify and resolve data issues to ensure eligibility information is transmitted, processed, and maintained accurately. This position requires exceptional attention to detail, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities and deadlines simultaneously. This is a data operations role rather than a data engineering or programming position. The role does not require SQL, Python, or software development experience. This position offers the flexibility to work hybrid from our Wallingford, CT office or fully remote from anywhere in the U.S. The standard work schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, regardless of residential time zone. Essential functions Excel Data Analysis & File Preparation Manipulate, reformat, validate, and analyze large data sets using Microsoft Excel for system imports, file production, reconciliation, and data comparison. Compare data from multiple sources to identify discrepancies in eligibility, demographics, coverage, effective dates, terminations, and other benefit-related information. Prepare data for import into internal and vendor systems by ensuring required fields, formats, values, and relationships meet established specifications. Perform detailed reconciliation following imports, exports, and file processing to confirm that records were processed completely and accurately. Use Excel functions and tools such as XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, sorting, filtering, conditional formatting, text functions, PivotTables, and data validation to efficiently analyze and transform data. Investigate data discrepancies and determine whether issues originate from source data, formatting, file configuration, system processing, or business rules. 834 EDI Testing & Implementation Perform testing, implementation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of incoming ANSI X12 834 benefit enrollment and eligibility files. Review 834 files for proper enrollment transactions, demographic information, benefit elections, effective dates, terminations, identifiers, and other required eligibility information. Validate incoming file results against source data and expected enrollment outcomes. Coordinate testing with clients, vendors, trading partners, and internal teams through implementation and production readiness. Identify file-level and member-level discrepancies and communicate findings clearly to the appropriate stakeholders. Support ongoing production files by researching processing issues, eligibility discrepancies, and unexpected file results. Document testing results, outstanding issues, resolutions, and implementation decisions. Data Imports, Exports & Reconciliation Perform data import and export activities of varying complexity for new client implementations, renewals, benefit changes, and ongoing eligibility maintenance. Review incoming data before import to identify formatting or data-quality issues that could impact processing. Validate and reconcile imported data to ensure expected records and benefit elections were processed accurately. Create and maintain outbound data files, reports, and other deliverables as required. Assist with manual eligibility updates when necessary while maintaining a high level of accuracy. File Transmission & Troubleshooting Support secure file delivery and receipt through established FTP and SFTP processes and other approved transmission methods. Troubleshoot file receipt, formatting, processing, and transmission issues in partnership with internal teams and external trading partners. Monitor and follow up on outstanding file or data issues to ensure timely resolution. Communication & Workload Management Communicate clearly and professionally with clients, carriers, brokers, vendors, and internal teams regarding testing, data discrepancies, implementation status, and required corrections. Manage multiple client implementations, testing activities, production issues, and recurring responsibilities simultaneously while meeting established deadlines. Maintain organized documentation and follow-up for outstanding issues and deliverables. Escalate risks, discrepancies, or delays appropriately. Process Improvement Identify opportunities to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and consistency of data processes. Develop and maintain procedures, documentation, checklists, and other resources supporting Data Operations. Participate in system and process improvement initiatives by providing business requirements and operational expertise. Assist with departmental training and knowledge sharing as needed. Complete special projects and additional responsibilities as assigned. Required qualifications Strong Microsoft Excel skills with demonstrated experience manipulating, reformatting, comparing, and analyzing large data sets. Experience using Excel functions and tools such as XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, sorting/filtering, conditional formatting, text manipulation, and PivotTables. Ability to analyze data from multiple sources and identify discrepancies, missing information, and unexpected results. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments, deadlines, and competing priorities. Strong analytical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to clearly explain data discrepancies and technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams and external partners. Strong follow-through and ownership of assigned responsibilities and outstanding issues. Preferred qualifications 2+ years of experience working with eligibility, enrollment, benefits administration, EDI, or related healthcare data. Hands-on experience working with ANSI X12 834 EDI benefit enrollment/eligibility files (highly preferred) Experience working with health and welfare benefit eligibility data, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, or other benefit elections. Experience performing enrollment reconciliation between source data, eligibility systems, and carrier data. Experience with secure file transmission processes such as SFTP or FTP. Experience working in a benefits administration, TPA, benefits consulting, carrier, or HR technology environment. What We Offer: NFP is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO and paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health and wellness programs, and more. Our people-first culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $60,000 – $75,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. 2591158

This position requires exceptional attention to detail, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities and deadlines simultaneously. This is a data operations role rather than a data engineering or programming position. The role does not require SQL, Python, or software development experience. This position offers the flexibility to work hybrid from our Wallingford, CT office or fully remote from anywhere in the U.S. The standard work schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, regardless of residential time zone. Essential functions Excel Data Analysis & File Preparation Manipulate, reformat, validate, and analyze large data sets using Microsoft Excel for system imports, file production, reconciliation, and data comparison. Compare data from multiple sources to identify discrepancies in eligibility, demographics, coverage, effective dates, terminations, and other benefit-related information. Prepare data for import into internal and vendor systems by ensuring required fields, formats, values, and relationships meet established specifications. Perform detailed reconciliation following imports, exports, and file processing to confirm that records were processed completely and accurately. Use Excel functions and tools such as XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, sorting, filtering, conditional formatting, text functions, PivotTables, and data validation to efficiently analyze and transform data. Investigate data discrepancies and determine whether issues originate from source data, formatting, file configuration, system processing, or business rules. 834 EDI Testing & Implementation Perform testing, implementation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of incoming ANSI X12 834 benefit enrollment and eligibility files. Review 834 files for proper enrollment transactions, demographic information, benefit elections, effective dates, terminations, identifiers, and other required eligibility information. Validate incoming file results against source data and expected enrollment outcomes. Coordinate testing with clients, vendors, trading partners, and internal teams through implementation and production readiness. Identify file-level and member-level discrepancies and communicate findings clearly to the appropriate stakeholders. Support ongoing production files by researching processing issues, eligibility discrepancies, and unexpected file results. Document testing results, outstanding issues, resolutions, and implementation decisions. Data Imports, Exports & Reconciliation Perform data import and export activities of varying complexity for new client implementations, renewals, benefit changes, and ongoing eligibility maintenance. Review incoming data before import to identify formatting or data-quality issues that could impact processing. Validate and reconcile imported data to ensure expected records and benefit elections were processed accurately. Create and maintain outbound data files, reports, and other deliverables as required. Assist with manual eligibility updates when necessary while maintaining a high level of accuracy. File Transmission & Troubleshooting Support secure file delivery and receipt through established FTP and SFTP processes and other approved transmission methods. Troubleshoot file receipt, formatting, processing, and transmission issues in partnership with internal teams and external trading partners. Monitor and follow up on outstanding file or data issues to ensure timely resolution. Communication & Workload Management Communicate clearly and professionally with clients, carriers, brokers, vendors, and internal teams regarding testing, data discrepancies, implementation status, and required corrections. Manage multiple client implementations, testing activities, production issues, and recurring responsibilities simultaneously while meeting established deadlines. Maintain organized documentation and follow-up for outstanding issues and deliverables. Escalate risks, discrepancies, or delays appropriately. Process Improvement Identify opportunities to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and consistency of data processes. Develop and maintain procedures, documentation, checklists, and other resources supporting Data Operations. Participate in system and process improvement initiatives by providing business requirements and operational expertise. Assist with departmental training and knowledge sharing as needed. Complete special projects and additional responsibilities as assigned. Required qualifications Strong Microsoft Excel skills with demonstrated experience manipulating, reformatting, comparing, and analyzing large data sets. Experience using Excel functions and tools such as XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, sorting/filtering, conditional formatting, text manipulation, and PivotTables. Ability to analyze data from multiple sources and identify discrepancies, missing information, and unexpected results. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments, deadlines, and competing priorities. Strong analytical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to clearly explain data discrepancies and technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams and external partners. Strong follow-through and ownership of assigned responsibilities and outstanding issues. Preferred qualifications 2+ years of experience working with eligibility, enrollment, benefits administration, EDI, or related healthcare data. Hands-on experience working with ANSI X12 834 EDI benefit enrollment/eligibility files (highly preferred) Experience working with health and welfare benefit eligibility data, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, or other benefit elections. Experience performing enrollment reconciliation between source data, eligibility systems, and carrier data. Experience with secure file transmission processes such as SFTP or FTP. Experience working in a benefits administration, TPA, benefits consulting, carrier, or HR technology environment. What We Offer: NFP is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO and paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health and wellness programs, and more. Our people-first culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Do you enjoy collaborating closely with the business rather than practicing law from the sidelines? As our Corporate Counsel (P&C), you'll support our evolving insurance businesses and work directly with the people making day-to-day decisions. The work ranges from high-volume contracts such as NDAs to more nuanced carrier, MGA/MGU and regulatory matters. You'll have room to take ownership, develop relationships and become a trusted legal resource for the businesses you support. This role is a strong fit for an attorney who understands how the P&C insurance business operates and can turn legal analysis into practical guidance. Experience working with insurance carriers, MGAs/MGUs, brokers or related insurance businesses is especially valuable. Prior business-side insurance experience is also welcome. What You'll Do Draft, review and negotiate carrier agreements, MGA/MGU and program administrator agreements, client service agreements, NDAs and other commercial contracts. Advise business teams on P&C insurance operations, regulatory matters, risk management and contract issues. Review carrier and client agreements, identify meaningful legal and business risks, and recommend practical solutions. Support MGA/MGU operations and carrier relationships as business needs and regulatory requirements evolve. Partner directly with business leaders to understand their objectives and provide timely, business-focused legal guidance. Handle routine agreements efficiently while knowing when an issue requires deeper analysis or escalation. Ask questions, gather information and collaborate across legal and business teams to resolve issues. Monitor relevant P&C insurance regulatory developments and help the business respond to changing requirements. Contribute to legal team initiatives and share knowledge with colleagues across the organization. Qualifications: Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and an active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction. 5+ years of legal experience involving the property and casualty insurance industry. Experience working with an insurance carrier, MGA/MGU, insurance broker, regulatory agency or insurance-focused law practice. Experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements. Strong solid understanding of P&C insurance operations and the relationships among carriers, brokers and insurance intermediaries. Ability to identify legal and business risks and translate them into clear, practical recommendations. Ability to independently manage priorities, follow through on commitments and seek additional information when needed. Communication skills that build credibility with legal colleagues and business partners. Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable: Carrier agreements or carrier relationship management MGA, MGU or program administrator operations Commercial Lines insurance Retail insurance brokerage P&C insurance regulatory matters Claims or related risk issues Business-side experience within the insurance industry Technology or AI tools used for legal research, drafting or workflow improvement What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. The base salary range for this position is $163,100 – $190,000. Posting Description About the Company: Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services - empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence. With over 1,200 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first - our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers. Job Summary This internship offers hands-on experience in accounting and financial operations, including bookkeeping, accounts payable, reconciliations, financial reporting, and maintaining financial records using tools such as QuickBooks Online and Bill.com. It’s ideal for an Accounting student who is detail-oriented, organized, comfortable with Excel, and eager to gain practical accounting experience in a professional environment. Key responsibilities include: Support day-to-day bookkeeping and general accounting activities. Assist with the preparation of financial reports and cash flow analyses. Process accounts payable transactions accurately and timely using Bill.com. Assist with bank and credit card reconciliations and help resolve discrepancies. Enter, review, and maintain financial information in QuickBooks Online and other accounting systems. Maintain organized and accurate accounting records and supporting documentation. Provide support for special projects and administrative tasks, as assigned. Qualifications: Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field; junior or senior standing is preferred. Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to accuracy. Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel; familiarity with QuickBooks Online or Bill.com is a plus. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage time, prioritize assignments, and meet deadlines in a professional environment. Collaborative, dependable, and eager to learn with a positive, professional approach. Do you see yourself excelling in this position? Don't hesitate to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification on the list. We recognize that career journeys are as unique as individuals themselves, and valuable skills can come in various forms. We're eager to learn about your unique talents and experiences! The hourly range for this position is $18.00 – $20.00 per hour. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. Job.JobTitle: Commercial Lines, Account Manager (remote-PST, MT, CST)
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the world address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Job Summary: The Commercial Lines Account Manager is responsible for working with Producers to service their client accounts. This is a generalist book of coverages with special emphasis on trucking and transportation clients. The position requires day-to-day client servicing for a specific set of clients and entails verbal, electronic and other written communications. The Account Manager will manage an assigned book of business, handling endorsements, binding policies, setting up financing, issuing certificates, billing, and responding to requests and questions from the insured and underwriters. You will also be involved in the renewal and marketing process, preparing proposals, obtaining signed applications, securing payment, and putting bind paperwork together. Work is completed with a significant amount of independent discretion. While in this role, you should be developing relationships with clients and carrier contacts and working proactively to efficiently and effectively respond to their needs. This is a full-time remote position working in either PST, MT or CST time zone. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Works proactively to develop relationships with carrier and client contacts and takes an active role in meetings. Bind and endorse policies, issue certificates, bill invoices, request payments, and have contact with all assigned clients verbally and by email regularly. Communicates directly with clients and carriers to obtain accurate information to market renewals. Prepare and send the request for renewal quotations to applicable insurance carriers and propose to insured. Duties also include quoting policy changes, facilitating financing, collecting additional premium and down payments and ensuring carrier payments are received. Responsible for updating and keeping client policy records in the agency management system. Answers incoming calls and emails, responding to client questions as needed. Posting Description Who We Are: Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services—empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence. With over 1,200 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first—our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers. Key Responsibilities Plan Administration & Compliance Be responsible for the full administration cycle for a block of defined contribution retirement plans Perform non-discrimination and compliance testing, including ADP/ACP, 410(b) coverage, top-heavy, 415 annual addition limit, 401(a)(4) cross-testing and other necessary measurements Calculate and allocate employer contributions Reconcile payroll contributions to determine prior activity aligns with prior instructions and reconcile employee census data to determine current year plan eligibility Review and approve participant distribution and loan requests performed by a centralized, supporting group Review Qualified Domestic Relations Orders (QDROs) and calculate distributions to alternate payees Reconcile trust assets and contributions, interpreting trust financial statements to resolve discrepancies Support plan conversions and takeovers, including coordination with prior TPAs, investment advisors, and clients Interpret plan document provisions to ensure accurate, compliant administration Ensure clients adhere to government filing and regulatory requirements Government Filings & Regulatory Support Complete, review, and provide audit support for Forms 5500, 5330, 8955-SSA, 1099-R, and related schedules Review and validate work completed by other plan administrators and support staff to ensure accuracy prior to delivery Maintain and expand ERISA compliance and software knowledge in step with evolving regulations and our evolving technology platform capabilities Client & Relationship Management Serve as the primary point of contact and consultant for an assigned block of clients, guiding plan design and ongoing maintenance to meet their needs Consult with clients on the timely deposit and remittance of deferrals and employer contributions Assist clients in navigating plan sponsor and participant recordkeeping portals Accompany relationship managers to client and participant meetings, contributing to discussion and presentation of plan results Develop effective working relationships with clients, internal teams, and external advisors, recordkeepers, and auditors supporting shared client relationships Identify and surface opportunities for new business development Analysis & Communication Review, analyze, and summarize plan data in clear, succinct written communication to support Advisors, Consultants, and fellow Plan Administrators Serve as a technical resource for research and plan analysis projects for internal and external clients Professional Development Align with continuing education requirements and pursue ongoing credentialing Participate in professional organizations and independent study to stay current on ERISA and industry developments Integrate new knowledge and skills into daily work, sharing insights with colleagues as appropriate Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree in business administration, business analytics, mathematical economics, finance, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. High school diploma required. Experience Three to five years of directly related experience in retirement plan administration and consulting. Credentialing (one or more preferred): ASPPA: Qualified 401(k) Administrator (QKA), Qualified Plan Specialist (QKS), Qualified 401(k) Consultant (QKC), and/or Qualified Pension Administrator (QPA) NIPA: Accredited 401(k) Specialist (AKS), Accredited Pension Administrator (APA), and/or Accredited Pension Representative (APR) IRS Enrolled Retirement Plan Agent (ERPA) NAPA: Certified Plan Fiduciary Advisor (CPFA) and/or Qualified Plan Financial Consultant (QPFC) Technical Skills Experience with Stax.ai, FT William, and PensionPro strongly preferred; familiarity with ASC a plus. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams. High degree of technical and legal knowledge, including familiarity with the Internal Revenue Code and ERISA as they apply to qualified plans. Skills You'll Use Every Day Communication – effective oral, written, and interpersonal skills; communicates clearly and interactively with team members and support staff Judgment & problem-solving – proven organizational and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment on plan design and compliance matters Client service – demonstrated ability to deliver quality customer service while managing multiple tasks with a high degree of accuracy Ownership – a sense of urgency and commitment to timely, high-quality project completion, balanced with attention to detail and confidentiality Collaboration – ability to work independently and within a team, bringing a positive, proactive, and entrepreneurial mindset Do you see yourself excelling in this position? Don't hesitate to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification on the list. We recognize that career journeys are as unique as individuals themselves, and valuable skills can come in various forms. We're eager to learn about your unique talents and experiences. What We Offer: Wealthspire Advisors is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $75,000 – $85,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. Wealthspire and You... Serving as the lead consultant and primary point of contact, this role provides strategic guidance and oversight across all aspects of client service. This individual independently prepares applications, specifications, and marketing strategies for the renewal of assigned accounts with minimal supervision. The Senior Account Executive supports middle market clients and may manage large, complex accounts involving significant premiums and multifaceted insurance programs, requiring a high level of technical expertise and consultative judgment. Clients may include organizations within construction, human services, or municipal sectors, each with distinct risk and coverage considerations. This is a full‑time role that offers the flexibility of a remote schedule from anywhere in the U.S. The standard work schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, regardless of residential time zone. When working remotely, employees must have access to a confidential, uninterrupted workspace and reliable high‑speed internet. Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary of Job As the Senior Data Analyst at NFP, you will support Implementation Leads throughout the data conversion lifecycle, including the extraction, transformation, mapping, validation, and migration of data from legacy agency management systems to NFP's standard operating platforms. This role works closely with agencies, project teams, conversion vendors, and development resources to ensure converted data is accurate, complete, and delivered in accordance with implementation achievements. Responsibilities Gather and examine data from source systems available in multiple formats. Convert this data into uniform conversion templates using Microsoft Excel, SQL, Alteryx, and other Microsoft data and analytics tools. Work directly with customers to facilitate data-related meetings, communicate requirements, track decisions, and supervise data cleanup activities through completion. Collaborate with agency partners, Implementation Leads, and Project Leads to map data from source systems to destination platforms and resolve mapping questions or data discrepancies. Prepare, analyze, and format carrier, employee, and other configuration-related data for agency review, mapping decisions, and setup within the destination agency management system. Identify data quality risks, anomalies, and trends, and recommend appropriate cleanup or remediation actions. Over 5 years of experience in data analysis, data transformation, data conversion, or related roles using Microsoft Excel, SQL, Alteryx, database tools, or comparable technologies. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, lookup functions, PivotTables, VBA and data analysis techniques. Demonstrated experience analyzing large or complex datasets and identifying data quality issues, discrepancies, and patterns. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. Ability to understand source and destination data structures and translate business requirements into mapping and conversion requirements. Proven ability to prioritize multiple tasks, meet critical deadlines, and drive assigned work to completion with limited oversight. Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and business priorities. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead customer-facing meetings and clearly convey technical or data-related concepts to various audiences. Strong interpersonal and collaboration abilities with the capacity to work effectively across business, technical, vendor, and customer groups. High degree of personal and business integrity, accountability, initiative, and professionalism. Ability to travel ~ 10%. Ability to support occasional after-hours or weekend activities during critical conversion and implementation events. Preferred Requirements Experience within the insurance, brokerage, or agency management industry. Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server. Experience working with Microsoft Fabric, Dataflows Gen2, or comparable Microsoft data technologies. Experience with Alteryx or comparable data preparation and transformation tools. Familiarity with agency management or insurance operating systems. Experience converting or migrating data from one enterprise system to another. Experience in data mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation. Experience supporting large-scale system implementations, migrations, or enterprise transformation initiatives. Experience building or employing automation to streamline data preparation, conversion, validation, and reconciliation processes. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. Posting Description Who We Are: Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services - empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence. With over 1,400 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first - our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Key Responsibilities: Provide support to Advisors in all areas of financial planning. Initiate and field client calls on various items (e.g., strategy ideas, account specific questions, portfolio inquiries, etc.). Create proposals for prospective clients. Create and/or update financial plans for clients. Prepare materials for client meetings; work with other internal teams to ensure client meetings are prepared for thoroughly and accurately. Attend client meetings and manage/complete all meeting follow-up activities. Liaise with client’s attorneys and accountants as needed. Monitor portfolios and maintain portfolio target allocations. Rebalance portfolios as needed. Assist with client data consolidation and maintenance as needed. Assist with special projects as required. Qualifications: One to four years of relevant experience. Preferred or pursuing CFP®, CFA or JD. Bachelors’ degree or higher from an accredited university; major in financial planning, business, accounting, finance, economics, or law preferred. Continuously exhibits personal integrity and professional initiative. Reliable, follows through on commitments, self-starter when it comes to new challenges. Must be organized, detail-oriented and able to manage and prioritize tasks. Demonstrates a commitment to accuracy by delivering high quality work. Excellent written and verbal communication. Collaborative and able to work effectively with others. What We Offer: Wealthspire is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, and more. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. Wealthspire is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer. #Wealthspire 2592134

We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Summary: NFP’s Professional Liability practice is seeking a licensed P&C Broker to support placements across Management Liability, Cyber, and Professional Liability lines of coverage. This role can sit remote, hybrid, or in-office, with a preference for candidates based on the East Coast or near an NFP office. This is an opportunity for a broker who can operate with a high level of independence, managing their own book of business while continuing to build expertise in complex professional liability exposures. The role is best suited for an individual early to mid-career who is ready for increased responsibility and hands-on broking experience, but who is still looking to deepen their technical knowledge across these lines. The team is seeking someone who can come in with a strong foundation, contribute immediately, and grow into a more specialized broker over time. Candidates may come from a generalist background or a smaller brokerage environment, with exposure to multiple lines of coverage. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Proactively coordinate broking around the renewal cycle in accordance to NFP’s service model standards and timelines Support placement of Management Liability, Cyber, and Professional Liability programs, developing go-to-market strategies for each client or prospect Negotiate with insurance carriers to secure competitive terms, conditions, and pricing, while building a strong understanding of client risk profiles Partner with account management teams to prepare and market submissions, respond to underwriter inquiries, and evaluate carrier quotes Analyze coverage options and present clear, strategic recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders Assist in preparing proposals, coverage comparisons, and client-facing materials Respond to client inquiries and support issue resolution in a timely and professional manner Review binders and policies to ensure accuracy of terms and conditions Participate in client meetings, presentations, and renewal discussions as part of the broking team Develop and maintain strong relationships with carriers, wholesalers, and internal partners Build working knowledge of the professional liability marketplace, including emerging trends in cyber and management liability Support cross-sell and upsell opportunities across NFP’s broader platform Maintain accurate and organized client and broking data within internal systems Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex coverage concepts clearly Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams Strong negotiation and analytical skills, with attention to detail Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Foundational knowledge of P&C coverages; exposure to management liability, cyber, or professional liability is preferred but not required Ability to learn quickly and build technical expertise over time Positive, proactive attitude with a strong sense of ownership and accountability Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with Epic a plus Education and/or Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred Minimum of three to five years insurance experience Background as a generalist broker or experience across multiple lines Certificates, Licenses, Registration: P&C License required What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $68,000.00 – $98,000.00. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! As an Employee Benefits Consultant, you'll serve as the primary advisor for a portfolio of clients, helping employers design, manage, and optimize their employee benefits programs. You'll lead client strategy, renewal planning, and ongoing consulting initiatives while partnering with internal teams to deliver outstanding service! This role blends relationship management, benefits expertise, financial analysis, and problem-solving, offering the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both client success and business growth. This position is ideally based in Austin, Texas, where team members participate in a hybrid work environment that balances in-person collaboration with flexibility. However, we are open to considering exceptional candidates outside the market for a fully remote arrangement. Key Responsibilities: Client Management Responsible for ongoing client satisfaction. Ensure clients receive timely and effective solutions to their needs, fostering long-term relationships. Be accountable to retain clients, ensuring their continued satisfaction and loyalty. Implement strategies to maintain high client retention rates and address any issues promptly. Focus on growing current clients, making sure their needs are fulfilled and looking for opportunities to expand. Absorb new clients into the book, providing them with exceptional service and support. Serve as the main strategic point of contact, addressing their needs and concerns. Provide clients with consistent and reliable support, ensuring their satisfaction and loyalty. Strategic Planning Take charge of accounts within the book of business, making strategic decisions to optimize benefits for clients. Develop and implement innovative approaches to enhance client benefits and satisfaction. Identify and drive opportunities for client expansion, exploring new benefit options and solutions. Proactively seek ways to improve client offerings and add value to their benefit plans. Financial Management Be responsible for running a book of $500k-5 million dollars of annual revenue. Ensure financial targets are met and optimize revenue streams through effective client management. Team Collaboration Collaborating with the Account Manager Team on annual execution of core work, ensuring all deliverables are met. Coordinate and lead all aspects of the completion of key projects and initiatives throughout the year. Collaborate closely with the Managing Consultant and Producer to ensure the success of each account. Work together to align strategies and goals, ensuring seamless service delivery. Industry Knowledge Stay informed about industry trends, new strategies, and cutting-edge solutions. Continuously update knowledge to provide clients with the latest and most effective benefit options. Provide thought leadership and innovative solutions to clients, positioning the company as a leader in the industry. Share insights and expertise to help clients navigate complex benefit landscapes. Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities: Strong understanding of benefits administration, industry trends, and carrier products and services. Proven track record to manage client relationships and anticipate client needs. Excellent communication skills, both written and oral. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Passion for developing and building strength and capabilities in a team. Education and/or Experience: 6+ years of experience in employee benefits or a related field. Preferably a bachelor's degree. Job.JobTitle: Regional Vice President, Benefits Compliance (Eastern Region)
Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com. Job summary: Under the general direction of the Regional Vice President (RVP), Group Leader, the RVP, Benefits Compliance, Atlantic Region will join a team of other compliance attorneys and specialists dedicated to providing exemplary benefits compliance support services. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing guidance to our employee benefit consultants and their clients on compliance with a broad range of laws applicable to health and welfare plans, including ERISA, PPACA, COBRA, HIPAA, Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act, Transparency in Coverage and No Surprises Acts, Internal Revenue Code (including Section 125), FSAs, HRAs, HSAs, FMLA and other state and federal laws. This role requires understanding relevant laws and explaining benefits compliance inquiries in language accessible to laypeople. The individual must communicate clearly with benefits brokers, consultants, and employer clients. Responsibilities include reviewing employee benefits compliance checklists, assisting with seminars and webinars, and offering internal training to employee benefit consultants and their clients across the Atlantic Region as assigned by market segment. Physical proximity to the East Coast preferred. Essential duties and responsibilities Perform compliance checklist reviews for key and national account clients, including pre-checklist review and detailed follow-up in coordination with account management teams. Respond to benefits compliance questions in a timely manner, often within 24 hours. Stay abreast of the changing legislative and regulatory landscape, to include statutory legislation and regulation impacting the Region. Attend internal Benefits Compliance Team meetings regularly. Attend internal regional and office-specific meetings (Team Lead, office-specific, etc.) regularly. Own or co-own regional compliance initiatives in conjunction with regional sales and account management leaders, including regular regional decisions, education, and webinar training. Communicate and educate account teams (and clients, as relevant) on compliance initiatives and resources, including Compliance Toolkits, Publications, and NFP Connect. Conduct or support benefits compliance seminars and webinars. Contribute to the overall mission of the Benefits Compliance Department including other duties as assigned by the team and/or the Regional Leads. Knowledge, skills, and/or abilities Must have knowledge of laws and regulations governing health and welfare plans. Must have clear communication skills and ability to explain compliance in easy to understand and accessible language to internal and external stakeholders. Job.JobDescription:
Posting Description Who We Are: Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services—empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence. With over $580B in assets under advisement, and more than 1,200 employees across 40+ offices, we deliver insights and solutions grounded in deep research, advanced technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first—our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers. Key responsibilities include: Assist with the development and preparation of client financial plans. Support portfolio construction, analysis, and client portfolio reviews. Reconcile and review financial data to ensure accuracy and completeness. Conduct investment and market research to support client needs and firm initiatives. Assist with the review and allocation of 529 college savings plans. Research client-specific questions and issues and present findings to team members. Collaborate with colleagues across the firm to gain exposure to different areas of the business. Develop and present clear, concise analysis and recommendations. Qualifications: Pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Finance preferred, or an undergraduate/graduate degree program aligned with the CFP® certification. Demonstrated interest in financial planning and wealth management. Demonstrates integrity, professionalism, and initiative. Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Highly organized and detail-oriented. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Collaborative and able to work effectively in a team environment. Do you see yourself excelling in this position? Don't hesitate to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification on the list! We recognize that career journeys are as unique as individuals themselves, and valuable skills can come in various forms. We're eager to learn about your unique talents and experiences! The hourly range for this position is $20.00 – $22.00 per hour. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.
